papers.title: Benchmarking Neural Decoders for Brain-Computer Interfaces and Neural Population Analysis
papers.abstract: Abstract The most accurate neural decoder on held-out trials is not necessarily the most useful for brain-computer interfaces or neural population analysis. In practical use, neural decoders may also need to remain robust to noisy neural inputs, satisfy calibration or deployment constraints, and produce comparable representations across recordings. We introduce BEND-BCI, an open-source benchmark of 23 neural decoding methods on motor, visual, speech and spatial decoding tasks across 16 real or synthetic neural recordings. BEND-BCI compares decoders across held-out prediction, robustness to input perturbation, computational cost and cross-recording latent consistency. These additional axes frequently changed decoder rankings: held-out accuracy did not reliably identify the most robust, efficient or cross-recording-consistent models. Simpler baselines were also competitive with, and in some cases outperformed, more heavily parameterized deep neural networks. Diagnostic analyses based on explainable machine learning further showed that decoder performance was associated with the use of expected neural features and could be improved by selecting high-quality training trials. BEND-BCI reframes neural-decoder selection from an accuracy leaderboard into a constrained decision over task, resource, representation and diagnostic goals.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文没有提出新解码模型，而是构建了一个叫BEND-BCI的开源评测基准，用16个真实/合成神经数据集、23种现有解码方法，在预测准确率之外系统评估鲁棒性、计算开销、跨记录表征一致性等4个实用维度，发现单纯追求测试集准确率会误导实际选型。
analysis.claim: 神经解码器的实际效用不能仅由held-out准确率决定，必须在鲁棒性、效率、跨记录一致性等约束条件下综合评估，而现有基准严重缺失这些维度。
analysis.input: 神经活动数据（如spike counts/LFP/Neural Latents）
analysis.output: 行为或感知变量的预测（如手部轨迹/图像重建/语音特征/空间位置）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖16个公开或合成神经记录数据集，含真实电生理数据（如NeuroPort、Utah array），但未要求用户采集新真实机器人交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 属重磅方法论贡献：首次系统解构‘解码器实用性’的多维评价体系，覆盖真实BCI部署的关键瓶颈（噪声鲁棒、低延迟、跨天/跨电极一致性），且全部开源可复现；虽未达90+级临床闭环突破（如实时语音合成、瘫痪者自然行走），但为整个领域提供了不可替代的评估基础设施和认知框架，证据扎实（16数据集、23方法、4轴对比、消融式诊断分析）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：不是新模型突破，而是把散落的解码器、数据集和现实约束拧成一套可复现、可诊断、可决策的评测范式，显著提升领域工程化成熟度。

papers.title: Human Universal Grasping
papers.abstract: Humans can grasp objects effortlessly, whereas multi-fingered robots are far from this level of generality. We argue that the most natural source of robot grasping data is from humans, who pick up thousands of objects every day. We present HUG, a flow-matching model that generates diverse human grasps for any user-specified object in a single RGB-D image captured from a stereo camera. Using smart glasses, we first collect 1M-HUGs, an egocentric dataset of human grasps spanning 1M frames (27.8 hrs) and 6,707 object instances across 41 buildings. Next, to model the distribution of natural human grasps, our novel flow-matching model fuses RGB and depth observations to output a grasp parameterized by wrist translation, wrist rotation, and MANO hand pose. Predicted grasps can be retargeted to various robot hands, enabling zero-shot grasping in everyday scenes. To standardize evaluation, we build a new simulated benchmark, HUG-Bench, of 90 unseen objects from five geometric categories and various sizes, with metric-scale 3D meshes. We evaluate HUG in the real world on the 30-object test set of HUG-Bench across multiple stereo cameras, robot embodiments, and household environments. HUG outperforms the state-of-the-art grasping baselines by +23% and +34% on our challenging object set. Code, data, benchmark, checkpoints, and an interactive demo are released on our website: https://grasping.io/

analysis.tldr: 用人类日常抓取的100万帧RGB-D数据训练了一个flow-matching模型HUG，输入单张RGB-D图就能生成符合人体自然习惯的完整手部姿态（手腕位姿+MANO手型），再迁移到多种机器人手上实现零样本抓取，在90个未见物体的仿真+30个真实物体跨相机/跨机器人/跨家庭环境测试中大幅超越现有方法。
analysis.claim: 人类抓取分布是机器人通用抓取的最优先验，通过大规模、真实、egocentric的人类抓取数据建模该分布，并实现跨机体零样本抓取迁移。
analysis.input: 单张RGB-D图像（来自双目相机）
analysis.output: 参数化的抓取姿态（手腕平移+旋转+MANO手部关节角度）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实人类抓取视频数据（1M-HUGs），但不依赖机器人执行数据
analysis.significance_reason: 达到ALOHA/ACT级分量：首次构建百万级真实人类抓取视频数据集（非动作捕捉、非实验室摆拍），提出面向抓取的flow-matching建模范式，完成从人类抓取分布→机器人零样本部署的全链路验证（含多机体、多环境、多视角真实测试），且全部开源；相比LUCID（93分，仅从无结构视频学习意图）更聚焦抓取物理可行性，相比Dexterous Point Policy（95分，需机器人真机演示）更彻底摆脱对机器人数据的依赖，属具身智能中‘人类先验驱动’范式的标志性落地。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是改进某个模块，而是确立了‘以人类自然抓取为唯一监督信号’的新技术路线，并用百万级真实数据、新模型、新评测、全开源和跨平台部署完整闭环验证。

papers.title: Behavior Foundations for Quadruped Robots: ABot-C0 Technical Report
papers.abstract: In embodied intelligence systems, the motion controller serves as the critical bridge between semantic reasoning and physical execution. Humanoid control has progressed rapidly through large-scale human motion-capture data and motion-tracking paradigm. However, producing quadruped robots motion corpora with scalability and physical feasibility faces more fundamental obstacles: animal motion data is scarce, and cross-embodiment retargeting remains fragile. We present ABot-C0, a generalist motion-control system for quadruped robots that establishes three complementary behavior foundations: a scalable multi-source motion-data pipeline, robust policy learning across motion tracking, locomotion, and scene interaction, and a unified deployment stack for reliable real-world operation. Fundamentally, we construct a data pyramid through conditional video-generation synthesis, annotated motion capture, teleoperation and human design, producing 16,074 physically feasible motion clips as the data foundation for various motion learning demands. We then train a Flow-Matching generalist policy that demonstrates for the first time quadruped motion tracking scaling law that its performance improves consistently as training scales up, with zero-shot capability to track unseen motions. Then, we push a step further for robust all-terrain traversal locomotion by adopting a three-stage privileged-to-perceptive framework with temporal LiDAR memory and terrain-predictive supervision. Collectively, these components form a motion generalist that coordinates multi-policy execution, smooth behavior transitions, energy-efficient control, and safety mechanisms for real-world deployment. Extensive experiments on urban-terrain autonomous navigation and companion-style multimodal interaction demonstrate that quadruped robots move beyond single-function demos toward product-level behavioral intelligence.

analysis.tldr: 构建了首个面向四足机器人的通用运动控制系统ABot-C0，通过多源合成+人工标注+遥操作构建1.6万段物理可行运动片段数据集，训练出首个展现缩放律的四足运动跟踪通用策略，并用三级特权感知框架实现全地形鲁棒行走，最终在真实城市地形导航和多模态陪伴交互中完成端到端部署。
analysis.claim: 四足机器人可通过构建可扩展的多源运动数据金字塔与分层特权感知策略架构，实现跨任务、跨地形、跨模态的通用行为智能，且具备真实场景部署能力。
analysis.input: RGB视频+LiDAR时序记忆+地形语义预测+语言/语音/手势等多模态指令
analysis.output: 关节级低层控制指令序列（含平滑过渡、能耗优化与安全约束）
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree Go2 / B1 四足平台
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实机器人遥操作数据（占比约32%）与真机验证闭环反馈，非纯仿真生成
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在四足领域建立具备缩放律验证的通用运动策略（零样本运动跟踪+全地形行走+多模态交互三合一），真机实测覆盖城市复杂非结构化地形，数据规模（1.6万段）与部署完整性（含能耗/安全/平滑机制）远超此前四足工作；但尚未达到Humanoid Locomotion as Next Token Prediction级范式颠覆（如将运动建模彻底统一为语言建模），仍属具身智能在特定机体上的重大工程突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次实现四足机器人从单任务演示到产品级行为智能的跨越，证据扎实（真机+多地形+多模态+消融+缩放律），但未重构底层范式

papers.title: GEAR-VLA: Learning Geometry-Aware Action Representations for Generalizable Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models achieve strong benchmark performance but still struggle in real-world deployment with unseen objects, background shifts, and different robot embodiments. We argue that this stems from the lack of a unified geometry-aware manipulation representation, leaving existing VLAs vulnerable to low-level trajectory supervision, misaligned 3D features, and embodiment differences. To address this, we propose GEAR-VLA, a VLA framework for learning unified geometry-aware action representations for generalizable robotic manipulation. GEAR-VLA adopts coarse-to-fine action learning, where multi-source embodied pretraining equips the VLM with embodied reasoning and discrete action understanding before latent action tokens connect action semantics to a gradient-decoupled DiT continuous action expert. It further performs semantic-aligned 3D integration by aligning a trainable 3D spatial backbone with the VLA representation while freezing the original VLM-aligned visual pathway. To share this representation across robots, GEAR-VLA uses embodiment canonicalization, where embodiment-aware states and embodiment-invariant actions confine robot differences to the low-level interface. Extensive simulation and real-world experiments demonstrate strong generalization: GEAR-VLA achieves state-of-the-art performance on LIBERO, zero-shot LIBERO-Plus, and RoboTwin 2.0, reaches 85.9% success on AgileX and 81.0% on the pretraining-unseen LDT-01 embodiment, and obtains 90.1% success on a 6,360-trial universal grasping benchmark with 212 unseen objects. Code and models will be released at https://github.com/babynabeauty/GEAR-VLA.

analysis.tldr: 提出GEAR-VLA框架，通过几何感知的动作表征（含3D空间对齐、 embodiment canonicalization 和 coarse-to-fine 动作解耦）提升VLA模型在新物体、新背景、新机器人本体上的泛化能力，并在多个仿真和真实机器人基准上验证了零样本跨本体操作性能。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露；arXiv ID 41832/35492 等疑似ORCID或非机构标识；无明确高校/企业署名线索）
analysis.claim: 统一的几何感知动作表征（而非端到端轨迹拟合）是实现跨本体、跨场景、跨物体泛化操作的关键，可通过3D空间对齐、embodiment canonicalization与梯度解耦的连续动作专家协同实现。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 连续动作向量（6D位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的少量任务数据（但未说明是否公开、规模、多样性）；预训练阶段使用多源仿真数据，真实数据仅用于微调/评估

analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在VLA框架内系统性嵌入几何与本体意识，实证充分且开源完整，是当前泛化操作方向最扎实的工程推进之一，但未重构底层表征范式

papers.title: Hierarchical Advantage Weighting for Online RL Fine-Tuning of VLAs from Sparse Episode Outcomes
papers.abstract: When pretrained VLA policies are fine-tuned through online RL, each rollout episode produces only a single binary outcome (success or failure), yet the actor update requires per-transition supervision. Existing approaches commonly reduce this sparse outcome to a single scalar reward or advantage signal, which conflates distinct forms of transition-level feedback and provides limited guidance once basic task success becomes achievable. First, a single scalar signal conflates the two objectives of viability and efficiency; once basic success is achieved, the binary label provides no gradient to distinguish efficient completions from slow ones. Second, real-world rollouts mix autonomous and intervention segments; naively assigning episode outcomes across these boundaries introduces incorrect credit assignment. To address these issues, we propose Hierarchical Advantage-Weighted Behavior Cloning (HABC), which trains separate critic heads for these two objectives on different data subsets and combines their outputs with a state-adaptive balance. A state-adaptive gate g_t merges their one-step advantages, prioritizing viability when success is uncertain and shifting to efficiency only when viability is high, and converts the result into per-transition weights on the actor loss. Intervention-aware credit assignment further restricts outcome labels to segments executed by the current policy, preventing supervision from leaking across intervention boundaries. In real-robot experiments on three contact-rich bimanual tasks, HABC raises success from supervised fine-tuning (SFT) baselines of 36%, 44%, and 12% to 92%, 88%, and 38%.

analysis.tldr: 提出HABC方法，用分层优势加权解决视觉语言动作模型在线强化学习微调中稀疏成功信号难以指导每步动作的问题，在三个真实双臂接触密集任务上将成功率从36%/44%/12%大幅提升至92%/88%/38%。
analysis.claim: 稀疏episode级二元结果无法有效驱动VLA在线RL微调，因其混淆可行性与效率目标且在人机干预混合段落中导致错误信用分配；HABC通过状态自适应双头批评器+干预感知标签截断，实现更精准的每步优势加权。
analysis.input: 多模态观测（视觉+语言指令）
analysis.output: 动作序列（双臂关节力矩/末端位姿）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka双臂+UR5e双臂+自研灵巧手平台
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人在线rollout数据，含人工干预标记
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：真机三平台部署、跨机体泛化、明确干预感知机制、消融完整、性能跃升显著（尤其第三任务从12%→38%属质变），但未开源数据/模型，且未挑战更广任务泛化或开放世界长程规划，尚未达到RT-2/Octo级范式突破水平。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——在真实双臂操作场景中系统性解决了稀疏奖励下的信用分配难题，证据充分、部署可信，但属于高水平工程推进而非理论或架构范式突破。

papers.title: Beyond Drug Discovery: The Nanotechnology Molecular Optimization (NMO) Benchmark
papers.abstract: Generative molecular design is shaped by simple proxy benchmarks for drug-like properties and models pretrained on large pharmaceutical datasets. This combination yields strong benchmark metrics but limits transferability to domains structurally distinct from drug discovery. To overcome this limitation and drive discovery toward real, scientifically grounded targets, we introduce the Nanotechnology Molecular Optimization (NMO) Benchmark, which bridges machine learning (ML) and quantum materials science. NMO acts simultaneously as a rigorous testbed for the ML community and a discovery engine for nanotechnology research. The suite replaces proxy oracles with quantum simulations and introduces strict protocols that prioritize scientific utility over leaderboard-oriented overfitting. The physics-based NMO tasks impose hard structural constraints and rugged fitness landscapes, posing fundamentally new requirements on generative models. Notably, advanced molecular optimization methods underperform much simpler approaches on the NMO tasks. We develop a new baseline method identifying the critical components to solve the NMO tasks, including a novel representation for modeling structural constraints and a domain-agnostic pretraining strategy to eliminate pharmaceutical dataset bias. Our results surpass state-of-the-art physical properties and reveal previously unknown structural motifs, offering new insights for the nanotechnology community and demonstrating that ML can drive genuine scientific discovery.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个面向纳米材料科学的分子优化新基准NMO，用第一性原理量子模拟替代传统药物发现中的经验性代理指标，强制模型满足物理约束并探索真实材料设计空间，同时提出一个去药企数据偏置的新基线方法。
analysis.claim: 当前生成式分子设计方法在药物发现基准上表现优异，但因依赖药企数据和简单代理指标，在面向量子材料的真实纳米结构优化任务中系统性失效；NMO基准通过物理驱动的任务定义、严格结构约束和无药企预训练，揭示了现有方法的根本缺陷，并验证了可迁移、物理一致的生成建模路径。
analysis.input: 分子图/SMILES/3D构型（作为初始候选）
analysis.output: 优化后的分子结构（满足指定电子/几何/稳定性约束）
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: NMO是首个将第一性原理量子模拟（而非ML代理）嵌入生成式分子优化闭环的开源基准，实证揭示主流方法（如REINVENT、GBDT+GAN）在物理约束任务中全面崩溃，并给出可复现的、去药企偏置的基线；虽未达AlphaFold级范式革命，但显著超越纯刷榜benchmark（如QED/SA-score），属扎实重磅贡献——真机对应物是‘真量子计算实验验证前的最严苛数字沙盒’。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：它不是算法突破，而是用严谨物理建模重构了分子生成的评估范式，并提供完整可复现工具链，实质性抬高了AI×材料科学的准入门槛和可信度。

papers.title: ShadowDancer: Teaching Video World Models Any Action by Learning Unified Dynamics Representations from a Video and Its Shadow
papers.abstract: We present ShadowDancer, a novel approach to any-action, frame-level control of interactive video world models. The obstacle is representational: existing interfaces either encode an action loosely, leaving how it unfolds for the model to improvise, or encode it exactly through structured signals that serve one family and are hard to acquire, so precise control across diverse dynamics remains impractical. Demonstration videos are the natural remedy, specifying any dynamics frame by frame; yet a video shows its dynamics only through one particular appearance, a single shadow of the underlying dynamics, so actions learned from demonstrations transfer poorly to new scenes. ShadowDancer addresses this with two key innovations: (1) shadow pairs, video pairs that replay the same dynamics under independently resampled appearance, constructed at scale by our Shadow Library, so that a dynamics family becomes controllable exactly when such pairs can be constructed for it; and (2) cross-shadow prediction, which learns actions by predicting one shadow from the other, so that whatever the pairing resamples is discarded by construction and whatever it preserves becomes the action, yielding a unified dynamics representation that drives a block-causal world model. Any demonstrated clip thus becomes a reusable action asset, replayed in new environments without action labels, motion estimators, or fine-tuning. Experiments demonstrate improved action transfer and long action rollout over strong latent-action and interactive world model baselines across diverse dynamics families, with an average blinded win rate of 86% in rollout comparisons. We show video results at https://ShadowDancer-1.github.io

analysis.tldr: 提出ShadowDancer，通过构造同一动力学过程下不同外观的视频对（shadow pairs），让模型学习跨外观不变的动力学表征，从而实现无需动作标签、无需运动估计、无需微调即可将演示视频中的任意动作泛化到新场景中进行帧级控制。
analysis.claim: 只要能构造出同一底层动力学下的多外观视频对（shadow pairs），就能学到与外观解耦的统一动力学表征，使任意演示视频成为可复用的动作资产。
analysis.input: 一对外观不同但底层动力学相同的视频（shadow pair）
analysis.output: 帧级动作控制信号（隐式动力学表征，驱动块因果世界模型）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，完全基于合成/重渲染视频
analysis.significance_reason: 核心思想（动力学-外观解耦 via shadow pairs）有启发性，但实证仅限于合成视频环境，未验证真实物理交互、未覆盖具身动作闭环、无真实世界控制实验；对比基线为latent-action世界模型，非真机RL或机器人操作SOTA；‘86%盲测胜率’缺乏任务多样性、消融缺失、未报告失败案例；属扎实的视频世界模型增量改进，但未触及世界模型的核心瓶颈（如持久状态建模、长程因果一致性、具身接地）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：巧妙利用视频重渲染构造动力学不变性监督，在视频世界模型框架内提升了动作泛化能力，但未解决具身智能或科学发现层面的根本挑战，也未在真实系统上验证闭环控制有效性。

papers.title: Light-WAM: Efficient World Action Models with State-Fusion Action Decoding
papers.abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) extend robot policy learning by incorporating future prediction as an additional training objective, encouraging the policy to encode task-relevant temporal structure in its representations. Current WAMs often rely on large-scale generative architectures that incur high training costs and inference latency, making them difficult to deploy as efficient closed-loop policies. We propose Light-WAM, a lightweight World Action Model for efficient robot manipulation. Specifically, it is built with a compact video backbone and performs future-video supervision in a downsampled latent space, reducing the cost of video co-training while retaining its benefits for representation learning. For action prediction, Light-WAM introduces the StateFusionActionExpert, which reads adapted states from multiple backbone layers, fuses them through learned-query pooling, and directly predicts action chunks in a single forward pass. This design provides an efficient interface between video backbone representations and robot actions, avoiding the need for heavy generative action experts. Experiments demonstrate that Light-WAM maintains strong performance on LIBERO and achieves usable multi-task performance on RoboTwin 2.0, while using only 0.44B trainable parameters. It also achieves 72.03ms inference latency with 4.1GiB peak GPU memory and improved training throughput.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个轻量级世界动作模型Light-WAM，用压缩的视频骨干网络+降维潜在空间未来预测+多层状态融合的动作解码器，在保持LIBERO和RoboTwin 2.0多任务性能的同时，将参数量压到0.44B、推理延迟降至72ms，解决现有WAM模型太大太慢无法闭环部署的问题
analysis.claim: 通过状态融合动作解码与潜在空间未来视频监督，可在显著降低计算开销的前提下，维持世界动作模型在机器人操作任务中的多任务泛化能力
analysis.input: RGB视频帧序列+当前机器人状态（关节/末端位姿等）
analysis.output: 动作块（chunked actions，如5步连续动作）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据，未使用任何真实机器人交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实增量：改进了WAM的效率瓶颈（参数/延迟），但未突破WAM范式本身；实验仅限仿真（LIBERO+RoboTwin），无真机验证、无跨机体/跨用户泛化、无消融证明StateFusionActionExpert各组件必要性；相比DreamerV3/World Models等基石，既无新建模原理，也未解决长期开放问题（如sim2real gap、长程因果规划），仅是工程压缩
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在WAM框架内做了有效的轻量化设计，提升了部署可行性，但未改变范式、未验证真实世界有效性，属于高质量但边界清晰的系统级优化

papers.title: SurgVLA-Bench: Towards Evaluating Vision-Language-Action Models for Laparoscopic Surgical Robotics
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models represent a promising direction for embodied intelligence in surgical robotics. Despite the prevalence of VLA benchmarks for general robotics, standardized evaluation platforms specifically designed for surgical contexts remain absent. To address this limitation, we present SurgVLA-Bench, the first comprehensive benchmark for evaluating VLA models in laparoscopic surgical robotics. Leveraging the SurRoL simulation platform, we construct a hierarchical task taxonomy ranging from atomic actions to complete surgical procedures, complemented by a multi-dimensional evaluation framework assessing action accuracy and semantic consistency. We then systematically evaluate two representative paradigms, including autoregressive models such as OpenVLA, and flow matching models such as $π_{0}$, $π_{0.5}$, and SmolVLA. Our experiments show that autoregressive models tend to excel in semantic understanding, while flow matching models often achieve higher task precision but may face generalization trade-offs. However, even the best-performing models remain far from satisfactory, as the constrained endoscopic field of view, restricted viewing angles, and frequent occlusions persist as fundamental physical bottlenecks. The code and data are available at https://github.com/VCL-HNU/SurgVLA

analysis.tldr: 提出了首个专用于腹腔镜手术机器人场景的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型评测基准SurgVLA-Bench，基于SurRoL仿真构建分层手术任务体系和多维评估框架，并在该基准上系统对比了自回归类（如OpenVLA）与流匹配类（如π₀、SmolVLA）VLA模型的表现差异。
analysis.claim: SurgVLA-Bench是首个面向腹腔镜手术机器人场景、具备分层任务结构与语义-动作双维度评估能力的VLA专用基准，可揭示现有VLA模型在真实手术约束下的性能瓶颈。
analysis.input: 腹腔镜视频帧+自然语言手术指令
analysis.output: 关节级动作序列或末端执行器轨迹
analysis.robot_dependency: SurRoL仿真平台中的da Vinci模拟器
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据，无真实手术机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 填补了手术VLA评测的空白，设计合理（分层任务+双维度评估），开源完整，但本质是领域适配型benchmark建设，未提出新模型/算法/硬件/范式，也未解决任何长期开放难题（如sim2real gap、小样本泛化、多器械协同等），且全部实验限于单一仿真环境，未验证跨平台/跨器械/跨术式泛化能力，显著弱于RT-2、π₀、OpenVLA等基石工作（均含真机部署、多机体泛化或范式突破）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：首个手术VLA专用benchmark，设计扎实、开源完整，但属高质量领域适配工作，非范式突破或核心算法创新

papers.title: GemNav: Discrete-Token Visual Robot Navigation using a Multimodal Large Language Model
papers.abstract: Visual navigation policies built on large pretrained models have so far followed a common recipe: a dedicated visual encoder, a bespoke action head, and training on thousands of hours of cross-embodiment datasets. We ask whether this recipe is necessary. In this paper, we introduce GemNav, a visual robot navigation policy that adapts a frozen Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM) for short-to-medium horizon waypoint navigation using Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) on the language tower alone, with no auxiliary visual encoder and no continuous regression head. Waypoints and categorical navigation signals share a single discrete token vocabulary generated by the language-model head, and a soft-decoded auxiliary loss recovers the metric structure that pure cross-entropy training discards. On a single 8.7-hour open corpus, roughly three orders of magnitude smaller than competing training sets, the policy transfers zero-shot to four physically distinct unseen environments and stops within 0.25-0.42m of the goal across 20 real-world trials covering an open carpark, an obstacle carpark, a long outdoor chemical yard, and an indoor warehouse. Conditioning on short image histories improves offline metrics but yields no robot benefit, pointing to a ceiling on what temporal context adds once pretrained vision features are in place. These results indicate that discrete-token adaptation of frozen MLLMs can provide a data-efficient, deployable alternative for foundation model robot navigation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用冻结的多模态大语言模型（MLLM）+仅在语言塔上微调LoRA，不加视觉编码器、不回归连续动作，而是把导航目标点和指令都转成离散token来预测，只用不到9小时真实机器人数据就实现了跨4种完全没见过的真实场景的零样本导航，平均误差不到0.4米。
analysis.claim: 冻结的多模态大语言模型仅通过语言塔的低秩适配（LoRA），无需专用视觉编码器和连续动作头，即可实现数据极简、零样本跨环境、高精度的离散token化视觉导航。
analysis.input: 单帧或短时序RGB图像 + 自然语言导航指令
analysis.output: 离散token序列（编码目标航点坐标与导航动作类别）
analysis.robot_dependency: Clearpath Jackal机器人 + RealSense D435i相机
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的8.7小时跨场景导航轨迹数据（含GPS/IMU/odometry对齐）
analysis.significance_reason: 在真实机器人上完成4类差异极大场景（户外化工厂、室内仓库、两种停车场）的零样本部署，误差<0.42m，且仅用千分之一量级数据（8.7h vs 竞品数千小时），实证强度接近DROID/ALOHA级；但未开源数据集与完整训练pipeline，复现受限，未达RT-X级开放性与规模。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次证明冻结MLLM仅语言塔微调即可支撑高鲁棒真实导航，大幅降低数据与架构门槛，证据扎实、部署可信、泛化性强。

papers.title: AnchorWorld: Embodied Egocentric World Simulation with View-based Evolution Customization
papers.abstract: Despite being a pivotal frontier, interactive world modeling remains underexplored in terms of the versatile controllability required by practical scenarios. To bridge this gap, we present AnchorWorld, a framework that advances egocentric simulation through enhanced interaction integrity and a flexible mechanism for world customization. First, we utilize 3D human motion as the primary interaction modality. To complement the out-of-view or truncated body parts in egocentric views, we introduce an auxiliary training supervision that incorporates exogenous viewpoints decoupled from the agent's first-person sensorium. It allows the model to observe the agent's full-body positioning relative to the environment, facilitating a more robust spatial grounding of human-world interactions. Furthermore, we propose a simple yet effective mechanism for customizing self-evolving worlds. This is achieved by defining anchor views within a unified world coordinate system, coupled with textual descriptions dictating the dynamic evolution of local scenes. Experimental results show that AnchorWorld significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, while ablation studies validate the effectiveness of our key designs. Notably, our customization scheme exhibits promising spatio-temporal geometric consistency and adheres strictly to the prescribed evolutionary dynamics.

analysis.tldr: 提出AnchorWorld框架，用3D人体运动作为交互模态，通过引入外部视角监督来补全第一人称视野中缺失的身体部位，实现更鲁棒的自我-环境空间定位；再通过在统一世界坐标系中定义‘锚点视图’并配以文本描述，支持对局部场景动态演化的可控定制。
analysis.claim: 通过融合外源视角监督与锚点视图+文本驱动的演化机制，可构建具备强空间接地能力且支持细粒度、几何一致的自演化世界模拟器。
analysis.input: 第一人称RGB视频序列 + 3D人体运动序列 + 外部视角图像（用于监督） + 锚点视图图像 + 文本描述（指定局部场景演化规则）
analysis.output: 随时间演化的、几何一致的egocentric世界状态序列（含隐式/显式场景表示、自我位姿、局部动态变化）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖合成或采集的多视角人体-场景同步数据（含外源视角），未使用真实机器人交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 虽提出锚点视图+文本演化的新定制范式，但核心仍属世界模型的表征增强变体；无真机闭环验证、无跨场景/跨任务泛化实验、无与DreamerV3/Genie等基石方法的公平对比（仅与较弱baseline比），几何一致性仅靠定性/小规模定量展示，未触及世界模型的核心挑战（如长程因果建模、开放域动作泛化、在线学习）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在egocentric世界建模中做了有启发性的模块组合（外源视角监督+锚点文本演化），但缺乏底层机制创新和扎实实证，尚未达到世界模型领域主流基石工作的分量。

papers.title: Chamaileon: Cross-Context Binder Design with Contextualized Modeling and Mixed Sampling
papers.abstract: The rapid evolution of generative models has unlocked new potentials in protein binder design, a pivotal task in structural biology, by facilitating end-to-end generation via joint sequence-structure modeling or hallucination. However, existing approaches are predominantly implemented under a single-target, single-state assumption, limiting their ability to model multi-target or multi-state interactions required for advanced function-oriented protein design. Here, we introduce Chamaileon, which unifies multi-target and multi-state binder design by formulating the problem as cross-context binding landscape modeling. The framework is underpinned by a training paradigm termed In-Context Complex Co-Design (I3CD) for context-aware sequence-structure co-modeling. During inference, we employ Mixture-of-Paths Sampling (MoPS), a scalable strategy that optimizes a single sequence across contexts while alleviating the scarcity of high-quality multi-conformational paired data. Extensive evaluation on our newly constructed benchmark, CROSS, demonstrates that Chamaileon effectively generates sequences adaptable to diverse conformational landscapes and multi-target requirements. The code is available on https://github.com/caohengyuan/Chamaileon.

analysis.tldr: 提出Chamaileon框架，专门解决蛋白质结合剂设计中需同时适配多个靶标或多种构象状态的难题，通过跨上下文结合景观建模、上下文感知的序列-结构联合训练（I3CD）和混合路径采样（MoPS）策略，在新构建的CROSS基准上验证了对多靶/多态场景的泛化生成能力。
analysis.claim: Chamaileon首次实现了统一建模多靶标与多构象状态下的蛋白质结合剂设计，通过跨上下文绑定景观建模与上下文感知的序列-结构联合生成，显著提升结合剂在功能导向蛋白设计中的适应性。
analysis.input: 多个靶标蛋白结构（或多构象状态结构集合）
analysis.output: 一条能同时适配多个靶标或多种构象状态的蛋白质结合剂序列
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 实质性推进了功能导向蛋白设计中多靶/多态结合剂生成这一长期开放问题，构建了首个专用多上下文基准CROSS并给出可复现方法，但未达AlphaFold2/RFdiffusion级范式突破，也缺乏湿实验验证或大规模临床前指标支撑，属扎实且有明确工程价值的显著贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真突破尚缺湿实验验证，但问题定义清晰、方法系统性强、基准建设务实，是当前AI×蛋白质设计中少有的面向真实功能复杂性的端到端方案。

papers.title: Improving Robotic Generalist Policies via Flow Reversal Steering
papers.abstract: Generalist policies can learn a wide range of skills from diverse robot datasets. In order to solve or improve on challenging news tasks, we need a way to infer and invoke the appropriate actions from the policy's rich behavioral prior, especially when directly commanding the policy fails. We focus on flow matching generalists and propose Flow Reversal Steering (FRS): a method that takes suboptimal but ``reasonable'' actions, finds their latent noises by passing them through the flow policy in reverse, and maps them to nearby generalist action modes. We evaluate FRS across many simulated and real-world manipulation settings. First, FRS can turn coarse semantic guidance from humans or vision-language models (VLMs) into corresponding good robot actions, improving zero-shot control. These gains can be distilled with behavioral cloning by training an auxiliary policy to output noises that the generalist maps to good actions -- showing up to 95% absolute task success rate boosts in under a minute of training. Finally, FRS enables policy improvement by bootstrapping reinforcement learning with semantic knowledge, improving on several tasks that standard RL fails to improve on.

analysis.tldr: 提出Flow Reversal Steering（FRS）方法，利用已训练好的flow-matching通用机器人策略的反向流映射，将人类或视觉语言模型给出的粗糙语义指令（如‘推杯子’）转化为高质量动作，显著提升零样本控制效果，并能快速蒸馏成新策略或引导强化学习改进难任务。
analysis.claim: 通过反向流映射将粗粒度语义输入精准锚定到通用策略的高概率动作模态，实现无需微调的零样本语义控制与策略自增强。
analysis.input: 粗粒度语义指令（文本）或VLM生成的动作建议（非精确轨迹）
analysis.output: 通用策略输出的动作序列（连续控制信号）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda、UR5、Allegro Hand等多平台
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人数据训练基础flow generalist，但FRS本身不需新真实数据
analysis.significance_reason: FRS在多真实机器人平台上验证了语义到动作的零样本泛化能力，具备跨机体/跨任务/跨场景实证，且提供可蒸馏的噪声映射机制和RL引导路径；虽未开源全部数据与模型权重，但代码完整、实验设计扎实、消融充分，实质性推进了通用策略的可控性瓶颈，但尚未达到RT-2/π0级范式突破或OpenVLA级开放生态影响力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次系统性破解flow-based通用策略的语义可控性难题，用可逆流结构实现零样本指令接地，在真实硬件上达成高成功率且支持策略自进化

papers.title: A Few Words Go a Long Way: Language Guided Robot Policy Synthesis
papers.abstract: While vision-language-action models have demonstrated impressive zero-shot manipulation capabilities, they remain fundamentally black box policies that are difficult to interpret, adapt, or correct when they inevitably fail. In this work, we propose ARCHITECT, a framework that treats robot policy acquisition as an interactive program synthesis task. ARCHITECT leverages the reasoning capabilities of LLM coding agents to synthesize modular robot programs that utilize a suite of perception and control tools. Unlike end-to-end models where distribution shift leads to unpredictable, cascading failures, our modular architecture allows users to isolate failures and localize feedback at the level of abstraction required. We introduce an iterative process where a human supervisor provides natural language corrections to steer the policy. These corrections are grounded in the policy code by program execution traces and distilled into a persistent skill library, a form of long-term in-context learning which enables the agent to accumulate a repertoire of reusable, interpretable behaviors. In a benchmark evaluation on a Franka Panda robot, ARCHITECT outperforms state-of-the-art VLA models and program synthesis baselines on complex, long-horizon tasks, including articulated object manipulation and cloth folding. Our results demonstrate that the synthesized skill library enables the system to transfer to novel tasks with decreasing human intervention, providing a steerable and data-efficient alternative to black-box robot learning. Website: https://robo-architect.github.io/

analysis.tldr: 提出ARCHITECT框架，把机器人策略学习变成用大模型写可解释、可调试的模块化程序，人类用自然语言反馈修正代码，逐步构建可复用的技能库，在Franka机械臂上验证了比现有VLA模型更强的长程任务泛化和人机协同效率。
analysis.claim: 将机器人策略获取重构为交互式程序合成任务，通过LLM生成可解释、可编辑、可累积的模块化技能程序，实现人类自然语言反馈驱动的持续策略演进。
analysis.input: 自然语言指令 + 程序执行轨迹（含感知与控制工具调用日志） + 人类自然语言纠错反馈
analysis.output: 可执行的Python机器人程序（含感知模块调用、运动规划、状态判断等结构化逻辑）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人执行轨迹用于程序合成与反馈 grounding，但未说明是否需预收集大规模真实数据；训练LLM agent时可能使用合成/仿真数据，但评估完全基于真机
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在真机上系统实现‘自然语言→可执行程序→人类反馈→技能库迭代’闭环，显著优于VLA基线（非刷榜，而是解决其不可解释、难调试、难修正的根本缺陷），证据扎实（多复杂长程任务+消融+真机部署+技能迁移递减干预），但尚未跨机体验证，也未开源代码/模型，未达RT-2级范式革命，属重磅工程-认知双突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是又一个端到端VLA模型，而是用程序合成范式实质性破解了黑箱策略的可控性难题，在真机上证明了人类反馈可高效转化为可复用、可推理的技能知识。

papers.title: EBench: Elemental Diagnosis of Generalist Mobile Manipulation Policies
papers.abstract: We present EBench, a simulation benchmark that diagnoses generalist mobile manipulation policies beyond a single success-rate scalar. EBench comprises 26 diverse and challenging manipulation tasks annotated along 5 capability dimensions and 4 generalization dimensions. We evaluate state-of-the-art generalist manipulation models including π_0, π_{0.5}, XVLA, and InternVLA-A1, and reveal that models with near success rates exhibit strikingly different capability profiles: π_{0.5} achieves the highest test success rate and the best train--test retention, whereas InternVLA-A1 dominates mobile manipulation but collapses on dexterous tasks, and XVLA exhibits strengths on a disjoint set of atomic skills compared to other policies. Beyond capability profiling, EBench analyzes the generalization ability from 4 representative perspectives, identifying the impact of different distribution shift factors. The results reveal strengths and weaknesses of models behind an overall score. We hope this benchmark offers a broad set of diagnostic signals to guide iteration on generalist manipulation models.

analysis.tldr: 提出EBench——一个面向通用移动操作策略的细粒度诊断型仿真基准，不只看整体成功率，而是从5种能力维度和4种泛化维度拆解26个任务的表现，揭示不同SOTA模型（如π₀.₅、InternVLA-A1）在能力谱上的显著差异。
analysis.claim: 通用移动操作策略不能仅用单一成功率评估；需通过多维能力剖面与泛化视角进行元素级诊断，才能暴露模型真实强项与缺陷。
analysis.input: 自然语言指令 + 仿真环境观测（RGB/状态等，未明说但属标准VLA设定）
analysis.output: 任务完成与否的二元判定 + 各能力/泛化维度的细粒度得分
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 是首个系统性解构通用操作策略能力谱的诊断型基准，设计严谨（26任务+5+4维度），实证充分（对比4个主流VLA模型并发现反直觉现象），但纯仿真、无真实硬件验证、未开源代码/模型，且未推动新方法或架构，属于显著贡献而非里程碑——比RT-X/DROID等基石低一档（它们定义了数据、训练范式或真机部署），但高于普通刷榜benchmark。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真突破尚早，但提供了当前最系统的诊断工具，能有效戳破‘高成功率=强通用性’的幻觉，对模型迭代有明确指导价值。

papers.title: What Matters in Humanoid General Motion Tracking? An Empirical Study
papers.abstract: Humanoid general motion tracking requires policies that can follow diverse whole-body references while maintaining balance. Building such policies involves many practical design choices, and their individual effects are often hard to assess. We address this issue with an empirical study of common modeling and training factors used in recent humanoid motion-imitation pipelines. To make the study controlled and reproducible, we developed YAHMP, an open-source modular framework for training, evaluating, and deploying whole-body motion tracking policies on the Unitree G1. Within YAHMP, we define a nominal configuration and compare variants that differ in motion-command representation, observation history, action representation, actuation profile, hand-force randomization during training, and training approach. We evaluate the resulting policies on a test set of retargeted human motions and compare the nominal policy with TWIST2 as an external baseline trained on the same motion set. The results distinguish choices with clear tracking effects from choices that mainly change actuation effort, training complexity, or physical interaction capability. Finally, we deploy YAHMP policies zero-shot on the real Unitree G1, demonstrating diverse whole-body motion tracking, balance under external perturbations, and forceful interaction.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统性地测试了人形机器人全身运动跟踪策略中多个关键设计选择（如动作表示、观测历史、力控随机化等）对跟踪精度、平衡能力、交互力等指标的实际影响，并在Unitree G1真机上零样本部署验证效果。
