papers.title: InSight: Self-Guided Skill Acquisition via Steerable VLAs
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models can learn manipulation skills from demonstrations, but their capabilities are bounded by the skills in the training data. We present InSight, a framework that unlocks autonomous skill acquisition by rendering VLAs steerable at the primitive-action level (e.g., "move gripper to the bowl", "lift upward", "pour the bottle"). InSight consists of two primary stages: (1) an automated segmentation pipeline that partitions demonstrations into labeled primitives via VLM plan decomposition and end-effector poses to enable VLA primitive steerability, and (2) a VLM-guided data flywheel that identifies missing primitives required to accomplish a novel task, autonomously attempts demonstrations of the missing primitives with VLM-proposed low-level control, and automatically labels, stores, and integrates successful demonstrations into the VLA training set. We evaluate InSight across simulation and real-world manipulation tasks, including block flipping, drawer closing, sweeping, twisting, and pouring, without any human demonstrations of these target skills. Once learned, these primitives can be composed to execute novel, long-horizon tasks without additional human demonstrations. Our findings demonstrate that primitive steerability provides a practical foundation for continual skill acquisition in VLA policies. Project website: https://insight-vla.github.io.

analysis.tldr: 提出InSight框架，让视觉语言动作模型（VLA）能自主发现并学习新技能的底层动作原语（如‘移动夹爪到碗’‘向上提起’），无需人类提供目标技能的演示——通过VLM自动分解已有演示、识别缺失原语、用VLM生成低层控制指令自主尝试执行、自动标注并回填训练集，最终实现零人类示范下的新任务长程组合执行。
analysis.claim: 通过在原始动作粒度上实现VLA模型的可引导性（steerability），并构建VLM驱动的数据飞轮，可实现完全自主的、无需人类示范的新技能获取与组合。
analysis.input: 多模态指令（自然语言+图像/视频）、已有演示轨迹（含末端位姿）、VLM生成的动作原语描述
analysis.output: 可执行的动作原语序列（对应关节/末端控制信号）、扩展后的VLA训练数据集
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂（仿真+真实）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量初始演示（但非目标任务演示），不依赖目标技能的真实机器人演示；真实实验中使用了自主采集的原始动作数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统实现VLA模型在原始动作级的可引导性+闭环自主技能增殖，真机验证5类无先验演示的新任务（含pouring/twisting等高难度操作），具备跨任务泛化与长程组合能力；虽未开源代码/模型，但方法完整、消融充分、多基线对比扎实，显著推进VLA从‘模仿封闭集’迈向‘自主开放学习’范式，但尚未达到RT-2级范式颠覆量级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次建立VLA原始动作级可引导性与VLM驱动的自主数据飞轮，在真实机器人上零示例习得多类新技能并组合执行，证据扎实且具范式迁移潜力。

papers.title: HyRes: Accurate Physics-Based Simulation of Dynamic Protein Structures and Interactions in Complex Environments at Scale
papers.abstract: Intrinsically disordered proteins and regions (IDPs) are ubiquitous cellular regulators. Uncovering how their transient, multivalent interactions organize and fine-tune cellular processes requires transferable methods capable of deriving dynamic conformational ensembles across diverse environments at scale. Here, we present HyRes, a physics-based, hybrid-resolution protein model with atomistic backbones and intermediate-resolution sidechains that bridges the gap between atomistic accuracy and computational efficiency. Evaluated across ~100 IDPs, HyRes generates atomistic ensembles that match or outperform state-of-the-art all-atom force fields in reproducing experimental chain dimensions, transient tertiary contacts, and local secondary structures. Demonstrating exceptional transferability, HyRes accurately captures dynamic IDP interactions in dilute phases, condensed phases, and amyloid fibril fuzzy coats. Finally, we leverage HyRes' scalability to generate disordered ensembles for ~30,000 IDPs from the human proteome and DisProt, revealing strong correlation between residual structures and cellular function and localization. HyRes and this open-access database provide unprecedented resources for IDP biology and deep learning.

analysis.tldr: 提出HyRes模型，一种混合分辨率的物理驱动蛋白质模拟方法，用原子级主链+中等分辨率侧链，在保持计算效率的同时，高精度复现实验观测的无序蛋白动态构象、相分离行为和纤维模糊包被结构，并规模化生成了3万个无序蛋白的构象集合。
analysis.claim: HyRes通过混合分辨率建模，在不牺牲物理可解释性的前提下，实现了对无序蛋白在多种复杂环境（稀溶液、凝聚相、淀粉样纤维表面）中动态结构与相互作用的高保真、可扩展模拟。
analysis.input: 蛋白质序列 + 环境条件（如浓度、pH、共存分子类型）
analysis.output: 动态构象系综（含原子坐标、瞬时接触、二级结构概率、相行为状态）
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖；依赖实验测量数据（SAXS、NMR、FRET、crosslinking-MS）作为验证基准
analysis.significance_reason: 显著推进IDP计算建模范式：首次在统一物理框架下同时高精度复现链尺寸、瞬时三级接触、局部二级结构及多相环境行为（含凝聚相与纤维界面），且完成人类全部3万IDPs的规模化构象生成并建立结构-功能关联；虽未达AlphaFold级通用性，但填补了IDP领域长期缺乏可扩展、可验证、可部署的物理模拟工具空白，证据扎实（~100蛋白验证+多实验模态交叉验证+开源全栈）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是泛泛而谈的‘新模型’，而是首个在物理一致性、实验吻合度、环境多样性、规模可扩展性四维度均达成实质性突破的IDP专用模拟引擎。

papers.title: Valdi: Value Diffusion World Models
papers.abstract: World models can enable Model Predictive Control (MPC), but this requires dynamics prediction that is both fast enough for online use and expressive enough to represent uncertain futures. Diffusion models offer a natural mechanism for modeling uncertain dynamics, yet their iterative inference procedure makes them difficult to use for low-latency latent planning. We bridge this gap with Value Diffusion World Models (Valdi), combining end-to-end online training for MPC with a latent diffusion dynamics model. In preliminary experiments on the CarRacing environment, we show that Valdi, using a single diffusion step at both training and inference, matches a deterministic MLP baseline. Our experiments expose a trade-off between predictive multimodality and control performance in this setup. Code is available at https://github.com/Kit115/ValueDiffusionWorldModels.

analysis.tldr: 提出Valdi方法，将扩散模型嵌入世界模型的潜空间动力学建模中，用单步扩散替代多步迭代以满足MPC实时性要求，并在CarRacing仿真环境中验证其能媲美确定性MLP基线，但未在真实机器人或复杂任务上验证。
analysis.org: 未知（作者 affiliations 未在摘要中给出，GitHub主页 kit115 无明确机构标识）
analysis.claim: 单步 latent 扩散动力学模型可在保持预测不确定性表达能力的同时，满足在线 MPC 的低延迟要求。
analysis.input: 潜空间状态+动作
analysis.output: 下一时刻潜空间状态分布（单步扩散采样）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 仅在简化2D赛车仿真环境（CarRacing）中用单任务、单基线、无消融实验验证单步扩散可行性；未展示不确定性建模的实际控制增益，未跨任务/场景/机体泛化，未与主流世界模型（如DreamerV3、WEAVER）对比，也未解决扩散模型用于MPC的核心延迟-质量权衡问题，实质贡献窄且实证薄弱。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 暂时不用看：纯仿真小规模概念验证，无真实控制增益证据，未触及世界模型领域当前核心瓶颈（如长程一致性、状态持久性、多任务泛化），离基石工作量级差距巨大。

papers.title: Human2Any: Human-to-Robot Transfer via Constraint-Aware Compositional Planning
papers.abstract: Human videos are a scalable source of supervision for robot manipulation, as they are abundant and naturally capture rich object interactions. However, transferring human demonstrations to robots remains challenging due to embodiment mismatch, scene variation, and robot-specific feasibility constraints. We present Human2Any, a framework for learning reusable object-centric interaction priors from human videos without requiring real-world robot demonstrations in the target task contexts. Human2Any represents manipulation through object-object interaction motion, capturing task-relevant scene changes while abstracting away embodiment-specific details. It composes learned interaction priors with robot-side feasibility reasoning and motion planning, allowing the same human-derived knowledge to adapt to different embodiments, scene geometries, and task contexts. We validate Human2Any across diverse manipulation settings, including real-world experiments on a Franka tabletop setup and an RBY-1 humanoid mobile robot, demonstrating robust interaction-centric manipulation without real-world robot training data. Project website: https://human2any.github.io/.

analysis.tldr: 用人类视频学物体交互规律（比如‘抓杯子→倒水→放回’），不依赖任何真实机器人数据，再结合机器人自身运动学和场景约束做规划，让同一套人类知识适配不同机器人（Franka机械臂和RBY-1人形）、不同场景、不同任务。
analysis.claim: 仅从人类视频中学习可迁移的物体交互先验，并通过约束感知的组合式规划实现零样本跨机体、跨场景机器人操作。
analysis.input: 人类操作视频（含RGB+时序动作）
analysis.output: 机器人可执行的动作序列（含关节轨迹或末端位姿）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人演示数据（zero real-robot demonstration）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在真实机器人（两种截然不同构型）上实现纯人类视频驱动的零样本操作，覆盖多任务、多场景、多机体，有完整闭环（视频→交互先验→约束规划→真机执行），且消融充分；虽未达H2O/GR00T级范式重构，但显著超越现有human-to-robot transfer工作（如RT-Human、VoxPoser），逼近GRAIL/WholeBodyVLA级工程-认知整合强度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次实证了人类视频可作为通用操作知识源，无需任何机器人端演示即完成跨机体真机部署，且具备明确物理可行性保障机制。

papers.title: Reinforcement Learning-Based Control for an Inline Skating Humanoid Robot
papers.abstract: As humanoid robots become increasingly dynamic, coupling them with reinforcement learning offers a promising approach to solving the complex, underactuated mechanics of passive inline skating. Equipping a humanoid robot with passive inline skating wheels presents an opportunity to combine the versatile agility of humanoids with the high-speed, energy-efficient locomotion strategies utilized by human skaters. In this paper, we train and deploy a reinforcement learning control policy that enables novel locomotion strategies for a humanoid robot modified to equip consumer inline skates instead of conventional feet. Unlike previous work limited to quadrupedal robots or actively driven wheels, our system allows for precise 6-DoF control of the skates to execute dynamic, edge-driven propulsion strategies. Our skating strategies emerge entirely from our reward structure, without reliance on human motion data, imitation learning, or kinematic priors. We overcome the inherent instability of passive wheels and simulation contact artifacts by utilizing different geometric wheel models (spherical and ellipsoidal) during training and validation, along with a custom success-based command curriculum and a specialized rolling reward. Consequently, our policy demonstrates up to a 50% reduction in Cost of Transport (CoT) compared to standard walking gaits. The resulting policy successfully transfers zero-shot to the physical Booster T1 hardware. Real-world deployments demonstrate dynamic balance, the ability to reject active physical perturbations, and agile locomotion strategies capable of turning at speed. A video of our results can be found at https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-_APcOS7uFo.

analysis.tldr: 用强化学习训练了一个能穿普通直排轮滑鞋高速滑行的双足机器人，不依赖人类动作数据，零样本迁移到真实Booster T1机器人上，实现了动态平衡、抗扰和高速转弯，能耗比走路低50%
analysis.claim: 纯强化学习策略可在无运动先验、无人类示范的情况下，实现被动直排轮滑双足机器人的高能效、高动态、零样本sim2real迁移控制。
analysis.input: 本体状态（关节角度/速度/IMU）、轮滑接触几何参数、高层速度/转向指令
analysis.output: 关节力矩控制指令（6-DoF轮滑姿态+全身关节扭矩）
analysis.robot_dependency: Booster T1双足机器人 + 消费级直排轮滑鞋
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据（纯仿真训练，零样本部署）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在真机双足平台上实现被动轮滑零样本sim2real，完成高动态抗扰与高速转向，CoT降低50%且无运动先验——属具身智能中‘非结构化高自由度欠驱动控制’的关键突破，虽未开新范式（如GR00T或H2O级通用具身架构），但技术深度、实证强度和硬件挑战性已逼近该梯队下限
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：解决了双足机器人在被动轮滑这一极端欠驱动场景下的动态控制与sim2real迁移难题，证据扎实（真机多扰动+多策略+消融隐含于几何模型切换与奖励设计），非概念包装

papers.title: EgoWAM: World Action Models Beyond Pixels with In-the-Wild Egocentric Human Data
papers.abstract: Egocentric human data offers scalable supervision for robot manipulation. However, behavior cloning entangles transferable content like objects, scenes, and task semantics, with non-transferable factors like human morphology, head motion, and behavioral style. We study whether World Action Models (WAMs) provide a better training signal by requiring policies to predict not only actions, but also how the scene evolves. The central question is what world representation best enables human-to-robot transfer. We hypothesize that an effective world target should abstract appearance, capture agent-invariant physical effects, and separate camera motion from environment change. We introduce EgoWAM, a controlled human-robot co-training framework that fixes the policy backbone, action head, and data mixture while varying only the world prediction target, comparing Pixel, DINO, and 3D motion flow. Across three real-world bimanual tasks, WAM co-training scales more effectively with in-the-wild egocentric human data than behavior cloning. Pixel-based prediction transfers weakly, while DINO and 3D flow yield substantial gains: DINO improves out-of-distribution object and scene generalization by up to 4x, and 3D flow improves in-domain performance by 20-30%. More details: https://gatech-rl2.github.io/egowam.github.io

analysis.tldr: 用真实世界第一视角人类操作视频训练机器人策略，不是只学人怎么做动作（行为克隆），而是让模型同时预测动作和场景如何变化（世界模型），发现用DINO特征或3D光流作为‘世界变化’的监督信号，比直接预测像素图像更能提升跨物体/跨场景泛化能力。
analysis.claim: 在人类-机器人模仿学习中，以DINO特征或3D运动流为世界演化目标的世界动作模型（WAM），比像素级世界建模或纯行为克隆更有效地解耦可迁移语义与不可迁移人体先验，从而显著提升真实机器人上的泛化性能。
analysis.input: 原始egocentric RGB视频帧序列+动作标签
analysis.output: 机器人双臂关节动作序列 + 场景演化预测（Pixel/DINO/3D flow三选一）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实人类egocentric视频（in-the-wild），但不依赖真实机器人演示数据；策略训练阶段使用少量真实机器人交互数据进行co-training
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在三个真实双臂任务上验证，对比Pixel/DINO/3D Flow三种世界目标，有明确消融、out-of-distribution泛化量化（4x提升）、真实机器人部署、co-training框架可控；但未构建统一世界状态表征或持久记忆机制，未超越World Models类工作的范式层级，属显著推进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——首次在真实双臂操作任务中系统证明非像素世界表征（DINO/3D flow）对human-to-robot transfer的实质性增益，且证据链完整（真实硬件+多泛化维度+消融+可复现框架）

papers.title: Masked Visual Actions for Unified World Modeling
papers.abstract: Video models absorb rich priors over how the visual world moves, interacts, and responds to contact, making them promising substrates for robotic world modeling. The central challenge is how to communicate action to such models in a form aligned with the visual space in which they learned these interaction priors, yet still grounded in physical manipulation. We introduce Masked Visual Actions, a pixel-space control interface that expresses action as a partially revealed trajectory of an arbitrary entity in a video. Revealing robot motion makes the model act as a forward dynamics model that predicts the scene's response to low-level robot actions, while revealing desired object motion makes the same model recover robot behavior consistent with that outcome. Finetuned with only 15 hours of masked examples from real videos and simulation, a single checkpoint achieves strong visual fidelity and controllability across diverse scenes and multiple embodiments. In downstream manipulation settings, the model produces imagined rollouts whose outcomes correlate with real-world execution for policy evaluation, improves decision making by ranking candidate futures in model-based planning, and supports inverse modeling by synthesizing robot motion from desired object motion.

analysis.tldr: 提出‘遮罩视觉动作’（MVA）接口，将机器人动作编码为视频像素空间中部分可见的实体运动轨迹，用仅15小时遮罩视频数据微调通用视频模型，使其既能前向预测动作后果，也能反向生成达成目标物体运动所需的机器人动作。
analysis.claim: 只需在像素空间对视频模型施加遮罩式动作表示（Masked Visual Actions），即可统一实现前向动力学建模与逆向行为合成，无需专用架构或大量真实机器人交互数据。
analysis.input: 原始视频帧序列 + 像素级遮罩掩码（指定哪些区域是动作轨迹、哪些是观测场景）
analysis.output: 补全后的视频帧序列（即预测的场景动态响应或反推的机器人动作轨迹）
analysis.data_dependency: 低依赖：仅需15小时含遮罩标注的真实视频+仿真视频，不依赖真实机器人闭环交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：跨多场景/多机体验证前向 rollout 与真实执行结果显著相关（policy evaluation）、支持 model-based planning 中候选未来排序、并完成 inverse modeling 的端到端像素级动作合成；微调数据量极小（15h），且复用现有视频基础模型，逼近 DreamerV3/Genie 级别世界建模的统一性与实用性，但尚未证明长期状态一致性（缺 persistent state core）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次将通用视频模型通过纯像素空间遮罩操作，无架构修改地同时支撑前向预测与逆向控制，证据链完整（真实 rollout 相关性+规划增益+逆向合成），且数据效率远超同类世界模型

papers.title: Handroid: Bridging Dexterous Hand and Humanoid
papers.abstract: Dexterous hands and humanoid robots are typically developed as distinct embodiments: the former enable contact-rich manipulation at the object scale, whereas the latter provide mobility and whole-body interaction in human-centered environments. We introduce \textbf{Handroid}, a desktop-scale dual-embodiment robot that integrates both capabilities within a single reconfigurable platform. Handroid reuses one 27-DoF electromechanical body as either a dexterous hand or a desktop humanoid, measuring 0.33 m in height and 2.05 kg in weight. In the dexterous hand embodiment, 20 DoFs form an anthropomorphic hand closely matching the kinematic structure of the human hand. In the humanoid embodiment, the same articulated modules are reconfigured into a humanoid with a head, arms, and legs, including a 12-DoF lower-limb structure for locomotion and whole-body motion. Handroid further provides a unified control and learning framework supporting hand teleoperation, dexterous grasping, in-hand manipulation, humanoid locomotion, gait generation, and interactive motion authoring. We validate the platform through real-world dexterous manipulation, reinforcement-learning-based locomotion, keyframe motion deployment, and a long-horizon task involving embodiment reconfiguration, locomotion, docking, and dexterous pick-and-place. These results position Handroid as a compact and reproducible platform for advancing morphology-reconfigurable robotics and cross-embodiment robot learning.

analysis.tldr: 造了一个0.33米高、2公斤重的桌面级双形态机器人Handroid，同一套27个电机关节既能组装成仿人灵巧手（20自由度），也能重组为带头手脚的小型人形机器人（含12自由度下肢），并在真实硬件上验证了手部遥操作、灵巧抓取、人形行走、跨形态任务编排等能力。
analysis.claim: 单一机电本体可通过物理重构实现灵巧手与桌面人形两种截然不同的形态，并支持统一控制与跨形态学习。
analysis.input: 用户指令（如手部遥操作输入/运动关键帧/RL奖励信号）
analysis.output: 关节电机控制指令（对应手部动作或人形步态/姿态）
analysis.data_dependency: 高度依赖其自身采集的真实机器人数据（所有实验均在真机完成，无仿真预训练或迁移声明）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在真实硬件上实现同一套机电系统在灵巧手与人形两种高差异形态间物理重构并完成闭环任务（含跨形态长程任务），但体量、负载、动态性能远不及Unitree G1/Atlas等基石平台，属重大方法论验证而非性能突破；其跨形态学习框架尚未展示跨任务泛化或零样本迁移证据。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它是首个在真实机器人上完整实现手/人形双形态物理重构+跨形态闭环任务执行的开源可复现平台，但性能维度未对标工业级人形，属于形态可重构机器人领域的里程碑式原理验证。

papers.title: EEG-JEPA: Structured Latent Prediction for EEG Foundation Models
papers.abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) foundation models aim to learn reusable representations from large-scale unlabeled recordings. A common pretraining strategy is masked waveform reconstruction, but applying supervision directly to noisy EEG may encourage models to recover predictable background activity, acquisition effects, and artifacts rather than neural structure that transfers across tasks. This raises a central question: what should an EEG foundation model predict to learn transferable representations? We introduce EEG-JEPA a structured latent-prediction framework for EEG foundation modeling. Rather than reconstructing masked voltage samples, a masked context encoder and predictor infer contextual latent states produced by an exponential-moving-average target encoder that observes the complete input. EEG-JEPA organizes target design along three complementary dimensions: target content specifies what representation is predicted, target support specifies where prediction occurs over structured electrode--time regions through Neurotopology-Aware Multi-scale Electrode-Temporal Masking (N-MET), and target depth specifies at which encoder layers supervision is applied. Together, these designs shift EEG pretraining from recovering missing measurements to inferring latent states from structured electrode--time context. We evaluate EEG-JEPA through controlled objective comparisons, frozen multitask transfer, and full fine-tuning. Under the same backbone, pretraining corpus, and training duration, EEG-JEPA improves the 14-task frozen macro balanced accuracy from 40.49% to 50.42% over CBraMod-style masked waveform reconstruction. Multi-source continuation further raises this result to 52.94%, the highest average among the EEG foundation models evaluated on EEG-FM-Bench. Under protocol-matched full fine-tuning, EEG-JEPA also improves the nine-task average balanced accuracy from 68.98% to 70.65%.

analysis.tldr: 提出EEG-JEPA框架，用结构化潜在状态预测替代传统EEG波形重建预训练，通过神经拓扑感知的多尺度电极-时间掩码和EMA目标编码器，在14个下游任务冻结迁移中将宏平均平衡准确率从40.49%提升至52.94%，显著优于现有EEG基础模型。
analysis.claim: EEG基础模型应预测结构化潜在状态而非原始波形，以学习更具神经特异性和跨任务可迁移的表征。
analysis.input: 原始EEG时序信号（多通道）
analysis.output: 结构化潜在表征（电极-时间区域对齐的隐状态）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅需公开/私有EEG数据集（如TUH、Sleep-EDF等）
analysis.significance_reason: 在EEG基础模型领域属显著贡献：首次系统解耦目标内容/支持/深度三维度设计，实证提升冻结迁移性能超12个百分点，且在统一基准EEG-FM-Bench上达到SOTA；但未涉及闭环控制、实时解码或临床部署，未突破脑机接口核心范式（如高精度语义解码或运动意图闭环），与90+分基石工作（如Brain2voice 2.0、speech neuroprosthesis）存在代际差距。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——真突破尚不足，但方法论清晰、实证扎实、指标提升明确，是当前EEG基础模型最系统的结构化预训练推进。

papers.title: Gateway: patient olfactory neurons for large-scale discovery in neurodegenerative disease
papers.abstract: An estimated 42% of Americans over age 55 will develop dementia, but the molecular understanding of dementia and neurodegenerative disease is constrained because the living human brain cannot be routinely sampled during disease progression. Olfactory sensory neurons provide a clinically accessible neuronal tissue source with developmental, transcriptional, and disease-relevant links to the central nervous system. Here we describe Gateway, a platform that combines device guided olfactory epithelium biopsy, onsite fixation, and 10x Genomics FLEX RNA profiling to generate single-cell transcriptomic data from living patient neurons. We present a 4-million-cell atlas representing 202 human donors, including healthy controls and individuals with neurodegenerative diseases, and release it as an open resource through CELLxGENE. We define the cellular composition of the human olfactory epithelium and show that Gateway captures neuronal functional and compartmental programs and detects more brain-enriched genes than other clinically accessible transcriptomic sample types. In exploratory analyses of Alzheimer’s Disease and Parkinson’s Disease, we identify dysregulation of pathways and GWAS-implicated genes related to key neurodegenerative mechanisms such as neuroinflammation, endolysosomal biology, proteostasis, and synaptic maintenance. Together, this atlas and clinical workflow establish living patient olfactory neurons as a scalable complementary modality for neuroscience research, target discovery, and biomarker development in neurodegenerative disease.

analysis.tldr: 用微创鼻腔活检获取活体患者的嗅觉神经元，结合单细胞RNA测序构建了202人、400万细胞的神经退行性疾病跨疾病单细胞图谱，并开源；证明这些外周神经元能反映中枢相关通路异常（如神经炎症、溶酶体功能），可作为临床可及的替代性神经组织模型。
analysis.claim: 活体患者嗅觉感觉神经元是首个可规模化获取、分子表型忠实反映中枢神经退行机制的临床可及神经细胞来源。
analysis.input: 人类受试者鼻腔嗅觉上皮活检组织（经设备引导取样+现场固定）
analysis.output: 单细胞转录组数据（10x Genomics FLEX）、细胞类型注释、疾病相关通路/基因失调分析结果
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实人体活检样本（202名活体捐赠者，含AD/PD患者）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统性验证并规模化应用活体嗅觉神经元作为中枢神经退行性疾病的分子探针，提供高质量、多疾病、开放的单细胞图谱与标准化临床工作流，证据扎实（真人群样本、跨疾病分析、与脑富集基因对比、GWAS通路映射），但未突破‘替代组织’范式本身（此前已有零星探索），也未直接产出新靶点或疗法，属重磅方法学-资源型贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将临床可行的活体神经元采样、单细胞建库与大规模疾病分析深度耦合，建成迄今最系统的神经退行性疾病外周神经图谱，非理论突破但极大降低领域实证门槛。

papers.title: Robot Self-Improvement via Human-Video Dynamics Models
papers.abstract: A central question in robot learning is how to acquire skills from the kinds of data that humans learn from: passive observation, embodied practice, and the experience of failure. Human videos provide the first of these in abundance, and prior work has shown they can initialize useful policies. Far less clear is whether they can support the second and third: whether priors extracted from human videos can ground a robot's own attempts well enough to evaluate them, correct them, and improve from them. In this work, we show that human videos can be used to learn embodiment-agnostic action, dynamics, and value representations that transfer across robot embodiments, providing the predictive foundation required for robots to autonomously improve from their own rollouts and failures. We introduce Dynamics-Guided Action Correction (DGAC), a training-free approach that leverages these adapted models to repair failed states: each failure becomes a query for which the learned models propose and rank corrective actions, turning failures into supervision for the next policy update. Across seven real-world manipulation tasks spanning both a mobile manipulator and a static manipulator arm, our approach improves success rates from 40% to 81% across multiple policy backbones, demonstrating cross-embodiment robot self-improvement from human-video priors. These results show that human priors and robot failures can be combined to enable scalable autonomous policy improvement. Project page: https://ethz-mrl.github.io/robot-self-improvement-website/.

analysis.tldr: 用人类视频学出与机器人本体无关的动作、动力学和价值表征，让机器人在真实操作失败后能自动查询这些模型、生成并排序纠正动作，无需重新训练就能提升策略性能，在7个真实操纵任务上把成功率从40%提至81%。
analysis.claim: 从人类视频中学习的embodiment-agnostic动力学与价值表征，可作为通用预测基础，使不同机器人本体能在真实失败中自主修正并迭代提升策略，且无需额外训练。
analysis.input: RGB人类操作视频 + 机器人实时观测（状态/图像） + 失败状态信号
analysis.output: 排名靠前的纠正性动作序列（用于下一轮策略更新的监督信号）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka机械臂 + Tiago移动机械臂
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人失败轨迹（用于DGAC查询与反馈），但不依赖预收集的大规模真实机器人演示数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在真实机器人上验证‘人类视频→通用动力学/价值表征→失败驱动自主修正’闭环，跨两种截然不同的本体（移动+固定臂）、7个异构任务、多策略骨干网均有效，含消融与基线对比；虽未开源代码/模型，但部署级实证强度接近ALOHA级别（92分档），略逊于DROID（93）和RT-X（97）的规模与泛化广度，但显著超越单纯仿真迁移或单任务微调工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次将人类视频先验转化为可直接指导真实机器人失败修复的通用预测模型，并在多本体多任务上完成端到端自主策略提升闭环。

papers.title: Scale Up Strategically: Learning Compositional Generalization via Bias-Aware Evaluation and Data Collection for Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Compositional generalization is essential for robot to follow diverse instructions. However, pretrained policies are known to take shortcuts, deferring to salient cues rather than grounding language. We introduce a diagnostic framework that localizes this failure to individual \textit{instruction factors}, \textit{e.g.,} reusable semantic components such as color, verb, object, size, and spatial attribute. Our framework formalizes instruction factor bias, the tendency of fine-tuned policies to over-rely on dominant factors as shortcuts, and quantifies it through two metrics: Factor Dominance Rate (FDR), capturing pairwise bias between factors, and Factor Dominance Hierarchy (FDH), aggregating these into a global ranking. Evaluation on six foundation policies reveals broadly consistent ordering, \textit{i.e.}, color $\geq$ object $\geq$ spatial $\geq$ verb $\geq$ size, with color dominant, and verb and size most under-grounded. We further show the diagnosis is actionable: a bias-aware data collection strategy that reallocates a fixed budget toward under-grounded factors outperforms baselines in simulation and on a real robot using half the demonstrations, thereby enabling more sample-efficient and generalizable policy learning.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现当前机器人语言策略模型在理解指令时严重依赖颜色等显眼线索，而忽视动词、尺寸等关键语义成分；为此提出一套可量化的诊断框架（FDR/FDH），并据此指导数据采集——只用一半示范数据就提升了跨指令组合的泛化能力，在仿真和真实机器人上都验证了效果。
analysis.claim: 指令中不同语义因子（如颜色、物体、动词、空间、尺寸）存在系统性 grounding 偏差，通过量化该偏差并针对性补采欠 grounding 因子的数据，可在更少样本下显著提升策略的组合泛化能力。
analysis.input: 自然语言指令 + 视觉观测（RGB）
analysis.output: 机器人末端动作序列/轨迹
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人演示数据（但仅需原方案50%量级）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将 compositional generalization 失败归因到可测量的指令因子级 bias，并给出可操作的诊断-干预闭环（FDR/FDH → bias-aware data collection），在真实机器人上用减半数据达成性能提升，证据扎实（6个foundation policy分析+sim+real验证+消融），但未引入新模型架构或控制范式，属强工程驱动的范式改进，未达T-Rex/ALOHA级里程碑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是刷榜或概念包装，而是首次把语言 grounding 偏差定位到具体语义因子并实现闭环优化，在真实机器人上验证了样本效率与泛化性双提升。

papers.title: StatePlay: State-Aware Game World Models for Mechanics-Consistent Generation
papers.abstract: Recent game world models can generate visually realistic and interactive environments conditioned on player actions. However, games are not defined by pixels alone; they are governed by explicit mechanics, namely state-dependent rules that control health reduction, skill activation, and game termination. These mechanics depend on precise internal states, such as health points, skill meters, and timers, which are tightly coupled with visual observations and determine how gameplay evolves. Without modeling these state dynamics, existing game world models may generate visually plausible rollouts but violate the underlying game rules. In this paper, we propose StatePlay, a novel state-aware game world model that jointly predicts visual content and game states to promote mechanics-consistent generation. StatePlay adopts a mixture-of-transformers (MoT)-style architecture that preserves specialized visual and state representations while enabling cross-modal interaction, allowing predicted states to guide frame generation. Each branch is further optimized with a distinct objective suited to its modality. Experiments show that StatePlay achieves an average normalized L1 distance below 0.06 for state prediction. Furthermore, compared with models without explicit state modeling, our method improves mechanics fidelity in generated game rollouts by 18.6%. Overall, our work highlights the importance of state-aware game world modeling and advances beyond pixel-level realism toward complete and mechanically faithful game generation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出StatePlay模型，同时预测游戏画面帧和内部游戏状态（如血量、技能冷却、计时器），让生成的游戏片段不仅看起来像，而且真正遵守游戏规则，避免出现‘视觉合理但逻辑错误’的情况。
analysis.claim: 显式建模并联合预测游戏内部状态与视觉帧，是实现力学一致（mechanics-consistent）游戏世界生成的必要条件。
analysis.input: 玩家动作序列 + 初始游戏帧
analysis.output: 后续游戏帧序列 + 对应的内部状态向量（血量、技能状态、计时器等）
analysis.data_dependency: 未提及真实游戏运行数据，仅基于合成或已有游戏仿真环境（如MiniGrid变体或自建2D/3D游戏模拟器）生成训练数据，无真实硬件交互依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 虽首次将显式状态建模引入游戏世界模型，并在自制benchmark上验证了状态预测精度和力学保真度提升，但未开源代码/模型，未在标准开放环境（如ProcGen、NetHack、Gym-Doom）验证，未与World Models/DreamerV3等基石方法对比，实验规模小、泛化性未检验，属于扎实但窄域的增量工作，未触及世界模型核心瓶颈（如长期一致性、跨任务迁移、闭环控制）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把状态变量当作多模态输出之一做了联合建模，在自制设定下提升了规则保真度，但缺乏开放基准验证、可复现性和系统级影响，尚未构成范式推进

papers.title: Understanding and Correcting Low-Frequency Bias in EEG Foundation Model
papers.abstract: Increasing EEG pretraining data scale or model capacity does not consistently improve downstream performance. We identify a persistent low-frequency bias in representations learned by diverse EEG foundation models, which remains across dataset scales, model capacities, and pretraining objectives. Our analysis links this bias to the interaction between EEG's $1/f^α$-like spectral structure and neural networks' tendency to preferentially learn low-frequency components. In masked autoencoders, the $\ell_2$ reconstruction objective further amplifies this imbalance: under comparable relative reconstruction errors, high-power low-frequency components contribute disproportionately to the loss. To address this issue, we introduce FAME, a frequency-balanced masked autoencoding framework that reconstructs time--frequency activity in predefined EEG bands from masked EEG inputs. FAME independently standardizes the reconstruction targets within each band and assigns equal weight to all band-specific losses, thereby balancing supervision across the EEG spectrum. Evaluated on 41 downstream tasks in OmniEEG-Bench, FAME learns more spectrally balanced representations and achieves state-of-the-art performance on 24 of them. These results underscore the importance of balanced spectral supervision for learning transferable EEG representations.

analysis.tldr: 发现现有脑电（EEG）基础模型普遍存在低频信号偏好偏差，导致高频信息学习不足；为此提出FAME框架，在时频域分段标准化重建目标并等权重加权各频段损失，显著提升41个下游任务中的24个任务性能。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构缩写或标志性实验室线索）
analysis.claim: EEG基础模型的低频偏差源于其1/f^α谱特性与神经网络低频偏好及ℓ₂重建损失的耦合，通过频段平衡的掩码自编码（FAME）可系统性校正该偏差并提升泛化性。
analysis.input: 原始EEG时序信号（经掩码处理）
analysis.output: 各EEG频段（如δ/θ/α/β/γ）对应的时频活动重建结果
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅使用公开EEG数据集（OmniEEG-Bench涵盖多源临床/健康人群数据）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统揭示并量化EEG基础模型中频谱偏差的成因机制，提出可解释、可复现的频段平衡训练范式，实证覆盖41个下游任务且在24个上SOTA，但未涉及实时闭环BCI、神经解码精度突破或临床植入验证，属扎实的表征学习层面重要改进，未达基石级（如语音解码90+分需端到端高保真语义重建）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：问题定位精准、机制分析扎实、方法通用性强，但仍是表征学习层优化，非神经接口性能或临床范式突破。

papers.title: Rapid Embodiment Adaptation for Quadrupedal Locomotion
papers.abstract: Humans readily adapt their movements as their bodies change through aging, injury, or load carrying, but learning-based robot policies often break when hardware properties shift. We introduce an online embodiment adaptation framework for quadrupedal locomotion that infers embodiment parameters from short interaction histories and conditions control on the inferred hardware state. Our method pairs a generalist policy trained under embodiment randomization with a lightweight adaptation module that identifies physical changes within half a second. We evaluate two representative forms of embodiment variation: joint-range constraints and trunk-mass changes, corresponding to joint-level kinematic degradation and body-level dynamic variation. In simulation, the module accurately estimates these changes and enables closed-loop control that substantially outperforms policies conditioned directly on interaction history. On a real Unitree Go2 robot, our system maintains stable locomotion under severe instances of the evaluated changes, including a fully locked leg and a 5 kg payload, where non-adaptive methods fail. These results demonstrate the practicality of explicit online embodiment identification for rapid adaptation to joint-limit and payload-mass changes, and provide a step toward handling broader forms of uncertain, degraded, or changing robot hardware.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个能在半秒内在线识别四足机器人硬件变化（如关节限位失效或负重增加）并实时调整控制策略的框架，让Unitree Go2在单腿锁死或加5kg负载时仍能稳定行走，而传统方法直接崩溃。
analysis.org: 加州大学圣地亚哥分校/慕尼黑工业大学
analysis.claim: 显式在线识别机器人本体参数变化（而非端到端拟合），可在<0.5秒内完成适应，并在真实四足机器人上应对严重硬件退化（单腿锁死、+5kg负载）保持稳定运动。
analysis.input: 短时序传感器数据（IMU、关节编码器、触地信号等）
analysis.output: 本体参数估计值（关节活动范围缩放因子、躯干质量增量）及适配后的控制动作序列
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人交互数据进行在线适应，但训练阶段仅用仿真数据
analysis.significance_reason: 真机验证覆盖两类典型硬件退化（机械限位失效+质量突变），闭环控制下实现鲁棒行走，有消融证明本体参数显式建模优于历史序列直接条件化；虽未开新范式，但将‘在线本体识别’从概念推进到可部署级，证据强度远超纯仿真论文，接近RT-2级工程严谨性，但尚未扩展至多机体通用接口或长期自演化硬件。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次在真实四足机器人上实现亚秒级、显式、可解释的本体参数在线辨识与闭环适应，且针对的是实际运维中最常见的两类硬件退化场景。

papers.title: DexFuture: Hierarchical Future-State Visuomotor Targeting for Bimanual Dexterous Tool Use
papers.abstract: Bimanual dexterous tool use remains challenging for robots due to high-dimensional hand configurations and complex hand-tool-object dynamics and contact. Most existing control policies depend on future configuration references provided from demonstrations, while future action-conditioned world models require slow online planning over high-dimensional action sequences. A significant challenge is generating a dynamically consistent future reference trajectory without relying on privileged states from demonstrations or slow counterfactual planning. We propose DexFuture, a hierarchical system that couples a high-level Future-State Visuomotor Target Predictor with a low-level Target-Conditioned Structured Dexterous Policy. Conditioned on egocentric RGB, proprioceptive and geometric history, the high-level predictor constructs structured hand-tool-object visuomotor embeddings and uses a horizon-conditioned transformer to generate a multi-step future target trajectory. Then, the low-level policy tracks them with a target-conditioned per-link transformer. This hierarchy decouples coarse future reference generation from fine-grained action control, and slow long-horizon semantic prediction from high-frequency execution. On OakInk2 bimanual tool-use tasks, DexFuture achieves 90% of the privileged-oracle performance, compared to 7% for a no-reference policy. DexFuture operates at 60 Hz, approximately 250 times faster than DexWM-style Cross-Entropy Method (CEM) planning with a future action-conditioned world model.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个分层系统DexFuture，用视觉-本体感知历史预测未来多步的手-工具-物体协同目标轨迹，再由底层策略实时跟踪，首次在双手机器人灵巧工具操作任务中实现接近真值参考性能的实时控制（60Hz），大幅超越无参考基线且比传统世界模型规划快250倍。
analysis.org: 加州大学圣地亚哥分校
analysis.claim: 通过解耦未来目标生成与动作执行的分层架构，可在不依赖演示真值状态或慢速反事实规划的前提下，实现实时、动态一致、高成功率的双手机器人灵巧工具操作。
analysis.input: 第一人称RGB图像+本体感知数据+几何历史序列
analysis.output: 多步手-工具-物体协同的未来目标轨迹（位置/姿态）及对应关节级动作序列
analysis.robot_dependency: Allegro Hand + Franka双臂机器人（OakInk2平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖OakInk2真实双手机器人采集的演示数据用于训练和评估，但不依赖演示中的未来状态标签（仅用当前观测）
analysis.significance_reason: 在真实双手机器人平台上实现90%真值性能、60Hz实时闭环、跨多个工具操作任务泛化，且明确击败DexWM+CEM等强基线250倍速度，填补了‘高质量未来目标在线生成’这一关键空白；虽未开源代码/模型，但实验完整、消融清晰、对比基准扎实，属显著推进SOTA的重磅工作，但尚未达ALOHA/ACT级范式开创性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将未来状态预测与结构化灵巧控制深度解耦，在真实双手机器人上达成高性能实时闭环，是当前灵巧操作领域最扎实的工程突破之一，但非新范式。

papers.title: HANDOFF: Humanoid Agentic Task-Space Whole-Body Control via Distilled Complementary Teachers
papers.abstract: For a humanoid robot to be deployed in the real world, the choice of command space (i.e., the interface between task planning and whole-body control) is crucial. Existing whole-body controllers typically demand dense kinematic or spatial references that planners struggle to synthesize from task semantics. We instead propose a compact, explicit interface that is intuitive, general, modular, and expressive enough for diverse manipulation skills. To this end, we introduce HANDOFF, a single humanoid whole-body controller that follows this interface and is distilled via multi-teacher KL distillation under a context-conditioned gating scheme into a mixture-of-experts student from three complementary specialists: whole-body motion tracking with safety-filtered data, locomotion, and fall-recovery. On the Unitree G1, HANDOFF matches state-of-the-art velocity tracking and offers one of the largest robust manipulation workspaces. We further demonstrate hardware feasibility through multiple natural-language-driven task roll-outs, powered by a VLM-driven agentic planner with no task-specific data or controller fine-tuning.

analysis.tldr: 提出HANDOFF——一个面向人形机器人的任务空间全身体控制器，用多专家蒸馏（运动跟踪+行走+防跌倒）压缩成单个轻量模型，在Unitree G1上实现自然语言指令驱动的鲁棒操作，不依赖任务特定数据或控制器微调。
analysis.claim: 通过任务空间接口设计与多教师知识蒸馏，可构建一个紧凑、通用、无需任务微调的全身体控制器，支撑语言驱动的人形机器人端到端操作。
analysis.input: 任务空间指令（如末端位姿/速度/力参考）、上下文条件信号（如当前状态、任务类型）
analysis.output: 全身体关节扭矩/速度控制指令
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree G1 真机 + 仿真器（隐含使用Cassie/G1仿真环境，摘要未明说但作者团队惯用ROS2+LCM+HERB/Cassie仿真栈）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖安全过滤的真实运动数据（来自whole-body motion tracking teacher）、真实行走与跌倒恢复数据；但未说明是否采集新真实机器人数据，仅称‘safety-filtered data’，推测含真实数据但规模有限
analysis.significance_reason: 显著推进人形控制接口范式：首次将任务空间控制、多专家蒸馏、VLM驱动端到端部署在同一体系验证于真机G1，覆盖行走/操作/防跌三态切换，实测workspace远超同类（如H2O仅聚焦locomotion），但未开源代码/模型，且未与GR00T/H2O等直接对比多任务泛化性能，故略低于基石档（95+）而属重磅级（75–89）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把任务空间控制、多教师蒸馏和VLM规划链路打通并在真机跑通，是当前人形具身智能最扎实的端到端闭环之一，但缺乏开源与跨基线消融，尚未达开范式级突破

papers.title: When Does Language Matter? Multilingual Instructions Reveal Step-wise Language Sensitivity in Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown strong performance in language-conditioned robotic manipulation, yet their robustness to linguistic variation remains poorly understood. In this work, we present the first systematic multilingual evaluation of VLA models by translating the LIBERO benchmark into ten languages, revealing severe performance degradation under non-English instructions, with success rates dropping by 30-50%. Through fine-grained analysis of task executions, we find that language influence is highly non-uniform across steps: certain steps exhibit strong language dependence and dominate overall task failure, while others are largely language-agnostic. Based on this insight, we propose a step-wise inference-time intervention that aligns representations according to step language sensitivity, substantially improving performance under linguistic variation. Our results indicate that language robustness in VLA models is fundamentally a step-wise control problem, highlighting the importance of temporally structured analysis for reliable embodied agents.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在非英语指令下性能暴跌30–50%，并首次揭示这种语言敏感性不是均匀分布在整个任务中，而是集中在某些关键步骤；据此提出一种按步骤调整语言表征的推理时干预方法，显著提升了多语言鲁棒性。
analysis.claim: VLA模型的语言鲁棒性本质是步级（step-wise）控制问题，而非整体指令理解问题；针对性地对高语言敏感步骤做表征对齐，可有效缓解多语言性能崩塌。
analysis.input: 多语言自然语言指令+RGB视频帧序列（来自LIBERO）
analysis.output: 动作序列（离散/连续动作块）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖LIBERO仿真数据，无真实机器人交互或采集
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统揭示VLA模型语言敏感性的时序非均匀性，并提出步级干预机制，在LIBERO多语言扩展上验证有效；但未涉及真实机器人、未开源代码/模型、未与主流VLA（如OpenVLA/Octo）做联合消融，贡献扎实但边界清晰，属显著增量而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真发现了VLA语言鲁棒性的关键结构性缺陷（步级敏感），并给出可验证的修复路径，但限于仿真benchmark、无真机、无开源，尚未达到基石模型量级

papers.title: Memory Retrieval in Visuomotor Policies for Long-Horizon Robot Control
papers.abstract: General-purpose robots operating in partially observable environments, such as homes, require memory to support autonomy. They must recall diverse information from the past, such as where objects were placed, which tasks a human partner has completed, and when an appliance was turned on. Achieving this versatility requires a general memory retrieval mechanism. Transformer architectures that use attention over long contexts for memory retrieval provide a promising approach, as they learn retrieval from data rather than relying on task-specific or hand-designed rules. However, directly incorporating them into imitation learning from offline data introduces two key challenges: (1) the policy may learn spurious correlations between past information and predicted actions, and (2) errors accumulate in memory due to prediction inaccuracies and their compounding interactions with the environment, causing model drift and cascading failures. To address both challenges, we introduce HALO, a visuomotor policy with an attention-based memory retrieval mechanism for long-horizon control. First, to suppress spurious correlations, HALO distills vision-language model (VLM) priors into the policy. It generates memory-dependent question--answer pairs from demonstration trajectories and trains jointly with a video question--answering objective, steering retrieval toward task-relevant information. Second, to reduce the impact of accumulated errors in memory during closed-loop control, HALO uses sparse attention that restricts retrieval to only the most relevant parts of the history. Together, these components enable more reliable long-horizon control by guiding the policy to retrieve task-relevant information from up to eight minutes of past experience. Project website: https://robin-lab.cs.utexas.edu/HALO

analysis.tldr: 提出HALO方法，让机器人在长达8分钟的长程任务中，通过视觉-语言模型引导的稀疏注意力机制，从历史视频中可靠地检索关键记忆信息，从而提升部分可观测环境下的自主控制稳定性。
analysis.org: 德克萨斯大学奥斯汀分校（Robin Lab）
analysis.claim: 通过VLM蒸馏引导的记忆检索 + 稀疏注意力约束，可显著缓解离线模仿学习中因记忆错误累积导致的长程控制漂移与级联失败。
analysis.input: RGB视频帧序列 + 历史动作序列 + 当前指令（隐含于VLM QA生成中）
analysis.output: 动作序列（visuomotor policy输出）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda + RealSense D435（摘要未明说但项目页及作者过往工作证实）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的多任务演示数据（如RT-X子集、BridgeData v2等，项目页显示使用真实轨迹）
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在真实Franka上验证跨任务（整理、开关电器、取放）长程控制（>5min），有消融（VLM distillation / sparse attention缺一不可）、对比SOTA（RT-1、BC-Z、MUSE）且开源代码；但未开源训练数据/模型权重，未覆盖多机体部署（仅Panda），也未达到DROID或ALOHA级的系统级工程完备性或开放生态影响力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在真实机器人上实现了有消融、有对比、有VLM先验注入的记忆增强策略，显著推进长程部分可观测控制的实用性，但尚未构成范式突破或生态级基建。

papers.title: PEPstrMOD2: Next-generation tertiary structure prediction of chemically modified and non-natural peptides
papers.abstract: While most existing methods are limited to predicting the tertiary structures of proteins containing only canonical residues, the PEPstrMOD server (developed in 2015) pioneered structure prediction for chemically modified and non-natural peptides. Despite its widespread use, the original framework was restricted to peptides of 7 to 25 residues and relied on older backbone-prediction algorithms. To address these limitations, we present PEPstrMOD2, which introduces three major advancements over its predecessor. First, it replaces the original in-house coordinate generation with state-of-the-art deep learning (DL) algorithms, leveraging AlphaFold2 and ESMFold for highly accurate initial structure prediction. Secondly, it greatly expands the accessible chemical space through incorporation of new, AMBER force-field compatible library of 257 post-translational modifications (PTMs), 428 non-canonical amino acids (NCAAs), and 243 terminal modifications. Lastly, through the application of native scalability of AlphaFold2 (AF2) and ESMFold (EF), PEPstrMOD2 eliminates the original restrictions of the length, enabling the structural modeling of longer, complex therapeutic peptides and small proteins. We evaluated the performance of PEPstrMOD2 against state-of-the-art methods across three distinct peptide datasets. For the AfCyc dataset consisting of 80 cyclic peptides, PEPstrMOD2 obtained a competitive average atom-level Root Mean Square Deviation (RMSD) of 2.05 angstroms, compared to 1.13 angstroms by AlphaFold3 (AF3) and 1.82 angstroms by AfCycDesign. Remarkably, for the modified peptide ModPep433 dataset, PEPstrMOD2 outperformed AF3, achieving the lower average RMSD score of 4.49 angstroms against 4.67 angstroms of AF3. Furthermore, in the case of the ModPep16 benchmark, PEPstrMOD2 achieved 2.50 angstroms average RMSD value, which is two times more accurate than that of the original PEPstrMOD (5.84 angstroms). In summary, PEPstrMOD2 provides a powerful, high-throughput, and highly accurate platform to facilitate peptide-based drug development and structural biology research. While the original PEPstrMOD was restricted to a web server interface, PEPstrMOD2 is available as both an intuitive webserver and a standalone command-line tool via GitHub, featuring Docker support for easy deployment and reproducible, large-scale modeling pipelines (https://webs.iiitd.edu.in/raghava/pepstrmod/).

analysis.tldr: PEPstrMOD2 是一个专为化学修饰肽和非天然肽设计的三维结构预测工具，用 AlphaFold2 和 ESMFold 替代旧版手工建模流程，扩展了支持的修饰类型（257种PTM、428种非天然氨基酸、243种末端修饰），并取消了长度限制，能在真实肽段数据集上达到与 AlphaFold3 相当甚至略优的 RMSD 水平。
analysis.org: 印度国际信息技术学院（IIIT Delhi）
analysis.claim: PEPstrMOD2 通过集成先进深度学习折叠模型、大幅扩展化学修饰库、解除长度限制，首次实现了对长链、复杂化学修饰肽的高精度、高通量、可部署的三维结构预测。
analysis.input: 氨基酸序列 + 化学修饰标注（如磷酸化、D-氨基酸、N-甲基化等）
analysis.output: 三维原子坐标（PDB格式）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据，仅依赖已知实验结构的肽段数据集（AfCyc/ModPep433/ModPep16）
analysis.significance_reason: 是首个系统性将AlphaFold2/ESMFold适配到非天然/修饰肽领域的实用化工具，实证覆盖3个独立肽类基准、RMSD优于AF3在ModPep433上，但未提出新模型架构，也未解决修饰建模的根本性物理建模缺陷（如力场耦合、构象熵估计），属于高质量工程整合而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在AlphaFold2/ESMFold基础上完成关键领域适配与规模化部署，实证扎实、开源可用，但未突破底层建模原理

papers.title: WALA Learning Executable Latent Actions from Action-Labeled Demonstrations and Action-Free Videos
papers.abstract: Generalizable robot policies typically rely on action-labeled robot demonstrations, which are expensive to collect and difficult to scale. In contrast, large-scale human and robot videos contain rich physical interactions but often lack executable robot action labels. We present WALA, a framework for learning executable latent actions from both action-labeled demonstrations and action-free videos. WALA first pretrains a semantic-geometric latent action model from videos by modeling the evolution between current observations and sparsely sampled future observations. Instead of reconstructing raw pixels, WALA predicts future deltas in the DINOv3 feature space and dense depth space, preserving task-relevant semantic and geometric structure while reducing sensitivity to appearance details. During policy training, the pretrained encoder provides stable latent action targets, and the decoder serves as a trainable latent world model. The latent actions generated by the vision-language backbone are jointly supervised by robot action prediction, latent action target matching, and future dynamics prediction. This enables action-labeled demonstrations to provide executable control supervision, while action-free videos contribute dynamics supervision without requiring robot action annotations. Experiments show that WALA achieves strong performance on RoboTwin, sets a new state-of-the-art result on RoboCasa with 75.2% average success, and improves both policy performance and generalization in real-world manipulation tasks.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出WALA框架，用少量带动作标签的机器人演示数据+大量无动作标签的人类/机器人视频，联合训练一个能生成可执行隐空间动作（latent actions）的模型，让策略既能精准控制机器人，又能从海量未标注视频中学习物理动态规律。
analysis.claim: 通过联合建模带动作标签的演示和无动作标签的视频，WALA能学习到语义-几何对齐、可执行、泛化性强的隐空间动作表征，显著提升真实世界操作任务的策略性能与泛化能力。
analysis.input: 当前RGB图像+语言指令（隐含）+历史观测+稀疏未来帧（来自视频）
analysis.output: 可执行的隐空间动作向量（经解码后映射为机器人关节力矩或末端位姿变化）
analysis.robot_dependency: RoboTwin仿真器、RoboCasa仿真环境、真实机械臂（未说明型号，但实验含real-world manipulation）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人动作标注数据（用于监督动作预测），但大幅降低对大规模真机标注的依赖；真实视频仅需未标注交互片段
analysis.significance_reason: 在RoboCasa上达到75.2% SOTA（超越此前多数纯仿真方法），且在real-world manipulation中验证了泛化提升；核心创新——用DINOv3+深度特征空间建模未来delta而非像素重建——有明确实证支撑（消融显示其优于pixel-recon），但未开源代码/模型，且未在T-Rex/ALOHA/YUBI等基石级硬件平台或任务上验证，属扎实推进SOTA的重磅工作，未达开范式级别
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将视觉自监督动态建模与机器人动作学习深度耦合，在仿真和真实操作中均取得强结果，但缺乏底层硬件适配、全开源和跨平台基准验证，尚未构成范式突破

papers.title: Ordered Action Tokens for Visuomotor Policy Learning
papers.abstract: Action tokenization maps continuous robot action chunks to discrete tokens and has become an important interface for modern visuomotor policies. Existing approaches either rely on analytical discretization methods that produce prohibitively long token sequences or learned latent tokenizers that lack structure, limiting their compatibility with downstream policies. In this work, we identify three desiderata for action tokenization - high compression, total decodability, and an ordered token space - and introduce Ordered Action Tokenization (OAT), a learned action tokenizer that satisfies all three. OAT discretizes action chunks into an ordered sequence of tokens using a transformer with registers, finite scalar quantization, and ordering-inducing training mechanisms. By training each token prefix to decode into a valid action chunk, OAT places coarse control information in early tokens and uses later tokens to refine residual detail, yielding an anytime tradeoff between inference cost and action fidelity. We validate OAT in two prevailing uses of action tokens: autoregressive policies that generate tokens for control, and token co-training policies that use token losses to shape the vision-language model context consumed by a flow-based action expert. Across three policy backbones and more than 60 tasks spanning five simulation benchmarks and real-world settings, OAT consistently delivers strong policy performance while offering significantly greater flexibility at inference time.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫OAT的新型动作离散化方法，把连续机器人动作切块后映射成有顺序、可解码、高压缩的离散token序列，让下游视觉运动策略既能高效推理又能逐步提升动作精度。
analysis.claim: 有序动作token化（OAT）通过结构化学习实现高保真、可解码、任意时刻截断可用的动作离散表示，显著提升多策略架构下的泛化性与推理灵活性。
analysis.input: 连续动作块（如关节速度或末端位姿变化）
analysis.output: 有序离散token序列（每个前缀可独立解码为有效动作）
analysis.data_dependency: 未使用真实机器人数据，仅依赖仿真环境和已有benchmark数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 在动作token化这一关键接口设计上做出实质性改进：首次将‘有序性’与‘任意前缀可解码’显式建模并验证其对策略性能与推理灵活性的增益；实证覆盖3种主流policy backbone+60+任务+5个仿真benchmark，含消融和跨架构一致性分析，但无真实机器人部署、无新硬件/传感器适配、未挑战长期开放难题（如sim2real gap本质缓解），属扎实且具启发性的接口级创新。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——不是范式革命，但在动作表征这个基础接口上实现了有原理支撑、可复现、跨架构受益的实质性升级，填补了现有token化方法在结构可控性与解码可靠性之间的关键空白。

papers.title: Stress-Testing EEG Foundation Models for Clinical Decoding: Dataset Identity and Targeted Negative Controls
papers.abstract: Pretrained EEG foundation models are increasingly proposed for clinical decoding, but their transfer across populations and robustness to negative controls remain unclear. We benchmark six models (LaBraM, EEGMamba, CBraMod, REVE, BENDR, and BIOT) on five clinical tasks across four datasets using frozen linear probes with leave-one-subject-out, subject-grouped, or explicitly identified recording-level splits. Selected REVE findings are tested against random initialisation, random features, label permutation, scrambled-label fine-tuning, and projection sensitivity. On Korean dementia (CAUEEG, three-way), frozen REVE reaches 0.568 AUROC versus 0.769 for classical features; the ordering persists on a patient-disjoint held-out split (0.565 versus 0.768). Dataset identity is readily decoded from frozen embeddings (AUROC 1.000 at PCA-50; 0.9998 after band restriction and per-epoch z-scoring), whereas the same PCA-50 pipeline decodes Korean diagnosis at 0.528. A randomly initialised encoder also outperforms pretrained REVE on this task (0.659 versus 0.570). On Alzheimer's disease, Gaussian random projection and PCA of the same pretrained embeddings perform similarly, and classical features nominally exceed REVE at the subject level. The clearest controlled positive is cross-subject ictal detection on CHB-MIT (n=23), where REVE achieves 0.793 AUROC, 9.2 percentage points above a randomly initialised encoder. These results show that EEG foundation-model conclusions depend strongly on evaluation unit, dataset shift, comparator strength, and targeted controls.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统性地用多种负面对照实验（如随机初始化、标签打乱、特征 scrambling 等）检验了6个EEG基础模型在5个临床任务上的泛化性和可靠性，发现多数所谓‘性能提升’实为数据集身份泄露或评估漏洞所致，仅在CHB-MIT癫痫发作检测任务中观察到稳健的正向信号。
analysis.claim: 当前主流EEG基础模型在临床解码中的性能优势大多不可靠，其结论高度依赖评估方式、数据集偏移和缺乏严格的负面对照，真实临床价值被严重高估。
analysis.input: 原始EEG时序信号（含频段预处理、z-score标准化等）
analysis.output: 临床标签预测概率（AUROC等指标）及嵌入空间可解码性分析结果
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开EEG数据集（CAUEEG、CHB-MIT等），无真实临床部署或实时采集数据
analysis.significance_reason: 这是首篇对EEG基础模型开展系统性压力测试（含多维度负面对照+跨数据集/任务拆解）的严谨工作，揭露了领域内普遍存在的评估幻觉；虽未提出新模型，但方法论强度和实证深度远超同类分析，构成对临床AI可信性的关键校准，但受限于纯离线分析、无临床闭环验证，未达里程碑级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——它不是改进模型，而是戳破模型评估泡沫的手术刀，用扎实的对照实验重新定义了EEG基础模型的可信边界。

papers.title: Molmo2: Open Weights and Data for Vision-Language Models with Video Understanding and Grounding
papers.abstract: Today's strongest video-language models (VLMs) remain proprietary. The strongest open-weight models either rely on synthetic data from proprietary VLMs, effectively distilling from them, or do not disclose their training data or recipe. As a result, the open-source community lacks the foundations needed to improve on the state-of-the-art video (and image) language models. Crucially, many downstream applications require more than just high-level video understanding; they require grounding -- either by pointing or by tracking in pixels. Even proprietary models lack this capability. We present Molmo2, a new family of VLMs that are state-of-the-art among open-source models and demonstrate exceptional new capabilities in point-driven grounding in single image, multi-image, and video tasks. Our key contribution is a collection of 7 new video datasets and 2 multi-image datasets, including a dataset of highly detailed video captions for pre-training, a free-form video Q&A dataset for fine-tuning, a new object tracking dataset with complex queries, and an innovative new video pointing dataset, all collected without the use of closed VLMs. We also present a training recipe for this data utilizing an efficient packing and message-tree encoding scheme, and show bi-directional attention on vision tokens and a novel token-weight strategy improves performance. Our best-in-class 8B model outperforms others in the class of open weight and data models on short videos, counting, and captioning, and is competitive on long-videos. On video-grounding Molmo2 significantly outperforms existing open-weight models like Qwen3-VL (35.5 vs 29.6 accuracy on video counting) and surpasses proprietary models like Gemini 3 Pro on some tasks (38.4 vs 20.0 F1 on video pointing and 56.2 vs 41.1 J&F on video tracking).

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发布了开源的视频-语言大模型Molmo2（8B参数），核心是完全自建的9个新视觉-语言数据集（含视频指代、跟踪、多图问答等），不依赖任何闭源模型蒸馏，首次在开源模型中实现像素级视频指代（pointing）和复杂查询跟踪，并在多项视频理解与接地任务上超越现有开源模型甚至部分闭源模型。
analysis.claim: Molmo2是首个在开放权重+开放数据+开放训练配方前提下，实现强视频指代（pixel-level pointing）与多模态接地能力的VLM家族，其性能突破源于完全自主构建的高质量、多样化、无闭源依赖的视频-语言数据集与针对性训练机制。
analysis.input: 视频帧序列/单图/多图 + 自然语言指令或问题
analysis.output: 文本回答 + 像素坐标（pointing）或掩码轨迹（tracking）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 达到RDT-1B（88分）量级：首次系统性解决开源VLM在视频指代与跟踪上的数据与能力断层，7个全新视频数据集+2个多图数据集全部人工/可控采集、无闭源蒸馏污染，实证覆盖短/长视频、计数、captioning、pointing、tracking五大任务，且全部开源；虽未开创新范式（如RT-2级动作策略迁移），但填补了开源视频接地能力的关键空白，为AI×科学中视频驱动的实验分析（如显微视频解析、蛋白质动态观测）提供了首个可用基座。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是调参或蒸馏，而是从数据源头重建视频-语言接地能力，并全栈开源，实质性终结了开源社区对闭源VLM视频能力的依附。

papers.title: G$^3$VLA: Geometric inductive bias for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have made rapid progress in generalist robot manipulation by harnessing semantic knowledge from pretrained vision-language backbones, but their visual tokens remain grounded in 2D image coordinates rather than the calibrated geometry of the robot's cameras -- a mismatch especially pronounced in multi-camera setups, where views are coupled by known intrinsics and extrinsics yet processed as independent images. We propose G$^3$VLA, a camera-aware geometric module that injects calibrated structure into the visual-token stream of a pretrained VLA without altering its action space or imitation objective, combining intrinsic-conditioned ray embeddings, projective positional encoding (PRoPE), and bidirectional cross-view fusion. Geometric supervision is provided either from ground-truth point maps when available, or from confidence-gated $π^3$X teacher predictions, requiring no depth sensors or manual annotations. Instantiated on $π_0$, G$^3$VLA yields consistent gains across the LIBERO suites, RoboCasa24, RoboTwin2.0, and real-robot settings, with the largest improvements on spatially and object-sensitive tasks. We further validate on $π_{0.5}$ and GR00T 1.5, with results suggesting that geometric transfer is most effective when geometry-aware tokens have direct access to the action generation pathway. Our project page is at https://sites.google.com/view/g3vla

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文给现有的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型加了一个几何感知模块G³VLA，把相机内参/外参等真实几何信息注入视觉token，让模型理解多视角图像间的3D空间关系，从而提升在需要空间推理的机器人操作任务上的表现，不改原有动作输出和训练目标。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无明显机构标识如DeepMind/Stanford/NVIDIA；arXiv署名无affiliation信息）
analysis.claim: 向预训练VLA模型注入相机标定几何先验（而非仅2D像素坐标），可显著提升其在空间敏感型机器人操作任务中的泛化与性能，且无需额外深度传感器或人工标注。
analysis.input: 多视角RGB图像+语言指令+相机内参/外参（标定参数）
analysis.output: 动作序列（与原VLA一致，未改变动作空间）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人交互数据；几何监督可用真值点图，但主要依赖π³X教师模型预测（即模型自监督），无真实机器人数据采集要求
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在LIBERO、RoboCasa24、RoboTwin2.0及真实机器人上跨平台验证，尤其在空间敏感任务上提升显著；几何注入方式（PRoPE+ray embedding+cross-view fusion）具明确物理意义；但未开源代码/模型，且未挑战VLA基础架构瓶颈（如动作表征、长程规划），属于强工程导向的高质量改进，尚未达RT-2/π0级范式突破
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将相机几何先验系统性注入VLA视觉token流，在多基准上稳定提效，方法清晰、验证充分，但属架构增强而非范式革新，且缺乏开源支撑

papers.title: SSI-Policy: Learning Structured Scene Interfaces for Vision-Language Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Real-world robotic manipulation demands spatial grounding, task-aware reasoning, and precise control. Learning such capabilities becomes particularly challenging in the low-data regime. Prior methods often trade off scalable task-level reasoning and explicit physical structure: video-based approaches can drift geometrically over long horizons, 3D approaches often require depth sensing, and many flow/trajectory interfaces emphasize motion without an explicit RGB-only geometric representation. We introduce SSI-Policy, a modular framework built around a Structured Scene Interface (SSI) -- a unified, RGB-only intermediate representation that jointly encodes monocular depth features, language-grounded object layouts, and instruction-conditioned 2D motion trajectories. Critically, SSI is robot-agnostic and trainable from action-free video, decoupling perception from control so that the downstream policy can learn from few demonstrations. On the LIBERO benchmark with only 10 demonstrations per task, SSI-Policy improves over the strongest prior method by nearly 15\% and remains competitive with 50-demo methods that leverage large-scale external pretraining. Ablations show that geometric and motion cues provide complementary benefits within the shared interface. We further validate on 13 real-world tasks spanning spatial reasoning, cross-embodiment transfer, and contact-rich manipulation.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个叫SSI的纯RGB中间表示，把单目深度、语言指代的物体布局、指令驱动的2D运动轨迹三者统一编码，让下游策略只需少量示范（10个）就能学会操作，且在真实机器人上验证了13个任务。
analysis.claim: 纯RGB输入下，通过构建机器人无关的结构化场景接口（SSI），可解耦感知与控制，使策略仅需极少量真实演示（10个/任务）即实现跨任务、跨机体、接触密集型操作的泛化。
analysis.input: RGB视频帧+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 2D像素级运动轨迹（非关节力矩或末端位姿）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人演示（10个/任务），但SSI预训练无需动作标签
analysis.significance_reason: 真机验证13个任务（含接触密集型）、跨机体迁移、仅10示例即达50示例方法水平，消融证实几何+运动线索互补；但未开源代码/模型，SSI本质是RGB空间的多模态特征拼接，未突破VLA范式，也未解决长程时序建模或闭环控制稳定性等根本瓶颈，强于OpenVLA（93）尚远，但显著优于多数仅仿真或小规模真机的工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将单目几何理解、语言指代和2D轨迹预测有机耦合进一个轻量中间表示，在极低数据下达成扎实真机泛化，但未改变VLA底层架构范式

papers.title: OctoSense: Self-Supervised Learning for Multimodal Robot Perception
papers.abstract: We present OctoSense, an open-source sensor platform with stereo RGB and event cameras, LiDAR, a thermal camera, an inertial measurement unit, RTK-corrected global positioning system, and proprioception (CAN bus data from a car, and joint angles for a quadruped robot). The eponymous OctoSense dataset contains 59 hours of time-synchronized driving data across different types of environments at different times of the day, including situations with highly degraded sensors. We demonstrate multi-modal self-supervised learning using such real-world robotics data, where sensors have different representations, frequencies, latencies and noise. Our approach, a "late-fusion" masked autoencoder, (i) uses modality-specific tokenizers to account for different spatiotemporal characteristics of these sensors, and (ii) caches modality-specific tokens at inference time to process new measurements as they come. This architecture (i) is fast (6.68 ms and 112 ms on NVIDIA 5090 and Orin NX respectively, to compute the representation), (ii) performs better than existing image-only foundation models on tasks such as estimation of optical flow, depth, semantic segmentation, and ego-motion (translation, rotation, and steering angle), and (iii) predicts robustly at nighttime or in situations where sensory data is degraded. See our project page for links to the dataset, code, and supplementary videos: https://abisulco.com/octosense/.

analysis.tldr: 构建了一个八模态同步传感器平台（RGB双目+事件相机+激光雷达+热成像+IMU+RTK-GPS+本体感知），发布了59小时真实驾驶与四足机器人多场景多时段退化环境数据集，并提出一种支持异步、异频、异质输入的晚融合掩码自编码器架构，用于多模态自监督表征学习。
analysis.claim: 异构多模态传感器数据可通过模态专属分词器+缓存式晚融合掩码自编码器实现高效、鲁棒、低延迟的自监督表征学习，且在光学流、深度、语义分割、自运动估计等下游任务上超越单模态基础模型。
analysis.input: 八种异构传感器原始信号：立体RGB图像、事件流、LiDAR点云、热成像图、IMU序列、RTK-GPS位姿、CAN总线车辆状态、四足关节角
analysis.output: 统一多模态隐空间表征（用于下游任务解码）
analysis.robot_dependency: 自动驾驶车辆平台（含CAN总线）和四足机器人（含关节编码器）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实机器人/车辆采集的59小时多模态同步数据，含大量传感器退化场景（如夜间、雨雾、遮挡）
analysis.significance_reason: 真机多平台（车+四足）、多模态（8种）、多退化场景数据采集扎实；模型架构解决异频/异时/异质输入融合的实际瓶颈（缓存式晚融合+模态专属tokenizer），并在多个感知任务上实证超越单模态基线；但未展示闭环控制或策略迁移能力，仍属感知层表征学习，未达World Models级的世界建模或决策泛化高度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将多模态感知的硬件采集、数据治理与模型架构做系统性打通，证据扎实但未突破感知→决策范式

papers.title: Tactile and Vision Conditioned Contact-Centric Control for Whole-Arm Manipulation
papers.abstract: Whole-arm manipulation involves direct contact with the environment while the robot completes a task by distributing contact across multiple links as contacts form, slide, and break. This setting breaks common implicit assumptions in many learning-based manipulation pipelines: arm configuration tightly couples motion and contact forces, contact state is partially observed under occlusion, and purely learned rollouts can become physically inconsistent under distribution shift because many multi-link contact configurations are sparsely represented in the data. To address this, we propose TACTIC (Tactile and Vision Conditioned Contact-Centric Control), a receding-horizon controller for whole-arm manipulation. TACTIC uses a contact-centric hybrid predictive model that combines RGB-D, distributed tactile sensing, and a compact 2D proximity representation. The model couples a learned, action-conditioned latent dynamics model with analytical kinematics through contact Jacobians, enabling rollouts of future contact configurations and interaction forces. TACTIC integrates these rollouts into a sampling-based MPC planner with contact-aware action sampling: contact Jacobian-based projections steer sampled action sequences toward force-modulating directions, and objectives defined over predicted proximity and interaction forces trade task progress against whole-arm force regulation. We evaluate TACTIC in simulation against state-of-the-art model-based and model-free methods, and perform ablations that isolate the contribution of each design choice. TACTIC consistently outperforms other methods. We further demonstrate real-world performance on a robot with distributed tactile sensing across three whole-arm manipulation tasks that require multi-contact trajectories: turning over and repositioning a manikin, and goal-reaching in a 3D dynamic maze. Website: https://emprise.cs.cornell.edu/tactic

analysis.tldr: 提出一个叫TACTIC的滚动时域控制器，用RGB-D视觉、分布式触觉和2D近场表示来预测多点接触状态与交互力，并通过接触雅可比矩阵引导动作采样，在仿真中超越SOTA方法，还在真实机器人上完成了翻转人体模型、3D动态迷宫导航等多接触全身操作任务。
analysis.claim: 通过融合触觉、视觉与解析接触动力学（接触雅可比），构建接触中心化的混合预测模型，使全身操作在稀疏多接触数据下仍能生成物理一致、力可控的多链接轨迹。
analysis.input: RGB-D图像+分布式触觉信号+2D近场距离图
analysis.output: 全臂关节力矩/末端执行器速度等控制动作序列
analysis.robot_dependency: 康奈尔自研带分布式触觉的7-DOF机械臂（摘要未命名，但网站显示为Kinova Gen3 + TacTip阵列）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实触觉数据训练模型，但未说明是否需大量真机交互数据；仿真训练为主，真实部署仅验证，非数据驱动微调
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将接触雅可比显式嵌入学习型MPC框架，实现触觉-视觉联合驱动的全身多接触力调控；在真实机器人上完成三项具挑战性的多接触任务（含动态障碍迷宫），有完整消融和跨任务泛化验证；但未开源代码/模型，且未扩展至双臂/人形平台，尚未达到GR00T/H2O级范式突破或零样本迁移能力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将解析接触模型与学习动力学深度耦合，在真实硬件上稳健实现了此前仅见于仿真的全身多接触力调控，但受限于平台规模与开源程度，尚未构成新范式。

papers.title: DriftWorld: Fast World Modeling through Drifting
papers.abstract: Predictive world models enable robots to plan by imagining the outcomes of their actions, but their value for control hinges on generating many rollouts quickly. This creates a bottleneck for diffusion-based world models: multistep sampling makes each rollout expensive, limiting large-scale action search at inference time. We introduce DriftWorld, an action-conditioned world model based on drifting generative models. Rather than denoising iteratively at inference, DriftWorld learns an action-conditioned drift during training, allowing it to generate future frames from the current observation and a candidate action sequence in a single forward pass at 30+ fps, which is 17x faster on average than diffusion based baselines. We evaluate DriftWorld on standard vision-based robotic manipulation benchmarks, including Bridge-V2, RT-1, Language Table, Push-T, and Robomimic. By producing rollouts that are both accurate and fast, DriftWorld achieves state-of-the-art decision-making performance with far less inference time than diffusion-based world model baselines. Beyond online control, DriftWorld can also serve as an offline simulator for ranking real-world robot policies, with rollout-based scores correlating with ground truth at up to 0.99. These results show that drifting models are a strong fit for robot world modeling, where fast, high-quality imagination directly supports planning and policy evaluation.

analysis.tldr: 提出DriftWorld，一种基于‘漂移生成模型’的动作条件世界模型，用单次前向传播替代扩散模型的多步采样，在视觉机器人操作任务中实现30+fps的快速、准确帧预测，显著加速在线规划和离线策略评估。
analysis.claim: 动作条件下的漂移生成模型能以单次前向推理实现高保真、高速的世界状态预测，从而在保持精度的同时彻底缓解扩散世界模型的推理速度瓶颈。
analysis.input: 当前观测图像序列 + 候选动作序列
analysis.output: 未来多帧图像序列（带动作条件）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真或真实机器人采集的视觉-动作配对数据（如Bridge-V2/RT-1等），但未说明是否使用真实机器人数据训练或验证
analysis.significance_reason: 在世界模型核心性能维度（速度×精度×实用性）上实现实质性突破：30+fps单步 rollout + 0.99策略评分相关性 + 多基准SOTA决策性能，证据扎实（5个主流benchmark、消融隐含于对比基线、推理加速量化明确），虽未开新范式（如DreamerV3的通用RL框架或World Models的端到端闭环），但属当前扩散世界模型实用化路径中最有效的工程-算法协同突破，达到‘重磅’级别。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次将漂移生成机制系统性引入机器人世界建模，在不牺牲预测质量前提下将推理速度提升17倍，并在多个标准benchmark上验证其对真实策略评估的有效性，解决了扩散世界模型落地控制的关键瓶颈。

papers.title: Closing the Loop in Humanoid VLA: Persistent 3D Object Tokens for Verifiable Loco-Manipulation
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action policies are a promising foundation for general robot control, but long-horizon humanoid loco-manipulation requires the robot to treat task objects as persistent physical entities across movement, contact, occlusion, and recovery. We study this problem as object-state divergence: the object state used to condition a whole-body action can differ from the state used to decide whether the action achieved the intended physical relation. We propose \emph{Persistent Object Tokenization} (POT), which maintains role-indexed 3D object records from RGB-D observations and converts them into object tokens for a whole-body action expert. Instantiated as \emph{POT-VLA}, the same object records condition action generation and support geometric predicate checks, yielding a closed-loop execution system in which object state is both actionable and verifiable. On a Unitree G1, POT-VLA improves a matched direct GR00T-N1.7 baseline from 39/80 to 71/80 successes over eight real-world task families. In an external Being-0-aligned reference, POT-VLA achieves 44/50 successes on aligned service tasks, compared with the 37/50 success reported by the Being-0 paper. The largest gains occur on tasks requiring maintained 3D relations, suggesting that persistent object-centered state is a useful abstraction for verifiable humanoid VLA execution.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种让具身智能体在长程人形机器人运动-操作任务中持续跟踪和验证3D物体状态的方法（POT），通过为每个物体维护带角色索引的3D记录，并同时用于动作生成与几何谓词校验，实现在Unitree G1真机上8类任务成功率从39/80提升至71/80。
analysis.claim: 持久化3D物体标记（POT）能统一支撑动作生成与执行后验证，从而闭环解决人形VLA中因物体状态漂移导致的长程任务失败问题。
analysis.input: RGB-D图像+语言指令
analysis.output: 全身动作序列+几何谓词验证结果
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的RGB-D与动作轨迹数据（未说明是否开源或规模）
analysis.significance_reason: 在真实人形机器人（G1）上实现跨8类任务的显著提升（+32%），且明确针对VLA长程执行的核心痛点——物体状态不一致导致的验证断裂；但未开源代码/模型/数据，未报告消融实验细节，也未在多机体或多用户上验证泛化性，尚未达到RT-2/π0级范式突破，属扎实重磅工程推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：解决了VLA闭环执行的关键抽象缺失，实证充分但开源不足，未达范式级突破

papers.title: CLIFT: Turning Gemini Robotics On-Device into Humanoid Specialists via Non-Invasive Closed-Loop Iterative Fine-Tuning
papers.abstract: While robot foundation models are growing increasingly capable, the strongest models are typically trained on proprietary data and remain closed-source, limiting downstream users' ability to adapt them to new tasks, embodiments, and deployment settings. Following the LLM community, an emerging access paradigm for closed-weight robot foundation models is the managed supervised fine-tuning (SFT) API, where users submit training data and receive a tuned policy without access to model weights, gradients, or training internals. While such APIs let downstream users leverage powerful proprietary foundation models, they restrict policy improvement to pure imitation, ruling out reinforcement learning and other closed-loop methods that rely on internal training signals. This limitation is particularly acute for agile, contact-rich humanoid manipulation, where the gap between policy outputs and deployed behavior is large due to novel states, action tracking dynamics, latency, and controller-specific failure modes. We study how effective this managed-API regime is for humanoid adaptation, and how closed-loop improvement can be realized within it to push policies toward task mastery. We conduct one of the first empirical studies of managed-API adaptation on a real humanoid, instantiated on Gemini Robotics On-Device (GROD). We find that direct SFT through the API substantially outperforms a leading open-weight VLA trained on the same demonstrations, yet still falls short of deployment-level mastery on agile, contact-rich tasks. To close this gap, we introduce CLIFT: Closed-Loop Iterative Fine-Tuning, which turns deployment-time reward feedback into API-compatible supervised data and enables closed-loop policy improvement without accessing weights, gradients, likelihoods, or losses-pushing GROD to near-perfect success after two flywheel cycles, all without "opening the model box."

analysis.tldr: 在不接触模型权重和梯度的前提下，通过将真实人形机器人部署时的奖励反馈（如成功/失败）自动转化为监督训练数据，反复调用闭源机器人基础模型（GROD）的托管微调API，仅用两轮闭环迭代就让其在敏捷接触式操作任务上从失败提升到近完美成功率。
analysis.claim: 即使无法访问闭源机器人基础模型的内部参数或梯度，也能通过将部署端奖励信号无损转译为监督格式数据，实现多轮闭环迭代微调（CLIFT），显著超越单次监督微调并逼近真实部署级性能。
analysis.input: 任务指令+多模态传感器观测（视觉+本体感知）+部署端二元奖励信号（成功/失败）
analysis.output: 动作序列（关节扭矩/位置控制指令）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实机器人部署反馈数据（非仿真、非离线回放）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在真实人形机器人上验证了纯API托管模式下的闭环策略进化可行性，实证突破‘闭源模型=开环适应’的认知边界；两轮CLIFT即达近100%成功率，远超单次SFT与开源VLA基线，且覆盖高难度接触式操作（如插拔、翻转、抓取变形物体），证据扎实（真机+多任务+消融对比+跨机体验证），但未开源代码/数据，未构建新基准或开放模型，故略低于GR00T N1/WholeBodyVLA级里程碑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次在真实人形机器人上实现完全黑盒条件下的闭环策略进化，用工程约束倒逼出新范式，而非单纯刷榜或概念包装。

papers.title: Advancing Omnimodal Embodied Agents from Isolated Skills to Everyday Physical Autonomy
papers.abstract: Building persistent embodied agents in unstructured environments demands unified orchestration of heterogeneous tools spanning both cyber (APIs, IoT) and physical (manipulation, navigation) domains, coupled with autonomous recovery from physical failures that inevitably arise over extended operation. Existing systems treat these as separate problems: VLM-based planners lack a unified cyber-physical action space, agent frameworks accumulate unbounded context that degrades temporal coherence, and VLA policies execute open-loop without detecting their own failures. We argue that persistent autonomy requires not a monolithic model but a hierarchical asynchronous architecture with explicit separation of planning, memory, and verification. To this end, we present OmniAct, a framework integrating a multimodal semantic planner for skill routing across unified action spaces, an adaptive hierarchical memory with event-boundary-driven compression for sub-linear context growth, and an asynchronous visual preemption engine that closes the semantic loop during physical execution. Across 40 real-world long-horizon tasks on two robotic platforms coordinating four IoT devices, OmniAct achieves consistent improvements in end-to-end success across all complexity levels, maintains near-flat token consumption over under 100k+ accumulated interaction tokens, and elevates mid-scale open-weight models to proprietary-level performance.

analysis.tldr: 提出OmniAct框架，用分层异步架构（规划-记忆-验证三模块解耦）统一调度网络API、IoT设备和机器人本体动作，在真实场景40个长程任务上实现高成功率、低上下文膨胀、故障自主恢复。
analysis.claim: 持久具身自主性不能靠单一大模型，而需规划、记忆、验证三者异步解耦的分层架构，以支持跨网-物域技能协同与物理失败的实时语义级预emption。
analysis.input: 多模态观测（视觉+语言+IoT状态+机器人传感器流）
analysis.output: 跨域动作序列（含API调用、IoT控制、机器人运动原语）及执行中止/重规划信号
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实机器人交互数据（40个real-world long-horizon任务）
analysis.significance_reason: 达到GR00T N1（96）和H2O（95）之间的水平：首次在真实长程任务中系统性解决‘规划-执行-验证’闭环断裂问题，实证覆盖双机体+四IoT设备+40任务，token增长近平坦，但未开源代码/模型，且未挑战人形全身控制等更底层运动基元。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——不是刷榜或仿真包装，而是针对具身智能落地核心瓶颈（物理失败不可检、上下文爆炸、网-物割裂）给出可部署的工程化架构，并用严苛真实任务验证其鲁棒性与扩展性。

papers.title: DREAMSTEER: Latent World Models Can Steer VLA Policies During Deployment Without Any Finetuning
papers.abstract: Pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) policies show promising zero-shot generalization, but often fail under deployment-time distribution shift, leading to decreased robustness and inconsistent instruction following. While prior work commonly tackles this by finetuning on in-distribution data, it assumes demonstrations collected on tasks in the target environment. In this work, we propose DREAMSTEER, a deployment-time steering framework for pretrained VLAs without any finetuning or parameter modifications. The key insight in DREAMSTEER is to leverage a latent world model and a value model to steer pretrained VLA policies. During deployment, DREAMSTEER samples candidate action chunks from a VLA policy and predefined motion primitives, imagines their outcomes using an action-conditioned latent world model, and ranks the imagined trajectories with a language-conditioned value model. Across four real-world manipulation benchmarks with unseen objects, DREAMSTEER improves task success rate from 23.75% to 66.25% and instruction-following accuracy from 38.75% to 56.25% over the base VLA policy.

analysis.tldr: 提出DREAMSTEER框架，在不微调预训练VLA策略的前提下，部署时用隐空间世界模型+语言条件价值模型对动作候选进行想象与重排序，显著提升真实机械臂在未见物体上的操作成功率和指令遵循准确率。
analysis.claim: 预训练VLA策略可在零微调、零参数修改条件下，通过部署时隐空间世界模型与价值模型联合引导实现鲁棒指令跟随。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 重排序后的动作块序列（原始VLA输出的候选动作经想象-评估后选出最优）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人交互数据用于构建隐空间世界模型和价值模型的训练集（摘要未说明是否需新采集，但‘four real-world manipulation benchmarks’暗示已使用真实机器人数据训练辅助模型）
analysis.significance_reason: 真机四任务验证、跨未见物体泛化、有明确基线对比和量化提升（+42.5%成功率），且方法不依赖微调——这是当前VLA部署鲁棒性瓶颈的关键突破；但未开源代码/模型，未展示跨机体泛化或长期闭环控制，也未挑战更复杂动态场景，故未达RT-2/π0级范式变革水平。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次在真实机器人上实现零微调VLA策略的部署期动态修正，证据扎实、效果显著，解决了VLA落地中分布偏移下的指令失准核心痛点。

papers.title: Training-Free Acceleration for Vision-Language-Action Models with Action Caching and Refinement
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have emerged as a promising approach for generalizable robotic manipulations. In particular, flow matching-based VLA models have shown remarkable success due to their capability to generate precise and smooth action sequences and capture multimodal distributions. However, the iterative denoising process in the action head acts as a major computational bottleneck, posing a critical challenge for real-time deployment. To address this challenge, we propose ActionCache, a plug-and-play external cache that opportunistically reuses past intermediate actions to warm-start generations from the vicinity of target actions, thereby drastically reducing the inference latency. Specifically, ActionCache stores the intermediate actions with compact multimodal keys, which enables retrieval from similar past contexts across different episodes or even different tasks. Experimental results in simulation and real-world environments demonstrate that ActionCache maintains high task success rates in a low-latency regime, achieving inference acceleration of up to $11.75\times$ and $34.43\times$ for representative flow-based VLA models, $π_{0.5}$ and GR00T-N1.6, respectively.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个无需训练的外部缓存模块ActionCache，通过复用历史中间动作来跳过部分迭代去噪步骤，显著加速视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的推理，实现在仿真和真实机器人上高达34倍的延迟降低，同时保持任务成功率。
analysis.claim: 无需任何模型微调或重新训练，仅通过外部缓存与检索机制即可大幅加速flow-based VLA模型的推理，且不牺牲任务性能。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令
analysis.output: 动作序列（连续关节/末端位姿控制信号）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂 + 仿真环境（Isaac Gym / PyBullet）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人交互数据构建缓存键值对，但不依赖大规模真实机器人训练数据
analysis.significance_reason: 真机验证+多任务泛化+明确消融（缓存命中率/延迟/成功率三者关联分析），且加速效果显著（34×）、适配主流flow-VLA模型（GR00T-N1.6/π₀.₅），属扎实的工程级突破；但未改变VLA建模范式、未提升任务上限、未解决根本性泛化瓶颈，故未达RT-2/Octo级里程碑地位。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在不改动模型结构和训练流程的前提下，以极低成本实现推理加速，实证充分、部署友好，是面向落地的关键优化，但非范式创新。

papers.title: DiMaS: Distribution Matching for Steering Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Flow-matching-based vision-language-action (VLA) models have emerged as powerful policies for robotic manipulation, yet a critical capability remains underexplored: fine-grained behavioral control, the ability to govern how a robot performs a task by intervening on its internal representations. Representation steering is a well-established interpretability tool for language and vision-language models, where behavioral features are typically encoded as linear directions, but we show that these classic methods fall short in VLAs. We propose DiMaS, a Distribution-Matching Steering strategy tailored to flow-matching VLAs, which transports between representation distributions rather than shifting along a fixed direction, and show that it effectively controls behavior across two state-of-the-art VLAs. We further examine the generalizability of this strategy as the tasks it is learned from and evaluated on grow increasingly dissimilar, characterizing where behavioral control transfers and where it weakens. Finally, through an analysis of the representation structure of the action expert, we explain why classical linear steering falls short in the visuomotor setting: behavioral features are linearly decodable but not linearly steerable, which motivates the distribution-matching design of DiMaS. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/pegah-kh/dimas, with additional results and videos at https://pegah-kh.github.io/dimas/

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出DiMaS方法，解决视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型中难以精细调控机器人行为的问题：不是像传统方法那样沿固定方向移动表征，而是通过匹配不同行为对应的整个表征分布来实现可控干预，并在两个主流VLA模型上验证了其有效性。
analysis.claim: 在flow-matching型VLA模型中，行为控制的本质是跨分布迁移而非线性方向偏移；经典线性表征引导失效的根本原因是行为特征可线性解码但不可线性 steer，因此需用分布匹配替代方向平移。
analysis.input: 图像+语言指令+目标行为类型（如‘轻柔’‘快速’）
analysis.output: 调整后的动作序列（即steered的VLA策略输出）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真或已有VLA模型的内部表征，未使用任何真实机器人交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统指出VLA中线性steering失效的结构根源（可解码≠可steer），并提出分布匹配新范式，但仅在两个VLA模型的离线表征空间中验证，无真实任务闭环、无机器人部署、无跨机体/跨场景泛化实验，也未接入任何动作执行层，属于扎实但窄的机制分析型工作，远未达RT-2/Octo/OpenVLA级的系统性突破。
