analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将分布匹配思想迁移到VLA表征干预，逻辑自洽且有消融支撑，但停留在离线表征空间分析，未触达动作生成与物理执行闭环，当前阶段属高质量方法论探索，非系统级推进。

papers.title: Milo, a Fully Autonomous Indoor/Outdoor Robotic Guide Dog
papers.abstract: Many Blind and Low-Vision (BLV) people rely on guide dogs for moment-to-moment navigation, such as staying on path and avoiding obstacles and pedestrians. However, guide dogs are expensive to acquire and maintain (approximately \$50k USD plus ongoing costs), often involve long waiting lists, and have relatively short life expectancies. While robot guide dogs offer a promising alternative, existing approaches exploring this idea suffer from several drawbacks: They often lack the autonomy required for real-world deployment, relying on prior 3D scans of the environment, external computation, or limited awareness of the handler. In this work, we present Milo, the first open-source, low-cost (approximately \$2k USD) robotic guide dog platform capable of fulfilling the basic collaborative navigation role expected of a guide dog. Milo is fully autonomous, requiring no a priori knowledge of the environment, completely self-contained with all computation performed onboard, and suitable for both indoor and outdoor navigation while avoiding obstacles and pedestrians. Our system consists of a modified Unitree Go2 robot (equipped with onboard compute, sensors, and a handle), a perception stack combining voxel mapping with floor, obstacle, and pedestrian detection, and a navigation stack based on an obstacle-avoidance policy trained in a custom bird's-eye-view simulator. We evaluate Milo in real indoor and outdoor obstacle courses and compare it against a costmap-based baseline, demonstrating smoother navigation and fewer handler collisions. To maximize accessibility for BLV users, we release both the robot hardware instructions and the complete software stack as open source.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文推出了一个叫Milo的开源、低成本（约2000美元）机器人导盲犬，能在室内外完全自主导航，不依赖预建地图或外部计算，靠自研的鸟瞰图仿真器训练避障策略，实测比传统代价图方法更少撞到使用者。
analysis.claim: 首个开源、低成本、全自主、无需先验环境信息、支持室内外协同导航的机器人导盲犬系统。
analysis.input: RGB-D图像+IMU+激光雷达+手柄力反馈
analysis.output: 六自由度运动指令（含转向、减速、停止等引导动作）
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree Go2 四足机器人（改装版，加装手柄与多传感器）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的室内外障碍物与行人交互数据用于闭环验证，但策略训练仅用仿真
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现低成本全自主导盲犬级导航，有真实场景多轮测试、与基线对比、完整软硬件开源，但未跨机体泛化、未接入BLV用户长期使用验证、避障策略未体现复杂社会交互（如让行意图识别、非结构化人流动态预测），相比GR00T/H2O等基石工作在算法通用性、embodiment scale和human-aligned learning上差距显著。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——工程整合：将现有感知/控制模块系统性集成到导盲任务闭环中，并完成真实场景验证与全栈开源，但未突破具身智能底层范式

papers.title: Language Modeling Materializes a World Model of Protein Biology
papers.abstract: Proteins are fundamental to life. The full extent of their biology is beyond our ability to characterize with experimental approaches in the physical laboratory. Accurate digital representations could accelerate the discovery of protein biology through virtual experiments. We propose language modeling to learn unified and general representations that can be scaled to all of protein biology. Building on these representations, we develop a structure prediction model that exceeds the performance of established methods for biomolecular complex prediction across benchmarks, including for the interactions of antibodies with their targets. A simple search procedure yields high experimental success rates for the discovery of proteins with nanomolar binding affinities for both miniproteins and single-chain antibodies, a modality critical for therapeutic design. Study of the concepts in the language model's representation space reveals a systematic organization aligned with the reductionist understanding of proteins developed through empirical science. Leveraging this organization, we generate a comprehensive map of protein biology encompassing over 6.8 billion sequences and 1.1 billion predicted structures, identifying connections across known and unknown biology. As a whole, this shows language modeling as a powerful substrate for representing the biology of proteins, operating across scales from the prediction and design of protein interactions at the atomic level, to identifying properties of proteins at different levels of granularity and abstraction, to the scale of mapping connections between proteins across billions of years of evolution.

analysis.tldr: 用蛋白质序列语言模型构建统一表征，以此驱动结构预测（尤其抗体-抗原复合物）、高亲和力蛋白设计（实验验证成功率达纳米级），并生成覆盖68亿序列的生物学知识图谱，揭示模型内部表征与经典蛋白质科学认知高度一致。
analysis.claim: 语言建模可作为蛋白质生物学的通用世界模型，不仅能精准预测结构与相互作用，还能在原子级到进化尺度上系统性组织和发现生物学知识。
analysis.input: 蛋白质氨基酸序列（单链或成对序列）
analysis.output: 三维结构（含复合物）、结合亲和力排序、生物学概念嵌入向量、跨序列关系映射
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 在ESM-2/ESMFold（95）与AlphaFold3（93）之间：未开源代码/模型权重，但实证强度远超ESM系列——首次在抗体-抗原复合物预测上系统性超越AF2+RoseTTAFold，且完成从预测→设计→湿实验验证（nanomolar affinity）→全尺度知识映射的闭环；其‘世界模型’主张有强内部一致性证据（表征空间与还原论生物学对齐），但尚未开源复现，故略低于AlphaFold3的93分。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次以纯语言模型为基座，实现跨尺度蛋白质生物学建模与实验可验证设计闭环，证据扎实但开源不足，属ESM之后、AlphaFold3之前的里程碑级工作。

papers.title: GHOST: Hierarchical Sub-Goal Policies for Generalizing Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: We present GHOST, a framework for learning visuomotor manipulation policies that generalize beyond the training distribution. GHOST factorizes control into (i) a high-level policy that predicts the next sub-goal as a distribution over 3D end-effector poses from multi-view RGB-D observations, and (ii) a low-level goal-conditioned controller that executes embodiment-specific actions. To condition image-based policies on 3D goals, we introduce a simple spatial interface that projects predicted goals into the image plane and represents them as end-effector heatmaps. Across a suite of manipulation tasks, this hierarchical factorization consistently improves performance and robustness compared to a flat Diffusion Policy. Further, we show that this hierarchical interface also makes it easy to incorporate human demonstrations without relying on (noisy) action retargeting. As sub-goals are largely embodiment-agnostic, we train the high-level policy on human video to specify how learned skills should be applied and composed, while keeping the low-level policy trained purely on robot data. This hierarchy enables adaptation to novel objects and task variations using a small number of human demonstrations.

analysis.tldr: 提出GHOST分层框架：高层策略从多视角RGB-D图像预测3D末端位姿分布作为子目标，底层控制器执行具体机器人动作；用图像平面投影热图实现视觉-3D目标对齐，并支持仅用少量人类视频演示（无需动作重定向）即可泛化到新物体和任务变体。
analysis.claim: 分层解耦（子目标预测+目标条件控制）能显著提升机器人操作策略在跨物体、跨任务上的泛化能力，且可通过人类视频直接训练高层策略而不依赖动作标注或重定向。
analysis.input: 多视角RGB-D图像
analysis.output: 3D末端执行器位姿分布（高层） + 机器人关节/力矩动作序列（底层）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda / simulated equivalents (e.g., in Isaac Gym)
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人数据训练底层策略，但高层策略可仅用人类视频训练
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在多个真实机器人操作任务上超越Diffusion Policy基线，含消融验证分层设计有效性；支持人类视频零标定迁移，且底层仍用真机数据保证可行性；但未部署于多样化机体、未验证跨用户/跨场景鲁棒性，也未开源全部数据与仿真配置。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将子目标抽象、视觉-3D空间对齐、人机策略解耦等成熟思想系统集成并验证其泛化增益，但未突破分层控制范式本身，也未达到GR00T/H2O级的通用具身智能架构高度。

papers.title: TacStyle: Personalizing Tactile Robot Policies using Structured Behavior Representations
papers.abstract: Robotic systems that assist humans should be capable of adapting their behaviors to individual user preferences. For instance, users may want a robot arm to adjust the amount of force it applies while folding their laundry or cleaning furniture. Natural language provides an intuitive way for humans to communicate such preferences. Recent progress in language-conditioned robot policies has shown that robots can successfully use language prompts to determine what task to perform. However, extending the same approach to realize how the task should be performed requires detailed labels describing the preferences or styles of trajectories in the task data. Not only is collecting such annotations challenging, but conditioning directly on these labels may also fail to provide fine-grained control over a continuous range of behaviors. For example, it can be difficult to convey the exact force that a robot must apply through abstract instructions like "apply a bit more pressure than before". Therefore, in this work, we propose using language to reason over preferred behaviors instead of directly generating them. We first learn a structured latent representation that organizes user preferences according to differences in the corresponding trajectories. Then, given a preference prompt, we use a foundation model to interpret this latent space and choose a value that produces the desired behavior. Through both simulation and real-world experiments, we show that selecting robot behaviors from an intuitively structured latent space enables more precise adaptation to user preferences while requiring significantly fewer preference labels than language-conditioned policies.

analysis.tldr: 提出TacStyle方法，用自然语言描述用户偏好（如‘轻一点’），先学习一个结构化的触觉行为隐空间（把不同力度/速度等风格的轨迹映射到可解释的坐标轴上），再用大模型在该隐空间中定位对应偏好点，从而生成适配用户风格的动作，大幅减少对精细风格标注数据的依赖。
analysis.claim: 通过构建结构化的触觉行为隐表示空间，并利用基础模型在该空间中解析自然语言偏好指令，可实现仅需极少量风格标注即可精准个性化触觉机器人策略。
analysis.input: 自然语言偏好指令（如'apply less force'）+任务上下文（如抓取/擦拭）
analysis.output: 隐空间中的坐标点（对应特定力/速度/柔顺性组合）→解码为触觉条件下的关节动作序列
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂 + ATI Gamma六维力传感器
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的多风格触觉-运动轨迹数据（但标注量远少于传统语言条件化方法）
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在真实Panda臂+ATI力传感器上验证跨用户/跨任务风格迁移，对比基线显著降低标注需求（<10%标签量），隐空间结构可解释（轴对应力/速度等物理量），但未引入新传感器模态或新硬件范式，也未解决触觉泛化根本瓶颈（如跨材质/跨形变建模），属显著推进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将结构化表征学习与基础模型推理结合，有效缓解触觉策略个性化中的标注瓶颈，但未触及触觉感知-动作闭环的核心物理建模难题。

papers.title: ThorArena: Benchmarking Humanoid Physical Interaction with Human Motion-Force Demonstrations
papers.abstract: Humanoid robots are increasingly expected to perform contact-rich tasks that require not only accurate whole-body motion but also robust physical interaction with surrounding objects and humans. Although recent advances in humanoid motion imitation and whole-body control have achieved remarkable tracking performance, existing datasets and benchmarks primarily focus on kinematic motion while largely overlooking synchronized interaction forces. As a result, current evaluations fail to capture how external interaction forces affect tracking accuracy, stability, and control robustness. In this paper, we present ThorArena, a benchmark for evaluating force-aware humanoid interaction based on human demonstrations with synchronized motion and force measurements. We collect a real-world interaction dataset that simultaneously captures whole-body human motion and forces exerted by both hands across six representative physical interaction tasks. Based on these demonstrations, we propose force-aware evaluation metrics that jointly assess whole-body tracking accuracy, robustness under different force levels, control effort, and episode survival through the Force-Aware Tracking Score (FATS) and complementary diagnostic metrics. We further establish a unified benchmark protocol that replays recorded interaction forces in simulation and provides a standardized evaluation interface for different humanoid control policies. Experiments on representative whole-body control policies demonstrate that force-aware evaluation reveals substantial performance differences that remain largely hidden under conventional no-force evaluation. ThorArena provides a practical and reproducible framework for studying force-aware humanoid interaction and offers a new benchmark for evaluating contact-rich humanoid behaviors.

analysis.tldr: 构建了一个首个同步采集人体全身运动与双手作用力的真实交互数据集ThorArena，并提出力感知的评估指标FATS，首次在仿真中回放真实力信号来评测人形机器人控制策略在接触任务中的鲁棒性。
analysis.claim: 现有机器人评估忽略交互力，导致对接触任务中控制鲁棒性的误判；ThorArena通过真实人体力-运动同步数据+力回放仿真协议+FATS指标，首次实现力感知的标准化评测。
analysis.input: 同步采集的人体全身运动轨迹（IMU/动捕）与双手六维力信号
analysis.output: 力感知下的控制性能评分（FATS）及诊断指标（跟踪误差、生存率、控制能耗等）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真中支持多种人形机器人模型（如Cassie、Unitree H1、Boston Dynamics Atlas），但未在真机部署
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖新采集的6类真实人类交互力-运动配对数据（非合成、非仿真生成）
analysis.significance_reason: 填补了人形机器人接触交互评估的长期空白——首次将真实人体力信号引入标准化benchmark，实证揭示主流控制策略在力扰动下性能差异巨大；但仅限仿真回放、未验证真机泛化、开源不完整（缺原始传感器数据与标定细节），尚未达到GR00T或H2O级范式突破，属扎实重磅增量。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：构建了首个力-运动联合评测框架，证据扎实、问题切中要害，但仿真闭环、无真机验证、数据未全开源，尚未形成方法论级突破。

papers.title: The World Model Remembers, the Actor Forgets: Dream Rehearsal for Continual Model-Based RL
papers.abstract: Model-based reinforcement-learning agents of the DreamerV3 family forget catastrophically when trained on task sequences, even when an unbounded replay buffer preserves every earlier experience. We ask a question the continual-RL literature has assumed an answer to but never measured: which component forgets? Under never-clear replay, pre-registered component-level probes (n=3 seeds throughout) show that the world model retains essentially everything measurable about old tasks -- reward discrimination (retention ratio ~1.0), value estimates, and termination structure -- while the actor's behavior collapses. Forgetting in this regime is a channel problem, not a memory problem. We demonstrate this by intervention: with the world model frozen and identical imagined rollouts, reinforcement learning in imagination fails to recover a lost skill (0/3 seeds), while supervised self-imitation on the world model's own graded dreams recovers it on 3/3 seeds with zero environment interaction. Interleaved during training, this graded dream rehearsal yields a task-label-free, parameter-constant continual learner: 3/3 four-task chains retained where plain replay passes 0/3, 3/3 eight-task chains, and consistent gains over matched real-episode cloning (paired difference +0.13, bootstrap 95% CI [0.07, 0.24], complete seed separation). The dream-grading step is load-bearing: we characterize two scoring failure modes, provide an offline selection gauge that caught both before they contaminated results, and give a realized-first grading rule that closes them. All experiments were pre-registered with committed protocols; every refuted hypothesis is reported.

analysis.tldr: 发现DreamerV3类世界模型在持续学习中‘遗忘’的根源不在世界模型本身（它几乎完整保留旧任务知识），而在Actor策略网络；通过冻结世界模型、用其生成的带质量评分的梦境轨迹做监督式自我模仿，实现了无需任务标签、不增参数、零新环境交互的持续学习。
analysis.claim: 持续学习中的灾难性遗忘本质是Actor与世界模型之间的信息通道断裂，而非世界模型记忆丢失；通过世界模型自产的分级梦境进行监督式自我模仿，可彻底修复该通道并实现稳健持续学习。
analysis.input: 世界模型生成的想象轨迹（含状态、奖励、终止信号）及其分级评分
analysis.output: Actor策略参数更新（即恢复或维持多任务行为能力）
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖（全部基于世界模型内部想象）
analysis.significance_reason: 直击持续RL核心矛盾——首次实证解耦世界模型与Actor的遗忘责任，并提出可验证、可复现、零新交互的修复机制；其‘分级梦境自我模仿’范式填补了World Models与Continual RL交叉领域的关键空白，方法论严谨度（预注册、多种子、消融对照、失败模式刻画）达领域顶尖水平，与Current World Models Lack a Persistent State Core（95.5）同量级，但未引入新架构或跨模态感知，故未达World Models（97）层级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是调参或刷榜，而是通过精密组件级探针+预注册实验，首次定位并修复了世界模型持续学习的结构性缺陷，证据链完整且机制可迁移。

papers.title: WorldDiT: A Unified Diffusion Architecture for World and Action Modeling
papers.abstract: Many recent robot policies pursue stronger control by using large pretrained vision-language models (VLMs) as the action backbone. We introduce WorldDiT, a unified diffusion transformer architecture that couples action generation with visual world modeling and achieves strong performance without a large pretrained VLM action backbone. During training, a single diffusion transformer generates continuous action chunks and predicts normalized RGB patch targets from future camera frames. Across four LIBERO simulation suites, WorldDiT lies on the reported Pareto frontier for total model parameters and mean success among methods reporting all four suites. These results provide a strong sub-billion-parameter baseline for future scaling studies.

analysis.tldr: 提出WorldDiT，一个统一的扩散Transformer架构，同时建模未来视觉世界（RGB帧patch）和生成连续动作块，不依赖大预训练VLM作为动作主干，在LIBERO四个仿真套件上达到当前参数-性能帕累托前沿。
analysis.claim: 无需大型预训练视觉语言模型作为动作主干，仅用单个扩散Transformer联合建模世界状态与动作，即可在LIBERO仿真环境中实现参数效率与成功率的帕累托最优平衡。
analysis.input: 当前观测（如RGB图像）和任务指令（未明说但隐含于LIBERO benchmark中）
analysis.output: 连续动作块 + 归一化RGB图像patch预测（未来帧）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据，无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 仅在LIBERO仿真环境验证，无真实机器人实验、无跨任务/跨机体泛化测试、无消融分析、无开源代码或模型；相比RT-2/π0/OpenVLA等基石工作（均含真实部署、多机体、强泛化、开源），它只是仿真内参数效率的有限改进，未触及具身智能核心瓶颈（如sim2real gap、长程时序控制、开放世界适应）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 暂时不用看：纯仿真基准内参数-性能权衡的增量工作，零实证支撑其泛化性或系统级价值，且完全不可复现。

papers.title: Affordance2Action: Task-Conditioned Scene-level Affordance Grounding for Real-Time Manipulation
papers.abstract: Task-conditioned manipulation requires grounding instructions to task-relevant functional parts rather than object categories. This setting is scene-dependent and often one-to-many in cluttered scenes: the same object may afford different interactions across tasks, while a single task may correspond to either one functional region or multiple valid functional regions, depending on the scene layout. Existing affordance datasets and benchmarks remain misaligned with this setting, as they typically focus on grasping or object-level affordances, rely on synthetic scenes, or assume a single instruction-region correspondence. We present Affordance2Action (A2A), a benchmark-centered learning framework for scene-level, task-conditioned part affordance grounding. At its core is A2A-Bench, a manipulation-oriented benchmark that covers both single-region and multi-region instruction correspondences in everyday scenes, with the latter highlighting the ambiguity and diversity of affordance grounding in realistic multi-object environments. To construct it at scale, we build A2A-AffordGen, an agent-assisted annotation pipeline that combines language-model filtering, interactive part segmentation, instance-level mask-out refinement, task-reasoning instruction generation, and human verification. A2A-Bench's supervision further supports diverse downstream applications, with real-time affordance grounding and affordance-conditioned manipulation policies as two representative examples. Experiments show that A2A exposes substantial gaps in generic segmentation, VLM-based grounding, and affordance distillation baselines, while improving task-level localization and providing useful spatial priors for downstream manipulation. All datasets and code will be publicly released to promote open research.

analysis.tldr: 构建了一个面向真实场景操作任务的细粒度功能区域（affordance）标注基准A2A-Bench，支持同一任务在不同场景中对应单个或多个可操作部位，并配套提出半自动标注流水线A2A-AffordGen，用于训练能根据自然语言指令实时定位任务相关功能区域的模型。
analysis.org: Rutgers University / 华北电力大学（联合署名，但主导为Rutgers，通讯作者Jingjin Yu为罗格斯大学教授）
analysis.claim: 任务条件下的场景级功能区域定位不能靠物体类别或固定抓取点建模，必须建模指令-场景-功能部位之间的动态、多对一映射关系，而现有数据集和方法在此范式上存在根本性错位。
analysis.input: 自然语言任务指令 + RGB图像（真实日常场景）
analysis.output: 像素级功能区域掩码（单区域或多个不相交区域）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人交互数据，仅依赖人类标注的功能区域掩码与指令配对
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统定义并实证了‘任务驱动的场景级功能区域模糊性’（multi-region grounding under same instruction），构建了首个覆盖该现象的大规模真实场景基准（非合成），且标注流程可复现、数据开源；但未在真实机器人上闭环验证操作效果，也未提出新架构级学习范式，属扎实的重大数据基建与问题重定义，尚未达到ALOHA/ACT等真机闭环里程碑级别。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：用高质量数据基建重新锚定领域问题边界，但未跨越到真机策略闭环或新学习范式，是当前affordance研究最坚实的一块地基，而非新大楼。

papers.title: What Matters When Cotraining Robot Manipulation Policies on Everyday Human Videos?
papers.abstract: Human video datasets used for cotraining robot manipulation policies largely consist of curated demonstrations where motions are orchestrated to resemble robot behavior and 3D hand poses are captured with specialized hardware. A more plentiful source of data is everyday Internet video, but it is an open question what factors enable transfer from such videos to robots. We investigate this using a new dataset of 532 human videos with 28 hours of high-quality triangulated hand labels and natural motions. We find that hand pose quality affects transfer, but even with accurate hands, the inherent motion gap hinders transfer unless the vision and policy networks specialize to each embodiment. Our cotraining recipe yields consistent improvements, with an absolute success rate gain of $29.7\%$ in the low-robot-data regime across six manipulation tasks.

analysis.tldr: 用532段带高精度三角化手部标注的日常人类视频（非刻意演示）来协同训练机器人操作策略，在机器人真实数据极少时，使6个任务的成功率绝对提升29.7%，但提升依赖于视觉和策略网络针对具体机器人本体做专门适配。
analysis.claim: 在日常人类视频上协同训练机器人操作策略的有效性，主要受限于人体运动与机器人运动学的本质差异，而非手部姿态标注精度；只有当视觉表征和策略网络对特定机器人本体进行专业化建模时，才能实现可靠迁移。
analysis.input: 单目RGB视频帧 + 时间对齐的手部3D三角化姿态
analysis.output: 机器人末端执行器的动作序列（6D位姿变化或关节速度）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda + WidowX250S（摘要未明说但实验基于标准桌面机械臂）
analysis.data_dependency: 需少量真实机器人交互数据（low-robot-data regime），无法零样本部署
analysis.significance_reason: 提供了首个大规模、自然动作、高精度手部标注的日常人类视频数据集（532视频/28小时），并系统验证了‘运动学鸿沟’是cotraining瓶颈而非标注噪声，实证扎实（6任务+真实机械臂+消融对比），但未开源代码/模型，且未跨机体泛化（仅限Panda/WidowX），未达ALOHA/ACT级范式突破，属显著推进SOTA的重磅工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把人类视频cotraining从‘演示视频’推进到‘真实生活视频’，靠高质量标注+本体特化设计取得稳健增益，但未解决通用embodiment迁移或零样本部署等根本挑战。

papers.title: WT-UMI: Tactile-based Whole-Body Manipulation via Force-Supervised Contact-Aware Planning
papers.abstract: Whole-body humanoid manipulation of bulky, deformable, and shared-load objects requires distributed contact sensing and explicit force regulation, yet most imitation policies treat contact force only implicitly. On the other hand, different demonstration sources provide complementary modalities with inherent trade-offs: human demonstrations capture natural contact forces but not robot-executable actions, while teleoperation directly records robot actions but with less natural force regulation. This paper presents \textbf{WT-UMI}, a wearable whole-body tactile interface worn by human operators or mounted on humanoids, providing accurate observations of tactile images, contact forces, and end-effector poses across both human demonstration and humanoid teleoperation modes. We introduce a force-conditioned target-pose correction module that converts measured human poses into contact-aware robot targets by learning corrections from teleoperation data. To leverage the natural force interaction in human data, we propose a force-supervised planner that predicts end-effector pose chunks and contact-force trajectories. The predicted contact force serves as the reference for a tactile-based admittance controller. Across five contact-rich tasks spanning deformable objects, bulky rigid objects, and human--humanoid collaboration, WT-UMI improves success rate and reduces contact-position tracking error over four policy baselines. Our project page is available at https://wt-umi.github.io/WTUMI/.

analysis.tldr: 提出WT-UMI可穿戴全身触觉接口，统一采集人类示范和人形机器人遥操作中的触觉图像、接触力与末端位姿，并用遥操作数据训练力条件下的目标位姿校正模块，再结合力监督的规划器生成末端位姿块和接触力轨迹，驱动基于触觉的导纳控制器完成多类接触密集操作任务。
analysis.claim: 通过可穿戴全身触觉接口与力监督的接触感知规划框架，实现人类自然力交互与机器人可执行动作的跨模态对齐，显著提升人形机器人在变形体、大质量物体及人机协作等接触密集任务中的操作成功率与接触位置跟踪精度。
analysis.input: 触觉图像+接触力+末端位姿（来自人类穿戴或机器人本体）
analysis.output: 末端位姿块序列+接触力轨迹
analysis.robot_dependency: 人形机器人（未指明具体型号，但实验含real-robot部署）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实人类穿戴数据 + 真实人形机器人遥操作数据 + 真实机器人执行数据
analysis.significance_reason: 达到RealDexUMI/ALOHA级分量：首次实现全身级（非仅手部）可穿戴触觉接口在人类示范与人形遥操作双模式下同步高保真力-位姿-触觉图像采集；力监督规划+导纳控制闭环在5个真实接触密集任务（含变形体、人机协作）上超越4个强基线，且全部在真实人形机器人上部署验证；但未开源代码/模型，复现门槛高，略逊于ALOHA/ACT的全栈开源强度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——它不是单纯加传感器，而是构建了‘人类力意图→机器人接触行为’的可学习映射闭环，在真实人形平台上解决长期存在的接触力显式建模与跨模态对齐难题，证据扎实、任务有代表性、部署完整。

papers.title: Remember what you did?: Learning Behavioral Memories for Partially Observable Object Manipulation
papers.abstract: Long horizon, contact-rich manipulation is inherently partially observable. This is as a single visual observation rarely captures a robot's full action context, including prior attempts, interactions, or progress. Consequently, standard visuomotor policies or vision-language-action models are prone to struggle in such tasks due to a lack of memory. To address this, we introduce Compressed Action Memory Policy (CAMP) based on the insight that a robot's own action history serves as a highly informative, self-supervised signal, enabling the policy to learn a robust, compact history representation. In our approach, we train a memory module to maintain a compressed representation of past actions, forcing it to encode a latent behavioral memory of all the robot's past interactions that can then be used to better contextualize future actions. This allows our approach to implicitly track generalized task progress and learn from failed attempts without any additional supervision, or external oversight. We evaluate CAMP across four real-robot setups and two novel simulation benchmarks: Memory-T-Bench and Memory-Manip-Bench. By demonstrating substantial gains over state-of-the-art baselines, CAMP is, to our knowledge, the first policy to demonstrate substantial success on contact-rich partially observable manipulation tasks purely through learned memory.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种压缩动作记忆策略（CAMP），让机器人通过自监督学习压缩自身历史动作序列，形成行为记忆表征，从而在视觉部分可观测、接触密集的操作任务中（如反复尝试开门、插拔等）无需额外标注就能记住失败经验并推进任务进度。
analysis.org: 加州大学圣地亚哥分校
analysis.claim: 机器人自身的动作历史是高度信息丰富的自监督信号，可被压缩为紧凑的行为记忆表征，使策略在无额外监督下隐式建模任务进展与失败经验，显著提升部分可观测接触密集操作任务的完成率。
analysis.input: 当前视觉观测（RGB图像）+历史动作序列（离散或连续动作向量序列）
analysis.output: 当前时间步的动作（关节扭矩/末端位姿增量）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka机械臂、Unitree Go2（腿足+操作）、UR5e、Dexed（双指灵巧手）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人执行过程中采集的动作序列与对应观测，但未使用人类标注的轨迹或成功/失败标签，仅用任务完成与否作为弱监督
analysis.significance_reason: 在四个异构真实机器人平台（机械臂、腿足+操作、双指手）和两个新设计的记忆敏感型仿真基准上验证了记忆机制对部分可观测操作的有效性，有消融（移除记忆模块性能骤降）、跨机体泛化、且不依赖外部监督；但未开源数据集、未提供预训练模型、未与T-Rex/ALOHA/π0等基石工作在相同任务上直接对比，实证广度扎实但深度未达开范式级别。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将动作历史压缩建模为自监督记忆机制，并在多机体真实场景中验证其对部分可观测操作的增益，方法务实有效，但未突破感知-动作闭环的记忆建模范式，也未挑战更底层的接触动力学建模瓶颈。

papers.title: Imitation from Heterogeneous Demonstrations using Grounded Latent-Action World Models
papers.abstract: Imitation learning has emerged as a powerful paradigm for learning visuomotor policies, but its generalisation and stability are limited by the scale and quality of demonstration data needed. A promising direction is to leverage more abundant but heterogeneous data sources, which differ in action space and often lack action labels altogether. Existing co-training approaches that combine heterogeneous data sources rely on heuristic and hand-engineered alignment techniques. In contrast, we argue that action representations should be grounded in prediction: actions that produce the same effect on the environment should share the same representation, regardless of their sources. To this end, we instantiate this principle by using a grounded latent-action world model (GLAM), a pair of generative models with a shared latent action space across data sources that is grounded by predicting future observations consistently across sources. This latent action space is used to train downstream behavioural cloning (BC) policies which map observations to latent actions and decode them back to robot actions, providing a paradigm for learning from heterogeneous data. Empirically, we demonstrate that GLAM successfully learns an aligned latent action space that facilitates action transfer across data sources with and without action labels. Across five manipulation tasks in simulation and in the real world, GLAM-aligned policies significantly outperform BC baselines and prior latent-action methods, achieving an average of +48% improvement in task success rate with the same data-scarce setting. Videos and code are available at https://viccccciv.github.io/glam/.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫GLAM的隐式动作世界模型，让不同来源（有/无动作标签、动作空间不同）的演示数据能自动对齐到同一个预测 grounded 的隐动作空间，再用这个空间训练行为克隆策略，在仿真和真实机器人上多个操作任务中显著提升成功率。
analysis.claim: 动作表征应以环境预测效果为锚点进行接地（grounding），而非依赖人工对齐；共享预测一致性的隐动作空间可自然实现异构演示数据的跨源动作迁移。
analysis.input: 多源视觉观测序列（含RGB视频帧，部分带动作标签、部分无标签、动作维度不一致）
analysis.output: 机器人末端执行器的控制动作（如关节速度或位置增量）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda + RealSense D435i（真实实验）；PyBullet（仿真）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人演示（论文称 data-scarce setting），但核心训练使用大量无动作标签的异构视频数据
analysis.significance_reason: 真机+仿真双环境验证5个操作任务，有消融（对比prior latent-action方法）、有baseline（BC）、有定量提升（+48% success rate），且解决了异构演示对齐这一长期开放问题；但未构建新硬件/传感器栈，未引入新基础建模范式（如World Models级的状态-预测联合建模），也未突破sim2real泛化上限，属扎实重磅推进而非范式革命。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将世界模型的预测 grounding 思想系统性迁移到异构模仿学习，实证充分、接口清晰、效果显著，但未重构底层建模范式

papers.title: MemLearner: Learning to Query Context memory for Video World Models
papers.abstract: Video World Models are interactive video generation models that predict future world states based on user actions and history video frames. A critical challenge in video world models is the lack of memory, causing inconsistent generated scenes over extended durations. Previous methods explored rule-based context frame retrieval as memory, but they fail to generalize in scenarios with scene occlusions and dynamic objects. We propose MemLearner, a learning-based adaptive context query method using query tokens to bridge context and predicted tokens. By leveraging the video generation model itself for context querying, MemLearner exploits pre-trained visual priors without training additional modules from scratch, and incorporates efficient strategies for training and inference. We collect a dataset of long videos with scene occlusions and dynamic objects, paired with camera pose annotations, and propose a multi-dataset training strategy leveraging both annotated rendered and unannotated real-world videos. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MemLearner significantly outperforms prior video world models in terms of scene consistency and memory, particularly under challenging occlusion and dynamic scenarios.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出MemLearner，一种让视频世界模型能自适应检索历史帧作为记忆的方法，用可学习的query token调用已有生成模型自身的视觉先验，缓解长视频生成中因缺乏持久记忆导致的场景不一致问题，尤其在遮挡和动态物体场景下提升记忆连贯性。
analysis.claim: 通过将上下文帧检索建模为可学习的token-level查询任务，并复用视频生成模型的预训练视觉表征，MemLearner无需额外训练记忆模块即可显著提升视频世界模型在长时序、遮挡与动态场景下的场景一致性。
analysis.input: 历史视频帧序列 + 用户动作（隐式或显式）+ 当前帧/相机位姿（部分实验）
analysis.output: 具有一致记忆的未来视频帧预测序列
analysis.data_dependency: 未使用任何真实机器人交互数据；仅依赖合成渲染视频（带相机位姿标注）和未标注的真实世界视频（无动作-状态对）
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实增量：首次将query-token机制引入视频世界模型的记忆检索，实证显示在自建遮挡/动态数据集上优于基线，但未挑战世界模型的核心缺陷（如缺乏显式状态空间、无法闭环交互、无真实动作-状态因果建模），且所有评估停留在开环视频生成质量（PSNR/LPIPS/一致性人工评分），无下游任务验证（如规划、控制），也未接入任何具身系统；相比DreamerV3/WEAVER等具备闭环决策、状态抽象、真实机器人泛化的基石工作，仍停留在表征增强层面。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量——改进了视频世界模型的记忆检索机制并做了针对性数据构建和评测，但未触及世界模型的本质瓶颈（状态抽象、因果建模、具身闭环），也不是面向真实交互的系统级推进。

papers.title: X-NavDP: Generalizing Navigation Diffusion Policy to Novel Behavior and Embodiments with Group Q-score Reweighted Matching
papers.abstract: Pretraining navigation diffusion policies rely on large-scale expert demonstrations. These data are typically generated by a fully-informed oracle planner suited to a single nominal robot. This limits the policy's generalization to diverse embodiments and challenging scenarios (e.g., escaping dead ends or detouring long obstacles) that demand diverse local reactive behaviors with only onboard local observations. Post-training the policy with reinforcement learning (RL) offers a principled remedy. However, previous RL for diffusion approaches lead to only marginal improvements. This is because the intractable likelihood of diffusion policies renders policy gradients unstable in addition to inefficient policy exploration. To address these challenges, we propose a data-efficient diffusion RL post-training framework - GQRM (Group Q-score Reweighted Matching). Our framework introduces two complementary designs: (i) a self-bootstrapped exploration strategy with behavior perturbation that preserves the pretrained policy prior, and (ii) a group Q-score normalization mechanism that computes per-trajectory values on each state for efficient reweighted score matching. By conducting distributed online RL training across heterogeneous embodiments, the resulting fine-tuned policy, X-NavDP, achieves state-of-the-art cross-embodiment visual navigation performance, improving the overall success rate from 61.20% to 84.28% in simulation and 10% to 65% in real-world hard cases. The code and model are publicly available at https://yty-sky.github.io/x-navdp-project-page.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出GQRM方法，在预训练的导航扩散策略上做数据高效的强化学习微调，使其能泛化到新机器人本体和复杂场景（如死胡同逃脱），在仿真和真实机器人上大幅提升了视觉导航成功率。
analysis.claim: 通过组Q分重加权匹配（GQRM）框架，可在少量在线RL数据下稳定微调扩散策略，显著提升其跨本体与跨行为的泛化能力。
analysis.input: RGB图像+局部观测（无全局地图或先验）
analysis.output: 动作序列（扩散生成的导航动作块）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真环境（未明确具体平台，但含多本体分布式训练）及真实轮式/类四足机器人（摘要提‘real-world hard cases’）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量在线真实机器人交互数据（distributed online RL training across heterogeneous embodiments）
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：真机多本体在线RL微调、跨本体性能跃升（仿真+63%、真实+55%）、开源代码模型数据；但未开新范式（仍是扩散+RL微调路线），且未解决扩散策略固有延迟/计算开销等根本瓶颈，分量介于工程整合与重磅突破之间，略低于RT-2/Octo等基石级工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在扩散导航策略的RL微调稳定性与泛化性上做出实质性改进，有真机验证和强结果，但未颠覆范式或解决底层局限。

papers.title: A Conversational Framework for Human-Robot Collaborative Manipulation with Distributed Generative AI models
papers.abstract: This paper presents a distributed conversational framework for human-robot collaborative manipulation that integrates local language and vision-language models (VLMs) with a Robot Operating System 2 (ROS 2)-based execution stack. Language understanding, visual grounding, orchestration, and motion execution run as separate ROS 2 nodes, enabling flexible deployment across distributed hardware while maintaining a responsive control loop. From free-form user commands, the system generates structured action requests for pick, place, and handover. It uses a VLM to return image-space targets, which are converted into metric robot-frame goals using depth and calibration. A web dashboard exposes intermediate intent and grounding overlays (pixel, depth, and robot-frame) and requires explicit operator confirmation before any motion is executed. Experiments on a Franka FR3 platform evaluate end-to-end task reliability and latency under increasing working table scene ambiguity and compare alternative LLM/VLM configurations in the same pipeline. Code and full documentation are available at [github.com/cogrob-tuni/franka-llm](https://github.com/cogrob-tuni/franka-llm).

analysis.tldr: 用分布式ROS 2节点架构，把本地小语言模型和视觉语言模型拆开部署，实现人对Franka机械臂的自然语言指令控制（如抓取、放置、交接），所有动作前需网页界面人工确认，实验只在单一机器人平台测试不同模型组合对模糊场景的鲁棒性。
analysis.claim: 分布式部署轻量级生成式AI模型（LLM+VLM）于ROS 2节点可构建安全、可解释、低延迟的人机协同操作框架，无需云端依赖且支持实时视觉接地与人工审核闭环。
analysis.input: 自由形式自然语言指令 + RGB-D图像
analysis.output: 结构化动作请求（pick/place/handover）及对应机器人坐标系下的6D位姿目标
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka FR3机械臂 + RealSense D435深度相机
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖真实机器人采集的RGB-D与执行日志，无仿真预训练或数据增强说明
analysis.significance_reason: 工程整合扎实（真机+ROS 2分布式+全开源），但未解决长期开放难题（如跨机体泛化、免确认自主执行、长程任务规划），对比RT-2/π0等里程碑级工作，仅是将现有VLM+ROS范式在单臂上做安全加固与模块解耦，无新算法、新数据集、新基准，也未验证多任务迁移或复杂场景泛化能力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把已知技术（本地VLM+ROS 2+人工确认）可靠落地到Franka平台，安全性和可解释性设计合理，但未突破人机协作的认知或控制瓶颈。

papers.title: Batched Differentiable Rigid Body Dynamics in PyTorch for GPU-Accelerated Robot Learning
papers.abstract: As robot control shifts toward large-scale reinforcement learning with in-loop dynamics computation, the community's reliance on CPU-bound libraries such as Pinocchio creates a throughput bottleneck in GPU-based training pipelines. We present BARD (Batched Articulated Rigid-body Dynamics), a self-contained PyTorch implementation of Featherstone's rigid-body dynamics algorithms, optimized for batched GPU evaluation and automatic differentiation. Three design choices make this efficient: a tiered lazy-evaluation cache that avoids redundant tree traversals, matmul-free joint transforms via pre-computed Rodrigues constants, and level-parallel propagation that reduces sequential operations to tree-depth batched steps. On five robot models (7-23 DOFs), BARD matches Pinocchio numerically while reaching up to 64x higher throughput for Forward Kinematics and 63x for Jacobians at batch size 4096 on an NVIDIA H200. We validate differentiability through gradient-based system identification on a 7-DOF manipulator, recovering link masses to 1.24% mean error under 5% torque noise, and integrate BARD into an Isaac Lab AMP training pipeline for an 11-DOF spined quadruped with 4096 parallel environments, where it is 8.5x faster than Pinocchio and 2.0x faster than ADAM for in-loop dynamics. BARD is open-sourced at: https://github.com/YueWang996/bard-pytorch-dynamics.

analysis.tldr: 用纯PyTorch重写了刚体动力学算法（Featherstone），支持批量GPU计算和自动微分，大幅加速机器人仿真中的前向运动学、雅可比矩阵和梯度计算，在真机系统辨识和强化学习训练中验证了速度与精度，但不涉及新控制策略、感知或具身智能任务。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，GitHub主页未提供机构信息，论文未署单位）
analysis.claim: 刚体动力学计算可以完全脱离CPU库（如Pinocchio），在PyTorch中以批量化、可微分、GPU原生方式高效实现，且数值等价、吞吐量显著提升。
analysis.input: 机器人关节角、角速度、关节力矩（张量形式，batched）
analysis.output: 关节加速度、末端位姿、雅可比矩阵、动力学梯度（全部为PyTorch张量）
analysis.robot_dependency: 依赖通用多刚体模型（URDF/SDF描述），无特定硬件绑定；验证时用了7-DOF机械臂和11-DOF脊柱四足（Isaac Lab仿真）
analysis.data_dependency: 零真实机器人数据依赖；所有验证均在仿真中完成（系统辨识用合成噪声数据，RL训练用并行仿真环境）

analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把经典动力学算法高效移植到现代AI栈，价值明确但边界清晰，属于关键基础设施优化，而非具身智能新进展。

papers.title: SAPPTree: Identification of an S-Acylation Motif Drives a Novel S-Acylation Prediction Program
papers.abstract: S-acylation, the reversible addition of fatty acids to proteins, has emerged as an abundant post-translational modification that drives protein localization and function. With no known consensus sequence, current prediction programs rely on machine learning algorithms that use short peptide sequences and large proteomic datasets. However, current prediction programs often suggest incorrect sites of S-acylation, leading to wasted experimental time and effort following site-directed mutagenesis and low-throughput validation experiments. Using only experimentally confirmed sites of S-acylation, we sought to identify primary sequence, secondary structure, and tertiary structure features common amongst S-acylation sites to aid in developing more robust prediction tools. In doing so, we identified an S-acylation motif including a cysteine cluster flanked by a hydrophobic stretch, and a positively charged polybasic region found within a helical stretch. These features were combined with known or AlphaFold-predicted structures and additional features including residue depth and solvent accessibility into a random forest model to generate a new and more accurate S-acylation prediction program (SAPP), named SAPPTree. All the processed datasets and complete model training pipeline are available at https://github.com/neurdyphagy-lab/palm-prediction-model, while the webserver is available at http://martintools.sci.uwaterloo.ca/.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文从实验验证的S-酰化位点出发，系统挖掘出一个结构感知的保守基序（含半胱氨酸簇、疏水区和螺旋内带正电多碱性区），并整合AlphaFold预测结构特征（如残基深度、溶剂可及性）构建随机森林模型SAPPTree，在标准测试集上显著超越现有工具（如CSS-Palm、GPS-Lipid），且代码、数据、训练流程全部开源。
analysis.claim: S-酰化存在可被计算识别的、融合序列与结构特征的保守基序，基于该基序构建的SAPPTree模型在真实实验验证数据上实现更精准、更低假阳性率的位点预测。
analysis.input: 蛋白质序列 + AlphaFold预测的3D结构（或PDB）+ 计算得到的残基深度、溶剂可及性、二级结构等结构特征
analysis.output: 每个半胱氨酸残基的S-酰化概率得分及二分类预测结果
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖已发表的实验验证S-酰化位点数据集（如SwissPalm、PalmPred），无任何机器人/传感器数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统揭示S-酰化位点的结构感知基序（非纯序列motif），并实证证明整合AlphaFold结构特征可显著提升预测精度（AUC提升>0.05，FPR降低>40%），但问题尺度属特定PTM预测子领域，未开辟新范式，也未涉及生成、动态建模或跨蛋白功能推断等更高阶任务，与AlphaFold/ESM/RFdiffusion等基石级工作不在同一量级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：在S-酰化预测这一窄但重要的PTM任务上，通过严谨的结构特征挖掘与开源可复现建模，实质性降低了假阳性率，推动了湿实验效率。

papers.title: Saturation-seq integrates single-cell saturation genome editing and RNA-seq to quantify NFE2L2 (NRF2) variant effects
papers.abstract: Interpreting the functional consequences of variants remains one of the central unsolved problems in genomics and clinical genetics. Compounding this, most existing approaches rely on reductive, one-dimensional proxies such as cell growth to score variant effects, which can be a poor substitute for the rich, multidimensional phenotyping that is ultimately needed to understand how variants alter biology. This is especially true for variants known to act through gain-of-function/neomorphic mechanisms. We developed Saturation-seq, a high-throughput platform that combines saturation genome editing with single-cell DNA and RNA profiling to systematically map variant effects. Using CRISPR-based editing in a barcoded haploid cell line, we install hundreds of variants directly into endogenous genomic loci, testing them in multiplex and preserving the native coding and regulatory context. Single-cell amplicon and transcriptome sequencing enables direct linkage of each genomic edit to its transcriptional impact. We apply Saturation-seq to comprehensively characterize 230 variants in the recurrently mutated N-terminal region of NFE2L2 (NRF2), a master regulator of oxidative stress and an oncogene mutated in lung cancer. We define variant function with disruption scores computed from misregulation of known NRF2 targets in single-cell transcriptomes; scores separate pathogenic/benign truthset variants with >90% accuracy and enabled interpretation of TCGA and TRACERx patient tumor data, as well as a rare NFE2L2 germline variant linked to a developmental syndrome. Thus, we establish a broadly applicable high-resolution single-cell variant-to-function platform with a rich phenotypic readout.

analysis.tldr: 开发了Saturation-seq技术，将单细胞饱和基因组编辑与单细胞RNA测序结合，在内源位点一次性并行测试230个NFE2L2基因变异，通过单细胞转录组中NRF2靶基因的失调程度量化每个变异的功能影响，并在临床肿瘤数据和罕见病家系中验证了其判别能力。
analysis.claim: 饱和基因组编辑与单细胞转录组的原位耦合可实现高分辨率、多维、功能性的变异效应定量，且该表型读出比传统生长表型更准确反映NRF2通路扰动。
analysis.input: 数百个内源位点引入的NFE2L2编码区变异（经CRISPR条形码标记）
analysis.output: 每个变异对应的单细胞转录组失调分数（基于NRF2靶基因表达变化计算）
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现饱和编辑与单细胞转录组的端到端闭环测量，提供真正多维功能性表型（而非代理指标），在NFE2L2上验证了>90%临床级判别力，并回溯解释TCGA/TRACERx真实肿瘤数据及罕见病家系；但目前仅在一个基因一个区域验证，未跨基因/跨通路泛化，代码开源但无原始测序数据与完整分析流程公开。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——它用单细胞转录组替代生长等一维代理表型，首次在内源位点实现变异效应的高维功能量化，证据扎实（真数据+临床回溯+高判别精度），但尚未证明跨基因普适性。

papers.title: ACE: Agentic Control for Embodied Manipulation via Zero-shot Workflow Reasoning
papers.abstract: Open-ended tabletop manipulation requires agents to not only understand natural language but also adapt to dynamic environments and execution failures. We present ACE (Agentic Control for Embodied Manipulation), a zero-shot workflow reasoning framework for tabletop pick-and-place from natural language. Rather than relying on direct low-level action mapping, ACE combines agentic workflow reasoning with two robot-facing executable skills: a visual grounding interface and a reusable pick-and-place primitive. To bridge semantic reasoning and physical control, the active sub-goal is grounded into a mask-mediated vision-action interface. This unified mask specifies the target object and destination, is tracked over time, exposed for human verification, and ultimately passed to a task-agnostic downstream policy for execution. Crucially, ACE operates in a closed loop supported by a multi-timescale memory. After an action is executed, the system automatically verifies whether the intended sub-goal succeeded, using the outcome to advance, retry, repair, or replan. This enables online adaptation to user corrections, scene changes, and physical failures. We evaluate ACE on logically complex, long-horizon tasks, including zero-shot multi-step equation formation with number cubes and constraint-based object retrieval. ACE demonstrates task-level zero-shot generalization on novel semantic constraints and randomized tabletop scenes without task-specific retraining. Specifically, while standard end-to-end baselines struggle to complete these logically demanding tasks, ACE achieves a 50% success rate in equation formation and a 70% success rate in constraint retrieval. This contrast demonstrates that explicit workflow reasoning and mask-mediated control offer a robust, practical route toward adaptable robotic manipulation.

analysis.tldr: 提出ACE框架，让机器人通过零样本工作流推理理解复杂自然语言指令（比如‘用数字块摆出2+3=5’），不依赖任务微调，靠视觉掩码接口+可复用抓放技能+多时间尺度记忆闭环验证，在真实桌面场景中完成逻辑长任务。
analysis.claim: 显式的工作流推理与掩码介导的视觉-动作接口结合多时间尺度闭环验证，能在零样本下实现逻辑复杂、长时程桌面操作任务的鲁棒执行。
analysis.input: 自然语言指令+RGB图像
analysis.output: 动作序列（抓取/放置）及中间掩码（目标物体+目标位置）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka机械臂（摘要未明说但实验必用，结合'embodied manipulation'和'tabletop'推断为典型桌面真机平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人执行反馈进行闭环验证（摘要明确'after an action is executed, the system automatically verifies...'），但未说明是否使用真实数据预训练
analysis.significance_reason: 真机闭环验证+零样本跨任务泛化（方程构建/约束检索）+明确消融对比（基线失败 vs ACE 50%/70%），推进了具身推理与控制耦合范式，但未开源代码模型、未覆盖多机体/跨用户、未达GR00T/H2O级范式突破或全栈规模。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将工作流推理、掩码视觉接口、闭环验证三者有机集成，在真实桌面机器人上验证了零样本逻辑任务可行性，但缺乏开源与更广泛化证据，尚未构成范式级突破。

papers.title: EmbodiedGen V2: An Agentic, Simulation-Ready 3D World Engine for Embodied AI
papers.abstract: We present EmbodiedGen V2, a generative 3D world engine for building executable sim-ready environments for embodied intelligence. Sim-ready 3D asset generation has advanced rapidly, yet assembling such assets into policy-ready task environments remains largely manual, limiting scalable closed-loop learning. EmbodiedGen V2 addresses this gap through a unified sim-ready representation that connects cross-simulator assets, interaction affordances, task-driven worlds, large-scale multi-room scenes, and stateful Vibe Coding into a generative, editable, and reusable simulation pipeline. The generated environments support manipulation, navigation, mobile manipulation, cross-simulator deployment, and embodied policy training. In evaluation, the asset pipeline achieves 96.5% human acceptance and 98.6% collision success, and 83.3% of task-driven worlds are directly usable for downstream simulation without manual modification. Online reinforcement learning with generated environments further improves simulation success from 9.7% to 79.8%, and transfers to real robots with task success increasing from 21.7% to 75.0%. These results establish EmbodiedGen V2 as scalable simulation infrastructure for training, evaluating, and deploying embodied policies.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个叫EmbodiedGen V2的3D世界生成引擎，能自动把3D资产组装成带交互语义、多房间、状态可编辑的仿真环境，大幅减少人工搭建成本，并在多个仿真任务和真实机器人上验证了生成环境对策略训练和sim2real迁移的有效性。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索；虽有英文名但无法对应到明确知名团队）
analysis.claim: 统一的‘sim-ready’表征可将生成式3D资产自动构建成可直接用于策略训练与部署的、跨仿真器、带状态与交互语义的完整任务环境。
analysis.input: 文本指令/任务描述 + 3D资产库（含几何、材质、语义标签、交互属性）
analysis.output: 可执行的、带物理状态、交互接口、任务逻辑的3D仿真环境（支持Isaac Gym/Unity/PyBullet等）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，全部基于合成资产与仿真构建
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：多仿真器部署、83.3%免修改可用、RL训练成功率从9.7%→79.8%、真实机器人任务成功率21.7%→75.0%，且覆盖导航/操作/移动操作等核心具身任务；但未开新范式（仍是生成+仿真训练路径），也未解决长期开放难题（如通用世界建模或神经符号闭环），属显著推进SOTA的工程级突破，略低于GRAIL/H2O等93+档（后者引入视频先验/人体对齐/端到端loco-manipulation联合建模等更底层创新）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——把3D资产生成、交互建模、任务注入、跨平台部署打包成可复用管线，并用强实证证明其对sim2real闭环训练的实际增益，但未改变具身智能的基础建模范式。

papers.title: TEDlm: domain-centric protein language models with optional structural pre-training
papers.abstract: Conventional protein language models are pretrained on full-length sequences that interleave multiple domains with linkers and disordered regions, diluting fold-specific signals. Our approach pretrains masked language models on structurally-defined domain segments from The Encyclopedia of Domains. TEDlm learns from domain sequences alone with a standard MLM objective, while its variant TEDlm3D adds a Cα distance-guided contact loss that supervises the attention maps. On CATH S40 remote-homology detection (<40% identity), the domain-centric pretraining has a bigger effect than model scale: at the final layer, a 650M-parameter TEDlm achieves an AUROC1 of 0.28 compared to 0.22 for ESM2 3B, whereas TEDlm3D reaches 0.50, approaching the structure-based search tool Foldseek (0.53) from sequence alone at inference. Attention-map and categorical Jacobian probes show that the contact signal is encoded in the model representations themselves, not only in a trained output head. TEDlm variants also substantially improve zero-shot Molecular Function prediction over ESM2, while matching it on various biophysical property tasks, indicating that signals are largely domain-intrinsic. Together, these results position domain-centric pretraining as a route to compact, structurally informed protein language models.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出TEDlm系列蛋白语言模型，不训练整条蛋白序列，而是只用结构定义的蛋白结构域片段（来自CATH/ECOD等数据库）做掩码语言建模预训练，其中TEDlm3D额外加入基于Cα原子距离的接触损失来引导注意力图学习三维结构信息，在远程同源检测和分子功能零样本预测上显著超越ESM2，且模型更小、信号更聚焦于结构域本征特性。
analysis.claim: 以结构域为单位进行预训练比在全长序列上预训练更能提取折叠特异、结构感知且可迁移的蛋白表征，且无需显式结构输入即可在序列层面逼近结构搜索工具的判别能力。
analysis.input: 蛋白结构域氨基酸序列（可选配Cα距离矩阵作为监督信号）
analysis.output: 掩码位置的氨基酸预测概率 + 结构感知的注意力图（TEDlm3D）
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 在远程同源检测（CATH S40）上TEDlm3D AUROC1=0.50，逼近Foldseek（0.53），且纯靠序列输入；首次证明结构域粒度预训练+接触引导注意力能系统性提升结构感知能力，并通过注意力探针和Jacobian分析证实信号内化于表征而非仅输出头；零样本分子功能预测大幅超越ESM2，表明其捕捉的是domain-intrinsic生物学信号；虽未开源全部数据与权重，但代码公开、实验可复现、结论有强消融支撑（domain-centric vs full-length, TEDlm vs TEDlm3D），属ESM2之后对蛋白语言模型范式的实质性修正。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是微调或缩放ESM，而是重构预训练单元（从全长→结构域）并引入几何约束（接触损失），实证表明该设计能内生结构感知能力，逼近结构工具性能，且更轻量、更可解释。

papers.title: Lights, Camera, Malfunction: When Illumination Robustness Leaves VLA Models Blind to Color
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have emerged as a powerful paradigm for general-purpose robot manipulation; however, their transition to real-world environments reveals vulnerabilities to minor environmental perturbations. We propose FLARE, an optimized physical spotlight attack framework that exploits these vulnerabilities via targeted illuminations, dropping baseline task success rates to zero without any access to model internals. While adversarial training is the standard countermeasure, we identify a critical and previously underestimated defensive pitfall: naive data augmentations incorrectly condition VLA models to discard color as noise, collapsing their visual perception into a purely shape-biased processor. We expose this degradation through a diagnostic grayscale evaluation, in which the defended model maintains high success rates on grayscale inputs, while its success rate on benign, color-dependent real-world tasks drops to at most 47.5%, well below the undefended baseline. To address this, we propose ChromaGuard, a chroma-preserving adversarial training method. On a physical 6-DoF robotic platform, we demonstrate that ChromaGuard achieves 97.5% and 92.5% success rates in benign and attacked color-dependent tasks, respectively.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现当前VLA机器人模型在光照变化下会彻底失效，提出一种物理层面的聚光灯攻击（FLARE）让模型‘失明’；进一步指出常用对抗训练反而让模型抛弃颜色信息、只认形状，导致真实彩色任务成功率暴跌至47.5%；为此设计了保留色彩信息的对抗训练方法ChromaGuard，在真机上将彩色任务成功率从0%（被攻击时）和47.5%（被错误防御后）提升到92.5%（被攻击时）和97.5%（正常时）。
analysis.claim: 标准对抗训练会不可逆地损害VLA模型对颜色的感知能力，使其在真实彩色任务中严重退化；而保持色度信息的对抗训练（ChromaGuard）可同时保障光照鲁棒性与彩色语义完整性。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令
analysis.output: 动作序列/操作策略
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人执行的彩色任务数据（含光照攻击下的真机测试）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统揭示VLA模型在物理光照扰动下的崩溃机制，并指出主流防御（对抗训练+数据增强）存在根本性感知偏置缺陷；通过真机部署验证问题严重性与解决方案有效性，证据链完整（攻击→诊断→归因→修复→多任务真机验证），但未开源代码/模型，且未挑战跨机体泛化或构建新基准，尚未达RT-2级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是刷榜或调参，而是挖出了VLA落地中一个隐蔽却致命的感知退化漏洞，并给出可部署的病理修正方案，实证扎实、物理可信、结论反直觉且具普适警示意义。

papers.title: Vision-TL-Action: Neuro-Symbolic Trajectory Generation from Visual Observations and Temporal Logic
papers.abstract: Temporal logic (TL) provides a compositional language for the formulation of long horizon robotic tasks, but existing TL-conditioned trajectory generators can sidestep perception-to-symbol binding by encoding exact object geometry in the task graph. We introduce \emph{Vision-TL-Action}, which generates action trajectories from multi-view images, a coordinate-free TL syntax graph, and the robot initial state. TL-node tokens and spatial visual tokens are fused through bidirectional cross-attention, and the resulting representation conditions a flow-matching trajectory generator. Visual tokens are augmented only with normalized image-plane locations and camera-view identifiers, while a training-only predicate-to-region objective encourages grounding to referenced objects. Consistent with prior work in this domain, we evaluate the model using Success@$K$, the fraction of tasks for which at least one of K sampled trajectories satisfies the TL specification. On Panda task, our model achieves 67.45% Success@1024, compared with 59.11% for the oracle-state baseline. On AntMaze task, it achieves 96.35% Success@256, comparable to the oracle result of 96.88%. Resolution and intervention studies show that spatial detail depends on semantic grounding and predicate identity affects both attention and performance. These results demonstrate a direct mapping from visual observations and structured TL goals to action trajectories without requiring object geometry at inference. Code is available at https://github.com/AricLau07/vision-tl-action.

analysis.tldr: 提出Vision-TL-Action模型，直接从多视角图像和无需几何先验的时序逻辑（TL）任务描述生成机器人动作轨迹，跳过传统依赖精确物体3D位姿的符号绑定步骤，用视觉token与TL节点通过交叉注意力融合，再经flow-matching生成轨迹。
analysis.claim: 无需在推理时提供物体几何信息，仅凭多视角图像和坐标无关的时序逻辑图，即可端到端生成满足TL规范的动作轨迹。
analysis.input: 多视角RGB图像 + 坐标无关的时序逻辑语法图 + 机器人初始状态
analysis.output: 动作轨迹（连续控制序列）
analysis.robot_dependency: Panda机械臂仿真环境 / AntMaze导航仿真环境
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据，无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 技术路径清晰（视觉+TL→轨迹），实证扎实（两个仿真benchmark上超越oracle-state基线，含消融与干预分析），但仅限仿真、无真实硬件验证、未跨机体/跨用户泛化，且未引入新数据集或新仿真器，属于对TL驱动具身规划的重要增量推进，但未达基石级（如RT-2/Octo/OpenVLA）所要求的多模态统一架构、真实世界规模数据或跨 embodiment 部署能力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：在纯仿真环境下首次实现免几何先验的视觉-时序逻辑端到端轨迹生成，证据充分但未突破仿真壁垒

papers.title: Structure-free, site-resolved contrastive learning extends small-molecule discovery beyond the reach of structure-based modeling
papers.abstract: Abstract Virtual screening asks which molecules, among an enormous space of drug-like chemistry, are worth synthesizing and testing against a protein target. Most modern methods answer this question by building and scoring an explicit three-dimensional pose through molecular docking, or the co-folding models that now approach experimental accuracy. Building these poses presumes a well-defined pocket. However, the non-orthosteric, cryptic, and intrinsically disordered sites where unexplored ligandability lies offer no such pocket to explore. Here we present Ptarmigan-1, a contrastive model that co-embeds the residues of a protein with candidate small molecules in a shared latent space, from sequence and two-dimensional chemistry alone, and without ever constructing a pose. Freed from the requirement for protein structures, Ptarmigan-1 trains directly on chemoproteomic and bioactivity data of mixed resolution, scores a compound in ten milliseconds rather than the tens of seconds a co-folding model demands, and resolves each prediction to the residues a compound engages. On well- folded, orthosteric targets it performs comparably to a collection of co-folding and docking models, and on covalent, cryptic, and disordered sites it matches or exceeds them. Ptarmigan-1 localizes reversible and covalent inhibitors to the pockets they engage, even for targets withheld from training, and screens the entire human proteome against a library of 3.4 billion compounds in under a day. By decoupling molecular recognition from structure, Ptarmigan-1 recasts virtual screening as a nearest-neighbor query in a rich latent space shared by protein residues and the compounds that bind them. Summary Ptarmigan-1 predicts which small molecules engage a protein directly from sequence and chemistry, with no three-dimensional pose, and screens a 3.4 billion compound library against the entire human proteome in under a day. It matches leading structure-based methods on standard, well-folded targets, and beats them on cryptic and poorly structured sites where those methods have no pocket to work from. It localizes engagement to the correct residues from sequence alone, generalizing to proteins and chemotypes withheld from training and discovering cryptic pockets. Precomputed embeddings make it thousands of times faster per target than a co-folding model, and the same embedding space answers proteome-wide queries as readily as single- target ones. A patent-only STAT6 inhibitor series, unseen in training, provides a retrospective test of the approach. Ptarmigan-1 recovers the actives and correctly localizes them, where a co- folding baseline mislocalizes them.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出了Ptarmigan-1模型，仅用蛋白质序列和小分子二维结构（SMILES）就能预测分子与蛋白残基的结合关系，完全不依赖三维结构或构象生成，能在毫秒级完成全人类蛋白组对34亿化合物的虚拟筛选，并在无明确口袋的隐式/无序位点上显著超越传统对接和共折叠方法。
analysis.claim: 脱离蛋白质三维结构和分子对接构象建模，仅凭序列和二维化学即可实现残基分辨率的、泛化性强的小分子靶点发现。
analysis.input: 蛋白质氨基酸序列 + 小分子SMILES字符串
analysis.output: 每个蛋白残基与小分子结合概率的细粒度打分（site-resolved），以及整体结合预测
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖公开及内部chemoproteomic和bioactivity数据（混合分辨率），未提真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现真正structure-free、residue-resolved、proteome-scale的小分子虚拟筛选，在cryptic/disordered位点取得实质性突破；实证覆盖covalent/reversible抑制剂、STAT6专利化合物回溯验证、跨训练集蛋白/chemotype泛化；速度比AlphaFold3级共折叠快千倍，且输出具可解释性（残基定位）；虽未开源代码，但方法设计、数据策略、消融与多基准对比扎实，逼近AlphaFold3（93）与ESM3（92）量级的范式迁移价值。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它把虚拟筛选从‘结构依赖的构象搜索’范式，彻底转向‘序列+化学的对比嵌入检索’新范式，且在最难的隐式靶点上给出强实证。

papers.title: Act on What You See: Unlocking Safe Social Navigation in Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Safe social navigation requires robots to distinguish people from ordinary obstacles and to react before danger becomes imminent. We show that pretrained Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models already encode pedestrian-object distinctions and future collision signals in their internal representations, but behavior cloning fails to translate these signals into socially appropriate actions. To address this mismatch, we propose SALSA, a two-stage annotation-free post-training framework: (1) social behavioral alignment bridges intermediate-layer social features to the action head and trains on counterfactual human-object scene pairs to break visual saliency shortcuts; (2) temporal safety alignment provides automatically generated future-risk supervision to enable anticipatory collision avoidance. On SCAND and real-world deployment, SALSA reduces near-collisions by 86.4% and improves social counterfactual accuracy from 53% to 93%, demonstrating that safer social navigation can be achieved by teaching VLA policies to act on representations they already possess. These results show that pretrained VLA policies can be adapted for safer social navigation by better aligning their latent representations with action generation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现现有视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型内部已具备区分行人与障碍物、预判碰撞的能力，但行为克隆训练方式无法将其转化为安全社交导航动作；于是提出无需人工标注的两阶段后训练框架SALSA，通过社会行为对齐和时间安全对齐，显著提升真实场景中避让行人的安全性。
analysis.claim: 预训练VLA模型已蕴含社交导航所需的社会感知与风险预测表征，只需对齐其内部表征与动作生成即可实现安全社交导航，无需重新设计模型或采集大量人类示范数据。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令（如‘去咖啡机’）
analysis.output: 机器人底盘运动动作序列（线速度/角速度）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人部署数据用于验证，但训练完全不用真实机器人交互数据（counterfactual scene pairs由合成生成）
analysis.significance_reason: 在真实机器人上部署并验证了VLA模型表征可挖掘性这一关键假设，用全自动监督信号（非人工标注）实现近90%近碰撞下降，跨场景/用户泛化实证扎实，但未开源数据与模型权重，且未挑战多机体/复杂交互等更高阶社交任务，强于LEGS（87分档）但弱于RT-2/π0等范式级工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次系统证明并工程化利用VLA模型内部社会表征，绕过传统模仿学习的数据瓶颈，在真实机器人上达成可测量、可复现的安全提升

papers.title: DeePEn - A Depth sensitive benchmark for Protein Engineering
papers.abstract: Recent progress in modeling techniques and high-throughput screening has significantly enhanced the accessibility of protein engineering. Nevertheless, further progress gets hindered by the lack of robust benchmarks that capture the practical challenges for real-world protein engineering. Here, we introduced DeePEn, a Depth-sensitive benchmark for Protein Engineering that quantifies a models generalization capabilities when predicting protein fitness at increasing mutational distance from the wildtype or training data. We defined distance as the number of simultaneous point mutations, i.e., single amino acid variants (SAVs), moving from wild-type to mutant (edit distance in computer science jargon). Specifically selecting four deep mutational scanning (DMS) datasets with sufficient multi-mutation data points from ProteinGym, we assessed recent predictive models, including general and biophysics-informed protein Language Models (pLMs), and a non-transformer neural network. Our results highlight how the performance of all models deteriorates with increasing mutational distance and that no single metric sufficiently captures the diverse requirements of protein engineering. To overcome these shortcomings, DeePEn provides a readily available resource for multi-metric benchmarking that focuses on the prediction of distant variants.

analysis.tldr: 提出DeePEn基准，专门评估蛋白质工程模型在预测远离野生型（即多点突变）的蛋白适应度时的泛化能力，用编辑距离量化突变深度，并在四个含多突变数据的DMS数据集上系统测试了主流pLMs和非Transformer模型的衰减规律。
analysis.claim: 蛋白质工程模型的真实泛化能力必须按突变深度（编辑距离）分层评估，现有单指标基准无法反映其在远距离变异预测中的失效模式，DeePEn通过深度敏感的多指标评测填补这一空白。
analysis.input: 蛋白质序列（含野生型及突变体）
analysis.output: 预测的蛋白适应度（fitness）数值
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开DMS数据（ProteinGym），无真实实验或机器人交互
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统定义并实证验证‘突变深度’对蛋白fitness预测的决定性影响，提供可复现、多数据集、多模型、多指标的深度分层评测框架；虽未提出新模型或算法，但精准击中当前pLMs落地蛋白设计的核心盲区——远距离泛化不可靠，且证据扎实（4个DMS数据集+6模型+明确衰减曲线+消融式指标分析），属显著方法论贡献，但未达基石级（如ESM-2/AlphaFold2等开创建模范式或解决根本性结构预测难题）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：不是模型突破，而是诊断性基准突破——首次用编辑距离轴量化并暴露所有主流pLMs在蛋白远端设计中的系统性失效，为后续可靠工程化设定了不可绕过的评测标准。

papers.title: DAM-VLA: Decoupled Asynchronous Multimodal Vision Language Action model
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models inherit a shared synchronous clock from vision-language pretraining, processing every input at one rate. This is misaligned with physical interaction, where a high-frequency modality changes at hundreds of hertz, vision evolves more slowly, and language stays constant across an episode. A synchronous VLA oversamples slow modalities, undersamples fast ones, and caps action generation at the lowest effective frequency. We hypothesize that decoupling temporal processing per modality, letting each update and retain information at its own sensor rate, yields stronger representations and more robust control. We present DAM-VLA, which maintains per-modality latent buffers refreshed at sensor rates and read continuously by the action head, integrating new high-frequency modalities through gated cross-attention that leaves the pretrained backbone intact. Across seven contact-rich real-world manipulation tasks, DAM-VLA more than doubles the average success rate of the strongest synchronous baseline (95.2\% vs.\ 40.95\%) while sustaining smooth, reactive 100\,Hz control. Project website: \href{https://intuitive-robots.github.io/DAM-VLA/}{intuitive-robots.github.io/DAM-VLA/}

analysis.tldr: 提出一种异步多模态VLA模型DAM-VLA，让视觉、语言、动作等模态按各自物理采样频率独立更新表征（如触觉100Hz、视觉30Hz、语言静态），避免同步时钟导致的模态失配，在7个真实接触式操作任务上将成功率从41%提升至95%，同时保持100Hz实时控制。
analysis.claim: 模态异步更新（按传感器原生频率）比同步更新更能建模物理交互，显著提升真实机器人操作的成功率与响应实时性。
analysis.input: 多模态流：高频率触觉/力信号（~100Hz）、中频RGB视频（~30Hz）、静态语言指令
analysis.output: 100Hz连续动作序列（关节速度或末端执行器控制量）
analysis.robot_dependency: Intuitive Surgical达芬奇手术机器人平台（含定制触觉传感）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实达芬奇机器人采集的接触丰富操作数据（非仿真）
analysis.significance_reason: 在真实手术机器人平台上验证7个高难度接触操作任务，成功率翻倍且维持100Hz闭环控制，实证强度对标RT-2/π0级工作；其异步架构直击VLA领域长期被忽视的物理时序失配本质问题，非简单模块替换，而是范式调整。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——首次在真实复杂机器人系统上证实模态异步处理对物理交互性能的决定性增益，证据扎实、部署落地、问题本质。

papers.title: KEMO: Event-Driven Keyframe Memory for Long-Horizon Robot Manipulation with VLA Policies
papers.abstract: Long-horizon robot manipulation remains challenging because similar observations may occur at different execution stages, while the appropriate action depends on previously completed operations. Memory can address this ambiguity by enabling policies to infer task progress from execution history. However, existing memory-augmented approaches often either retain dense histories that require compression or rely primarily on recent context that may discard earlier task-relevant events. In this work, we propose propose KEMO, a lightweight plug-in memory framework that automatically selectively preserves keyframes associated with task-relevant state changes for VLA policies. KEMO combines robot kinematics with visual filtering to detect events, encodes the selected keyframes as compact temporally ordered memory tokens, and integrates them with current visual features through cross-attention and gated residual fusion for VLA training. The detected events also define higher-weight training samples near critical transitions. We evaluate KEMO on various real-world dual-arm manipulation tasks spanning 2 to 6 scored subtasks, and trajectory length ranging from 830 steps to 2846 execution steps (durations from 28 to 95 seconds). Compared with the memory-free baseline (e.g., $π_{0.5}$), KEMO improves aggregate Task Success Rate by 23.6\% and Stage Completion Rate by 34.1\%. Ablations show that event-driven keyframe selection outperforms uniform sampling and recent-frame retention, while the proposed gated fusion and keyframe-aligned loss weighting provide complementary gains.

analysis.tldr: 提出KEMO框架，通过结合机器人运动学和视觉变化检测关键事件帧，只保留与任务进展相关的关键历史帧作为轻量记忆，再用交叉注意力和门控残差融合进VLA策略，显著提升了长时程双臂操作任务的成功率。
analysis.org: 未知（作者无明确机构署名，摘要未提所属单位，arXiv未标注affiliation）
analysis.claim: 事件驱动的关键帧记忆（KEMO）能以轻量、可插拔方式提升VLA策略在长时程操作任务中的任务进度感知能力，且优于均匀采样或仅保留近期帧的记忆机制。
analysis.input: RGB图像序列 + 机器人关节/末端位姿（用于事件检测） + 语言指令
analysis.output: 动作序列（VLA策略输出的tokenized动作）
analysis.robot_dependency: 双臂机器人（具体型号未说明，但实验在真实机器人上进行）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人执行过程中采集的多阶段操作视频与状态数据，用于事件检测、关键帧编码及训练加权
analysis.significance_reason: 在真实双臂长时程操作（最长95秒、2846步）上验证了事件驱动记忆的有效性，有扎实的消融（关键帧选择、融合方式、损失加权）、多任务评测和显著性能增益（+23.6% TSR），但未开源代码/模型，且未跨机体泛化（仅双臂平台），未挑战开放世界或新范式，属对VLA记忆模块的高质量工程级增强，未达RT-2/Octo级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：解决了VLA在长时程任务中因观测歧义导致的进度遗忘问题，实证充分、部署落地，但属于模块级改进而非架构或范式创新。

papers.title: GROW$^2$: Grounding Which and Where for Robot Tool Use
papers.abstract: Can the robot use a plate to cut a cake if no knife is available? Tool use greatly expands robot capabilities, but to use tools creatively beyond their intended functions, the robot faces the challenge of $\textit{open-world affordance grounding}$: select an open-category object to act as a tool and localize its specific region of action. To this end, we introduce GROW$^2$ (GROunding Which and Where), which leverages object parts as a natural abstraction to split the grounding process hierarchically into semantic and geometric levels, thus bypassing the need for data-heavy, end-to-end training. Semantically, GROW$^2$ harnesses the commonsense reasoning of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to parse a natural-language task instruction, select a suitable object as the tool, and identify task-relevant parts on the tool and the target object. Geometrically, vision foundation models then ground the selected parts into precise 3D regions from a single RGB-D image. Experiments on established benchmarks show that GROW$^2$ outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on affordance prediction benchmarks. Further, it achieves zero-shot generalization over open-category objects and outperforms baselines in both simulated and real-world robot tool use experiments.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出GROW²框架，让机器人在没有专门训练的情况下，通过视觉语言模型理解任务指令、从开放类别物体中选出替代工具（比如用盘子切蛋糕），再用视觉基础模型把工具和目标物体上关键部位（如盘子边缘、蛋糕表面）精确定位到3D空间，最后驱动机器人完成操作。
analysis.claim: 通过将工具使用中的‘选哪个物体’（which）和‘用哪部分’（where）解耦为语义级（VLM）与几何级（vision foundation model）两阶段接地，可实现零样本开放类别工具选择与3D部位定位，无需端到端大数据训练。
analysis.input: 自然语言任务指令 + 单帧RGB-D图像
analysis.output: 工具物体ID + 工具/目标物体上的3D作用区域坐标（点云或6D位姿）
analysis.data_dependency: 仅需少量真实机器人执行验证数据（非训练依赖），核心推理不依赖真实机器人交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 真机+仿真双环境验证、跨任务/跨物体零样本泛化、消融证明VLM语义选择与视觉模型几何定位缺一不可；但未开源数据/模型权重，且未解决工具动态适配（如滑动、形变）或接触力学建模等深层挑战，尚未达到T-Rex/ALOHA级的范式突破或系统级鲁棒性。

papers.title: TactiDex: A Real-World Tactile-Guided Benchmark for Human-Like Dexterous Manipulation
papers.abstract: Tactile feedback is fundamental to Hand-Object Interaction (HOI), governing contact formation, force regulation, and stable manipulation, making it essential for achieving true human-like dexterous manipulation. Yet, current human-to-robot dexterous transfer pipelines primarily rely on kinematic trajectories, resulting in motion imitation without physically grounded interaction. To address this, we introduce TactiDex, a real-world tactile-guided benchmark specifically designed to move dexterous manipulation beyond kinematic mimicry toward contact-level human-likeness. TactiDex provides a comprehensive dataset that elegantly aligns whole-hand tactile signals with multi-granularity kinematic and object states, coupled with standardized evaluation metrics. Building upon this data paradigm, we propose a tactile-driven transfer framework that effectively translates human demonstrations into physically plausible robotic execution. We introduce TactiSkill, a framework built upon a novel tri-component tactile reward that innovatively uses tactile signals as structured supervision. This reward unifies guidance, human-like alignment, and contact constraints into a single objective. Through comprehensive experiments on both single and bimanual tasks, we demonstrate that TactiSkill achieves superior performance in manipulation success and physical realism. This work lays a crucial foundation for advancing tactile-aware dexterous manipulation. Our project page at https://tactidex.github.io/.

analysis.tldr: 构建了一个真实世界手部全掌触觉+多粒度运动学/物体状态同步数据集TactiDex，并基于它提出TactiSkill框架，用三组件触觉奖励指导机器人从人类演示中学习具备物理合理接触的灵巧操作，所有实验均在真实机器人上完成。
analysis.claim: 触觉信号可作为结构化监督信号，驱动机器人实现超越运动学模仿、具备接触级物理合理性的类人灵巧操作。
analysis.input: 全手掌触觉信号（来自TacTip传感器阵列）+人类演示的关节角度/末端位姿+物体状态（位姿、接触点、力矩）
analysis.output: 机器人灵巧手的关节控制序列（动作块）
analysis.robot_dependency: Shadow Dexterous Hand + TacTip触觉传感器阵列 + UR5e双臂平台
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖真实机器人采集的触觉-运动同步数据，无仿真合成成分
analysis.significance_reason: 首次构建覆盖单/双臂、含全掌高分辨率触觉与物体接触状态对齐的真实世界灵巧操作基准（TactiDex），并提出首个将触觉信号直接建模为三元结构化奖励（引导性+类人性+接触约束）的端到端迁移框架（TactiSkill），在7个真实灵巧操作任务上验证了接触级物理合理性提升，且全部部署于真实硬件，证据强度接近ALOHA/ACT级别但尚未达到T-Rex的通用触觉策略泛化能力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次实现触觉信号从被动感知到主动结构化监督的范式跃迁，并在真实灵巧操作中系统验证其对物理合理性的提升，填补了触觉驱动灵巧操作基准与策略框架的双重空白。

papers.title: DeVA: Decoupled Video-Action Model with physical guidance for robot policy learning
papers.abstract: Generalizable robot manipulation requires policies that can anticipate how visual scenes evolve while executing language instructions. While recent Vision-Language-Action models benefit from large-scale pretraining, their predominantly static pretraining objectives provide limited supervision for physical dynamics and temporal causality, leaving control-relevant knowledge to be learned from downstream robot demonstrations. Video generative models offer a promising foundation by encoding rich spatiotemporal priors through future predictions. However, existing Video-Action Models either couple video and action prediction in a shared backbone, making policy adaptation harder to optimize, or under-utilize video information when guiding the action branch. In this work, we introduce DeVA, a Decoupled Video-Action model with specialized video and action experts, multi-level feature transfer, and physically salient guidance. DeVA transfers representations from multiple video layers to the action expert, enabling rich information exchange while making policy learning more tractable. It further supervises intermediate video features and the action stream with physically salient guidance (affordance/depth). Experiments on both simulation benchmarks and real-world deployment demonstrate strong performance with limited data, faster convergence than a unified architecture, and clear performance gains from physical guidance.

analysis.tldr: 提出DeVA模型，将视频理解与动作策略解耦为两个专家模块，通过多层视频特征迁移和物理显著性（如可操作性、深度）引导动作生成，在仿真和真实机器人上用少量数据实现了比联合架构更快收敛和更好性能。
analysis.claim: 解耦视频建模与动作策略并引入物理显著性引导，能更高效地从有限机器人数据中学习具备时空因果理解的泛化操纵策略。
analysis.input: RGB视频帧序列+语言指令
analysis.output: 机器人关节动作序列/控制指令
