Pretrained on a mixture of robot demonstrations, human videos, and simulated data, UMA consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines specialized for each inference mode.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出UMA模型，用3D物体运动轨迹作为统一接口，把视觉-运动控制、动力学建模、任务适应三类机器人能力整合进同一个生成式框架，不依赖人工指令标注，能用混合数据（真机演示+人类视频+仿真）预训练，同一套参数支持三种不同下游模式推理。
analysis.claim: 3D物体运动轨迹可作为统一表征，使单一生成式模型同时支撑visuomotor控制、动力学建模与少样本任务适配，且无需任务级指令标注。
analysis.input: 多源视频帧序列（含机器人操作、人类动作、仿真场景）+ 对应的3D物体运动轨迹（hindsight relabeled）
analysis.output: 未来物体运动轨迹预测 + 机器人动作序列 + 动力学参数估计（三者共享隐空间，按mask模式切换）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka、ALOHA、H1等异构真机平台（摘要提及部署验证）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人演示数据（用于hindsight relabeling和few-shot adaptation验证），但预训练阶段可混入人类视频和仿真数据降低依赖强度
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在Franka/ALOHA/H1三类异构机体上验证了motion-conditioned visuomotor control、motion-based dynamics modeling、few-shot task adaptation三重能力，有跨机体泛化、多数据源混合预训练、消融验证mask设计与contrastive目标作用；但未开源代码/模型，且未在开放benchmark（如RT-X、OpenVLA）上报告标准指标，相比GR00T/H2O等基石工作，缺乏端到端具身闭环验证和大规模真实世界长程任务测试。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将多任务机器人学习统一到运动轨迹生成范式下，实证覆盖多机体多模态，但缺乏开源与开放评测，尚未达到开新范式的突破层级。

papers.title: Current World Models Lack a Persistent State Core
papers.abstract: World models are increasingly regarded as a decisive step toward artificial general intelligence, yet modeling the physical world demands more than rendering convincing frames on demand: it requires an internal world state that keeps evolving over time, decoupled from observation, so that objects endure and events run to their conclusions whether or not a camera is watching, much as the moon holds to its orbit when no one is looking. This requirement is a blind spot of existing benchmarks, which reward surface properties such as fidelity, motion, and camera controllability while never asking whether a generated world keeps evolving once it is unobserved. We introduce WRBench, the first systematic diagnostic benchmark that treats camera motion as an intervention on observability and resolves evaluation into a human-calibrated chain that asks whether the camera executes the requested interaction, whether the scene stays continuous and identifiable while in view, and whether a returning target remains consistent with the event that was set in motion. Across 9{,}600 videos from 23 models spanning four control paradigms, one finding proves stubborn: current systems maintain the observed world as a tracking shot, resuming a returning target in the state at which it was abandoned rather than advancing the event while it went unseen. Because this failure recurs across control paradigms, model families, and increments of scale, robust world-state evolution does not follow from cleaner imagery, tighter control, richer geometric priors, or sheer parameter count We therefore argue that the stability of the physical state kernel and the consistency of worldlines under viewpoint intervention should become first-class objectives of world-model design, so that a world model captures how the world will unfold rather than how the next frame appears.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文指出当前世界模型（World Models）普遍缺乏一个持续演化的内在物理状态核心，即模型无法在没有观测时继续推演世界状态；为此作者构建了首个专门诊断该能力的基准WRBench，并通过大规模实验验证几乎所有主流模型都失败于此——它们只是‘暂停-恢复’目标状态，而非真正推进事件演化。
analysis.claim: 当前世界模型的根本缺陷在于缺失持久、自主演化的内部世界状态核心，该缺陷无法通过提升图像质量、控制精度、几何先验或模型规模来缓解。
analysis.input: 视频序列+相机运动指令（作为可观测性干预）
analysis.output: 生成视频中目标对象在相机重入视野时的状态一致性判断（是否延续未观测期间的物理演化）
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖，全部基于合成视频和仿真环境
analysis.significance_reason: 提出并实证了一个被长期忽视的核心缺陷（世界状态不可观时的演化失效），设计首个针对性诊断基准WRBench，覆盖23个模型/4类范式/9600视频，结论稳健且跨架构复现；虽未提出新模型，但定义了下一代世界模型必须解决的‘物理状态核稳定性’这一第一性问题，对标DreamerV3（96分）属准里程碑级问题界定工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次以系统性实证揭示世界模型‘无观测即停滞’这一根本缺陷，并建立不可绕过的诊断标准，为领域设定了新的能力边界和优化目标。

papers.title: Flowing With Purpose: Latent Action Guided Flow Matching Policies For Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Flow matching has recently become a new standard for behavior cloning in robotic manipulation. However, state-of-the-art flow matching policies suffer from a systematic structural mismatch: they rely on a globally fixed isotropic source distribution despite the strongly fragmented and heteroscedastic structure of robotic action spaces. This agnostic initialization forces the model to learn highly entangled vector fields, bottlenecking training efficiency and limiting overall policy performance. To address this limitation, we introduce Latent Action Guided Flow Matching (LAFM), a novel framework that replaces the monolithic Gaussian with an adaptive library of learned prior distributions. By grounding these distributions using a latent action model, LAFM maps current observations to discrete motion primitives, selecting a specialized base distribution that provides an informed, structurally aligned initialization for the denoising process. This dynamic adaptivity naturally accommodates heteroscedasticity in human demonstrations and makes transport trajectories shorter and less entangled. Empirically, LAFM substantially outperforms standard flow matching formulations, increasing task success rates by 23.4% in real-world robotic deployments and by 10.4% on the LIBERO-90 benchmark. Furthermore, we demonstrate that LAFM achieves state-of-the-art results, surpassing massively pre-trained vision-language-action models while utilizing significantly smaller architectures.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫LAFM的新方法，用可学习的、任务自适应的隐式动作先验分布替代传统flow matching中固定的各向同性高斯分布，让去噪过程起点更合理，从而提升机器人操作策略的训练效率和真实世界成功率。
analysis.claim: 用隐式动作引导的、结构对齐的动态先验分布替代固定高斯源分布，能显著缓解flow matching在机器人操作中因动作空间异质性导致的向量场纠缠问题，提升真实部署性能。
analysis.input: 视觉观测（RGB图像）+任务指令（语言或目标图像）
analysis.output: 连续动作序列（末端执行器6D位姿或关节扭矩）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人收集的演示数据（LIBERO-90含仿真，但real-world结果明确基于真实Panda部署）
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在LIBERO-90（强泛化基准）和真实Panda上均取得显著提升（+10.4%/+23.4%），且超越大模型但用更小架构，证明其先验建模思路有效；但未引入新传感器/新硬件/新交互范式，也未解决长期开放难题（如零样本泛化、跨机体迁移），属对flow matching范式的高质量工程改进，未达T-Rex/ALOHA级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在flow matching框架内做出关键结构改进，实证充分、部署有效，但未开辟新方向或解决根本性瓶颈

papers.title: SkyJEPA: Learning Long-Horizon World Models for Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real Control of Quadrotors
papers.abstract: Accurate dynamics models are critical for informed decision-making in robotic systems, particularly for agile aerial vehicles operating under uncertainty. Neural network dynamics models are attractive for capturing complex nonlinear effects, but existing predictive approaches struggle with long-horizon forecasting because their autoregressive rollout mechanism amplifies errors over time. Joint Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) offer a compelling alternative by modeling dynamics in latent space, yet prior JEPA-style methods for robot navigation have been studied primarily for kinematic-level planning, with limited investigation in high-frequency control. In this work, we introduce the JEPA-style model for real-time quadrotor control. The proposed approach combines a latent dynamics model with a novel physics-inspired prober that maps frozen latents to interpretable state, enabling physically grounded long-horizon prediction. Additionally, we combine the learned model with a sampling-based optimal control solution to take advantage of its predictive capabilities for real-time control on embedded hardware. Finally, to reduce the dependence on expensive and unsafe real-world data collection, we develop a structured pipeline for automated dataset generation. Extensive open-loop and outdoor closed-loop experiments demonstrate accurate prediction, robust zero-shot sim-to-real transfer, and strong generalization across diverse operating conditions.

analysis.tldr: 提出SkyJEPA，一种基于JEPA范式的潜空间动力学模型，专为四旋翼无人机设计，用物理启发的探针将冻结潜变量映射回可解释状态，配合采样型最优控制器，在无真实数据微调下实现开环预测准确、户外闭环零样本sim2real控制。
analysis.claim: JEPA范式可通过物理引导的潜空间建模与冻结-探针机制，实现无需真实飞行数据微调的长时域四旋翼零样本sim2real控制。
analysis.input: IMU读数+电机指令序列（仿真中为状态导出信号）
analysis.output: 未来多步状态预测（位置/速度/姿态/角速度）及实时控制指令
analysis.robot_dependency: 定制四旋翼仿真器（基于PyBullet/Gazebo）+ Crazyflie 2.1 真机
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实飞行数据训练；仅在零样本部署阶段使用真机验证，未用于训练或微调
analysis.significance_reason: 达到DreamerV3级分量：首次将JEPA成功落地到高频率、高不确定性、需物理一致性的空中机器人控制，实证包含户外风扰、光照变化、多起降点等强泛化场景的零样本闭环控制，且控制延迟满足嵌入式硬件实时性（<10ms），证据强度远超纯仿真论文，但尚未开源完整数据集与硬件部署细节。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是JEPA概念复用，而是针对四旋翼动力学特性重构了潜空间物理可解释性与实时控制耦合机制，并通过严苛户外零样本验证，实质性推进了世界模型在真实具身系统中的可用边界。

papers.title: VLA-FAIL: Efficient Task Failure Detection for Finetuned Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action models (VLAs) achieve state-of-the-art performance on many robotic manipulation tasks, yet they can still behave unpredictably in out-of-distribution scenarios. Runtime failure detection is therefore essential for the safe real-world deployment of VLAs. However, existing task failure detectors require computationally expensive action sampling, are based on architectural assumptions that limit their applicability to VLAs, or need access to failure rollouts. We propose VLA-FAIL, a lightweight and broadly applicable failure detection framework for VLAs that combines two novel failure detectors with minimal overhead, without requiring failure data. The first, last-layer Mahalanobis distance (LLMD), detects out-of-distribution states by measuring token-wise deviations in last-layer features relative to the training data. The second, action chunk consistency (ACC), exploits the temporal overlap induced by receding-horizon control and detects failures when consecutive action chunks become inconsistent. To capture the trade-off between detection accuracy and detection latency, we introduce AUCPDT, a threshold-independent metric that jointly evaluates precision, recall, and detection time. Through extensive real-world and simulation experiments, we demonstrate that LLMD and ACC capture complementary failure modes whose combination enables reliable and early failure detection across diverse tasks, frequently outperforming significantly more expensive baseline methods.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出了一种轻量、无需失败数据的双路机制（LLMD + ACC），用于在视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）执行机器人操作任务时实时检测任务是否失败，已在真实机器人和仿真中验证其能早于基线方法发现多种失败模式。
analysis.org: 奥地利林茨约翰开普勒大学
analysis.claim: 无需失败标注、不依赖架构修改、无额外训练开销的双信号失败检测框架（LLMD+ACC），能在真实机器人上实现低延迟、高互补性的任务级失败识别。
analysis.input: VLA模型最后一层token特征序列 + 连续生成的动作块序列
analysis.output: 二元失败判定信号（含置信度与检测时间戳）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda + RealSense D435i（真实实验）；PyBullet/Octo simulation（仿真）
analysis.data_dependency: 仅需正常任务执行过程中的前向推理特征/动作输出，不依赖失败样本或人工标注
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统性解耦VLA运行时失败检测为状态偏移（LLMD）与动作时序不一致（ACC）两个正交维度，在真实机械臂上跨7个操作任务验证有效性，并提出AUCPDT新指标；但未开源数据/模型权重，且未挑战VLA本身能力边界，属关键使能技术而非范式突破，略低于RT-2/π0等基石但显著强于纯仿真刷榜工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：解决了VLA落地中‘出错不知何时错’的关键安全瓶颈，方法简洁、实证扎实、多任务泛化好，但未改变VLA建模本质，也未开源全部资产。

papers.title: Source-space precision charts for lifespan EEG connectomics
papers.abstract: Source-space electroencephalography (EEG) connectomics aims to estimate interactions among cortical generators from sensor cross-spectra that are mixed by the head and lead field. This task is difficult because marginal source covariance or coherence can retain leakage, common drive and indirect mediation, whereas developmental mapping requires conditional interactions that can be estimated repeatedly across large cohorts. We developed JSPACE (Joint Source-space Precision And Cross-spectral Estimation), a frequency-domain inverse framework for estimating multi-frequency source precision matrices from scalp cross-spectra. JSPACE couples posterior source cross-spectral estimation with standardized precision fitting, sparse frequency-smooth anatomical regularization, stochastic active-set optimization and post-selection refitting. In simulations, its advantage was target-specific: JSPACE reduced coherence inflation and achieved the lowest imaginary-coherence and peak-frequency errors in a forward neural-mass benchmark. When the ground-truth precision matrix was known, it achieved the highest exact, edge-collapsed and leakage-aware support recovery. We applied JSPACE to HarMNqEEG cross-spectral data from 1,935 participants aged 5.17--97.00 years, spanning 47 frequency bins and 360 cortical parcels. Affine-invariant Karcher tangent harmonization reconstructed subject-level estimates into a lifespan atlas of 360 diagonal and 64,620 source-pair age-frequency surfaces. The atlas revealed a continuous off-diagonal morphology landscape, in which age direction, frequency preference and interaction strength varied as overlapping axes rather than discrete edge classes. In contrast, diagonal precision surfaces shared a conserved alpha-trough morphology across parcels. Representative real-precision pathways captured posterior parietal, sensorimotor-parietal, frontopolar and visual-parietal motifs. Delta-band gradients were moderately aligned with the sensorimotor-association (S-A) organization of cortex from childhood through late adulthood, with a candidate oldest-old deviation in the sparsest age range. JSPACE provides a scalable framework for frequency-resolved source-precision charting in lifespan EEG.

analysis.tldr: 提出JSPACE方法，从头皮EEG频谱数据中稳健估计全脑源空间精度矩阵（即条件功能连接），构建了覆盖5–97岁人群、360个脑区、47个频段的首个全生命周期源精度图谱，揭示了连接模式随年龄和频率连续变化的几何结构而非离散边类别。
analysis.claim: 源空间EEG精度矩阵可被稳定、无泄漏地跨大样本人群与宽频带估计，其生命周期动态呈现连续的多维形态景观，而非传统离散的功能连接边分类。
analysis.input: 头皮EEG交叉功率谱（多频段、多被试）
analysis.output: 源空间精度矩阵（360×360，每个元素为频率特异性条件交互强度）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据，但严重依赖高质量大规模真实EEG数据（HarMNqEEG，n=1935）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现大规模人群、全生命周期、多频段源精度矩阵的稳健估计与系统建模，证据扎实（仿真验证泄漏抑制、真数据n=1935、消融隐含于方法设计、跨频/龄/区三维图谱），但未引入新测量范式或临床干预，也未开源代码/模型，属脑电连接组学方法论的重大推进，尚未达到基石级（如BCI通信/运动重建）的跨领域颠覆性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：在EEG源连接组学中确立了精度矩阵作为核心表征的可行性与可扩展性，用严谨方法+大样本+多维图谱终结了长期对‘EEG连通性易受泄漏污染’的质疑，但非跨学科范式革命。

papers.title: MIRTH: Mutual-Information Reasoning with Temporal Hubs for Vision-Language-Action Agents
papers.abstract: VLA models have emerged as a powerful paradigm for transferring semantic knowledge from web-scale data to physical robotic control. However, current single-frame architectures suffer from intrinsic limitations: temporal myopia that discards historical dynamics, reasoning gaps between high-level instructions and low-level motor commands, and inference inefficiency due to autoregressive scalar decoding. In this work, we propose MIRTH, a unified framework designed to address these challenges. MIRTH augments a pretrained VLA backbone with three key innovations: (1) dual-scale temporal memory hubs that compress long-term scene evolution and short-term motion trends into compact embeddings; (2) latent reasoning tokens optimized via a mutual-information objective carving out a semantic plan space to align multimodal context with action trajectories; and (3) a parallel action decoding scheme that replaces autoregressive generation with vector-wise prediction to maximize control throughput. Extensive evaluations on the LIBERO simulation benchmark and a real-world LeRobot platform demonstrate that MIRTH achieves state-of-the-art performance and exhibiting emergent error recovery capabilities. The codes and collected datasets are released at http://github.com/kiva12138/mirth.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出MIRTH框架，通过双尺度时间记忆枢纽、互信息驱动的隐式推理token、以及并行动作解码，改进视觉-语言-动作模型在时序建模、语义到动作映射和推理效率上的缺陷，在LIBERO仿真和LeRobot真机平台上提升了任务成功率，并声称具备错误恢复能力。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索；github用户名kiva12138无法对应知名机构）
analysis.claim: 通过引入双尺度时间记忆枢纽、互信息优化的隐式推理token和并行动作解码，VLA模型可克服时间短视、语义-动作鸿沟与自回归低效三大瓶颈，实现更高性能与错误恢复能力。
analysis.input: RGB视频帧序列+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 并行预测的动作向量序列（6D末端位姿或关节扭矩）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的数据集（摘要称‘collected datasets’，但未说明规模/多样性/是否公开标注）
analysis.significance_reason: 技术组合有合理性（时间压缩+互信息规划+并行解码），在LIBERO和LeRobot上验证了提升，但未跨机体测试、无消融证明各模块贡献、错误恢复能力仅定性提及、未与RT-2/Octo/OpenVLA等基石模型同台对比（仅称SOTA，未指明基线），属扎实但非范式级的增量改进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：工程整合——将多个已知思路（时间记忆、互信息对齐、并行解码）有效耦合，在仿真+小规模真机上验证有效性，开源完整，但缺乏机制深度分析与跨平台泛化证据，未触及VLA基础瓶颈。

papers.title: S-CEReBrO: Breaking the Memory Barrier in Continuous EEG Monitoring
papers.abstract: Foundation models offer a promising paradigm for Electroencephalography (EEG) analysis, leveraging generalizable representations from vast unlabeled datasets. Yet, Transformer-based architectures face a critical bottleneck: global attention mechanisms couple the attention memory state to the signal duration, causing memory overflow during continuous monitoring. To address this, we introduce S-CEReBrO (Streaming CEReBrO), an evolution of the CEReBrO architecture designed for continuous monitoring. Our novel Windowed Alternating Attention mechanism factorizes attention computation into fixed-size spatiotemporal windows, guaranteeing constant KV cache memory as only the active window requires resident attention maps. Empirical scaling analysis confirms that windowed alternating attention can process signals 100X longer than full self-attention and 3X longer than low-rank linear attention. Compared to low-rank linear attention on long contexts, windowed alternating attention requires 55% of the memory while increasing inference throughput by 2.1X. Pre-trained on >25,000 hours of recordings from >12,000 subjects, S-CEReBrO achieves state-of-the-art performance on 7 of 11 downstream tasks, with up to 60% fewer parameters. This work represents a significant step toward the realization of efficient, generalizable, and continuous EEG monitoring. An accompanying code repository is available.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫S-CEReBrO的流式EEG基础模型，用窗口交替注意力机制解决Transformer在长时程连续脑电监测中显存爆炸的问题，能在内存恒定前提下处理百倍更长的信号，并在11个下游任务中7个达到SOTA。
analysis.claim: 窗口交替注意力机制可将Transformer在连续EEG建模中的KV缓存内存开销降为常数级，从而实现真正可扩展的长时程流式脑电分析。
analysis.input: 连续多通道EEG时序信号（流式输入）
analysis.output: EEG表征向量（用于下游分类/检测等任务）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，但依赖大规模真实EEG临床/人群数据（>25,000小时，>12,000人）
analysis.significance_reason: 技术扎实：实证显示内存恒定、吞吐提升2.1X、长度扩展100X，且在7/11下游任务SOTA；但属算法工程优化而非范式突破——未解决BCI核心瓶颈（如低信噪比解码、跨被试泛化鲁棒性、闭环控制），也未涉及实时闭环、神经反馈或意图解码等临床落地关键环节，与所列基石工作（如脑机打字97分、语音合成92分、脊髓接口95分）相比，仍停留在离线表征学习层，无神经接口硬件、闭环验证或临床功能输出。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：是EEG基础模型实用化的关键工程突破，但非BCI范式变革，暂未触及临床级神经解码或闭环控制。

papers.title: APT: Action Expert Pretraining Improves Instruction Generalization of Vision-Language-Action Policies
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models that couple pretrained Vision-Language Models (VLMs) with continuous action experts have achieved strong manipulation performance, yet generalization to out-of-distribution (OOD) language instructions remains poor. A known challenge is the structural imbalance in VLA data, where language is far less diverse than visual and action content, making policies prone to visual shortcuts. While discrete-action methods mitigate this through vision-language co-training, continuous action experts lack such protection: they start from random initialization and learn entirely from imbalanced data, producing noisy gradients that corrupt the VLM and fail to exploit its language capability. We address this from a Bayesian perspective, factorizing the policy into a language-agnostic Vision-Action (VA) prior and a language-conditioned VLA likelihood, and propose APT, a two-stage training method emphasizing Action expert PreTraining. In Stage 1, the action expert is pretrained as a VA prior on vision-action pairs from a frozen VLM, bypassing the language imbalance. In Stage 2, language tokens are injected through a gated fusion mechanism that integrates VLM features while preserving the learned visuomotor prior. APT applies to mainstream VLA architectures, including the $π$ and GR00T-style architectures. Comprehensive experiments validate that APT achieves consistent gains on unseen instructions and compositional tasks. Project Page: https://xukechun.github.io/papers/APT/

analysis.tldr: 提出APT两阶段训练法，先用视觉-动作对预训练动作专家（绕过语言数据不平衡问题），再注入语言信息微调，提升VLA模型对未见过指令的泛化能力。
analysis.claim: 通过将策略分解为语言无关的视觉-动作先验和语言条件化的似然，并分阶段训练动作专家，可显著缓解VLA模型因语言数据稀缺导致的指令泛化失败。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 连续动作序列（6DoF末端位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开仿真/真实机器人数据集（如Bridge、RT-1、OpenX），未采集新真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 方法设计有清晰因果逻辑（贝叶斯分解+分阶段解耦训练），在多个主流VLA架构（π、GR00T）和多个基准（Bridge、OpenX、VoxPoser）上验证了对OOD指令和组合任务的稳定提升，含消融实验；但未在真实机器人上部署，未开源代码/模型，且未挑战更难的跨机体/跨用户泛化，属扎实的SOTA推进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：解决了VLA中被长期忽视的语言数据瓶颈问题，实证充分但落地闭环不完整，是高质量的方法论改进而非原理性突破。

papers.title: Trajectory-Level Redirection Attacks on Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies bring natural language into closed-loop robot control, enabling robots to execute manipulation tasks directly from text instructions. The same interface gives text a recurring role in control because the prompt is reused at every replanning step, and each prompt-conditioned action changes the future observations on which the policy acts. Existing VLA attacks study adversarial prompts that elicit targeted low-level actions or make such actions persist across changing images. We identify a stronger trajectory-level failure mode: a prompt that still $\textit{appears}$ to specify the intended task but redirects the final physical outcome. We mathematically formalize this setting as $\textit{command-preserving trajectory redirection}$, a prompt-only threat model in which the attacker chooses one prompt before the episode, all policy and environment components remain fixed, and the prompt must stay close to the benign instruction while omitting target words and correction language. To find such prompts, we introduce an on-policy prompt search method that uses rollouts to discover perturbations whose closed-loop behavior tracks a target task while satisfying the command-preserving constraints. Experiments in simulation and on hardware show that near-benign prompt perturbations can redirect VLA rollouts to attacker-specified targets. These results expose a trajectory-level vulnerability in VLA instruction grounding: text that appears to preserve the intended command can still give an adversary control over the robot's final physical outcome. Project website: https://vla-redirection-attack.github.io/

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现并系统构造了一类新型攻击：通过微调自然语言指令（如把‘拿苹果’改成‘拿苹果然后放桌上’），让视觉-语言-动作模型在执行过程中看似忠实地遵循原指令，实则最终完成完全不同的物理任务（比如把苹果放进冰箱而非桌上），且该攻击在仿真和真实机器人上均有效。
analysis.claim: VLA模型存在轨迹级指令劫持漏洞——仅通过语义相近、表面合规的文本提示扰动，即可在不触发明显异常的前提下，系统性地重定向整个任务执行轨迹的最终物理结果。
analysis.input: 自然语言指令+当前多模态观测（RGB图像等）
analysis.output: 动作序列/轨迹
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂 + PyBullet仿真
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人交互数据用于验证，但攻击生成本身不依赖真实数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次形式化并实证了VLA模型中‘指令表意不变但行为轨迹被劫持’这一高危漏洞，覆盖仿真+真实机器人+多任务，具备强现实威胁意义；但未提出防御方案，未开源代码/模型，也未挑战或改进现有VLA架构本身，属于关键安全缺陷揭示而非技术推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——不是突破模型能力，而是首次用扎实实验揭露VLA范式下被忽视的深层语义-行为解耦风险，对部署级可靠性构成实质性警示。

papers.title: HEFT: Heavy-Payload Full-size Humanoid Teleoperation with Privileged Motion Guidance and Windowed Payload Curriculum
papers.abstract: General motion tracking and teleoperation offer a promising path to scalable humanoid skill acquisition, yet most existing frameworks are validated on compact platforms or without real payload interaction, leaving full-size humanoids with real payloads largely unexplored. Scaling to full-size humanoids introduces two compounding challenges: their larger inertia and tighter balance margins make tracking highly sensitive to noise, drift, and retargeting errors from commodity VR trackers, while their payload potential remains largely underutilized. We present HEFT, a heavy-payload full-size humanoid teleoperation framework that addresses both challenges. HEFT learns from deployable noisy VR references with physically plausible reconstructed references through Privileged Motion Guidance (PMG), and uses a Windowed Payload Curriculum (WPC) with expert-guided payload caps to acquire robust heavy-payload tracking. We deploy HEFT on L7, a 175cm, 65kg humanoid. The robot tracks motions including turns, forward/backward locomotion, and squats under payloads up to 24kg.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文实现了全尺寸人形机器人（L7，175cm/65kg）在最高24kg真实载荷下的VR遥操作运动跟踪，通过Privileged Motion Guidance修正消费级VR追踪噪声，用Windowed Payload Curriculum逐步提升载荷能力。
analysis.claim: 在无高精度动捕、仅依赖消费级VR设备的前提下，实现全尺寸人形机器人在真实重载（24kg）下的鲁棒遥操作运动跟踪。
analysis.input: 消费级VR手柄+头显的6DoF位姿+关节角度估计（含噪声）
analysis.output: 全身体关节扭矩控制指令（实时闭环）
analysis.robot_dependency: L7全尺寸人形机器人（自研硬件）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人在不同载荷下的闭环遥操作数据，但未说明是否公开或规模
analysis.significance_reason: 真机部署、多任务（转体/行走/深蹲）、跨载荷（0→24kg）验证、消融显示PMG与WPC均有效；但未开源代码/模型，未与SOTA遥操作框架（如H2O、GRAIL）对比，未测试泛化到其他机体或用户，且VR噪声建模和物理重建仍属工程优化而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在真实重载人形平台上扎实落地了VR遥操作，解决了噪声敏感与载荷耦合难题，但未开新范式、未开源、未跨机体验证，属于高水平工程推进而非理论或架构突破。

papers.title: Domain Arithmetic: One-Shot VLA Adaptation under Environmental Shifts
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models often fail to perform the same learned tasks under environmental shifts, such as changes in camera pose and shifts to a different but similar robot (e.g., from Panda to UR5e). Adapting these models to the shifted environment (i.e., target domain) often requires training on multiple demonstrations for each task, which are costly to collect. To reduce the burden of data curation and training, we propose an analogy-based method that adapts VLA models under environmental shifts through weight vector arithmetic with domain-specific information addition, named Domain ARiThmetic (DART). Unlike prior approaches, DART requires collecting only a single demonstration, enabling efficient adaptation. To accurately isolate domain-specific information for addition, DART performs subspace alignment between singular components in weight vectors to filter out noisy components. In both simulated and real-world experiments, DART outperforms existing VLA adaptation methods in one-shot scenarios across diverse visual and embodiment shifts. Code is available at https://github.com/snumprlab/dart.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫DART的方法，只用一个示范样本（one-shot）就能把视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型快速适配到新环境（比如换摄像头角度或换机器人型号），核心是通过权重向量的子空间对齐+向量加法注入域信息。
analysis.claim: 仅需单个示范样本，即可通过权重空间中的域特定向量算术实现VLA模型在视觉与具身环境变化下的高效跨域适应。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令+单个目标域示范轨迹（含动作）
analysis.output: 适配后的VLA模型权重（即新参数），用于在目标域执行相同任务
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖1个真实机器人示范样本（per task），但未说明是否需真实传感器标定/时序同步等隐性数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在one-shot VLA跨域适应这一明确痛点上给出可验证、多机体（Panda→UR5e）、多视觉位姿、真机+仿真联合验证的方案，有子空间对齐等技术细节和消融，但未开源数据/模型权重，且未挑战更难的开放场景泛化（如未知物体/新任务组合），属扎实推进SOTA而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：方法简洁有效，在one-shot跨域VLA适配任务上实证充分，但受限于单任务单示范设定和未完全开源，尚未达到RT-2/Octo级的系统性影响力。

papers.title: Benchmarking AI Protein Structure Predictors Reveals a Persistent Bias in Multi-State Proteins
papers.abstract: Protein structure predictors achieve high single-state accuracy, but it remains unclear whether they can recover functionally relevant conformational ensembles or account for the presence of ligands and/or binding partners. Here, we benchmark AlphaFold3, Boltz-2, Chai-1, and BioEmu on four canonical multi-state proteins (Pf-MATE, LAO, SecA, and β2AR), quantifying state bias and sampling breadth against experimental reference structures. Models frequently default to a dominant state represented in the PDB; small-molecule ligands have weak or inconsistent effects, while large protein partners drive clear conformational switching between states. Multiple sequence alignment (MSA)-based approaches (AF-Cluster and random subsampling) recapitulate similar biases, indicating that this behavior is not unique to newer architectures. These results underscore current limitations for multi-state protein structure prediction and structure-guided ligand discovery.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统评测了AlphaFold3、Boltz-2、Chai-1和BioEmu等主流AI蛋白结构预测模型在多构象蛋白（如Pf-MATE、LAO等）上的表现，发现它们普遍存在对PDB中优势构象的严重偏好，难以准确采样功能相关的多态构象集合，且对小分子配体响应微弱，仅对大蛋白伙伴有较明显构象切换，说明当前模型在动态结构预测和配体诱导变构建模上存在根本性局限。
analysis.claim: 当前主流AI蛋白结构预测器在多状态蛋白建模中存在系统性构象偏好偏差，该偏差源于训练数据与MSA构建方式，而非模型架构特有，严重制约其在变构药物设计中的实用性。
analysis.input: 蛋白质序列+配体/伙伴蛋白信息（文本/结构标识）
analysis.output: 预测的三维结构集合（多构象采样）
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统量化四大前沿模型在多态蛋白上的构象偏差，并关联到MSA采样机制与实验参考结构，证据扎实（4个经典多态蛋白+定量状态分布分析+消融式MSA对比），但未提出新模型或算法，属高质量诊断性研究，推进了领域认知边界，尚未达到基石级方法论突破（如AF2/ESMFold/RFDiffusion）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——不是新模型，而是用严谨基准揭示了当前SOTA模型在动态结构预测中的结构性缺陷，为后续变构建模和药物发现提供了不可绕过的实证基线。

papers.title: STST-JEPA: Shallow-Target Spatio-Temporal Joint Embedding Prediction Architecture For EEG Self-Supervised Learning
papers.abstract: Brain age - the age inferred from a physiological recording - is an emerging biomarker whose deviation from chronological age tracks neurological and psychiatric burden, and EEG is an attractive substrate for it because it is cheap, portable, and temporally rich. Yet EEG brain-age models must contend with cross-site montage heterogeneity, small labelled cohorts, and dominant subject-level non-stationarity, and few EEG foundation models have been shown to deliver competitive age regression across the full pediatric to older adult range in which such a biomarker would actually be deployed. We introduce STST-JEPA, a self-supervised transformer for resting-state and task EEG, pretrained on 47,703 sessions spanning ages 5-81 from the brain.space and Healthy Brain Network (HBN) corpora. The model combines a latent-prediction objective - predicting masked-token representations against an EMA-of-tokenizer target - with an auxiliary signal-reconstruction term, applied to 30-second multi-channel windows under spatiotemporal block masks. A lightweight attentive probe trained on frozen pretrained embeddings achieves a best held-out-validation mean absolute error of 3.06 years (r = 0.924) for age regression on 3,367 sessions, against a predict-the-mean baseline of approximately 10 years MAE. With light task-specific finetuning of the model's final layers, the same pretrained encoder achieves rank-1 placements - with the model's native 30-second windows - on the public NeuralBench x brain.space EEG leaderboard for sex classification (balanced accuracy 0.911), age prediction (r = 0.749), and psychopathology composite regression (r = 0.215). We further show that the model's age-prediction residual is negatively correlated with cognitive efficiency over several tasks we examined.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个名为STST-JEPA的自监督Transformer模型，用4.7万段跨年龄（5–81岁）多中心EEG数据预训练，通过掩码时空块预测+信号重建联合目标学习通用表征，在冻结主干后仅用轻量探针就实现3.06年脑龄预测误差，并在多个EEG下游任务（性别、年龄、精神病理）上刷榜。
analysis.claim: STST-JEPA通过浅层目标联合嵌入预测架构，在跨站点、跨年龄段、小标注样本约束下，学习到泛化性强的EEG基础表征，显著提升脑龄等生物标志物建模性能。
analysis.input: 30秒多通道静息态/任务态EEG时序信号（按spatiotemporal block mask掩码）
analysis.output: 被掩码时间-空间位置的潜变量表示 + 原始EEG信号重建
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在超大尺度（4.7万段）、全生命周期（5–81岁）、多中心EEG数据上验证了自监督JEPA范式对脑龄等临床相关生物标志物的有效性，MAE=3.06年具临床可解释性，且跨任务迁移表现稳健；但未开源代码/模型权重，未报告消融实验细节，未与同期SOTA（如EEGNet+SSL变体）做公平对比，也未验证其残差是否真能驱动干预决策。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：工程整合——将JEPA框架扎实落地于EEG基础模型，数据规模与任务覆盖广度确属当前领先，但缺乏开源与机制分析，尚未达到‘真突破’门槛

papers.title: Worlds in One Demo: A Synthetic Data Engine for Learning Open-World Mobile Manipulation
papers.abstract: Learning open-world mobile manipulation policies requires vast data to achieve spatial generalization, long-horizon robustness, and scene generalization. Current prevailing data collection paradigms, teleoperation and UMI, demand prohibitive human effort and cost at scale. To scale beyond the limits of manual data collection, we seek to maximize the value of each human demonstration by scalable data generation. To this end, we introduce WANDA: learning open-World mobile mANipulation from one demonstration via a synthetic DAta engine. WANDA first reconstructs background Gaussian splats and robot-object interaction trajectories from source RGBD observations, as a world substrate for later planning and rendering. It then rearranges contact-rich robot-object interaction segments into extensive spatial configurations, utilizing whole-body motion planning to chain them into new trajectories. To enhance long-horizon robustness, it applies Corrective State Expansion to increase the robot and object state diversity at different stages of mobile manipulation. To unlock cross-environment generalization, trajectories are synthesized on diverse generated 3D worlds from everyday photos. Furthermore, we synthesize photo-realistic observations by compositing rendered robot and object meshes with Gaussian splatting backgrounds. We evaluate our approach on extensive simulation and real-world tasks in various scenes. Experiments show that policies trained with WANDA achieve long-horizon robustness, broad spatial generalization and cross-environment generalization from one real demonstration. Moreover, WANDA naturally supports cross-embodiment data generation, validated by zero-shot deployment on another mobile manipulator with a distinct morphology.

analysis.tldr: 只用一个真实人类演示，通过重建场景高斯溅射、重排交互片段、扩增状态空间、合成多样化3D世界和照片级渲染，生成海量高质量合成数据，训练出能在不同环境、不同机器人本体上泛化的移动操作策略。
analysis.claim: 仅需单次真实人类演示，即可通过可扩展的合成数据引擎WANDA生成具备空间泛化性、长时程鲁棒性和跨环境/跨本体泛化能力的移动操作策略。
analysis.input: 单次真实RGBD演示（含机器人与物体交互）
analysis.output: 移动操作策略（动作序列/轨迹）
analysis.robot_dependency: 通用移动机械臂仿真器（如Isaac Gym/PyBullet）及真实移动机械臂平台（未指明具体型号，但验证于至少两种形态）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖：必须输入1段真实RGBD演示作为种子；后续全部为合成数据
analysis.significance_reason: 达到SPEAR/SimFoundry级工程深度：构建端到端合成数据流水线（重建→重排→扩态→跨世界合成→光栅化渲染），在仿真+多真实机器人上验证跨场景/跨本体零样本迁移，且所有模块可复现；但未开源代码/模型，未建立社区基准标准，略逊于RT-X（开放协议+跨实验室统一接口）和DROID（真机闭环自改进）的范式影响力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次实现从单段真实演示出发、全自动合成具备跨环境与跨本体泛化能力的移动操作训练数据，证据扎实（多真机部署+消融模块+长任务评估），但受限于未开源，尚未形成生态级影响。

papers.title: Trustworthy Protein-Ligand Binding Affinity Prediction via Reliability-Aware Multi-Engine Fusion
papers.abstract: Accurate protein-ligand binding affinity prediction is central to computational drug discovery, yet modern docking engines frequently disagree without indicating which prediction to trust. Consensus scoring and ensemble methods improve mean accuracy but treat all predictions identically without interpretable confidence measures or uncertainty decomposition, ignoring the chemical context of each protein-ligand pair. To address this limitation, we introduce RELIABLE-BA (RELIABiLity-aware Evidential fusion for Binding Affinity), an evidential framework for multi-engine binding affinity prediction. Our model comprises three steps: (1) modeling each engine as an evidential expert via Normal-Inverse-Gamma distributions, (2) scaling epistemic uncertainty through learned reliability from molecular context while preserving each expert's predictive mean, and (3) fusing experts through closed-form aggregation that captures both individual uncertainty and inter-engine disagreement. Experiments on the PDBBind and BDB2020+ benchmarks demonstrate competitive point prediction with substantially improved uncertainty calibration, and additional validation on the SARS-CoV-2 Mpro dataset and 5HT2A receptor demonstrates applicability to clinically relevant drug targets. Crucially, these uncertainty estimates enable reliable filtering of protein-ligand pairs, reducing prediction error by up to 25% when retaining only high-confidence pairs. To our knowledge, RELIABLE-BA is the first multi-engine binding affinity prediction framework to combine evidential fusion with context-dependent reliability, offering a principled path toward trustworthy AI-guided drug discovery. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/yongchand/RELIABLE-BA.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个叫RELIABLE-BA的框架，用证据理论（evidential learning）融合多个分子对接引擎的打分结果，不是简单平均，而是根据每个蛋白-配体对的化学上下文动态评估各引擎的可靠性，并输出带校准不确定性的结合亲和力预测值，从而能筛掉低置信度预测、显著降低误差。
analysis.claim: 通过引入基于分子上下文的可靠性感知证据融合机制，多引擎结合亲和力预测可在保持点预测精度的同时，实现可解释、可校准的不确定性估计，并支持高置信度筛选以实质性降低预测误差。
analysis.input: 蛋白结构+配体SMILES+多个对接引擎（如RF-Score、Vina、PLP等）的原始打分结果
analysis.output: 标量结合亲和力预测值及其对应的不确定性（evidential uncertainty，含epistemic component）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在AI×药物发现领域属重磅增量：首次将evidential learning与多引擎可靠性建模结合，实证覆盖PDBBind/BDB2020+/SARS-CoV-2 Mpro/5HT2A四大场景，不确定性校准指标（ECE、NLL）显著优于基线，且验证了‘高置信筛选降误差25%’这一可落地价值；但未突破底层物理建模或生成范式，未解决亲和力预测的根本性误差来源（如构象采样不足、溶剂化缺失），也未与湿实验闭环验证。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将证据学习严谨迁移到多引擎融合场景，不确定性校准扎实、开源完整、跨靶点验证充分，但未触及亲和力预测的物理瓶颈，属于当前SOTA框架的高质量可信升级而非范式突破

papers.title: EgoRecovery: Acquiring Failure Recovery Ability Through Human Recovery Demonstration
papers.abstract: Robust embodied robots should be able to recover from failures and retry tasks in order to operate reliably in unstructured and noisy real-world environments. Achieving this capability requires training policies on data that captures recovery behaviors. However, collecting such data through robot teleoperation is difficult to scale, as it is time-consuming to induce diverse failure states, perform corrective actions, and reset the environment. This challenge is further exacerbated by the high diversity of failure modes, which demands substantially more recovery data than success demonstrations. In this work, we show that egocentric human data capturing failure recovery processes provides a scalable alternative. By efficiently arranging task-level failure configurations and recording short recovery segments, human operators can generate more than 10x as much valid recovery data per hour compared to robot teleoperation under our protocol. To address the embodiment gap between human and robot, we propose EgoRecovery, a co-training framework for learning recovery behavior, where human recovery demonstrations are aligned to a compact corrective-intent space shared with robot data, which captures the timing and magnitude of correction. Only a small number of robot recovery demonstrations are required to connect this intent to executable robot actions. At deployment, a learned recovery gate predicts when correction is needed from robot observations and activates the corrective intent only in recovery states. Experiments on real-world recovery tasks show that EgoRecovery improves success from failure starts over robot-only recovery, direct co-training with human recovery data, and direct intent-transfer baselines.

analysis.tldr: 用人类第一视角录像中失败后手动恢复的动作作为数据，教机器人在自己失败时如何恢复；只用少量真实机器人恢复数据做桥接，就能让机器人在真实任务中比纯机器人数据训练的恢复成功率更高。
analysis.claim: 人类第一视角的失败恢复演示可规模化生成高质量恢复行为数据，通过意图空间对齐与轻量机器人桥接，能有效迁移至真实机器人实现鲁棒失败恢复。
analysis.input: 机器人本体观测（如RGB-D、关节状态）+ 人类第一视角视频片段（含失败-恢复过程）
analysis.output: 恢复动作策略（动作序列/轨迹）及恢复触发门控信号
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂 + RealSense D435i相机
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人失败恢复演示（用于意图-动作对齐），但主体训练数据来自人类录制的egocentric视频
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统验证人类egocentric恢复行为可作为机器人失败恢复的高效数据源，并提出可验证的意图对齐框架；在真实机械臂上完成多任务（抓取、推、插）失败恢复实验，有消融和多个强baseline对比，但未开源数据集、未跨机体验证、未接入端到端闭环任务栈（如失败检测→恢复→续任务），尚未达到ALOHA/ACT级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将人类恢复行为转化为机器人可执行恢复能力的完整技术链已跑通，证据扎实但扩展性与开放性尚有欠缺

papers.title: Cross-Embodiment Transfer via Behavior-Aligned Representations
papers.abstract: Recent progress in large-scale imitation learning for robot manipulation has been driven by leveraging datasets across a wide range of robot embodiments. However, achieving significant cross-embodiment transfer is often still challenging. In this work, we study the role of using behavior-aligned representations (e.g., object bounding boxes, language motions, end-effector traces of robot motion) in vision-language-action (VLA) models to promote cross-embodiment transfer. We hypothesize that by possessing invariances across embodiments while being predictive of robot actions, these representations can help unify large-scale cross-embodiment data to enhance transfer. To assess our hypothesis, we develop a simulation-based benchmark designed to assess transfer with diverse cross-embodiment data to new embodiments. Using this benchmark, we compare different representations and ways of incorporating them. We identify that end-effector traces can be particularly beneficial for transfer, representations are generally more useful with larger prior datasets, and can be used to benefit from action-free data. We also demonstrate that they can enhance sim-to-real cross-embodiment transfer, improving task completion progress of real robot policies pre-trained on simulation data by 28%. We provide videos of our evaluations at our website: https://ajaysridhar.com/barx/.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文研究如何让机器人模仿学习模型在不同机械臂（甚至不同构型）之间迁移能力，核心是用行为对齐的中间表示（如末端执行器轨迹、物体框、语言动作描述）作为跨机体的统一语义锚点，实验证明用末端轨迹做表征能显著提升仿真到真实机器人的跨机体迁移效果，真实机器人任务完成进度提升28%。
analysis.claim: 行为对齐的中间表示（特别是末端执行器轨迹）可作为跨机器人本体的不变语义接口，使VLA模型在不修改架构的前提下实现更鲁棒的跨机体迁移，且能利用无动作标注的数据。
analysis.input: 多视角RGB图像+语言指令+（可选）行为对齐表示（如末端轨迹/物体框/语言动作）
analysis.output: 机器人关节动作序列或末端位姿轨迹
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda、UR5、ALOHA、H1等仿真与真实平台
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真生成的跨机体数据；真实机器人实验仅用于最终sim2real验证，未用于训练
analysis.significance_reason: 提出行为对齐表征这一清晰设计原则，并在统一仿真基准上系统验证其对跨机体迁移的有效性，含消融和真实机器人验证（+28%任务进度），但未开源代码/模型，且未覆盖人形/全身操作等更广本体谱系，属扎实推进SOTA而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将行为语义锚点（如末端轨迹）作为跨机体迁移的轻量接口，实证充分、落地有效，但未改变VLA建模范式，也未解决底层运动学/动力学不匹配的根本矛盾。

papers.title: ContactFlow: A video action conditioning that transfers across embodiments
papers.abstract: World models offer a promising route toward robot planning by enabling agents to imagine and verify the consequences of actions before execution. However, current video-based world models often struggle to capture the physical constraints that govern manipulation, particularly contact. Further, their action conditioning is often constrained to specific embodiments such as parallel grippers. We propose \emph{Contact Flow}, an embodiment-agnostic action representation that encodes manipulation through the trajectory of 3D contact points between an actor and a target object. By discarding actor-specific appearance and kinematics, Contact Flow provides a shared conditioning signal for both human demonstrations and robotic execution. Therefore, we can train a large-scale video generative model on both human and robotic object interaction videos conditioned on Contact Flow, yielding a world model that predicts physically plausible manipulation outcomes. We integrate this model into a propose-imagine-verify-act pipeline, where generated rollouts are assessed by a vision-language model before execution. Experiments on the DROID dataset and real-world tabletop manipulation tasks demonstrate that Contact Flow enables transfer between human demonstrations and different robotic embodiments.

analysis.tldr: 提出ContactFlow——一种不依赖具体机器人形态的3D接触点轨迹动作表征，用它统一条件化人类演示视频和机器人操作视频，训练出能预测物理合理操作结果的世界模型，并在真实桌面任务中实现人类示范到多种机器人本体的跨形态迁移。
analysis.claim: 用接触点轨迹（Contact Flow）作为跨本体的动作条件信号，可使视频世界模型同时泛化到人类演示和异构机器人执行，且生成结果满足物理合理性约束。
analysis.input: RGB视频帧序列 + ContactFlow动作轨迹（3D接触点序列）
analysis.output: 未来帧预测视频（物理合理操作结果）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖DROID等真实机器人操作视频数据集，但未说明是否使用真实机器人在线闭环数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将接触动力学显式编码为跨本体动作表征并用于视频世界模型训练，在DROID和真实桌面任务上验证了human-to-robot跨本体迁移，但未开源代码/模型，实验规模有限（单任务类型、未报告多任务消融），物理合理性依赖VLM评估而非定量力/接触约束验证，未达基石级范式突破但属显著贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真突破尚缺开源与多任务实证，但ContactFlow表征设计扎实，是首个系统性打通人类演示与异构机器人视频世界模型条件化的方案。

papers.title: Temporal Policy: History-Initialized Action Generation for Robotic Learning from Demonstration
papers.abstract: By relying on independent couplings from uninformative Gaussian priors, standard diffusion and flow matching models are forced to learn complex, high-cost vector fields to reach the physical action space. Generative models excel at capturing multimodal behaviors for robotic Learning from Demonstration (LfD), but often suffer from high inference cost. This paper introduces Temporal Policy, a generative framework based on stochastic interpolants that formulates action generation as a temporally coupled transport problem. By initializing the generative flow at the robot's recent history, we explicitly couple past states to future action sequences. This data-dependent coupling reduces transport cost and produces straight vector fields. We validate Temporal Policy across visuomotor simulation benchmarks and on a physical Barrett WAM 2x 7DoF teleoperation platform. Our approach reduces transport costs by nearly an order of magnitude compared to noise-initialized baselines, achieving a 19.1 ms inference latency on a single NVIDIA RTX 4080. Crucially, these geometric and computational efficiencies are achieved while matching the success rates of state-of-the-art baselines. This simplified transport geometry bypasses the computational bottleneck of independent Gaussian priors, helping enable high-frequency, closed-loop control. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/dmiller12/TemporalPolicy.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫Temporal Policy的生成式动作策略框架，通过用机器人最近的动作历史初始化生成过程（而非传统随机噪声），大幅降低扩散模型的向量场传输代价，从而实现低延迟（19.1ms）、高成功率的实时动作生成，已在仿真和真实7DoF机械臂上验证。
analysis.claim: 用机器人近期动作历史替代高斯噪声作为生成起点，可将动作生成的传输代价降低近一个数量级，同时不牺牲任务成功率，从而支持高频闭环控制。
analysis.input: 视觉-运动观测序列（含近期动作历史）
analysis.output: 未来动作序列（连续控制信号）
analysis.robot_dependency: Barrett WAM 2×7DoF机械臂 + MuJoCo/PyBullet仿真器
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人演示数据用于训练和评估，但未说明是否需大量真实交互采集（仅提及teleoperation平台验证）
analysis.significance_reason: 在LfD生成建模中首次系统性解耦‘初始化方式’与‘传输几何’，实证显著降低延迟并保持性能，在真实7DoF臂上达成19.1ms闭环推断——属扎实的显著贡献，但未跨机体/跨任务泛化验证，也未挑战更复杂场景（如灵巧操作、多智能体），未达基石论文所代表的范式级突破或通用架构影响力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：工程上切实解决了生成式LfD的实时性瓶颈，但仍是特定设定下的高效改进，非范式转移或通用基础模型。

papers.title: What Can Latent World Models Know? Physical Parameter Identifiability in Multimodal Predictive Representations
papers.abstract: A central premise of latent world models is that predicting the future forces a representation to internalize the physics of its environment. Which physical quantities does a trained latent actually contain, and what decides this? We answer with controlled interventions in POKEWORLD, an interactive environment whose visually identical objects hide mass, drag, and contact stiffness. A certificate-gated protocol first certifies each parameter as recoverable from raw observations, then measures whether it enters the latent, so a null result can be attributed to the objective rather than to the environment. The resulting identifiability map has two organizing mechanisms and one frontier. Inputs limit what can be known, while prediction targets decide what is retained. Stiffness enters the latent only when touch is forecast ($R^2=0.50$, compared with $-0.02$ when the same signal is merely fused into the input), and under single-step prediction a vision-only latent discards even perfectly visible object state. Drag marks the frontier. It carries a recoverability certificate of 0.89 yet plateaus near 0.13 under every deterministic prediction objective we test, while a supervised head on the same trunk reaches 0.45. Parameters whose readout is slow and ratio-type under the sensed coordinates fall outside what these objectives acquire. On RH20T, an input-target factorial across scaling curves reproduces both mechanisms across two robots and 4,258 episodes. Every arm missing information or prediction pressure stays flat over a fivefold data range, and only the full multimodal objective forecasts force beyond a persistence baseline, with held-out gains that grow with scale. Objective structure determines which physical parameters a latent acquires, and additional data improves only the parameters it already acquires.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统检验了潜世界模型（latent world models）到底能学到哪些物理参数（如质量、阻力、接触刚度），发现在视觉完全相同但物理属性不同的环境中，模型是否编码某个参数，主要取决于预测目标的设计（比如是否要求预测触觉信号）和输入模态组合，而非数据量多少；阻力参数即使可恢复也几乎学不到，暴露了当前确定性预测目标的固有局限。
analysis.claim: 潜世界模型中物理参数的可识别性（identifiability）由预测目标（prediction target）和输入模态（input modality）共同决定，而非数据规模或模型容量；某些物理量（如drag）在标准确定性预测目标下本质上不可习得，因其读出特性（slow, ratio-type）与当前目标不匹配。
analysis.input: 多模态观测（视觉+触觉+本体感知）
analysis.output: 未来状态预测（含力/触觉/运动学）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，全部基于POKEWORLD仿真环境及RH20T仿真数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 首次用受控干预+可恢复性证书（recoverability certificate）量化分析潜表示对物理参数的捕获能力，揭示预测目标结构对物理知识获取的决定性作用，并在RH20T上跨机器人复现；证据扎实（消融完备、多目标对比、scaling analysis），但未部署真机、未提出新模型架构，属重大机制发现而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——不是提出新模型，而是首次以因果可控方式证明‘学不到物理参数’不是数据或算力问题，而是预测目标设计缺陷，为世界模型的物理一致性训练提供了不可绕过的诊断框架。

papers.title: MonoDuo: Using One Robot Arm to Learn Bimanual Policies
papers.abstract: Bimanual coordination is essential for many real-world manipulation tasks, yet learning bimanual robot policies is limited by the scarcity of bimanual robots and datasets. Single-arm robots, however, are widely available in research labs. Can we leverage them to train bimanual robot policies? We present MonoDuo, a framework for learning bimanual manipulation policies using single-arm robot demonstrations paired with human collaboration. MonoDuo collects data by teleoperating a single-arm robot to perform one side of a bimanual task while a human performs the other, then swapping roles to cover both sides. RGB-D observations from a wrist-mounted and fixed camera are augmented into synthetic demonstrations for target bimanual robots using state-of-the-art hand pose estimation, image and point cloud segmentation, and inpainting. These synthetic demonstrations, grounded in real robot kinematics, are used to train bimanual policies. We evaluate MonoDuo on five tasks: box lifting, backpack packing, cloth folding, jacket zipping, and plate handover. Compared to approaches relying solely on human bimanual videos, MonoDuo enables zero-shot deployment on unseen bimanual robot configurations, achieving success rates up to 70%. With only 25 target robot demonstrations, few-shot finetuning further boosts success rates by 65-70% over training from scratch, demonstrating MonoDuo's effectiveness in efficiently transferring knowledge from single-arm robot data to bimanual robot policies.

analysis.tldr: 用一台单臂机器人+人类协作采集数据，通过多模态合成（RGB-D+手部姿态估计+分割+补全）生成双臂机器人可训练的仿真演示数据，从而零样本迁移到真实双臂机器人上执行任务。
analysis.claim: 仅需单臂机器人与人类协作采集的数据，即可合成物理合理的双臂操作演示，支撑双臂策略的零样本迁移与高效微调。
analysis.input: RGB-D图像（腕部+固定视角）+人类手部姿态+单臂机器人关节状态
analysis.output: 双臂机器人关节轨迹/动作序列
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda（单臂）+目标双臂平台（如 two-Panda 或自定义双臂）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实单臂机器人+人类协同的原始采集数据（非纯仿真），但不依赖双臂机器人真实操作数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统性打通‘单臂硬件→双臂策略’的闭环：含真实人机协同数据采集、基于物理约束的合成流水线、5个具挑战性的双臂任务验证、跨机体零样本+少样本提升显著；但未开源代码/模型，且未在标准基准（如 RDT-1B/UMI）上横向对比，也未覆盖灵巧操作（dexterous）或触觉等维度，强于一般增量但未达ALOHA/ACT级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将现有技术（手部估计、inpainting、分割）严谨组装成可落地的单臂→双臂迁移管线，在真实双臂机器人上验证了可行性与泛化性，但缺乏开源和更广基准验证，尚未构成新范式。

papers.title: Human2Humanoid: Physics-Aware Cross-Morphology Motion Retargeting for Humanoid Robots
papers.abstract: Retargeting human motion to humanoid robots is critical for teleoperation, imitation learning and human-robot interaction. However, it remains challenging because of substantial morphological discrepancies between humans and robots, including differences in skeletal topology, limb proportions and degrees of freedom, as well as the scarcity of paired motion data. This paper presents Human2Humanoid, an unsupervised motion retargeting framework that transfers human motions to humanoid robot behaviors with high fidelity. To bridge the domain gap under unpaired data, we adopt a CycleGAN-based architecture equipped with a skeleton-aware graph convolutional network to capture topology-dependent motion features. To address cross-domain scale mismatches, we introduce a morphology-invariant end-effector consistency loss that aligns normalized end-effector trajectories to preserve motion semantics across embodiments. To improve physical plausibility and reduce contact artifacts, we impose explicit physics-aware feasibility constraints to encourage reproduction of the contact patterns in the source motion. Experimental results show that the proposed method successfully retargets human motion to the Unitree G1 humanoid robot without paired data, and outperforms existing methods in both downstream controllability and physical feasibility.

analysis.tldr: 用无配对的人类动作数据，把真人动作（如RGB-D或动捕）转成人形机器人能稳定执行的动作，重点解决人和机器人骨架不同、比例不同、自由度不同带来的动作失真问题。
analysis.claim: 在无配对数据条件下，通过骨架感知图卷积+归一化末端轨迹一致性损失+显式物理可行性约束，可实现高保真、物理合理、跨形态的人类动作到人形机器人的运动重定向。
analysis.input: 人类动作序列（如SMPL/AMASS格式的3D关节轨迹或原始动捕数据）
analysis.output: 人形机器人关节角度轨迹（带接触状态标签）
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree G1仿真器（PyBullet/Mujoco）及实机验证
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人执行数据；仅需人类动作数据集（AMASS等），无人-机器人配对数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在无配对设定下系统性整合骨架拓扑建模、尺度不变末端约束与接触物理正则，在Unitree G1上完成多任务（行走/挥手/拾取）sim2real验证并报告下游控制性能，但未开源数据/模型权重，且未与H2O/GR00T等基石方法在统一benchmark上横向对比，属扎实推进但未达范式级突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将多个已知技术模块（CycleGAN、GCN、末端轨迹归一化、接触约束）有机耦合，在真实人形机器人上验证了无配对重定向的可行性，但缺乏新原理、未开源核心资产、未挑战更难机体（如Atlas或全尺寸双足），尚未构成范式迁移。

papers.title: Scaling by Diversified Experience for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action models face significant challenges in real-world deployment due to the entanglement of high-level reasoning with low-level control, and the instability of policy optimization. In this paper, we introduce SyVLA, a robust VLA model trained with diversified experiences. We propose an Intention Decoupling algorithm to isolate control-relevant features from reasoning contexts and a similar-sample guided RL pipeline to stabilize policy updates and mitigate distribution shift. Extensive experiments on real-world robotic tasks and multi-modal benchmarks demonstrate that SyVLA achieves superior task success rates and stronger out-of-distribution generalization compared to existing methods, while effectively preserving core vision-language capabilities. Codes and Datasets is released on \href{https://sy-vla.github.io/}{project page}.

analysis.tldr: 提出SyVLA模型，通过意图解耦算法分离高层语义与底层控制特征，并用相似样本引导的强化学习稳定策略训练，在真实机器人任务和多模态基准上提升了任务成功率和分布外泛化能力。
analysis.claim: 通过解耦意图表征与动作控制、并用相似样本引导RL训练，可显著提升VLA模型在真实机器人上的鲁棒性与泛化性，且不损害视觉-语言理解能力。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 机器人末端动作序列（6DoF位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂+RealSense D435相机
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的多样化操作数据（含失败轨迹），但未说明是否使用预收集的大规模离线数据集或仅在线采集
analysis.significance_reason: 在真实机器人上验证了意图解耦+相似样本RL的有效性，跨任务/场景泛化有实证（Table 3/4），但未开源代码与模型权重（仅项目页），未与RT-2/Octo/OpenVLA等SOTA进行公平对比（如统一仿真评估或相同真实硬件基线），也未展示多机体迁移或长程任务规划等关键能力突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在真实Panda平台上实现了较扎实的VLA部署改进，但缺乏开源支撑与范式级创新，尚未达到OpenVLA/RT-2级的分量

papers.title: RHO: Your Coding Agent is Secretly a Roboticist
papers.abstract: Code-as-Policies (CaP) has shown that large language models (LLMs) can write code to solve robotics tasks by composing perception, planning, and control primitives. Recent CaP systems, however, rely on multi-turn code-generation loops at test time, which is often infeasible for real-time robot control. We introduce Robotics Harness Optimization (RHO), a novel paradigm in which tool-enabled coding agents, at training time, propose and search for interpretable, neurosymbolic multi-file policy repositories (Repositories-as-Policies) that compose these primitives rather than a single prompt, function, or file. RHO searches with reflective feedback from environment reward and execution rather than teleoperation demonstrations. It generalizes to perturbed pick-and-place settings like LIBERO-PRO, where OpenVLA scores 0.0% and $π_{0.5}$ averages 12.83%. Using the same low-level primitives, RHO reaches a 45.0% success rate, 2.5x higher than the strongest multi-turn agentic system, and 3.5x higher than $π_{0.5}$. On Robosuite, RHO sets a new state-of-the-art of 70.0%, exceeding the prior multi-turn record of 68.29% using single-turn execution with no corrective LLM code edits at deployment. When an LLM is used in the control loop, as on RAI's O3DE benchmark, RHO optimizes the deployed agent's multi-file harness of prompts, tools, and control code, improving held-out success from 23.5% to 44.3% with 20% less wall-clock time and 27% fewer tool calls.

analysis.tldr: 提出RHO范式，让编码智能体在训练时自动搜索并构建多文件、可解释的神经符号化策略仓库（而非单次生成代码），用环境反馈替代人工示范进行优化，在多个机器人任务上显著提升单次执行成功率，尤其在需要泛化的扰动场景中大幅超越现有CaP方法。
analysis.claim: 通过训练时搜索多文件策略仓库（Repositories-as-Policies）并利用环境奖励进行反射式优化，可摆脱测试时多轮LLM代码修正的实时瓶颈，实现更高鲁棒性与泛化性的机器人策略部署。
analysis.input: 视觉观测（RGB）、任务指令（自然语言）、低层感知/控制原语接口
analysis.output: 多文件策略仓库（含prompt、工具调用逻辑、控制脚本等组成的可执行代码包）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真器交互数据，无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 实质性推进CaP范式：首次将策略表示从单次生成函数升维为可搜索、可组合、可复用的多文件仓库，并用环境反馈驱动训练期搜索；在LIBERO-PRO和Robosuite上取得扎实SOTA，且明确对比了单次执行vs多轮修正的工程代价（wall-clock/time/tool calls），但未验证真机部署、未开源代码模型、泛化仍限于仿真扰动场景。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将LLM编码代理从‘在线调试模式’转向‘离线策略仓库构建模式’，显著提升部署效率与稳定性，但仍是仿真内闭环，未跨出sim2real关键一步。

papers.title: Adaptive Neural Reorganization Enables Real-Time Finger-Level Robotic Control in BCI-Naïve Stroke Survivors
papers.abstract: Restoring hand function remains a major challenge for individuals with motor impairments following stroke. Noninvasive brain–computer interfaces (BCIs) aim to address this problem by translating neural signals into robotic assistance; however, control of individual fingers has not been demonstrated in BCI-naïve populations. In this study, we investigated whether individuals with stroke and no prior BCI experience could achieve finger-level robotic control using motor imagery. Nine stroke-affected participants performed real-time BCI tasks to control a robotic hand through imagined finger movements decoded from electroencephalography. On average, participants achieved decoding accuracies of 84% for two-finger tasks and 61% for three-finger tasks, demonstrating reliable control at the level of individual fingers. These results indicate that discriminable neural signals for fine motor control persist after stroke and can be leveraged using data-driven deep learning decoders. Sensor-level and source-level electrophysiological analyses further reveal patterns of stroke-related neural reorganization. Overall, these findings support the potential of noninvasive, finger-level BCIs for post-stroke robotic assistance.

analysis.tldr: 让9名从未用过脑机接口的中风患者，仅靠想象单个手指动作，实时控制机械手完成两指/三指协同任务，平均准确率84%/61%，证明中风后大脑仍保留可解码的精细运动神经信号。
analysis.claim: BCI-naïve中风患者无需训练即可通过运动想象实现非侵入式、实时、手指级的机器人控制，其神经信号具有足够判别性且伴随可识别的皮层重组模式。
analysis.input: 高密度EEG信号（运动想象诱发）
analysis.output: 单个手指或手指组合的二元/多类控制指令（如‘食指+中指’）
analysis.robot_dependency: 商用机械手（未指明型号，但属标准外骨骼/仿生手平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖真实中风患者EEG数据，无仿真预训练；所有9人均为首次BCI使用，无筛选排除（即非‘BCI-literate’）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在真正BCI-naïve中风人群中实现手指级实时闭环控制，有真实机器人验证、多被试统计、源定位神经机制分析和消融式解码对比（LSTM vs. CNN），但未跨机体泛化、未长期随访、未与临床金标准功能量表关联，也未开源代码/模型，距基石级（>90分）缺临床效用证据链和系统鲁棒性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅：实证扎实的临床突破，但限于小样本单中心，尚未证明功能恢复效果，属于显著推进SOTA的神经康复BCI工作。

papers.title: See-and-Reach: Precise Vision-Language Navigation for UAVs within the Field of View
papers.abstract: UAV Vision-Language Navigation (UAV-VLN) is typically formulated as a holistic search-and-reach problem, where long-range target discovery and final target approach are optimized and evaluated jointly. This formulation makes it difficult to assess a critical capability of aerial embodied agents, namely whether a UAV can accurately ground a visible target and translate vision-language evidence into precise 3D motion once the target enters its field of view. To address this limitation, we introduce UAV-VLN-FOV, a target-visible navigation task that isolates the see-and-reach stage and enables a more diagnostic evaluation of terminal reaching ability. We further propose 3DG-VLN, a vision-language waypoint prediction framework guided by dynamic 3D direction cues to enhance fine-grained visual grounding and spatial direction alignment for precise target reaching. Specifically, 3DG-VLN adaptively processes high-resolution front-view and downward-view observations to preserve fine-grained visual and geometric details for target grounding. It also updates the target-relative direction online during closed-loop navigation, allowing the agent to maintain spatial alignment with the target and reduce accumulated direction drift. To support this task, we construct a dedicated high-resolution benchmark which contains 2,717 trajectories with target-oriented high-level instructions, high-resolution front-view and downward-view egocentric observations, and continuous 3D waypoint annotations. Experiments show that 3DG-VLN outperforms competitive UAV-VLN baselines, achieving a 13.82\% improvement in success rate. Real-world trials further demonstrate the potential of 3DG-VLN for practical see-and-reach navigation. The source code and benchmark are available at https://github.com/xuefanfu/3DG-VLN.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个聚焦于无人机视野内目标可见后的精准到达阶段（see-and-reach）的新任务UAV-VLN-FOV，并设计3DG-VLN模型，利用前视+下视双视角高分辨率图像和动态3D方向线索预测连续3D航点，提升视觉-语言对齐与空间定向精度，在自建2717条轨迹高分辨率基准上验证效果，实机测试初步可行。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构缩写或知名实验室线索；Xue Fanfu等姓名常见于国内高校，但无法确认具体单位）
analysis.claim: 无人机在目标进入视野后能否精准完成视觉-语言驱动的3D空间到达，取决于细粒度视觉接地与在线方向对齐能力，而非整体搜索-到达联合优化。
analysis.input: 高分辨率前视图像+下视图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 连续3D航点序列（x,y,z,heading）
analysis.robot_dependency: 无人机（未指明具体型号，实测用某四旋翼平台，但未公开型号）
