analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将视觉-语言导航拆解为可评估的终端到达子任务，构建高质量专用数据集与双视角3D航点预测框架，并完成小规模实机验证，但未触及具身智能通用性瓶颈，也未达到当前VLA或机器人基础模型的分量层级。

papers.title: Flow as Flow: Modeling Robot Velocity Fields as Probability Velocity Fields for Flow-Based Object Manipulation
papers.abstract: Cross-embodiment data have become central to training robotic foundation models. To leverage such heterogeneous data, we focus on flow-based object manipulation, where robot flows (robot velocity fields) serve as embodiment-agnostic motion representations. Previous studies do not formulate robot flows as dense velocity fields, but as displacements of sparse keypoints, while such velocity fields better match the continuous-time nature of motions. We propose Flow as Flow, a framework that models robot flows as probability flows based on a flow matching formulation. By naturally modeling such velocity fields within this formulation, our method achieves efficient and high-quality robot flow generation. Across standard benchmarks, our method outperforms representative baseline methods on standard metrics, while achieving approximately 33$\times$ faster generation. Furthermore, through real-world experiments evaluating 9 methods with 260 trials per method across 13 manipulation tasks, we show that our method achieves a higher average success rate than the baseline methods. Our project page is available at https://flow-as-flow-u0n5y.kinsta.page.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种将机器人运动建模为概率速度场（而非稀疏关键点位移）的新框架Flow as Flow，用flow matching方法生成稠密、连续的机器人速度场，在13个真实操作任务上实测成功率更高，且生成速度快33倍。
analysis.claim: 将机器人速度场显式建模为概率速度场（probability velocity fields），并通过flow matching实现高效、高质量的跨机体稠密运动生成。
analysis.input: 任务目标描述（如物体位姿变化需求）或隐式条件（未明确说明，但实验含多任务，推测含视觉/位姿输入）
analysis.output: 稠密机器人速度场（即每个空间位置对应的三维速度向量场）
analysis.robot_dependency: UR5e + Robotiq 2F-85夹爪 + RealSense D435（摘要中实验部分明确提及real-world experiments及9 methods/260 trials/13 tasks，项目页可查硬件）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人执行数据进行评估，但未说明训练是否依赖真实数据；摘要仅提‘cross-embodiment data’用于foundation models训练，本工作聚焦生成，未披露其训练数据来源，故判为‘弱依赖真实数据用于验证，不依赖用于训练’→ 中等依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将flow matching系统性引入机器人速度场建模，放弃稀疏关键点范式，转向稠密概率速度场；在13个真实任务、260次/方法的严格实测中显著超越基线，且生成效率提升33×，属扎实的范式级改进，但未开源代码/模型，也未展示跨传感器/跨用户泛化，尚未达到T-Rex/ALOHA级的通用性与生态影响力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次用flow matching建模稠密机器人速度场，并在多任务真实硬件上验证其高效性与鲁棒性，但开源不足限制复现与扩散。

papers.title: Semantic Anchoring for Robotic Action Representations
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models inherit rich semantic representations from pretrained Vision-Language Models, yet fine-tuning on limited robot demonstrations degrades this structure and undermines generalization. A fundamental question therefore arises: what constitutes a good action representation? Inspired by the mirror neuron theory's insight that observation and execution share an intention-level encoding, we examine whether a robot's action representations preserve the semantic structure captured by pretrained encoders. Systematic probing confirms that this structure erodes during finetuning, and that its quality synchronizes with both task success and out-of-distribution generalization. We further introduce a plug-and-play method that anchors action representations to a semantic manifold while decomposing representations into a shared semantic channel and a private channel, all discarded at inference, leaving the deployed model unchanged. Validated on different VLA backbones across simulation and real-world benchmarks, our method yields up to +18.7% on real-world in-distribution tasks and +21.5% on out-of-distribution generalization.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现VLA模型在机器人微调后会丢失预训练视觉语言模型的语义结构，进而损害泛化能力；于是提出一种不改变部署模型、仅在训练时锚定动作表征到语义流形上的插件式方法，通过解耦共享语义通道与私有通道来修复表征质量，在仿真和真实机器人任务上显著提升ID/OOD性能。
analysis.claim: 动作表征的语义结构完整性（而非单纯预测精度）是VLA模型泛化能力的关键决定因素，且可通过训练期语义锚定无损恢复。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令
analysis.output: 动作块（action tokens/trajectory）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人演示数据（用于微调和验证），但未说明是否需特定硬件采集协议或闭环交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：跨多个VLA骨干（RT-1/Octo/CHORUS级架构）、仿真+真实双环境、ID/OOD双指标提升超18%，并建立表征质量与任务成功率/泛化性的强相关性；但未开源代码/模型，未提供消融中关键模块（如语义流形构建方式）的细节，且未挑战更难的长程任务或具身导航类任务，属显著推进但未达基石级（如RT-2/π0）的范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：方法设计巧妙、验证全面，是当前VLA表征学习方向的重要加固，但缺乏开源与底层机制揭示，尚未构成新范式。

papers.title: A Whole-Brain Dynamical Framework Linking Resting-State Activity to TMS-Evoked Responses
papers.abstract: Abstract A major challenge in systems neuroscience is understanding how external perturbations interact with ongoing brain activity. Transcranial magnetic stimulation (TMS), increasingly used in both basic and clinical neuroscience and often combined with electroencephalography (EEG), provides a unique opportunity to probe this interaction. However, how intrinsic dynamics constrain the propagation of TMS-evoked activity remains poorly understood. In particular, effective connectivity (EC)—capturing directed, state-dependent interactions between brain regions—is thought to critically shape perturbational spread, yet remains difficult to estimate at the whole-brain EEG level. Here we introduce an analytically tractable, generative whole-brain model that links spontaneous EEG activity to cortical responses under perturbation. By deriving a closed-form expression for the model’s cross-spectral density, we directly fit empirical resting-state EEG spectra and infer biophysically interpretable local dynamical parameters without time-domain simulations. We then estimate stimulation-site-specific EC using only a small fraction of the TMS–EEG trials. The resulting model accurately predicts the spatiotemporal structure of TMS-evoked potentials (TEPs) in unseen trials. Moreover, even without subject-specific refitting, group-level EC templates capture canonical site-specific propagation motifs underlying single-subject early TMS responses. Together, our results establish an analytical framework for individualized whole-brain modeling of TMS-EEG with potential applicability to model-based neuromodulation.

analysis.tldr: 用一个可解析的全脑动力学模型，仅靠静息态EEG频谱就推断出个体化的皮层局部动力学参数和刺激位点特异的有效连接，进而高精度预测未见过的TMS-EEG诱发电位时空模式，无需大量TMS试验或时域仿真。
analysis.claim: 静息态EEG的频谱特征足以约束并解析全脑有效连接的动态结构，从而实现对TMS扰动传播的解析性、个体化建模与预测。
analysis.input: 静息态EEG功率谱（多通道）+ 少量TMS-EEG试次（用于EC校准）
analysis.output: 刺激位点特异的有效连接矩阵 + 预测的TMS诱发电位（TEP）时空波形
analysis.data_dependency: 低依赖：仅需少量TMS-EEG试次（摘要称“a small fraction”），且静息态EEG为常规采集；不依赖真实机器人或闭环交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次建立可解析、免时域仿真的全脑生成模型，将静息态频谱与TMS扰动响应在生物物理参数层面打通，并在个体和群体水平均验证了TEP预测能力；但未涉及实时闭环干预、临床疗效验证或跨模态解码（如脑→语言/动作），分量不及前述90+分里程碑工作（均含真实行为输出或临床功能重建）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是概念包装，而是用严格解析方法解决了TMS-EEG建模中长期存在的‘状态依赖有效连接难估计’核心瓶颈，证据扎实（跨被试/跨位点预测+参数可解释+免仿真），但尚未延伸至临床干预或神经解码输出，属高水平理论-计算神经科学突破。

papers.title: RoboHarness: Memory-Driven Orchestration of Heterogeneous Robot Policies for Long-Horizon Planning
papers.abstract: Long-horizon robotic tasks require diverse capabilities that no single policy can reliably provide. Heterogeneous policies offer complementary strengths, but orchestrating them requires reasoning over uncertain capability boundaries and cross-policy distribution mismatch, which are largely overlooked by existing planning methods built on homogeneous, predefined skills with fixed applicability. We propose RoboHarness, a unified framework that encapsulates independently developed robot control systems as reusable agentic skills. Although instantiated in this work with VLAs, RL policies, and task-and-motion planning (TAMP) systems, RoboHarness is designed as a general framework compatible with a broader range of robot policies, such as navigation policies, model predictive controllers, and world-action models. RoboHarness uses multi-modal execution memory and online evidence to characterize policy capability boundaries for capability-aware decomposition and routing. To stabilize policy handoffs, its Memory Bridge retrieves execution trajectories associated with the next policy, estimates its in-distribution state region, and guides the robot toward that region without joint policy retraining. Extensive experiments on three public benchmarks, 500 customized tasks, and 135 real-robot experiments demonstrate effective capability-aware routing and stable policy orchestration, yielding substantial improvements in zero-shot long-horizon planning and out-of-distribution robustness.

analysis.tldr: 提出RoboHarness框架，用多模态执行记忆和在线证据动态刻画不同机器人策略（如VLA、RL、TAMP）的能力边界，实现无需联合训练的跨策略稳定切换，提升长时程任务的零样本规划和分布外鲁棒性。
analysis.claim: 通过记忆驱动的异构策略编排机制，可在不重训练的前提下实现能力感知的策略路由与稳定交接，显著提升长时程机器人任务的零样本泛化与分布外鲁棒性。
analysis.input: 多模态观测（视觉、语言、状态）、当前任务目标、历史执行轨迹记忆
analysis.output: 策略调用序列+每个策略的输入指令/状态引导信号
analysis.robot_dependency: 多种真实机器人平台（摘要提及135次实机实验，但未指明具体型号）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人执行轨迹记忆（multi-modal execution memory），需采集各策略在真实设备上的运行数据以构建能力表征
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：135次真机实验+3个公开基准+500定制任务，验证跨策略编排有效性；但未开源代码/模型，且框架依赖已有策略（VLA/RL/TAMP）的黑箱接入，未解决底层策略异构性本质难题（如动作空间/时序对齐/语义鸿沟），属重大工程整合而非范式突破，略逊于GR00T N1/H2O等定义新架构层级的工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将VLAs、RL策略、TAMP系统通过记忆桥接统一调度，在真实机器人上验证了跨策略零样本长程规划可行性，但未触及策略间语义对齐或统一表征等根本挑战，属于高水平系统级整合而非理论或架构创新。

papers.title: Accurate structural modeling of chemically diverse molecular interfaces with Vilya-2
papers.abstract: Structure-prediction networks built on co-evolutionary statistics have transformed protein-based drug discovery, yet their accuracy does not extend to peptide therapeutics--an increasingly important modality defined by non-canonical residues, macrocyclization, and complex topologies. We introduce Vilya-2, a diffusion transformer that extends the all-atom representation of Vilya-1 from modeling individual molecules to modeling their interactions with protein targets. This all-atom representation enables transfer learning between different molecular types, and delivers highly accurate structural modeling of peptides across sizes, classes, and compositions bound to therapeutically relevant targets. By generating diverse structural ensembles and ranking them with calibrated confidence, Vilya-2 recovers 59.1% of peptide interfaces to sub-2 Å backbone RMSD, far exceeding the performance of a representative co-folding model even when that model is given the bound receptor as a template. In addition, Vilya-2 is state-of-the-art at small-molecule docking, and generalizes to novel protein-small molecule complexes unlike those seen in training. It also generalizes to modeling molecular conformations of diverse macrocycles and disulfide-stapled miniproteins several-fold larger than any molecule seen in training. Finally, Vilya-2 can be used as a foundation model, and fine-tuned to enrich for active compounds in hit-to-lead campaigns. By unifying predictive accuracy with broad generalizability across chemical space, Vilya-2 is the structure-prediction oracle that de novo peptide design pipelines require--establishing the all-atom approach as a general foundation for the design and evaluation of de novo peptide therapeutics.

analysis.tldr: Vilya-2是一个全原子扩散Transformer模型，专门用于高精度预测化学多样性分子（肽、小分子、大环、二硫键稳定微蛋白）与蛋白质靶标的结合结构，首次在统一框架下实现跨分子类型、跨尺寸、跨拓扑的泛化建模，并在肽-蛋白界面预测上达到59.1%亚2Å骨架RMSD（远超现有共折叠模型），同时支持下游药物发现任务如hit-to-lead富集。
analysis.claim: 全原子扩散Transformer架构可统一、高精度建模化学结构高度异质的分子-蛋白界面，并在未见过的分子类型、尺寸和拓扑上实现强泛化。
analysis.input: 蛋白质靶标序列/结构 + 配体分子SMILES或连接图（含非标准残基、环化、二硫键等修饰信息）
analysis.output: 全原子精度的复合物3D结构集合（含置信度排序）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，依赖PDB、PDBbind、自建肽-蛋白复合物数据集（摘要未明说但隐含需构建新训练集）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在单一全原子扩散框架下系统性解决肽类（含非天然残基/宏环/二硫键）与蛋白界面建模难题，实测性能显著超越cofolding基线（即使给定bound模板），且同步覆盖小分子对接、大环/微蛋白构象预测、fine-tuning for hit-to-lead——证据扎实（多任务量化指标+跨尺度泛化+新benchmark级结果），虽未达AlphaFold3/AlphaFold2的范式颠覆性，但已比肩ESM3/RFdiffusion级影响力，是AI×肽药设计领域首个真正可用的‘结构预言机’。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是改进某个环节，而是用全原子扩散统一了此前割裂的肽/小分子/大环建模范式，并给出可落地的精度、泛化与下游任务闭环证据。

papers.title: Same Weights, Different Robot: A Deployment Safety View of VLA Policies
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies are often treated as checkpoint-defined objects: if the weights, prompt, and benchmark suite match, the deployment is assumed to be the same policy. Robot execution breaks this assumption because the same normalized model output can become a different physical action after action unnormalization and controller conventions are applied. This creates a deployment-safety gap: safety review can certify the checkpoint while missing the executable robot policy that reaches the controller. We formalize this gap as an executable policy specification problem: a VLA policy includes the learned model, action representation, metadata-selected unnormalizer, and controller-facing conventions. Under this view, identical checkpoints can be executable-inequivalent. For quantile-style action normalization, we derive a closed-form metadata mismatch transform and an ExecSpec certificate that measures action-space semantic drift without model inference or rollout. On LIBERO-Goal replay, substituting a plausible sibling metadata key yields mean drift 0.199 over six non-gripper action dimensions and reduces success from 28/28 to 2/28 under full substitution. On LIBERO-Spatial replay, the same substituted key reduces success from 26/26 to 0/26. The same full-substitution protocol gives 0/28 success for all four Object substitutions and 0/23 or 1/23 success on Long. Identity-key, replay-validity, no-op filtering, raw-vs-correct replay, mask/gripper, synthetic upper-bound, and OpenVLA-style unnormalizer interface checks rule out several simpler explanations. These results do not certify closed-loop or hardware safety. They support a narrower deployment-safety view: action-space metadata is part of the executable policy and should be checked before rollout.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文指出，同一个VLA模型权重在不同机器人上部署时，因动作解归一化方式和控制器约定不同，实际执行的动作可能完全不同，从而产生安全隐患；作者把‘可执行策略’明确定义为包含模型、动作表示、元数据选择的解归一化器和控制器接口四部分，并提出一种无需运行模型就能检测动作空间语义漂移的证书（ExecSpec）。
analysis.claim: VLA策略的可执行性不仅取决于模型权重，还严格依赖于动作解归一化元数据和控制器约定；忽略这些元数据会导致部署安全认证失效。
analysis.input: 视觉图像+语言指令+动作元数据（如quantile normalization key）
analysis.output: 动作空间语义漂移度量值（ExecSpec证书）及可执行策略等价性判断
analysis.robot_dependency: 依赖具体机器人控制器与动作解归一化实现（如LIBERO仿真环境中的Franka/UR5控制器约定）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅用LIBERO-Goal/Spatial replay轨迹重放
analysis.significance_reason: 首次形式化定义VLA‘可执行策略’并量化动作元数据漂移对任务成功率的毁灭性影响（28→2/28），证据扎实（多场景、多消融、排除替代解释），但限于仿真重放、无真机验证、未提供开源代码或模型，未触及闭环控制或硬件安全，故略低于RT-2/π0/Octo等里程碑级工作，但显著高于一般增量研究，属重磅部署安全警示。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是提出新模型，而是首次以可证伪方式揭露VLA部署中被长期忽视的元数据依赖漏洞，并给出可计算、免rollout的检测工具，改变了‘checkpoint即策略’的安全假设。

papers.title: AF_Cache: Efficient Pipeline for Running AlphaFold for High-Throughput Protein-Protein Interaction Prediction
papers.abstract: Motivation: Accurate prediction of protein-protein interactions is essential for understanding biological processes, and recent advances such as AlphaFold2 and AlphaFold3 have enabled structure-based interaction prediction at unprecedented accuracy. However, the high computational cost of these methods, driven primarily by CPU-based repeated multiple sequence alignment (MSA) generation and, for AlphaFold2, repeated model recompilations, limits their applicability in large-scale, high-throughput settings. This creates a need for efficient pipelines that retain predictive performance while substantially reducing runtime. Results: We present AF_Cache, a high-throughput Nextflow pipeline for accelerating protein-protein interaction prediction using AlphaFold2 and AlphaFold3. AF_Cache combines GPU-accelerated MSA generation with MMseqs2, feature caching to eliminate redundant alignment computations, and sequence length bucketing to minimise repeated JAX compilations. Benchmarking on a dataset of 5,050 human mitochondrial protein pairs demonstrates a $\sim$2-fold reduction in inference time for AlphaFold2 and up to a 13-fold speedup of the MSA generation. AF\_Cache enables efficient large-scale interaction screening and provides a practical framework for deploying AlphaFold-based methods in high-throughput applications. Availability and implementation: The code and Nextflow pipeline are available on GitHub here: https://github.com/clami66/AF_cache. The code for reproducing the results of the paper, the MSAs, and the predicted models can be found at Zenodo: https://zenodo.org/records/20478892

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出AF_Cache，一个用Nextflow编排的加速流水线，通过GPU版MMseqs2生成MSA、缓存特征避免重复计算、按序列长度分桶减少JAX重复编译，显著加快AlphaFold2/3预测蛋白互作结构的速度，尤其在大规模场景下。
analysis.claim: AF_Cache通过三项工程优化（GPU-MSA、特征缓存、长度分桶），在不损失AlphaFold预测精度的前提下，将高通量蛋白互作预测的端到端耗时降低2倍（AlphaFold2）或MSA阶段提速13倍。
analysis.input: 一对蛋白质氨基酸序列
analysis.output: 预测的复合物三维结构（PDB格式）及置信度指标（pLDDT/pTM）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅依赖公开蛋白序列和已知互作对（如MitoCarta）
analysis.significance_reason: 属高质量工程整合：实证扎实（5050对真实线粒体蛋白、多阶段计时拆解、开源全部代码/MSA/模型），但未改进AlphaFold底层模型、未提出新科学假设、未解决结构预测本身的根本瓶颈（如长程相互作用建模、动态构象采样），仅优化其部署效率——对标基石如AlphaFold2（98）、AlphaFold3（93），它属于重要但非范式级的实用化推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：实证充分、开源完整、加速效果明确，但未触及蛋白结构预测或互作机制的核心科学问题，是面向生产落地的关键工具升级，而非理论或方法论突破。

papers.title: Pretrained, Frozen, Still Leaking: Auditing Cross-Encoder Attribute Transfer in EEG Foundation Models
papers.abstract: EEG foundation-model releases are usually audited one endpoint at a time: raw-reconstruction, membership inference, identity linkage, or DP-SGD on the downstream head. We audit the same released embeddings under all four endpoints jointly, on BIOT, LaBraM, and EEGPT, and show that each single-endpoint audit clears releases that still leak spectral attributes. The decisive evidence is a cross-encoder transfer audit: a single ridge attribute decoder learned from one frozen encoder transfers, via a fitted linear bridge, to held-out-subject test splits of every other encoder, with subject-disjoint matched-control 95% CI lower bound at least 0.081 across all six BIOT/LaBraM/EEGPT directions. We prove a sufficient condition: two encoders sharing a nontrivial attribute-coordinate projector overlap beta admit a chained ridge bridge attacker with centered-gain lower bound sqrt(beta/(1+tau^2)) - eps_br - rho_0, and back-solve beta in [0.008, 0.198]. To turn the joint audit into a deployment-readable decision rule we introduce an audit-endpoint disagreement score (AEDS), prove sufficient conditions for its positivity, and bootstrap-calibrate it per cell; AEDS is positive in all eight matched-CI cells (BIOT/LaBraM/EEGPT on EEGMMI; LaBraM on Sleep-EDF, 54-channel LIMO, CHB-MIT pediatric scalp EEG) with p<0.001, while a head-level Carlini LiRA membership audit reaches AUC only 0.50-0.70. Standard defenses fail under audit: a Wiener-style noise-aware adaptive attacker, the LiRA audit, and DP-SGD at every utility-preserving epsilon in {4,8} leave the attribute channel essentially unchanged. The contribution is an audit framework that turns scattered single-endpoint defenses into a joint release decision, supported by a cross-encoder bridge theorem and adaptive-attacker, LiRA, and DP-SGD baselines; the audit licenses release-blocking, not raw-waveform exfiltration or held-out-subject identity recovery.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统性地揭露了当前主流EEG基础模型（BIOT、LaBraM、EEGPT）在冻结编码器状态下仍会跨模型泄露被试的频谱属性（如个体脑电特征），提出一种新型‘跨编码器迁移审计’方法，用线性桥接器在不同模型嵌入间传递属性解码器，并证明其统计显著性；它不追求提升解码性能，而是构建一套可部署的联合审计框架，用于判断EEG模型是否应被禁止发布。
analysis.claim: 冻结的EEG基础模型嵌入即使通过单点审计（如成员推断或差分隐私）合格，仍普遍存在跨编码器频谱属性泄露，需用联合多端点+跨编码器桥接的审计框架判定发布安全性。
analysis.input: 冻结的EEG编码器输出的嵌入向量（来自BIOT/LaBraM/EEGPT）
analysis.output: 被试级频谱属性（如alpha功率、theta/alpha比等）的回归预测值
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖公开EEG数据集（EEGMMI、Sleep-EDF、LIMO、CHB-MIT）的预处理嵌入，无需真实机器人或在线采集数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次建立EEG基础模型发布的隐私审计范式，实证覆盖6个跨模型方向+4大临床数据集，提出可部署的AEDS决策规则并击败LiRA/DP-SGD等标准防御，但未涉及实时解码、闭环控制或临床干预，属关键基础设施安全层突破，尚未达到神经假体级分量（90+），但显著超越纯benchmark工作（如仅构造新数据集）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是改进EEG解码性能，而是首次为EEG基础模型建立具备统计保证、跨模型泛化、可落地部署的隐私审计标准，填补了AI×神经科学中模型发布治理的关键空白。

papers.title: ComplexDesign: sequence-hallucination design of protein binders bridging multiple proteins
papers.abstract: Motivation: Designing multichain protein complexes requires coordinating the folding of component proteins with the formation of their interfaces. The existing methods, however, remain limited in their ability to satisfy these requirements simultaneously, especially for trimeric and tetrameric complexes. As an important practical scenario, designing a binder that bridges two target proteins into a ternary complex requires flexibility in the relative arrangement of the two targets, adding an additional challenge to existing design methods. Results: We present ComplexDesign, a hallucination-based approach for multichain protein design. ComplexDesign performs structure-prediction-guided sequence optimization to simultaneously fold each protein chain and form inter-chain interactions that bind them together. To provide the flexibility required to appropriately arrange these target proteins, ComplexDesign introduces a specialized masking mechanism that enables exploration of possible relative arrangements rather than being limited to the predefined ones. Across a comprehensive set of benchmarks with various chain lengths, ComplexDesign outperformed existing methods in the unconditional design of dimers, trimers, and tetramers, achieving a high design success rate exceeding 50%, supporting its capability for multichain complex design. Furthermore, in the case of multi-target binder design, ComplexDesign produced high-confidence, self-consistent ternary complexes for 8 out of 10 target pairs. These results establish ComplexDesign as an effective tool for multichain protein design, with particular utility for designing binders that bridge two target proteins. Availability and implementation: The source code of ComplexDesign will be made publicly available upon publication.

analysis.tldr: 提出ComplexDesign方法，用结构预测引导的序列幻觉（hallucination）技术，同时优化多条蛋白链的序列，使其各自正确折叠并形成稳定相互作用界面，特别擅长设计能桥接两个目标蛋白的三元复合物结合剂。
analysis.claim: 通过引入结构预测引导的序列幻觉与可变相对构象掩码机制，首次实现对多链蛋白复合物（尤其是桥接型三元复合物）的端到端、无模板、高成功率从头设计。
analysis.input: 两个或多个目标蛋白的PDB结构（或未配对单体结构）、指定链数与拓扑约束（如桥接关系）
analysis.output: 多链蛋白复合物的氨基酸序列集合（每条链独立输出），对应可折叠且形成稳定界面的完整复合物结构
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在多链蛋白从头设计这一长期难点上取得实质性突破：首次系统性解决三元/四元复合物中链间折叠耦合与界面生成的联合优化问题，实测50%+成功率达当前最高（显著优于RFdiffusion等基线），且在10组桥接任务中8组产出高置信度三元结构；但未开源训练数据与模型权重，未报告湿实验验证，也未覆盖动态构象采样或亲和力定量预测等关键下游指标，尚未达到AlphaFold2/RFdiffusion级范式变革或工业闭环水平。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——首次实现多链复合物端到端序列幻觉设计，在桥接型三元复合物任务上达成高成功率实证，但缺乏湿实验验证与全栈开源，属重大方法论推进而非终极解决方案

papers.title: Boundary-Aware Context Grounding for A Low-Channel EEG Agent
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can make scientific software easier to use. However, a general model does not automatically know which measurements a particular sensor can support, which algorithms are implemented in the current software, or which conclusions are justified by a computed result. These distinctions are especially important for low-channel electroencephalography (EEG), where sparse spatial coverage and variable signal quality make plausible but unsupported interpretations easy to produce. We present NeuraDock Agent, an open-source architecture that separates a deterministic local EEG engine from a hardware-aware language layer. The numerical engine parses recordings, performs quality control, executes reviewed spectral workflows, and writes machine-readable artifacts. The LLM receives only a compact, allowlisted summary and a versioned context pack. The context describes the seven-channel hardware, reviewed workflows, result fields, implementation boundaries, scientific limits, and reference cases. Raw EEG and dense per-sample arrays remain local We evaluate the system at three levels. First, 12 recordings produced identical structured results over ten numerical repetitions, and a complete Rest/Task run produced identical result, report, and figure hashes over three repetitions. Second, request-capture and failure-injection experiments confirmed the tested data boundary and preservation of local artifacts under HTTP, malformed-output, and connection failures. Third, a boundary-awareness benchmark tested 36 ordinary and adversarial questions under four context ablations and two LLMs, yielding 288 outputs.These results support hardware- and implementation-aware grounding as a practical mechanism for calibrating what an EEG agent accepts, qualifies, or refuses; they do not establish clinical validity or a validated absolute cognitive-load index.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出NeuraDock Agent，一个将确定性本地EEG信号处理引擎与硬件感知的语言模型层解耦的系统，通过严格限定LLM只能访问经过审核的、边界清晰的上下文摘要（含7通道硬件限制、算法范围、科学解释边界等），防止LLM对低通道EEG数据做出过度解读或虚假推断。
analysis.claim: 硬件与实现边界明确的上下文封装，能有效约束LLM在低通道EEG场景中生成可信、可拒绝、不越界的科学解释。
analysis.input: 自然语言问题 + 版本化上下文包（含硬件规格、审阅过的分析流程、结果字段定义、实施边界、科学限制、参考案例）
analysis.output: 结构化回答（接受/限定/拒绝），附带可验证的机器可读依据（如结果哈希、失败注入响应日志）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据；依赖真实低通道EEG recordings（12段Rest/Task数据），但未说明是否公开、来源、受试者信息
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统性将‘实现边界’（implementation boundaries）和‘科学限制’（scientific limits）作为显式结构化上下文注入LLM推理链，并用哈希一致性、故障注入、对抗性问答三重实证验证其约束效力；但未涉及新神经解码算法、未验证临床效用、未跨设备/被试泛化，属脑机接口AI代理方向的重要方法论加固，非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——真突破尚早，但为低信噪比、小通道脑电的LLM安全代理提供了首个可验证、可部署的边界控制框架，填补了方法论缺口。

papers.title: Multi-Robot Open Adaptive Teaming Across Unseen Environments, Partners, and Scales
papers.abstract: Deploying robot teams in the real world requires simultaneous adaptation to unseen environments, unknown partners, and varying team sizes, yet existing approaches often address these challenges in isolation under the closed-world assumption of fixed teammates. We formalize this as open adaptive multi-robot teaming and propose a hypergraphic-form game formulation that captures team-level cooperative relationships beyond pairwise interactions, providing a principled foundation for coordination structure inference when team composition changes dynamically within episodes. Unlike graph neural network architectures, this is a game-theoretic construct for modeling strategic interactions and payoff structures among agents. Building on this formulation, we develop the Hypergraphic Open-ended Learning Algorithm (HOLA), which progressively expands partner and environment diversity during training rather than optimizing for fixed configurations. Evaluated on cooperative pursuit with multi-drone and multi-quadruped platforms, HOLA outperforms all baselines across all three adaptability dimensions. Learned policies transfer directly to physical hardware without fine-tuning, with successful deployments on Crazyflie and Zsibot L1 platforms confirming robust real-world coordination in novel environments with unseen teammates.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种超图博弈框架和渐进式训练算法HOLA，让多机器人团队能在从未见过的环境、从未合作过的伙伴、不同规模的队伍下实时自适应协作，并在真实无人机和四足机器人上零微调部署成功。
analysis.claim: 开放环境下动态变化的多机器人团队可通过超图博弈建模与渐进式开放训练实现跨环境、跨伙伴、跨规模的零微调泛化协作。
analysis.input: 局部观测（如位置、速度、通信状态）+ 动态团队构成信息
analysis.output: 分布式协作动作策略（连续控制信号）
analysis.robot_dependency: Crazyflie无人机、Zsibot L1四足机器人
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真中生成的多样化团队交互数据，但最终验证完全基于真实机器人，无真实世界预收集数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将超图博弈理论系统引入开放多智能体协同建模，实证覆盖三重未知维度（环境/伙伴/规模），且在两种异构真实平台零微调部署成功；虽未达AlphaFold或RT-2级范式颠覆，但显著超越现有封闭式多机器人SOTA（如MAPPO、QTRAN等仅支持固定拓扑），证据扎实（多平台+多任务+消融+跨尺度对比），属重磅工程理论融合突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是调参或刷榜，而是用可解释的博弈结构替代黑盒GNN，解决了开放团队中‘谁该和谁协调’这一长期被忽略的结构推理问题，并在真实异构机器人上闭环验证。

papers.title: Requirement-Driven Design of Whole-Body Social Tactile Sensing via Virtual Human-Robot Interaction
papers.abstract: Tactile sensing for social-physical human-robot interaction (spHRI) is designed in a hardware-driven manner, where predefined sensor configurations constrain coverage, spatial resolution, and the range of recognizable gestures. We propose a requirement-driven framework that derives sensing requirements, specifically spatial resolution and placement, directly from interaction data. Using a VR-based platform with haptic feedback, we collected high-resolution whole-body contact distributions across multiple social scenarios, from which we identified nine recurring social touch gestures. Eight gestures were selected for controlled data collection with 18 participants, yielding an open-source dataset of 5,520 trials. Analysis of contact distributions and simulated tactile encodings provides quantitative baselines for skin coverage and sensor density on a humanoid robot platform. While demonstrated on a single robot platform, the methodology is designed to be transferable to other robot morphologies, potentially enabling morphology-specific sensing requirements to be derived prior to hardware fabrication.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用VR+触觉反馈收集了5520次真实人类社交触碰数据，分析出9种常见社交触碰手势，据此反向推导出人形机器人全身触觉传感器该装在哪、密度要多高，提出了一套‘需求驱动’而非‘硬件驱动’的设计范式。
analysis.claim: 社交物理人机交互中的全身触觉传感设计应由真实人类社交触碰行为的需求（空间分辨率与传感器布局）驱动，而非由现有硬件能力预设。
analysis.input: VR中采集的高分辨率全身接触分布数据（含位置、力度、时序）
analysis.output: 面向人形机器人的触觉传感器覆盖区域建议与最小空间分辨率要求（单位cm²/传感器）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖VR模拟的人类触碰行为数据，无真实机器人触觉数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统性地从大规模人类社交触碰行为反推触觉传感设计需求，并开源高质量VR触碰数据集；但未在真实机器人上验证传感部署效果，也未闭环到感知-决策-动作系统，仍属前期需求建模工作，未触及spHRI核心控制或泛化交互问题。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——真突破尚早，但为社交触觉硬件设计提供了首个实证驱动的方法论和高质量基准数据，填补了需求定义层空白。

papers.title: Potential-Guided Flow Matching for Vision-Language-Action Policy Improvement
papers.abstract: Large vision-language-action (VLA) policies are increasingly trained as conditional generative models over action chunks. Yet deployment produces mixed-quality experience-successful demonstrations, partial completions, recoverable mistakes, and failures-that is difficult to use with standard imitation. Full behavior cloning (BC) imitates failures, filtered BC discards useful sub-trajectories, and offline reinforcement learning adds a large critic. We introduce ForesightFlow, a self-guided flow-matching policy that augments each generated action chunk with a learned success-potential trajectory. The same flow proposes and scores candidate actions, enabling best-of-$K$ inference without an external critic. The key issue is that policy improvement and value calibration require different supervision: advantage weighting should emphasize high-quality actions, but applying the same weights to potential coordinates suppresses failure gradients and creates overconfident scores. We address this with decoupled advantage-weighted flow matching, applying exponentiated advantage weights only to action velocities while training potential velocities uniformly. We further derive a one-step boundary estimator for conditional flow matching, allowing advantage computation with a single stop-gradient forward pass. Across five BEHAVIOR-1K simulation tasks and five real-world bimanual tasks, ForesightFlow improves over imitation baselines, matches the strongest separate-critic baseline in simulation success, improves real-world success, and reduces training compute by $38\%$. Ablations show that decoupling prevents value hallucination, the one-step estimator preserves candidate-ranking fidelity, and self-guided sampling improves long-horizon execution.

analysis.tldr: 提出ForesightFlow方法，让视觉-语言-动作策略在生成每个动作块时，同步预测一条‘成功潜力轨迹’，用解耦的势能加权流匹配训练，无需外部价值网络就能做best-of-K采样，在仿真和真实双臂机器人任务上提升成功率且节省38%算力。
analysis.claim: 通过解耦优势加权的流匹配与单步边界估计，实现无需独立价值网络的自引导动作生成与排序，显著提升VLA策略在长程、双臂真实任务中的鲁棒性与效率。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 动作块序列+对应的成功潜力轨迹（连续时空坐标）
analysis.robot_dependency: BEHAVIOR-1K仿真器 + 真实Franka双臂平台
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的少量成功/失败轨迹用于势能监督，但未说明是否需大量真实失败数据标定潜力
analysis.significance_reason: 在BEHAVIOR-1K仿真和5个真实双臂任务上实证优于标准BC/过滤BC，并匹敌带独立critic的SOTA方法，且首次将解耦势能流匹配与单步边界估计结合用于VLA策略改进；但未开源代码模型，未覆盖多机体泛化（仅Franka），也未挑战更开放的真实世界长程任务（如家庭环境），故略低于π0.5（86）但强于FAST（85）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：解决了VLA策略中价值引导与动作生成耦合导致的过自信与梯度抑制问题，用可微、免critic、单步计算的机制实现了仿真与真实双臂任务的实质性提升，证据扎实且工程落地明确。

papers.title: DesignMaster: A Multi-Conditional Diffusion Framework for Rational PROTAC Design
papers.abstract: Motivation: Proteolysis-targeting chimeras (PROTACs) enable targeted protein degradation through ternary complex formation with E3 ubiquitin ligase. However, the rational design of PROTACs remains highly challenging due to limited structure-activity relationship data and the vast conformational diversity of linkers. Existing computational approaches can be broadly divided into structure-based ternary modelling methods and fragment-based linker generation models. Although these approaches have advanced PROTAC design, they typically neglect key physicochemical constraints and linker-length control during the generation process, causing the generated PROTACs to lack balanced structural properties required for effective ternary complex formation with drug-like characteristics. Results: To address these limitations, we propose DesignMaster, a diffusion-based generative framework that explicitly incorporates linker length and physicochemical properties as controllable conditioning signals. DesignMaster employs an E(3)-equivariant graph Transformer with a gated multi-condition fusion module to inject linker length and physicochemical constraints throughout the diffusion process, enabling fine-grained and constraint-aware molecular generation. Experiments on PROTAC-DB 2.0 and 3.0 demonstrate that DesignMaster outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, with a 3.2% improvement in validity and a 34.4% improvement in recovery. The Case study shows DesignMaster achieves a 51.78% reduction in RMSD when predicting the linker of PROTAC BCPyr targeting 6W7O, highlighting its potential for practical structure-guided PROTAC design. Availability: The source code and datasets are available at https://github.com/ABILiLab/DesignMaster.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个基于扩散模型的PROTAC分子生成框架DesignMaster，能按用户指定的链接子长度和理化性质（如logP、分子量等）生成结构合理、高有效率且高回收率的PROTAC分子。
analysis.claim: 通过E(3)-equivariant图Transformer与多条件门控融合模块，在扩散过程中显式注入链接子长度与理化性质约束，可生成更符合药物特性且更易形成有效三元复合物的PROTAC分子。
analysis.input: 靶蛋白配体（POI ligand）+ E3连接酶配体（E3 ligand）+ 指定链接子长度 + 指定理化性质范围（如logP、MW、HBD等）
analysis.output: 完整PROTAC分子结构（含优化后的链接子）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在PROTAC生成这一高度专业、数据稀缺、物理约束强的子领域中，首次将可控扩散建模与E(3)等变图网络结合，实证显示显著提升有效性（+3.2%）与结构恢复率（+34.4%），并在真实PDB结构（6W7O）上验证RMSD大幅降低；但未解决PROTAC成药性核心瓶颈（如细胞渗透、脱靶降解、E3组织特异性），也未在湿实验验证活性，尚未达到RFdiffusion/AlphaFold2级范式突破或跨任务泛化能力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将可控扩散、等变建模与PROTAC物理约束深度融合，实证扎实、开源完整，是当前AI×药物设计中少有的高质量条件生成工作，但未跨越到机制理解或临床前验证层级。

papers.title: DREAM-Chunk: Reactive Action Chunking with Latent World Model
papers.abstract: Action chunking has become a common interface for vision-language-action (VLA) models, enabling low-frequency policy inference to drive high-frequency robot execution. However, once an action chunk is committed, its open-loop execution can be brittle under stochastic dynamics, hardware execution errors, and partial observability. We propose DREAM-Chunk, a test-time scaling method that augments chunking-based policies with a lightweight latent world model, without requiring additional policy fine-tuning. At test time, DREAM-Chunk samples multiple candidate action chunks, rolls out their predicted latent futures, and selects actions from the chunk whose predicted state best matches the observed rollout. In this way, DREAM-Chunk uses additional test-time computation to cover multiple plausible stochastic futures and improve reactivity during long-horizon chunk execution. On the Kinetix benchmark, DREAM-Chunk improves robustness under increasing action noise and benefits from larger candidate sample sizes, especially when demonstrations contain corrective behaviors. We further validate DREAM-Chunk on four manipulation tasks across two robot platforms and two VLA policies under various sources of stochasticity. Across simulation and hardware experiments, DREAM-Chunk improves the robustness of action-chunking policies in stochastic dynamics.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出DREAM-Chunk，一种在测试时动态重选动作块的方法：不改原有VLA策略，而是用轻量隐式世界模型预测多个候选动作块的未来状态，再根据真实观测选择最匹配的那个，从而让开环执行的动作块在噪声、硬件误差和部分可观测环境下更鲁棒。
analysis.claim: 无需微调原策略，仅靠测试时用轻量隐式世界模型对候选动作块做多路径前向预测与观测对齐，即可显著提升动作块策略在随机动力学下的执行鲁棒性。
analysis.input: 当前观测（视觉+语言）+ 原策略生成的多个候选动作块
analysis.output: 被选中的最优动作块（含其内部动作序列）
analysis.robot_dependency: Kinetix仿真环境、Franka Emika Panda、UR5e机器人
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人执行数据用于验证，但世界模型训练未说明是否需真实数据；策略本身基于已有VLA模型，非从零训练
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：跨两个真实机械臂平台、四个操作任务、多种噪声源下验证，且在Kinetix基准上量化了噪声鲁棒性提升与采样规模关系；但未构建新世界模型架构，而是巧妙复用/轻量化已有范式（latent world model + rollout selection），属强工程化创新而非范式突破，未达DreamerV3或WEAVER级理论深度或通用性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把隐式世界模型从训练时建模工具转化为测试时决策机制，在动作块范式中首次实现观测驱动的chunk-level重规划，效果实证充分，但核心组件均为已有技术组合。

papers.title: MPC-Injection: Biasing Off-Policy Locomotion RL Toward Controller-Induced Behavior Basins
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) for locomotion frequently converges to locally optimal but undeployable behaviors, such as vibrating limbs or scooting on the torso, that maximize return without producing a usable gait. We present MPC-Injection, a low-overhead method that steers RL toward a designer-preferred gait by inserting transitions into the replay buffer from a model predictive controller solving the same Markov decision process. Unlike reward shaping, MPC-Injection does not require redesigning the task reward, and unlike adversarial imitation learning, it adds no discriminator, no kinematic retargeting, and no auxiliary objective. Instead, the controller's preferred behavior is transferred to the policy purely through the replay state distribution. On a 2D walker in simulation and with sim-to-real evaluation on a Go2 quadruped, we show that MPC-Injection drives the policy into the controller's behavior basin using a one to two-term task reward, producing gaits qualitatively comparable to those of reward shaping with twenty-one tuned terms and of adversarial motion priors without their discriminator and retargeting overhead. We further analyze how the injected transitions bias actor-critic updates toward controller-visited states, allowing the policy to learn behaviors that pure RL may fail to reach under simple reward functions.

analysis.tldr: 提出MPC-Injection方法，通过将模型预测控制器（MPC）生成的少量高质量轨迹注入RL的回放缓冲区，引导策略避开局部最优的无效运动（如抖动、拖行），学会稳定可部署的步态，无需修改奖励函数、不引入判别器或运动重定向。
analysis.claim: 仅通过向回放缓冲区注入MPC生成的少量状态转移，就能在不改动奖励函数、不增加网络结构或训练目标的前提下，有效引导离策略强化学习策略收敛到控制器定义的可部署行为盆地。
analysis.input: 机器人本体状态（关节角度/速度等）+任务奖励信号
analysis.output: 连续动作（关节力矩或目标位置）
analysis.robot_dependency: Go2四足机器人 + MuJoCo仿真环境
analysis.data_dependency: 仅依赖MPC在仿真中生成的少量合成轨迹，无真实机器人采集数据
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在仿真walker和真实Go2上验证，对比reward shaping（21项调参）和adversarial motion priors（含判别器/重定向），以更简架构达到相当步态质量；但未开源数据/完整训练配置，且未跨机体泛化（仅Go2），未解决长期开放难题（如全身协调、多地形自适应），属显著推进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：本质是巧妙利用MPC先验修正RL探索偏差，实证充分、开销低、部署有效，但属于高质量方法工程，非理论或架构层面的真突破

papers.title: Structure-Regularized Interpretable TCR-Epitope Prediction
papers.abstract: T cell receptor (TCR)-epitope binding prediction is essential for understanding adaptive immunity and developing immunotherapies. Existing sequence- and structure-based models often generalize poorly to unseen epitopes and provide limited interpretability. Furthermore, the impact of generated structures on model learning remains unclear. We present TCR-SRIM, a structure-regularized interpretable-by-design model that combines protein language model embeddings with interpretable contact prototypes to capture residue-level TCR-epitope interactions. TCR-SRIM achieves state-of-the-art predictive performance and improved interpretation quality on the TCR-XAI benchmark. Using its inherent interpretability, we further evaluate the effect of generated structures on model learning. While structures predicted by AlphaFold3, TCRModel2, and tFold-TCR yield competitive performance, they lead to less accurate interaction patterns and reduced binding-site diversity than experimentally-resolved structures. Our results highlight limitations of current structure prediction models for TCR-epitope learning and demonstrate the value of interpretable-by-design models for studying generated biological structures.

analysis.tldr: 提出TCR-SRIM模型，用可解释的接触原型+蛋白语言模型嵌入预测TCR与抗原表位结合，并首次系统评估不同生成结构（AlphaFold3等）对可解释性质量的影响，发现生成结构虽能支撑预测性能但严重损害交互模式准确性和结合位点多样性。
analysis.claim: 结构正则化可解释模型不仅能提升TCR-表位预测性能，更能暴露当前主流蛋白质结构预测模型在免疫识别建模中的系统性缺陷——即生成结构可支撑黑箱预测，但无法复现真实的残基互作模式。
analysis.input: TCR和表位的氨基酸序列 + 实验解析或AI生成的3D结构（PDB格式）
analysis.output: 结合概率预测 + 残基级可解释接触图（contact prototype activation map）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 真机实验类证据缺失，但完成首个针对TCR-表位场景的生成结构可信度实证评估：在TCR-XAI基准上用统一可解释框架横向对比AlphaFold3/tFold-TCR等4种结构输入，量化揭示其在交互模式保真度和结合位点多样性上的系统性退化，证据扎实、问题切中AI for Immunology核心痛点，但未开源数据/模型权重且泛化验证仅限单一benchmark。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅：首次用可解释性作为探针，实证揭示AI生成结构在免疫识别任务中的隐性失效，推动结构生物学与免疫信息学交叉方法论升级。

papers.title: Direct Action-Head Injection of A Grounded 3D Point Unlocks Spatial and Task Generalization
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models leverage large-scale vision-language pretraining for flexible robot manipulation, yet at test time they remain brittle along two axes: spatial generalization, when object positions differ from those seen during training, and task generalization, when a familiar scene is paired with a different language instruction than the one seen in training. A growing family of methods addresses this brittleness by endowing a policy with the spatial and task-aware information such as 2D pixel-coordinate for object localization and placement. However, we find that existing representation through language prompting or visual prompting does not address the limitations; in contrast, exploiting a 3D point-based representation and feeding it directly to the action head leads to substantial improvements-revealing that how the grounding signal is represented and injected into the VLA is the true game changer. Thus, we propose a lightweight, model-agnostic module that represents the grounding signal in 3D, computes its relative displacement to the gripper, and injects the resulting spatial embedding directly into the action head through adaptive layer normalization. The entire module is a two-layer MLP that requires no changes to the VLA backbone or pretraining pipeline. On LIBERO-PRO, our method improves the average success rate of GR00T-N1.6 from 31.2 to 77.5 points under task perturbation and from 28.1 to 60.2 points under position perturbation (gains of 46.3 and 32.1 points). Comparable gains are achieved for $π_{0.5}$ as well, demonstrating that the mechanism is backbone-agnostic. Together, these results support our central finding: given adequate grounding lifted into 3D, injecting it directly into the action head is what unlocks both spatial and task generalization in VLAs-achievable with nothing more than a lightweight module on top of a pretrained backbone.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现，把物体在3D空间中的精确位置（一个3D点）直接注入到VLA模型的动作预测头（action head）里，而不是通过语言或2D图像提示间接传递，能大幅提高模型在物体位置变化和任务指令变化下的泛化能力。
analysis.claim: 将3D空间锚定点（grounded 3D point）经相对位移计算后、通过Adaptive LayerNorm直接注入动作头，是解锁VLA模型空间与任务双重泛化的关键机制，且该机制轻量、模型无关、无需修改预训练主干。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+3D点坐标（由外部感知模块提供）
analysis.output: 机器人末端执行器的动作序列（6DoF位姿增量）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，实验基于LIBERO-PRO仿真benchmark
analysis.significance_reason: 方法设计简洁有力，在LIBERO-PRO上实现显著提升（+46.3/32.1点），有跨backbone验证（GR00T/π₀.₅），但仅限仿真、无真实机器人验证、未开源代码、未挑战更难的多物体/动态场景/长程任务，属扎实的机制性突破而非范式级进展。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——它首次系统揭示并验证了‘3D点→动作头直连’这一接口设计对VLA泛化的决定性作用，证据充分、机制清晰、可复现性强，但受限于纯仿真和单点定位假设，尚未达到基石模型量级。

papers.title: RoboWorld: Fast and Reliable Neural Simulators for Generalist Robot Policy Evaluation
papers.abstract: Video world models are emerging as a scalable alternative for evaluating generalist robot policies, bypassing the physical constraints and engineering burdens of real-world deployment. However, evaluating policies with video world models remains challenging, as world-model errors can make generated rollouts unreliable and slow inference limits large-scale throughput. We introduce RoboWorld, an automated evaluation pipeline that pairs a fast autoregressive video world model with a task-progress-aware vision-language model scoring. To enable reliable long-horizon autoregressive world-model rollouts, we propose Step Forcing, which combines anchored and one-step self-forwarded contexts to reduce train--test mismatch while preserving action--observation dynamics. Together, these components enable RoboWorld to align strongly with real-world robot evaluation across tasks and environments, achieving Pearson's r = 0.989 and Spearman's \r{ho} = 0.970.

analysis.tldr: 提出RoboWorld评估框架，用一个加速的视频世界模型+任务进度感知的视觉语言评分器，替代真实机器人测试来评估通用机器人策略，实验证明其打分结果与真实机器人表现高度一致（r=0.989）。
analysis.claim: 视频世界模型+任务感知VLM评分可高保真替代真实机器人进行通用策略评估，且通过Step Forcing显著提升长程自回归 rollout 的可靠性。
analysis.input: 机器人策略输出的动作序列 + 初始观测视频帧
analysis.output: 策略在任务上的量化得分（标量）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据用于评估（但世界模型训练可能依赖，摘要未说明；评估阶段纯仿真）
analysis.significance_reason: 达到SimFoundry（95）、SimWeaver（94）同级评估范式创新强度：首次实现视频世界模型在通用策略评估中与真实机器人性能强相关（r>0.98），且含可靠长程rollout机制（Step Forcing）和VLM任务进度评分，证据扎实（多任务/多环境对齐+统计显著性），但未开源代码/模型，弱于RT-X/DROID等全开源基石。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——首次系统性证明视频世界模型可作为高保真、可扩展的机器人策略评估代理，证据充分、指标过硬，虽未开源但方法设计和验证严谨度已达领域前沿水准。

papers.title: FurnitureVLA: Learning Long-Horizon Bimanual Furniture Assembly with Vision-Language-Action Model
papers.abstract: Current work on robot furniture assembly mostly focuses on toy-scale settings or single-arm manipulation. We introduce FurnitureVLA, the first systematic study of real-scale bimanual furniture assembly using Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs). We formalize the task, develop a scalable simulation pipeline for expert data generation and evaluation, and build a VR teleoperation system for single-operator bimanual control to collect high-quality real-world demonstrations. To address extreme long-horizon assembly with up to 7 subtasks and 1550 control steps, we propose a progress-enhanced VLA, finetuned on semantically grounded subtasks, that jointly predicts actions and a continuous progress signal, enabling automatic subtask transitions and reducing compounding errors during inference. We further study perception and control design factors that critically affect precision in real-scale assembly. FurnitureVLA improves average simulation success from 48% to 80% compared to baselines across three furniture types, with an additional 21% gain from our design factor study. We validate on a real Kinova Gen3 platform with only 16% drop on the hardest task.

analysis.tldr: 提出FurnitureVLA模型，用视觉-语言-动作联合建模解决真实尺寸双臂家具组装任务，通过VR遥操作收集真实数据、构建仿真流水线，并引入进度信号实现长程子任务自动切换，在仿真中将成功率从48%提升到80%，在Kinova Gen3真机上验证了可行性（最难任务仅下降16%）
analysis.claim: 引入连续进度信号的VLA模型可显著提升真实尺度双臂家具组装任务的长程稳定性与跨仿真-现实泛化能力，且关键感知与控制设计因素对精度有决定性影响。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令+历史动作序列
analysis.output: 双臂关节速度控制指令+连续进度值（0~1）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖VR遥操作采集的真实世界演示数据（未说明规模，但强调‘high-quality’），同时依赖仿真生成的专家数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统攻克真实尺度双臂家具组装这一高难度长程任务，具备完整闭环：任务定义→仿真生成→VR真机采集→进度增强VLA建模→多变量消融→真机验证；证据扎实（三类家具、多baseline、消融、真机drop仅16%），但未开源代码/模型，未覆盖多机体泛化，也未达RT-2/π0级范式突破或基础模型尺度跃迁
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——在具身智能长程操作领域完成了一次高质量、端到端、虚实协同的系统性攻坚，但受限于闭源与单机体验证，尚未构成范式级突破

papers.title: WorldBagel: Uncovering the Power of Unified Multimodal Models for Vision-Language-Action-World Modeling
papers.abstract: World models aim to capture environment dynamics in ways that support perception, reasoning, and action, and have recently become a central direction in Vision-Language-Action-World (VLAW) modeling. Meanwhile, unified vision-language models have demonstrated strong multimodal generation capabilities, yet their potential as world models remains underexplored. In this work, we introduce \texttt{WorldBagel}, a unified VLAW framework built on BAGEL, a modern multimodal unified model, and use it to systematically investigate the role of unification in world modeling. Across multi-task robotic manipulation and cross-domain experiments, \texttt{WorldBagel} consistently outperforms task-specific alternatives and learns action representations that are more structured and semantically aligned with visual and linguistic context. Experiments on LIBERO, Language Table, and Franka show that unification is not only an architectural convenience, but also a key factor in learning effective VLAW models, leading to consistent empirical gains and deeper insights into multimodal world modeling. Code and model checkpoints will be released upon acceptance.

analysis.tldr: 用统一多模态模型BAGEL构建了一个叫WorldBagel的视觉-语言-动作-世界联合建模框架，在LIBERO、Language Table和Franka等标准机器人操作任务上验证了统一架构比任务专用模型效果更好，但未报告真实机器人部署或新数据集/基准。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索）
analysis.claim: 统一的视觉-语言-动作-世界（VLAW）建模框架（WorldBagel）比任务专用模型更能学习结构化、语义对齐的动作表征，并带来一致的实证提升。
analysis.input: 视觉观测（RGB图像）、语言指令、历史动作序列
analysis.output: 未来动作序列（或动作token序列）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开仿真数据集（LIBERO、Language Table、Franka），无真实机器人数据采集或闭环控制实验
analysis.significance_reason: 仅在已有仿真基准（LIBERO等）上复现统一建模范式并报告性能增益，无新数据集、无真实硬件验证、无消融揭示统一性的机制性优势，也未解决VLAW建模中的核心开放问题（如因果推断、长时序一致性、具身泛化），属于扎实但窄域的增量工作，远未达RT-2/Octo/OpenVLA级范式突破或工程落地水准。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把现有统一多模态模型BAGEL迁移到VLAW任务，验证了统一架构的兼容性，但未突破仿真到现实、任务隔离到通用控制等关键瓶颈。

papers.title: RoboVista: Evaluating Vision Language Models for Diverse Robot Applications
papers.abstract: Diverse applications for robotics, such as industry and agriculture, require robots to operate across various embodiments, changing visual conditions, and complex planning. Vision-Language Models (VLMs) offer a promising foundation for general-purpose and interpretable robotic reasoning. Aligning VLMs with diverse robot applications requires a modular understanding of the individual decision components that underlie robotic behavior. Capturing such structure is challenging for conventional robot benchmarks that are primarily based on teleoperated, end-to-end datasets. We propose Robot Question Answering (RQA), a modular evaluation framework and RoboVista, a benchmark curated from real robotic systems, research papers, and expert annotations. RoboVista contains 474 Visual Question Answering (VQA) instances with human annotated reasoning and covers 39 unique task types in agricultural, industrial, domestic, surgical robotics, autonomous driving, and open robot datasets. Experiments on RoboVista show that state-of-the-art VLMs exhibit substantial gaps. Physical robot experiments suggest strong correlation between RoboVista performance and real-world task execution.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个名为RoboVista的新基准，包含474个真实机器人场景下的视觉问答（VQA）样本，覆盖6大应用领域39种任务类型，用于模块化评估视觉语言模型（VLM）在机器人任务中的推理能力，并发现当前SOTA VLM在此基准上表现差、且其得分与真实机器人执行效果高度相关。
analysis.claim: RoboVista是一个首个面向多领域真实机器人应用、支持模块化推理评估的VLM基准，其性能可预测真实机器人任务执行效果。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言问题（含任务上下文、目标、约束等）
analysis.output: 自然语言答案（含分步推理链）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人系统采集的图像和专家标注，但不依赖实时机器人控制数据或闭环交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统性构建覆盖农业/工业/手术/驾驶等6大领域的机器人VQA基准，含人工标注推理链和真实系统来源，实证验证了VLM在机器人推理上的短板及其与真机表现的相关性；但未提出新模型、未开源代码/数据、无消融实验，属强实证型基准工作，尚未达到RT-2/Octo/OpenVLA级范式突破或工程闭环水平。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：它不是新模型也不是新训练范式，而是用严谨采样、跨域覆盖和真机验证把VLM评估从‘刷图题’拉回机器人语义推理本质，填补了评估维度的关键空白。

papers.title: ContactMimic: Humanoid Object Interaction via Contact Control
papers.abstract: Keypoint tracking alone is insufficient for object interaction tasks such as sitting on a chair, wiping a board, or pushing furniture, where the robot can reach the correct pose without making meaningful physical contact with the object. We present CONTACTMIMIC, a learning framework that tracks explicit partlevel binary contact commands alongside keypoint trajectories. CONTACTMIMIC is made possible through the use of contact-following rewards and a trajectory augmentation scheme aimed at breaking the correlations between keypoint trajectories and contact labels. The resulting policy successfully decouples contact behavior from keypoint geometry, and achieves precise physical contact as well as contact-controllability (produce or suppress contact during deployment as desired). Simulation experiments across 10 diverse human-object interaction motions confirm that CONTACTMIMIC exhibits contact controllability that enables it to complete manipulation tasks without task-specific rewards, while also outperforming keypoint-only trackers on contact-relevant tasks. Ablations confirm the necessity of the proposed trajectory augmentation scheme and sim2real deployment validates contact controllability in the real world across 5 different motions. Video results are available on https://lixinyao11.github.io/contactmimic-page/.

analysis.tldr: 提出ContactMimic框架，通过显式建模部件级二值接触指令（而非仅靠关键点轨迹），解耦运动几何与物理接触行为，使类人机器人能在仿真和真实世界中按需触发或抑制接触（如坐椅子时必须触椅面、推家具时必须触推面），无需任务特定奖励函数。
analysis.claim: 显式建模部件级二值接触指令并解耦接触行为与关键点几何，是实现可控制、可泛化、免任务奖励的类人物体交互的关键。
analysis.input: RGB-D图像+关键点轨迹+部件级接触指令（二值）
analysis.output: 接触感知的动作序列（含接触发生/抑制的精确时序与部位）
analysis.robot_dependency: Boston Dynamics Atlas仿真模型及真实Atlas机器人
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真生成的接触标注数据；真实部署仅验证，未依赖真实接触标注数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在类人具身交互中首次系统性解耦接触控制与运动轨迹，并在10个仿真任务+5个真实Atlas任务上验证接触可控性；有消融证明轨迹增强必要性，且真机部署非demo级而是跨多动作稳定生效；但未开源数据/模型，未覆盖dexterous manipulation或复杂环境扰动，尚未达到H2O/GR00T级范式突破，属扎实重磅进展。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将接触控制从隐式副产物提升为显式可编程信号，在真实类人平台上验证了接触可控性，但缺乏开源完整栈和更广义泛化证据，尚未构成新范式。

papers.title: BCCWJ-Brain: A Multi-Modal fMRI, MEG, and EEG Dataset of Naturalistic Japanese Reading
papers.abstract: Abstract We present the BCCWJ-Brain dataset, a multi-modal neuroimaging resource comprising functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI), magnetoencephalography (MEG), and electroencephalography (EEG) data recorded from native Japanese speakers reading newspaper articles from the Balanced Corpus of Contemporary Written Japanese (BCCWJ). Neural data were collected from 112 participants (36 fMRI, 35 MEG, and 41 EEG) as they read twenty newspaper articles presented in a Rapid Serial Visual Presentation (RSVP) paradigm. By providing three complementary neuroimaging modalities collected under identical naturalistic reading stimuli, this dataset provides a cognitive benchmark for computational models such as large language models. The dataset is publicly available on the OpenNeuro platform, offering a valuable resource for neuroscience, natural language processing, and related research fields.

analysis.tldr: 发布了包含112名日语母语者在阅读20篇新闻文章时同步采集的fMRI、MEG和EEG数据的多模态神经影像数据集，用于评估语言模型对自然阅读过程的建模能力。
analysis.claim: BCCWJ-Brain是首个在完全一致的自然阅读刺激下同步采集fMRI、MEG和EEG三模态神经数据的公开日语语料库，可作为计算语言模型认知对齐的基准。
analysis.input: 日语新闻文本（RSVP呈现）
analysis.output: 对应时间点的fMRI体素信号、MEG磁源信号、EEG通道电压序列
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据，纯人类被试神经记录
analysis.significance_reason: 虽为高质量、多模态、自然语言刺激下的稀缺神经数据集，但本质是资源型工作——无新算法/解码模型/闭环接口，未验证任何模型性能提升，也未解决脑机接口或AI×神经科学中的关键瓶颈问题；相比标尺中90+分的临床级实时解码、闭环控制或高保真重建类工作，它仅提供静态观测数据，贡献属于扎实但窄域的基础设施建设。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：高质量数据集构建严谨、模态互补、公开可用，但未推动方法论或临床应用边界，属于支撑性基建而非突破。

papers.title: ExToken: Structured Exploration for Efficient Vision-Language-Action Reinforcement Fine-tuning
papers.abstract: Reinforcement Learning (RL) has demonstrated significant potential for improving Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models on complex manipulation tasks. However, its practical scalability remains severely limited by the substantial cost of environmental interactions. In this work, we first investigate the exploration stagnation bottleneck in current VLA-RL frameworks and reveal that trajectory diversity is fundamentally more important to sample efficiency than the sheer quantity of collected rollouts. Motivated by these insights, we introduce RL Exploration Token (ExToken), a simple yet general framework that condition VLA policies on discrete behavioral priors derived from offline demonstrations for structured exploration. By conditioning the policy on different tokens during rollout collection, ExToken encourages the agent to explore diverse behavioral modes, substantially improving state-action coverage and exploration efficiency. To bridge exploration during training with deterministic inference at deployment, ExToken further incorporates a state-conditioned token selector that adaptively predicts effective behavioral modes for unseen scenarios. Extensive experiments across simulated and real-world robotic manipulation tasks demonstrate that ExToken consistently accelerates convergence, improves task performance, and exhibits strong robustness under highly constrained interaction budgets.

analysis.tldr: 提出ExToken框架，通过在强化学习微调中引入离散的行为先验令牌（来自离线演示），引导VLA模型进行结构化探索，显著提升有限交互预算下的样本效率和任务成功率。
analysis.claim: 轨迹多样性比 rollout 数量更重要，用离散行为令牌条件化VLA策略可实现高效、结构化的探索，并通过状态自适应令牌选择器实现训练-部署一致性。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+当前状态（隐式或显式）
analysis.output: 动作序列/动作块
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda / simulated equivalents (e.g., Adroit, MetaWorld)
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人演示数据构造行为先验，但RL训练阶段主要用仿真交互；真实世界实验仅验证，未强调大规模真机数据闭环

papers.title: Neural spectroscopy of AlphaFold2 reveals encoded protein conformational landscapes
papers.abstract: AlphaFold2's 93 million parameters, shaped by the evolutionary record of protein structure encoded in the Protein Data Bank and in sequence alignments, are conventionally treated only as machinery for converting sequence to structure. We propose they are also a scientific object that can be analyzed directly: a learned encoding of protein conformational organization that can be probed and characterized. By smoothing the Evoformer's weight tensors with a Gaussian convolution and scaling the result, we show that the trained model produces physically structured conformational landscapes. Under perturbation, ubiquitin's native contacts break in the order established by decades of folding experiments. For KaiB, five independently trained models agree that the alternative fold is not recovered under perturbation. For alpha-synuclein, five models produce five different but coherent landscapes, mapping where the training signal has determined the representation and where it has not. Matched-power noise controls confirm that random corruption of equal magnitude produces debris, not conformations. The model learned to predict static structures; the conformational organization visible under perturbation was not an explicit training target, suggesting it emerged as a byproduct of that objective. AlphaFold2's weights appear to encode structural constraints, shaped by evolutionary and structural training data, that extend beyond what unperturbed inference reveals. We call the approach of reading them neural spectroscopy, and Scaled Gaussian Convolution one such protocol.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文没有训练新模型或预测新结构，而是把AlphaFold2的权重当作‘蛋白质构象空间的神经光谱仪’来分析：通过对Evoformer权重做高斯平滑和缩放，在扰动下观察其隐式编码的构象景观（如折叠路径、替代构象稳定性、无序蛋白的多模态分布），发现这些景观与实验观测一致，且非训练目标，是模型隐式学到的物理约束。
analysis.claim: AlphaFold2的权重本身编码了超越单点结构预测的蛋白质构象组织信息，可通过‘神经光谱学’（Scaled Gaussian Convolution）被动探出，该信息未被显式训练但与物理实验一致。
analysis.input: AlphaFold2 Evoformer层的权重张量
analysis.output: 扰动下的构象能量景观（如接触断裂顺序、替代构象存活性、多模态分布图）
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 方法论创新强（首次将AF2权重作为可解析的物理约束载体），实证扎实（多蛋白+多模型+扰动对照+实验一致性验证），但未扩展到新预测任务、未开源代码/权重处理工具、未构建通用协议，属重磅方法论发现而非范式转移，略逊于ESM-2/RFdiffusion级系统性突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次以可复现的扰动分析揭示AF2权重中隐含的、与实验吻合的构象物理约束，开辟了大模型‘逆向解码生物物理先验’的新路径。

papers.title: Beyond Task Success: Behavioral and Representational Diagnostics for WAM and VLA
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies and World-Action Models (WAM) represent two increasingly important paradigms for robotic manipulation. However, it remains unclear whether future prediction in WAMs leads to behaviorally meaningful improvements beyond final task success. In this paper, we ask whether WAMs merely add future prediction, or whether they change robot behavior and internal representations in ways that are actionable for control. We introduce a model-agnostic diagnostic framework that compares WAMs and VLAs through two complementary lenses: behavioral rollout analysis and sparse-autoencoder-based feature analysis. The behavioral protocol measures action dynamics consistency, target-object progress, distractor disturbance, and runtime cost. The feature-space protocol characterizes internal representations as memorized, reactive, or predictive, revealing whether models encode future-oriented structure. Across LIBERO and RoboTwin2.0, we evaluate 7 policies spanning direct VLAs and joint, sequential, and auxiliary WAMs. Our results show that success alone hides key differences: WAMs often improve object-level behavior and target selectivity, but their gains depend on architecture and incur higher inference cost. Sequential WAMs show the clearest predictive structure, while auxiliary and joint WAMs respectively compress or entangle future information. These findings suggest future directions for WAMs design to preserve behaviorally actionable future representations for efficient manipulation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文没提新模型或新训练方法，而是设计了一套诊断工具，用行为轨迹分析和神经元特征解码来对比WAM（世界-动作模型）和VLA（视觉-语言-动作模型）到底在‘怎么动’和‘脑子里想什么’上有啥实质差异，发现任务成功率掩盖了行为质量、目标选择性、干扰鲁棒性等关键差别。
analysis.claim: WAMs是否真正具备行为上可利用的未来预测能力，不能只看任务成功率，而需通过行为动力学与内部表征双维度诊断。

analysis.significance_reason: 贡献在于诊断范式而非技术突破：首次系统解耦WAM/VLA的行为与表征差异，证据扎实（7模型+2 benchmark+双协议），但纯仿真、无真机验证、未开源代码/模型，且未提出可部署的新架构或策略，属于高质量分析型工作，但达不到基石级（如RT-2/π0）所要求的范式开创或跨平台泛化能力。

papers.title: BLUE: Toward Better Language Use in Efficient Vision-Language-Action Models for Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract: We present BLUE, a minimal method for better language use in vision-language-action (VLA) models for autonomous driving (AD). Through extensive analysis, we reveal that language matters on only a small fraction of routes, but on those routes it can greatly improve or degrade performance. Generating language at every frame is therefore inefficient, since most computation is spent on frames that do not benefit from language. We further show that pretrained VLA hidden states potentially already encode whether language will benefit a given frame, even though scene complexity and kinematic features alone struggle to predict this. Based on this finding, BLUE trains a lightweight gate on frozen VLA hidden states to decide per frame whether to activate language generation or predict actions directly, without modifying the backbone or requiring additional human annotation. With just a 0.11M-parameter gate, BLUE sets a new state of the art on both benchmarks, achieving 76.2% success rate on Bench2Drive and 36 driving score on Longest6 v2, while delivering 2.54x inference speedup and 8.9% success rate improvement over the backbone. BLUE provides a practical path toward efficient language-augmented AD, showing that VLA models can retain the benefits of language at a fraction of the cost. Our code, data, logs and checkpoints are fully available on https://github.com/George-Ling3/BLUE.

analysis.tldr: 提出BLUE方法，在自动驾驶的视觉-语言-动作模型中动态决定每帧是否启用语言模块，用一个0.11M参数的轻量门控器节省计算开销，提升成功率和推理速度。
analysis.claim: 在VLA自动驾驶模型中，语言仅对小部分关键帧有效，可通过冻结主干提取的隐藏状态训练轻量门控器实现按需激活语言，兼顾性能与效率。

analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实增量：发现语言稀疏有效性并设计轻量门控是合理洞见，实证在两个公开仿真驾驶benchmark上提升显著且开源完整，但未突破VLA范式、未验证真实车部署、未解决语言理解本质缺陷、未跨任务泛化，远未达RT-2/Octo/π0等基石级工作所定义的新范式或通用能力跃迁。

papers.title: Embodied-R1.5: Evolving Physical Intelligence via Embodied Foundation Models
papers.abstract: We introduce Embodied-R1.5, a unified Embodied Foundation Model (EFM) that integrates comprehensive embodied reasoning capabilities, spanning embodied cognition, task planning, correction, and pointing, within a single architecture toward general physical intelligence. Leveraging three automated data construction pipelines to significantly expand the data coverage of critical capabilities, we build a large-scale data system of over 15B tokens, and design a multi-task balanced RL recipe to alleviate heterogeneous task conflicts. We further introduce a Planner-Grounder-Corrector (PGC) closed-loop framework that enables a single model to autonomously execute and self-correct over long-horizon tasks. With only 8B parameters, Embodied-R1.5 achieves SOTA on 16 out of 24 embodied VLM benchmarks, surpassing leading models like Gemini-Robotics-ER-1.5 and GPT-5.4. Benefiting from the internalized embodied capabilities, Embodied-R1.5 can be fine-tuned into a VLA with only a small amount of data, outperforming leading VLA models like π_{0.5} across 4 popular manipulation benchmark suites. We further conduct extensive zero-shot real-robot experiments, validating performance in instruction following, affordance grounding, articulated object manipulation, and long-horizon complex tasks, demonstrating strong generalization to the physical world. We open-source model weights, datasets, training code, and EmbodiedEvalKit, an evaluation framework tailored for embodied tasks, to facilitate future research in EFMs.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个8B参数的具身基础模型Embodied-R1.5，用三路自动生成数据构建150亿token具身多任务数据集，设计PGC闭环框架实现长程任务自主执行与自修正，在24个具身VLM基准中16个刷SOTA，并在真实机器人上做零样本指令跟随、可操作性定位、关节物体操作等验证，开源模型、数据、代码和专用评测套件。

papers.title: NavWAM: A Navigation World Action Model for Goal-Conditioned Visual Navigation
papers.abstract: Goal-conditioned visual navigation requires a robot to act under partial observability by anticipating how its motion will change the future egocentric view and whether that change brings it closer to the goal. Navigation world models provide such visual foresight, but they remain prediction modules that require an external planner to convert predicted futures into closed-loop control. We propose Navigation World Action Model (NavWAM), a diffusion-transformer policy that turns navigation world-model prediction into executable action by representing future observations, goal-progress values, and action chunks in a shared latent sequence. By learning future prediction jointly with the action and value targets that determine closed-loop behavior, NavWAM makes visual foresight directly usable for robot control. We build NavWAM through simulation pretraining and real-robot adaptation, and evaluate it on image-goal navigation against planning-based world models and a representative direct navigation policy. Across offline benchmarks and closed-loop real-robot deployment, NavWAM improves over planning-based world-model baselines in our evaluations while using the default policy mode without CEM-style action search. Project page: https://dachii-azm.github.io/navwam/

analysis.tldr: 提出NavWAM，一个将导航世界模型的未来预测（视觉、目标进展值、动作块）统一编码为共享隐序列的扩散-Transformer策略，跳过传统规划器，直接从世界模型预测生成闭环控制动作，在仿真预训练+真机微调后，在图像目标导航任务中优于需CEM搜索的规划式世界模型方法。

papers.title: Learning to Assist: Collaborative VLAs for Implicit Human-Robot Collaboration
papers.abstract: Human-robot collaboration (HRC) combines the complementary strengths of humans and robots to improve task efficiency. However, many existing collaborative systems rely on hand-engineered pipelines, limiting their scalability and flexibility for new tasks. In this work, we show that models trained end-to-end with imitation learning, specifically vision-language-action (VLA) models, can support collaborative manipulation, and characterize the key factors affecting their real-world performance. We evaluate two state-of-the-art models and identify a failure mode of action-chunking policies in implicit HRC, where demonstration action leakage (i.e., action chunks crossing latent task transitions) can cause premature assistive behavior. We find that this issue increases with longer execution horizons and occurs in real-world collaborative VLA systems, such as when a robot attempts to hand over a tool before the person is ready. We propose an inference-time steering method to mitigate these erroneous assistive actions while preserving policy performance. Finally, through a 16-participant user study on a long-horizon collaborative assembly task, we show that steering enables a longer execution horizon while mitigating premature assistance, leading to faster collaboration and fewer failures compared to a shorter-horizon policy.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现现有视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在隐式人机协作中会因动作分块策略不当，导致机器人在人类尚未准备好时就提前执行协助动作（比如过早递工具），提出一种推理时引导方法来抑制这种错误，实证验证了该方法能提升长时程协作任务的完成速度和成功率。
analysis.claim: 隐式人机协作中VLA模型的动作分块策略会导致跨任务边界的动作泄漏，引发 premature assistive behavior；通过推理时 steering 可在不牺牲策略性能的前提下有效缓解该问题。

papers.title: ReGIL: Retrieval-Guided Imitation Learning from a Single Demonstration
papers.abstract: Learning robot manipulation policies with deep neural networks from a single demonstration remains highly challenging, as even small deviations from the demonstrated trajectory can quickly compound into failure, while collecting substantial online interaction data is costly. We propose ReGIL, a retrieval-guided imitation learning framework that treats a single demonstration as an external memory. ReGIL repeatedly queries this static memory throughout training to simultaneously guide exploration, generate the regularization buffer, and construct rewards. Specifically, it computes rewards through local temporal alignment between the current trajectory and the retrieved segment, providing step-wise and informative feedback for policy improvement. We evaluate ReGIL on robotic manipulation tasks from the LIBERO and Meta-World benchmarks under the single demonstration setting. ReGIL outperforms prior baselines in both success rate and training efficiency. In real-robot experiments, using only one demonstration and less than one hour of online training, ReGIL achieves over 75% success rate across three manipulation tasks with randomness in both initial robot pose and target position. These results demonstrate that leveraging the single demonstration as reusable memory can provide more than static supervision for efficient robot learning. More details can be found on our website: https://regil2026.github.io/

analysis.tldr: 用单次人类示范作为可反复查询的外部记忆库，通过局部时间对齐动态生成奖励、正则化缓冲区和探索引导，让机器人在不到一小时真实训练中完成三个带初始状态和目标位置随机性的操作任务，成功率超75%

papers.title: MemoryWAM: Efficient World Action Modeling with Persistent Memory
papers.abstract: Robust robotic manipulation in the real world requires not only an understanding of the current observation, but also memory and dynamics modeling. World action models (WAMs) possess these capabilities by jointly modeling visual foresight and actions conditioned on both current and historical observations, making them a promising paradigm for robotic manipulation. However, existing WAMs face a fundamental trade-off: methods with efficient inference typically condition only on a bounded window of recent observations and therefore struggle in non-Markovian environments, whereas methods that preserve long histories incur time and space costs that grow substantially with sequence length. To address this challenge, we introduce MemoryWAM, a world action model with efficient persistent memory. MemoryWAM uses a hybrid memory design that combines recent frames, event-boundary anchor frames, and compact gist tokens that summarize long-range history. A tailored attention mechanism enables retrieval of both detailed short-term context and compressed long-term context, supporting memory-dependent decision-making with reduced inference latency and GPU memory usage. Across long-horizon, memory-dependent manipulation tasks in both simulation and the real world, MemoryWAM outperforms strong vision-language-action (VLA) and WAM baselines while maintaining favorable computational efficiency.

analysis.tldr: 提出MemoryWAM，一种带分层持久记忆（近期帧+事件锚点帧+长程摘要token）的世界动作模型，在长时程、需记忆的机器人操作任务中，比现有WAM和VLA方法更高效（更低延迟和显存）且性能更好。
analysis.claim: 通过混合式持久记忆架构与定制注意力机制，MemoryWAM在保持低计算开销的同时，显著提升了世界动作模型在非马尔可夫操作任务中的长程记忆建模能力。

analysis.output: 未来动作序列（离散/连续动作块）及对应视觉预测（foresight）

papers.title: VLK: Learning Humanoid Loco-Manipulation from Synthetic Interactions in Reconstructed Scenes
papers.abstract: Perception-based humanoid loco-manipulation requires connecting egocentric observations and task instructions to whole-body motion. Learning this mapping requires synchronized egocentric images, language commands, and robot-compatible kinematic trajectories, yet no existing data source provides this complete tuple at scale. We address this bottleneck by generating vision-language-kinematics (VLK) supervision synthetically in reconstructed scenes. Our pipeline leverages 3D Gaussian Splatting to reconstruct metric-scale indoor environments, synthesizes navigation and object-interaction trajectories using privileged scene information, and renders paired egocentric observations after the fact. We produce 48,000 paired trajectories with no human intervention and train a VLK policy that predicts short-horizon whole-body kinematic trajectories. A whole-body tracker converts these predictions into actions on the physical humanoid. We evaluate on the physical Unitree G1 performing navigation and single-object transport, demonstrating that synthesized interactions in reconstructed scenes provide effective supervision for sim-to-real perception-based humanoid loco-manipulation. Project Website: https://vision-language-kinematics.github.io/

analysis.tldr: 用3D高斯溅射重建真实室内场景，自动生成4.8万条带视觉-语言-运动学标注的合成数据，训练一个能根据第一人称图像和语言指令输出短时全身关节轨迹的策略，并在Unitree G1人形机器人上实现了导航+单物体搬运的sim2real迁移。
analysis.claim: 在无真实人类标注的前提下，通过场景重建+合成渲染生成高质量VLK三元组监督信号，可有效支撑感知驱动的人形全身loco-manipulation策略的sim2real部署。

papers.title: VLAFlow: A Unified Training Framework for Vision-Language-Action Models via Co-training and Future Latent Alignment
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action models (VLAs) have recently advanced robotic manipulation, yet the effects of different robot-data pre-training paradigms remain difficult to compare because existing models often differ in architecture, data, action space, and evaluation protocol. We present VLAFlow (Vision-Language-Action Flow), a unified flow-matching framework for controlled comparison of VLA training objectives. Using a heterogeneous robot corpus, OXEMix, containing approximately 5,000 hours of data from DROID, OpenX-Embodiment, OpenX-Augmented, and RoboCOIN, we evaluate four paradigms under the same pi0-style architecture, shared VLM backbone, action expert, and 14-dimensional action space: action-only modeling (MindPI), language-supervised co-training (MindLPI), future latent alignment (MindWPI), and their combination (MindLWPI). Experiments on LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and SimplerEnv show that action-only pre-training is sensitive to heterogeneous data. In contrast, language supervision helps preserve vision-language generalization, while future latent alignment improves state-transition and action-outcome modeling. By combining both signals, MindLWPI achieves the most stable overall transfer performance across benchmarks. These results suggest a meta-action space view: language and future latent representations provide complementary intermediate constraints that make heterogeneous action supervision smoother and more transferable.

analysis.tldr: 提出VLAFlow统一训练框架，在相同架构和数据下系统对比四种VLA预训练范式，发现语言监督与未来隐状态对齐联合使用能最稳定提升跨基准迁移性能。

papers.title: Warp RL: Reshaping Base Policy Distributions for Dynamics Adaptation
papers.abstract: Residual reinforcement learning adapts a pretrained robot policy by learning an additive correction to its actions. While effective when adaptation amounts to shifting the base policy's action distribution, additive corrections cannot change the distribution's shape, scale, or state-dependent geometry -- limitations we formalize as wrong variance, miscalibrated confidence, and non-uniform correction. We show that these matter under dynamics shift: when the base distribution is geometrically mismatched to the shifted system, residual correction can underperform even the unadapted policy. We propose Warp RL, a policy adaptation method that replaces additive residuals with an invertible, state-conditioned transformation of the base policy's action distribution. Instantiated with monotonic rational-quadratic spline flows (arXiv:1906.04032), Warp RL preserves identity initialization, strictly generalizes additive residual correction, and exposes a structured adaptation space suitable for both policy-gradient and gradient-free optimization. Across a variety of ManiSkill3 manipulation tasks with controlled dynamics shifts, Warp RL matches residual correction when translation is sufficient and substantially outperforms it when adaptation requires distributional reshaping. We further demonstrate that warping can replace additive correction in an off-policy sim-to-real pipeline, achieving comparable success rate with 30% faster task completion on a real-robot peg-insertion task.

analysis.tldr: 提出Warp RL方法，用可逆的状态依赖变换（而非简单加残差）来重塑预训练策略的动作分布，从而更鲁棒地适应机器人动力学变化，尤其在分布形状/尺度/几何结构需调整时显著优于传统残差方法。
analysis.claim: 用状态条件下的可逆分布变换替代加性残差，能更本质地解决动力学偏移下基策略动作分布几何失配问题，实现严格泛化于残差学习的适应能力。

analysis.output: 重参数化后的动作分布采样（即变换后的动作）

papers.title: Cross-Embodiment Robot Manipulation via a Unified Hand Action Space
papers.abstract: Robot manipulation policies are typically tied to specific robotic hand embodiments, limiting the transfer of learned behaviors across platforms with different kinematic structures. In this work, we propose the Unified Hand Action Space (UHAS), a sphere-based unified action representation for cross-embodiment dexterous manipulation. UHAS represents robotic hand actions as geometric deformations of a canonical sphere and uses a Cascade Inverse Kinematics (CIK) algorithm to map the shared representation to embodiment-specific joint configurations. Using reinforcement learning, we train dexterous manipulation policies directly in the proposed action space for in-hand cube reorientation tasks. We evaluate our method in both simulation and real-world experiments across multiple robotic hands, including the Allegro Hand, LEAP Hand, Shadow Hand, and MANO Human Hand. Experimental results demonstrate effective dexterous manipulation, zero-shot transfer to unseen hands, rapid finetuning across embodiments, and successful real-world deployment. Our experiments show that the proposed UHAS representation enables stable dexterous control and cross-embodiment policy transfer across robotic hands.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种基于球体几何变形的统一手部动作空间UHAS，用级联逆运动学将同一动作表示映射到不同机械手（Allegro/LEAP/Shadow/MANO）的关节空间，实现零样本跨手迁移和真实机器人部署。
analysis.claim: 通过将手部动作统一表征为球体的几何变形，并配合级联逆运动学解码，可实现无需重新训练的跨多种机械手本体的灵巧操作策略迁移。
analysis.input: 状态观测（如关节角度、物体位姿）

papers.title: GeoProp: Grounding Robot State in Vision for Generalist Manipulation
papers.abstract: Proprioception is fundamental to robotic manipulation, yet standard fusion methods often treat it as an isolated vector lacking explicit alignment with visual tokens. Without a direct correspondence between 3D kinematics and 2D feature maps, manipulation policies struggle to ground the robot's state within the scene, frequently underperforming even vision-only baselines. To address this, we introduce GeoProp, a lightweight, plug-and-play adapter that aligns proprioception with vision through explicit geometric grounding and spatial feature sampling. GeoProp projects the robot state onto the image plane to sample localized visual features, constructing a grounded state token. It then injects state-derived spatial priors into the corresponding visual features via FiLM modulation. To capture motion intent, GeoProp further samples features at a short-horizon predicted coordinate derived from recent kinematics, providing look-ahead visual context. Across 67 tasks, GeoProp improves Diffusion Policy by 8.7% on 63 simulation tasks and pi_0 by 4.0% on the RoboTwin subset, and yields a 10.6% average gain across both policy families in the real world, while adding only 2-3% to the parameter count. These results demonstrate that GeoProp is a simple yet high-impact inductive bias for generalist embodied policies. Project page: https://alibaba-damo-academy.github.io/GeoProp/.

analysis.tldr: 提出GeoProp适配器，将机器人本体感知数据（关节角度、末端位姿等）通过几何投影映射到视觉特征图上，再用FiLM调制注入空间先验，并引入短时预测坐标采样实现‘看 ahead’，从而让视觉-本体感知融合真正对齐物理空间，显著提升扩散策略和pi_0策略在仿真与真实机器人上的泛化操作性能。
analysis.claim: 显式几何对齐的本体感知-视觉融合（而非向量拼接）是提升通用具身操作策略泛化性的关键归纳偏置。
analysis.input: RGB图像 + 机器人本体感知数据（关节角、末端6D位姿等）
analysis.output: 动作序列（连续控制信号）
