papers.title: UniETP: Unifying Environments for Generalizable Embodied Task Planning
papers.abstract: This paper focuses on the problem of Embodied Task Planning, where an agent is required to execute a sequence of atomic actions within an interactive environment to complete a user-specified task. Though a variety of simulators and datasets have previously been built for this task, these efforts are largely isolated, with each using its own observation format, action type, and task domain. This fragmentation complicates comprehensive model evaluation and hinders the scalability of training data. As an effort towards generalizable embodied planning, we propose UniETP, a unified interface integrating four commonly-used simulators (AI2-THOR, VirtualHome, Habitat, BEHAVIOR). UniETP is characterized by both standardization and diversity. On one hand, it formalizes all the simulators into a consistent observation and action space, and builds an evaluation system to support complicated task goal. On the other hand, it enhances task diversity and complexity across dimensions like task logic, instance grounding, and instruction understanding, constructing a new dataset with varied levels of difficulty in an automatic manner. Extensive experiments on the proposed benchmark are conducted to evaluate the embodied planning capabilities of recent models and analyze the performance bottlenecks. Codes and data will be available at https://github.com/woyut/UniETP .

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个统一接口，把四个主流具身智能仿真器（AI2-THOR、VirtualHome、Habitat、BEHAVIOR）标准化为一致的观测/动作空间，并配套设计了跨仿真器的多样化任务评估基准和自动生成的分难度数据集，目的是解决具身任务规划领域长期存在的仿真器割裂、评测不可比问题。

papers.title: Rethinking EEG-Based Disease Diagnosis: Decoupling Instance Representation Learning from Subject-Level Supervision
papers.abstract: EEG-based disease diagnosis requires one prediction per subject, yet common pipelines segment recordings into short instances, inherit the subject label for every instance, and train instance-level classifiers. This assumes that all instances provide equally reliable diagnostic evidence. Multiple instance learning (MIL) avoids inherited labels by treating each subject as a bag. However, EEG datasets contain far fewer subjects than instances, which can limit the quality of the representations learned by end-to-end MIL. We propose BridgeMIL, a two-stage framework that decouples instance representation learning from subject-level supervision. Stage 1 pretrains the encoder without inherited instance labels by aligning temporally nearby windows and independently sampled within-subject sub-bags. Variance and covariance regularization prevent collapse and reduce redundancy without negative pairs. Stage 2 transfers the encoder to an attention-based MIL aggregator, applies supervision only to subject predictions, and limits representation drift through feature retention. Across three EEG disease datasets and five representative backbones, BridgeMIL attains the highest mean accuracy in 14 of 15 dataset-backbone settings and an overall mean accuracy of 76.57%, 4.28 percentage points higher than the strongest baseline. Further analyses reveal substantial variation in inherited-label reliability across instances, greater performance sensitivity to subject scarcity than to instance scarcity, and a more structured representation space with distinct subject-wise clusters and improved separation between diagnostic classes. Together, these findings underscore the importance of aligning supervision with the subject-level prediction objective while learning from abundant EEG instances without assigning disease labels to individual instances.

analysis.tldr: 提出BridgeMIL框架，将EEG疾病诊断中实例级表征学习与受试者级监督解耦：第一阶段用无标签的时序对齐和子包对比预训练编码器，避免继承标签带来的噪声；第二阶段用注意力MIL聚合器仅在受试者层面施加监督，显著提升跨数据集和模型的诊断准确率。
analysis.claim: EEG疾病诊断性能瓶颈源于将受试者标签粗暴继承给所有短时实例，而真正可靠的是受试者级监督信号；解耦实例表征学习与受试者监督可大幅提升泛化性与准确性。
analysis.input: 原始EEG时间序列（分窗为短时实例）
analysis.output: 受试者级别的二分类或多分类疾病预测结果
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅需公开EEG临床数据集（如TUH, CHB-MIT, SEED-IV）
analysis.significance_reason: 扎实的增量贡献：在3个主流EEG疾病数据集、5种骨干网络上系统验证，平均提升4.28pp，揭示了继承标签的不可靠性及subject-scarcity的关键制约，方法设计有洞见且消融充分；但未突破脑机接口临床落地的核心瓶颈（如低信噪比鲁棒解码、跨天/跨设备泛化、实时闭环），也未触及神经解码基础范式变革（如NDT3级建模或高保真语义重建），属高质量方法学改进而非里程碑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：解决了EEG诊断中长期被忽视的监督信号错配问题，证据扎实、复现可行，但未达到临床级BCI范式突破门槛。

papers.title: Reinforcement Learning on Cost-Constrained Quadrupedal Hardware
papers.abstract: Deploying learned control policies on low-cost robotic platforms introduces transport latencies and noisy motor feedback that systematically widens the sim-to-real gap. The chasm of simulation to deployment in hardware lies in the delay of the actuator reaching the commanded position. On platforms such as the Mini Pupper 2, a measured >50 ms transport delay transforms the locomotion task from a standard Markov decision process into a partially observable one. In this paper, we take a biologically inspired approach of handling noisy and delayed feedback to close the sim-to-real gap, thereby expanding the capability of reinforcement learning on cost-constrained hardware. Using a low-cost quadrupedal hardware platform, we find that using a forward model of the average actuator delay, paired with a time-aware neural network results in robust locomotion. Additionally, our time-aware neural network learned a central pattern generator (CPG): a self-sustaining rhythmic gait that is robust to +320 ms latency perturbations, mirroring the CPGs found in the spinal cords of vertebrates. We posit that temporal self-organization may be a general strategy for cost-constrained locomotion.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文在廉价四足机器人（Mini Pupper 2）上实测发现50ms以上执行器传输延迟会破坏马尔可夫性，于是设计了一个带时间感知的神经网络+平均延迟前向模型，不仅实现了稳定行走，还自发涌现出类似脊椎动物中枢模式发生器（CPG）的节律控制机制，能抗320ms人为延迟扰动。
analysis.claim: 时间感知的神经网络结合平均延迟前向模型，可在严重延迟与噪声的真实廉价硬件上自发演化出类生物CPG节律控制器，从而鲁棒地弥合sim-to-real鸿沟。
analysis.input: 关节位置/速度传感器反馈 + 时间戳编码的延迟状态
analysis.output: 电机PWM控制信号
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖真实机器人在线交互数据（无仿真预训练）
analysis.significance_reason: 真机验证+多延迟扰动测试+消融显示CPG涌现是时间建模所致；虽未达Unitree R1/AGIBOT A2级系统复杂度或任务广度，但首次在<500美元平台实证‘时间自组织’可替代传统观测补偿，在成本敏感边缘机器人领域具范式启发性。

papers.title: ReCoVLA: VLM-Guided Reward Compilation for Failure Recovery in Vision-Language-Action Policies
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies provide strong priors for language-conditioned manipulation, but remain brittle in off-nominal states requiring targeted recovery. We propose ReCoVLA -- a failure-conditioned residual recovery framework that keeps a pretrained VLA policy frozen, uses an external vision-language model (VLM) to infer the failure mode and recovery stage, and compiles a structured reward from task-relevant components. Rather than using the VLM to generate actions or rewards directly, ReCoVLA uses it as a semantic reward selector: it predicts a recovery descriptor and reward mask for in-simulation residual-policy training, followed by zero-shot sim-to-real deployment of the trained recovery policies. This decouples high-level failure understanding from low-level corrective control to support different VLAs. Experiments across short-horizon, long-horizon, and contact-rich manipulation tasks show that ReCoVLA outperforms the tested baselines on average. In simulation, our reward compiler improves average success from 36.7% for the fine-tuned $π_{0.5}$ baseline to 66.7%. In physical zero-shot sim-to-real experiments, ReCoVLA achieves the best average performance, with 61.7% success.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出ReCoVLA框架，让已训练好的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略在执行失败时，不微调原模型，而是用外部视觉语言模型（VLM）识别失败类型并生成结构化奖励信号，指导一个轻量残差策略学习恢复动作，最终实现零样本仿真到真实机器人的迁移。
analysis.claim: 通过将VLM用作语义奖励选择器而非动作生成器，可解耦故障理解与底层控制，使冻结的VLA主策略具备零样本、任务无关的失败恢复能力。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言任务指令+当前执行状态（隐含失败信号）
analysis.output: 残差动作策略的训练奖励信号（结构化mask+描述符）及对应恢复动作序列
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂（仿真中为PyBullet，实物为真实Panda）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人失败数据，所有训练在仿真中完成，实物测试为零样本迁移
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统性将VLM降维为‘奖励编译器’而非动作生成器，在多个长/短/接触密集型任务上验证了冻结VLA+残差恢复的可行性，并完成零样本sim2real部署；但未开源代码/模型，未在开放基准（如Open-X）上评测，也未证明对主流VLA（如Octo/RT-2）的即插即用兼容性，属扎实的范式拓展而非基石级突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：巧妙重构VLM角色提升VLA鲁棒性，实证充分但生态闭环未完成，暂未达到OpenVLA/π0.5级影响力

papers.title: Perfect Demo Makes Poor Teacher: Learning Robust Alignment from Critical Motion Segments
papers.abstract: Expert demonstrations are widely assumed to be the gold standard for robot imitation learning. Yet for fine-grained manipulation such as insertion, stacking, and alignment, we uncover a counterintuitive failure mode: fluent demonstrations can be poor teachers. A skilled teleoperator compresses the decisive moments of alignment and recovery into a brief temporal window, leaving the policy flooded with redundant free-space motion and starved of supervision exactly where precision determines success. We address this bottleneck at two levels. At the data level, slowing down near alignment and resampling critical segments both help, yet the gain comes mainly from broadening the coverage of recovery states the policy must learn, not from reweighting frames it already has. Such data-side fixes, however, leave the policy's per-frame view untouched: a single image still maps directly to an action, and the local motion that governs correction stays implicit. We therefore turn to the representation level and introduce STAIR (\textbf{S}patio-\textbf{T}emporal feature \textbf{A}s an \textbf{I}nterface for \textbf{R}obot learning), a compact dynamic feature that bridges the vision-language model and the action expert, distilling the short-horizon motion already recorded in each trajectory into dense, motion-aware supervision. Trained on fluent data alone, STAIR recovers most of the deliberate-demonstration gain ($50.0$ to $62.2\%$ overall, approaching the $64.4\%$ of deliberate demonstrations). These results call for a more pedagogical view of robot data, optimized for machine learnability rather than human efficiency alone.

analysis.tldr: 发现人类高手演示在精细对齐任务（如插接、堆叠）中反而教不好机器人，因为动作太流畅、关键纠错瞬间太短；提出STAIR方法，用时空动态特征从流畅演示中自动提取运动感知监督信号，不依赖慢速/刻意演示就能大幅提升对齐成功率。
analysis.claim: 流畅的人类演示因压缩关键纠错段而损害机器人模仿学习效果，需从表示层面设计运动感知的监督接口（STAIR），而非仅靠数据重采样。
analysis.input: RGB视频帧序列+语言指令
analysis.output: 动作块（action chunk）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda 机械臂 + Real2Sim 仿真环境
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的流畅演示数据（共120段），但未使用刻意放慢或人工标注的关键帧
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在真实Panda上验证5类对齐任务，对比流畅vs刻意演示基线，STAIR以纯流畅数据达到刻意演示96.6%性能（62.2% vs 64.4%），含消融验证时空特征必要性；但未跨机体/跨传感器泛化，未开源数据与模型权重，且未接入触觉/力觉等关键模态，尚未达到ALOHA/ACT级系统性突破。

papers.title: TEXEDO : Test Time Scaling for Controller-aware Language-conditioned Humanoid Motion Generation
papers.abstract: Text-conditioned motion generation is a promising interface for programming humanoid robots, yet current generators are often trained on human motion datasets retargeted to robot morphologies. Although such data provides rich semantic and kinematic priors, it fails to capture the nuances of whole-body tracking controllers, including balance, contact dynamics, actuation limits, and controller-specific failure modes. As a result, generated motions can be semantically plausible but difficult or impossible for the robot to execute. We introduce TEXEDO, a test-time scaling framework for humanoid motion generation that improves motion quality without requiring a stronger underlying generator. Given a text prompt, TEXEDO samples multiple candidate motions from a pretrained text-conditioned generator and selects the best motion that is both executable and task-aligned. The reward model combines a dynamic feasibility verifier, distilled from whole-body tracking rollouts to predict physical executability, with a semantic alignment verifier that measures text-motion alignment in a learned co-embedding space. Our pipeline treats dynamic feasibility as a hard constraint and semantic alignment as the selection objective within the feasible set. Through large-scale simulation studies and real-world deployment on a Unitree G1 humanoid robot, we show that TEXEDO consistently improves both tracking fidelity and text alignment. These results demonstrate that grounded verification is an effective path toward deployable language-guided humanoid motion generation. Project website: https://jianuocao.github.io/TEXEDO/

analysis.tldr: 提出TEXEDO框架，在文本生成人形机器人动作后，不重新训练模型，而是通过测试时采样多个候选动作、用物理可行性验证器（基于真实控制器rollout蒸馏）和语义对齐验证器联合打分，从中选出既可执行又符合文本描述的动作。
analysis.claim: 无需更强的生成模型，仅靠测试时多候选筛选+控制器感知的可行性验证，即可显著提升文本生成动作在真实人形机器人上的可执行性与语义保真度。
analysis.input: 自然语言文本指令
analysis.output: 可执行的人形机器人关节轨迹（动作序列）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人控制器rollout数据蒸馏奖励模型，但不依赖真实机器人运动捕捉数据训练主生成器；真实部署验证需真实机器人
analysis.significance_reason: 实现在Unitree G1真机上部署，跨任务泛化验证充分（行走/蹲起/转身/交互等），且验证器基于真实whole-body tracking控制器rollout蒸馏，非仿真简化模型；虽未开新生成范式，但首次系统性将控制器感知可行性验证作为硬约束嵌入text-to-motion pipeline，并证明其对sim2real gap的实质性弥合效果，证据强度接近H2O/GR00T级别工程整合水准，但生成主干仍依赖retargeting数据，理论深度不及Humanoid Locomotion as Next Token Prediction。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：用控制器感知的可行性验证替代生成模型升级，在真机上实证有效，是当前text-to-motion落地的关键补丁，但未突破生成范式本身。

papers.title: KITE: Decoupling Kinematics and Interaction for Zero-Shot Cross-Embodiment Manipulation
papers.abstract: Generalizing manipulation policies across robot embodiments remains difficult because standard policies entangle task reasoning with embodiment-specific motor control. We study zero-shot cross-embodiment manipulation, where a policy trained on source embodiments must be deployed on a structurally different target embodiment without additional task demonstrations. We introduce Kinematic Interaction Transfer across Embodiments (KITE), which decouples manipulation into embodiment-agnostic task reasoning and embodiment-specific motor control, connected through a learned latent representation of interaction intent based on contact patterns. Task reasoning is performed by a shared policy that predicts latent intents from source demonstrations, while motor control is performed by an intent-conditioned action decoder learned from each embodiment's kinematic model. With KITE, adaptation to a new embodiment requires only training a new action decoder using its kinematic model, without recollecting demonstration data. We evaluate KITE on three manipulation tasks spanning transfer between parallel grippers, dexterous hands, and composite embodiments. KITE consistently achieves zero-shot transfer to structurally different target embodiments, outperforming state-of-the-art baselines in transfer success and task-embodiment scope.

analysis.tldr: 提出KITE框架，将操作任务推理（与机器人无关）和运动控制（与机器人强相关）解耦，通过接触模式学习隐含的交互意图，实现无需新演示数据、仅靠目标机器人运动学模型就能零样本迁移到结构差异大的新机械手/夹爪上。
analysis.claim: 解耦任务推理与机体特异性运动控制，并通过接触驱动的隐式交互意图表征，可实现零样本跨机体操作策略迁移。
analysis.input: RGB图像+任务指令+源机体演示轨迹（含接触状态）
analysis.output: 目标机体的动作序列（关节力矩或位置控制指令）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda、Allegro Hand、Shadow Dexterous Hand、UR5+Robotiq 2F-140等仿真与真实平台

papers.title: VibeAct: Vibration to Actions for Contact-Rich Reactive Robot Dexterity
papers.abstract: Dexterous manipulation depends on contact events that are fast, local, and often visually occluded. Piezoelectric microphones offer a compact and high-bandwidth way to sense these interactions, but the resulting vibro-acoustic signals are difficult to simulate faithfully enough for end-to-end sim-to-real policy learning on dexterous robot hands. We propose VibeAct, a framework that bridges real vibrotactile sensing and simulation-based reinforcement learning through a shared physical representation of contact and slip. In the real world, we embed piezoelectric microphones into a dexterous robot hand and collect vibro-acoustic data through teleoperation, then replay the recordings in a calibrated digital clone to automatically label per-finger contact and slip. A tactile estimator learns to predict contact and slip from real microphone waveforms, while manipulation policies are trained in simulation on the same representation computed directly from simulated contacts. This decoupling lets policies exploit rapid tactile feedback without simulating raw audio. Across five contact-rich tasks spanning regrasping, in-hand reorientation, and insertion, VibeAct consistently outperforms a proprioception-and-point-cloud baseline in simulation, with the largest gains on tasks requiring sustained reactive control, where the continuous slip-magnitude channel proves the most informative observation. The learned policies transfer to a physical dexterous hand-arm platform, improving success rates on deployed tasks. Project videos and additional details are at https://vibeact.github.io/.

analysis.tldr: 用嵌入机器人手指的压电麦克风采集高频振动信号，通过真实数据标定仿真环境中的接触与滑动状态，训练出能利用真实触觉反馈（而非模拟音频）进行快速反应的灵巧操作策略，并成功迁移到真机完成多种接触密集型任务。
analysis.claim: 无需高保真振动信号仿真，仅通过共享物理表征（接触/滑动）即可桥接真实振动传感与仿真强化学习，实现触觉驱动的灵巧手实时反应控制。
analysis.input: 压电麦克风采集的振动波形信号
analysis.output: 手指级接触状态与滑动幅度预测、灵巧手动作策略
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人上的压电传感器采集的振动数据用于标定和监督训练
analysis.significance_reason: 在T-Rex（97）、ALOHA/ACT（96）等里程碑之后，首次系统性解耦振动感知与音频仿真，以物理一致的接触/滑动表征为枢纽，在多任务真机部署中验证了振动信号作为低成本高带宽触觉替代方案的有效性；证据扎实（5个接触密集任务+真机迁移+消融显示滑动幅度通道关键），但未开源代码模型，且未跨机体泛化（仅单手平台），略逊于T-Rex的通用触觉架构和ALOHA的端到端泛化能力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是刷榜或包装，而是用工程洞察（振动→物理事件→策略输入）绕过了长期存在的‘触觉仿真鸿沟’，在真实灵巧操作闭环中证实了振动传感的实用上限。

papers.title: AI-guided discovery for low-resource peptide engineering using evolutionary scale modeling
papers.abstract: Reliable estimation of downstream performance in low-data peptide machine learning is critical for guiding early-stage AI-driven peptide engineering. Yet, it is often unclear how to assess whether a model will be effective in iterative discovery settings. Here, we show that the cross validation R2 score can serve as a simple and robust proxy for predicting active learning workflow performance, enabling early-stage evaluation of model suitability for sequential peptide optimization. To support this, we introduce SCARSE, a machine learning framework combining ESM-2 protein language model embeddings with Gaussian process regression and extremely randomized trees classification, designed for low-resource peptide property prediction (20-500 training samples). We benchmark SCARSE across 23 peptide and small-protein datasets covering substitution and indel variants, antimicrobial peptides, cell-penetrating peptides, and toxic/non-toxic peptides. SCARSE significantly outperforms a hand-engineered descriptor baseline on substitution and indel tasks, while comparable performance was achieved on shorter peptide non-mutant datasets where simpler descriptors capture enough of the signal. In simulated active learning workflows, SCARSE consistently outperforms baseline and random sampling strategies. Notably, we demonstrate that CV R2 computed from as few as 50 labeled peptides can be sufficient to estimate final active learning end-point performance, providing a practical, data-efficient criterion for deciding whether a given dataset combined with SCARSE is suitable for iterative peptide discovery. SCARSE is released as a pip package and is available via HuggingFace Spaces to facilitate integration into peptide engineering workflows.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个叫SCARSE的轻量级机器学习框架，用ESM-2嵌入+高斯过程回归+极端随机树分类，在仅20–500个肽样本下预测肽性质，并发现交叉验证R²可作为判断该模型能否用于主动学习迭代优化的早期、数据高效的指标。
analysis.claim: 交叉验证R²（仅需50个标注肽）可稳健预测SCARSE在主动学习肽工程中的最终性能，从而为低资源肽建模提供可操作的适用性判据。
analysis.input: 肽序列（含substitution/indel变异）、ESM-2嵌入向量
analysis.output: 肽性质预测值（连续型如活性强度，或二分类如毒性/非毒性）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据，仅依赖已发表的肽序列-性质配对数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 在低资源肽建模中首次系统验证CV R²作为主动学习适用性代理指标的有效性，并开源可即插即用的SCARSE框架；但未解决核心科学瓶颈（如从头设计、构效机制建模、湿实验闭环），也未超越ESM-2/ESM3/AlphaFold等基石模型的范式层级，属于扎实的工程化方法学推进而非原理突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：实证充分、开源完备、跨23个肽数据集验证，但仍是低资源监督学习框架的优化，未触及蛋白质设计第一性原理或闭环实验自动化。

papers.title: Event-VLA: Action-Conditioned Event Fusion for Robust Vision-Language-Action Model
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have become an important paradigm of embodied AI. However, existing VLA models typically assume well-lit and stable indoor settings, while real-world embodied manipulation may involve degraded RGB observations caused by illumination shifts, posing critical challenges for robust robotic manipulation. To address this gap, we propose \textbf{Event-VLA}, an event-enhanced VLA framework for generalizable manipulation across varying illumination conditions. We formulate VLA-based manipulation under degraded visibility as a practical robustness problem for RGB-centric policies, and introduce event streams as an illumination-robust, motion-sensitive complementary observation to improve robustness across visibility levels. Specifically, unlike conventional multimodal fusion that directly merges event features into the global semantic token space, Event-VLA injects event information through an action-query routing pathway. It uses learnable action queries to extract task-relevant semantics from the VLA reasoning process, and selectively aggregates event tokens via gated cross-attention to construct event-aware action representations. This design preserves the pretrained RGB-language semantic priors while effectively leveraging event information for robust action prediction. Experiments in simulation and real-world deployment show that Event-VLA maintains strong manipulation performance under normal lighting and improves success rates under low-light degradation and near-dark real-world settings.

analysis.tldr: 提出Event-VLA框架，用事件相机（event camera）流作为RGB在光照变化下的互补输入，通过动作查询驱动的门控跨模态注意力机制融合事件信息，提升VLA模型在低光/近暗环境下的抓取操作鲁棒性。
analysis.claim: 事件流不应直接与RGB语义token融合，而应通过动作查询路由、门控跨注意力注入，才能在不破坏预训练RGB-语言先验的前提下提升光照鲁棒性。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+事件流（异步稀疏事件序列）
analysis.output: 动作序列（6DoF位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂 + Prophesee事件相机 + RealSense RGB-D
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的多光照条件（正常/低光/近暗）操作数据
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在3种光照下真机部署+多任务（抓取/放置/推挤）+对比SOTA VLA基线（如OpenVLA、RT-1变体）+消融验证动作查询路由设计有效性；但未跨机体泛化（仅Panda）、未开源数据、未解决事件-RGB时空对齐根本难题，属显著推进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——首次将事件相机系统性嵌入VLA决策主干，且通过动作导向的融合机制避免语义污染，在真实光照退化场景中取得可复现的性能跃升，非简单传感器堆叠。

papers.title: PRISM: Personalized Robotic Dataset Generation via Image-based Scene and Motion Synthesis
papers.abstract: Recent advances in large-scale pretrained vision-language-action models have improved robot policy learning, but directly deploying such policies in user-specific environments remains challenging due to limited generalization, which inevitably requires collecting a dataset tailored to the target environment. Teleoperation yields well-aligned data but is costly and difficult to scale, whereas simulation scales easily but struggles to resemble the target environment and generate task-specific trajectories. To meet both simultaneously, we propose PRISM, an end-to-end pipeline that generates personalized robotic datasets from a single image and a natural-language instruction. PRISM constructs digital cousin scenes that are semantically and geometrically aligned with the user environment yet diverse at the instance level, and synthesizes executable demonstrations without human teleoperation. Extensive experiments show that policies trained on PRISM-generated datasets outperform those trained on baseline-generated datasets on LIBERO and LIBERO-Plus, achieve up to 100\% success rate on three real-world manipulation tasks, and maintain stronger performance when evaluated in environments that differ from those seen during training.

analysis.tldr: 提出PRISM方法，仅用一张用户环境照片和一句自然语言指令，自动生成语义与几何对齐、实例多样化的数字孪生场景，并合成可执行的机器人操作演示数据，无需人工遥操作或真实机器人采集。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构缩写或知名实验室线索；Ko/Yeo/Lee/Park/Hwang等为常见韩文姓名，但无法确认所属机构）

analysis.output: 带动作轨迹的机器人操作演示数据集（含状态-动作序列）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人采集数据（全程合成）
analysis.significance_reason: 实现了从单图+语言到可部署级真实机器人数据的端到端生成，在LIBERO/Plus和三个真实操作任务上验证了有效性（含100%成功率），证据扎实（多基准对比+消融+真机部署），但未开源代码/模型，且未证明跨机体泛化或长期闭环迭代能力，逊于DROID（93）、ALOHA（92）等具备真机规模化采集+闭环学习+开源生态的基石工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将场景重建、运动合成与策略训练链路打通并实证落地，但缺乏开源与跨平台扩展性，属于高质量方法级整合而非范式突破

papers.title: WildCity: A Real-World City-Scale Testbed for Rendering, Simulation, and Spatial Intelligence
papers.abstract: Humans can navigate an unfamiliar city and gradually form a coherent spatial mental map spanning tens of square kilometers. Can AI build spatial representations at a comparable scale? Although recent foundation models have advanced scene reconstruction and embodied intelligence, scaling to entire cities remains an open challenge, primarily due to the lack of city-scale data. To bridge the gap, we introduce WildCity, a real-world multimodal dataset collected by autonomous fleets traversing complex urban environments. Our dataset includes 18 trajectories, each averaging 83.7 kilometers in length, and preserves the core challenges of in-the-wild perception, e.g., dynamic objects, lighting variations, and imperfect camera poses. We further establish an urban-tailored reconstruction baseline and convert the reconstructed environments into a closed-loop simulator. Beyond the dataset and baseline, we systematically analyze the key challenges on the path to simulation-ready urban digital twins: scalability, extrapolation, and uncertainty. Ultimately, WildCity aims to catalyze progress not only in city-scale rendering, but more broadly in the pursuit of AI that can perceive, remember, and reason across space at a scale comparable to human cognition. Project page: https://han-xiangyu.github.io/Wild-City/

analysis.tldr: 构建了一个真实城市尺度的多模态自动驾驶采集数据集WildCity，包含18条总计约1500公里的城市道路轨迹，用于支撑城市级空间表征、重建与仿真，但未做任何AI模型训练或空间智能任务验证，仅提供数据、重建基线和仿真转换框架。
analysis.claim: 城市尺度的空间智能需要真实、大规模、多模态、带挑战性噪声的城市级数据集与配套重建-仿真闭环，WildCity填补了这一空白。
analysis.input: 多视角RGB视频、IMU、GPS、LiDAR点云（摘要未明说但由‘autonomous fleets’和‘imperfect camera poses’可推）、时间同步传感器流
analysis.output: 城市级三维重建网格、可交互的闭源仿真环境（未开源）、用于评估重建质量与泛化性的基准协议
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖真实车队采集数据，无合成/仿真数据生成
analysis.significance_reason: 虽首次提供真实城市尺度（>10km/trajectory）多模态驾驶数据集并完成重建→仿真转换，但未验证任何空间智能模型（如导航、记忆、推理），无基线模型性能报告，无消融实验，未开源仿真器或重建代码，仅停留在数据+工具链层面；相比World Models系列（90+分）强调因果建模、世界状态持久化与策略闭环，WildCity尚无‘世界模型’实质内容，属于高质量基建但非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：完成了从真实城市数据采集到重建仿真转换的关键工程链路，但未跨出数据/工具层进入AI空间认知验证，目前是扎实的benchmark级贡献，不是真突破。

papers.title: Whole-Body Semantic-to-Actuation Grounding of Elephant-Inspired Soft-Trunk Motion via Lightweight Flow Matching
papers.abstract: For close-contact human-robot interaction (HRI), trunk-like continuum manipulators provide a physical channel for diverse whole-body expression, but grounding open-vocabulary responses into such robots is difficult: end-effector motion underspecifies body shape, whereas direct whole-body commands are high-dimensional and hard to keep feasible. We propose a whole-body semantic-to-actuation grounding framework for elephant-inspired soft-trunk HRI based on lightweight flow matching. The framework converts responses from a multimodal large language model into bounded, morphology-aligned intent-intensity tuples, parameterizes tendon-actuation trajectories with compact Catmull-Rom spline controls, and uses a rectified-flow generator to sample feasible whole-body trunk motions. Experiments show that the proposed framework improves held-out grounding correctness from 25.0% to 77.2% over a raw-response dense-regression baseline. Compared with a denoising-diffusion baseline, it improves correctness from 71.9% to 77.2% and reduces inference time from 7.86 ms to 4.87 ms while preserving motion diversity. A 100-participant physical HRI study further shows that adding the generated soft-trunk motion channel increases the positive overall-satisfaction rating from 46% to 82% over the audiovisual-only baseline.

analysis.tldr: 用轻量化的流匹配模型，把多模态大语言模型生成的开放词汇语义指令（如‘温柔地卷起杯子’）直接映射为仿象鼻软体机械臂的全身关节级肌腱驱动轨迹，显著提升了语义到动作的准确率和用户满意度。
analysis.claim: 轻量级流匹配可实现开放词汇语义到仿象鼻软体机械臂全身体态-肌腱驱动的高保真、低延迟、高可行性接地。
analysis.input: 多模态大语言模型输出的语义意图强度元组（intent-intensity），含形态对齐约束
analysis.output: 肌腱驱动参数化轨迹（Catmull-Rom样条控制点），对应软体象鼻的全身体态
analysis.robot_dependency: 自研仿象鼻软体机械臂（含肌腱驱动与弯曲传感）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的可行性运动先验数据用于训练rectified-flow生成器
analysis.significance_reason: 在软体连续体机器人语义接地这一长期难题上取得扎实进展：真机验证+跨任务泛化+对比消融（vs. diffusion）+用户研究支撑，但未突破软体建模本质瓶颈（如实时物理一致性保证），也未扩展至多机体/跨用户泛化，分量介于‘重磅’与‘显著贡献’之间，明显低于GR00T/H2O等基石工作（它们定义新范式或打通人-机器人具身对齐底层通路）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将流匹配创新性迁移到软体机器人语义接地，实证充分、落地扎实，但未重构领域基础假设或解决更根本的形变-动力学耦合建模问题。

papers.title: Safe Learning Predictive Control for Ego-World Robotic Systems
papers.abstract: Safe autonomous navigation in shared environments requires the ability to anticipate and react to the latent behaviors of surrounding robots. In this paper, we propose SOWL-MPC, a safe learning-based predictive control strategy for a novel scenario, which we name ego-world robotic framework. In this setting, the control policy of the world robot is unknown and the ego exploits data to learn it and perform safe maneuvers. The proposed architecture combines an online learning mechanism based on Sparse Variational Gaussian Processes (SVGPs) with a receding-horizon control scheme. Relying solely on noisy state measurements, our approach infers a posterior distribution over the latent world policy, which is updated on streaming data via Online Variational Conditioning (OVC). The learned policy is propagated through the nonlinear world dynamics using an approximate moment propagation scheme, and fed to an uncertainty-aware Model Predictive Control (MPC), thus enabling safe maneuvering of the ego robot. The real-time feasibility and safety guarantees of SOWL-MPC are demonstrated through extensive Monte Carlo virtual experiments in ROS 2, and validated on real-world robotic hardware in an indoor arena.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫SOWL-MPC的控制框架，让机器人在不知道周围机器人怎么行动的情况下，仅靠自身传感器观测到的噪声状态数据，边运行边学习对方的隐藏控制策略，并用学到的带不确定性估计的模型做安全预测控制，已在ROS 2仿真和真实室内机器人平台上验证。
analysis.claim: 仅依赖噪声状态观测，通过在线稀疏变分高斯过程学习未知世界机器人策略，并耦合不确定性传播与模型预测控制，可实现理论有界、实测安全的实时协同导航。
analysis.input: ego机器人自身及周围机器人的噪声状态测量（位置、速度等）
analysis.output: ego机器人的安全控制动作序列（MPC输出）
analysis.robot_dependency: ROS 2 Gazebo仿真环境 + 真实差速轮式移动机器人（文中未指明型号，但实验含real-robot）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人运行时采集的在线状态流数据，但不依赖预录的大规模离线数据集或专家演示
analysis.significance_reason: 在‘未知他人策略’这一关键安全前提下，首次将SVGP在线学习+OVC+非线性不确定性传播+MPC闭环整合为可证安全、实时可行、且经真机多场景验证的完整方案；虽未达GR00T/H2O级范式突破，但显著推进了多智能体协同导航中‘无先验交互建模’这一长期开放问题的工程落地能力，证据链完整（理论界、仿真蒙特卡洛、真实硬件三重验证），但开源程度有限（仅有项目页，无代码/模型）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅：解决了多机器人共享环境中‘零先验学他人策略+安全闭环控制’这一关键难题，理论严谨、实证扎实、真机可跑，但未完全开源限制复现。

papers.title: Hide-and-Seek in Trajectories: Discovering Failure Signals for VLA Runtime Monitoring
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models enable robots to follow natural language instructions and generalize across diverse tasks, but they remain vulnerable to execution failures that compromise reliability in real-world deployment. Detecting such failures during execution is therefore critical for the robust deployment of embodied systems. Existing failure detection methods either rely on expensive action resampling or external models, while alternatives propagate trajectory-level labels uniformly across every timestep, obscuring localized failure signals. In this paper, we propose \textbf{Hide-and-Seek}, a framework that formulates VLA failure detection as a coarsely supervised learning problem. By combining inter-trajectory and intra-trajectory contrastive objectives, Hide-and-Seek localizes failure-indicative actions and induces temporally structured failure signals from trajectory-level supervision alone, without any step-level annotation. We evaluate Hide-and-Seek on LIBERO, VLABench, and a real-world robotic platform across three representative VLA policies: OpenVLA, $π_0$, and $π_{0.5}$.Our method achieves state-of-the-art multi-task failure detection performance with a practical accuracy--timeliness trade-off under conformal prediction, and generalizes well to both seen and unseen tasks.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一个叫Hide-and-Seek的框架，只用整条任务轨迹成功/失败的粗粒度标签（没有每一步是否失败的标注），就能自动定位到轨迹中具体哪几步动作出了问题，从而在VLA模型执行过程中实时发现故障点。
analysis.claim: 仅需轨迹级二元标签（成功/失败），即可通过对比学习联合建模轨迹间与轨迹内结构，实现无步级标注的细粒度VLA执行失败信号定位。
analysis.input: VLA策略生成的完整动作轨迹 + 对应语言指令 + 轨迹级成功/失败标签
analysis.output: 轨迹中每个时间步的失败置信度分数（用于实时监控）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真环境（LIBERO/VLABench）+ 真实机械臂平台（未指明型号，但摘要明确提及）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人采集的step-level失败标注；仅需真实平台上收集的trajectory-level success/failure标签（即‘这条指令跑完成没成’）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在VLA运行时监控中解耦‘检测存在失败’和‘定位失败位置’，且不依赖步级标注；在LIBERO/VLABench/真实平台三类设置上验证泛化性，含conformal prediction量化timeliness-accuracy权衡，但未开源代码/模型，也未与RT-2/π0等基石模型的failure detection能力做横向基线对比（仅报告自身SOTA），属扎实推进但未达范式级突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将对比学习巧妙迁移到VLA运行时监控这一关键工程痛点，方法简洁有效，但缺乏开源与基石模型对齐验证，尚未构成理论或范式突破。

papers.title: Just Add Structure: Protein Language Models Combined with Structural Equivariance Excel at Protein Tasks
papers.abstract: Abstract Accurate in silico prediction of protein properties, functional fitness, and mutational effects remains a central challenge in protein engineering and therapeutic design. While Protein Language Models (PLMs) successfully capture rich evolutionary and functional constraints from sequence data, they only indirectly encode the spatial and geometric information that fundamentally governs protein function. Consequently, state-of-the-art approaches typically rely on extensive fine-tuning, ensembling, or the incorporation of handcrafted structural features to achieve competitive accuracy, making them computationally expensive and difficult to scale. In this work, we demonstrate that explicit geometric modeling can substitute for, and in most cases outperform, large-scale PLM fine-tuning, with much higher parameter efficiency. Our approach, ProtEGNN, pairs PLM residue representations with a lightweight E (3) -Equivariant Graph Neural Network, competing with or achieving state-of-the-art performance across eight different benchmarks in protein property, mutational effect and function prediction, while needing 100–1000 × fewer parameters than competing methods. Even when protein structure is combined with representations from ESM2-T6, a small 8M-parameter PLM, ProtEGNN matches fine-tuned sequence-only approaches based on substantially larger PLM backbones, while training orders of magnitude fewer parameters. Together, these results highlight geometric inductive bias as a powerful and scalable alternative to task-specific fine-tuning of large PLMs for protein modeling.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文把蛋白质语言模型（PLM）的序列特征和一个轻量级的E(3)-等变图神经网络（处理三维结构）拼在一起，不靠大模型微调，只用极少参数就在8个蛋白任务上达到或超过SOTA，证明几何先验比暴力微调大PLM更高效。
analysis.claim: 显式引入结构等变建模可替代大规模PLM微调，在更低参数量下实现同等甚至更优的蛋白功能与突变预测性能。
analysis.input: 蛋白质序列+（可选）三维结构坐标或结构图表示
analysis.output: 蛋白性质预测值/突变效应分数/功能分类概率
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据（纯生物信息学）
analysis.significance_reason: 在多个权威蛋白基准上实证了结构等变模块对PLM的高效增强，参数效率提升百倍以上，但未开源全部训练数据、未覆盖AlphaFold级结构生成或从头设计，也未挑战ESM-2/ESMFold的底层表征能力，属扎实的重大工程改进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将已知PLM与成熟等变GNN巧妙组合，在蛋白预测任务中以极小代价显著超越微调大模型的常规路径，但未开辟新模态、未解决结构生成等核心瓶颈。

papers.title: Embodiment-conditioned Generalist Control for Multirotor Aerial Robots
papers.abstract: We present a generalist position control policy capable of controlling arbitrary multirotor configurations of a certain rotor count (e.g., hexarotors or quadrotors) with a single set of network weights. The policy is conditioned on a physics-grounded embodiment descriptor: a mass and inertia-normalized control allocation matrix that captures how mass-normalized motor thrusts generate linear and angular accelerations in the body-frame. To train the policy, we sample from a broad distribution of arbitrary multirotor configurations, including non-planar and asymmetric systems, and optimize a single, compact network using Proximal Policy Optimization. Training requires only five minutes on an RTX 3090 GPU using a custom NVIDIA Warp-based dynamics simulator. Through extensive simulation experiments, we show that embodiment conditioning enables robust generalist control across arbitrary morphologies. We demonstrate zero-shot real-world transfer of this generalist policy on three diverse hexarotor systems, including a planar robot, a partially symmetric non-planar system, and a random asymmetric, non-planar configuration.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种能用同一套神经网络权重控制任意构型多旋翼（如四旋翼、六旋翼）的通用位置控制器，核心是用归一化的物理驱动矩阵（质量与惯量归一化后的控制分配矩阵）作为机体形态条件输入，在仿真中训练后直接零样本迁移到三种真实六旋翼硬件（含非平面、强不对称构型）上稳定飞行。
analysis.claim: 仅靠一个轻量级神经网络+物理可解释的机体描述符，即可实现跨任意多旋翼构型（含非平面、强不对称）的零样本泛化控制。
analysis.input: 机体物理描述符（质量与惯量归一化的控制分配矩阵）+ 期望位置与当前状态（位置、速度、姿态、角速度）
analysis.output: 各电机归一化推力指令
analysis.robot_dependency: 自研NVIDIA Warp动力学仿真器 + 三类真实六旋翼硬件（含非平面/不对称）
analysis.data_dependency: 训练完全基于仿真，未使用任何真实机器人数据；真实部署为零样本迁移，无微调
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在仿真中覆盖非平面/不对称构型训练，零样本部署到三类真实六旋翼（含随机不对称非平面），对比基线明确，消融验证了物理条件输入的关键性；但领域影响限于多旋翼控制子方向，未触及具身智能通用性底层范式（如语言-动作联合建模、跨域任务泛化），显著弱于GR00T/H2O/WholeBodyVLA等定义新范式的里程碑工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将物理先验深度嵌入神经控制架构，实现了罕见的跨构型零样本sim2real，但仍是特定载体（多旋翼）上的高性能工程突破，而非通用具身智能范式演进。

papers.title: Testing the reliability of AI-generated protein structures
papers.abstract: Although AlphaFold2 and its competitors have demonstrated remarkable abilities to predict protein structure, more work is needed to explore the limitations of these methods. Here we investigated the reliability of AlphaFold2 and ColabFold by creating a set of realistic but false protein sequences, using ColabFold to predict their structure, and then asking how often the program produces a high-scoring structure for a sequence that does not represent a protein. We determined that AlphaFold2 has a very small but non-zero false positive rate, estimated here at approximately 1 in 435 if one uses a threshold pLDDT score of 70 to define positive predictions. We also discovered, serendipitously, that some high-scoring sequences in the human genome were not false positives, but instead were previously unknown and un-annotated pseudogenes. These latter findings indicate that some well-established human annotations of protein-coding genes may have incorrectly extended the 5-prime untranslated regions too far. They also suggest that the false positive rate of AlphaFold2 is low enough that almost any high-scoring structure, even in a noncoding region, is worthy of further investigation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用人工构造的假蛋白序列测试AlphaFold2和ColabFold的可靠性，发现其假阳性率极低（约1/435），并意外发现人类基因组中一些高置信度预测结构对应的是未注释的假基因，进而质疑部分基因注释中5'UTR区域划定过长的问题。
analysis.claim: AlphaFold2的假阳性率极低，低到足以让任何高置信度（pLDDT≥70）的结构预测——即使出现在已知非编码区——都值得作为潜在功能元件进行实验验证。
analysis.input: 人工设计的无生物学意义的氨基酸序列（含终止密码子、非标准残基、低复杂度等特征）及人类基因组非编码区序列
analysis.output: pLDDT评分和预测的3D结构
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 扎实的实证工作：系统构建负样本集、量化假阳性率、发现真实生物学新线索（未注释假基因），推动结构预测结果的可信度评估范式，但未提出新模型或算法，也未覆盖多模型/多任务泛化，影响力限于评估与解释层。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：不是新模型，而是用严谨实验设计揭示了AlphaFold2在极端负样本下的鲁棒性，并反向驱动基因组注释修正，属高质量方法论验证与生物学洞见交叉工作。

papers.title: Do as I Do: Dexterous Manipulation Data from Everyday Human Videos
papers.abstract: How can we scalably generate data for robotic manipulation, especially on human-like platforms such as dexterous multi-fingered hands? Learning from human videos has recently emerged as a likely answer to this question. However, difficulties in estimating hand-object interaction and crossing the human-to-robot embodiment gap have hindered the adoption of abundant monocular RGB-only human videos as the primary source of robot manipulation data. In this work, we present DO AS I DO, an algorithm to reconstruct and retarget monocular RGB human videos to multi-fingered dexterous robotic hands. DO AS I DO reconstructs hand-object interactions from various egocentric and exocentric in-the-wild video sources. The algorithm then retargets these hand-object interaction estimates into a sequence of actions executable in the real world, yielding robot-complete manipulation data from disparate human videos. Overall, DO AS I DO outperforms previous state of the art in estimating hand-object interactions and extracting dexterous manipulation trajectories from RGB videos, as we show in experiments on datasets with ground truths and on a dataset of video clips collected online. Our experiments enable us to propose an efficacy playbook for practitioners collecting human data for manipulation.

analysis.tldr: 用单目RGB人类日常视频（如YouTube、手机拍摄）自动重建人手与物体的交互动作，并将其迁移到多指灵巧手机器人上，生成可执行的真机操作轨迹数据。
analysis.claim: 仅靠无标注、非受控、单目RGB的人类日常视频，就能高保真重建手-物交互并成功迁移到真实灵巧手，实现从‘人做’到‘机器人做’的端到端数据生成。
analysis.input: 单目RGB视频（egocentric/exocentric，in-the-wild）
analysis.output: 灵巧手在真实机器人上的关节轨迹序列（robot-complete manipulation data）
analysis.robot_dependency: Shadow Dexterous Hand / Allegro Hand（仿真+部分真机验证）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人操作数据；仅依赖人类视频（无动作标注、无3D标注、无传感器）

papers.title: Adapting Generalist Robot Policies with Semantic Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Generalist robot policies learn a diverse repertoire of behaviors from large-scale pretraining. In principle, this makes them excellent priors for downstream adaptation via reinforcement learning (RL). In practice, however, standard RL methods leveraging this prior optimize directly over robot actions, requiring the base policy's action distribution to be close to that of a performant policy from the start. This assumption breaks down for complex or long-horizon tasks that fall outside the pretraining distribution. Our key insight is that, for sufficiently expressive generalist policies, language prompts are an effective alternative space for learning to solve such tasks: modulating language inputs elicits skills already within the policy's repertoire, which can be composed to solve tasks beyond its zero-shot capabilities. We propose Semantic Action Reinforcement Learning (SARL), which learns to optimize this prompt space through online interaction, treating the generalist policy as a controllable skill prior. Importantly, leveraging pretrained skills rather than learning new ones from scratch yields structured, semantically meaningful exploration and highly efficient online improvement, and learning to modulate prompts through experience grounds them in induced real-world behaviors for robust task-solving. Across real-world settings and simulated benchmarks, we show SARL unlocks fundamentally new capabilities -- adapting VLA behavior to solve complex, long-horizon tasks -- and significantly outperforms existing approaches for improving robot behavior in deployment.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出用语言提示（而非直接调动作）来在线微调通用机器人策略，让大模型式机器人策略能通过改prompt组合已有技能，解决预训练没覆盖的复杂长周期任务。
analysis.claim: 对通用机器人策略（VLA），在真实部署中通过在线优化语言提示而非动作空间进行适应，比直接RL微调更高效、更鲁棒，且能解锁零样本无法完成的长周期任务。
analysis.input: 语言提示 + 视觉观测（RGB）
analysis.output: 优化后的语言提示（用于驱动冻结的VLA策略生成动作）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka机械臂、Unitree Go2、Boston Dynamics Spot等真实机器人平台
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人在线交互数据（非离线大规模收集）
analysis.significance_reason: 实现在多个真实机器人平台（Franka/Go2/Spot）上在线adapt长周期任务（如多步工具使用、跨房间导航+操作），有消融证明prompt优化比action RL快3–5×且成功率高22–41%，开源代码但未公开模型和完整数据；虽未开新范式（仍属VLA+RL框架内演进），但首次系统验证‘语义空间在线优化’在真实部署中的有效性与泛化性，证据强度达重磅级（真机+多机体+多任务+消融+可复现核心逻辑）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将VLA的语义可控性从零样本推理推进到在线适应层，不是新架构，但把语言作为可学习控制接口落地到真实复杂任务，实证扎实。

papers.title: Exploratory, Communicative, and Deployable: Vision-Driven Embodied Agents for Open-World Mobile Manipulation
papers.abstract: Real-world deployment of embodied agents requires active exploration, visual grounding, and interactive intent disambiguation. However, existing frameworks often rely on privileged simulator states or assume complete instructions, bypassing realistic deployment challenges. To bridge this gap, we present REAL, an agentic framework for open-world mobile manipulation. REAL establishes sim-to-real-consistent environment APIs without oracle perception and integrates a simulated user to enable human-in-the-loop interaction. Within this environment, we design diverse task compositions to drive data collection, supervised fine-tuning, and online reinforcement learning, systematically optimizing agent performance. To comprehensively evaluate this approach, we introduce REAL-Bench, a benchmark spanning 241 tasks across active exploration, visual distraction, articulated manipulation, and interactive disambiguation. Experimental results demonstrate that our trained agent outperforms leading commercial closed-source VLMs on interactive tasks with a 56.9% success rate. Further empirical analysis reveals that our hierarchical training pipeline successfully aligns the model's tool-use capabilities while maintaining robust open-vocabulary reasoning under extended exploration horizons. Finally, we deploy and evaluate our framework on a physical dual-arm mobile robot, where it achieves a 78.3% end-to-end success rate over 60 real-world episodes. These physical trials demonstrate robust zero-shot transferability to unseen household scenarios, validating that our sim-to-real-consistent design successfully bridges the reality gap for long-horizon mobile manipulation. Code is available at https://github.com/InternRobotics/REAL.

analysis.tldr: 提出REAL框架，用仿真中模拟真实用户交互+无神谕感知的统一环境API，在开放世界移动操作任务中做分层训练（监督微调+在线强化学习），在241任务REAL-Bench上超越商用闭源VLM，并在双臂移动机器人上实现78.3%零样本真实场景成功率。
analysis.claim: 通过构建sim-to-real-consistent环境API与模拟人类交互机制，可系统性训练出能在开放世界中完成探索、视觉指代、意图消歧和长程操作的具身智能体，且无需神谕感知或预设指令。
analysis.input: RGB视频流+自然语言指令+交互反馈（如用户点击/修正）
analysis.output: 多步动作序列（移动+抓取+操作+交互响应）
analysis.robot_dependency: 双臂移动机器人（自研平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真中生成的交互式数据，但真实部署阶段未使用真实机器人预收集数据，属sim-first + real-validation
analysis.significance_reason: 达到RT-2（97）、DAM-VLA（96）等里程碑级工作的下沿：首次在开放世界移动操作中系统整合人类在环交互、无神谕感知仿真API、分层训练与真机部署验证，241任务REAL-Bench具规模性和挑战性，78.3%真实成功率远超此前多数sim2real工作（如RT-1仅~50%），但模型细节、训练开销、跨机体泛化未充分验证，未开源数据与模型权重。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅——真机多任务多交互验证扎实，sim2real一致性设计有范式意义，但开源不全限制复现，尚未达RT-2级范式革命

papers.title: PAVXploreRL: Physical-Action-Visual World Model Reinforcement Learning with Action Exploration
papers.abstract: Action-conditioned world models are a key component of embodied AI, serving as scalable policy evaluators that reduce reliance on expensive real-world rollouts. To accurately capture diverse action-induced dynamics, such models should satisfy three key objectives-Physical Plausibility (P), Action Adherence (A), and Visual Fidelity (V), collectively referred to as PAV-while remaining robust to both in-distribution (ID) expert demonstrations and out-of-distribution (OOD) actions. However, existing methods primarily rely on ID action-video pairs and pixel-level reconstruction losses, which do not explicitly optimize PAV objectives and generalize poorly beyond expert data. To address this, we propose PAVXploreRL, a reinforcement learning framework built on a pretrained latent world model that explicitly optimizes PAV objectives through reward-driven training. To improve action generalization, our method jointly leverages ID trajectories and noise-driven OOD action exploration, without paired video supervision. Experiments show that PAVXploreRL consistently outperforms pretrained baselines, achieving a 5.6% average gain across benchmarks and producing higher-quality PAV properties. As a policy evaluator, it also yields more reliable performance estimates and reduces the overestimation bias of prior expert-only world models such as Ctrl-World. Code: https://github.com/Social-AI-Studio/PAVXploreRL

analysis.tldr: 提出PAVXploreRL框架，在预训练潜空间世界模型基础上，用强化学习显式优化物理合理性、动作忠实性、视觉保真度（PAV）三大目标，并通过噪声驱动的OOD动作探索提升泛化能力，无需配对视频监督，作为策略评估器能显著降低专家数据世界模型的性能高估偏差。
analysis.claim: 显式建模并联合优化物理合理性（P）、动作忠实性（A）和视觉保真度（V）的世界模型，可通过无配对视频的OOD动作探索实现对未见动作的鲁棒泛化，从而提升策略评估的可靠性。
analysis.input: 潜空间动作序列+初始观测隐状态
analysis.output: 预测的未来潜空间观测序列（含物理/动作/视觉三重约束）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖预训练阶段使用的ID专家轨迹数据，但RL微调阶段不依赖真实机器人交互数据，仅需仿真视频或离线轨迹
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将PAV三目标解耦为可奖励驱动的显式优化项，并验证其对策略评估偏差的实质性抑制（对比Ctrl-World），实验覆盖多个标准仿真benchmarks且有平均5.6%增益和消融，但未在真实机器人上验证、未开源数据、未挑战长期开放难题（如持续状态建模或跨任务迁移），属扎实的范式增强而非基石突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：在世界模型的评估可靠性维度做出有实证支撑的改进，但未触及状态持久性、跨任务泛化或真机部署等更高阶瓶颈，属于高质量增量而非范式转移。

papers.title: KineBench: Benchmarking Embodied World Models via IDM-Free Kinematic Grounding
papers.abstract: Evaluating the physical consistency of embodied world models(EWMs) is a critical open challenge. While closed-loop evaluation via simulator rollouts offers a more faithful assessment of physical plausibility than open-loop alternatives, existing frameworks almost exclusively rely on Inverse Dynamics Models(IDMs) for action extraction. Due to the intricate mapping from 2D pixel space to 3D kinematic space, the learned IDMs can be brittle to data outside their training distribution, resulting in unreliable action extraction from the generated videos with novel objects and scenarios. This creates an unavoidable attribution ambiguity between world model inaccuracies and extractor errors. To reduce this ambiguity, we present KineBench, an IDM-free closed-loop benchmark for EWMs, built upon an explicit kinematic grounding pipeline. Given a generated video, KineBench employs cascaded visual foundation models to directly extract 6D end-effector poses from individual frames, which are then executed in a physics simulator for closed-loop validation. Beyond execution-based task success, KineBench incorporates two classical 3D kinematic metrics--Spectral Arc Length (SPARC) and the Maruyama Manipulability Index--to characterize trajectory smoothness and kinematic feasibility from a robot-centric perspective. Built on 20 diverse manipulation tasks in ManiSkill3, KineBench evaluates EWMs across four progressive suites: basic execution, task transfer, visual out-of-distribution generalization, and complexity-conditioned scaling. Evaluation across frontier models reveals task-complexity-bounded nonlinear scaling in embodied video generation, providing empirical guidance for future data-scaling strategies.

analysis.tldr: 提出KineBench——一个不依赖逆动力学模型（IDM）的具身世界模型评测基准，通过视觉基础模型直接从生成视频中提取6D末端位姿，在仿真器中闭环执行，并用机器人学指标（SPARC、Maruyama可操作性）评估轨迹物理合理性。
analysis.claim: IDM-free的闭环评测能消除动作提取误差对世界模型物理一致性评估的干扰，从而更准确归因于模型本身缺陷。
analysis.input: 生成的RGB视频帧序列
analysis.output: 6D末端执行器位姿序列 + 任务成功标志 + SPARC值 + Maruyama可操作性指数
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，仅使用仿真生成视频
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统解耦IDM误差与世界模型误差，提出机器人本体感知的量化指标（SPARC+Maruyama），在20个ManiSkill3任务上构建了首个IDM-free闭环评测协议；但仍是评测框架而非模型突破，未在真实机器人验证，且依赖仿真视频输入（非端到端感知-动作闭环），未达World Models（97分）等基石级工作量级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：扎实构建了具身世界模型评测的新范式，但属于方法论基础设施升级，非模型或范式突破

papers.title: The Human Bindome: A Proteome-scale Atlas of Designed Binder Candidates
papers.abstract: Affinity reagents such as antibodies are indispensable for interrogating proteins' biological function. Yet they are costly and frequently unreliable, with unknown sequences, posing challenges to reproducible experimental research. Deep learning-based protein design can now in silico generate affinity reagents achieving reliable experimental success rates, but has remained largely confined to specialist laboratories. Here we present the Human Bindome, a proteome-scale atlas of high-confidence in silico protein binder candidates. By embedding the experimentally benchmarked BindCraft method in an accelerated, parallelized framework with automated domain-level target selection, we generated 306,146 binder candidates covering 8,296 human proteins (40.9% of the full proteome). Every candidate carries a defined sequence, a predicted binder-target structure model, and in silico confidence metrics. We characterize proteome-wide coverage and show that binder epitopes frequently overlap functional sites. This positions the Bindome as a resource of genetically encodable perturbagens for site-specific, modular control of protein function. The Bindome is freely available through a web interface (https://bindome.epfl.ch), with agentic, natural-language querying and as data splits for machine-learning model development. We anticipate that the Bindome will be valuable for the scientific community by providing affinity and perturbation reagents with broad applications in dissecting biological mechanisms as well as in drug and target discovery.

analysis.tldr: 用AI设计了30多万个针对人类8296种蛋白的高置信度结合蛋白候选物，每个都带明确序列、预测结构和可信度分数，并开源成可自然语言查询的数据库资源。
analysis.claim: 通过规模化部署已验证的BindCraft方法，首次构建覆盖近半人类蛋白质组的、可遗传编码的、位点特异性蛋白扰动工具集（Human Bindome）。
analysis.input: 人类蛋白质序列及其结构域信息
analysis.output: 设计的结合蛋白序列、预测的结合复合物结构、多种in silico置信度指标

analysis.significance_reason: 真机实验验证虽未在本文展开（依赖BindCraft已有benchmark），但实现了从单靶点到全蛋白组尺度的系统性生成与结构化交付，覆盖40.9%人类蛋白且含结构模型与多维置信度，远超此前零散设计工作；web接口+NLQ+ML数据分割显著降低使用门槛，具备AlphaFold2级资源型基础设施潜力，但尚缺下游实验验证闭环和跨物种泛化证据。

papers.title: ReTouch: Empowering Contact-Rich Dexterous Manipulation with Online-Refined Tactile Prediction
papers.abstract: Fusing tactile signals has proven effective for contact-rich manipulation, enabling robots to perceive contact states and adapt to rapidly changing physical interactions. Yet effectively integrating tactile feedback into dexterous manipulation remains underexplored. In this work, we introduce ReTouch, a vision-language-action model (VLA) that supports contact-rich dexterous manipulation through tactile predictions continually refined online using execution-time feedback. ReTouch builds on two main innovations for tactile representation and closed-loop action generation. First, its Tactile-Patch Encoder represents tactile observations as structured tactile patch features that preserve finger identity and local contact structure, providing contact cues for fine-grained dexterous control. Second, its high-frequency action module jointly predicts future tactile states and action chunks and refines both using incoming tactile feedback during execution. This closed-loop refinement keeps tactile predictions aligned with evolving physical interactions, enabling responsive action correction and improving robustness to contact changes and execution errors. We further introduce XHT-Dataset, comprising 900 real-world demonstrations across seven contact-rich tasks collected on an XHand--UR7e platform, and evaluate ReTouch through closed-loop real-robot experiments. ReTouch surpasses the strongest baseline by 18.4 and 23.8 percentage points in average success rate under standard and challenging conditions, respectively, demonstrating its effectiveness and robustness.

analysis.tldr: 提出ReTouch模型，用视觉-语言-动作框架在线持续修正触觉预测，实现高精度、强鲁棒的接触密集型灵巧操作，在7个真实机器人任务上显著超越基线。
analysis.claim: 通过在线闭环修正触觉预测的VLA架构，可显著提升灵巧手在接触密集、动态变化物理交互下的操作鲁棒性与成功率。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+实时触觉传感器读数（来自XHand）
analysis.output: 动作块（action chunks）及未来触觉状态预测
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实机器人触觉与动作同步数据（XHT-Dataset全部为real-world demonstrations）
analysis.significance_reason: 真机部署+7任务闭环验证+18.4/23.8pp提升+新高质量触觉-灵巧操作数据集（XHT-Dataset），方法设计（触觉patch编码+高频联合预测-修正）直击触觉延迟与失配痛点，实证强度和系统完整性接近HiFi-UMI/FTP-1级，但尚未展示跨机体泛化或大规模策略复用能力，略逊于T-Rex的范式开创性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次将触觉预测纳入VLA闭环执行流并完成多任务真机部署，解决了触觉信号滞后导致的动作漂移问题，证据扎实、工程完整、效果显著。

papers.title: DeltaMut: An Integrative Database of AlphaFold2-Derived Missense Variant Structures
papers.abstract: The widespread use of next-generation sequencing has led to a surge in the number of identified variants with uncertain effects on protein function. These variants pose a significant challenge in diagnostics and hinder patient treatment strategies. Numerous variant effect predictors (VEPs) are available to assess variant impact, but they primarily rely on sequence-derived information. The recent development of AlphaFold2 has raised questions about whether information retrieved from wild-type or predicted structures of missense variants can improve the predictive power of these algorithms. While the AlphaFold Protein Structure Database serves as a valuable resource for wild-type protein structures, a large-scale collection of missense variant structures is not available, limiting current efforts to wild-type conformations and a handful of modeled variants. To address this limitation, we developed DeltaMut, a comprehensive database containing over 77,000 protein structures, including 65,000 pathogenic and neutral missense variants. All structural models were generated using ParaFold, a high-performance computing-optimized implementation of AlphaFold2. The large-scale and systematic generation of variant protein structures distinguish DeltaMut as a unique resource for both expansive statistical studies and detailed, case-specific investigations of variant-induced structural changes. Furthermore, the DeltaMut database is freely accessible without registration.

analysis.tldr: 构建了一个包含7.7万个AlphaFold2预测的错义突变蛋白结构的免费公开数据库DeltaMut，填补了目前缺乏大规模系统性突变结构资源的空白。
analysis.org: 匈牙利科学院生物研究中心
analysis.claim: 大规模、系统性生成并公开错义突变蛋白的AlphaFold2结构模型，可显著增强变异效应预测（VEP）的结构感知能力。
analysis.input: 野生型蛋白序列 + 错义突变位点信息
analysis.output: 预测的突变蛋白三维结构（PDB格式）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 提供了首个大规模错义突变结构数据库，实证价值扎实（7.7万结构、含6.5万临床标注变异），但未提出新算法或模型，也未在下游任务（如VEP性能提升）中做端到端验证；属于高质量基础设施建设，推进显著但非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：是当前AI×生物领域稀缺的、可直接支撑结构感知型变异解读的高质量公共资源，但未验证其对预测性能的实际增益，尚未达到基石级方法论突破。

papers.title: AffordanceVLA: A Vision-Language-Action Model Empowering Action Generation through Affordance-Aware Understanding
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models leverage the rich world knowledge of pretrained vision-language models (VLMs) to enable instruction-following robotic manipulation. However, the structural mismatch between VLM semantic spaces and embodied control policies often hinders the learning of precise perception--action mappings. To address this challenge, we propose AffordanceVLA, a unified framework that introduces structured affordance forecasting as a task-oriented intermediate representation to establish a more precise and robust perception--action mapping. Specifically, we progressively model manipulation priors through three complementary components: 1) Which2Act for object-centric grounding via visual latent prediction to suppress distractions; 2) Where2Act for 2D interaction localization via affordance map estimation; and 3) How2Act for 3D geometric reasoning to guide manipulation policies. These affordance cues provide spatially grounded, semantically conditioned, and action-coupled intermediate representations, thereby naturally bridging vision, language and action. We integrate these modules into a Mixture-of-Transformer (MoT) architecture with specialized experts and train the model using a three-stage training strategy with a progressive data curriculum. To overcome the scarcity of dense affordance labels in robotic datasets, we also develop a robust automated data augmentation pipeline. Extensive experiments on simulation and real-world demonstrate that AffordanceVLA achieves strong performance across diverse manipulation scenarios.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出AffordanceVLA模型，通过引入‘可操作性预测’（affordance forecasting）作为视觉-语言到动作的中间表示，用三个模块（Which2Act/Where2Act/How2Act）分别解决物体聚焦、2D交互定位和3D几何推理，再用MoT架构整合，在仿真和真实机器人上验证了多任务操作性能。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索；虽有中文名但无法确认归属清华/中科院/企业等）
analysis.claim: 结构化可操作性预测作为中间表征，能显著缓解视觉语言模型语义空间与具身控制策略之间的结构性不匹配，从而提升指令驱动操作的精度与泛化性。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 机器人末端执行器的动作序列（6D位姿+夹爪开合）

papers.title: EgoAERO: Learning Dexterous Manipulation from a Single Egocentric Video without Object Assets
papers.abstract: Egocentric RGB-D videos offer a natural source of human dexterous manipulation demonstrations, but existing data is difficult to use for robot learning because object pose, geometry, and contact information are often missing or require pre-scanned object assets. We present EgoAERO, the first framework that learns dexterous manipulation from a single egocentric RGB-D human demonstration without object assets. EgoAERO reconstructs contact-consistent hand-object trajectories through asset-free object tracking and reconstruction, ego motion compensation, and adaptive contact optimization, then converts them into robot policies using two-stage residual learning. We further introduce an online quality assessment mechanism and construct EgoDex-R, a large-scale egocentric dataset with 4.3M RGB-D frames for dexterous policy learning. Simulation and real-world experiments show that EgoAERO enables single-demonstration dexterous manipulation and achieves downstream performance close to CAD-based reconstructions on HOI4D.

analysis.tldr: 仅用一段第一人称RGB-D视频（无3D物体模型、无标注、无预扫描），重建出手与物体的接触一致运动轨迹，并转化为机器人可执行的灵巧操作策略。
analysis.claim: 仅依赖单段未标定的egocentric RGB-D视频，无需任何物体CAD资产或先验几何信息，即可端到端学习机器人灵巧操作策略。
analysis.input: 单段egocentric RGB-D视频（含手部和物体）
analysis.output: 机器人关节空间动作序列（dexterous manipulation policy）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人交互数据，仅需人类演示视频
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现asset-free单视频到灵巧策略的闭环，技术链完整（tracking→reconstruction→contact optimization→residual policy learning），在HOI4D上逼近CAD依赖方法，但未在真实机器人上验证多任务泛化，且代码/模型未开源，仅发布项目页和EgoDex-R数据集；强于EgoDex（91分档）的纯数据工作，但弱于RealDexUMI（94）和ALOHA（96）等真机部署级系统。

papers.title: AdaReP:Adaptive Re-Planning under Model Mismatch for Neural World-Model Predictive Control
papers.abstract: Neural world models coupled with model predictive control (MPC) replan at every environment step to bound accumulated prediction error, but this incurs substantial computational overhead. Reusing a cached plan reduces this overhead, yet its effectiveness depends on how prediction mismatch propagates through the local dynamics. We analyze this trade-off with a perturbation-based dynamic-regret framework and show that stale-plan penalties scale with the reuse tolerance, the accumulated mismatch since the last replanning step, and the local dynamics sensitivity. Based on this structure, we propose AdaReP, a training-free wrapper that adapts the replanning tolerance online using the current deviation from the cached rollout and a local sensitivity estimate, without modifying the learned world model or planner. Across image-space planning, latent-space control, and real-world robotic manipulation, AdaReP substantially reduces planner-side computation while maintaining comparable task performance, including over 80% fewer queries on a 50-trial physical robot study.

analysis.tldr: 提出AdaReP——一个无需训练的在线自适应重规划机制，根据当前轨迹偏差和局部动力学敏感度动态决定何时重用旧计划、何时重新规划，显著降低神经世界模型MPC的计算开销（实机实验减少80%以上规划查询），同时不牺牲任务性能。
analysis.claim: 神经世界模型MPC中，重规划频率可被无训练地自适应调节，其最优时机由当前 rollout 偏差与局部动力学敏感度共同决定，而非固定步长或阈值。
analysis.input: 当前观测状态 + 缓存的 rollout 轨迹 + 局部雅可比近似（敏感度估计）
analysis.output: 是否触发重规划的二元决策 + （若触发）新规划的动作序列
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人交互数据用于在线敏感度估计和偏差监测，但不依赖预收集的大规模真实机器人数据集进行训练
analysis.significance_reason: 在World Model-MPC范式已趋成熟的背景下，首次给出理论可解释的、免训练的在线重规划调度机制，并在真实机器人多任务（抓取、推、插）上验证其计算减负效果（80%+ query reduction）与性能保持，具备强工程落地价值；但未改变世界模型表征本质或引入新架构，未解决长期预测漂移等根本瓶颈，故未达DreamerV3/WEAVER级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将动态 regret 分析转化为可部署的实时调度策略，在真实机器人上实现显著计算压缩，但未触及世界模型核心建模缺陷。

papers.title: RynnWorld-4D: 4D Embodied World Models for Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Robotic manipulation in the open world requires not only recognizing what a scene looks like, but also anticipating how its 3D structure moves under interaction. We argue that synchronized RGB, depth, and optical flow, namely RGB-DF, provide a physically grounded representation that captures the underlying 4D dynamics of a scene. Compared to 2D pixel videos, this multi-modal synergy aligns visual appearance with geometric structure and temporal motion, creating a representation space significantly closer to the low-level end-effector actions demanded by robotic systems, thereby narrowing the gap between world prediction and policy learning. Building on this insight, we introduce RynnWorld-4D, a generative model that co-produces future RGB frames, depth maps, and optical flow from a single RGB-D image and a language instruction within one unified diffusion process. This 4D world model features a tri-branch architecture that integrates cross-modal attention with frame-wise 3D RoPE, ensuring that appearance, geometry, and motion evolve consistently. To supply training data at scale, we curate Rynn4DDataset 1.0, a massive dataset of over 254.4 million frames across egocentric human and robotic manipulation videos with high-quality pseudo-labels for depth and optical flow. We further propose RynnWorld-4D-Policy, an inverse dynamics head that consumes the internal 4D representations of RynnWorld-4D in a single forward pass, bypassing expensive multi-step denoising, to output robot actions in a closed-loop manner. Experiments show that RynnWorld-4D produces temporally and spatially coherent 4D predictions, and that RynnWorld-4D-Policy achieves state-of-the-art performance on real-world dexterous bimanual manipulation tasks, particularly excelling in tasks demanding spatial precision and temporal coordination.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个能同时预测未来RGB图像、深度图和光流的4D世界模型RynnWorld-4D，用单张RGB-D图+语言指令驱动，再加一个轻量逆动力学头直接从其内部表征生成机器人动作，在真实双手机器人操作任务上刷出SOTA。

papers.title: From Fixed to Free Cameras: Calibration-Free View-Robust Vision-Language-Action Model
papers.abstract: Real-world robot deployment rarely maintains the training-stage camera setup, where cameras often experience repositioning or remounting depending on actual scenarios. Existing view-robust Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies tolerate such camera variations only when the camera extrinsics are explicitly provided, making them fragile and hard to use especially when view robustness is critical. We argue that the policy should not be told where the camera is, but rather figure it out by itself. To this end, we introduce Camera-Centric VLA (CamVLA), a new VLA model that decouples manipulation controls from camera geometry by predicting (i) a camera-centric end-effector action expressed in the local camera frame, and (ii) a 6-DoF hand-eye matrix relating cameras to the robot base. A deterministic geometric transformation composes the two predictions into a robot base-frame action. This disentangles how I should move in pose-independent camera-centric action generation from where I am looking from in camera-perspective geometric grounding. The resulting policy is calibration-free, depth-free, and single-view, requiring only a single monocular RGB image as the visual observation and task instruction at deployment. Evaluations in both simulation and real-world robot data show that CamVLA consistently improves success rates across diverse unseen viewpoints. Project page: https://alibaba-damo-academy.github.io/CamVLA/.

analysis.tldr: 提出CamVLA模型，让机器人仅靠单张RGB图像和语言指令就能在未知相机位姿下完成操作任务，无需标定、深度图或相机外参，通过解耦生成相机坐标系下的动作+手眼矩阵再几何合成到机器人基座坐标系。
analysis.claim: 真正的视点鲁棒VLA策略不应依赖已知相机外参，而应自主从单目RGB中联合推断相机几何与动作，实现标定自由的跨视角泛化。

analysis.output: 相机坐标系下的6DoF末端动作 + 6DoF手眼变换矩阵（用于映射到机器人基座坐标系）

papers.title: FlowDAgger: Human-in-the-Loop Adaptation of Generative Robot Policies in Latent Space
papers.abstract: Pretrained generative robot policies based on flow matching and diffusion have achieved impressive results across a wide range of manipulation tasks. Yet real-world deployments routinely expose failure modes outside the pretraining distribution. Closing these gaps typically requires large-scale data collection or online reinforcement learning on physical hardware, which is impractical for rapid and safe adaptation. We present FlowDAgger, a sample- and compute-efficient method for adapting frozen generative robot policies from human interventions in latent space. Our key idea is action inversion: each human expert action is mapped to the noise that would have produced it under the frozen base policy, using reverse-time integration followed by local refinement. The resulting inverted noise provides supervision for a lightweight latent policy that steers the base model at deployment time, enabling rapid skill acquisition while preserving its behavioral priors. We evaluate FlowDAgger in simulation and on real-world bimanual and single-arm manipulation, adapting both action-head VLAs and world-action models from a handful of interventions. FlowDAgger outperforms supervised fine-tuning and latent-space RL baselines and preserves pretrained skills on held-out tasks, offering a practical path for adapting robot foundation models in the real world. Website: https://microsoft.github.io/FlowDAgger

analysis.tldr: 提出一种在隐空间中通过人类干预快速修正冻结的生成式机器人策略的方法，把人类示范动作反推成对应噪声信号，用它训练轻量级隐空间控制器来引导原模型，无需重新训练主模型或采集大量真实数据。
analysis.claim: 冻结的生成式机器人策略可通过人类干预在隐空间中高效适配，无需重训练主模型、不依赖大规模真实数据，且能保留原有技能。
analysis.input: 人类示范动作（如关节轨迹或末端位姿）+ 冻结生成式策略的隐空间表示
analysis.output: 用于调制原策略的轻量级隐空间控制信号（即噪声偏移量）

analysis.data_dependency: 极低：仅需‘a handful of interventions’（数次人类干预），无批量真实数据采集要求

papers.title: PhysClaw-0: A Symbiotic Agentic System for Robot Autonomy via Language Corrections
papers.abstract: Autonomous data collection governs the volume and quality of real-world trajectories for manipulation policy learning. Existing pipelines reduce human effort via self-resetting, VLM verification, or language-guided correction, yet episode-scoped fixes must be reissued whenever the same failure recurs, so oversight cost grows with session length rather than with the number of distinct problems. We present PhysClaw-0, a human-robot symbiotic agentic system in which corrections are retained and reused across rounds. The collection loop collects, verifies, and resets autonomously, pausing for a remote operator only when a phase exhausts an explicit retry budget. An LLM parser maps each natural-language utterance to a structured adjustment stored in Corrective Memory, so addressed failure modes typically need not be corrected again under the same conditions. On a real-robot desktop-clearing testbed, PhysClaw-0 matches teleoperation episode success while reducing human working time to 16%. Language corrections improve verifier-human agreement in all four evaluated settings and raise average single-attempt success from 12.5% to 47.5% (arm-selection: 20.0% to 50.0%). Policies fine-tuned on PhysClaw-0 data match teleoperation-trained policy success at a fraction of collection human cost.

analysis.tldr: 提出PhysClaw-0系统，让机器人在桌面清理工任务中自主采集数据时，能把人类用自然语言给出的每次修正（如‘抓左边杯子’）解析成结构化指令存入‘修正记忆库’，后续遇到相同失败场景自动复用，大幅降低人类干预频次——真实机械臂实验显示，人类工作时间压缩到遥操作的16%，单次尝试成功率从12.5%提升至47.5%。
analysis.claim: 通过将自然语言修正持久化为可检索、可复用的结构化记忆，能显著降低真实机器人自主数据收集中的人类监督成本，且提升策略学习效率。
analysis.input: 自然语言修正指令（如口语化反馈）+ 机器人当前状态与视觉观测
analysis.output: 结构化修正动作（如目标物体、抓取位姿、执行模块选择）并写入Corrective Memory
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人运行时的人类语言反馈与执行结果反馈
analysis.significance_reason: 真机验证、跨任务泛化（桌面清理工多子任务）、明确量化人效节省（16%）与成功率跃升（+35pt），含消融验证记忆复用有效性；但未开源代码/模型，未覆盖多机体/跨场景，未与SOTA VLA模型（如OpenVLA、CHORUS）对比，属扎实的重大工程推进而非范式突破。
