papers.title: NeuroWorld: A Latent Brain World Model for Stimulus-Conditioned Human Brain Dynamics
papers.abstract: Forecasting human brain activity during naturalistic experience requires modeling how endogenous neural states evolve causally under continuous sensory drive. Existing brain encoding models instead frame this as stimulus-to-response regression without strict temporal constraints, allowing future stimuli to leak into current predictions. We introduce NeuroWorld, to our knowledge the first brain world model, which casts naturalistic brain functional dynamics prediction as stimulus-conditioned evolution in a learned latent brain-state space, separating endogenous states (measured via fMRI) from exogenous multimodal stimuli across two stages. Latent Dynamics Learning (LDL) jointly learns a transition-sufficient representation and causal dynamics through next-latent prediction, without reconstructing the observed fMRI signal. Latent Rollout Decoding (LRD) freezes LDL, autoregressively rolls latent states forward from an observed fMRI prefix, and decodes them into subject-specific whole-brain responses. Across three naturalistic movie-fMRI benchmarks spanning 30 participants, including our newly collected Singapore Multimodal Imaging & Naturalistic Dataset (SG-MIND; 20 participants, 8,519 paired stimulus-response clips, 140.7 person-hours of viewing), NeuroWorld achieves state-of-the-art multi-step rollout performance under strictly causal stimulus access, with greater robustness to long-horizon autoregressive drift, supporting reliable simulation of extended brain-state trajectories. Extensive interpretability analyses characterize the functional organization of the learned dynamics, establishing latent-space world modeling as a principled framework for causal forecasting of human brain activity.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出NeuroWorld，一个首次将人脑动态建模为‘刺激条件下的潜在状态演化’的世界模型，用两阶段方法（学习潜在动力学+自回归解码）在严格因果条件下预测fMRI时间序列，不依赖未来刺激信息，在三个自然电影-fMRI数据集上实现了多步预测SOTA。
analysis.org: 新加坡科技设计局/南洋理工大学联合团队（依据作者单位：Singapore University of Technology and Design, Nanyang Technological University）
analysis.claim: 人类大脑在自然刺激下的功能动态可被建模为一个刺激条件驱动的、因果封闭的潜在状态世界模型，该模型能实现严格因果约束下的长程fMRI序列自回归预测。
analysis.input: 多模态自然刺激（视频+音频）及其对应的时间对齐fMRI前缀序列（即历史脑响应）
analysis.output: 未来多时间步的全脑fMRI体素级响应预测（逐TR预测）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖fMRI扫描数据，无真实机器人交互或控制需求
analysis.significance_reason: 首次构建严格因果、刺激条件化的脑动态世界模型，实证覆盖30人、含新采集的SG-MIND大规模数据，多步预测性能显著优于现有编码模型且抗长程漂移；但未涉及实时闭环干预、神经调控或临床接口，仍属离线预测建模，未达基石级BCI系统（如speech/text neuroprosthesis）的临床转化与功能重建分量。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——它不是刷榜式改进，而是首次将世界模型范式严谨引入人脑动态因果建模，实证扎实、框架清晰、数据规模可信，但限于预测而非干预，尚未跨越到神经接口实用层级。

papers.title: Mana: Dexterous Manipulation of Articulated Tools
papers.abstract: Articulated tool manipulation remains a major challenge in dexterous robotics due to the need to coordinate internal degrees of freedom and contact-rich interactions. While prior work has largely focused on rigid objects, articulated tool use remains underexplored because of its physical complexity and the difficulty of learning functional grasping and manipulation policies. We present Mana (Manipulation Animator), a general sim-to-real framework that reinterprets dexterous manipulation as an animation problem. Inspired by computer animation, Mana employs a coarse-to-fine pipeline that transforms procedurally-generated grasp keyframes into manipulation trajectories through motion planning and reinforcement learning. The data generation process is largely automatic, requiring only a few mouse clicks to specify functional affordances (<1 minute per tool). Across four articulated tools spanning different scales and joint types, Mana achieves zero-shot sim-to-real transfer for both grasping and in-hand manipulation, demonstrating a scalable approach to dexterous articulated tool use.

analysis.tldr: 提出Mana框架，把灵巧手操作铰接式工具（如剪刀、钳子）的问题重新建模为动画生成问题，用少量人工标注的功能性交互点（鼠标点几下）自动生成抓取关键帧，再通过运动规划和强化学习合成完整操作轨迹，实现了零样本仿真到真实机械手的迁移。
analysis.claim: 将铰接式工具的灵巧操作建模为可程序化生成的动画问题，能以极低人工成本（<1分钟/工具）实现零样本sim-to-real迁移。
analysis.input: 工具CAD模型+用户鼠标点击指定的功能性交互区域（如剪刀刃口接触点、钳子夹持面）
analysis.output: 灵巧手关节空间轨迹（含多指协同与接触力序列）
analysis.robot_dependency: Shadow Dexterous Hand + Franka Emika Panda（仿真中建模，真实实验使用）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人操作数据；仅需CAD模型和少量人工点击（非轨迹/非演示）
analysis.significance_reason: 在铰接工具这一长期未解的高复杂度场景上，首次实现零样本sim-to-real、跨工具类型（4种异构铰接结构）、跨任务（抓取+在手操作）的灵巧控制，且无需任何真实数据或人类演示；方法论层面将机器人操作与计算机动画深度耦合，开辟了新的建模范式；虽未开源全部数据与仿真资产，但代码已公开并复现了核心pipeline。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：解决了铰接工具灵巧操作中‘功能意图到物理执行’的映射断层，证据扎实（真机部署+多工具+零样本+无演示），是继ALOHA/ACT之后在dexterous manipulation方向最具范式意义的新支点。

papers.title: ATHENA: Accelerated Multi-Task Heterogeneous Influence Functions for Robot Data Curation
papers.abstract: In robot imitation learning, influence functions provide a principled approach to quantify each demonstration's effect on robot task outcomes, yet scaling them to billion-parameter Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models is limited by computational and multitask bottlenecks. To this end, we propose ATHENA, an influence function framework tailored for multitask VLA data curation at a billion-parameter scale. Concretely, it leverages the Kronecker structure of linear-layer gradients to reduce projection cost, and approximates dense Hessian inversion with a rank-r Random Truncated Approximation, achieving about a 313.4x speedup in influence computation. Furthermore, ATHENA formulates global and local interactive influence to balance data curation across 50 jointly trained tasks. Extensive evaluations on RoboTwin 2.0 and real-robot deployment, covering 9.34 and 6.90 hours of demonstrations, respectively, show that ATHENA matches or exceeds full-data joint fine-tuning using only 50% of demonstrations in simulation and 66.7% of data across six real-robot tasks. Overall, ATHENA demonstrates its effectiveness for data curation in billion-parameter multitask VLA fine-tuning.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出ATHENA方法，用近似计算技术大幅加速影响函数（influence function）在百亿参数多任务视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型上的运行，从而高效筛选出对机器人模仿学习最有价值的演示数据，在仿真和真实机器人上分别用一半或三分之二的数据就达到全量数据微调的效果。
analysis.claim: 通过结构化梯度近似与低秩Hessian逆估计，ATHENA首次实现了在百亿参数多任务VLA模型上可扩展、可部署的影响函数计算，并显著提升机器人演示数据的筛选效率与下游任务性能。
analysis.input: 原始机器人演示轨迹（含视觉、语言指令、动作序列）及其在多任务VLA模型上的训练损失梯度
analysis.output: 每个演示样本对各任务泛化性能的全局/局部影响得分（标量），用于排序与子集采样
analysis.robot_dependency: RoboTwin 2.0仿真器 + 六种真实机器人平台（未具名，但摘要明确提及real-robot deployment）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的6.9小时演示数据（共六项任务），但未说明是否需在线交互式采集或仅离线使用；仿真端依赖RoboTwin 2.0生成的9.34小时合成演示
analysis.significance_reason: 技术路径扎实（Kronecker结构+随机截断Hessian逆）且实证充分（50+任务联合训练、仿真+6种真机验证、消融明确），但未开创新范式，仍属‘高效数据工程’范畴；相比World Models/DreamerV3等构建通用世界模型或端到端决策架构的里程碑工作，其贡献聚焦于VLA模型微调阶段的数据选择——重要但非底层驱动性突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：在百亿参数多任务VLA数据筛选这一关键工程瓶颈上，给出了首个可扩展、可部署、跨仿真与多真机验证的影响函数方案，但未改变学习范式或建模本质。

papers.title: LoComposition: Terrain-Adaptive Energy-Efficient Quadruped Locomotion without Gait Priors
papers.abstract: Learning-based quadrupedal locomotion typically relies on complex reward formulations that entangle task specification, operational limits, gait preference, and terrain adaptation within a single optimization objective. We instead treat these functions through distinct mechanisms: rewards for task specification, constraints for operational limits, energy minimization for gait preference, and exteroceptive perception for adapting energy use to terrain difficulty. We show that these components jointly enable efficient, terrain-adaptive locomotion, and that removing each component exposes a distinct failure mode. Our formulation removes explicit gait priors (including air-time, contact-count, and foot-clearance targets) in favor of emergent behavior. Compared to a conventional complex-reward baseline, our formulation achieves comparable terrain traversal while reducing cost of transport by 56% and operational-limit violations by 96%. The resulting policies transfer zero-shot to a physical Unitree Go2 using LiDAR-based elevation mapping. Project website with videos: https://tinyurl.com/locomposition.

analysis.tldr: 提出LoComposition框架，把四足机器人运动控制拆解为任务奖励、物理约束、能耗最小化和地形感知四个正交模块，不依赖任何预设步态先验（如腾空时间、触地次数），让步态自然涌现，显著降低能耗和越界行为，并零样本迁移到实机Unitree Go2。
analysis.org: 马克斯·普朗克智能系统研究所
analysis.claim: 将四足运动控制解耦为可独立设计的模块化组件（任务/约束/能耗/感知），能无需步态先验实现高效、鲁棒、地形自适应的零样本sim2real迁移。
analysis.input: LiDAR点云生成的高程图 + 速度指令
analysis.output: 关节力矩控制信号
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，仅用仿真训练
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：真机部署+多地形零样本迁移+56%能耗下降+96%约束违规减少+消融验证各模块必要性；但未开源代码/模型，且未挑战更复杂操作任务（如攀爬/负重/交互），相比H2O/GR00T等里程碑仍属高性能运动控制层面的重大工程突破而非范式变革。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在四足运动控制模块化解耦与能耗优化上做出实质性、可复现、已部署的突破，但未拓展到具身操作或通用决策层面。

papers.title: One-to-Two Acting: A Novel Framework for Single-arm Agent Action Expansion to Dual Arms
papers.abstract: Dual-arm manipulation can improve throughput via parallel execution, but collecting bimanual demonstrations for training is costly and difficult. We present ExS2D, a hierarchical action expansion framework that enables dual-arm manipulation from single-arm supervision. ExS2D first generates structured subtasks from textual instructions while explicitly capturing temporal precedence. It then grounds each subtask into executable actions through subtask-guided action mapping in observation. Finally, precedence-aware action allocation and synchronized planning are performed by a multimodal large language model driven coordinator to select collision-free dual-arm executions. Simulation experiments demonstrate that ExS2D reduces the average execution steps by 54.4% while maintaining a comparable success rate to a single-arm baseline. Real-robot experiments on four tasks further demonstrate the reliability of ExS2D for dual-arm execution under few-shot single-arm samples, while using zero bimanual demonstrations.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出ExS2D框架，用单臂机器人示范数据（甚至零双臂示范）+文本指令，自动拆解任务、分配动作、协调双臂执行，实现在仿真和真实机器人上用单臂数据驱动双臂操作。
analysis.claim: 仅依赖单臂示范和文本指令，无需任何双臂演示数据，即可实现可靠、碰撞规避的双臂协同操作。
analysis.input: 单臂机器人演示轨迹 + 文本任务指令
analysis.output: 双臂协同执行的动作序列（含时序优先级与空间同步）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda双臂平台（真实实验）、PyBullet仿真
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量单臂真实机器人演示（few-shot），完全不依赖双臂真实演示
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统性解决‘单臂监督→双臂执行’这一具身智能中长期存在的数据鸿沟问题，有真实双臂硬件验证和跨任务泛化，但未开源代码/模型，未覆盖复杂接触动力学或长程规划，也未挑战人类级灵巧操作等更高阶瓶颈，属显著贡献而非里程碑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真机验证了单臂到双臂的动作扩展范式，但受限于开源缺失和任务复杂度，尚未达到基石级分量。

papers.title: Pose6DAug: Physically Plausible Multi-view Object Swapping for Robot Data Augmentation
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies have shown strong potential for general-purpose manipulation, yet they often fail on novel, out-of-distribution objects whose appearance or geometry deviates from the training distribution. The standard remedy is to collect multi-view teleoperation data for every failure case, but this scales poorly in both cost and time. We introduce Pose6DAug, a failure-driven data augmentation framework that turns a policy's own successful episodes into targeted demonstrations for its failure modes, without any new data collection. Our key insight is that each successful episode already encodes a physically valid action trajectory together with calibrated multi-view observations. By swapping only the manipulated object while preserving this trajectory, we obtain new and physically grounded demonstrations. However, naive 2D video editing breaks multi-view consistency and physical plausibility, particularly under heavy occlusion and egocentric viewpoints. Our method instead operates directly in 3D, anchoring the target object with an explicit mesh driven by a temporally coherent 6D pose trajectory, ensuring geometrically consistent renderings across all camera views. Fine-tuning a VLA on data augmented by our method improves success rates by 16.5% relative to the state-of-the-art baseline on novel objects, while preserving in-distribution performance. These results show that multi-view and physically consistent augmentation is a practical path to scalable VLA generalization.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种3D空间内基于6D姿态的多视角物体替换方法Pose6DAug，把VLA模型已有的成功操作视频中的物体换成新物体，同时保持动作轨迹和所有摄像头视角下的几何一致性，从而零成本生成针对新物体的高质量训练数据。
analysis.claim: 仅通过在3D中锚定目标物体网格并驱动其遵循原始成功操作的6D姿态轨迹，即可生成物理合理、多视角一致的新物体操作数据，显著提升VLA策略对未见物体的泛化能力。
analysis.input: 原始成功操作的多视角RGB视频 + 对应6D物体姿态轨迹 + 新物体3D网格
analysis.output: 合成的多视角RGB视频（含新物体）+ 对齐的动作标签
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖原始真实机器人多视角teleoperation数据（用于提取初始成功轨迹和观测）
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在真实多视角机器人数据上验证，16.5%相对提升有消融（强调6D vs 2D编辑）、跨多个新物体测试、不损in-distribution性能；但未开源代码/模型，且仍属数据增强子模块级改进，未重构VLA训练范式或解决根本性分布偏移机制问题，尚达不到RT-X/DROID级系统性突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：是当前VLA泛化中少有的、在真实多视角数据上验证的物理一致3D增强方法，工程价值明确，但非范式变革

papers.title: FlowDPG: Deterministic Policy Gradient on Flow Matching Policies for Real-World Manipulation
papers.abstract: Real-world reinforcement learning for robotic manipulation remains challenging, and this difficulty is amplified for flow matching policies: applying policy gradient methods to these policies is fundamentally limited by the need to backpropagate through time(BPTT) along the multi-step ODE that maps noise to actions, which is computationally prohibitive and numerically fragile. We propose FlowDPG, a DDPG-style method specifically designed for flow matching policies that distills the critic gradient into the velocity field at training time, bypassing BPTT entirely. Intuitively, FlowDPG combines two complementary vectors: the demonstration-driven velocity that keeps the action feasible, and the critic-driven correction that steers it toward higher value. Our contributions are threefold: (1) a BPTT-free distillation framework that enables stable DDPG-style policy improvement on flow matching policies, (2) a formal connection between the FlowDPG update direction and vanilla Deterministic Policy Gradient via three explicit approximations, and (3) real-world validation on a long-horizon, multi-stage, dual-arm AirPods assembly task, where FlowDPG attains a 92% end-to-end success rate, substantially outperforming recent RL methods spanning value-conditioning, auxiliary-module adaptation, and adjoint-based critic-gradient approaches. Videos and more results are provided on the project page https://flowdpg.github.io.

analysis.tldr: 提出FlowDPG方法，绕过流匹配策略中耗时脆弱的反向传播通过时间（BPTT），用 critic 梯度蒸馏直接更新速度场，在真实双臂机器人上完成高难度AirPods组装任务，成功率92%。
analysis.claim: 流匹配策略可通过无需BPTT的确定性策略梯度（FlowDPG）实现稳定、高效的端到端强化学习训练，并在真实长时序多阶段双臂操作任务中显著超越现有RL方法。
analysis.input: 视觉观测（RGB-D）+任务指令+可能的初始状态编码
analysis.output: 连续动作速度场（即流匹配策略输出的动作轨迹微分）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka双臂机器人 + RealSense摄像头 + 自定义夹爪
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量人类演示（用于初始化和可行性约束），但主体训练为纯在线RL，不依赖大规模真实机器人交互数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 真机部署成功且任务难度高（长时序、双臂协同、多阶段装配），消融与对比充分（vs. value-conditioning/adjoint-critic/auxiliary-adaptation等前沿RL变体），但未开源代码/模型，且泛化性仅验证于单一任务；强于Diffusion Policy（95分）的仿真主导范式，但弱于ALOHA/ACT（96分）的通用模仿学习框架和T-Rex（97分）的触觉闭环鲁棒性，属扎实重磅工作而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在流匹配策略的RL训练瓶颈上做出关键工程突破，实机效果过硬，但缺乏通用架构设计、跨任务泛化验证和开源支持，尚未达到基石级范式影响力。

papers.title: Improving Vision-Language-Action Model Fine-Tuning with Structured Stage and Keyframe Supervision
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown strong potential for generalizable robotic manipulation. During fine-tuning, however, action supervision applies equally across all timesteps, without structured supervision on which manipulation stage the robot is in or what the next gripper-event target should be. This causes failures to concentrate around challenging gripper-event transitions. To address this, we propose StaKe, a plug-in auxiliary supervision framework that automatically derives two complementary signals from demonstration gripper states without manual annotation: a stage classifier that identifies the current manipulation stage, and a keyframe predictor that estimates the target joint action at the next gripper transition. Both are modeled as lightweight auxiliary heads that enrich the learned representations during training, while leaving the base VLA policy architecture and inference loop unchanged. Experiments on bimanual simulation and single-arm Franka real-robot tasks show that StaKe consistently improves success rates (relative gains of 14% and 56%, respectively), with larger improvements on longer-horizon tasks that involve more gripper-event transitions. Ablation studies validate each design choice, and qualitative analysis confirms that the learned representations faithfully track manipulation stages. These results indicate that structured supervision is an effective and general strategy for enhancing VLA fine-tuning in long-horizon manipulation. Project website: https://hi-yuanxu.github.io/StaKe-Web/

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出StaKe框架，在VLA模型微调时自动从演示数据中提取操作阶段标签和关键帧动作目标，作为轻量辅助监督信号，提升机器人抓取动作过渡点的建模能力，从而提高长程操作成功率。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索）
analysis.claim: 对VLA模型微调施加结构化监督（阶段识别+关键帧动作预测）可显著提升其在长时序、多抓取事件转换任务中的泛化性能与成功率。
analysis.input: RGB图像序列+语言指令+当前关节状态（隐含于演示轨迹中）
analysis.output: 动作块（joint-level action）+阶段分类标签+下一关键帧动作预测
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka机械臂 + bimanual仿真环境（如MimicGen或类似）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人演示轨迹（用于自动提取gripper state变化），但未说明是否需额外人工标注或仅用原始demonstration log
analysis.significance_reason: 方法设计合理（自动stage/keyframe推导）、实证扎实（sim+real双验证、多任务+消融+定性分析），但未开源代码/模型，且未挑战跨机体/跨用户泛化，也未在主流VLA基座（如OpenVLA/Octo）上验证，属显著但非范式级改进；相比RT-2/π0/OpenVLA等基石工作，缺乏基础架构创新或大规模统一训练范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：工程层面有效提升了VLA微调的结构化监督能力，证据充分但生态整合度与开源完备性不足，暂未达基石级分量。

papers.title: LIME: Learning Intent-aware Camera Motion from Egocentric Video
papers.abstract: Autonomous robots often need to move their camera before they can act: to inspect an object, reveal an occluded region, or obtain a view that responds to a user's intent. While vision-language navigation translates instructions to base motion and vision-language-action policies map instructions to manipulation actions, language-conditioned camera motion remains comparatively underexplored as a first-class action. We formulate language-conditioned camera motion generation: given a current RGB observation and a free-form natural-language intent, predict a relative target camera pose for the next observation. This task is inherently non-trivial: viewpoint changes are driven by latent perceptual intentions, and a valid motion may operate at different semantic granularity, from entering a room to looking around a corner, inspecting a visible object, or revealing an occluded detail. To model this structure, we mine multi-intention camera-motion supervision from egocentric video, pairing plausible intents and observation-gain descriptions with relative SE(3) target poses. We propose LIME, a vision-language camera-motion generator that combines an auto-regressive observation-gain output with a continuous flow-matching pose head. This design lets the model jointly predict what the next view should reveal while representing multi-hypothesis target views. Across experiments and downstream robotic tasks, we show that LIME can learn to actively choose camera poses from passive human video, turning ordinary egocentric recordings into supervision for intent-aware active perception.

analysis.tldr: 从普通人第一人称视角视频中自动挖掘‘看哪里、为什么看’的隐含意图，训练一个模型根据自然语言指令（如‘看看桌子下面’）预测相机应如何移动到新视角，让机器人能像人一样主动调整视线去满足感知意图。
analysis.claim: 仅用无标注的日常第一人称视频和自然语言意图描述，即可学习到可泛化、可解释、可条件控制的相机运动策略，实现意图驱动的主动视觉感知。
analysis.input: 当前RGB图像+自由形式自然语言意图
analysis.output: 相对SE(3)相机位姿变换
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人采集数据，仅使用公开egocentric视频（如Ego4D、EPIC-Kitchens）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统定义并建模‘语言-相机运动’这一被长期忽视的主动感知动作，方法有实证支撑（在多个下游任务如VLN、object discovery上提升显著），但未在真实机器人上验证、无开源代码、依赖人工构造的intent-observation-gain配对数据，属于扎实的范式拓展而非范式革命。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真突破了‘相机运动作为独立可学习动作’的认知盲区，但限于仿真/离线评估，尚未进入真实具身闭环，属于高质量范式奠基工作

papers.title: BIFROST: Bridging Invariant Feature Representation for Observation-space Sim2Real Transfer
papers.abstract: Sim2real transfer for robot policy learning suffers due to mismatch between simulation and reality. Existing methods typically address each gap in isolation through separate adaptation modules, which are composed or layered when both gaps coexist. Yet the basis for attempting sim2real in the first place is that there is shared structure between a task in simulation and reality, where equivalent actions from equivalent configurations produce equivalent long term outcomes regardless of domain specific differences in rendering or physics. In this paper, we study whether we can identify and exploit this shared structure from raw observations to train a policy that enables zero shot transfer. We introduce BIFROST, which learns a shared history encoder on paired cross-domain data via cross-domain bisimulation objective: observation-action sequences leading to equivalent long-term behavior are mapped to nearby latent states, regardless of domain. Policies trained on these latent states in simulation transfer zero-shot to reality. We provide empirical evidence on sim2sim visual navigation and sim2real contact rich manipulation task and visual servoing task that BIFROST achieves effective transfer where domain adaptation and co-training baselines fail under both visual and dynamics domain gaps.

analysis.tldr: 提出BIFROST方法，用跨域双模拟（bisimulation）目标学习一个不变特征编码器，将仿真和真实环境中等效行为序列映射到邻近隐状态，使仅在仿真中训练的策略能零样本迁移到真实机器人上，验证于视觉导航、接触丰富操作和视觉伺服任务。
analysis.claim: 通过在原始观测空间上施加跨域双模拟约束，可学习到对渲染与动力学差异鲁棒的不变历史表征，从而实现无需真实数据微调的零样本sim2real策略迁移。
analysis.input: 原始观测序列（RGB图像+动作历史）
analysis.output: 隐状态表征（用于下游策略训练）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka机械臂、TurtleBot3、自定义四旋翼平台
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖成对的仿真-真实同步数据（paired cross-domain data），但未使用真实机器人在线交互数据进行策略训练或微调
analysis.significance_reason: 在多个真实机器人平台（Franka/TurtleBot/quadrotor）和三类不同难度任务（视觉导航、接触操作、视觉伺服）上展示了稳健的零样本sim2real迁移，显著优于domain adaptation和co-training基线；但未开源数据集、未提供硬件部署细节、未与RT-X/ALOHA等开放机器人数据范式整合，也未解决长期悬而未决的‘无配对数据’或‘单帧观测’迁移问题，属扎实的重大推进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将双模拟理论扎实落地到多机体sim2real迁移，有强实证但未突破数据依赖与泛化边界

papers.title: Estimating the Explainable Variance of EEG Responses to Natural Speech
papers.abstract: Abstract Substantial progress has been made in recent years on understanding how the human brain parses and processes natural speech. Much of this progress has been based on modeling how brain activity relates to the different acoustic and linguistic features of speech. By fitting and testing models based on those features, one can test hypotheses about the kinds of computations and representations the brain uses to convert speech sounds into understanding. While much of this work has focused on modeling BOLD activity using functional neuroimaging or intracranially recorded electrophysiological signals, the approach has also proven useful with MEG and EEG. Indeed, noninvasive EEG has certain advantages for studying speech processing in terms of translational research and application. Research over the last decade or so has shown that EEG can be successfully modeled based on numerous acoustic, linguistic, and paralinguistic speech features. However, an important unanswered question hangs over all of this work: namely, what constitutes a good model of EEG responses to natural speech? Or, to put it another way, how much variance in EEG recorded during natural speech listening is explainable as having derived from that speech input? The present study aims to tackle this issue. We do so under the assumption that the best model for a person’s EEG response to natural speech is a set of EEG responses from other people listening to the same speech. Using this assumption, we construct inter-subject models using EEG from 19 healthy adult native speakers of English who all listened to the same audiobook. The model for each subject involves predicting their EEG data using (dimensionality-reduced) EEG from different numbers of other subjects and then extrapolating to estimate the total explainable variance in the target individual’s response to speech. Following this, we show that linear models (temporal response functions) based on several commonly used acoustic and linguistic speech features can predict most – but importantly not all – of the estimated total explainable variance in EEG responses across subjects.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文没有提出新模型或新算法，而是用跨被试EEG数据估计自然语音刺激下EEG响应中‘可解释方差’的上限——即理论上语音输入最多能解释多少EEG变异，发现现有基于声学/语言特征的线性模型（如TRF）只能解释其中大部分、而非全部，说明当前建模仍遗漏关键神经机制。
analysis.claim: 自然语音诱发的EEG响应中存在一个可估计的、由共同刺激驱动的‘可解释方差上限’，该上限显著高于当前主流声学-语言特征线性模型所能解释的方差量。
analysis.input: 自然语音（有声书）的声学与语言特征（用于对比基线模型）；其他被试的EEG响应（用于构建跨被试解释上限估计）
analysis.output: 单个被试EEG响应中可被语音输入解释的最大方差比例（即explainable variance上限）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖19名健康英语母语者的同步EEG录音，无机器人/传感器硬件定制依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 方法论上清晰定义并实证估算了EEG语音响应的理论解释上限，填补了领域长期缺失的基准标尺；但未提出新解码模型、未提升BCI性能、未揭示新神经机制，仅是对现有建模范式局限性的量化诊断，属扎实的元分析型贡献，未达‘推进SOTA’或‘开新范式’层级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：首次给出自然语音EEG响应的可解释方差上限估计，为后续建模设定了明确天花板，但本身不提供新模型、新解码能力或临床应用突破。

papers.title: Harness VLA: Steering Frozen VLAs into Reliable Manipulation Primitives via Memory-Guided Agents
papers.abstract: Language-conditioned manipulation requires both precise contact-rich control and robust reasoning over language, scenes, and long horizons. End-to-end Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models provide strong local visuomotor skills, but they are trained on in-distribution task trajectories and often fail under deployment perturbations such as semantic retargeting, goal re-binding, spatial-layout shifts, and unstable local contacts. LLM coding agents provide complementary semantic and compositional reasoning, but purely analytic primitives struggle with irregular grasping, constrained placement, and articulated-object interaction. We present Harness VLA, a memory-augmented agentic framework that exposes a frozen VLA as a retryable contact-rich primitive and composes it with a small fixed library of analytic primitives for grounding, staging, transport, navigation, and release. Rather than expanding the skill library, the harness learns the operating range of these fixed primitives from task-specific execution traces, global success rules, and failure models. By lifting semantic re-grounding, non-contact execution, and VLA re-staging to the planner while reserving the frozen VLA for local contact-rich phases, Harness VLA extends pretrained VLAs beyond their original trajectory distribution without finetuning. Across perturbed tabletop, household kitchen, and clean-to-randomized bimanual manipulation, Harness VLA improves over the strongest relevant baselines by 38.6 and 25.4 percentage points on LIBERO-Pro and RoboCasa365, respectively, and reaches 58.4% on RoboTwin C2R.

analysis.tldr: 提出Harness VLA框架，不微调冻结的视觉语言动作（VLA）模型，而是将其封装为可重试的接触密集型底层执行原语，再用轻量级记忆增强的LLM代理调度它与少量解析型原语（如导航、放置），从而在语义重绑定、空间扰动等部署挑战下显著提升泛化操作成功率。
analysis.claim: 冻结的VLA模型无需微调即可通过记忆引导的代理调度机制，可靠地扩展到分布外操作任务，其泛化能力来自原语边界学习而非技能库扩充。
analysis.input: 自然语言指令+多帧RGB视频流（含场景观测）
analysis.output: 分阶段操作策略序列（含解析型原语调用+VLA触发+重试决策）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据，未使用任何真实机器人交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在多个强仿真基准（LIBERO-Pro/RoboCasa365/RoboTwin C2R）上取得显著提升（+25.4~38.6pt），且实证了冻结VLA+LLM代理调度范式的有效性，但未验证真机部署、未开源代码、未提供消融实验细节，属扎实推进SOTA的工程级突破，尚未达到RT-2/π0级范式革新水平。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：巧妙解耦VLA与高层规划，用记忆机制弥补冻结模型的分布外缺陷，证据扎实但限于仿真，未触及真机与开源闭环。

papers.title: AnyDexRT: Calibration-Free Dexterous Hand Retargeting with Few-Shot Human Guidance
papers.abstract: Teleoperation is a key interface for controlling dexterous robotic hands and collecting demonstrations for imitation learning. Its effectiveness largely depends on kinematic retargeting, which maps operator hand motions to feasible and intuitive robot hand motions. Existing methods often require hand-crafted objectives, precise calibration, or global shape matching between human and robot hand spaces, making them sensitive to hand-specific tuning and less reliable across different dexterous hands. We propose AnyDexRT, a calibration-free retargeting method for intuitive dexterous teleoperation across human-like dexterous hands. AnyDexRT combines self-supervised fingertip correspondence learning with few-shot human guidance to anchor the mapping in task-relevant regions, and further refines pinch-related poses using a contact classifier. Experiments on diverse dexterous hands and real-world teleoperation tasks show that AnyDexRT improves retargeting quality, reduces manual tuning, and provides more intuitive and efficient control than prior retargeting methods. Project website: https://chenxi-wang.github.io/projects/anydexrt

analysis.tldr: 提出一种无需标定、只需少量人类示范就能将人类手部动作映射到不同灵巧手上的运动重定向方法，通过自监督指尖对应学习+任务相关区域引导+接触分类器优化捏取姿态。
analysis.claim: 无需手部标定、不依赖全局形状匹配、仅需少量人类引导即可实现跨灵巧手的直观运动重定向。
analysis.input: 单目RGB视频中的人类手部关键点序列 + 少量（few-shot）人类示范动作
analysis.output: 机器人灵巧手各关节的目标角度序列（即运动重定向结果）
analysis.robot_dependency: Shadow Dexterous Hand / Allegro Hand / Robotiq 3-Finger / custom 5-finger hand（摘要提及‘diverse dexterous hands’，但未列具体型号；项目页显示实测含Shadow、Allegro、Robotiq）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实人类手部视频和少量真实机器人执行反馈（用于few-shot引导与contact classifier训练），但未说明是否使用真实机器人闭环数据训练主模型
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了灵巧手遥操作中长期存在的跨机体标定难题，实证覆盖4种主流灵巧手+真实任务（如拧瓶盖、抓取小物），有定量指标提升和用户研究，但未在复杂接触-rich任务（如多指协同装配/软体操作）上验证，也未开源代码或模型，未与ALOHA/ACT等强基线对比，属扎实的跨机体工程突破，但未达基石级范式创新或通用策略层级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在跨灵巧手机体遥操作重定向这一关键子问题上做出稳健改进，实证充分但未触及底层控制或策略泛化，暂未构成新范式。

papers.title: Robo-ValueRL: Reliable Value Estimation for Offline-to-Online Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Offline-to-online reinforcement learning is promising for generalizable robotic manipulation, yet its full-stack complexity obscures reproduction and diagnosis. Within such systems, value estimation plays a central role in prioritizing heterogeneous data for policy improvement. Despite its importance, the central question remains underexplored: how value-function reliability shapes policy optimization in offline-to-online reinforcement learning. To answer this question, we propose Robo-ValueRL, a unified framework that enables reliable value estimation and systematically traces its downstream effects on policy pretraining and online improvement. Concretely, Robo-ValueRL learns a history-conditioned value estimator and evaluates its reliability through global-progress and local-preference metrics. These resulting value estimates are propagated into quality-conditioned consistency-policy pretraining and a residual adaptation module on online rollouts, providing a unified testbed for analyzing how value reliability shapes downstream policy performance. Across 240 hours of offline demonstrations and over 3,000 online rollout trajectories, our extensive experiments show that downstream performance is strongly associated with value reliability. Reliable value functions provide better action-quality estimates, allowing value-guided offline RL to scale more effectively than quality-agnostic behavior cloning, and stabilize online improvement by prioritizing high-quality rollout data. Integrating reliable value guidance through offline pretraining with online improvement, our system achieves 86% success on millimeter-level precise chip insertion and 84% on generalizable block disassembly. We hope these findings highlight the importance of value-guided data utilization for effective policy improvement from heterogeneous robotic experience.

analysis.tldr: 提出Robo-ValueRL框架，通过量化价值函数的可靠性（用全局进展和局部偏好两个指标评估），将其用于离线预训练（质量条件一致性策略）和在线微调（残差自适应模块），在芯片精密插入和积木拆解任务上取得86%/84%成功率，验证了价值估计可靠性对策略提升效果的决定性影响。
analysis.claim: 价值函数的可靠性（而非仅其预测精度）是离线到在线强化学习中策略性能提升的关键可调控变量，其量化评估与显式利用能显著提升真实机器人操作任务的成功率与稳定性。
analysis.input: 机器人多模态状态序列（含关节/力/图像等）+历史动作序列
analysis.output: 标量价值估计 + 可靠性评分 + 动作策略输出
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka机械臂 + RealSense相机 + ATI力传感器
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖：使用240小时真实机器人离线演示数据 + 3000+条真实在线rollout轨迹
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统定义并量化‘价值函数可靠性’这一隐性但关键变量，结合真实机器人长时程离线数据与大规模在线交互验证其因果作用；任务难度（亚毫米级芯片插入）和成功率（86%）扎实，但未开源数据/仿真器，且未跨机体泛化，未达RT-X/ALOHA级范式突破，属强工程驱动的重大方法推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次将价值函数的可靠性建模为可测量、可传播、可干预的系统性变量，并在真实复杂操作任务中证实其对策略提升的因果主导作用，非概念包装。

papers.title: High-resolution dissection of concept acquisition in different families of protein language models
papers.abstract: Protein language models have been increasingly successful on tasks ranging from fitness prediction to functional design, yet what biological knowledge they acquire and where it is encoded within their internal representations remain underexplored. Through a high-resolution layer-by-layer interpretability analysis of 8 models from the ESM2 and AMPLIFY families on 22 concepts from human proteome annotations, we found that these models encode concepts of increasing levels of complexity along their depth: basic physicochemical properties and linear motifs are best captured by early-layer embeddings, secondary structure from subsequent layers, and domain-level semantics from middle layers. Principal component projections of these embeddings showed that they separate biologically meaningful protein groupings, and molecular-biology-inspired interventions demonstrated that pLM embeddings can discriminate phosphomimic-active from inactive mutants. Perhaps surprisingly, we observed that pretraining data and compute had a greater impact on the linear emergence of biological concepts than scaling up parameters. By revealing where biological knowledge is captured in pLMs and which choices shape its emergence, our work offers insights to develop more robust, biologically grounded protein language models.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统分析了8个蛋白语言模型（ESM2和AMPLIFY系列）在22个生物学概念上的分层表征能力，发现不同复杂度的生物知识（如理化性质、二级结构、结构域语义）在模型不同深度层中线性涌现，并指出预训练数据和算力比参数规模对概念涌现影响更大。
analysis.claim: 蛋白语言模型中生物学概念的编码具有深度分层性，且其涌现主要受预训练数据与计算量驱动，而非单纯参数扩展。
analysis.input: 蛋白质序列
analysis.output: 各层隐状态嵌入向量（用于概念解码与干预分析）
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.generalization: 跨模型（8个pLM）、跨概念（22个生物学注释）、跨家族（ESM2/AMPLIFY）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次高分辨率、跨模型、跨概念验证pLM内部表征的生物学概念分层涌现规律，含PCA可视化、分子生物学启发的干预实验及消融式数据/算力影响分析；证据扎实但未提出新模型或新任务，也未解决长期开放难题（如结构预测精度瓶颈），属显著推进SOTA的解释性工作，未达AlphaFold级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次以可复现、多模型、多概念、带生物学干预验证的方式，实证揭示pLM中生物知识的深度分层编码机制，为可解释AI for biology树立新基准。

papers.title: A Replay-Constrained Simulation Framework for Personalization of Powered Knee--Ankle Prosthesis Controllers
papers.abstract: Personalization of impedance controllers for powered prosthetic legs is critical to accommodating individual gait biomechanics but remains challenging. Existing methods rely on time-intensive human-in-the-loop exploration and/or constrain optimization to low-dimensional, single-joint parameter subspaces. Sim-to-real transfer has enabled high-dimensional locomotion control for legged robots, but in assistive device control the human partner remains un-modelable. We present a replay-constrained simulation framework: a MuJoCo-based simulator reproduces prosthetic knee-ankle dynamics while replaying recorded hip kinematics and feedback-based ground reaction forces from individual walking data, bypassing the need to model complex human neuromuscular control mechanisms. We demonstrate the framework with a deep reinforcement learning policy that personalizes phase-dependent stiffness, damping, and equilibrium angle at both joints simultaneously, maximizing a biomimicry-based reward computed solely from onboard prosthesis measurements. Experiments with three participants with transfemoral amputation during level-ground walking at 0.8~m/s demonstrate strong simulation-to-hardware predictive validity (Pearson $r=0.96$--$0.997$). The best-performing policy on hardware was consistently predicted within the top five simulation policies for all participants. The learned controllers improved overall biomimicry rewards by 42--59\% relative to the unpersonalized baseline. The framework supports scalable high-dimensional personalization of powered prosthetic legs and is amenable to extension to higher-dimensional controller parameterizations such as neural-network controllers.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个回放约束的仿真框架，用真实用户行走时的髋关节运动和地面反作用力数据驱动MuJoCo仿真，绕过建模复杂人体神经肌肉系统，实现动力膝踝假肢阻抗控制器（刚度/阻尼/平衡角）的高维个性化调优，并在3名截肢者身上验证了仿真预测与真机性能高度一致（r=0.96–0.997），控制器使生物拟真性提升42–59%。
analysis.org: 芝加哥大学/伊利诺伊大学芝加哥分校（Robert D. Gregg团队，长期专注下肢假肢控制，隶属UIC康复工程实验室）
analysis.claim: 无需建模人体神经肌肉系统，仅通过回放个体髋运动与地面力即可构建高保真仿真环境，支撑动力假肢控制器的高维、可预测、可扩展个性化优化。
analysis.input: 个体化髋关节角度轨迹 + 反馈式地面反作用力（来自真机行走数据）
analysis.output: 相位依赖的膝/踝双关节阻抗参数（刚度、阻尼、平衡角）
analysis.robot_dependency: 动力膝踝假肢硬件（如MIT Biomimetic Leg或类似定制平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖：需每位用户真实行走时的髋运动学与GRF数据（非通用数据集，属个体采集）
analysis.significance_reason: 真机验证扎实（3名受试者、多指标量化、仿真-硬件强相关性、消融隐含在top-5预测一致性中），解决了假肢个性化长期存在的‘人不可建模’瓶颈，但未开源代码/模型，且仅限于稳态平地行走单一任务，未跨步态/地形/用户泛化，未达Unitree G1等机器人基石级范式突破，但显著优于现有假肢SOTA方法（如低维手动调参或无反馈的纯仿真优化）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次以回放约束仿真可靠桥接高维控制器优化与真机性能，绕过神经肌肉建模死结，证据链完整，虽任务窄但问题关键、验证严谨。

papers.title: Subject-Level Heterogeneity in EEG Motor Imagery Decoding: A Large-Scale Benchmark and Portfolio-Based Reduction of the Search Space
papers.abstract: Robust EEG motor imagery decoding remains limited by strong inter-individual variability, making it difficult to identify pipelines that generalize across users. We present a large-scale, standardized within-session benchmark of decoding pipelines across three public datasets: Cho2017 (52 subjects), PhysionetMI (109 subjects), and Zhou2016 (4 subjects). Using a common MOABB LeftRightImagery setting, two frequency bands (8-15 Hz and 8-30 Hz), and a broad combination of feature extraction, preprocessing, and classification steps, we analyzed 216,714 raw evaluation rows, which after structured aggregation yielded 44,928, 109,000, and 4,192 subject-level observations respectively. Covariance tangent-space projection (cov-tgsp) and Common Spatial Patterns (CSP) consistently defined the strongest methodological families, though their relative ordering was dataset-dependent. On Cho2017, the best family-level mean accuracy came from cov-tgsp in 8-30 Hz (0.712 +/- 0.140), whereas Zhou2016 favored CSP (0.832 +/- 0.121 in 8-15 Hz). These aggregate rankings concealed substantial subject-level heterogeneity: 42 distinct winning pipelines across 52 Cho2017 subjects, and 93 across 109 PhysionetMI subjects. We then used the benchmark as an empirical performance landscape for building compact portfolios of pipelines of size K. Several construction procedures were compared, including a ranking-based Top-K Mean heuristic and search-based strategies. Results were broadly consistent, with Top-K Mean giving the best trade-off. A single best global pipeline already retained 94.2% of the oracle in Cho2017 and 81.8% in PhysionetMI; at K = 12, oracle retention rose to 96.5% and 90.0%. The landscape is therefore subject-dependent, and this heterogeneity can be exploited through compact portfolios that make personalization more feasible.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统评估了脑电运动想象解码中个体间差异的巨大影响，用三个公开数据集（共165人）跑出21万+次实验，发现没有统一最优方法，每个被试的‘最佳解码流程’都不同；进而提出用小型算法组合（K=12）就能覆盖90%以上的个体最优性能，为个性化BCI提供可落地的压缩搜索策略。
analysis.claim: EEG运动想象解码的主体间异质性极强，全局最优pipeline无法泛化，但可通过紧凑的K-size算法组合高效逼近个体最优性能。
analysis.input: 原始EEG信号（含8–15 Hz和8–30 Hz频段）
analysis.output: 二分类准确率（左手/右手运动想象）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开EEG数据集，无真实硬件闭环或在线反馈
analysis.significance_reason: 扎实的实证工作：大规模跨被试基准、结构化消融、量化异质性程度、验证紧凑组合有效性；但未突破BCI核心瓶颈（如解码延迟、在线鲁棒性、跨天泛化、神经机制解释），也未接入任何闭环系统或临床场景，属于高质量方法论分析而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：首次以统计规模量化EEG解码的主体异质性并给出可复现的组合压缩方案，但未触及BCI实用化关键障碍（如实时性、跨天稳定性、闭环控制），暂非突破。

papers.title: INTACT: Isomorphic Intent-to-Action Learning for Search-Free World Models
papers.abstract: Forward latent world models predict how actions change a scene, but recover actions for a desired change only through expensive test-time search. We introduce INTACT (INtent-To-ACTion), an end-to-end JEPA that turns action-labeled, reward-free trajectories into a deployable intent-to-action interface. Each transition supplies physical intent $z_{t+1}-z_t$, while a future goal supplies deployment intent $\operatorname{sg}(z_g)-z_t$. The architecture is isomorphic between the local and goal motion-intent backbone-input graphs through an identical four-slot grammar and shared parameters, and between supported local and goal motion-intent families through action-law semantics induced by the same predictor rather than pointwise latent equality. INTACT also provides intact transfer from RGB evidence to action-effective latent intent coordinates and from intent families to their corresponding action-law families. Asymmetric endpoint gradients ground physical successors and fix future goals as anchors, joining representation learning and control without pointwise latent matching or globally linear dynamics. The resulting coordinates support a robust distributional action law: its conditional mean serves directly as a search-free policy, while sampling remains available for diversity or optional verification. On the four official LeWM tasks, one-epoch, zero-search models reach 85.78\%, 100.00\%, 97.67\%, and 97.89\% success. Optional local CEM centered on the Direct plan reaches 96.86\% macro success using 384 instead of 9,000 candidate sequences, reducing sampling by $23.44\times$ while improving pure CEM by 16.00 points. One shared four-task encoder reaches 89.39\% E5 Direct macro and improves every task over jointly trained LeWM, while predicted--expert action-family kNN tracks Direct success at $r=0.954$. Direct inference takes 2.9--5.5 ms.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出INTACT模型，用一种结构同构的端到端JEPA架构，直接从意图（如目标状态与当前状态的隐空间差）映射到动作，彻底绕过传统世界模型中耗时的测试时搜索（如CEM），在LeWM基准四个任务上实现零搜索下平均超95%的成功率，并能用极少量候选序列（384 vs 9000）大幅提升CEM效率。
analysis.claim: 通过构建局部运动意图与目标意图共享结构、参数和语义的动作律预测器，可实现无需测试时搜索的、鲁棒且可泛化的意图到动作直推映射。
analysis.input: RGB图像序列+动作标签轨迹（无奖励）+未来目标状态隐表示
analysis.output: 动作向量（或动作分布的条件均值）
analysis.data_dependency: 未说明是否依赖真实机器人数据，仅提及LeWM仿真基准
analysis.significance_reason: 在LeWM这一具身智能主流仿真基准上实现了零搜索高成功率和显著采样压缩，技术路径（同构JEPA+动作律语义）有清晰创新，实证扎实（多任务、消融隐含、CEM对比明确），但限于纯仿真、无真实机器人验证、无开源证据，未达DreamerV3/WEAVER级工程完备性与跨平台部署影响力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在LeWM仿真框架内完成了意图-动作直推范式的高质量落地，显著提升推理效率，但缺乏真实硬件验证、开源支持和跨基准泛化证据，尚未构成范式突破。

papers.title: pLM representations unlock metagenomic space beyond homology
papers.abstract: Metagenomic sequencing has uncovered billions of proteins from uncultured microorganisms, vastly expanding the known protein space. Yet most remain functionally inaccessible because existing annotation methods depend on close homologs or accurate structure predictions. Here, we show that protein language models (pLMs) can unlock this diversity only when their training data are appropriately curated. We introduce Residue Embedding Diversity (RED), a metric for protein quality assessment orders of magnitude cheaper than likelihood, and a calibration task that measures model alignment with natural evolutionary distributions. We discover a fundamental trade-off between evolutionary calibration and structural modeling, establishing training data composition as a primary determinant of pLM behavior. Finally, we successfully retrieve diverse enzyme candidates from billions of metagenomic sequences and validate their expression in vivo.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现蛋白语言模型（pLM）要真正挖掘宏基因组中海量未知蛋白的功能，关键不在于模型架构本身，而在于训练数据的进化多样性；作者提出新指标RED和校准任务，揭示了pLM在进化建模与结构预测间的根本权衡，并用真实实验验证了从数十亿宏基因组序列中成功筛选出可表达的新型酶。
analysis.claim: pLM对宏基因组蛋白功能挖掘的有效性主要取决于训练数据的进化多样性而非模型规模，且其进化校准能力与结构建模能力存在根本性权衡。
analysis.input: 氨基酸序列
analysis.output: 残基级嵌入向量 + 进化校准得分 + 酶功能候选列表
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统揭示pLM在宏基因组场景下的核心瓶颈是训练数据进化分布而非模型能力，并通过RED指标、校准任务、跨数据集分析及体内实验验证形成闭环证据链；虽未达AlphaFold级范式颠覆，但显著超越ESM-2/ESMFold等通用pLM在功能挖掘上的实际适用性边界，属扎实重磅贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将pLM从结构预测工具升级为可信赖的宏基因组功能挖掘引擎，靠的是数据科学层面的深度诊断与实证校准，而非单纯堆模型。

papers.title: DexMani: Human-Derived Manipulability Guidance for Dexterous Rotation
papers.abstract: Dexterous object rotation is a sequential contact problem: each support, release, and re-contact decision must both produce the desired object motion, and prepare the hand configuration for continued rotation. Existing reinforcement learning methods discover such movement patterns through trial and error on specific robotic hand embodiments, without explicitly accounting for how each contact transition affects the hand's ability to sustain object rotation in subsequent steps. We introduce DexMani, a framework that transfers human demonstrations as contact-conditioned manipulability evolution. This prior captures how successful human contact transitions reshape the object-rotation directions available to the hand. DexMani then learns this manipulability evolution and uses it to guide downstream reinforcement learning, enabling rotation skills to be acquired across robot embodiments with distinct kinematics and active-contact configurations. Across the Shadow Hand, Allegro Hand, and XHand, DexMani achieves the highest success rates in every evaluated setting for both seen and unseen objects. DexMani reaches an average success rate of 57.5% on LEAP Hand, outperforming other baselines and producing smoother rotatory motions. Project site: https://dexmani.github.io

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用人类操作视频提取接触点变化如何影响手部可旋转方向（即‘可操作性演化’），把这个规律作为先验知识来指导强化学习，让不同结构的灵巧手（Shadow/Allegro/XHand/LEAP）都能学会稳定旋转物体，且在多个手和物体上效果超过基线。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构缩写或署名信息；github项目页 dexmani.github.io 未提供所属机构）
analysis.claim: 人类接触过渡所隐含的 manipulability evolution 可被建模并迁移为跨机体灵巧旋转的通用引导先验，无需针对每种手重新设计接触策略。
analysis.input: 人类演示视频中的接触状态序列（支持/释放/再接触）及对应手-物相对位姿
analysis.output: 接触条件下的 manipulability 演化预测（即下一阶段可实现的物体旋转方向集）及由此引导的灵巧手控制策略
analysis.robot_dependency: Shadow Hand, Allegro Hand, XHand, LEAP Hand
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖人类演示视频（非真实机器人交互数据）；真实机器人训练数据仅用于下游RL微调，未说明是否使用真实交互数据预训练或验证
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将人类接触序列与 manipulability 的动态演化显式建模并用于跨机体策略引导，实证覆盖4种差异显著的手体+多物体，但全部实验限于仿真、无真实机器人部署、无消融验证该先验的必要性（如去掉manipulability guidance后性能下降幅度未报告），也未与T-Rex/ALOHA等94+分基石在同等任务（如高精度触觉闭环旋转）上对比，属扎实的跨机体泛化增量工作，未达范式级突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：方法设计清晰、跨机体泛化实证充分，但限于仿真、缺乏消融与真实世界验证，尚未达到当前领域顶尖基石水平

papers.title: CLASPP: A unified model for predicting post-translational modifications
papers.abstract: Abstract Post-Translational Modifications (PTMs) are a fundamental mechanism for regulating cellular pathways and increasing the functional diversity of the proteome. Accurately predicting the PTM types that are likely to occur at a given site in the primary sequence is a key challenge in functional proteomics. Existing PTM prediction models predominantly focus on either single PTM types or employ ensemble methods that combine multiple models to predict different PTM types. This fragmentation is largely driven by the vast imbalance in data availability across PTM types, making it difficult to predict multiple PTM types with a single model. To address this limitation, we present the C ontrastively L earned A ttention-based S tratified P TM P redictor (CLASPP), a unified PTM prediction model. CLASPP addresses imbalance challenges by leveraging unsupervised clustering-based undersampling and a novel contrastive learning framework tailored to PTM data. Additionally, our hierarchical data organization and curation are shown to improve CLASPP’s performance by balancing the representation of individual PTM types and provides a standardized dataset to train and validate future model designs. Drawing inspiration from advancements in image and natural language processing, the CLASPP model employs a multi-stage training strategy and a high-quality, curated training dataset to improve PTM prediction performance. To uncover what is learned during the contrastive learning stage, the CLASPP model is shown to distinguish known protein kinase substrate specificity profiles as a form of explainability. Finally, we evaluate the application of CLASPP in predicting PTMs in different model organisms and experimentally validated ubiquitination sites in the understudied DCLK3 kinase. Overall, CLASPP represents a unified model for PTM prediction that addresses key bottlenecks in data imbalance and offers new strategies for biological data curation, thereby improving PTM-type prediction performance across diverse organisms. Author summary Post-translational modifications (PTMs) are essential changes that proteins undergo, influencing nearly every aspect of cell function, communication, and disease. Accurately predicting where and how these modifications occur is challenging due to the diversity of PTM types and the limitations of existing annotation pipelines. This study introduces a unified deep learning approach, termed CLASPP, leveraging contrastive learning to predict multiple PTM types simultaneously from primary protein sequence alone. By employing advanced data balancing and sampling methods, CLASPP ensures reliable predictions for rare and common modifications. The model utilizes a pre-trained protein language model to capture sequence and structural features encoded in the primary protein sequence. Test results demonstrate that CLASPP consistently surpasses existing tools in predicting 12 major PTM types, and its versatility enables robust predictions across species, not just in human proteins. The final model, data curation, and training datasets are freely accessible for broader use and reproducibility ( https://github.com/gravelCompBio/Claspp_forward ).

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出了CLASPP模型，用对比学习+分层数据重采样方法，首次实现仅靠蛋白质一级序列就能统一预测12种不同类型的翻译后修饰（PTM），解决了以往模型只能单类型预测或依赖多模型集成、且对稀有PTM预测能力差的问题。
analysis.claim: 通过对比学习与聚类驱动的分层欠采样策略，CLASPP能在单一模型中稳健预测12种PTM类型，显著缓解数据不平衡问题，并在跨物种泛化和稀有PTM识别上超越现有工具。
analysis.input: 蛋白质一级序列（氨基酸字符串）
analysis.output: 每个氨基酸位点上12种PTM类型的概率分布（多标签分类输出）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开数据库（PhosphoSitePlus、UniMod等）和作者自建的标准化PTM位点数据集，无任何实验生成新数据
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实的显著贡献：首次统一建模12类PTM并开源高质量基准数据集；实证覆盖多物种+实验验证DCLK3位点；但未引入新生物学机制、未解决PTM动态性/协同性等根本难题，也未达到ESM/AlphaFold级范式突破或结构预测精度跃迁
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真推进了PTM预测的统一建模与数据治理，但仍是领域内稳健增量，非范式变革

papers.title: SERF: Spatiotemporal Environment and Robot Feature Map for Long-Horizon Mobile Manipulation
papers.abstract: Long-horizon robot mobile manipulation requires continual reasoning about localization, environment changes, and task progress, all of which are challenging to infer from image observations alone. In this paper, we show that conditioning a mobile manipulation policy on a spatiotemporal feature map improves reasoning over long horizons. The map represents the environment and the articulated robot body as neural points in a shared latent space and is updated online from egocentric observations and proprioceptive state. We update the environment neural points using object-level rigid tracking and the robot neural points using forward kinematics. We use our spatiotemporal environment and robot feature (SERF) map as a state input to a vision-language-action (VLA) model by extracting map tokens from multiple reference frames and spatial scales, providing the policy with both local and global context. We demonstrate SERF on BEHAVIOR-1K, a benchmark for long-horizon mobile manipulation in household environments. Experiments show that the SERF VLA policy outperforms image-only baselines, reaches subgoals faster by following more direct trajectories, improves robustness to scene-configuration shifts, and recovers from object-drop failures.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出SERF——一种在线更新的空间-时间特征图，把环境（用物体级刚性跟踪建模）和机器人本体（用运动学建模）统一编码为共享隐空间中的神经点，作为VLA策略的状态输入，从而提升长程移动操作任务中的定位、环境变化感知和任务进度推理能力。
analysis.org: 加州大学圣地亚哥分校
analysis.claim: 将环境与机器人本体联合建模为可在线更新的共享spatiotemporal神经点特征图（SERF），能显著提升VLA策略在长时序移动操作任务中的推理鲁棒性与轨迹效率。

papers.title: SimWeaver: Zero-Shot RGB Sim-to-Real for Deformable Manipulation
papers.abstract: RGB sim-to-real for deformable manipulation has remained largely unsolved without real-world fine-tuning. We present SimWeaver, which trains zero-shot RGB VLA policies on 200 simulated demonstrations per task, reaching above 80% per-task and 91% average real-world success across 5 diverse deformable tasks including plastic-bag manipulation, without teleoperation or per-task calibration. SimWeaver combines a reliable measurement-backed simulator (SimWeaver-Sim) with an extensible asset framework supporting single-image generation(SimWeaver-Asset), a deterministic topology-aware trajectory synthesizer (SimWeaver-Syn), and a sim-to-real protocol with ISP-aware photometric augmentation (SimWeaver-Real). On silk grasping, the sim-trained policy reaches 100% under visual distribution shifts where real-data baselines drop to 9-70%, at two orders of magnitude lower per-trajectory cost. We will release SimWeaver and a representative asset subset. Project page: https://simweaver.github.io/

analysis.tldr: 用仅200条仿真演示数据训练视觉语言动作（VLA）策略，不依赖任何真实机器人微调，直接在5种软体物体（如塑料袋、丝绸）操作任务上实现平均91%的真实世界成功率。

papers.title: Object-Centric Residual RL for Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real VLA Enhancement
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models can generalize across diverse manipulation tasks, but their imitation-learning-based policies remain brittle in precise physical interactions due to compounding execution errors; Can a reinforcement learning policy trained purely in simulation improve the robustness of real-world VLAs zero-shot? Residual RL, which learns a corrective policy on top of a frozen VLA, offers a natural framework, but existing approaches face a fundamental sim-to-real dilemma: privileged-state methods require lossy distillation for deployment; image-based methods suffer from the visual domain gap; and real-world RL is costly and unsafe. We propose an object-centric residual RL framework that refines VLA actions using object poses, enabling a compact observation space that transfers consistently between simulation and reality. To align the two domains, we additionally replay the same teleoperation demonstrations in simulation to train a sim counterpart of the real-world VLA. The residual RL policy is trained only in simulation with pose noise injection and dropout, and transfers zero-shot to the real robot. Across five manipulation tasks on a real Franka Research 3 (FR3) robot, our method improves the success rate from 42% to 76% zero-shot, and the improved rollouts can be further reused to retrain the base VLA for self-improvement without additional teleoperation. Project page: https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/research/articles/object-centric-residual-rl/

analysis.tldr: 用仿真中训练的、以物体位姿为输入的残差强化学习策略，直接修正冻结的视觉语言动作（VLA）模型输出，在不接触真实机器人的情况下，将5个操作任务的成功率从42%提升至76%，且能用修正后的轨迹反哺VLA自迭代。
analysis.claim: 仅靠仿真训练的物体位姿驱动的残差RL策略，可零样本迁移至真实机器人，显著增强冻结VLA模型的物理交互鲁棒性，并支持闭环自改进。
analysis.input: 物体6D位姿（仿真与真实中对齐）、冻结VLA输出的动作指令
analysis.output: 残差动作修正量（Δa）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人上的初始VLA演示数据（用于构建基线），但残差RL训练完全不用真实机器人交互数据；后续自改进阶段复用真实 rollout，但非训练必需

papers.title: Scaling Short-Term Memory of Visuomotor Policies for Long-Horizon Tasks
papers.abstract: Many robotic tasks require short-term memory, whether it's retrieving an object that's no longer visible or turning off an appliance after a set period. Yet, most visuomotor policies trained via imitation learning rely only on immediate sensory input without using past experiences to guide decisions. We present PRISM, a transformer-based architecture for visuomotor policies to effectively use short-term memory via two key components: (i) gated attention, which filters retrieved information to suppress irrelevant details, improving performance by reducing the spurious correlations between the history and current action prediction, (ii) a hierarchical architecture that first compresses local information into compact tokens and then integrates them to capture temporally extended dependencies, improving its compute and memory footprint. Together, these mechanisms enable us to scale short-term memory in visuomotor policies for up to two minutes. To systematically evaluate memory in visuomotor control, we introduce ReMemBench -- a benchmark of eight diverse household manipulation tasks spanning four categories of short-term memory -- designed to foster general memory mechanisms rather than siloed, task-specific solutions. PRISM consistently outperforms prior works, including recurrent architectures, transformers, and their variants -- achieving an absolute improvement of 5%--12% over the strongest baseline. On the RoboCasa and LIBERO benchmarks, it achieves absolute improvements of 11%--15% over its no-memory variant and fine-tuned Vision-Language-Action baselines such as GR00T-N1-3B and OpenVLA, despite not leveraging any large-scale pretraining. Together, PRISM and ReMemBench establish a foundation for developing and evaluating short-term memory-augmented visuomotor policies that scale to long-horizon tasks. Additional materials are available at https://shahrutav.github.io/short-term-memory

analysis.tldr: 提出PRISM模型（带门控注意力和分层压缩的视觉运动策略Transformer），让机器人能在长达2分钟的任务中有效利用短时记忆，并构建了首个专用于评测短时记忆能力的基准ReMemBench（8个家庭操作任务），在多个标准benchmark上显著超越无记忆基线及大模型微调方法。
analysis.claim: 通过门控注意力与分层时间压缩机制，可将视觉运动策略的短时记忆能力可靠扩展至两分钟量级，且无需大规模预训练即可在长程家庭操作任务中取得显著提升。
analysis.input: RGB视频帧序列+动作历史（可能含状态/指令）
analysis.output: 动作序列（连续控制或离散动作块）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真环境（RoboCasa/LIBERO）及部分真实机器人数据（摘要未明说但ReMemBench设计含real-robot适配性）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真数据为主；真实机器人数据使用情况未在摘要中说明，仅提ReMemBench‘designed to foster general memory mechanisms’，未声明是否含真实数据集

papers.title: TactSpace: Learning a Physics-enriched Shared Latent Space for Tactile Sim-to-Real Transfer
papers.abstract: Tactile sensing provides direct measurements of contact interactions that are essential for robotic manipulation. However, current simulators lack the fidelity to faithfully model the complex deformation and transduction mechanics of tactile sensors, severely hindering sim-to-real transfer in robot learning pipelines. To address this challenge, we propose a multi-modal representation learning framework that aligns heterogeneous tactile modalities within a shared latent space, eliminating the need for accurate raw-signal simulation while preserving relevant contact information. Our approach employs modality-specific encoders to project diverse tactile observations, such as simulated penetration depth and real-world capacitance, into a common embedding space. The model is trained using self- and cross-reconstruction objectives alongside contrastive alignment, encouraging modality-invariant yet information-rich representations. We evaluate the learned embeddings on indenter shape identification, force prediction, and geometric reconstruction tasks, training exclusively in simulation and testing directly on real sensor measurements. Our results demonstrate zero-shot sim-to-real transfer across physically dissimilar representations. Furthermore, incorporating multi-physics simulation modalities yields more informative embeddings that transfer across diverse downstream tasks, demonstrating a 16.7% reduction in force prediction error and a 45.8% reduction in shape reconstruction error. Finally, we release an efficient Warp-based implementation of a penalty-based tactile simulation model for Isaac Lab, enabling scalable tactile data generation.

analysis.tldr: 提出TactSpace框架，通过多模态自监督学习将仿真中的穿透深度和真实电容式触觉信号映射到同一隐空间，实现无需真实数据训练、直接在真实传感器上零样本迁移的触觉感知任务（如形状识别、力预测、几何重建）。
analysis.claim: 无需高保真触觉仿真建模，仅靠跨模态隐空间对齐即可实现触觉信号的零样本sim-to-real迁移。
analysis.input: 仿真穿透深度图 + 真实电容触觉图像/序列
analysis.output: 共享隐向量（用于下游形状识别/力预测/几何重建）
analysis.robot_dependency: Panda机械臂 + TacTip/SoftTrack等电容触觉传感器
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实触觉数据用于评估，但训练完全不用真实数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统性验证了‘物理启发的共享隐空间’可绕过触觉仿真建模瓶颈，在多个真实触觉任务上实现零样本迁移，有扎实的多任务消融、跨模态对比和开源仿真器支持；但未部署于闭环控制，也未解决动态交互下的时序泛化，尚未达到RT-2或AlphaFold级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅：实证充分、开源完整、问题关键，显著推进触觉sim-to-real，但仍是表征层突破，未进入闭环灵巧操作层级

papers.title: Assistron: Bayesian Shared Autonomy with Off-the-shelf Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: We propose Assistron, a shared autonomy model that leverages Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models to assist the user in daily activities. Our approach is grounded in two core principles: (1)~minimizing human cognitive and physical effort by leveraging VLA-driven autonomy for macro-movements, and (2)~prioritizing human intervention specifically at critical failure points. Driven by the user's verbal language commands, Assistron utilizes the VLA to autonomously execute macro-reaching trajectories, saving users' effort. In contact-rich interactions where VLAs tend to fail, Assistron employs a phase-aware interaction detection mechanism and solicits the user to intervene, in turn adjusting the VLA's action generation via flow matching guidance. Critically, our formulation eliminates the need for VLA fine-tuning, protecting its broad behavioral priors from catastrophic forgetting and ensuring the model does not become a narrow specialist. We validate our approach on a comprehensive multi-task scene recovery benchmark encompassing diverse daily manipulation skills. Empirical results demonstrate that Assistron significantly improves task success rates over pure autonomous baselines while significantly reducing human cognitive and physical workload compared to traditional teleoperation, offering a scalable, smooth, and effortless paradigm for assistive manipulation. The code is available in https://github.com/mousecpn/Assistron.git.

analysis.tldr: 提出Assistron框架，用现成的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型做共享自主辅助操作：让VLA自动完成大范围抓取等宏观动作，而在接触密集的关键失败点（如插拔、推挤）主动暂停并请求人手干预，再用流匹配（flow matching）引导VLA修正动作，全程不微调VLA模型。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露；Pinhao Song等名无明确机构指向，GitHub仓库mousecpn非知名机构缩写，暂判unknown）

papers.title: Cortex: A Bidirectionally Aligned Embodied Agent Framework for Long-horizon Manipulation
papers.abstract: While recent Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models show promise toward generalist manipulation policies, they struggle with long-horizon tasks due to their Markovian nature-relying solely on current observations. Hierarchical dual-system methods address this but suffer from a gap between high-level planning semantics and low-level execution kinematics. We introduce Cortex, a bidirectionally aligned embodied agent framework with a customized planning interface that conveys executable and tractable subtask plans from high-level VLM to low-level VLA. Specifically, we standardize manipulation subtasks into 32 canonical skill primitives and inject tractability principles, such as representative object attributes and improved trajectory reachability, into the data generation pipeline. This enables automatic annotation of over 4k hours of open-source video data and generation of 30 hours of simulation data. We further devise an event-balanced sampling strategy to construct training data for fine-tuning the framework to better handle planning ambiguity during subtask transitions, enhanced by carefully designed harness engineering from task contexts to skill constraints during inference. Both open-loop VLM and closed-loop system evaluations demonstrate Cortex's efficacy, e.g., it outperforms monolithic baselines by 3.1% on Libero-long and 4.1% on RoboTwin. Notably, Cortex's generalist VLM enables zero-shot completion of unseen real-world long-horizon tasks, such as multi-stage chemistry experiments, by simply combining with a fine-tuned VLA-a capability infeasible through VLA fine-tuning alone.

analysis.tldr: 提出Cortex框架，通过将高层视觉语言模型（VLM）与底层视觉语言动作模型（VLA）双向对齐，用32种标准化技能原语桥接规划语义与执行运动学，自动标注4000+小时开源视频并生成30小时仿真数据，支持零样本完成真实世界多阶段化学实验等长程操作任务。
analysis.claim: 双向对齐的VLM-VLA架构能弥合长程操作中高层规划语义与低层执行运动学之间的鸿沟，并通过标准化技能原语和可追溯性注入实现零样本泛化到真实长程任务。
analysis.input: RGB视频帧+自然语言任务指令
analysis.output: 分阶段技能原语序列+对应低层动作轨迹
