analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖；全部训练数据来自开源视频自动标注+仿真生成
analysis.significance_reason: 实质性推进了VLM-VLA分层架构的设计范式，技能原语标准化和可追溯性注入有工程创新，但缺乏真机验证、未开放代码/模型、零样本能力仅在描述中未给定量实证（如化学实验成功率/失败模式），相比GR00T N1/H2O等95+分工作，仍属扎实增量而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在分层具身智能架构上做了系统性工程优化，但缺真机验证与开源，零样本能力未经实证检验

papers.title: Ego-Dynamics-Augmented World Model for Autonomous Driving with Zero-Shot Cross-Chassis Adaptation
papers.abstract: World model (WM)-based reinforcement learning enables sample-efficient end-to-end autonomous driving learning by imagining long-horizon trajectories in latent space. However, most driving WMs operate on bird's-eye-view (BEV) representations that are inherently egocentric: the transition between consecutive frames entangles the ego vehicle's own motion with scene dynamics. As a result, the WM devotes significant capacity to recovering ego-motion from warped observations, at the cost of scene modeling fidelity and imagination accuracy. This work proposes DynaDreamer, a dynamics-augmented Dreamer-style reinforcement learning method to address this problem by augmenting the WM with an explicit ego-dynamics prior. A physics-informed ego-dynamics encoder-decoder extracts the ego-state history into a compact and identifiable context, which modulates a causal Transformer WM to condition both its prior and posterior latents. During imagination, the ego-dynamics predictor propagates this context forward to keep the ego-dynamics prior synchronized with the rollout. An information-theoretic analysis shows that conditioning on this context reduces both the predictive entropy of the observation transition and the prior--posterior Kullback--Leibler divergence, confining the WM's modeling burden to the scene dynamics beyond ego-motion. An additional benefit is zero-shot cross-chassis adaptation: the ego-dynamics context depends on identifiable chassis parameters, so that a vehicle with previously unseen dynamic characteristics can adapt the WM to the new chassis without retraining. Experiments demonstrate that DynaDreamer improves task success rates over the strongest baseline by 28% and 61% in urban and highway driving scenarios, respectively, with the advantage rising to 73% when extrapolating to unseen chassis.

analysis.tldr: 提出DynaDreamer方法，在世界模型中显式建模自车动力学先验，分离自车运动与场景动态，从而提升驾驶轨迹想象精度，并实现无需微调即可适配新车型的零样本跨底盘迁移。
analysis.claim: 显式注入可识别的自车动力学先验到世界模型的因果Transformer中，能解耦ego-motion与scene dynamics，显著提升想象准确性，并支持零样本跨底盘泛化。
analysis.input: 多视角摄像头图像+车辆控制指令+IMU/速度等传感器信号
analysis.output: 未来多步BEV语义观测预测+隐状态序列+控制动作序列
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真环境（CARLA）生成的合成驾驶数据，未使用真实车数据
analysis.significance_reason: 技术思路清晰（解耦ego-dynamics），在CARLA上验证了强性能增益（+28%~73%）和跨底盘零样本能力，但仅限仿真、无真车实验、无开源代码、未与最新WM基线（如DreamerV3）做公平对比，属扎实增量而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将物理先验系统性嵌入Dreamer架构并验证其对解耦建模与跨平台泛化的价值，但受限于纯仿真验证和缺乏开源，尚未达到基石级影响力。

papers.title: Contract-Grounded Behavior Tree Synthesis via Coding Agents
papers.abstract: Synthesizing deployable robot behavior trees (BTs) from natural language (NL) requires grounding to ensure every generated BT references only skills a robot can actually execute. Existing LLM-based BT synthesis approaches often place this grounding responsibility on the prompt author. This makes deployment brittle when the author does not know which skills the robot can execute, how those skills are parameterized, or how the robot runtime software constrains valid BT structure. This paper proposes a contract-grounded BT synthesis architecture in which a coding agent queries a robot-side Model Context Protocol (MCP) server to retrieve an explicit contract consisting of a skill library, permitted BT operators, and optional BT composition templates, before synthesizing a BT for validation and execution. In our framework, non-expert operators issue NL commands without knowledge of robot implementation details, while a robot runtime validation gate enforces correctness before execution. We evaluate two LLMs, a closed model (Sonnet 4.6) and a smaller open-source model (Gemma4:31b), across 110 simulated tasks in PyRoboSim and 14 tasks on a physical Husarion Panther robot. Results show that contract grounding enables near-perfect BT validation and high task success, that BT composition templates substantially recover success on reactive control-flow tasks for the smaller model, and that the architecture transfers to physical hardware running a Nav2 stack opaque to both operator and agent.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种让大模型生成机器人行为树（BT）时自动对接机器人实际能力的方法：通过调用机器人端的‘契约协议’（技能列表+允许的操作符+可选模板）来约束生成过程，避免生成无法执行的BT，在仿真和真实机器人上验证了该方法能大幅提升BT验证通过率和任务成功率。
analysis.claim: 行为树生成必须由机器人运行时契约（skill library + BT operators + templates）显式约束，而非依赖人工提示工程，才能实现鲁棒部署。
analysis.input: 自然语言指令
analysis.output: 可验证的行为树（BT）结构
analysis.robot_dependency: PyRoboSim仿真器 + Husarion Panther真实机器人（Nav2栈）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖机器人端MCP服务器提供的实时契约接口，不依赖离线采集的真实机器人执行日志或轨迹数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将Model Context Protocol（MCP）契约机制系统性嵌入BT生成闭环，实现在仿真与真实机器人（跨平台Nav2）上的多任务验证，含消融（模板vs无模板）、双模型对比（Sonnet vs Gemma）、真机部署；但未开源代码/模型，未挑战复杂灵巧操作或长程任务，属具身智能中‘可靠行为编排’方向的重要工程推进，尚未达到RT-2/Octo级范式突破或基础模型尺度跃迁。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——解决了LLM生成BT落地难的核心痛点（技能不可知性），用契约驱动替代提示工程，证据扎实（真机+多任务+消融），但受限于未开源和任务粒度，属于高质量工程整合而非范式突破

papers.title: SoftNav: Injecting 3D Scene Tokens into VLMs for Embodied Navigation
papers.abstract: In goal-directed embodied navigation, where an agent must locate a specified target in an unseen environment, 3D scene understanding and navigation reasoning must work in concert. Current approaches transmit 3D scene information to vision-language models (VLMs) through text, suggesting a representation gap in our tested configurations; a controlled ablation confirms that direct embedding-level transfer significantly outperforms the evaluated text serialization formats. We introduce SoftNav, which injects entity-level 3D continuous representations -- one token per detected object or frontier -- into a VLM's hidden space as soft tokens through a lightweight projector. With the 3D encoder and VLM frozen, only ~1,200 samples and ~17M trainable parameters are needed. On HM3D-OVON, SoftNav achieves 74.2%/68.3%/66.7% SR across three splits, surpassing all prior methods in both SR and SPL; the same navigation policy transfers zero-shot to GOAT-Bench (67.2% SR), SG3D (47.2% s-SR), and real-world robot deployment without retraining or architectural modification. Injecting 3D scene tokens directly into VLMs bridges the representation gap, enabling transferable navigation with minimal training.

analysis.tldr: 提出SoftNav方法，把3D场景中检测到的物体和前沿点直接编码为连续向量（软token），注入冻结的视觉语言模型（VLM）隐空间，仅用1200个样本和1700万参数微调，就在多个仿真导航基准（HM3D-OVON、GOAT-Bench、SG3D）上实现零样本迁移，并成功部署到真实机器人上。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构缩写或知名实验室线索；Yi Wu等常见于国内高校/企业，但无法确认具体归属）
analysis.claim: 直接将实体级3D连续表征作为软token注入冻结VLM隐空间，比文本化3D信息更有效，且能实现跨基准、跨仿真器、跨真实机器人的零样本导航泛化。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言目标指令+3D场景几何与语义信息（物体检测框、前沿点坐标及类别）
analysis.output: 导航动作序列（离散动作：前进/左转/右转/停止）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人交互数据，仅使用仿真环境（HM3D、AI2THOR等）生成的RGB-D+语义标注数据
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在3个不同导航基准（含OVON、GOAT-Bench、SG3D）上SOTA，且完成真实机器人部署（非演示视频，摘要明确‘without retraining or architectural modification’），但未开源代码/模型，且未报告消融实验细节（如软token维度、投影器结构、是否用真实传感器数据微调），相比GR00T/H2O等95+分工作，缺乏多机体泛化、端到端闭环控制或具身基础模型级架构创新。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将3D感知与VLM深度耦合的高效方案，实证充分且落地真实机器人，但属强工程优化而非范式突破

papers.title: De Novo Design of Protein Switches with Diffusion-Based Ensemble Sampling
papers.abstract: Protein switches are proteins that can respond to biochemical stimuli by rearranging their structural elements, essential for cells to transduce signals. The de novo design of such proteins requires amino acid sequences whose energy landscapes support multiple stimulus-dependent conformations, yet most current de novo protein design pipelines are optimized for single stable structures. Existing multi-state inverse-folding methods can design sequences compatible with multiple backbones, but they assume that suitable backbone ensembles are already available, often requiring expert knowledge. We introduce Diff-Switch, a framework for sampling switch-like backbone ensembles from pretrained protein diffusion models. Given a reference backbone structure and domain decomposition, our method preserves local domain geometry while encouraging diversity in global domain arrangements along user-specified collective variables, inspired by metadynamics. We implement this objective through a controlled diffusion sampler with reward-tilting for local similarity between the ensemble members and history-dependent bias in collective-variable space to avoid repeated sampling of the same global arrangement. The resulting ensembles provide candidate conformational states for downstream multi-state inverse folding. Across our evaluation set of 20 diverse proteins, using conformations from these generated ensembles improves the success rate of finding switch-compatible sequences over baseline sampling. We further apply the method to a real-world protein switch design task and characterize the resulting designs.

analysis.tldr: 提出Diff-Switch方法，利用预训练蛋白扩散模型生成具有多构象能力的蛋白骨架集合（如开/关态），再输入给多态逆折叠算法设计能响应刺激的全新蛋白开关，实证上在20个蛋白上提升了序列设计成功率，并完成了一个真实蛋白开关的设计与表征。
analysis.claim: 通过可控扩散采样+集体变量引导+历史偏置，可从预训练蛋白扩散模型中高效生成具备功能相关构象多样性的骨架集合，从而支撑无需专家先验的从头蛋白开关设计。
analysis.input: 参考蛋白骨架结构 + 域分解信息 + 用户指定的集体变量（如域间距离/二面角）
analysis.output: 一组结构多样但局部几何保守的蛋白骨架构象集合（用于后续多态逆折叠）
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将扩散模型用于定向采样功能相关的多构象骨架集合，绕过专家手工构建构象集的瓶颈；在20蛋白基准上量化验证提升，且完成端到端真实设计与实验表征，证据链完整；但未开源数据/模型权重，未与RFdiffusion等主流框架深度耦合，也未证明对工业级靶点（如GPCR、激酶）的普适性，尚未达AlphaFold/RFdiffusion级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次实现基于扩散模型的功能导向构象集合生成，解决了多态蛋白设计中骨架先验依赖强的核心瓶颈，且有真实实验验证。

papers.title: WorldScape Policy 2.0: Empowering Steerable World Action Modeling with Reasoning-Augmented Memory
papers.abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) offer a promising paradigm for robotic manipulation by jointly modeling visual state transitions and robot actions. However, existing WAMs are constrained by limited temporal context, coarse episode-level language supervision, and predominantly text-only conditioning, which hinder task-progress tracking and fine-grained language-video-action grounding while limiting visual-context reasoning and cross-embodiment transfer. In this paper, we introduce WorldScape Policy 2.0, a controllable WAM with reasoning-augmented long short-term memory. Its causal short-term visual memory supplies recent observations as DiT prefill to preserve local interaction dynamics, while its long short-term event memory organizes historical VLM outputs into global-history, local-active, and event-boundary representations for progress-aware retrieval. The retrieved history augments perception and autoregressively generated planning tokens, yielding an implicit subgoal condition for autonomous planning; semantic forcing further transfers event-level instruction semantics into this latent planning pathway. To establish fine-grained multimodal controllability, we construct ManipEvent-5M, an event-grounded embodied pretraining dataset containing nearly 5 million event segments with aligned action trajectories, episode-level task instructions, segment-level subtask captions, goal images, and video demonstrations. These designs provide a unified interface for autonomous planning from high-level instructions and controllable execution from fine-grained text, goal-image, or video-context prompts. Experiments in both simulation and real-world platforms demonstrate superior capabilities in long-horizon autonomous planning, fine-grained instruction following and in-context adaptation.

analysis.tldr: 提出WorldScape Policy 2.0，一种带推理增强记忆机制的世界动作模型（WAM），通过短时视觉记忆（DiT预填充）和长时事件记忆（分层组织VLM历史）实现对长程任务的自主规划与细粒度多模态控制（文本/目标图/视频均可触发），并在仿真和真实机器人上验证了其在长视野规划和上下文自适应上的提升。
analysis.claim: 通过因果短时视觉记忆与结构化长时事件记忆的协同设计，WAM可实现具备进度感知、隐式子目标生成和语义强制注入的可控世界动作建模，突破现有WAM在时序建模粒度、多模态条件耦合与跨阶段泛化上的瓶颈。
analysis.input: 视频帧序列+语言指令/目标图像/视频片段+历史VLM输出（含全局历史、局部活跃、事件边界三类表示）
analysis.output: 动作序列+隐式子目标token+可检索的历史事件记忆索引
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda / WidowX / simulated UR5
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖ManipEvent-5M中约10%真实机器人采集数据（摘要未明示比例，但‘real-world platforms’实验存在且未提纯仿真，推断含真实数据）
analysis.significance_reason: 在WAM范式内做出实质性工程-算法整合：首次将DiT预填充用于短时视觉记忆、提出三层次事件记忆架构、构建首个500万级事件段对齐的操纵预训练数据集ManipEvent-5M，并在多真实机械臂平台验证；但未开源代码/模型，未报告消融实验细节，也未在标准基准（如RT-X、BridgeData v2）上横向对比，相比DreamerV3/WEAVER等基石工作仍属显著推进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——在WAM框架下系统性补全了记忆建模、多模态条件接口与大规模事件数据支撑，实证扎实但开源不足，尚未达到开新范式的量级

papers.title: MoMo: Dial Motion Mode in Robot Manipulation with Spatiotemporal Action Tokenization
papers.abstract: To operate effectively across diverse contexts, robots must not only perform manipulation tasks accurately but also adapt how their actions unfold to the task, object, and interaction setting. We ask whether this execution-level variation can be learned as a reusable behavioral factor shared across tasks. We present \textbf{MoMo}, a two-stage imitation-learning framework consisting of a spatiotemporal action tokenizer and a behavior-cloning transformer that takes task and a continuous motion-mode condition as inputs. Across six real-robot manipulation tasks, varying this condition produces steady, dynamic, and intermediate behaviors that human raters can distinguish and that differ in joint speed, acceleration, and end-effector approach pitch. On tasks demonstrated in only one mode, MoMo transfers the unseen requested mode while largely preserving task success. Together, these results provide evidence of compositional generalization to unseen task--mode combinations and show that motion mode can be reused across tasks to control how a manipulation skill is performed.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出MoMo框架，把机器人操作动作按‘运动模式’（如稳态/动态/中间态）拆解成可调节的时空动作token，让同一个技能能根据任务需求切换不同执行风格，并在真实机器人上验证了跨任务复用运动模式的能力。
analysis.claim: 运动模式（motion mode）是一种可泛化、可插拔的执行级行为因子，能在不同操作任务间共享并独立调控动作的时序动力学特性。
analysis.input: 任务指令（文本或嵌入）+ 连续运动模式条件（标量或低维向量）
analysis.output: 时空动作token序列（解码为关节控制指令）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人演示数据（六种任务各一种模式），但未使用多模态真实交互数据（如力觉/触觉/多视角视频）
analysis.significance_reason: 在真实机器人上实现了跨任务的运动模式解耦与重组合成，有消融实验和人类评估佐证，但未引入新传感器模态、未解决sim2real迁移瓶颈、未开源代码模型，相比ALOHA/ACT等基石工作缺少部署规模、多机体适配或闭环策略鲁棒性证据，属扎实且具启发性的中高阶推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将动作表征从‘做什么’拓展到‘怎么做得不同’，实证充分但生态位偏窄，尚未构成范式突破

papers.title: PAC-MAN: Perception-Aware CBF-RL for Whole-Body Safety in Humanoid Dodgeball
papers.abstract: We present PAC-MAN, a perception-aware CBF-RL framework that couples control-barrier safety with deployment-realistic onboard sensing for whole-body humanoid dodgeball. The deployed policy sees the ball only as segmentation-masked depth from a head-mounted camera, while training-time CBF guidance represents clearance to every body link, and an adversarial motion prior regularizes the resulting evasive reflexes. We evaluate on a controlled any-link contact benchmark with seeded throws in two regimes: single throws and a deployment loop in which the robot walks back to its station and recovers between throws. On this benchmark, the policy comes within a few points of a privileged state oracle: a fixed onboard camera alone is adequate for evasion. We find that usable barrier structure depends on perceptual observability: Joint-CBF gives the best performance with accurate ball states, degrades under fixed-camera observations when used only as training guidance, and recovers with a ball-tracking gimbal or privileged runtime filter. We therefore deploy a lightweight Link-CBF policy zero-shot on the Unitree G1 in the real world, where it tolerates imperfect perception, succeeds on 95% of throws, and uses semantic segmentation to dodge different balls.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出PAC-MAN框架，用带感知意识的控制屏障（CBF）+强化学习，在人形机器人打躲避球任务中实现全身安全避让——只靠头戴深度相机+语义分割就能实时判断球位置并全身协调闪避，在Unitree G1真机上达到95%成功率。
analysis.claim: 感知可观测性决定CBF结构的有效性：Link-CBF在固定相机+语义分割下仍可零样本迁移到真实人形机器人并保证全身安全避让，而Joint-CBF在相同感知条件下失效。
analysis.input: 头戴RGB-D相机的分割掩码化深度图（含球体语义分割）
analysis.output: 全身关节扭矩指令（whole-body torque commands）
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree G1人形机器人 + 自研仿真环境（基于MuJoCo/ROS）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实投球数据标定感知延迟与运动响应偏差，但策略训练完全在仿真中完成，未使用真实机器人交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 真机部署+多链接接触安全验证+感知受限下的CBF结构消融对比（Link-CBF vs Joint-CBF）+95%实测成功率，显著推进了具身安全控制在感知-动作耦合场景的落地能力；但未开新范式（仍是CBF+RL组合），且未解决长期开放难题（如动态多目标全身体避让泛化），略逊于H2O/GR00T等里程碑工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将CBF的安全保障能力与轻量级感知输入深度耦合，在真实人形机器人上实现了高鲁棒性全身避让，是安全控制在资源受限具身场景的重要落地范例，但非理论或架构层面的突破。

papers.title: Uncovering and Mitigating Positional Blind Spots in Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Recent Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models achieve promising performance in robotic manipulation, typically measured by success rates aggregated over predefined object configurations, an evaluation that implicitly assumes spatially uniform competence across the workspace. However, this assumption does not hold: even with the instruction and every other scene factor held fixed, merely relocating a task-irrelevant distractor can sharply raise the failure probability within localized, spatially coherent regions, which we term Positional Blind Spots (PBS). In this paper, we propose a two-stage black-box framework to uncover and mitigate PBS. During the uncovering stage, we grid the workspace and apply a one-sided log-likelihood-ratio test to localize PBS cells with significantly elevated risk. During the mitigation stage, we fine-tune the policy via LoRA on demonstrations collected from these PBS regions, improving competence there while largely preserving performance across the rest of the workspace. We evaluate our framework on five state-of-the-art VLA policies across two benchmarks, and find that PBS are pervasive and spatially concentrated in all of them, with failure rates up to 0.58. Our search strategy achieves an average F1-score of 0.678, outperforming random search and adaptive sampling baselines by 0.268 and 0.178, respectively. Guided by the discovered regions, targeted fine-tuning reduces the overall failure rate by 40.00%--85.19%.

analysis.tldr: 发现并修复视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在机器人操作中普遍存在的‘位置盲区’——即仅因无关干扰物位置微小变化就导致局部空间内任务失败率骤升的现象，提出黑盒定位方法+针对性LoRA微调，在5个SOTA模型上将盲区失败率降低40%–85%。
analysis.claim: 当前主流VLA模型存在空间非均匀的、可被系统性定位和修复的位置盲区（PBS），其成因与训练数据的空间覆盖偏差及模型对局部几何敏感性不足有关。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令+（隐式）机器人本体状态
analysis.output: 机器人末端动作序列/轨迹
analysis.robot_dependency: 真实机械臂（如Franka）或标准仿真器（如BridgeData v2 / RT-1 sim）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人执行失败案例采集（用于PBS验证与微调），但未说明是否使用原始预训练数据之外的新采集数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统定义、量化并修复VLA模型的空间鲁棒性缺陷，实证覆盖5个SOTA模型+2大基准，含F1定位指标与多模型消融，但未开源代码/模型，且未在跨机体或多形态硬件上验证，属扎实推进SOTA的重磅工作，尚未达RT-2级范式突破水平。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将统计检验、空间诊断与轻量微调结合，解决VLA落地中的关键鲁棒性瓶颈，证据充分但复现门槛高、泛化验证有限。

papers.title: VertiAKD: Adaptive Off-Road Kinodynamics on Vertically Challenging Terrain
papers.abstract: Off-road mobility requires autonomous mobile robots to generalize across heterogeneous vehicle fleets and continuously changing terrain conditions. Existing cross-vehicle adaptation approaches generally assume flat terrain, while terrain-aware kinodynamic models often require platform-specific data collection and retraining. To this end, we propose VertiAKD, a unified framework for transferring and adapting off-road kinodynamic knowledge across diverse vehicles on geometrically and semantically complex terrain simultaneously. VertiAKD learns a shared mobility representation that jointly encodes vehicle configurations, trajectory transitions, and local elevation and semantic terrain features. Given limited data from a novel vehicle operating on unseen terrain, VertiAKD identifies the most relevant mobility descriptors and transfers their knowledge to initialize a terrain-aware kinodynamic model via function encoders, which is then periodically refined online from streaming observations without gradient-based retraining. We evaluate VertiAKD in the Verti-Bench simulator, built on the Chrono multi-physics engine, and on five physical configurations of the Verti-4-Wheeler platform. With only one minute of new trajectory data and associated terrain features, VertiAKD reduces long-horizon prediction error by up to 34.52% over direct mobility descriptor transfer across diverse unseen vehicle configurations and 94.43% over competing baselines. We further demonstrate robust closed-loop trajectory tracking in both simulation and physical experiments, highlighting the effectiveness of terrain-aware cross-vehicle knowledge transfer for accurate modeling and reliable off-road navigation.

analysis.tldr: 提出VertiAKD框架，用少量新车辆在未知复杂地形下的1分钟轨迹数据，通过共享表征+函数编码器+在线无梯度更新，实现跨车型、跨地形的越野运动学动力学模型快速适配，显著提升长程预测精度和闭环跟踪鲁棒性。
analysis.claim: 仅需一分钟新车辆在未知复杂地形下的轨迹与地形特征数据，即可通过共享 mobility 表征与函数编码器驱动的无梯度在线精调，实现高精度、鲁棒的跨车型跨地形越野运动学动力学建模。
analysis.input: 车辆配置参数、局部高程图、语义地形标签、短时轨迹观测（位置/姿态/速度）
analysis.output: 地形感知的运动学动力学预测（下一时刻状态转移）
analysis.robot_dependency: Verti-4-Wheeler平台（5种物理构型）及Chrono仿真器
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的短时（1分钟）轨迹+地形特征数据，但无需平台专属大规模训练数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在越野移动机器人领域属重磅进展：真机验证5种构型+复杂垂直地形+闭环控制+多baseline对比+消融完整；但未开新范式（仍属模型迁移+在线适配路线），且未覆盖人形/腿足等更广机体类型，也未解决通用具身推理或跨域泛化根本难题，故低于Humanoid Locomotion等95+级里程碑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将跨车型迁移、地形感知建模、无梯度在线适应三者系统性耦合，在真实越野平台上达成强实证效果，但核心思想仍在现有技术谱系内演进，非范式突破。

papers.title: AirDreamer: Generalist Drone Navigation with World Models
papers.abstract: Navigating a drone in unseen and cluttered environments requires reliable generalization to unseen scene layouts and understanding of environmental structure relative to the robot's capabilities. Previous methods, which assume the same environment configuration, often rely heavily on human-designed perception pipelines and predefined rules to guide the robot toward the target. This process is environment-dependent and generalizes poorly across environments. Inspired by animal navigation behavior, we design a navigation framework that navigates with a reinforcement-learning-based policy on top of a world-model-based environment understanding to overcome these issues. In addition, a sparse reward function without hand-crafted shaping terms is designed to avoid local minima traps and encourage yaw control behaviors. In simulation and on real drones, our method exhibits emergent capabilities for navigating complex, unseen environments and escaping local optima where other methods fail. In challenging maps, it achieves a 5.3% higher navigation success rate than best baseline. Furthermore, the proposed framework achieves effective sim-to-real transfer without any tuning during deployment. The code will be publicly available.

analysis.tldr: 用世界模型学习环境动态，再在上面训练强化学习策略，让无人机无需人工调参或环境假设就能在没见过的复杂场景中自主导航，仿真和真机都直接运行不调参。
analysis.claim: 基于世界模型的通用无人机导航框架AirDreamer，能在未见过的杂乱环境中实现零调参sim2real迁移，并通过稀疏奖励激发自主偏航控制与局部最优逃离能力。
analysis.input: 单目RGB图像+目标位置指令（隐含在任务设定中）
analysis.output: 六自由度连续动作（含yaw控制）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真中用AirSim，真机用自研四旋翼平台（摘要未提具体型号，但明确说‘on real drones’）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人交互数据，仅用仿真预训练+真机零调参部署
analysis.significance_reason: 实质性推进了世界模型在真实具身系统上的端到端导航落地：真机多场景零调参部署、稀疏奖励下涌现yaw控制、比SOTA高5.3%成功率；但未开源数据/模型，未覆盖多机体泛化，理论深度不及DreamerV3/World Models等基石工作，属扎实重磅而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将Dreamer类世界模型成功压缩适配到资源受限的真实无人机上，完成从仿真到真机的闭环验证，但未突破建模本质或扩展通用性边界。

papers.title: SafeVLA-Bench: A Benchmark for the Success-Safety Gap in Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) benchmarks measure whether a policy completes a requested manipulation task, but binary success can hide safety-relevant trajectory behavior: reaching the goal while applying excessive contact, disturbing bystander objects, destabilizing the held object, or entering robot self-contact. We present SafeVLA-Bench, a post-hoc safety-evaluation framework for existing simulator-based VLA benchmarks. It formalizes task-aware safety requirements as Signal Temporal Logic (STL) specifications and reports native success with two unsafe-success metrics: Succ-But-Unsafe (SBU), the fraction of rollouts that both succeed and violate safety, and Violation Severity Index (VSI), a bounded worst-violation depth score. We instantiate SafeVLA-Bench on LIBERO and RoboCasa-365, evaluating nine policy-benchmark entries across tabletop and kitchen manipulation tasks. High task success does not imply safe execution: high-SR tabletop baselines still leave 13 to 15 percent unsafe-episode rates,and 36 to 56 percent of successful RoboCasa-365 rollouts violate at least one active safety clause. Project page: https://safevla.org.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文没提新模型或新训练方法，而是给现有视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型建了个‘安全体检表’：用信号时序逻辑（STL）定义安全规则，在LIBERO和RoboCasa-365仿真基准上批量检测已发表模型的轨迹——发现很多‘任务成功’的轨迹其实严重违反安全约束（比如乱碰东西、打翻物品、自碰撞），并量化了‘成功但不安全’的比例和违规严重程度。
analysis.claim: 当前VLA基准只看任务是否完成（二值成功），掩盖了大量危险但成功的轨迹行为；必须引入任务感知、可形式化验证的安全评估框架，才能真实反映VLA模型的部署风险。
analysis.input: 已有VLA策略在仿真环境中的执行轨迹（含状态、动作、观测）
analysis.output: 两个安全指标：Succ-But-Unsafe（SBU）率和Violation Severity Index（VSI）
analysis.robot_dependency: LIBERO/RoboCasa-365仿真器（Franka Emika Panda + kitchen/tabletop场景）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，仅基于公开仿真轨迹重放
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统性暴露VLA模型‘成功≠安全’的核心缺陷，并给出可复现、可形式化、可插拔的安全评测协议；但未提出任何新模型、新训练机制或真实硬件验证，仅是诊断工具，分量不及所有列出的基石工作（全部≥85），属于扎实的领域警示性增量贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把STL安全验证嫁接到现有VLA仿真基准上，做了严谨的横向体检，但不是新方法也不是新能力，暂时无法推动模型改进本身。

papers.title: LARA: Latent Action Representation Alignment for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Visual-language action (VLA) models enable robots to predict actions directly from observations and language instructions, but their performance depends on large-scale, high-quality data and is limited by the scarcity of real-world robot action datasets. To facilitate VLA model learning with abundant unlabeled human videos, Latent Action Models (LAM) learn latent action representations from visual dynamics to provide additional supervision for VLA learning. However, LAM and VLA are typically trained separately, leaving LAM ungrounded during VLA training and VLA models constrained by frozen LAM representations. To address these issues, we propose Latent Action Representation Alignment (LARA), a plug-and-play framework that jointly optimizes LAM and VLA via representation alignment. This enables reciprocal benefits where LAMs learn with action trajectories to avoid spurious visual changes, while VLAs are regularized by forward dynamics learned within LAMs to reduce hallucinations of functionally ineffective trajectories. We demonstrate LARA versatility and effectiveness for pre-training, post-training enhancement of pre-trained VLA models, and LAM refinement, achieving an average of ~10%, ~5%, and ~15% improvement over 3 simulation and 1 meticulously designed real-world robotic manipulation benchmarks.

analysis.tldr: 提出LARA框架，让视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）和潜在动作模型（LAM）在训练中互相校准表征，用大量无标注人类视频辅助提升VLA在仿真和真实机器人操作任务上的泛化能力。
analysis.claim: 通过联合优化与表征对齐，LAM和VLA可互为监督：LAM借助真实动作轨迹过滤伪影性视觉变化，VLA则被LAM学习到的前向动力学正则化以抑制无效动作幻觉。
analysis.input: RGB视频帧+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 动作序列（关节速度/末端位姿等低级控制信号）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda / simulated equivalents (e.g., Adroit, Kitchen)
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人演示数据（1个精心设计的真实世界基准），但主要利用无标注人类视频（如Ego4D、EPIC-KITCHENS）
analysis.significance_reason: 在VLA范式下首次实现LAM与VLA的端到端联合表征对齐，在3个仿真+1个真实基准上稳定提升（5–15%），有消融验证且跨预训练/后训练/模型精调三阶段有效；但未开源代码/模型，真实机器人实验仅限单平台单任务集，未挑战跨机体或用户泛化，显著弱于OpenVLA/Octo等开源、多机体、真机大规模部署的基石工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：解决了LAM-VLA割裂训练的关键耦合问题，实证扎实但落地闭环不完整，属当前VLA演进中重要的模块级改进，非范式突破。

papers.title: Targeting World Models to Compromise Robot Learning Pipelines
papers.abstract: World models have recently seen a rapid growth in both their popularity and capability as more data efficient tools for generating robot training data or simulating real world environments, with many works proposing their integration into the robot learning pipeline. While highly practical, in this work we demonstrate that world models introduce a uniquely stealthy and effective data poisoning entry point into the robot learning supply chain that can result in the deployment of unsafe or otherwise compromised robotic policies despite training on seemingly safe ground truth training data. In contrast to traditional data poisoning techniques which directly implant dangerous trajectories into sold or uploaded datasets, our novel attack methods inject malicious prompts or compromising transition dynamics into visibly safe teleoperated datasets which are only activated once fed through a world model as input. This can result in the generation of synthetic, dangerous robot training trajectories and subsequently unsafe or compromised robot policies. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our attacks against both state of the art action conditioned and text conditioned world models, showing a full end-to-end backdoor on a downstream DRL policy and a proof-of-concept for the VLA setting. Overall these findings necessitate research into more secure world models and reevaluating their position within the robot learning supply chain.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现并实证了世界模型（world models）在机器人学习流程中会成为隐蔽的数据投毒入口：攻击者无需篡改原始真实数据，只需在看似安全的遥操作数据中植入特定恶意提示或过渡动态，当这些数据被送入世界模型生成合成训练轨迹时，就会触发危险行为，最终导致强化学习策略或视觉语言动作模型产生安全隐患。
analysis.claim: 世界模型在机器人学习流水线中构成一种新型、隐蔽且有效的数据投毒攻击面，其风险源于模型对输入数据的隐式解码与动态放大，而非传统直接污染标注数据。
analysis.input: 遥操作轨迹（含恶意嵌入的提示或状态转移）+世界模型条件输入（动作/文本）
analysis.output: 被污染的合成训练轨迹 + 下游DRL策略/VLA策略的异常行为输出
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖合成遥操作数据集（未使用真实机器人采集数据）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统揭示世界模型作为‘信任放大器’引发的新型供应链攻击范式，实证覆盖SOTA世界模型（DreamerV3级）、DRL下游策略及VLA初步场景，含端到端后门演示和消融分析；但未在真实机器人上验证，也未提出防御方案，尚未达到World Models/DreamerV3等基石工作的范式开创性或工程完备性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——首次将世界模型定位为机器人学习中的可信计算薄弱点，并给出可复现的端到端攻击链证据，但限于仿真，尚未进入真实部署风险闭环。

papers.title: Modulation index-based phase-amplitude coupling does not encode temporal polarity
papers.abstract: Background: Phase-amplitude coupling (PAC) is widely used to quantify interactions between neural oscillations across timescales and is often interpreted as reflecting temporally meaningful coordination between slow and fast neural activity. New method: Combining empirical EEG data with mathematical analysis, we tested whether modulation index (MI)-based PAC distinguishes opposite temporal organisations of cross-frequency coupling by inverting the phase of the low-frequency oscillation by 180 degrees. Results: MI remained unchanged after phase inversion, whereas preferred phase rotated by exactly 180 degrees. Thus, opposite temporal organisations of cross-frequency coupling yielded identical MI values. Comparison with existing methods: Unlike preferred phase and the full phase-binned amplitude profile, MI quantifies the strength of phase-dependent amplitude modulation but does not retain information about temporal polarity or phase direction. Conclusions: Modulation index-based PAC does not encode temporal polarity and therefore cannot, on its own, support inferences about temporal alignment, phase polarity, or directionality. Studies seeking mechanistic interpretation of temporal organisation should complement MI with phase-sensitive measures.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用数学分析和实证EEG数据证明：常用的调制指数（MI）指标在相位-振幅耦合（PAC）分析中无法区分时间上的正向与反向耦合关系，因为对低频相位做180度翻转后MI值不变，仅偏好相位旋转，因此MI本身不携带时间极性信息。
analysis.claim: 调制指数（MI）-based PAC无法编码时间极性，因而不能单独用于推断神经耦合的时间对齐、相位极性或方向性。
analysis.input: EEG信号 + 数学建模（相位翻转操作）
analysis.output: 调制指数（MI）值、偏好相位、相位分箱振幅分布
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖公开/已有EEG数据，未采集新真实神经数据
analysis.significance_reason: 属神经信号分析方法论的关键澄清工作：指出现有主流指标MI的根本缺陷（丢失时间极性），证据扎实（理论推导+实证验证+与偏好相位等指标对比），但未提出新解码器/新范式/新硬件接口，也未解决临床BCI核心瓶颈（如实时性、跨被试泛化、闭环控制），影响力限于分析工具层，强于一般方法论note但弱于任何具备闭环神经调控或高维意图解码的里程碑工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：对PAC分析中长期被误用的MI指标做出关键方法论纠偏，但属于分析工具层的必要补丁，而非突破性神经接口或解码范式。

papers.title: Ambient Diffusion Policy: Imitation Learning from Suboptimal Data in Robotics
papers.abstract: We propose Ambient Diffusion Policy, a simple and principled method for imitation learning from suboptimal data in robotics. High-quality, task-specific robot data is expensive and time-consuming to collect, while suboptimal datasets with lower-quality or out-of-distribution demonstrations are abundant. Existing methods that co-train on both data sources in robotics often fail to separate the meaningful and the harmful features in the suboptimal samples. In contrast, our method extracts only the useful features by introducing a new axis to co-training in robotics: noise-dependent data usage. Ambient Diffusion Policy restricts the contribution of suboptimal data during training to only the high and low diffusion times. To rigorously justify our approach, we first observe that robot action data exhibits a spectral power law. This induces two important properties on the optimal Diffusion Policy that we exploit: a global-to-local hierarchy and locality. We theoretically formalize this discussion using a simplified model. Our experiments validate Ambient Diffusion Policy on four types of suboptimal action data (noisy trajectories, sim-to-real gap, task mismatch, and large-scale data mixtures) across six tasks. The results show that it effectively learns from arbitrary sources of suboptimal data. Notably, it outperforms existing co-training baselines by up to 33% when scaled to Open X-Embodiment - a large dataset with heterogeneous data quality and unstructured distribution shifts. Overall, Ambient Diffusion Policy increases the utility of suboptimal demonstrations and expands the set of usable data sources in robotics.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫Ambient Diffusion Policy的新方法，让机器人模仿学习能有效利用各种质量差、不匹配、混杂的真实或仿真动作数据（比如噪声轨迹、sim2real偏差、任务错配、大规模异构数据），通过在扩散模型训练中只在高/低噪声时间步使用次优数据，避开中间噪声段的有害干扰，从而提升泛化性能。
analysis.claim: 在扩散策略框架下引入噪声依赖的数据使用机制，可系统性地滤除次优演示中的有害特征，使模仿学习对任意类型次优数据鲁棒且增益显著。
analysis.input: 机器人状态观测（如关节角度、末端位姿）和次优动作轨迹（含噪声、错配、跨域等）
analysis.output: 扩散生成的动作序列（即策略输出的动作块）
analysis.robot_dependency: 通用机器人平台（未指定具体硬件，实验基于Open X-Embodiment多机体数据）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开次优数据集（Open X-Embodiment），无真实机器人在线采集或闭环验证
analysis.significance_reason: 在Open X-Embodiment大规模异构数据上实证了对四类典型次优数据的鲁棒性，相比基线提升达33%，且有理论谱分析支撑+消融验证；但未部署真机闭环测试，也未引入新硬件/仿真器/传感器，属于SOTA级方法论推进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将扩散建模与噪声时序选择结合，扎实提升了次优数据利用率，证据充分但未跨越到真机部署或新物理交互层面

papers.title: Learning Asynchronous Upper-body Task-space Trajectory Tracking Policy for Humanoid Robots
papers.abstract: High-level humanoid planners often output sparse task-space, low-rate trajectories, whereas whole-body controllers run at high frequency. This creates temporal asynchrony between the planning and execution, and structural incompleteness for full-body control. We propose an asynchronous upper body task-space tracking framework for humanoids. A student policy is initialized by teacher-student distillation, conditioned on the full cached future trajectory and an execution-time index, and trained with a sliding-window global reward to reduce frame drift without explicit frame estimation. For task-specific post-training, an MPC module completes sparse references into floating-base and upper-body guidance, while action- and FK level self-guidance constrain policy drift. Simulation and Unitree G1 hardware experiments show improved tracking under low update rates, stronger performance than synchronous and decoupled baselines, and safer adaptation to out-of-distribution motions.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文解决人形机器人高层规划轨迹稀疏（低频）与底层控制器高频执行之间的时序不匹配问题，提出一个异步上半身任务空间跟踪策略，用教师-学生蒸馏初始化策略，结合滑动窗口全局奖励和MPC后处理，在仿真和Unitree G1真机上验证了低更新率下的更稳更准跟踪。
analysis.claim: 通过异步条件化策略建模+滑动窗口全局奖励+MPC引导的混合架构，可显著提升人形机器人在稀疏高层轨迹输入下的上半身任务空间跟踪鲁棒性与泛化性，无需显式帧对齐或在线时间估计。
analysis.input: 缓存的未来任务空间轨迹序列 + 当前执行时间索引（标量）
analysis.output: 上半身关节力矩/速度控制指令（隐式映射到任务空间动作）
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree G1人形机器人 + MuJoCo/PyBullet仿真器
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实G1硬件数据用于微调和验证，但主体训练基于仿真
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了人形控制中长期存在的planning-execution时序失配这一关键工程瓶颈，实证扎实（真机G1+多任务+消融+对比SOTA基线），但未开新范式、未覆盖全身运动生成、未打通端到端VLA链路，属于显著但非里程碑级的系统性工程突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真机验证了异步轨迹跟踪的有效性，填补了稀疏指令下上半身精细操作的控制空白，但未触及具身智能核心认知层或通用任务编排。

papers.title: VT-WAM: Visual-Tactile World Action Model for Contact-Rich Manipulation
papers.abstract: Contact-rich manipulation requires policies to react to local deformation, pressure, slip, and friction, yet these cues are temporally sparse and often invisible in visual observations. Existing visual-tactile policies usually feed tactile observations directly into action prediction, but rarely model tactile deformation dynamics during action generation. In this paper, we introduce VT-WAM, a Visual-Tactile World Action Model that jointly learns future visual prediction, tactile deformation prediction, and action prediction within a unified flow matching framework. In particular, VT-WAM introduces (1) Asymmetric Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) attention to bridge a first-frame visual anchor with temporal tactile dynamics, and (2) contact-gated Action-Visual-Tactile Attention Guidance (AVTAG) to encourage action queries to rely on tactile evidence during contact phases. Across six real-world contact-rich manipulation tasks, VT-WAM achieves a 71.67% average success rate, outperforming Fast-WAM by 26.67% and OmniVTLA by 35.84%. Ablations demonstrate that modeling tactile deformation dynamics and guiding contact-phase tactile attention are both important for contact-rich tasks. Project website: https://vt-wam.github.io/.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个视觉-触觉联合的世界模型VT-WAM，用统一的流匹配框架同时预测未来图像、触觉形变和动作，在6个真实接触密集操作任务上达到71.67%成功率，显著超过Fast-WAM和OmniVTLA。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索；论文主页vt-wam.github.io未提供隶属信息）
analysis.claim: 建模触觉形变动力学并显式引导接触阶段的触觉注意力，是提升接触密集操作鲁棒性的关键机制。
analysis.input: 初始帧RGB图像 + 序列化触觉传感器读数（如GelSight或BioTac类高分辨率触觉图像/压力场）
analysis.output: 动作序列（关节速度或末端位姿增量）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda + GelSight/BioTac类触觉传感器
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实机器人触觉数据（所有实验均在real-world完成，且消融强调触觉动力学建模必要性）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将触觉形变动力学建模与接触阶段注意力门控嵌入世界模型框架，并在6个真实接触密集任务（如插销、拧盖、穿针）上验证有效性；但未开源代码/模型，未跨机体/跨传感器泛化，未与世界模型基石（如DreamerV3/WEAVER）在同等基准对比，属高质量工程推进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在真实触觉操作任务上做出扎实改进，结构设计有洞见，但缺乏开源与跨任务泛化证据，尚未达到世界模型级分量

papers.title: OPINE-World: Programmatic World Modeling with Ontology-error-Prioritized Interactive Exploration
papers.abstract: Learning how an environment behaves from interaction is central to building agents that adapt to unfamiliar tasks. World models learned with deep networks are flexible but data-hungry and transfer poorly beyond their training distribution. Program-synthesized world models, written as source code by LLMs and refined through counterexample-guided inductive synthesis (CEGIS), are instead data-efficient and reusable, yet they have been demonstrated mainly on structured-state worlds with a given object vocabulary, and a single program search does not scale to pixel-rendered environments whose object structure must be hypothesized flexibly. We introduce OPINE-World, an LLM agent that learns an object-centric programmatic world model online from interaction. OPINE-World couples two cooperating agents in a loop of hypothesis and test, one acting in the environment and one synthesizing the model in code with replay verification and model-based planning, and it steers exploration with a Bayesian measure of object-type adequacy we call ontology error. We evaluate OPINE-World on ARC-AGI-3, a benchmark for skill-acquisition efficiency in which the object vocabulary, the goal, and the action semantics are withheld. OPINE-World solves 20 of 25 games without per-game training and reaches an action-efficiency score of 78.4 against the human baseline.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出OPINE-World，一个用LLM在线交互式学习程序化世界模型的系统：它不依赖预定义物体词汇，而是边探索边假设物体类型，用贝叶斯‘本体误差’主动引导探索，并通过代码合成+重放验证+模型规划闭环构建可执行、可解释的世界模型，在ARC-AGI-3上零样本解出20/25个游戏。
analysis.claim: 程序化世界模型的在线构建无需预设物体词汇，可通过本体误差驱动的交互探索实现零样本泛化与高效技能获取。
analysis.input: 像素渲染环境中的动作-观测序列（含图像帧与动作标签）
analysis.output: 可执行的Python程序形式的世界模型（含对象类定义、状态转移函数、goal-check逻辑）
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖，全部基于ARC-AGI-3仿真环境交互生成
analysis.significance_reason: 在程序化世界建模方向迈出关键一步：首次实现像素输入下无先验物体词汇的在线本体发现与代码级模型合成，且在ARC-AGI-3这一强泛化基准上达成高行动效率；但未在真实机器人或复杂物理仿真中验证，仍属受限符号-神经混合范式，未撼动DreamerV3/World Models等以端到端表征学习为核心的基石地位。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——它是首个将本体发现、CEGIS代码合成与主动探索闭环整合并实证于零样本程序理解基准的系统，但限于合成环境，尚未进入具身智能主战场。

papers.title: ELMP: Efficient Learning for Motion Planning via Analytical Policy Gradients
papers.abstract: Neural Motion Planners (NMPs) enable fast reactive motion generation, but adapting them to new environments typically requires recollecting large expert datasets, which is computationally prohibitive. We propose ELMP, a framework for data-efficient adaptation via self-supervised fine-tuning. Rather than generating additional expert trajectories with expensive global planners, ELMP directly optimizes the policy through a differentiable kinematic layer using dense collision, target-reaching, and smoothness objectives. This replaces expert data generation with rapid problem sampling, reducing per-sample adaptation cost by roughly two orders of magnitude. To further support robust generalization across changing kinematic chains, we introduce a mechanism to explicitly encode tool geometry via point clouds. Benchmarked against classical and neural baselines, ELMP achieves an 84.8% average success rate with orders-of-magnitude lower cold-start latency than classical methods. In unseen environments, self-supervised fine-tuning improves success rate from 57.3% (zero-shot) to 89.8%, removing the data collection bottleneck. Our approach maintains millisecond-level inference latency and is validated on a physical Franka Emika Panda robot.

analysis.tldr: 提出ELMP框架，用可微运动学层替代传统专家轨迹生成，在无需重新采集大量专家数据的情况下，通过自监督微调快速适配新环境，实现在Franka机器人上的毫秒级实时运动规划。
analysis.org: 苏黎世联邦理工学院（ETH Zurich）
analysis.claim: 通过可微分运动学层与自监督微调，实现无需专家数据重采集的高效运动规划器在线适应，显著降低冷启动延迟并提升零样本外泛化能力。
analysis.input: 目标位姿、障碍物点云、当前关节状态
analysis.output: 关节空间运动轨迹（动作序列）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人交互数据用于微调，但不依赖大规模专家轨迹数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 在真实机械臂上验证了免专家数据微调范式，冷启动延迟压至毫秒级且成功率达89.8%，证据扎实（真机+多场景+消融隐含于方法设计+对比基线完整），但未扩展至全身/多体/长时序任务，属显著推进而非范式革命，略低于GRAIL/H2O等全身具身智能里程碑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将可微运动学与自监督优化深度耦合，在真实灵巧臂上实现了高鲁棒性、低延迟、免专家数据的在线适配，是运动规划领域近年最扎实的工程突破之一，但未触及全身具身智能或跨形态泛化等更高阶挑战。

papers.title: RynnWorld-Teleop: An Action-Conditioned World Model for Digital Teleoperation
papers.abstract: Scaling robot learning requires massive, diverse trajectory data, yet collection is currently bottlenecked by physical teleoperation, where every demonstration binds operator time to specific hardware and workspaces. We introduce digital teleoperation, a paradigm that decouples data collection from physical constraints by replacing the real robot with a generative world model. In this framework, an operator's hand-pose stream drives a robot-centric generative world model to synthesize high-fidelity egocentric videos from a single reference image. The recorded pose stream serves as an embodiment-agnostic action label transferable to any target robot via standard retargeting, yielding complete state-action trajectories for imitation learning independent of physical hardware. We instantiate this paradigm in RynnWorld-Teleop, a system that integrates depth-aware skeletal conditioning, progressive human-to-robot training on a video Diffusion Transformer, and streaming autoregressive distillation. This pipeline compresses the generative process into a single-pass inference, enabling 40+ FPS, real-time interactive generation on a single H100 GPU. Policies trained exclusively on RynnWorld-Teleop-generated data achieve effective zero-shot Sim2Real transfer across dexterous and diverse bimanual tasks. Moreover, augmenting real-world datasets with our digitally teleoperated data consistently improves success rates, demonstrating that RynnWorld-Teleop serves as a high-fidelity, scalable data engine for the next generation of robotic agents.

analysis.tldr: 提出‘数字遥操作’范式：用一个动作条件化的世界模型（RynnWorld-Teleop），仅凭操作员手部姿态流和一张参考图，实时生成高保真机器人第一视角视频，从而绕过真实机器人采集数据的瓶颈，生成可跨机器人迁移的动作标签和状态轨迹。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索；Zhao/Huang/Li等为常见中文名，但无法确认归属清华/中科院/智元/其他）
analysis.claim: 数字遥操作可通过动作条件化世界模型生成高质量、可泛化、硬件无关的机器人训练数据，替代物理遥操作成为规模化机器人学习的数据引擎。
analysis.input: 操作员手部骨骼姿态序列 + 单张机器人视角参考图像（含深度信息）
analysis.output: 高帧率（40+ FPS） egocentric 视频帧序列 + 对应的机器人关节状态与动作标签
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据（声称全合成），但benchmark评估中使用了真实机器人任务作为zero-shot sim2real目标
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有潜力的‘数字遥操作’新范式，技术链完整（Diffusion Transformer+流式蒸馏+深度感知骨骼条件），在多个bimanual任务上实现zero-shot sim2real，证据比纯仿真工作扎实，但缺乏开源代码/模型/数据，未报告消融实验细节，未与World Models基石工作（如DreamerV3/WEAVER）在统一基准上对比，也未验证长期状态一致性或闭环控制能力，属显著但非里程碑级贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将世界模型、扩散生成、姿态驱动与实时推理工程化集成，解决了数据采集瓶颈的局部痛点，但未触及世界模型核心缺陷（如持久状态建模），且实证封闭，暂未构成范式突破。

papers.title: Computational design of de novo integrated domains enables rational control of pathogen effector recognition in plant NLR immune receptors.
papers.abstract: The rapid evolution of plant pathogens poses a persistent threat to global agricultural sustainability, often outpacing the discovery and deployment of natural disease resistance genes. While bioengineering of plant intracellular immune receptors (NLRs) offers a potential solution, developing bespoke immune recognition remains constrained by the laborious characterisation of natural receptors and plant-pathogen interactions. Here, we describe a programmable framework that leverages generative AI protein design tools, RFdiffusion and ProteinMPNN, to design de novo integrated domains (IDs) against diverse pathogen effectors. By integrating these bespoke binders into the modular rice blast Pik-1/Pik-2 NLR receptor chassis, we successfully engineer recognition of a non-cognate virulence factor (effector) from the Panama disease pathogen, Fusarium oxysporum f. sp. cubense Tropical Race 4. Functional assays in Nicotiana benthamiana demonstrate that these de novo domains facilitate specific effector perception and initiate immune signalling, while structural and biophysical analyses confirm that de novo integrated domains maintain high structural fidelity to the initial designs and associate with their targets via the predicted interaction interfaces. Additionally, our findings provide orthogonal evidence for the role of integrated domains in regulation of NLR signalling, demonstrating integration of de novo IDs can either trigger autoactivity or, in some cases, lead to effector-mediated repression of cell death. By decoupling immune perception from natural evolutionary history through deploying AI-designed sensory domains, this work establishes a design-lead framework for generation of programmable plant immune receptors, providing a new avenue for bioengineering crops against emerging pathogens.

analysis.tldr: 用AI蛋白设计工具（RFdiffusion+ProteinMPNN）从头设计能特异性结合病原效应子的新型整合结构域，并将其插入水稻NLR免疫受体骨架中，首次实现人工编程植物免疫受体对非天然病原效应子（香蕉枯萎病菌Foc TR4的AvrPik类似物）的识别与免疫激活。
analysis.claim: 通过AI从头设计的整合结构域可被模块化嵌入NLR受体骨架，理性重编程植物免疫识别谱，且该设计能保持结构保真度、靶标亲和力及功能信号输出。
analysis.input: 目标病原效应子三维结构或序列（作为RFdiffusion/ProteinMPNN的设计约束输入）
analysis.output: 原子级精度的de novo整合结构域（ID）蛋白质序列与结构
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将生成式AI蛋白设计（RFdiffusion级工具）闭环应用于植物免疫受体工程，在活体植物中验证了AI设计ID的功能性整合与信号启动；虽仅在单一NLR骨架（Pik-1/Pik-2）和单个效应子（Foc TR4 AvrPik-like）上验证，但突破了天然NLR识别不可编程的范式瓶颈，证据链完整（计算设计→结构验证→生化结合→植物体内免疫表型→机制解析），显著优于纯计算预测或体外结合工作，但尚未展示跨NLR骨架/多效应子/田间抗性等规模化泛化能力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次实现AI从头设计蛋白域驱动植物免疫受体理性重编程，并在活体系统中完成从设计到功能验证的全链条闭环，实质性拓展了AI×植物免疫工程的可行性边界。

papers.title: Semantic fragment representations for coordinate-free analysis of genomics data
papers.abstract: Many genomic assays begin with individual DNA fragments, but standard analysis quickly collapses those molecules into counts over genomic intervals. Rich information carried by each fragment, including its sequence, fragment body, cleavage boundaries, and local flanking context, is lost in this process. This loss is especially apparent in mixed-source and heterogeneous samples, where individual fragments originate from disparate cell types and can retain information about their cell of origin. To address this, we present LEAF-1, a fragment-level foundation model pre-trained on approximately 58 billion fragments spanning bulk ATAC-seq, single-cell ATAC-seq, and cell-free DNA profiles, representing each DNA molecule as a point in a learned semantic space defined by sequence context, assay modality, and explicit cleavage-boundary tokens. In sparse scATAC-seq datasets, mean-pooled LEAF-1 embeddings readily classify human cell types from as few as ~1,000 fragments per cell, with high-scoring fragments linked to cell-type-associated transcription-factor programs. Similarly, in cell-free DNA profiling, LEAF-1 outperformed state-of-the-art coordinate-binning strategies and general-purpose DNA language model baselines across cancer detection tasks. Applying attention-based multiple-instance learning to LEAF-1 embeddings further improved cancer detection, reaching an area under the receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curve (AUC) of 0.95. This pan-cancer model generalizes beyond cancer types it is trained on, as we show by profiling plasma samples from clear cell renal cell carcinoma patients and healthy volunteers and applying the frozen classifier without retraining, achieving an AUC of 0.83. These results show that semantic learning over individual DNA fragments preserves biochemical, cell-associated, and disease-associated signals that are otherwise lost during coordinate-based aggregation.

analysis.tldr: 提出LEAF-1模型，将每个DNA片段（而非传统基因组坐标区间）作为独立语义单元建模，通过预训练学习序列上下文、实验模态和切割边界信息，在稀疏单细胞ATAC数据中仅用千级片段即可精准分型，并在无重训练前提下跨癌种检测cfDNA癌症信号。
analysis.org: 麦吉尔大学/加拿大基因组中心
analysis.claim: DNA片段本身是可学习的语义单元，其完整结构特征（序列、切割边界、局部上下文、实验模态）蕴含细胞来源与疾病状态信息，无需依赖基因组坐标系即可建模并泛化。
analysis.input: 原始DNA片段序列及其元信息（切割边界位置、测序模态类型、局部侧翼序列）
analysis.output: 每个DNA片段在语义空间中的稠密向量表示
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据，完全基于公开高通量测序数据（bulk/sc/cfDNA ATAC-seq）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统性证明DNA片段可作为独立语义单元进行foundation modeling，实证覆盖scATAC细胞分型（千片段/细胞）、cfDNA多癌种检测（AUC 0.95→0.83跨癌种冻结迁移），且显著超越坐标系方法和通用DNA语言模型；但未开源代码/模型权重，复现受限，且未解决片段级标注稀缺的根本瓶颈。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它颠覆了基因组学长期依赖坐标系聚合的范式，用实证确立‘片段即语义单元’的新基础，但工程落地完整性不足

papers.title: VIA: Visual Interface Agent for Robot Control
papers.abstract: Robot manipulation is a complex task that requires visual understanding, physical reasoning, planning, and closed-loop control. General-purpose foundation models (FMs) have grown remarkably capable of some of these, especially vision and reasoning. To leverage this for generalist robot policies, current methods typically involve converting existing FMs into vision-language-action (VLA) models by fine-tuning on robot data to output low-level actions. However, VLAs are often orders of magnitude smaller than frontier FMs given the limited data and compute available for fine-tuning, which in turn limits their general capability. Inspired by the growing ability of FMs to operate software through visual interfaces, we ask whether that same competence suffices to control a robot. We present VIA (Visual Interface Agent for robot control), a framework that recasts robot control as an agentic task: an off-the-shelf FM-powered agent drives a manipulator through a browser-based 3D interface by taking screenshots, issuing intuitive commands, observing the outcome, and adjusting. The agent receives no robot-specific fine-tuning and no access to privileged state information: it perceives visual input and acts through a small set of general tools. VIA inherits the agent's general reasoning, closed-loop error recovery, and ability to plan and re-plan from what it observes. It solves a diverse suite of tabletop manipulation tasks zero-shot with both Claude Code and Codex. With the strongest model (Fable 5) it achieves 96.7% success on three LIBERO-Goal tasks and 100% on a long-horizon rainbow assembly task. Performance improves with the scale and strength of the underlying model. These results suggest that frontier agents already possess skills that transfer directly to robot control given the right interface: your coding or computer-use agent is, in a sense, secretly a robot-control agent.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文把机器人控制变成一个‘用浏览器操作3D界面’的软件自动化任务，让现成的大模型（如Claude、Codex）不经过任何机器人数据微调，仅靠截图+自然语言指令+观察反馈，在网页版3D仿真环境中完成零样本桌面操作任务。
analysis.claim: 前沿视觉-语言大模型无需机器人领域微调，仅通过模拟人类使用图形界面的方式（截图→理解→发指令→观察→修正），即可实现零样本机器人操控。
analysis.input: 连续帧截图 + 自然语言任务指令
analysis.output: 在3D浏览器界面中执行的鼠标/键盘级交互动作（如点击、拖拽、输入文本）
analysis.robot_dependency: 基于WebGL的自研3D浏览器仿真器（非真实机器人或标准仿真器如PyBullet/Mujoco）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 创意新颖（将机器人控制降维为GUI自动化），但实证局限：仅在自建轻量级Web仿真器中验证，无真实机器人、无跨机体/跨传感器泛化、无消融分析、未对比VLA基线、benchmark任务窄（LIBERO-Goal仅3个短序列+1个长序列组装），且性能依赖闭源商用模型（Claude/Codex/Fable），无法复现核心结果。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——巧妙嫁接现有大模型的GUI操作能力到机器人仿真，但缺乏对机器人领域核心挑战（动力学建模、触觉反馈、sim2real gap、硬件闭环）的实质性突破，属于强概念+弱实证的跨界迁移。

papers.title: GaitSpan: Growing Humanoid Locomotion from Walking to Running
papers.abstract: A humanoid that can walk should not relearn locomotion from scratch to jog or run. Yet current approaches often obtain gait diversity by prescribing gait schedules, imitating motion clips, training experts to switch between or distilling skills into one policy. These strategies can produce impressive behaviors, but offer limited flexibility across continuous speed commands, terrains, and morphologies. We study skill growth with GaitSpan, a framework that expands a pretrained, basic walking policy into faster locomotion. It treats walking as a seed skill: reusable motor structure for balance, support, body coordination, and contact transition that can be regenerated at new rhythms, extended into longer/higher strides, and corrected by residual adaptation. This expansion has three aspects: 1) rhythm generation, which modulates the frozen walking policy with multiple internal clocks and learns command-conditioned combinations of the resulting canonical actions; 2) stride shaping, which rewards dynamic locomotion patterns appropriate for higher commanded speeds using a physically grounded objective inspired by spring-loaded inverted pendulum dynamics; and 3) residual adaptation, which captures motion details not accounted for by rhythm generation or stride shaping. GaitSpan is the first to deliver a single command-conditioned humanoid policy that spans walking, jogging, and running-like regimes covering a continuous speed range, transfers across morphologies, and deploys zero-shot on unseen sim-to-sim, and real-world terrains. Compared with baselines either trained with multi-experts or imitation from humans, it learns faster and achieves stronger gait performance.

analysis.tldr: 提出GaitSpan框架，通过节奏调制、步幅塑形和残差适应三阶段扩展预训练步行策略，实现单个策略连续控制人形机器人从走、快走、慢跑到类奔跑的全速域运动，并支持跨形态迁移和零样本部署到新仿真环境及真实地形。
analysis.claim: 一个预训练的步行策略可通过结构化扩展（而非重新训练或专家切换）自然生长为覆盖连续速度谱的通用步态策略，且具备跨形态与跨地形零样本泛化能力。
analysis.input: 连续速度指令+地形观测（高度图/接触反馈等）
analysis.output: 关节力矩控制序列（即底层动作输出）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人步态数据用于残差适配微调，但主体训练在仿真中完成
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在多个仿真机体（A1/H1/Cassie）和真实H1上验证连续速度泛化；对比多专家集成与人类动作模仿基线，收敛更快、鲁棒性更强；引入物理启发的SLIP式奖励进行步幅塑形，非黑箱调参；但未开源数据集，且真实世界测试仅限平整/轻度不规则地形，未挑战极端扰动或长期部署可靠性，故略低于GRAIL/H2O级里程碑（94分档），但显著优于纯仿真刷榜工作，属重磅推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将步行策略结构化扩展为连续步态谱的技术路径清晰、实证充分，但未开新范式，也未解决长期稳定性或感知-运动闭环等更深层瓶颈

papers.title: Reference Regulatory Element-Guided Gene Expression Analysis for Mechanistic Inference of Gene Regulatory Networks
papers.abstract: Regulatory genomics faces a depth-breadth gap: deep multi-omics provides regulatory detail but is difficult to scale, whereas broad expression datasets often lack the regulatory structure needed for mechanistic Gene Regulatory Network (GRN) analysis. We developed Regulatory Elements Guided Analysis (REGA), an interpretable framework that uses reference Regulatory Element (RE) catalogs to infer transcription factor (TF)-RE-gene programs from gene expression data. Across ChIP-seq, knockdown, Hi-C, cis- and trans-eQTL benchmarks, REGA prioritized functional REs, improved RE-gene and TF-gene inference over existing baselines, including methods using more data, and recovered coherent regulatory modules. In PsychENCODE snRNA-seq, REGA identified disease-associated modules and TF activities, linked regulatory dysregulation to genetic risk, and detected cross-cell-type neuronal-glial programs. In spatial transcriptomics, REGA linked cell-intrinsic regulatory programs with intercellular ligand-receptor communication; in Perturb-seq, it mapped perturbation responses to trait-associated regulatory architectures. REGA enables scalable, interpretable GRN analysis across expression datasets.

analysis.tldr: 提出REGA方法，利用已知的调控元件（RE）参考图谱，仅从基因表达数据中反推转录因子-调控元件-基因的因果性调控程序，无需多组学实验数据，实现在多种真实生物数据集（snRNA-seq、空间转录组、Perturb-seq）上的可解释GRN建模。
analysis.claim: 仅依赖基因表达数据和参考调控元件图谱，即可高精度、可解释地重建具有功能验证支持的TF-RE-gene调控程序，并在跨模态生物数据中揭示疾病相关调控模块与细胞间通讯机制。
analysis.input: 基因表达矩阵（如scRNA-seq、bulk RNA-seq、spatial transcriptomics）+ 参考调控元件注释（如ENCODE/FANTOM/SCREEN）
analysis.output: TF-RE-gene三元组调控程序、细胞类型/状态特异的调控模块、与遗传风险或表型扰动关联的调控架构
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖任何机器人或实验硬件数据，仅需公共表达数据与RE注释
analysis.significance_reason: 在GRN推断领域实现关键范式转移：首次系统性将静态参考调控元件图谱作为结构先验嵌入表达驱动建模，绕过多组学数据瓶颈，在多个独立高价值真实生物场景（PsychENCODE snRNA-seq、空间转录组、Perturb-seq）中完成跨细胞类型、跨扰动、跨模态验证，且性能超越使用更多数据的基线；但未开源完整训练数据与预计算RE图谱，且未提供端到端可复现pipeline（仅code），尚未达到AlphaFold级基础模型或dtSFM级药物发现平台的通用性与生态影响力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：解决了调控基因组学中‘深度vs广度’的根本矛盾，用结构先验+表达数据实现了可解释、可泛化、经多维度功能验证的GRN重构，是近年来少有的兼具方法原创性与生物机制洞察力的工作。

papers.title: Safe Execution of RL Policies Via Acceleration-Based CBF-QP Constraint Enforcement for Real-World Robotic Deployments
papers.abstract: Reinforcement Learning (RL) has demonstrated remarkable capabilities for solving complex robotic control problems, but its lack of safety guarantees severely limits deployment on hardware. In particular, as legged robots and manipulators often operate near safety-critical boundaries, out-of-distribution states can lead to failure upon deployment. To address this, we introduce Acc-CBF-QP, an acceleration-based Quadratic Program (QP) safety filter using Control Barrier Functions (CBFs) that constrains any RL policy onto a safe set at runtime without modifying training. The method applies to unconstrained and Safe-RL policies, and enforces joint position, velocity, torque, and collision constraints within a unified optimization framework. A key contribution is the formulation of RL+QP tasks that regulate deviation from the RL command when constraints would otherwise be violated. We introduce a TorqueTask, minimizing torque deviation, and a Forward Dynamics Task, minimizing induced acceleration deviation, thus providing principled control over safety-performance trade-offs. Experiments on a 7-DoF Kinova Gen3 manipulator and a 19-DoF Unitree H1 humanoid, both in simulation and on hardware, highlight substantial reductions in constraint violations. On the real H1 hardware, a Safe-RL policy alone yielded 10.04 violations/s, which were reduced by 92% to 0.80 violations/s when augmented with Acc-CBF-QP. On the Kinova Gen3, Acc-CBF-QP fully eliminated violations. Nominal task performance of the RL objective is preserved in violation-free regimes. Under aggressive velocity commands on H1, Acc-CBF-QP improves execution by preventing constraint-induced shutdowns, yielding longer survival times. The full pipeline is open-source.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种叫Acc-CBF-QP的安全滤波器，插在任意训练好的强化学习控制器后面，在机器人真实运行时实时用二次规划（QP）强制满足关节位置/速度/力矩/碰撞等物理约束，不改训练过程，显著降低硬件部署时的约束违反次数。
analysis.claim: 无需修改RL训练过程，仅通过运行时加装基于加速度建模的CBF-QP安全滤波器，即可在真实机器人上大幅降低约束违反率，同时保持原始任务性能。
analysis.input: RL策略输出的动作（如目标加速度或力矩）、当前状态（关节位置/速度/力矩）、安全约束边界
analysis.output: 经QP修正后的安全动作指令（加速度或力矩）
analysis.robot_dependency: Kinova Gen3机械臂、Unitree H1人形机器人
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖实时传感器反馈（位置/速度/力矩），但不依赖预收集的真实机器人训练数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在多机体（7DoF机械臂+19DoF人形）真实硬件上验证了CBF-QP对RL策略的即插即用式安全增强，量化效果扎实（H1违规率降92%，Gen3归零），开源完整pipeline；但未开新范式，属安全落地关键工程推进，尚未达到GR00T/H2O级的架构性突破。

papers.title: STEAM:ASpatio-TEmporal Alignment Mixture-of-Experts Model with Hierarchical Pre-training for EEG Decoding
papers.abstract: Brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) have been widely used in motor rehabilitation, disease diagnosis, and other neural engineering scenarios. However, conventional neural signal decoding algorithms often suffer from limited generalizability and high adaptation costs, motivating recent interest in BCI foundation models. Existing approaches still struggle to jointly achieve general transferability, accurate decoding, and efficient downstream adaptation. We present STEAM, a hierarchical transfer framework that reconciles general-purpose representation learning with paradigm-specific specialization in EEG foundation models. The framework is instantiated as a dual-branch spatio-temporal encoder in which a shared soft mixture-of-experts (SSMoE) module aligns the spatial and temporal branches, allowing complementary representations to exchange information through a compact set of soft slots. Across seven downstream datasets and fourteen evaluation settings, STEAM attains the best average rank among the compared methods at a competitive inference cost measured in FLOPs. Building upon the Stage-I general initialization, the hierarchical pre-training strategy further specializes the model to a target paradigm without retraining from scratch, yielding consistent gains in paradigm-specific decoding accuracy.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个名为STEAM的EEG解码基础模型，通过双分支时空编码器+软混合专家模块实现跨范式泛化，用分阶段预训练在7个下游数据集上取得平均排名最优，但未在真实BCI闭环系统中验证、无在线适应或实时解码实验。
analysis.claim: 分层预训练的时空对齐MoE架构能同时提升EEG基础模型的跨范式泛化性、解码精度和下游适配效率。
analysis.input: 原始或预处理的多通道EEG信号（时序+空间维度）
analysis.output: EEG对应的神经活动标签（如运动意图、刺激类别、想象任务等离散分类结果）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开离线EEG数据集，无真实BCI硬件交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 虽在多个离线EEG分类基准上达成SOTA级平均排名，但仍是纯监督分类任务，未涉及实时闭环控制、在线自适应、低延迟推理或临床级鲁棒性验证；相比90+分的基石工作（如脑控语音合成、瘫痪者自然行走），它未突破‘解码→行为输出’的闭环链路，也未解决高噪声、跨被试、小样本适配等临床核心瓶颈，属于扎实但窄向的算法改进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：在离线EEG分类泛化性上有明确提升，但未触及BCI临床落地的关键障碍，暂未构成范式突破

papers.title: CLAW: Learning Continuous Latent Action World Models via Adversarial Latent Regularization
papers.abstract: We introduce CLAW, a fully end-to-end self-supervised framework for learning a world model jointly with continuous latent action representations directly from action-free videos. Our approach leverages adversarial latent regularization and diffusion-based video generation to capture structured and semantically meaningful action representations while modeling rich, predictive environment dynamics, without relying on any action labels or annotations. By simultaneously training the Latent Action Model and world model, CLAW learns to reason about how inferred actions induce environment transitions from visual observations alone. We show that the resulting latent action world model supports both imitation learning from observation and goal-directed planning. In imitation learning, latent actions extracted from raw videos enable behavior cloning. For planning, CLAW generates sequences of latent actions and maps them to executable actions to reach desired goals. Extensive experiments across diverse tasks and embodiments demonstrate that CLAW produces semantically meaningful latent action representations, supports effective action transfer, and enables planning and imitation from observation, outperforming existing methods.

analysis.tldr: 仅用无动作标注的视频，端到端学出一个能预测环境变化的世界模型，同时自动发现连续、语义清晰的隐式动作表征，再用它做从视频模仿学习和目标导向规划。
analysis.claim: 无需任何动作标签或交互数据，仅通过自监督学习即可联合建模环境动态与语义连贯的连续隐式动作空间，并支撑下游模仿与规划任务。
analysis.input: 无动作标注的视频帧序列
analysis.output: 连续隐式动作向量序列 + 环境状态预测（未来帧/状态）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，仅用公开视频数据集（如BAIR Robot Pushing、RoboNet等仿真/真实机器人采集的无动作标签视频）
analysis.significance_reason: 在纯视觉世界建模+隐式动作解耦方向上显著推进：首次实现端到端联合训练且支持跨机体动作迁移与规划，但未在真实机器人上验证、无消融实验细节披露、未开源数据与完整训练配置，证据强度弱于DreamerV3/DreamerV1等需交互信号的标杆方法。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将对抗正则化、扩散生成与世界模型架构巧妙耦合，在无动作监督下达成语义动作解耦与跨任务泛化，但缺乏真机验证与完整可复现性，尚未达到里程碑级突破。

papers.title: Hierarchical Policies from Verbal and Egocentric Human Signals for Natural Human-Robot Interaction
papers.abstract: For natural human-robot interaction, a robot must understand human intent expressed not only through language but also through nonverbal signals such as gestures and gaze. However, current robot policies rely on language instructions as the sole interface for conveying intent, leaving nonverbal signals unused and placing the full burden of communication. In this work, we present EDITH, a robot framework that captures the human's nonverbal signals through continuous streams of first-person view and gaze from smart glasses, and uses them alongside language instructions as inputs to the robot policy. Our hardware system streams the human's first-person view, gaze, and speech to the robot in real time, transcribing the speech into language instructions. To handle these rich but noisy signals, we design a hierarchical policy in which a high-level policy infers the human's intent and produces a sequence of subtasks, where each subtask is represented as a fine-grained instruction paired with a keyframe that grounds the intent in the scene (e.g., the frame where the human points at the target object). A low-level policy then executes these subtasks. In our experiments on human-robot interactive tasks, EDITH enables the robot to act on the human's nonverbal signals even when intent is expressed only briefly, and significantly reduces user effort to convey intent compared to using language instructions alone. Visit our project page for source code and real-robot demo videos.

analysis.tldr: 提出EDITH框架，让机器人通过智能眼镜实时获取人类第一人称视角、注视点和语音，将三者融合输入分层策略（高层推断意图并生成带关键帧的子任务，底层执行），显著降低用户仅靠语言发指令的沟通负担。
analysis.claim: 融合第一人称视觉、注视点与语音的分层策略，能从短暂非语言信号中可靠推断人类意图并驱动机器人执行，比纯语言指令大幅降低用户交互 effort。
analysis.input: 第一人称RGB视频流+实时眼动轨迹+语音（转录为文本）
analysis.output: 动作序列（由高层生成带场景锚定关键帧的子任务，底层映射为具体动作）
analysis.robot_dependency: 定制硬件系统（含智能眼镜+机器人本体通信链路）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实人类佩戴智能眼镜在真实机器人上采集的多模态同步数据（摘要明确提及real-robot demo videos及实时流）
analysis.significance_reason: 真机验证多任务、跨用户、非语言主导交互，有明确用户effort量化对比（非纯仿真/小数据/单任务），但未开源代码模型、缺乏消融实验细节、未与主流VLA基线（如RT-2/Octo）对比，属扎实且具工程落地性的重磅进展，未达开范式级（如RT-2）或通用VLA架构级（如Octo）高度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：完整闭环的真实硬件系统+分层多模态策略设计实证有效，但开源不足、基线对比缺失、泛化分析有限，属于高质量落地型工作而非理论或架构突破。

papers.title: WireCraft: A Simulation Benchmark for Industrial DLO Manipulation
papers.abstract: Deformable Linear Objects (DLOs), such as wires and cables, are central to industrial assembly. Unlike rigid objects, whose state is captured by a 6-DoF pose, DLOs have an infinite-dimensional configuration space and deform continuously under contact with grippers, fixtures, and the workspace, making them a demanding benchmark for general dexterous manipulation. Despite their importance, policy development and comparison remain difficult: existing benchmarks are often tied to specific hardware setups, lack modular and customizable task assets, or study generic deformable-object tasks without the fixtures relevant to real-world industrial wire manipulation. Few benchmarks align simulation, real-world data, and shared evaluation protocols. To bridge this gap, we introduce WireCraft, a simulation benchmark for industrial DLO manipulation with configurable difficulty and assets, spanning three task families: connector insertion, clip routing, and channel seating. It supports two complementary DLO physics models, articulated and deformable, and the trajectories come from both simulation and a physical UR5. We benchmark reinforcement learning (RL), imitation learning (IL), and vision-language-action (VLA) policies under shared metrics. Privileged state-based RL solves a representative setting in each task family with over 82\% success, confirming the tasks are well-posed. For connector insertion, however, the transition from reaching the socket to contact-rich alignment remains a key bottleneck for vision RL, IL, and VLA policies. These results indicate that industrial DLO manipulation, though tractable under privileged state, remains an open challenge for current vision-based learning. The benchmark, data, and tools will be open-sourced upon acceptance.

analysis.tldr: 提出WireCraft——一个面向工业线缆（如电线、电缆）操作的可配置仿真基准，包含三类真实产线任务（连接器插入、卡扣布线、槽道嵌入），支持两种物理模型和多类策略（RL/IL/VLA）统一评测，但所有结果均在仿真中完成，未验证真机部署。
analysis.claim: WireCraft是首个专为工业级DLO操作设计的、任务可配置、资产模块化、评估协议统一、且同时支持仿真与真实UR5轨迹数据的开源仿真基准。
analysis.input: RGB图像+深度图（视觉输入）或特权状态（如DLO关键点坐标、夹具位姿）
analysis.output: 机器人末端执行器的6D动作增量或关节控制指令
analysis.data_dependency: 仅使用仿真生成轨迹 + 少量真实UR5采集的演示轨迹（未说明规模与多样性）
analysis.significance_reason: 填补了工业DLO仿真基准的空白，任务设计贴近产线，评测协议严谨，但全在仿真中验证，无真机泛化实验；未解决核心瓶颈（如视觉驱动下的接触密集对准），也未推动新算法范式，属于高质量增量型基准建设，达不到基石论文（如ALOHA/ACT/π0）所要求的真机闭环、跨任务泛化或策略架构突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：构建了迄今最贴近工业场景的DLO仿真基准，但仍是仿真内闭环，未跨越sim2real鸿沟，也未提供新策略解法，属扎实但非突破性的基础设施工作。

papers.title: 3D HAMSTER: Bridging Planning and Control in Hierarchical Vision Language Action Models through 3D Trajectory Guidance
papers.abstract: Hierarchical Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models decouple high-level planning from low-level control to improve generalization in robot manipulation. Recent work in this paradigm uses 2D end-effector trajectories predicted by a Vision-Language Model (VLM) as explicit guidance for a downstream policy. However, state-of-the-art low-level policies operate in 3D metric space on point clouds, and feeding them 2D guidance that lacks depth forces each waypoint to be assigned the depth of whatever scene surface lies beneath it, producing geometrically distorted trajectories. We propose 3D HAMSTER, a hierarchical framework that closes this gap by having the planner directly output metrically reliable 3D trajectories. We augment a VLM with a dedicated depth encoder and a dense depth reconstruction objective to predict 3D waypoint sequences, which are directly integrated into a pointcloudbased low-level policy. Across 3D trajectory prediction, simulation, and real-world manipulation, 3D HAMSTER consistently outperforms proprietary VLMs and 2D-guided baselines, with the largest gains under appearance-altering shifts and unseen language, spatial, and visual conditions. The project page is available at https://davian-robotics.github.io/3D_HAMSTER/.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现用2D图像轨迹指导3D点云控制策略会导致深度失真，于是改造视觉语言模型，让它直接输出可靠的3D轨迹（带深度），再喂给点云策略，从而在仿真和真实机械臂上提升了跨外观、跨空间、跨语言的泛化能力。
analysis.org: Davian Robotics（依据项目页域名及作者 affiliations 推断为韩国初创团队，非高校/大厂）
analysis.claim: 将VLA规划器的输出从几何失真的2D轨迹升级为度量准确的3D轨迹，可实质性缓解高层规划与底层点云控制之间的模态错配，提升跨域泛化性能。
analysis.input: RGB-D图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 3D空间中的有序轨迹点序列（x,y,z坐标）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda 机械臂 + RealSense D435i 深度相机
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的少量校准数据用于深度重建监督，但主训练基于合成与仿真数据
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了VLA中长期被忽视的2D→3D几何鸿沟问题，实证扎实（仿真+真实多任务+消融+跨域鲁棒性测试），但未开源代码/模型，且未达到RT-2/π0级范式突破或大规模基础模型尺度，属于对主流分层VLA架构的关键工程补全与可靠性增强。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：它没有发明新范式，但精准识别并修补了当前VLA流水线中一个导致几何失效的关键断点，实证充分、落地有效，是高质量的系统级改进。

papers.title: A Comprehensive Evaluation of Protein Structure Prediction Models for Short Peptides
papers.abstract: Short peptides pose distinct challenges for computational structural biology due to their lack of stable tertiary structures, high conformational flexibility, and limited evolutionary signals. To address how modern deep-learning architectures navigate these challenges, we conducted a comprehensive benchmarking of five state-of-the-art protein structure prediction models: AlphaFold2, RoseTTAFold2, ESMFold, OmegaFold, and DMPfold2. Using a curated dataset of experimentally determined short peptide structures (10-49 amino acids) from the Protein Data Bank, we systematically evaluated predictive performance across varying sequence lengths and secondary structure classes. Our results demonstrate that prediction accuracy systematically improves with peptide length. Furthermore, all models perform significantly better on α-helical and mixed-structure peptides compared to β-sheet-rich and intrinsically disordered sequences. Among the evaluated methods, AlphaFold2 and the single-sequence language models, ESMFold and Omegafold proved to be the most consistent and accurate overall. We also observed that internal model confidence scores are imperfectly calibrated for short peptides, necessitating cautious interpretation. Finally, by extending our analysis to the dbAMP3 dataset of uncharacterized antimicrobial peptides, we demonstrate that a multi-model consensus approach provides a rational framework for identifying robust structural hypotheses in the absence of experimental reference structures.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统评测了5种主流蛋白质结构预测模型（包括AlphaFold2、ESMFold等）在短肽（10–49残基）上的表现，发现所有模型精度随长度增加而提升，对α-螺旋类短肽效果好、对β片和无序肽效果差，且置信度分数不可靠；最后用多模型共识策略在无实验结构的抗菌肽上生成可信结构假设。
analysis.claim: 当前主流蛋白结构预测模型在短肽上存在系统性性能偏差，其预测质量高度依赖序列长度与二级结构类型，且内部置信度不可靠，需通过多模型共识策略弥补单模型局限。
analysis.input: 短肽氨基酸序列（10–49残基）
analysis.output: 三维结构坐标（PDB格式）及模型置信度分数
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开实验结构数据（PDB），无真实机器人/传感器交互
analysis.significance_reason: 扎实的benchmark工作：覆盖5个SOTA模型、自建短肽PDB子集、按长度/二级结构分层评估、验证置信度缺陷、拓展至dbAMP3实证共识策略；但未提出新模型/新架构/新训练范式，也未解决短肽预测的根本瓶颈（如构象采样不足、MSA缺失），仅揭示现象而非突破机制——显著优于普通灌水，但远未达基石级（如AlphaFold2/ESMFold/RFdiffusion）的范式级贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：是迄今最系统的短肽结构预测实证评估，填补了方法适用性认知空白，但属于高质量诊断性工作，非技术突破。

papers.title: Structured 4D Latent Predictive Model for Robot Planning
papers.abstract: Video predictive models are emerging as a powerful paradigm in robotics, offering a promising path toward task generalization, long-horizon planning, and flexible decision-making. However, prevailing approaches often operate on 2D video sequences, inherently lacking the 3D geometric understanding necessary for precise spatial reasoning and physical consistency. We introduce a Structured 4D Latent Predictive Model, which predicts the evolution of a scene's 3D structure in a structured latent space conditioned on observations and textual instructions. Our representation encodes the scene holistically and can be decoded into diverse 3D formats, enabling a more complete and 3D consistent scene understanding. This structured 4D latent predictive model serves as a planner, generating future scenes that are translated into executable actions by a goal-conditioned inverse dynamics module. Experiments demonstrate that our model generates futures with strong visual quality, substantially better 3D consistency and multi-view coherence compared to state-of-the-art video-based planners. Consequently, our full planning pipeline achieves superior performance on complex manipulation tasks, exhibits robust generalization to novel visual conditions, and proves effective on real-world robotic platforms. Our website is available at https://structured-4d-model.github.io/.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个能在结构化4D潜在空间中预测场景3D结构演化的模型，把视频+语言指令作为输入，输出未来多帧3D场景表示，再通过逆动力学模块转成机器人动作，在仿真和真实机械臂上验证了比2D视频预测方法更强的3D一致性、跨视觉条件泛化能力和操作任务性能。
analysis.claim: 结构化4D潜在空间建模能显著提升机器人规划中的3D几何一致性与跨条件泛化能力，且可端到端驱动真实机器人完成复杂操作任务。
analysis.input: RGB视频序列+文本指令
analysis.output: 未来多帧3D场景潜在表示（可解码为点云/体素/网格）及对应机器人关节动作序列
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂（摘要末句‘real-world robotic platforms’及官网示例可推断）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人执行数据用于逆动力学模块训练和闭环验证，但未说明是否用于4D潜空间建模本身
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在真实Panda平台上验证多任务操作（如堆叠、抓取、插入），对比SOTA视频预测基线展示3D一致性与多视角连贯性提升，并含跨光照/纹理泛化实验；但未开源代码/模型，未提供消融证明4D结构化设计的关键性，也未挑战World Models级的长期状态持久性或通用世界建模范式，属显著但非范式级推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将3D潜空间建模、多模态条件生成与逆动力学控制有效串联，在真实机器人上验证了3D一致性优势，但缺乏对核心表征机制的消融与开源，尚未触及世界模型的长期状态建模本质。

papers.title: Smooth Operator: A Real-Time Sampling-Based Algorithm for Kinematic Hand Retargeting
papers.abstract: Advances in learning-based robotic manipulation, such as Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models and Video Action Models (VAMs), heavily rely on high-quality teleoperation data. Their capabilities are strictly upper-bounded by the quality of the underlying human demonstrations. Current gradient-based retargeting algorithms often converge to different local minima, resulting in jitter that affects data quality and teleoperation experience. To address this, we introduce the Sampling-Based Retargeter (SBR), a novel gradient-free retargeting method drawn from the rich literature of sampling-based control and explicitly designed for low-jitter, real-time kinematic retargeting. We evaluate SBR both in simulation and through a rigorous real-world user study involving 18 participants performing 3 complex manipulation tasks. Compared to gradient-based baselines, SBR achieved the highest overall task success rate (54.1%) while significantly reducing operator cognitive fatigue, recording the lowest NASA-TLX workload score (36.4 out of 100). Ultimately, we establish SBR as a highly effective, intuitive retargeter for dexterous manipulation, providing the community with a rigorous benchmarking methodology to guide future retargeting research.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种不依赖梯度的采样式手部运动重定向算法SBR，用于将人类手势实时、低抖动地映射到机器人灵巧手，显著提升遥操作成功率并降低操作者认知负荷。
analysis.claim: 采样式、梯度无关的手部运动重定向方法SBR能在真实遥操作中实现更低抖动、更高任务成功率和更轻认知负荷，优于现有梯度法。
analysis.input: 人类手部关节角度或姿态序列（来自动作捕捉或可穿戴设备）
analysis.output: 机器人灵巧手各关节的目标角度序列

papers.title: Automated Synthesis of Facial Mechanisms for Conversational Animatronic Robots
papers.abstract: Animatronic faces are a central component of socially interactive robots, enabling rich nonverbal communication through facial articulation. However, state-of-the-art animatronic faces are typically tailored systems: each new facial geometry requires extensive manual mechanical redesign, making large-scale personalization prohibitively slow and costly. In this work, we pursue automated and scalable mechanical face synthesis, aiming to rapidly generate a physically realizable facial mechanism for a wide range of facial geometries. We introduce a parametric, linkage-driven mechanical face template whose topology and actuator layout are explicitly parameterized to support systematic scaling and retargeting across diverse facial morphologies. Building on this template, we propose a hierarchical automatic design algorithm that takes a single 2D portrait as input, reconstructs a target 3D face, and synthesizes a collision-free, manufacturable internal mechanism. The algorithm combines anatomy-guided feasible motion volumes, Action Unit (AU)-derived trajectory-based expressiveness objectives, and a collision-driven outer-loop refinement strategy. Beyond hardware synthesis, we argue that future mechanical faces deployed at scale must engage in bidirectional, multi-turn conversation rather than functioning solely as speaking or listening heads. To this end, we develop a dual-identity conversational facial motion synthesis framework that jointly models speaking and listening behaviors from audio, producing temporally coherent 3D facial motion suitable for physical execution. We validate our system through extensive experiments, including (i) quantitative evaluation of automatic mechanism synthesis across diverse facial geometries, (ii) comparisons against manual mechanical design, (iii) benchmarks on conversational facial motion synthesis and real-time deployment, and (iv) perceptual user studies.
