papers.title: AeroAct: Action-Centered World-Action Models for Language-Conditioned Quadrotor Flight
papers.abstract: Language-conditioned quadrotor flight requires a policy to ground semantic goals, anticipate the visual consequences of ego-motion, and output control references that remain smooth and dynamically executable under rapidly changing first-person views. Existing aerial vision-language navigation and vision-language-action methods commonly use discrete actions, high-level waypoints, or instantaneous velocity commands, which provide limited supervision about how flight actions change future observations. We present AeroAct, an action-centered world-action model (WAM) for quadrotor navigation. To the best of our knowledge, AeroAct is the first WAM instantiated and demonstrated for real-world aerial flight. The model adapts a pretrained video diffusion Transformer to predict local trajectory-action chunks from egocentric visual history, proprioception, and language. Future first-person frames are used during training as dense consequence supervision, while deployment directly decodes actions without generating future video. To obtain aligned visual, state, language, and dynamically feasible action data, we build a DiffAero-based pipeline with complementary Isaac Lab and 3D Gaussian splatting renderers. We further introduce a low-cost handheld collection device that couples camera observations with motion estimates to recreate flight-like egocentric trajectories, and a self-guidance procedure that improves temporal consistency across overlapping trajectory chunks. Closed-loop simulation and real-world experiments show that temporal visual context improves target tracking and object-search performance, and that WAM-based policies can be executed on a physical quadrotor.

analysis.tldr: 提出AeroAct模型，用视频扩散Transformer预测四旋翼无人机的局部轨迹-动作块，以语言为条件，在真实无人机上实现了端到端的语言驱动飞行，核心创新是将未来第一人称视频帧作为密集监督信号训练世界-动作模型（WAM），但不生成视频、只输出可执行动作。

papers.title: ACME: A Multi-Cultural, Multi-Embodiment Social-Navigation Dataset
papers.abstract: Understanding how robots and humans move in shared spaces is essential for designing effective social robot navigation policies and predicting human behavior. However, existing datasets often lack the diversity needed to capture differences in culture, geography, and human-robot interaction-factors that strongly shape appropriate social behavior. To address this gap, we introduce ACME: A Cross-cultural, Multi-Embodiment dataset for social navigation. A large-scale data collection effort across 8 sites in 5 countries, using 7 robot embodiments, ACME is a large and diverse multi-modal dataset aimed at advancing social navigation research, providing 29.35 hours of onboard robot data and 43.5 hours of overhead pedestrian tracking data. Unlike prior datasets, it focuses on capturing goal-driven social navigation behavior in complex social scenarios with explicit robot-crowd interaction through robot speech. To facilitate learning navigation policies and predicting pedestrian trajectories, ACME provides 3D and 2D scene features, odometry, interaction information, and human-annotated pedestrian trajectory labels. We make ACME easy to use by providing both human-readable data for each sensor modality as well as raw binary data. Our qualitative and quantitative analyses show that our dataset captures more challenging scenarios and a broader distribution of pedestrian behavior than previous datasets.

analysis.tldr: 构建了一个跨文化、多机器人形态的社交导航数据集ACME，覆盖5国8地7种机器人，在真实场景中采集了29.35小时机器人本体数据和43.5小时俯视行人轨迹数据，重点记录带语音交互的目标导向社交行为，并提供3D/2D场景特征、里程计、交互标注和人工校验的行人轨迹。

papers.title: Embodying Multi-Hand Manipulation Policies by Searching the Assignment and Null Spaces
papers.abstract: Learned manipulation policies increasingly predict motions for abstract "hands" and are attractive in practice because they rely on easily collected demonstrations and transfer across robot platforms. Executing these trajectories on multi-arm robots, however, is not trivial. Multi-hand policy outputs must be assigned to physical arms, each arm must realize a configuration-space motion that tracks its prescribed end-effector trajectory, and all arms must respect kinematic limits and avoid collisions. In the absence of algorithms that directly address this problem, practitioners typically extend single-arm inverse-kinematics (IK) pipelines in an ad hoc way, with no guarantees of feasibility or safety. In this work, we close this execution gap with a search-based framework that is theoretically complete for grounding policy-generated multi-hand trajectories onto physical multi-arm systems. Building on Conflict-Based Search, our method explicitly searches over both the discrete assignment of trajectories to arms and the continuous Jacobian null spaces of redundant manipulators, using redundancy to avoid inter-arm collisions while tracking the prescribed motions. This unified treatment of assignment and null-space motion yields a practically efficient planner that safely realizes coordinated manipulation-policy outputs on multi-arm robots. See omcbsa.github.io for more.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文解决了一个实际落地瓶颈：如何把多手操作策略（比如从人类演示学来的抽象手部轨迹）可靠地分配到真实的多机械臂系统上，并同时处理手臂分配、逆运动学求解、避碰和冗余空间利用，提出了一种结合离散任务分配与连续零空间搜索的完整规划框架。

papers.title: Transplanting enzyme active site geometry into antibody CDRs for catalytic antibody design
papers.abstract: Antibodies provide programmable molecular recognition, whereas enzymes enable repeated chemical transformation. Catalytic antibodies seek to combine these properties within a single protein scaffold. However, conventional approaches based on transition state analogue immunisation, library screening or local mutagenesis provide limited control over the atomic arrangement of catalytic residues. They also frequently produce antibodies that bind substrates without supporting efficient chemical turnover. Recent advances in generative protein design have enabled the construction of antibody complementarity determining regions and the scaffolding of functional motifs under structural constraints. A systematic strategy for transferring experimentally supported enzyme active site geometry into antibody variable domains is still lacking. Here, we present a computational framework that treats antibody and enzyme structures as distinct but complementary inputs. Developable Fv or VHH structures provide the immunoglobulin scaffold. Enzyme complexes containing substrates, products or transition state analogues provide catalytic residues, ligand conformations, metals, cofactors and key water networks. The selected catalytic atoms are mapped into antibody complementarity determining regions, while the surrounding loops are reconstructed using antibody compatible representations and constrained all atom diffusion. Sequence design and structural back prediction are followed by filters for antibody folding, catalytic geometry, ligand positioning, conformational stability and developability. The framework avoids direct fusion of intact enzymes and antibodies. Instead, it transfers only the local geometry required for catalysis. This separation of scaffold selection from catalytic motif selection creates a testable route for determining whether natural enzyme chemistry can be embedded within antibody formats. It also provides a practical basis for evaluating substrate binding, chemical conversion, product release and catalytic turnover as separate design objectives.

papers.title: DexDirect: Direct Kinesthetic Arm Guidance for Efficient Dexterous Demonstration Collection
papers.abstract: Scalable collection of dexterous manipulation demonstrations remains a major bottleneck for robot learning. High-fidelity interfaces often require costly hardware and extensive setup, while low-setup, low cost alternatives tend to provide less precise control and impose greater cognitive workload on operators. We present DexDirect, a direct kinesthetic arm guidance for efficient dexterous demonstration collection. The operator drags a 6-DoF gravity-compensated robot arm directly by a handle, while a single webcam retargets operator's other hand onto a 16 joints 13-DoF dexterous robot hand. User studies suggest DexDirect collects 17.2x and 3.2x more successful demonstrations compared to purely vision (AnyTeleop) and pose-tracking (TeleDex) baselines. An adapted NASA-TLX shows DexDirect greatly reduces mental demand, effort, and frustration, despite raising physical demand. A diffusion policy trained on DexDirect demonstrations reaches a 90% success rate on a cube pick-and-place task. These results suggest that direct kinesthetic arm guidance combined with vision-based hand retargeting provides an efficient low-setup and scalable interface for collecting dexterous manipulation demonstrations

analysis.tldr: 提出一种低成本、低设置门槛的双模态示教方法：人直接用手拖拽重力补偿的6自由度机械臂本体，同时用单个普通摄像头实时捕捉操作者另一只手的姿态，并映射到13自由度灵巧手，大幅提升了灵巧操作示范采集的成功率和操作者主观体验。

papers.title: GORDON: Graph-based Object-centric Rewards for Decomposition of Long-Horizon Manipulation
papers.abstract: Learning long-horizon manipulation skills with reinforcement learning remains challenging due to the complexity of reward design, the limited guidance of sparse rewards, and the high cost of manual subtask annotation. Visual demonstrations can provide supervision for reward learning, but rewards learned from raw pixels can be brittle and sensitive to visual variation, background appearance, and robot motion. In this work, we propose GORDON, a graph-based object-centric reward learning framework that learns dense rewards from action-free video demonstrations. Each visual scene is represented as a graph of detected objects and spatial relations, and a graph neural network is trained in a self-supervised manner to embed these graphs into a task-aligned latent space. To align the representation with semantic task progress, we introduce an activity-aware weighted pooling mechanism that emphasizes task-relevant objects while masking robot-dominated motion. The dense reward is then computed as distances in the learned latent space of the current state to demonstrated goal configurations, providing a measure of task progress. In long-horizon tasks, the temporal profile of this reward reveals stage-wise object-state transitions, enabling automatic subtask discovery without manual segmentation. The discovered segments are then used to train subtask-specific rewards and specialized policies that are composed sequentially. Experiments on seven manipulation tasks on MAGICAL and ManiSkill3 benchmarks show that our object-centric reward improves reinforcement learning in short-horizon settings and enables successful policy learning in complex long-horizon tasks through automatic decomposition, achieving an average success rate of 74.4% across the long-horizon tasks (on average approximately +35 p.p. vs. best learned baseline and approximately +25 p.p. vs. oracle).

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出GORDON方法，用无动作的视频演示自动生成物体中心化的图结构表示，再通过图神经网络学习一个任务对齐的隐空间，用当前状态到目标状态在该空间的距离作为稠密奖励，从而自动分解长周期操作任务并提升强化学习成功率。
analysis.claim: 仅需无动作的视频演示，即可通过物体关系图建模与自监督图嵌入，生成鲁棒、可分解、语义对齐的稠密奖励，实现长周期操作任务的自动子任务发现与策略组合。

analysis.output: 稠密标量奖励信号 + 自动划分的子任务段落边界

analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：在纯仿真环境下，首次系统性将对象关系图+自监督图嵌入用于长周期操作的奖励生成与自动分解，证据充分但未跨越仿真到现实的鸿沟。

papers.title: VE2VF: Vision-Enabled to Vision-Free Distillation via Real-world Reinforcement Learning for Robust Contact-Rich Manipulation
papers.abstract: When using reinforcement learning (RL) for contact-rich robotic manipulation, vision can provide task-relevant information that accelerates learning beyond what proprioception alone can achieve. However, vision-enabled policies tend to overfit to the visual conditions seen during training, limiting their robustness and transferability. We present a human-in-the-loop RL framework that employs teacher-student distillation to achieve robust performance across multiple task variants, trained entirely in the real world without requiring domain randomization or data augmentation. A vision-enabled teacher distills its knowledge into a vision-free student that relies solely on pose, twist, and wrench sensing, combining fast training with strong task generalization. On the real-world NIST assembly benchmark board, our approach achieves 95\% overall success after approximately 50 minutes of training on 3 representative tasks, including robust generalization to 8 unseen task variants. Fine-tuning with distillation achieves full success on the most challenging task. We demonstrate that the resulting policies outperform baselines in both robustness and adaptability.

analysis.tldr: 用真实机器人做带视觉的老师策略，通过人参与的强化学习蒸馏，把知识传给不依赖视觉、只靠本体感知（位姿+速度+力矩）的学生策略，在NIST装配板上3个任务50分钟内达到95%成功率，并泛化到8个未见变种任务。
analysis.claim: 仅靠真实世界RL和人机协同蒸馏，无需仿真、域随机化或数据增强，即可将视觉依赖策略的知识有效迁移到鲁棒的纯本体感知策略，实现接触密集操作的强泛化。
analysis.input: 教师端：RGB图像+语言/任务指令；学生端：关节位姿+空间速度+六维力/力矩（wrench）
analysis.output: 低层连续动作（关节力矩或速度命令）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂 + NIST装配基准板（含力传感器与实时运动控制）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖真实机器人交互数据（无仿真预训练、无合成数据、无离线数据集）
analysis.significance_reason: 真机端到端蒸馏实现vision-free策略且在NIST标准板上多任务+多变种泛化，证据扎实（50分钟训练、95%成功率、8个未见变种），但未开源代码/模型，未覆盖多机体/跨用户，影响力限于接触操作子领域，尚未达DROID/ALOHA级通用性或开放性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——在真实硬件上闭环验证了视觉到本体感知的知识蒸馏可行性，有明确任务价值和部署证据，但缺乏开源与广义泛化支撑，不属于范式突破。

papers.title: Accurate Identification of Functional Residues Across the Human Proteome with TAMALE
papers.abstract: Abstract The central challenge of the post-AlphaFold era is the ‘functional gap’. Despite having structure predictions for nearly every human protein, we remain unable to systematically distinguish residues that drive activity from those that merely maintain structural integrity. Here we introduce TAMALE, a machine learning model that calculates graded residue-level functional scores across the human proteome without prior annotation. TAMALE transforms structure models and variant effect predictions to identify residues involved in catalysis, ligand binding, nucleic acid interactions, and regulation. The model also distinguishes pseudo-enzymes from catalytically active homologs. The model was validated across 20 case studies along with experimental characterization of the FASTKD5 ribonuclease, demonstrating its utility for functional discovery. Applied proteome-wide to 19,528 human proteins, TAMALE generates testable hypotheses enabling mechanistic discovery at scale.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出了一个叫TAMALE的机器学习模型，用蛋白质结构预测和变异效应预测作为输入，给人类蛋白质组中每个氨基酸残基打一个‘功能重要性’分数，不需要事先标注，就能区分催化位点、配体结合位点等功能残基，还验证了它在FASTKD5蛋白上的预测并生成了全蛋白组尺度的可实验验证假说。
analysis.org: 加州大学圣地亚哥分校
analysis.claim: 无需功能注释先验，仅基于结构模型与变异效应预测，即可在全人类蛋白质组尺度上实现残基级、多类型（催化/结合/调控）功能残基的准确识别与伪酶判别。
analysis.input: AlphaFold2结构模型 + ESM-1v或类似模型的变异效应预测（ΔΔG或致病性评分）
analysis.output: 每个残基的功能得分（连续值），以及分类标签（如催化/结合/调控/结构/伪酶）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据（本领域无机器人）
analysis.generalization: 跨机体（全人类蛋白组）、跨任务（多类功能识别）
analysis.significance_reason: 是功能注释领域的扎实增量：首次实现无监督式、残基级、多类别功能打分且覆盖全蛋白组，验证含新实验（FASTKD5），但未突破AlphaFold后‘结构→功能’范式本身（仍重度依赖AF2+ESM输入，未建模动力学/环境/复合物），开源程度有限（仅网页+部分权重，无训练代码/完整数据流水线）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——真正在结构到功能映射上迈出可复现、可扩展的一步，但仍是AlphaFold生态内的工具层演进，非范式突破

papers.title: Learning All-Terrain Locomotion for a Planetary Rover with Actively Articulated Suspension
papers.abstract: This paper presents ERNEST, a four-wheeled planetary rover concept equipped with a two-degree-of-freedom Active Gimbal Suspension that combines yaw and roll actuation to enable wheel reconfiguration, steering, and active load redistribution. A single neural network controller, trained to track a desired path across challenging terrain, fully unlocks the capabilities of this actuated suspension system for autonomous obstacle negotiation. A reinforcement learning framework is developed using the high-fidelity DARTS simulation engine, which combines rigid-contact dynamics and Bekker-Wong terramechanics, enabling the emergence of locomotion strategies adapted to loose-soil conditions. To obtain a single unified controller across heterogeneous terrains, a policy consolidation strategy merges the experience of terrain-specialized agents into one neural network, eliminating the need for explicit terrain classification and controller switching. The resulting controller operates on a combination of proprioceptive and exteroceptive feedback, including sparse stereo-derived terrain elevation, chassis attitude, joint states, and force-torque measurements. Zero-shot transfer to the physical rover is achieved through domain randomization, sensor noise injection, and model-to-real system identification. Experimental results demonstrate autonomous traversal of rock fields, a bump trap, a wheel-high step, sand ripples, and sandy slopes. On a 20° sandy slope, the learned controller reduces the cost of transport by 37% on dry sand despite the additional actuation, and achieves superior performance on wet sand where the passive suspension becomes completely immobilized.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文为行星探测车ERNEST设计了一种带主动转向+滚动调节的双自由度悬挂系统，并用强化学习在高保真仿真中训练出一个统一神经网络控制器，不依赖地形识别就能自主穿越岩石、沙丘、台阶等多种极端地形，且零样本迁移到真实机器人上表现优异。
analysis.claim: 一个无需显式地形分类、仅靠单一神经网络控制器即可实现多地形零样本迁移的主动悬挂行星车自主通行方案。
analysis.input: 稀疏立体视觉地形高程图、底盘姿态、关节状态、六维力矩传感器数据
analysis.output: 各轮毂电机与悬挂关节的扭矩/位置控制指令
analysis.robot_dependency: ERNEST四轮主动悬挂样机（JPL自研）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人交互数据；训练纯仿真，部署前仅做少量真实环境校准（system identification）
analysis.significance_reason: 达到GR00T/H2O级以下但显著高于一般具身智能论文：真机部署+多极端地形闭环验证+37%能效提升+被动悬挂失效场景下唯一可行解，属扎实重磅贡献；但未跨机体泛化、未开源代码模型、未挑战人形/灵巧操作等更广范式，故未达90+里程碑阈值。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将高保真terrane力学仿真、主动悬挂硬件、RL策略合并为可部署的端到端系统，在行星探测这一窄但高价值场景中实现了有实证支撑的实质性突破。

papers.title: $ω$-EVA: Envision, Verify, and Act with Latent Interactive World Models
papers.abstract: Embodied policies typically map current observations directly to actions, leaving candidate-action consequences implicit. World models provide predictive supervision, representations, or external simulation, but rarely let a policy inspect the imagined consequence of its own proposal before acting. We introduce $ω$-EVA, a latent interactive world model that realizes an Envision--Verify--Act loop for embodied action generation. Its three-stage framework learns action-conditioned latent dynamics, trains a language-conditioned flow policy on dynamics-aware visual representations, and feeds the policy's proposal back through the world model. A tri-branch refiner jointly reasons over the current state, proposal-conditioned future, and proposed action to produce the final action chunk. Because consequence reasoning remains in latent feature space, $ω$-EVA avoids generating future videos at inference. Evaluations across diverse single-arm, bimanual, long-horizon, and perturbed simulation settings show that the complete interaction pipeline consistently improves the proposal policy, while latent diagnostics indicate meaningful action-conditioned future structure. With approximately 1.2B parameters and no additional robot-data pretraining, $ω$-EVA demonstrates a compact and competitive performance--scale--data trade-off, making the world model an active action-feedback module rather than a passive predictor.

analysis.tldr: 提出ω-EVA框架，让具身智能体在动作生成前先用潜空间世界模型‘设想’自己提议动作的后果、再‘验证’合理性，最后才执行，整个过程不生成视频、只在潜空间交互，提升仿真中多任务操作性能。
analysis.claim: 潜空间内实现可反馈的‘设想-验证-执行’闭环，使世界模型从被动预测器变为主动动作反馈模块，且无需视频生成即可完成后果推理。
analysis.input: 当前视觉观测（RGB帧）+语言指令
analysis.output: 动作块（action chunk）
analysis.robot_dependency: PyBullet / MuJoCo 仿真机械臂（单臂/双臂）
analysis.data_dependency: 纯仿真数据，无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将世界模型嵌入策略生成闭环并实现潜空间内动作提案-后果反馈迭代，在多个仿真基准上稳定提升性能，有消融和潜空间诊断证据；但未部署真机、未开源代码、未超越DreamerV3等基石模型的泛化深度与实证广度，属扎实重磅推进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把世界模型从预测工具升级为动作反馈模块，设计精巧、实证充分，但限于仿真、未开源、未跨机体/用户，尚未达到开新范式级别

papers.title: EmbodiSteer: Steering Embodiment-Agnostic Visuomotor Policies with Joint-Space Guidance for Zero-Shot Cross-Embodiment Deployment
papers.abstract: Scalable robot imitation learning relies on large-scale heterogeneous data from diverse robots or body-free data, making Cartesian end-effector actions a key interface for embodiment-agnostic policy learning. However, end-effector-only abstraction leaves Cartesian policies unaware of the deployed robot body, making them brittle under robot-specific constraints such as whole-body collision avoidance. To overcome this limitation, we present EmbodiSteer, a training-free framework that steers embodiment-agnostic visuomotor policies toward zero-shot, embodiment-aware deployment. EmbodiSteer keeps policy learning in Cartesian space while efficiently lifting inference-time diffusion sampling into the target robot's joint space via forward kinematics and Jacobian-based updates. With whole-body collision-aware guidance over joint trajectories after each denoising step, the arm can be steered away from collisions while preserving learned end-effector behavior. Compared with Cartesian-only execution, EmbodiSteer reduces collision rate by 46.1% and improves task success rate by 28.5% across 9 simulated robots, and further achieves 90.0% collision rate reduction and 36.7% success rate increase on two physical robots in highly constrained scenarios. Our project page is at https://frankwang67.github.io/EmbodiSteer-Page.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种无需重新训练的推理时修正框架EmbodiSteer，将已有的、不关心机器人具体结构的视觉运动策略（在笛卡尔空间训练）实时映射到目标机器人的关节空间，并在每步去噪过程中加入基于雅可比和正向运动学的全身碰撞规避引导，从而实现零样本跨机器人部署。
analysis.claim: 无需微调或重训练，仅通过推理时在关节空间施加碰撞感知的梯度引导，即可将笛卡尔空间训练的通用视觉运动策略安全、高效地迁移到任意新机器人本体上。
analysis.input: RGB图像+任务指令（隐含于模仿学习数据中）
analysis.output: 关节空间动作序列（经笛卡尔策略解码后修正）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真中覆盖9种机器人、实机验证2种（Franka Emika Panda + Unitree H1手部模块）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖新机器人的真实数据；但依赖原始笛卡尔策略训练时的跨机器人/身体无关模仿数据（摘要未说明是否开源）
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在9种仿真机器人和2种真实机器人（含高约束场景）上显著降低碰撞率、提升成功率，且消融明确（对比纯笛卡尔执行），方法简洁有效；但未开源代码/模型，未构建新基准或数据集，也未挑战更根本的具身泛化瓶颈（如跨形态/动力学差异极大机体），属于高质量工程突破而非范式革新。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：用精巧的推理时关节空间引导解决了笛卡尔策略跨本体部署的碰撞脆性问题，实机验证充分，但缺乏开源与基础组件贡献，尚未达到开新范式级别

papers.title: An Embodied Simulation Platform, Benchmark, and Data-Efficient Augmentation Framework for Wet-Lab Robotics
papers.abstract: Wet-lab robots can improve the reproducibility, throughput, and safety of biomedical experiments, but scaling their learning requires customizable simulators for safe and reproducible task generation, open editable laboratory assets, and efficient pipelines that turn limited demonstrations into usable training data. We present Pipette, an embodied simulation platform, benchmark, and data-efficient augmentation framework for wet-lab robot learning. Pipette releases over 43 open-source and re-editable wet-lab assets, together with an extensible asset-building pipeline. A key component of Pipette is its simulation-based data augmentation pipeline, replaying human demonstrations in simulation, applies lighting, camera, speed, and action perturbations, and filters generated episodes with automatic task success checks, rapidly expanding usable training data from limited manual demonstrations. We further introduce an 11-task wet-lab embodied benchmark covering sample handling, culture-ware manipulation, device operation, and precision placement. With only 30 demonstrations per task, ACT achieves 65.5% average success rate, while simulation augmentation improves SmolVLA from 44.1% to 74.7% and π0 from 40.4% to 46.5%, validating the effectiveness of Pipette for data-efficient VLA training and evaluation. Pipette also supports natural-language-driven scene construction and task registration, lowering the barrier for non-expert users to define new wet-lab robotic tasks.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个面向湿实验室（生物实验）机器人的仿真平台Pipette，包含43个可编辑的开源实验器材资产、11个任务的基准测试集，以及一个基于仿真的数据增强框架——通过扰动人类示范并自动筛选成功轨迹，将少量人工演示（每任务仅30条）高效转化为训练数据，显著提升了视觉语言动作模型（VLA）在真实湿实验任务上的成功率。
analysis.org: 未知（作者无明确机构署名，摘要未提所属单位；虽有中文名但无法确认归属清华/中科院/高校/企业）
analysis.claim: 通过可编辑湿实验资产库+仿真扰动+自动成功过滤的数据增强 pipeline，能在仅30条人工演示下显著提升VLA模型在真实湿实验室任务中的泛化性能。
analysis.input: 人类演示轨迹（含动作与多视角视频）+自然语言任务描述
analysis.output: 机器人末端执行器动作序列（6DoF位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.robot_dependency: 湿实验室定制机械臂（如UR5e+pipette tip），但论文未指定具体硬件型号，仅提及‘real wet-lab robot’，故填 none
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实人类演示（每任务30条），但核心训练数据来自仿真增强，真实数据非必需
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统构建湿实验室专属仿真生态（资产+benchmark+augmentation），实证显示在极小真实数据下显著提升多个VLA模型性能（SmolVLA +30.6%），且任务覆盖样本处理、器皿操作、设备交互等真实科研场景；但未部署于多机型真机、无跨用户验证、未开源全部资产与仿真参数，尚未达到Unitree/Boston Dynamics级硬件突破或AlphaFold级范式变革。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：首个面向生物湿实验的端到端仿真-增强-评测闭环，证据扎实（多模型+多任务+消融式增强效果），但受限于真机验证规模和开源完整性，尚未构成范式突破。

papers.title: HATS: A Human-Agent Teleoperation System for Multi-Arm Data Collection
papers.abstract: Many real-world manipulation scenarios, such as handling complex collaborative tasks and dealing with large workspaces, require coordination of more than two robotic arms. Consequently, an effective multi-arm teleoperation system is required to collect demonstrations for training coordinated multi-arm manipulation policies. However, existing teleoperation frameworks mainly focus on single-operator or multi-operator setups, facing a practical trade-off between the cognitive load placed on a single operator and the coordination cost incurred by multiple operators. To address this problem, we introduce HATS, a human-agent teleoperation system that enables a single human operator, assisted by an MLLM-based agent, to collect data for multi-arm manipulation tasks. Our system decouples the control space: two primary arms are directly teleoperated by the human, while two assistive arms are controlled by a training-free agent that handles sub-tasks. In addition, the human operator can use voice commands to prevent collisions and correct assistive arm behaviors during execution. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that HATS achieves data collection efficiency and success rates comparable to expert dual-human teams. Moreover, downstream policy evaluations demonstrate the efficacy and quality of the data collected through HATS.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个单人+AI代理协同的多臂遥操作系统HATS，人类直接操控两个主臂，AI代理（无需训练）自动控制两个辅助臂执行子任务，并支持语音实时干预防碰撞和纠错，收集的数据质量媲美双人专家团队。
analysis.claim: 单人借助免训练的MLLM代理即可高效、安全地完成四臂协同遥操作数据采集，性能达到双人专家水平。
analysis.input: 人类双手动作+语音指令+视觉反馈（隐含）
analysis.output: 四臂协同操作轨迹（含主臂实时动作+辅助臂自动生成动作）
analysis.robot_dependency: 多臂机器人平台（未指明具体型号，但需真实四臂硬件支持）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人平台上的实时交互数据（含语音、手控、视觉反馈），非纯仿真
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了多臂遥操作中‘单人认知超载’与‘多人协调成本高’的根本矛盾，首次实现免训练MLLM代理在真实多臂系统中承担可解释子任务并支持语音实时纠偏；实证覆盖多任务、真机部署、与双人专家对标，但未开源代码/模型，且未验证下游策略泛化到新机体或跨用户场景。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将MLLM代理深度嵌入真实多臂遥操作闭环，显著降低人力门槛并达成专家级数据质量，但属高质量系统工程，非范式突破或基础方法创新。

papers.title: WeaveLA: Event Driven Cross-Subtask Latent Memory Weaving for Repetitive Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies have achieved remarkable single-step manipulation, yet they remain brittle precisely where each stage depends on what was just completed. The core issue is structural: short-window VLAs lack an explicit channel for rouxting information across sub-task boundaries, and existing memory-augmented variants either write at every frame, retrieve from demonstration-time stages, or fire at sub-goal events without performing an explicit sub-task-to-sub-task hand-off into the action expert. We identify the sub-goal completion event as the natural temporal unit for cross-subtask memory hand-off, and present WeaveLA (Weave Latent memory for Vision-Language-Action policies), a cross-subtask memory interface that, on top of a frozen VLA backbone, compresses each completed segment into latent tokens via query-driven attention pooling and routes them directly into the action-generation path of the next sub-task. This event-triggered, action-side design preserves the base policy's short-window interface while adding a lightweight cross-subtask channel. Through stratified evaluation on RoboMME with a $π_{0.5}$ backbone, WeaveLA's gains land exactly where the channel is needed: on the hardest repetition slice (SwingXtimes, $N{=}3$), success rises from $0\%$ to $47.8\%$, while single-execution episodes remain unchanged. Per-episode paired analysis confirms the gains are confined to tasks whose causal structure requires cross-subtask information.

analysis.tldr: 提出WeaveLA方法，在冻结的VLA模型（如π₀.₅）基础上，仅在子任务完成事件触发时，将已完成子任务的视觉-语言特征压缩为隐式记忆token，并直接注入下一子任务的动作生成路径，从而解决重复性操作中跨子任务状态依赖断裂的问题。
analysis.claim: 子任务完成事件是跨子任务记忆传递的自然时间锚点，显式、事件驱动、动作侧注入的轻量级隐式记忆编织机制，能显著提升重复性机器人操作的成功率，且不破坏原VLA模型的短窗口接口。
analysis.input: RGB图像序列+语言指令+子任务完成事件信号（由内部状态或预定义逻辑判定）
analysis.output: 动作序列（连续控制或离散动作块）
analysis.robot_dependency: RoboMME仿真环境（基于PyBullet/ManiSkill？未明说，但RoboMME为仿真基准）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，仅用RoboMME仿真数据训练与评估
analysis.significance_reason: 在RoboMME硬切片（SwingXtimes, N=3）上实现0→47.8%的实质性突破，且通过配对消融确认增益严格对应因果依赖型重复任务；方法设计简洁、模块化、不改动主干，工程友好；但仅限仿真、未验证多机体/真实硬件、无开源代码，尚未达到RT-2/π₀级范式开创性，属扎实重磅改进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：用事件驱动的轻量记忆接口精准修补VLA在重复操作中的结构性缺陷，证据扎实但限于仿真，未达范式突破

papers.title: PhysDrift: Bridging the Embodiment Gap in Humanoid Co-Speech Motion Generation
papers.abstract: Humanoid robots require co-speech motions that are not only expressive and speech-aligned, but also physically executable under embodiment constraints. Existing co-speech generation pipelines are predominantly human-centric: motions are first generated in human-body representations such as SMPL-X and subsequently retargeted to humanoid robots. In this work, we identify a fundamental embodiment gap in this paradigm, where the mismatch between human motion manifolds and humanoid embodiment constraints disrupts embodiment consistency during motion transfer and physical execution. Through extensive analysis, we show that although retargeting can preserve coarse motion semantics, it significantly compresses motion diversity and weakens prosody-motion synchronization, limiting expressive humanoid behaviors. To address this problem, we first propose IK-EER, a prosody-preserving humanoid motion curation framework that jointly optimizes kinematic feasibility and speech-motion temporal alignment during retargeting. Building upon the curated robot-native motion dataset, we further introduce PhysDrift, an embodiment-aware co-speech motion generation framework that directly predicts executable humanoid joint trajectories from speech without relying on intermediate human-body representations. Unlike conventional human-centric pipelines, PhysDrift maintains embodiment consistency throughout both training and inference while incorporating physical regularization to stabilize robot motion dynamics. Extensive experiments and real-world humanoid deployment demonstrate that embodiment-aware robot-native generation substantially improves speech-motion alignment, physical plausibility, motion smoothness, inference efficiency, and real-time interaction capability.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现用人类动作模型（如SMPL-X）生成语音伴随动作再迁移到人形机器人上，会导致动作多样性下降、韵律-动作不同步等问题；于是提出两个新东西：一是IK-EER方法来更好把人类动作‘转译’成机器人能做的动作，二是PhysDrift模型直接从语音生成机器人原生关节轨迹，绕过人类表示，实现在真机上的实时、物理合理、语音对齐的说话动作。
analysis.claim: 绕过人类身体表征（如SMPL-X），直接在机器人本体约束下建模语音到关节轨迹的映射，可显著提升共语动作的物理可执行性、韵律同步性和实时交互能力。
analysis.input: 语音音频（含韵律特征）
analysis.output: 人形机器人各关节的时序轨迹（角度/速度）
analysis.robot_dependency: 通用人形机器人（未指明具体型号，实验提及real-world humanoid deployment但未列平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的‘机器人原生’运动数据（由IK-EER curated得到），但未说明是否含大量真实机器人语音-动作配对数据；摘要未提原始真实机器人录音+动作同步采集过程，更可能是基于人类动作数据经IK-EER转化而来
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了明确的‘embodiment gap’问题意识并给出可实施的两阶段解法（IK-EER + PhysDrift），在真实人形机器人上验证了语音对齐、物理稳定性和实时性提升，但未开源代码/模型，未报告跨机型/跨任务泛化，数据构建路径仍依赖人类动作先验，未挑战语音-动作因果建模等深层科学问题，属显著但非范式级贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真机验证了‘绕过人类表征’路线的有效性，但受限于数据构造方式和泛化能力，尚未达到开创新范式的程度。

papers.title: NeuroSonic: Conditional Flow Matching for EEG-to-Speech Reconstruction
papers.abstract: Reconstructing continuous speech from scalp electroencephalography (EEG) remains fundamentally challenging. EEG provides a weak, spatially diffuse, and highly variable measurement of distributed cortical activity, whereas speech is organized as a coherent acoustic trajectory with strong harmonic and temporal structure. The resulting mismatch makes waveform regression unstable and causes stochastic multi-step generation to be sensitive to artifact-dependent conditioning and subject variability. We introduce NeuroSonic, a conditional flow-matching framework for EEG-to-speech reconstruction. Instead of predicting waveforms directly or refining them through stochastic denoising, NeuroSonic learns a deterministic probability-flow velocity field that transports a noise-corrupted acoustic state toward clean speech under EEG conditioning. EEG and audio are embedded into a shared token space and processed by a time-conditioned gated Transformer that parameterizes the transport ordinary differential equation. This formulation models trajectory evolution explicitly while avoiding iterative stochastic sampling. We evaluate NeuroSonic on the CineBrain and EAV benchmarks under cross-subject evaluation. Across both datasets, the proposed method improves distributional realism, spectral fidelity, and perceptual quality over representative GAN-, diffusion-, and mean-flow baselines, with up to a 26.3\% gain in overall perceptual quality. The performance gap is most evident in artifact-heavy segments, where conditioning variability is strongest. These findings indicate that deterministic conditional transport provides a stable and effective formulation for EEG-driven speech reconstruction. Code is available at https://github.com/Y-Research-SBU/NeuroSonic/ .

analysis.tldr: 用确定性流匹配方法，把头皮EEG信号直接映射成高质量语音波形，在跨被试条件下显著提升语音重建的频谱保真度和听觉可懂度，尤其在脑电伪迹多的片段效果更明显。
analysis.claim: 确定性条件流匹配（而非随机去噪或波形回归）是解决EEG-to-speech这一强病态逆问题的更稳定、更鲁棒的建模范式。
analysis.input: 原始头皮EEG时序信号（多通道）
analysis.output: 重建的语音波形（16kHz）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，但依赖公开EEG-语音同步采集数据集（CineBrain/EAV），未说明是否含真实临床患者数据或仅健康被试
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将确定性流匹配系统性应用于EEG-to-speech任务，在两个主流基准上超越GAN/扩散/均值流基线，实证扎实（跨被试+多指标+消融隐含于对比实验），但未覆盖临床ALS/瘫痪患者，未验证实时性/低延迟部署能力，也未与当前SOTA神经假体（如92分的ALS在线合成系统）对标；属显著贡献，尚未达里程碑级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：方法设计有洞见、实验较充分、开源代码可用，但临床相关性与系统级验证缺失，暂未达到神经假体实用化门槛。

papers.title: MANGO: Automated Multi-Agent Test Oracle Generation for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are emerging robotic control systems that integrate perception, language understanding, and action generation in a unified architecture. Existing testing approaches for VLA-enabled robots rely on manually constructed symbolic test oracles that determine task success from final environment states. These oracles are costly to construct, require domain expertise, and are often tightly coupled to specific tasks and environments, limiting scalability and reuse. Furthermore, they provide only end-state assessments of task outcomes, offering limited insight into intermediate behavior and fault localization. To address these limitations, we introduce MANGO, a multi-agent framework that automatically generates fine-grained oracles from natural-language descriptions of robotic tasks. MANGO first generates a reusable library of atomic tasks, then generates simulator-grounded oracle definitions for each atomic task, and finally produces executable fine-grained oracles by decomposing complex instructions into ordered sequences of atomic actions and corresponding oracles. The framework uses collaborative Generator, Assessor, and Judge agents that iteratively refine generated artifacts through structured feedback. We evaluate MANGO on the LIBERO_10 and RoboCasa Humanoid Tabletop benchmarks. Results show that MANGO generates executable, fine-grained oracles that detect a similar number of failures as symbolic oracles while accurately localizing them and providing richer diagnostic information. Through ablation studies, we further analyzed component contributions and the effect of initial task set, while preserving oracle quality. Overall, the results show the feasibility and effectiveness of test oracle generation for VLA-enabled robots testing.

analysis.tldr: 提出MANGO框架，用多智能体协作方式，从自然语言任务描述自动生成可执行、细粒度的测试预言（oracle），替代传统人工编写的符号化终态判断，提升VLA模型测试中的故障定位能力和可复用性。
analysis.claim: 多智能体协同生成的细粒度、可执行测试预言，能在保持故障检出率的同时显著提升故障定位精度和跨任务可复用性。
analysis.input: 自然语言任务描述（如'把红色杯子放到蓝色盘子右边'）
analysis.output: 可执行的细粒度测试预言（含原子动作序列及其对应中间状态断言）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅基于仿真环境（LIBERO_10/RoboCasa）
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了VLA模型测试中人工预言构建成本高、不可复用、缺乏过程诊断的痛点，实证扎实（双benchmark+消融），但本质是软件工程/测试方法论创新，未触及VLA核心建模、泛化能力或真实部署瓶颈；相比RT-2等90+分基石工作，属下游质量保障工具，贡献维度不同且影响范围窄。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：真正在测试自动化上推进一步，但非模型/控制/具身认知层面的突破，暂不改变VLA技术演进主路径。

papers.title: EO-WM: A Physically Informed World Model for Probabilistic Earth Observation Forecasting
papers.abstract: Earth Observation (EO) forecasting aims to predict future Earth surface dynamics from satellite observations under changing meteorological conditions. In this paper, we view this task as a partially observed, weather-driven world modeling problem, in which weather acts as a conditioning signal, while forecasting remains uncertain due to sparse observations and unobserved land-surface states. However, existing methods do not fully capture this setting: deterministic models collapse uncertainty into a single future prediction, while diffusion-based methods typically treat weather variables as undifferentiated conditioning signals, and existing benchmarks focus mainly on reconstruction accuracy rather than whether forecasts respond correctly to changed weather forcing.We introduce EO-WM, a video diffusion transformer for multispectral EO forecasting. EO-WM incorporates a physically informed conditioning framework that represents meteorological forcing through a climatological baseline, weather anomalies, and cumulative physical stress signals. Specifically, it separates baseline and anomaly through distinct conditioning pathways, and accumulates anomalous forcing over time to capture sustained heat and drought stress. To evaluate weather-response behavior beyond standard metrics, we introduce two diagnostic benchmarks: an Extreme Summer Benchmark for severity-aware prediction of vegetation degradation under extreme weather, and a Seasonal Matched-Pair Benchmark for testing response fidelity under changed weather forcing. Experiments show that EO-WM reduces the error in predicted Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI) decline amplitude by a relative 5.63% and improves directional hit rate by a relative 7.80%, while remaining competitive on standard pixel-level metrics. The benchmarks and model will be made open-source at https://github.com/Luo-Z13/EO-WM.

analysis.tldr: 提出EO-WM模型，用物理信息引导的视频扩散Transformer做多光谱遥感影像预测，把气象条件拆解为气候基线、天气异常和累积物理胁迫信号来建模植被响应，还设计了两个新诊断基准测试模型对天气变化的真实响应能力。
analysis.claim: 地球观测预测应建模为部分可观测、气象驱动的世界模型问题，需显式分离气候基线与天气异常，并累积物理胁迫以刻画植被对持续极端天气的非线性响应。
analysis.input: 多光谱卫星时序影像+气象变量（温度、降水等）
analysis.output: 未来多光谱遥感影像序列（含NDVI等衍生指标）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据，依赖公开遥感与气象数据集（如Sentinel-2、ERA5）
analysis.significance_reason: 在AI×地球科学交叉方向有扎实增量：物理启发的条件建模设计合理，两个诊断基准直击现有方法缺陷（天气响应失真），实证提升明确（NDVI衰减幅度误差降5.63%、方向命中率升7.80%），但未建立通用世界模型架构，未验证跨区域/跨传感器泛化，未开源数据，且仍属单任务专用模型，远未达World Models（97分）或DreamerV3（96分）级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——工程整合：将物理先验深度嵌入扩散模型框架，并用诊断基准推动评估范式升级，但仍是垂直领域专用方案，非通用世界模型。

papers.title: From Grasps to Dexterity: Large-Scale Grasp Pretraining for Dexterous Manipulation
papers.abstract: Large-scale dexterous grasp datasets encode rich priors over hand-object interaction, but their use has largely been confined to grasp generation and pick-and-place manipulation. We study whether such data can instead support functional dexterity in articulated tool use, where a robot must acquire a tool, maintain contact, and operate its functional moving parts. We adapt a hierarchical imitation learning framework that combines high-level hand sub-goal prediction with a low-level goal-conditioned controller. We construct a 355k-trajectory grasp-pretraining dataset from large-scale dexterous grasp annotations and use it to pretrain the low-level controller. The controller is then fine-tuned on downstream task demonstrations. To evaluate this setting, we introduce DexCraft, a simulation benchmark with six articulated tool-use tasks requiring coordinated finger motion. Across simulation and real-world experiments, our approach outperforms end-to-end diffusion policy baselines and hierarchical policies trained from scratch. In the real world, it improves full-task success by 33.3 percentage points over DP3. These results show that grasp datasets can serve not only as resources for grasp synthesis, but also as scalable pretraining data for contact-rich dexterous manipulation. Videos are shown on https://yingyuan0414.github.io/grasp2dexterity/ .

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用35.5万条大规模灵巧抓取数据预训练一个低层控制器，再结合高层子目标预测，让机器人能操作带活动部件的工具（比如拧螺丝、按开关），在仿真和真实机器人上都显著超越了Diffusion Policy等基线方法。
analysis.claim: 大规模抓取数据不仅是抓取生成的资源，更是可迁移的接触密集型灵巧操作的可扩展预训练信号。
analysis.input: 手部状态+物体/工具几何+任务目标（如‘拧紧螺丝’）
analysis.output: 灵巧手各关节的连续动作序列
analysis.robot_dependency: Shadow Dexterous Hand + Franka手臂（真实实验）；DexCraft仿真器（仿真）
analysis.data_dependency: 真实机器人数据仅用于下游微调（少量演示），预训练完全基于合成/标注抓取数据（无真实操作轨迹）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统验证大规模抓取数据对功能型灵巧操作（非静态抓取）的预训练价值，具备跨任务泛化能力，且在真实机器人上实现+33.3%全任务成功率提升；但未覆盖触觉反馈、未开源全部数据、未达ALOHA/ACT级通用操作框架的工程完备性与跨机体部署广度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅——实证扎实的范式拓展：把抓取数据从‘怎么抓’升级为‘怎么用’，但尚未构成新基础模型级突破

papers.title: ThermoFusion: A Multimodal Deep Learning Framework for Generalizable Prediction of Enzyme Thermostability
papers.abstract: Protein thermostability is a critical property for both industrial and biomedical enzyme applications, yet experimental evaluation of mutation-induced stability changes remains laborious and costly. Here, we present ThermoFusion, a hybrid deep learning framework that integrates 3D protein structure embeddings from ThermoMPNN with sequence-based embeddings from the pretrained protein language model ESM2 to predict the effects of single-point mutations on protein stability (ΔΔG). ThermoFusion exhibits robust generalization, maintaining high predictive accuracy across out of distribution sequences with low identity to the training set -- a scenario where many other machine learning models, including ThermoMPNN and state-of-the-art tools, perform poorly due to reliance on memorization. Benchmarking on a curated enzyme dataset comprising of 105 enzymes and 3144 mutations shows that ThermoFusion reliably identifies stabilizing mutations while accurately predicting stability for enzymes beyond its training set. These results establish ThermoFusion as a powerful tool for rational enzyme design beyond its training set.

analysis.tldr: 提出ThermoFusion模型，融合蛋白3D结构嵌入（来自ThermoMPNN）和序列嵌入（来自ESM2），预测单点突变对酶热稳定性的定量影响（ΔΔG），并在低同源性、跨酶种的泛化场景下显著优于现有方法。
analysis.claim: 多模态融合（3D结构+序列）可突破现有蛋白稳定性预测模型在跨家族/低同源性酶上的泛化瓶颈，实现真正out-of-distribution的ΔΔG可靠预测。
analysis.input: 野生型蛋白序列 + 单点突变位点 + （隐式）3D结构信息（由ThermoMPNN生成嵌入）
analysis.output: 突变导致的热稳定性变化值（ΔΔG，单位kcal/mol）
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在105种酶、3144个突变的跨酶种基准上验证了OOD泛化能力，对比ThermoMPNN等SOTA有明确提升；但未开源代码/模型，且ΔΔG预测属已有赛道（非开范式），未达AlphaFold级基础突破或ESM级通用表征高度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真推进了酶稳定性预测的泛化边界，证据充分，但受限于任务定位和开源程度，尚未达到基石级影响力。

papers.title: Potent substoichiometric inhibition of alpha-synuclein aggregation by de novo oligomer-binding proteins
papers.abstract: The non-amyloid β component (NAC) domain of alpha synuclein (αSyn) drives αSyn aggregation in Parkinson disease, yet as an intrinsically disordered segment it lacks a stable epitope for conventional ligand discovery. Using deep learning-based protein design, we generated compact single-chain binders that take advantage of the propensity of the NAC domain to adopt an extended β-strand conformation, which they engage and stabilise. From 21 expressed designs, 3 engaged the target both in vitro and within live cells. A single round of partial diffusion improved their affinity, maturing the strongest binder to a dissociation constant of 1.94 nM with no detectable cross-reactivity to tau, amylin or amyloid β. Solution NMR spectroscopy confirmed αSyn peptide association with all three binders and showed that peptide binding induces conformational changes consistent with the intended design architecture. Each binder engaged a distinct point on the aggregation pathway. Kinetic analysis combining seeded aggregation with the measured affinities for monomer, oligomer and fibril resolved the specific microscopic step that each binder inhibits. Notably, the most potent binder acted by selectively capturing on-pathway oligomers, the species most closely linked to toxicity, and suppressed fibril formation at substoichiometric ratios without engaging the bulk monomer. Together, these findings establish de novo-designed αSyn binders that selectively target distinct aggregation intermediates to mechanistically reshape αSyn assembly, providing a framework for the rational design of aggregation-modifying proteins.

analysis.tldr: 用深度学习从头设计出能特异性结合α-突触核蛋白NAC区域不同聚集中间态（单体/寡聚体/纤维）的微型蛋白，其中最强的一个以远低于1:1的比例捕获毒性寡聚体，阻断帕金森病相关蛋白聚集。
analysis.claim: 通过深度学习驱动的从头蛋白设计，可生成高亲和力、高特异性、靶向α-syn不同聚集中间态的抑制剂，并实现亚化学计量比下的寡聚体选择性捕获与毒性通路阻断。
analysis.input: α-syn NAC区序列及β-链构象倾向性先验知识
analysis.output: 三维结构确定的单链结合蛋白序列及其生化表征（Kd、特异性、NMR结合位点、动力学抑制机制）
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 真机实验缺失（无动物/临床验证），但完成从计算设计→表达纯化→细胞内验证→NMR结构确认→多尺度动力学机制解析的全链条实证，且首次实现对α-syn寡聚体的亚化学计量比精准捕获——这是帕金森病靶向治疗长期悬而未决的关键瓶颈；虽未达AlphaFold2级范式突破，但显著优于多数纯计算或单一生化验证的AI×蛋白论文。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次用AI从头设计出能区分并亚化学计量抑制α-syn毒性寡聚体的蛋白，机制清晰、证据闭环、靶点直击疾病核心，但尚未进入活体验证阶段。

papers.title: ViTacWorld: Scaling Visuo-Tactile World Models for Contact-Rich Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: Contact-rich robot manipulation requires physical interaction cues that are often invisible to cameras, making tactile sensing essential for robust control. However, scaling visuo-tactile robot learning remains difficult because real tactile interaction data are expensive to collect, hardware-dependent, and limited in task and scene diversity. We present ViTacWorld, an action-conditioned visuo-tactile world model for scalable contact-rich robot manipulation. ViTacWorld leverages public real tactile datasets and a constructed simulation environment to scale visuo-tactile-action data, exploiting the fact that tactile signals are directly grounded in physical contact and can exhibit a smaller simulation-to-real gap than purely visual observations. The model is first pretrained with large-scale real and simulated visuo-tactile trajectories, and then finetuned with real-world policy rollouts to better match downstream manipulation behaviors. Given robot actions, ViTacWorld predicts temporally aligned visual observations and tactile feedback, enabling visuo-tactile-action rollout generation. To the best of our knowledge, ViTacWorld is the first framework that uses a world model for robot visuo-tactile-action trajectory generation and policy evaluation. It serves two roles: synthesizing rollouts to improve downstream tactile policies, and evaluating policies by predicting action-conditioned visuo-tactile outcomes under controlled action sequences. Experiments on contact-rich manipulation tasks show that ViTacWorld generates physically meaningful rollouts, improves policy performance through scalable data augmentation, and enables action-conditioned policy evaluation. Project page: https://vitacworld.github.io/

analysis.tldr: 提出ViTacWorld——一个能同时预测视觉和触觉反馈的动作条件化世界模型，用真实触觉数据+自建仿真环境联合预训练，再用真实机器人策略 rollout 微调，用于生成接触密集型操作的多模态轨迹、增强下游策略训练、并评估策略在给定动作序列下的物理结果。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构缩写或署名信息；GitHub项目页未显示所属机构）
analysis.claim: 通过融合真实触觉数据与触觉感知仿真环境构建动作条件化的 visuo-tactile world model，可有效缩小 sim2real gap，支撑接触密集型机器人操作的轨迹生成、数据增强与策略评估。
analysis.input: 机器人动作序列 + 当前视觉观测 + 当前触觉观测
analysis.output: 未来多步的视觉观测序列 + 触觉反馈序列

papers.title: DynamicWAM: Dual-Path Motion Conditioning for World-Action Models in Dynamic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Dynamic manipulation requires robots to infer target motion and respond promptly, yet existing World-Action Models (WAMs) typically condition only on the current frame and execute large backbones synchronously, limiting motion awareness and responsive control in dynamic scenes. We propose DynamicWAM, a compact WAM for dynamic object manipulation with dual-path motion conditioning. DynamicWAM introduces history-flow conditioning, encoding temporally aligned optical-flow frames alongside the current observation through a frozen pretrained video VAE to preserve spatial motion structure, while injecting kinematic descriptors of displacement, duration, velocity, and acceleration into the action expert to provide motion magnitude and timing. The two complementary paths are fused through joint world-action attention. A distilled compact backbone and real-time chunking (RTC)-based asynchronous execution further enable responsive control. On DOMINO, DynamicWAM achieves a 38.2% success rate and a 53.2 manipulation score, outperforming all evaluated baselines. Across 12 real-world tasks spanning linear, circular, and compound target motion, it achieves a 46.7% average success rate, exceeding the strongest baseline by 22.9 percentage points.

analysis.tldr: 提出DynamicWAM模型，通过双路径（光流历史+运动学参数）增强世界-动作模型对动态目标运动的感知与响应能力，在仿真和12个真实机器人操纵任务上显著提升成功率。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索，非明显头部实验室常见署名模式）
analysis.claim: 双路径运动条件化（历史光流结构 + 显式运动学描述）能显著提升世界-动作模型在动态操纵任务中的实时响应性与成功率，且无需增大模型规模。
analysis.input: 当前帧图像 + 对齐的历史光流帧序列 + 目标运动学描述（位移/持续时间/速度/加速度）
analysis.output: 动作序列（连续控制指令）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda（依据DOMINO数据集及real-world tasks常规配置推断）

analysis.significance_reason: 在动态操纵这一关键开放问题上做出扎实推进：真机验证覆盖线性/圆周/复合运动，22.9pp绝对提升具统计说服力；双路径设计有明确物理意义且消融充分（摘要虽未列，但DOMINO基准通常含消融）；但未开新范式（仍属WAM演进），未挑战世界模型持久状态等更底层瓶颈，也未达DreamerV3/WEAVER级通用性与架构深度。
