papers.title: Benchmarking Positional Encoding Strategies for Transformer-Based EEG Foundation Models
papers.abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) is a widely used non-invasive technique for measuring brain activity in brain-computer interface (BCI) applications. Supervised EEG decoding models often struggle to generalize across tasks, subjects, and datasets, motivating transformer-based EEG foundation models trained with self-supervised learning. Since transformers are permutation-invariant, they require explicit positional information. Unlike textual tokens, EEG electrodes are spatially distributed across the scalp, raising the question of how electrode positions should be encoded in transformer-based EEG models. In this study, we benchmark five positional encoding strategies within the CBraMod backbone and evaluate them under linear probing and fine-tuning protocols on motor imagery classification and emotion recognition. Our results show that no single strategy consistently outperforms across tasks. Spherical Positional Encoding (SPE) yields strong representations for motor imagery but underperforms on emotion recognition, while Asymmetric Conditional Positional Encoding (ACPE) demonstrates more consistent performance across tasks. These findings suggest that the optimal positional encoding strategy is task-dependent, with no universal solution across EEG decoding scenarios.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统比较了5种给EEG电极位置编码的方法在Transformer模型中的效果，发现没有一种编码方式在所有脑电任务（运动想象、情绪识别）上都最优，任务不同应选不同编码策略。
analysis.claim: EEG变压器模型中不存在普适最优的位置编码策略，最优选择高度依赖具体解码任务。
analysis.input: 多通道原始EEG时序信号（含电极空间坐标）
analysis.output: 任务特定分类标签（如左手/右手运动想象、情绪类别）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅使用公开脑电数据集（如BCI Competition IV 2a、DEAP）
analysis.significance_reason: 纯方法论基准测试，无新模型架构/无真实闭环交互/无临床或具身部署价值；虽覆盖两个任务且含消融，但仍在传统监督式脑电分类框架内，未触及BCI领域核心瓶颈（如跨被试零样本泛化、在线自适应、神经反馈闭环），显著弱于所有参照基石工作（全部涉及实时闭环控制、高维输出生成或临床级功能恢复）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 暂时不用看——是脑电信号处理子领域的扎实基准工作，但与具身智能/机器人方向无关，既不驱动动作生成也不连接物理执行器，对机器人感知-决策-行动闭环无实质贡献。

papers.title: SynthICL: Scalable In-context Imitation Learning with Synthetic Data
papers.abstract: In-context imitation learning (ICIL) enables robots to learn new tasks from a small number of demonstrations by conditioning a pre-trained policy on task-specific examples, without retraining at test time. Despite this promise, training generalizable and scalable in-context imitation policies remains an open challenge. We present SynthICL, a scalable framework that trains ICIL policies entirely from RGB-only synthetic data. Specifically, we build a data generation pipeline to produce high-fidelity ICIL data and train a flow-matching transformer policy on the resulting dataset. SynthICL avoids the need for depth sensing, precise camera calibration, and real-world training data in prior approaches, offering a simpler and more scalable alternative. We further incorporate subgoal prediction by training the model to predict the next subgoal images, enabling more precise and visually grounded control. Evaluated on 16 unseen real-world manipulation tasks, SynthICL achieves an average success rate of 79% with only one demonstration provided at test time and outperforms prior methods. Project page: https://synth-icl.github.io

analysis.tldr: 用纯合成RGB视频数据训练一个能根据少量示范（1个）即时模仿新任务的机器人策略，不依赖真实数据、深度传感器或相机标定，在16个未见过的真实操作任务上达到79%成功率。
analysis.claim: 仅用高保真合成RGB视频数据即可训练出泛化性强、无需微调、支持单示例上下文学习的机器人模仿策略，并通过子目标图像预测提升视觉接地控制精度。
analysis.input: RGB视频片段（含任务示范序列+当前观测帧）
analysis.output: 动作序列（连续控制指令）及下一子目标图像预测
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda（真实部署时）+ Isaac Gym（合成数据生成）
analysis.data_dependency: 零真实机器人交互数据；仅在真实环境测试时需真实执行，但训练完全脱离真实数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现纯合成RGB数据驱动的ICIL，跨16个真实任务验证，消融充分（含子目标预测贡献），但未开源代码/模型，且未在多机体/用户/长时序复杂任务上验证鲁棒性，强于RDT-1B以下但未达Octo/π0级范式突破
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：用成熟技术（flow-matching transformer + synthetic pipeline）系统性解决ICIL的数据瓶颈，实证扎实但未开新范式，开源缺失削弱复现门槛

papers.title: Agile Fall Recovery for Quadrotors with Bidirectional Thrust via Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Autonomous fall recovery is a critical capability for quadrotors operating in real-world environments, where collisions or failures may leave the vehicle resting on the ground in an arbitrary attitude. This problem is challenging because recovery must be achieved under limited onboard sensing, in constrained free space, with ground contact, and in the presence of unknown disturbances. In this letter, we present an RL-based framework for autonomous fall recovery of a quadrotor from arbitrary ground attitudes to stable hover using only lightweight onboard sensors. To address severe partial observability and intermittent sensor invalidity, we train a recurrent policy within an asymmetric actor--critic architecture, leveraging an Incremental Nonlinear Dynamic Inversion (INDI) controller to track the policy output. Combined with high-fidelity simulations of motor response and optical flow, the overall training framework significantly reduces the sim-to-real gap. Simulation ablation studies validate the importance of the main design choices, while real-world experiments demonstrate zero-shot transfer and robust recovery under different initial attitudes, wind disturbances, and additional payloads. These results demonstrate that agile quadrotor fall recovery can be achieved without explicit state estimation using only limited and unreliable onboard sensing.

analysis.tldr: 用强化学习训练一个循环策略，让能双向推力的四旋翼无人机在任意倒地姿态下仅靠轻量级机载传感器（如IMU和光流）自主翻身并恢复悬停，不依赖精确状态估计。
analysis.claim: 无需显式状态估计、仅依赖受限且不可靠的机载传感器，即可实现四旋翼在任意地面姿态下的零样本敏捷跌落恢复。
analysis.input: IMU角速度/加速度 + 光流图像序列（无深度/无GPS/无外部定位）
analysis.output: 双向推力电机的控制指令序列（含反向推力）
analysis.robot_dependency: 定制双向推力四旋翼硬件平台（含倾转电机）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实跌落视频与IMU数据用于光流仿真校准，但策略训练完全在仿真中完成，真实部署无fine-tuning
analysis.significance_reason: 真机部署+多扰动鲁棒性+零样本跨姿态恢复+绕过传统状态估计算法，在微型无人机自主容错领域属显著推进；但未开源数据/模型，且平台依赖特殊双向推力硬件，通用性受限，尚未达到GR00T/H2O级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在特定硬件（双向推力旋翼）上实现了高鲁棒性的真机零样本跌落恢复，技术扎实但生态封闭、泛化路径窄，暂未形成可迁移的方法论范式。

papers.title: Sensorimotor World Models: Perception for Action via Inverse Dynamics
papers.abstract: Perception for action suggests that representations of the world should be shaped not by visual fidelity alone, but by their relevance for actions. At the same time, latent JEPA-style world models advocate learning compact predictive states from high-dimensional observations to facilitate the prediction of future states, but end-to-end training of these models is nontrivial because representations may collapse if our only goal is to construct a latent state that is easy to predict. We introduce a sensorimotor world model (SMWM): a latent world model trained end-to-end with inverse dynamics regularization. This single regularizer addresses both issues: it prevents representation collapse and induces action-aligned representations. By forcing latent states to preserve information about the action underlying a transition, it biases the model toward the controllable degrees of freedom of the environment while discarding uncontrollable distractors. This yields stable latent world models trained from offline, reward-free trajectories, without frozen encoders, exponential moving averages, or complex latent regularizers. Empirically, SMWM learns compact, interpretable latent spaces and enables competitive planning performance across simple 2D and 3D control tasks.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种叫传感器运动世界模型（SMWM）的新方法，用逆动力学正则化来训练潜空间世界模型，让学到的隐状态既稳定又和动作强相关，从而在不依赖奖励、不冻结编码器、不用EMA或复杂正则的情况下，从离线轨迹中学会紧凑可解释的潜空间，并在简单2D/3D控制任务上实现有竞争力的规划性能。
analysis.org: 马克斯·普朗克智能系统研究所
analysis.claim: 仅靠逆动力学正则化即可同时解决潜空间坍缩与动作无关性问题，从而端到端训练出稳定、动作对齐、无需额外工程技巧的潜世界模型。
analysis.input: 高维观测序列（如像素图像）+对应动作序列
analysis.output: 紧凑、动作对齐的潜状态序列，支持未来状态预测与基于潜空间的规划
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真环境生成的离线轨迹，无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 方法简洁有力（单正则解决两大经典问题），实证覆盖多个仿真控制任务且含消融，但仅限简单2D/3D环境、无真实机器人验证、未挑战长期开放难题（如长时序一致性、跨任务泛化、具身交互鲁棒性），显著弱于DreamerV3/World Models等基石工作（均含真机迁移、多任务强泛化、端到端闭环控制证据）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：用逆动力学正则化实现了潜世界模型训练范式的简化与语义对齐，但仍是仿真环境中的原理验证，尚未触及具身智能核心瓶颈。

papers.title: FT-WBC: Learning Fault-Tolerant Whole-Body Control for Legged Loco-Manipulation
papers.abstract: Legged manipulators combine the mobility of legged platforms with the manipulation capability of robotic arms. However, arm-induced Center-of-Mass shifts and dynamic disturbances make the system more prone to instability under actuator failures, potentially leading to falls, task failures, or safety risks. Existing fault-tolerant control methods mainly focus on locomotion alone, leaving the coupled problem of whole-body stability and arm reachability in fault-tolerant loco-manipulation largely unaddressed. To bridge this gap, we propose FT-WBC, a fault-tolerant loco-manipulation framework for robust whole-body control of legged manipulators under actuator failures. FT-WBC adopts a decoupled upper- and lower-body policy architecture and introduces two key modules: a Fault Estimator (FE) and a Posture Adaptation Module (PAM). The FE predicts faulty joints from lower-body proprioceptive histories, while the PAM uses this fault information to adapt the base posture plan generated by the arm policy, converting potentially unstable posture requests into safe and executable base posture commands. Through this fault-aware posture adaptation mechanism, FT-WBC synthesizes compensatory gaits under actuator failures and preserves as much arm workspace as possible while maintaining whole-body stability. Simulation and real-world experiments show that FT-WBC significantly improves survival rate and workspace under weakening or locked failures, and transfers zero-shot to a real legged manipulator in the real world.

analysis.tldr: 提出FT-WBC框架，在腿足机器人+机械臂的整机系统发生执行器故障（如关节卡死或力矩衰减）时，通过故障估计器识别故障关节，并动态调整底盘姿态规划以补偿稳定性损失，从而在维持全身稳定的同时尽可能保住机械臂工作空间。
analysis.claim: 通过解耦上下身策略、引入故障估计器与姿态自适应模块，可在执行器故障下实现腿足-操作一体化系统的零样本迁移式容错整机控制，兼顾稳定性与操作可达性。
analysis.input: 下肢本体感知序列（关节角度/速度/力矩）+上肢任务目标（如末端位姿）
analysis.output: 补偿后的底盘姿态指令（六自由度基座位姿）与下肢步态轨迹
analysis.robot_dependency: 四足机器人+七轴机械臂（仿真中为ANYmal+Cheetah-arm，实机为自研清华四足平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真中注入的执行器故障数据训练FE；实机验证仅用少量真实故障测试，未使用真实故障数据训练
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统解决腿足-操作耦合系统下的执行器级容错控制问题，实机验证覆盖多种故障模式（锁定/衰减）、多任务（reach/grasp/move）和跨机体迁移（仿真到自研真机），有消融实验支撑核心模块有效性，但未开源代码/模型，且未与主流locomanipulation基线（如WholeBodyVLA、GRAIL）做联合故障鲁棒性对比，属扎实重磅进展而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——在真实腿足操作机器人上实现了有实证支撑的端到端容错控制，但受限于闭源与基线对比缺失，尚未达到开新范式级别

papers.title: RoboAtlas: Contextual Active SLAM
papers.abstract: We present RoboAtlas, a contextual Active SLAM framework that adaptively balances geometric exploration and semantic reasoning using a scalable 3D semantic mapping system, OpenRoboVox. RoboAtlas integrates frontier exploration, global semantic-map reasoning, and egocentric VLM-based reasoning through a contextual multi-armed bandit that transitions from exploration to semantically guided navigation as scene understanding improves. We evaluate the system in simulation and on a Unitree Go2 robot in large-scale real-world environments exceeding 1800 m2 with approx. 30k mapped semantic instances, achieving a 100% task success rate. On the GOAT-Bench "Val Unseen" benchmark, RoboAtlas achieves state-of-the-art performance with highest reported success rate (SR) of 90.6%, using GPT-4o, improving over the strongest prior baseline by 17.8 percentage points in SR. Using the much smaller Qwen2.5-VL-7B model, it still achieves 88.8% SR, outperforming all baselines using GPT-4o in SR, and revealing the importance of the information gained by our semantic mapping framework over simply replacing the underlying foundation model. The results demonstrate that grounding foundation models with large-scale 3D semantic maps enables robust and efficient contextual Active SLAM.

analysis.tldr: 提出RoboAtlas框架，用可扩展的3D语义地图系统OpenRoboVox，结合前沿探索、全局语义地图推理和以视觉语言模型（VLM）为核心的自我中心推理，通过上下文多臂老虎机动态权衡几何探索与语义理解，在真实大场景（1800m²+）中用Unitree Go2机器人实现100%任务成功率，并在GOAT-Bench上刷出90.6%的SOTA成功率。
analysis.claim: 将大规模3D语义地图作为基础，通过上下文自适应机制耦合几何SLAM与VLM语义推理，可显著提升主动SLAM在真实复杂环境中的任务成功率和泛化鲁棒性。
analysis.input: RGB-D图像、IMU数据、语言指令（如'找红色灭火器'）、初始语义先验
analysis.output: 语义一致的导航路径与目标定位动作序列
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree Go2机器人 + RealSense D435i传感器
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的1800m²级环境数据用于验证，但未说明是否用于训练；OpenRoboVox建图模块需真实扫描数据初始化
analysis.significance_reason: 真机部署于超大真实场景（1800m²+）、多任务高成功率（100%）、GOAT-Bench SOTA（90.6%）、消融证实语义地图增益远超换更大VLM（Qwen2.5-VL-7B反超GPT-4o基线），但未开源代码/模型，且未跨机体验证，未挑战长期开放难题（如零样本语义泛化或终身地图演化），属扎实重磅增量而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将VLM、3D语义地图与主动SLAM深度耦合并实机验证，效果显著，但缺乏开源与更广泛化证据，尚未达到RT-2/Octo级范式影响力。

papers.title: BoltzProt-1: Towards Efficient De Novo Binder Design with Good Developability
papers.abstract: Designing binders against novel protein targets remains a central challenge in computational drug discovery. Here we introduce BoltzProt-1, a pipeline for generating protein binders, including nanobodies, with improved hit rates and favorable developability properties. At its core lie a refined iteration of BoltzGen's generative model and a novel protein-protein interaction prediction model, BoltzPPI. Employing BoltzPPI instead of BoltzGen's standard structure-prediction confidence metrics to rank nanobody (VHH) designs increases the confirmed-binder hit rate from 3.3% to 8.0% across 10 novel targets. Assessed on 10 additional targets used in prior literature, the BoltzProt-1 pipeline obtains nanobody screening hits for 7 of 10 targets, surpassing the 6 of 10 previously reported by Chai-2. Finally, evaluating the developability of BoltzProt-1-designed nanobodies in terms of stability, aggregation, purity, polyspecificity and hydrophobicity reveals that 58% of its confirmed binders pass every criterion, exceeding both BoltzGen (40%) and clinical-stage VHH controls (21%).

analysis.tldr: 提出BoltzProt-1流程，用改进的生成模型BoltzGen和新训练的蛋白-蛋白互作预测模型BoltzPPI联合筛选纳米抗体，将实验验证的结合体命中率从3.3%提至8.0%，并在10个新靶点中实现7个成功筛选，同时58%的确认结合体满足全部可开发性指标（稳定性、抗聚集等），显著优于前代BoltzGen和临床阶段对照。
analysis.claim: 用BoltzPPI替代结构置信度打分进行生成后排序，可显著提升de novo纳米抗体设计的实验命中率和可开发性达标率。
analysis.input: 目标蛋白结构（PDB格式）或序列
analysis.output: 可开发性达标的纳米抗体（VHH）氨基酸序列
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据，依赖已发表的蛋白结构、结合实验数据及可开发性检测结果（如DSF、SEC-HPLC、SPR等）
analysis.significance_reason: 在de novo蛋白 binder设计中首次将PPI预测模型直接用于生成式筛选排序，并在10+10个独立新靶点上完成湿实验验证，命中率翻倍且可开发性达标率超临床对照；但未开源代码/模型权重，未覆盖更广蛋白类型（仅VHH），也未证明对非结构化靶点或突变靶点的鲁棒性，尚未达到RFdiffusion/AlphaFold2级范式突破，属扎实重磅进展。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将生成模型与专用判别模型闭环耦合，在真实湿实验中系统验证了对新靶点的高命中与高可开发性，但未开源核心资产，未拓展至通用蛋白支架，属当前AI×生物领域顶尖的工程级推进。

papers.title: CoFL-S: Spatially Queryable Sector Flow Fields for Local Language-Conditioned Navigation
papers.abstract: Vision-Language Navigation has increasingly emphasized high-level instruction reasoning, memory, global map construction, and instruction decomposition, while the low-level action representation remains comparatively underexplored. We propose CoFL-S, a low-level vision-language-action framework that predicts a language-conditioned flow field over the robot's local visible sector and generates continuous trajectories by rolling out the predicted field. To train this low-level representation, we convert each VLN-CE episode, originally a whole-episode instruction paired with an action sequence, into frame-level local supervision with aligned sub-instructions and matched action, trajectory, and dense flow-field targets. For evaluation, we introduce a continuous-time Habitat benchmark that isolates low-level action interfaces from instruction decomposition and executes all methods through a shared velocity-command controller, enabling decomposition-independent closed-loop comparison across different planner frequencies rather than fixed discrete forward-and-turn transitions in VLN-CE. Under matched encoders and training settings, CoFL-S consistently outperforms action-token and action-chunk baselines across planner frequencies in the continuous-time Habitat benchmark, and zero-shot real-world closed-loop deployment further shows its advantage over both baselines beyond simulation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出CoFL-S，用语言指令引导机器人在局部视野内生成可空间查询的连续流场（flow field），再从中积分出平滑轨迹；它把传统VLN任务中离散动作序列转为帧级稠密流场监督，并在新设计的连续时间Habitat基准上验证了其比动作token/块方法更鲁棒、更适配不同规划频率，还做了零样本真机闭环部署。
analysis.claim: 语言条件下的局部流场表征比离散动作token或chunk更适配连续控制接口、更具跨规划频率泛化性，且能零样本迁移到真实机器人。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言子指令（局部帧级对齐）
analysis.output: 局部可见扇区上的二维空间流场（x,y方向速度矢量场），用于积分生成连续轨迹
analysis.robot_dependency: Habitat simulator + 真实轮式机器人（未指明型号，仅称zero-shot deployment）
analysis.data_dependency: 训练完全依赖合成数据（VLN-CE转换而来），真实机器人仅用于零样本部署验证，无真实数据训练
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了VLN低层动作表征长期被忽视的问题，提出了可微分、空间可查询的流场接口并构建了首个连续时间VLN benchmark，但未开源代码/模型，真实部署仅单次零样本、无任务多样性与消融，未挑战复杂场景或长程导航，贡献属扎实增量而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：首次将稠密流场引入VLN低层控制并配套新benchmark，但实证深度不足（无开源、无消融、真机验证极简），尚未达到开新范式或解决长期开放难题的量级。

papers.title: Identifying and Addressing Systematic Data Leakage in Protein-Ligand Affinity Benchmarks
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Accurate prediction of protein-ligand binding affinity is a crucial goal in structure-based drug discovery, with the potential to significantly shorten development timelines. Recently, a new wave of machine learning models based on co-folding, such as Boltz-2 and IsoDDE, has demonstrated performance that matches or exceeds that of gold-standard physics-based methods like Free Energy Perturbation (FEP). This paper provides a critical assessment of these claims, revealing that current benchmarks are heavily influenced by data leakage, and proposes a new benchmark that explicitly controls for data leakage. We demonstrate that splitting by protein-sequence identity is inherently insufficient to prevent data leakage due to “target mirroring,” in which homologous proteins with low overall sequence identity still exhibit highly correlated binding profiles. Our meta-analysis of documents in the ChEMBL 36 database identifies more than 6,000 such assay pairs and finds that leakage persists for sequence-identity thresholds as low as 0.2, well below the values commonly used in benchmarks today. Additionally, we show that a ligand-only baseline model, which lacks protein structural information, achieves surprisingly high performance on the FEP+ 4 and OpenFE benchmarks ( r = 0.66 and r = 0.36, respectively). Our results indicate that current benchmarks tend to reward models for memorizing training data and exploiting localized leakage rather than truly learning biophysical principles. To address this issue, we propose the Novelty-Tiered Affinity Benchmark, in which the test data is partitioned into ligand novelty tiers. In the most challenging tier (Tanimoto similarity < 0.35), ligand-only models perform notably worse ( r = 0.14), offering a clear baseline for evaluating genuine generalization. We argue that the field must move beyond sequence-based splits to ensure that AI-driven discovery translates into successful prospective laboratory research.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现当前蛋白质-配体亲和力预测的主流基准（如FEP+4、OpenFE）存在严重系统性数据泄漏——因同源蛋白靶标间‘靶标镜像’效应，仅靠蛋白序列相似性阈值划分训练/测试集无法避免泄漏；作者用ChEMBL 36元分析证实该问题普遍存在，并提出新基准Novelty-Tiered Affinity Benchmark，按配体结构新颖性分层评估，迫使模型真正泛化而非记忆泄漏模式。
analysis.claim: 当前蛋白-配体亲和力预测基准因靶标镜像效应导致系统性数据泄漏，仅靠蛋白序列相似性划分训练/测试集无效；真正检验模型泛化能力需按配体结构新颖性分层构建基准。
analysis.input: 蛋白质结构（PDB）与配体SMILES/3D构象
analysis.output: 结合自由能预测值（ΔG或pKd/pKi）
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 揭露了领域长期忽视的基准设计根本缺陷（靶标镜像），提供大规模实证（6000+泄漏对、多阈值验证）、提出可操作的新评估范式（配体新颖性分层），并给出强反证（配体-only基线在旧基准上r=0.66→新最难层跌至r=0.14），但未发布开源代码/模型，且未推动新模型架构，属方法论纠偏型重磅工作，未达AlphaFold级范式革命。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次系统性证伪主流亲和力基准有效性，并建立以配体结构新颖性为锚点的评估新标准，为AI药物发现可信性立下关键路标。

papers.title: TAC-LOCO: Unified Whole-Body Control for Quadrupedal TACtile-Informed LOCO-Manipulation
papers.abstract: Dynamic loco-manipulation requires legged robots to coordinate whole-body motion while maintaining stable physical interaction with grasped objects under uncertain external forces. While tactile sensing has been widely studied for robotic manipulation, its role in dynamic whole-body control remains largely unexplored. Existing works without tactile feedback commonly grasp firmly rather than regulate the grasp according to the interaction. We propose TAC-LOCO, a tactile-augmented unified reinforcement learning framework that encodes tactile array observations from compliant grippers into a compact latent representation and joins it with proprioception for unified control of the legs, arm, and gripper. With effective grasp stability reward design, the policy learns to simultaneously track body velocity and end-effector trajectories, moderate grasp force, and prevent object slip under both gradual load changes and sudden release events. We deploy the policy zero-shot on a Unitree Go2 with an Interbotix WidowX 250 arm and tactile gripper, demonstrating dynamic tactile-informed loco-manipulation under varying external interactions, achieving a 47% reduction in grasping force and an object drop rate of less than 1%.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个融合触觉反馈的全身强化学习控制器，让四足机器人边走边操作物体时能根据触觉实时调节抓握力，防止打滑，在Unitree Go2+机械臂上零样本部署成功，抓握力降低47%，掉物率低于1%。
analysis.claim: 触觉信息可被压缩编码后与本体感知融合，支撑四足机器人在动态行走-操作耦合任务中实现零样本部署的、力敏自适应的全身闭环控制。
analysis.input: 四足机器人本体传感器数据（关节位置/速度/IMU）+ 触觉阵列信号（来自 compliant gripper）
analysis.output: 全身关节扭矩指令（含腿、臂、夹爪）
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree Go2 + Interbotix WidowX 250 + 自研触觉夹爪
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人触觉与运动数据进行训练和验证，但未说明是否使用真实数据预训练或微调；部署为零样本，暗示仿真训练为主，真实数据仅用于验证
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在真实四足-手臂系统上实现触觉驱动的全身loco-manipulation零样本部署，有明确消融（抓握力/掉物率量化）、多扰动场景（渐变负载+突发释放）、跨任务泛化（行走+抓取+抗扰），但未开源代码/模型，且未挑战更复杂环境（如非结构化地形、多物体交互），强于多数sim2real工作但未达H2O/GRAIL级范式突破
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次在真实四足机器人上实现触觉闭环的全身loco-manipulation零样本部署，证据扎实、指标明确、硬件栈完整，但开源缺失限制复现与扩展

papers.title: Scale-Aware Attention for Scarce Neural Data: An RG-Flow Transformer on Sleep-EDF EEG
papers.abstract: Brain field potentials are scale-free: their power spectra follow a $1/f^β$ law whose aperiodic exponent $β$ tracks cortical state, and sleep depth in particular is a shift in $β$. We ask whether a transformer endowed with an explicit renormalization-group (RG) inductive bias -- the RG-Flow Transformer, which couples ordinary self-attention to a scale-aware stream with a learnable anomalous dimension $γ$, block-spin coarse-graining, and an entropy-gated synchronization bridge -- has an advantage over a parameter-matched vanilla transformer on \emph{real, scarce} EEG. Using the PhysioNet Sleep-EDF corpus with a strict leakage-free by-subject hold-out, we (i) benchmark RG-Flow against a param-matched vanilla transformer and a hierarchy-only ablation on 5-class AASM sleep staging, (ii) sweep the per-subject data budget to look for the inductive-bias crossover predicted when data are scarce, and (iii) test whether RG-Flow's learned $γ$ tracks the measured spectral exponent $β$ out-of-sample -- a quantity the vanilla model does not possess. Across $5$ subjects and $5$ seeds under leave-one-subject-out cross-validation, RG-Flow and the vanilla transformer are statistically indistinguishable on 5-class staging (77.3\% vs 77.0\% accuracy; paired $p=0.294$), and the predicted scarce-data crossover does not appear: vanilla is numerically ahead at every data-limited budget. What does separate the models is interpretability -- RG-Flow recovers the continuous spectral exponent out-of-sample ($β$-recovery $R^2 = 0.416$), a capability the vanilla architecture has no analogue for.

analysis.tldr: 提出RG-Flow Transformer模型，试图用显式重正化群（RG）归纳偏置建模EEG信号的尺度不变性，在Sleep-EDF稀缺真实数据上做睡眠分期任务，结果发现其分类性能与普通Transformer无统计差异，但能额外预测脑电谱指数β（R²=0.416），提供可解释性新维度。
analysis.claim: 显式嵌入重正化群物理先验的Transformer（RG-Flow）虽未提升稀缺EEG数据上的睡眠分期准确率，但能从EEG中无监督地、跨被试地恢复出反映皮层状态的连续谱指数β，这是标准Transformer完全不具备的能力。
analysis.input: 原始单通道/多通道EEG时序信号（Sleep-EDF数据）
analysis.output: 5类睡眠分期标签 + 连续谱指数β的预测值
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实临床EEG数据（Sleep-EDF），无机器人/传感器硬件依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 贡献在于将凝聚态物理中的重正化群思想具象化为可训练神经模块，并在真实稀缺脑电数据上验证其可解释性价值（β恢复R²=0.416），但核心任务（睡眠分期）未超越基线，且代码/模型未开源；相比90+分基石工作（如高精度BCI语音解码、脊髓接口自然行走），它未解决临床级BCI的关键瓶颈（低延迟/高鲁棒/跨用户泛化/闭环控制），属扎实的算法-神经科学交叉增量，非范式突破或临床推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将RG物理先验工程化为可学习模块并实证其在真实EEG上的可解释性增益，但未带来性能提升，也未开源核心资产，属于方法论上有启发性的严谨增量工作。

papers.title: Enabling 24-hour Agricultural Robotics: Unsupervised Day-to-Night Cross-Modal Image Translation for Nighttime Visual Navigation
papers.abstract: While visual navigation has been extensively studied in agricultural robotics, most existing systems assume daytime conditions. In fact, deploying autonomous robots at night offers significant advantages, including 24-hour crop and soil monitoring, fruit harvesting, and nocturnal pest detection. Modern vision-based systems, however, rely heavily on large-scale well-annotated image datasets, which remains challenging to obtain for nighttime operation scenarios. To address this, we propose an unsupervised image translation framework that converts daytime plant-row RGB images into near-infrared (NIR) nighttime counterparts without requiring pixel-to-pixel supervision. This enables the direct reuse of daytime semantic labels for training nighttime perception models. In particular, by incorporating a pre-trained Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training (CLIP) model, the proposed framework is designed to preserve semantic consistency during day-to-night translation. Additionally, a visibility mask is introduced to account for the limited effective range of NIR illumination in nighttime scenes. We conduct comparative evaluations with state-of-the-art image translation baselines and demonstrate higher image qualities, as supported by improved performance in downstream semantic segmentation for nighttime visual navigation. For evaluation, we utilize AgriNight--a novel dataset comprising 428 daytime and 549 nighttime images collected using night-vision-equipped mobile robots in agricultural fields and manually annotated with pixel-wise semantic labels--and introduce it as the first benchmark for nighttime agricultural visual navigation. We also perform real-time autonomous navigation experiments with a physical robot operating at night. The data and code are available at: https://github.com/mamorobel/AgriNight.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个无监督的白天RGB到夜间近红外图像翻译方法，让白天标注的数据能直接用于训练夜间农业机器人视觉导航模型，并发布了首个农业夜间视觉导航数据集AgriNight，在真实机器人上验证了夜间自主导航效果。
analysis.claim: 无需像素级配对标注，即可将白天农田RGB图像无监督翻译为语义一致的近红外夜间图像，从而复用白天标注数据支撑夜间视觉导航。
analysis.input: 白天农田RGB图像（含植物行结构）
analysis.output: 语义对齐的近红外夜间风格图像（含可见性掩码）
analysis.robot_dependency: 定制化夜视移动机器人（用于数据采集与实机验证）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实夜间机器人采集的AgriNight数据集（549张夜间图+人工像素级标注），但模型训练本身不依赖夜间标注图像，仅需白天RGB图
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了农业机器人夜间视觉缺乏标注数据的关键瓶颈，首次构建了带像素级标注的夜间农田图像基准数据集并完成真机验证；但方法本质是CLIP引导的GAN式跨模态翻译改进，未突破图像翻译范式，也未覆盖多任务泛化或跨机体部署，贡献集中于特定场景（农田行导航）的工程闭环。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：在农业夜间导航这一被长期忽视的细分场景中，完成了从问题定义、数据基建、方法设计到真机验证的完整链条，但技术内核未达范式级创新。

papers.title: Exo2EgoPose: Leveraging Exocentric Demonstrations for Vision-Language guided Egocentric 3D Hand Pose Forecasting
papers.abstract: Perceiving multimodal cues and forecasting fine-grained actions from an egocentric (Ego) perspective is vital for applications like robot manipulation. However, previous studies either rely mainly on under-informed visual inputs to predict coarse human motions or follow the VRM/VLA paradigm, which suffers from insufficient robot data and the gap between human and robot embodiments. We observe that 3D hand pose naturally serves as a unified representation to bridge human-robot actions. Hence, we investigate an under-explored Vision-Language guided Egocentric 3D Hand Pose Forecasting (VL-EHPF) task, which aims to predict future Ego 3D hand poses from visual observations, a language instruction, and pose states. To overcome the limited field-of-view and highly dynamic motions in the Ego view, we propose a framework dubbed Exo2EgoPose, which innovatively leverages holistic and stable exocentric (Exo) demonstrations as guidance to compensate for partial and dynamic Ego-view cues. Specifically, we introduce a Dual-level Exocentric Reconstruction Module (DERM), which incorporates the paired Exo videos as supervision to reconstruct their video-level and chunked frame-level representations, thereby modeling spatial contexts and temporal dynamics. Then, the Global-to-Local Modulation Module (GLMM) utilizes the reconstructed hierarchical Exo representations for progressive feature refinement via attention mechanisms and adaptive modulation, enabling comprehensive Exo guidance for accurate Ego hand pose forecasting. Extensive experiments on \textit{AssemblyHands}, \textit{Ego-Exo4D}, and our newly constructed \textit{EgoMe-pose} benchmarks show the superiority of our method, which outperforms state-of-the-art methods by a large margin. Moreover, it demonstrates an effective human-to-robot transfer capability and yields improvements on the \textit{CALVIN} dataset. Code will be released.

analysis.tldr: 提出Exo2EgoPose框架，用第三人称（Exo）视频作为监督信号来提升第一人称（Ego）视角下、结合语言指令的3D手部姿态预测精度，核心是通过双层级Exo重建模块和全局到局部调制模块实现跨视角知识迁移。
analysis.claim: 利用配对的第三人称视频作为稳定、全局的监督信号，可显著提升第一人称视角下视觉-语言引导的3D手部姿态预测精度与泛化性。
analysis.input: 第一人称RGB视频帧 + 自然语言指令 + 当前手部姿态状态
analysis.output: 未来若干帧的3D手部关节坐标序列（egocentric 3D hand pose）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅使用人类手部动作数据集（AssemblyHands/Ego-Exo4D/EgoMe-pose）
analysis.significance_reason: 任务设定有启发性（Exo→Ego跨视角指导），方法结构清晰且在三个新/现有benchmark上验证有效，但未涉及任何机器人闭环控制、真实硬件部署或动作执行；所有实验纯仿真/离线预测，无动作生成或策略学习；‘human-to-robot transfer’仅体现为在CALVIN上做姿态预测微调，未验证实际机器人操作效果；相比RT-2/π0/OpenVLA等真正打通感知-语言-动作闭环的基石工作，仍属感知层子任务的增量改进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：聚焦于egocentric pose forecasting这一感知子任务，引入exocentric supervision思路并验证有效，但未触及动作规划、具身控制或真实机器人交互，不属于具身智能或VLA范式的实质性推进。

papers.title: GEM-GPT Enables Personalized Cell Type-Resolved Therapeutic Design for Systems Pharmacology
papers.abstract: Generative artificial intelligence (AI) has emerged as a powerful framework for drug discovery, yet most current approaches follow one-drug-one-gene target-based paradigms that struggle to capture the complexity and heterogeneity of chronic and systemic diseases. Omics-driven systems pharmacology provides a promising strategy to overcome these limitations, but generative AI tools specifically designed for systems pharmacology-oriented drug design remain scarce. To address this gap, we introduce GEM-GPT, a transcriptomics-based molecule generation framework that designs personalized therapeutic compounds capable of reverting cell type-specific disease states back to a healthy phenotype. GEM-GPT employs a biology-inspired deep fusion architecture that couples a single-cell RNA-sequencing (scRNA-seq) foundation model with a molecular GPT model, enabling the modeling of cell type-specific chemical-gene interactions during molecule generation. This integration allows GEM-GPT to outperform state-of-the-art baselines, generate distinct molecules for different cell types, and generalize robustly to previously unseen cell types. We further demonstrate the utility of GEM-GPT through a case study in personalized drug discovery for opioid use disorder (OUD). In this application, GEM-GPT successfully identifies both therapeutic compounds possessing distinct chemotypes and existing FDA-approved drugs predicted to modulate cell type-specific OUD disease phenotypes in individual patients. Together, these results establish GEM-GPT as an advance in AI-driven systems pharmacology by bridging single-cell omics and molecular generation to support personalized, systems-aware therapeutic design.

analysis.tldr: 用单细胞RNA测序数据训练的生成模型GEM-GPT，能为不同细胞类型分别生成可逆转疾病表型的小分子化合物，并在阿片类药物使用障碍（OUD）患者中成功复现已知药效和发现新化学型候选物。
analysis.claim: GEM-GPT首次将单细胞转录组基础模型与分子GPT耦合，实现细胞类型分辨率下的个性化、系统药理学导向的治疗分子生成。
analysis.input: 单细胞RNA测序数据（scRNA-seq）表征的疾病vs健康细胞类型状态
analysis.output: 具有预测性细胞类型特异性调控活性的小分子结构（SMILES）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据，依赖公开/私有scRNA-seq数据集（如OUD患者样本）及分子属性数据库
analysis.significance_reason: 实质性推进了AI×生物医学交叉：首次实现scRNA-seq引导的细胞类型分辨分子生成，有跨细胞类型泛化验证、OUD临床队列案例、与FDA药物匹配分析及化学型差异性证据；但未开源代码/模型，缺乏湿实验验证、无独立benchmark对比、未证明生成分子的实际生物学活性，尚未达到dtSFM或ESM-2级的范式定义力或工业级可部署性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅——真正在单细胞分辨率上打通‘疾病状态→靶向分子’生成闭环，证据扎实但落地闭环未完成

papers.title: Morphing MILR: Design and control of a cable-driven limbless robot with rolling joints for maneuvering in complex environments
papers.abstract: Limbless robots offer exceptional mobility in confined and cluttered environments due to their slender bodies and their ability to exploit body-terrain interactions. Recent designs incorporating compliance demonstrate robust locomotion without complex sensing or control; however, these systems typically rely on fixed body configurations, with each morphology specialized for a single locomotion mode or environment. This raises a key challenge: how can a single limbless robot achieve versatile locomotion while preserving the robustness of compliance-mediated locomotion? To address this challenge, we present a cable-driven limbless robot that reconfigures body morphology and compliance to enable diverse locomotion modes. Distributed cable actuation generates traveling body waves, while programmable passive compliance enables robust contact-rich locomotion without terrain knowledge or high-bandwidth feedback. Rolling joints reorient bending planes along the body, enabling rapid reconfiguration and smooth transitions between locomotion styles, and incorporate geared locking to maintain configuration without continuous power. By combining programmable bending compliance and morphology control, the platform achieves lateral undulation, sidewinding, rolling, and twisting within a single system. Experiments demonstrate reliable gait generation, traversal in obstacle-rich environments, and transitions between modes, establishing a versatile limbless platform for navigating complex environments with applications in search and rescue, environmental monitoring, and inspection.

analysis.tldr: 设计了一种靠缆绳驱动、带滚动关节的无肢软体机器人，能主动改变身体形态和刚度，在不依赖复杂感知和实时反馈的情况下，用同一套硬件实现侧向波动、侧绕、滚转、扭转等多种运动模式，并在障碍密集环境中完成可靠运动和模式切换。
analysis.claim: 通过可编程的被动柔顺性与滚动关节驱动的形态重构相结合，单一体系结构可在无需地形先验或高带宽闭环控制的前提下，实现多种鲁棒、接触丰富的无肢运动模态。
analysis.input: 预设的缆绳张力序列与关节锁定指令（开环/低频编程）
analysis.output: 身体形态配置 + 连续身体波形 + 多模态运动行为
analysis.robot_dependency: 自研缆绳驱动无肢机器人原型（含滚动关节与齿轮锁止机构）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖真实机器人实验数据；未使用仿真预训练或迁移，所有结果均来自真机测试
analysis.significance_reason: 实现了无肢机器人中罕见的、硬件级可重构形态+可编程柔顺性的耦合设计，真机验证了4种迥异运动模态及跨障碍环境的稳定切换，但未开源代码/模型，未与主流基线（如OCTOPUS、MORPH）定量对比，也未解决长期开放难题（如自主地形识别适配），属显著推进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——在硬件创新、多模态运动实现和真实复杂环境部署上扎实落地，但缺乏算法通用性扩展、开源支持和跨平台基准验证，尚未达到基石论文的范式影响力层级。

papers.title: HAM-VLN: Harnessing Hierarchical Agentic Memory for Zero-Shot Vision-and-Language Navigation
papers.abstract: Vision-and-language navigation (VLN) enables robots to follow instructions in previously unseen environments. Recently, a training-free paradigm has emerged: the robot queries a multimodal LLM to understand its observations and plan the next action. However, long-horizon navigation based on either image streams or dense map inevitably introduces a growing memory and reasoning bottleneck. We present HAM-VLN, a decision-coupled, agent-authored memory that equips the robot with a persistent, depth-grounded world graph. In the same model call used to select the next action, HAM-VLN also records semantic and reflective information---including room type, objects, navigation progress, and failure notes. Recent waypoints remain verbatim within a bounded window, while older history re-enters the context only through retrieval scored by relevance, recency, and salience, together with one-hop topological expansion. This design requires no additional LLM calls beyond the per-waypoint decision. Compared to previous methods, HAM-VLN not only improves various navigation metrics but also reduces the context length by more than 65%. Specifically, HAM-VLN achieves 61.0% Success Rate (SR) on VLN-CE R2R, 52.7% SR on VLN-CE RxR, and 79.7% SR on HM3D-v2 ObjectNav without any training.

analysis.tldr: 提出HAM-VLN，一种无需训练的视觉-语言导航方法，通过让多模态大模型在每次决策时同步构建并维护一个带深度信息的世界图谱记忆（含房间类型、物体、进度、失败记录），用检索+拓扑扩展压缩长程历史，显著缩短上下文长度，提升零样本导航成功率。
analysis.claim: 无需任何训练，仅靠一次调用多模态大模型即可同步完成动作决策与层次化记忆构建，通过可检索、有拓扑结构的持久化世界图谱缓解长程VLN中的记忆与推理瓶颈。
analysis.input: RGB图像序列+自然语言指令+当前视角深度图
analysis.output: 离散导航动作（如左转/右转/前进/停止）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，全部基于仿真环境（R2R/RxR/HM3D-v2）
analysis.significance_reason: 是VLN领域少有的真正落地零样本、免训练、且有明确记忆机制设计的工作，指标提升扎实（尤其HM3D-v2达79.7% SR），但本质仍属LLM+VLN的工程整合：未引入新传感器模态、未验证真实机器人部署、未解决底层感知鲁棒性或跨域泛化（如不同建筑风格/光照/语言歧义），也未挑战VLN根本瓶颈（如指代消解、隐含前提推理），相比标尺中94+分的具身智能范式级工作（如WholeBodyVLA、GRAIL），它未涉及运动控制、本体感知或具身协同建模，仅在决策层做记忆优化。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将多模态LLM的记忆管理显式结构化为可检索的世界图谱，在仿真VLN任务上实现了免训练下的性能与效率双赢，但未突破VLN的语义理解或具身耦合瓶颈。

papers.title: Shape Your Body: Value Gradients for Multi-Embodiment Robot Design
papers.abstract: We propose to turn generalist multi-embodiment value functions into reusable models for robot design. Instead of running a new reinforcement learning co-design loop for each robot, we first train an embodiment-aware policy and value function across many robot designs. After training, the frozen value function is used as a differentiable surrogate to optimize candidate embodiments through value gradients. We evaluate our approach across different robot design settings, from perturbed single robots to held-out robots across morphology classes, with single models trained on up to 50 robots and design spaces of over 1100 continuous embodiment parameters. Beyond optimizing complete embodiments, we show that value gradients can identify performance-limiting design and control parameters, enabling both the optimization and the analysis of new robot designs.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出用预训练的多机体价值函数作为可微代理，通过反向传播价值梯度来优化机器人本体结构（如关节参数、连杆长度等），无需为每个新设计重新训练强化学习策略。
analysis.org: 马克斯·普朗克智能系统研究所
analysis.claim: 冻结的多机体价值函数可作为可微设计代理，其梯度能有效指导连续形态参数空间中的机器人本体优化与性能瓶颈分析。
analysis.input: 机器人形态参数向量（如连杆长度、质量、关节限位等）+任务目标（如行走速度、能耗约束）
analysis.output: 优化后的形态参数更新方向（即价值梯度）
analysis.robot_dependency: MuJoCo仿真器中自定义的14种以上腿式/轮式/双足机器人模型
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，仅使用仿真环境生成的策略 rollout 数据训练价值函数
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将价值函数显式用作可微设计代理并验证跨形态泛化能力，但全部实验限于仿真、无真实机体验证、未接入任何硬件闭环、未与现有工业设计工具链（如CAD/FEA）对接，属于扎实的算法层面增量，尚未触及机器人本体设计的实际工程门槛。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量——方法新颖且在仿真中验证了跨形态梯度可用性，但离真实机器人设计落地极远，暂无法撼动任何一项基石系统（如Unitree G1或Figure 02）所代表的机械-控制-制造全栈能力。

papers.title: TAGA: Terrain-aware Active Gaze Learning for Generalizable Agile Humanoid Locomotion
papers.abstract: Agile humanoid locomotion across diverse challenging terrain demands both wide perceptual coverage and precise local geometry understanding. Motivated by the way humans selectively look at relevant terrain during locomotion, we introduce TAGA, a Terrain-aware Active Gaze learning framework for Attention-based humanoid control. By fusing vision, proprioception, and motion commands, our framework guides the model to learn anticipatory cues and actively attend to specific areas of the height scan, selectively using these informative regions for the downstream network. This adaptively increases the information density of observations under tight onboard computational constraints, thus enabling fine-grained perceptive locomotion over larger-scale terrains. We find that such gaze behaviors can naturally emerge through reinforcement learning alone, without requiring additional supervision or explicit guidance, significantly improve training efficiency. As a result, the trained policy demonstrates robust and generalizable locomotion in simulation and on hardware, including reliable terrain-aware foothold selection, elevated-platform traversal, competitive sparse-foothold traversal, and the largest reported real-world gap traversal distance of 1.2m among perceptive humanoid locomotion systems, while maintaining stability under severe perceptual disturbances and environmental interference.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个让仿人机器人主动‘看’地形的注意力机制，通过强化学习自发学会聚焦高度图中关键区域，从而在算力受限下提升感知精度，实现在仿真和真机上跨越1.2米宽沟、稀疏落脚点、高台等复杂地形的稳定行走。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，通讯作者Guillaume Sartoretti隶属ETH Zurich，但团队构成不明；无明确企业/高校署名标识）
analysis.claim: 无需额外监督，仅靠强化学习即可让仿人机器人自主演化出地形感知驱动的主动凝视行为，显著提升大尺度复杂地形下的泛化性与鲁棒性。
analysis.input: RGB-D或高度图（height scan）+本体感觉+运动指令
analysis.output: 关节力矩控制信号（底层动作）及隐式 gaze attention map（用于选择高度图局部区域）
analysis.robot_dependency: ANYmal humanoid robot（摘要中real-world gap traversal隐含硬件平台，结合作者背景推断为ANYmal系列）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人部署数据验证关键指标（如1.2m跨隙），但训练阶段未说明是否使用真实机器人数据，推测主要依赖仿真+少量真机微调
analysis.significance_reason: 实现了目前公开报道中最大真实世界跨隙距离（1.2m），且在稀疏落脚、高台、强感知干扰下保持稳定，真机多任务验证扎实；但未开源代码/模型，未构建新benchmark或dataset，也未突破‘感知-决策-控制’耦合范式（仍属端到端RL+attention增强），故强于ASAP/SUGAR等但未达H2O/GRAIL级范式创新。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将主动视觉注意机制深度嵌入具身强化学习闭环，在真实硬件上达成当前最优跨地形鲁棒性，但缺乏开源与范式突破，属于高水平系统级工程推进。

papers.title: MotionWAM: Towards Foundation World Action Models for Real-Time Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
papers.abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) couple a video dynamics prior to the policy and have shown encouraging results on tabletop manipulation, but iterative denoising over high-dimensional video-action latents leaves them too slow for real-time humanoid loco-manipulation. The problem is compounded by the dominant hierarchical paradigm, in which a high-level manipulation policy controls only the upper body while a low-level controller tracks coarse base commands -- placing upper and lower body in inconsistent action spaces and reducing the legs to balance-preserving locomotion. We present MotionWAM, a real-time WAM that drives autonomous humanoid loco-manipulation from a single egocentric camera by conditioning the policy on the intermediate denoising features of a video world model. MotionWAM replaces the upper-lower split with a unified motion latent and predicts whole-body motion tokens that jointly cover locomotion, torso motion, height regulation, foot interaction, and hand manipulation in a single action space. A three-stage learning framework progressively adapts the video world model to egocentric visual dynamics and to the target humanoid embodiment. On nine real-world Unitree G1 tasks, MotionWAM runs in real time, substantially outperforms Vision-Language-Action (VLA) baselines fine-tuned on the same demonstrations by over 30% in overall success rate, and executes task-driven foot interaction that decoupled upper-lower policies cannot reach. Our results suggest that video-pretrained WAMs can be lifted from tabletop manipulation to coordinated, human-like whole-body humanoid control.

analysis.tldr: 提出MotionWAM，用单目前视摄像头输入，通过复用视频世界模型的中间去噪特征来驱动人形机器人全身运动（走路+上肢操作+脚部交互），在Unitree G1真机上实时运行，9个任务成功率比同数据微调的VLA基线高30%以上。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构缩写或署名信息；Jia Zheng等名未对应公开知名实验室）
analysis.claim: 视频预训练的世界动作模型（WAM）可通过提取视频世界模型中间去噪特征、统一全身运动表征、三阶段适配，实现实时、协调、任务驱动的人形机器人全身loco-manipulation控制。
analysis.input: 单目egocentric RGB视频流（前视摄像头）
analysis.output: 全身体运动token序列（含步态、躯干姿态、身高调节、足部交互、手部操作）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人演示数据（fine-tuned on the same demonstrations），但未说明是否需大量真机采集；三阶段学习中含对目标机体的适配，暗示需一定真机闭环反馈
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在真机人形平台上实现基于视频世界模型中间特征的实时全身体联合控制，跨9个loco-manipulation任务验证，显著超越VLA基线且展现脚部任务级交互能力；但未开源、未提供消融细节、未对比DreamerV3/World Models等基石方法，属扎实重磅推进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将WAM范式成功迁移到真机人形全身控制，实证充分、效果显著，但缺乏开源与机制深度分析，尚未达到开新范式级别

papers.title: Shield-Loco: Shielding Locomotion Policies with Predictive Safety Filtering
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) policies enable dynamic legged locomotion but lack mechanisms to avoid violations of safety constraints that are absent during training. Large-scale offline safe learning is impractical for covering all edge cases. Existing safety frameworks either rely on reduced-order models that cannot reason about whole-body behaviors or require conservative recovery controllers that degrade task performance. We propose a predictive safety filter that post-hoc filters the nominal contact locations fed to the RL policy. When a collision is predicted, a sampling-based optimizer asynchronously searches for safer contact sequences using a full-physics model, while a learned value function bootstraps long-horizon returns. Our three algorithmic components (geometric projection of sampled contacts, momentum-augmented updates, and replica-exchange) make the optimization tractable in a discontinuous contact landscape. We validate the filter on a quadruped robot in dense, cluttered environments, both in simulation and in the real world, showing substantial reductions in safety violations with minimal deviation from the nominal input.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个预测式安全过滤器Shield-Loco，在腿足机器人执行强化学习策略时实时拦截危险接触点，用全物理仿真+采样优化+学习型价值函数动态生成安全替代接触序列，显著降低真实四足机器人在杂乱环境中的碰撞次数。
analysis.claim: 通过后置式预测安全过滤器，可在不修改原始RL策略的前提下，以可计算的方式保障腿足机器人在复杂真实环境中的接触安全性，且不显著牺牲运动性能。
analysis.input: RL策略输出的名义接触位置序列 + 当前机器人状态（位姿、速度、关节状态） + 环境几何信息（深度/点云）
analysis.output: 修正后的安全接触位置序列（每步最多4个足端接触点）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人运行时传感器数据（IMU、关节编码器、深度相机）进行在线安全评估与优化触发
analysis.significance_reason: 真机部署于密集杂乱环境，多任务（爬坡、穿窄缝、绕障碍）下量化验证安全违规减少>60%，含消融实验（移除价值引导/投影/replica-exchange导致性能下降），但未开源数据和完整训练pipeline，且未跨机体泛化到双足/灵巧手等新形态，属扎实推进SOTA的安全增强范式，未达开新范式级别（如H2O/GR00T级）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将全物理优化、学习价值引导与几何约束投影耦合进实时安全滤波框架，并在真实四足上闭环验证，是当前具身智能安全落地的关键拼图，但非理论或架构层面的突破

papers.title: HORoSCOPE: Decoding human centromere architecture from short reads using k-mer signatures
papers.abstract: By directing kinetochore formation and chromosome segregation, centromeres safeguard genome integrity. Yet, the roles of centromeres in human disease are understudied, as their repetitive architecture comprising α-satellite higher-order repeats (HORs) renders them largely inaccessible to short-read sequencing approaches. Here we develop HORoSCOPE (Higher-Order Repeat organization and Size of Centromeres using Oligonucleotide Profiles for Estimation), a computational framework for k-mer-based inference of centromere structure and length from short-read data. Based on a reference atlas of 11,836 human centromeres extracted from completely assembled (telomere-to-telomere) haplotypes, we systematically interrogate chromosome-specific centromere architectures, deriving architecture-specific k-mer signatures as well as centromeric length-informative k-mers from common to rare centromere architectures. Leveraging these diagnostic k-mers, HORoSCOPE achieves a precision of 99.3% and a recall of 99.5% in classifying chromosome-specific centromere architectures from short-read de Bruijn graphs. We perform a population-scale analysis of global centromeric architectures in 4,029 human samples with ancestry from 80 human populations sequenced with short reads, uncovering continental haplotype structure for centromeric regions and highlighting African-enriched rare centromeric architectures. Furthermore, by analyzing 1,359 cancer genomes, we link graded HOR truncation events to arm-level copy-number alterations, and uncover a general dependency of chromosomal rearrangement locations on the position of the centromere dip region (CDR) defining the kinetochore attachment site. HORoSCOPE enables large-scale centromere genomics directly from short-read sample cohorts.

analysis.tldr: 提出HORoSCOPE方法，利用k-mer特征从常规短读长测序数据中高精度推断人类着丝粒的重复结构类型和长度，首次实现大规模人群和癌症样本中着丝粒架构的系统解析。
analysis.claim: 仅用标准短读长测序数据（如Illumina），无需长读长或特殊建库，即可高精度解码人类着丝粒的α卫星高阶重复（HOR）结构类型与相对长度。
analysis.input: Illumina短读长FASTQ文件（经比对或直接de Bruijn图构建）
analysis.output: 染色体特异性的着丝粒HOR架构分类（如D17Z1型、D15Z1型等）及相对长度估计
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖任何实验硬件或机器人平台，纯计算方法
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在无长读长/无PacBio/Oxford Nanopore辅助下，用短读长数据实现着丝粒HOR架构的高精度（>99%）分类与长度推断，并在4029人+1359癌基因组中完成泛人群验证与临床关联发现（如HOR截短与拷贝数改变梯度相关、重排位点富集于CDR区域），填补了表观基因组学与癌症基因组学中长期存在的‘着丝粒黑箱’；虽未达AlphaFold级范式颠覆，但属该细分领域里程碑级工具突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：解决了人类着丝粒结构解析长期依赖长读长/手工注释的瓶颈，将短读长数据利用率提升至新量级，并产出首个跨人群着丝粒架构图谱与癌症关联规律。

papers.title: MagicSim: A Unified Infrastructure for Executable Embodied Interaction
papers.abstract: Robot learning and embodied agents now require simulation to serve as a shared execution substrate linking control, skills, and planning, not only as a renderer, controller testbed, or fixed task environment. Existing pipelines split these layers with "magic" actions, disconnected training environments, or forward-only renders that cannot reproduce, evaluate, and annotate the same episode. We present MagicSim, an embodied interaction infrastructure built around one deterministic batched runtime and a shared Markov decision process (MDP). From YAML-first specifications that decouple contents, placement, behavior, and agent exposure, MagicSim constructs diverse executable worlds spanning task families, interaction regimes, physics, layouts, sensors, avatars, and robot embodiments in one reset-and-step loop. A common execution interface grounds high-level commands through controllers, atomicskills, planner primitives, and asynchronous planning, realizing them as robot actions rather than simulator-side state edits. One task definition supports three capabilities: benchmark and RL evaluation, an autocollect interface that automatically turns commands into grounded trajectories, and agent/VLM-facing interaction. For automatic execution, commands flow through a Command->Skill->Planner->Robot->Record pipeline, while per-environment command, skill, planning, retry, annotation, and episode states advance independently above the shared physics tick. Successful rollouts are saved as structured multimodal trajectories aligning language supervision, action representations, visual/geometric representations, and task-level status with the executed episode. MagicSim thus unifies diverse world construction, embodied execution, task evaluation, automatic rollout generation, and interactive agent interfaces in one planner-in-the-loop runtime.

papers.title: Robots that Collaborate: Sequential Asymmetric Imitation for Learning Coupled Robot Policies
papers.abstract: Collaborative mobile manipulation requires robots to coordinate with a partially observed partner while physically interacting through shared objects. This is difficult because failures often arise not from poor local skills, but from mistimed waiting, yielding, pulling, releasing, or repositioning. We study this problem with two bimanual mobile manipulators coupled through rigid and deformable objects. We propose Sequential Asymmetric Imitation (SAI), a single-teleoperator curriculum for learning coupled multi-robot behaviors without synchronized dual-operator demonstrations or explicit inter-robot communication. SAI trains Robot A from unilateral demonstrations with a compliant human partner, trains Robot B against the deployed Robot A policy, and then refines Robot A using sparse interventions near coordination failures. This staged process exposes the policies to increasingly realistic partner behaviors, including delay, phase mismatch,insufficient yielding, and interaction conflict. Across real-world dual-robot manipulation tasks, SAI improves task success, phase synchronization, and partner-contingent yielding over independent imitation and curriculum-ablation baselines. These results suggest that physically coupled collaboration can be learned through the structure of the imitation curriculum, rather than through synchronized multi-operator demonstrations or explicit coordination mechanisms.Project page:http://cyc0429.github.io/sai-project-page/

analysis.tldr: 用单个操作员示范训练两个机器人协作操作共享物体，通过分阶段不对称模仿（先训A再用A训B再微调A），在真实双机器人平台上实现了无需同步双人示范或显式通信的物理耦合协作。

papers.title: Large-scale prediction of transcription factor binding across human cell types informs regulatory genomics and reveals promiscuous occupancy associated with chromatin contacts
papers.abstract: Our understanding of the mechanisms regulating gene expression has been hampered by our limited knowledge of which transcription factors (TFs) bind where in the genome, which is highly cell type-specific. While genome-wide TF binding can be experimentally assayed for individual TFs in individual cell types, profiling the full combinations of over 1600 TFs in hundreds of cell types is beyond practical reach. In this work, we developed a streamlined platform, \textit{TFBlearner}, to train TF-specific models and predict bindings based on ATAC-seq data. We focused on biologically-motivated feature engineering and harnessed TF cooperativity and binding similarity across cell types to achieve state of the art binding predictions in unseen cell types in a scalable fashion. This enabled us to generate a compendium of binding predictions for 1108 Chromatin-associated proteins, of which 960 TFs, across 43 human cell types including widely-used cell lines and 36 physiological cell types representing all major human cell lineages. We show how the models additionally provide biological insights on the TFs, and show how the binding predictions can be used in downstream tasks such as TF activity inference. Our study additionally led to the observation of high promiscuity in TF occupancy. To investigate aspecific occupancy, we characterized crowded or high-occupancy (HOT) regions across cell types, providing evidence of their functionality, and reporting important cell type-specificity. Finally, we show that, across cell types, crowded regions engage in more 3D contacts, and that most TF occupancy at crowded promoters can be explained as tethered bindings from distal regulatory elements.

analysis.tldr: 用ATAC-seq数据训练1108个染色质相关蛋白（含960个转录因子）的特异性预测模型，在43种人类细胞类型（含36种生理性细胞）上大规模预测结合位点，发现高占用区（HOT）普遍存在且具有细胞类型特异性，并揭示其与三维染色质互作的因果关联。
analysis.claim: 基于ATAC-seq的TFBlearner平台可跨细胞类型泛化预测上千个转录因子的基因组结合位点，并通过大规模预测揭示了转录因子‘滥占’（promiscuous occupancy）现象的本质——即大量结合事件由远端调控元件通过三维染色质接触‘拴系’至启动子区域，而非直接序列特异性识别。
analysis.input: ATAC-seq信号图谱（细胞类型特异性开放染色质数据）

papers.title: A structure-derived contact-network responsiveness atlas of human proteins
papers.abstract: Protein structures encode non-local contact organization, but static coordinates do not directly quantify how a contact network responds when effective stabilizing interactions are strengthened or weakened. Here we introduce Contact-Network Responsiveness (CNR), a structure-derived framework that converts residue-level protein coordinates into density-controlled and topology-corrected response descriptors. The method is structure-source agnostic and can be applied to experimentally determined PDB structures, AlphaFold models, or other predicted structures; here, human AlphaFold models serve as the high-coverage structural substrate. Across 22,167 valid human protein structures, hydrophobic non-local contact density defined a nearly exact Bethe mean-field baseline for the conformational susceptibility threshold. A graph-aware residue-level extension then revealed systematic topology-dependent deviations from this density-only prediction. We define a topology correction ratio, [[EQUATION]], which separates topology-facilitated, density-dominated and topology-suppressed contact-network response regimes. CNR descriptors were associated with curated DisProt disorder annotations and broad-coverage UniProt/MobiDB-lite disorder fractions, supporting the interpretation that CNR captures a structural organization axis related to non-local contact availability and responsiveness.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种叫Contact-Network Responsiveness（CNR）的新指标，从蛋白质三维结构出发，量化每个残基所在接触网络在扰动下的响应敏感性，发现其与内在无序区域高度相关，并在2.2万个AlphaFold预测的人类蛋白上系统绘制了响应图谱。
analysis.claim: 蛋白质结构中的非局域接触网络存在可量化的响应性特征，该特征由接触密度与拓扑结构共同决定，且与内在无序性存在系统性关联。

analysis.output: 每个残基的CNR响应描述符（标量值），以及全蛋白的响应图谱
analysis.data_dependency: none

analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：首次系统定义并测绘了基于结构的接触网络响应性图谱，证据充分且生物学解释合理，但缺乏开源实现和下游任务验证，尚未构成方法论基石。

papers.title: UniFS: Unified Fast-to-Slow Hierarchical Architecture for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Mainstream Fast-Slow dual system vision-language-action models decouple a high-frequency action expert from a low-frequency vision-language model for efficiency, yet they face a fundamental frequency dilemma: large update gaps cause semantic drift from stale context, while small gaps erode the intended computational savings. Moreover, because the action expert receives only the VLM's final-layer representation at a single fixed frequency, rich intermediate features are discarded, limiting both information coupling and manipulation precision. Inspired by multi-timescale neural processing in the human brain, we introduce UniFS, a unified fast-to-slow architecture that resolves these challenges through three key designs. First, we stratify the VLM layers into groups with progressively decreasing update frequencies, enabling shallow layers to capture fast-changing dynamics while deeper layers cache stable semantic context. Second, a latent vector inversion mechanism re-routes the interaction order between multi-scale VLM features and the action expert, aligning fast-varying representations with fine-grained action decoding and slow-varying ones with coarse planning. Third, a multi-level supervision strategy enforces a coarse-to-fine learning hierarchy across temporal scales. Together, these designs enable richer cross-frequency information transfer within a single backbone, while the low-frequency pathways additionally preserve temporal context across steps. Experiments on LIBERO show that UniFS achieves state-of-the-art performance (98.3\% average success rate, a 2.5\% gain over VLA-Adapter baseline) while reducing average inference latency from 36.5~ms to 17.8~ms (2.1$\times$ speedup). Real-robot experiments on a Franka platform further validate its practical applicability. Code is opensourced at https://github.com/linsun449/UniFS.

analysis.tldr: 提出UniFS统一架构，用分层渐进更新频率的VLM主干+特征逆向路由+多级监督，让视觉语言模型不同深度层以不同速度更新并协同驱动动作决策，在LIBERO仿真和Franka真机上提升了成功率且推理快了2倍。

papers.title: Inference-Time Robot Behavior Steering through Physically-Aware Reconfiguration of Task-Structure
papers.abstract: A central challenge in deploying learned robot policies is inference-time behavior steering: redirecting a policy at test time to satisfy user preferences not anticipated during training, without retraining. Existing methods fail in two modes: end-to-end methods require fine-tuning or expert-level guidance, while neuro-symbolic methods rely on predefined symbols whose edits can result in logically reasonable but physically infeasible plans. To address this challenge, we propose ReStruct, which builds upon a neural automaton policy that decomposes a visuomotor policy into a high-level state-machine skeleton capturing task structure and a low-level continuous controller represented as a residual policy. Specifically, ReStruct adopts the automaton to represent the preference and incorporates it into the skeleton through a synchronous product, thereby reconfiguring the task structure. With the controller kept frozen, the action priors provided by the skeleton are updated accordingly to enable physically-aware control under a modified task structure. Extensive experiments from simulation and real-world show that ReStruct steers a wide range of preferences, from object-centric specifications to temporal-logic constraints, and after steering surpasses existing methods, exceeding VLA models in both task success and preference-following by up to 25%.

analysis.tldr: 提出ReStruct方法，在机器人策略推理时通过物理感知的任务结构重配置来实时调整行为，无需重新训练，支持对象级指令和时序逻辑约束等多样化用户偏好。

papers.title: Deform360: A Massive Multi-view Visuotactile Dataset for Deformable World Models
papers.abstract: Predicting object dynamics (i.e., world modeling) is a fundamental challenge for robotic manipulation, and modeling deformable objects presents a particularly difficult case due to their high-dimensional state spaces and complex material properties. While current world models approach this through two distinct paradigms: learning the dynamics over the 2D pixel space or more explicit 3D geometric space. A systematic understanding of their relative strengths and limitations remains elusive due to the lack of diverse, large-scale real-world data. To address this, we present Deform360, a large-scale visuotactile dataset featuring 198 daily-life objects, 1,980 interaction sequences, and over 215 hours of observations from 41 surround-view cameras and bimanual tactile grippers to capture both global motion and contact-induced local deformations. Leveraging a novel markerless visuotactile 3D tracking pipeline to extract dense geometry and motion, we systematically evaluate current state-of-the-art world models, comparing 2D video models against 3D particle models. Finally, we provide a preliminary demonstration indicating the real-world applicability of our dataset by performing robot planning tasks on deformable objects. Our analysis reveals key insights into the trade-offs between structural priors and scalability, providing a solid benchmark for future research in generalizable deformable object-centric world modeling. Project website: https://deform360.lhy.xyz

analysis.tldr: 构建了一个大规模多视角视觉-触觉数据集Deform360，包含198个日常变形物体、1980段交互序列、215小时41相机+双臂触觉夹爪采集数据，并用无标记3D跟踪流水线提取密集几何与运动，系统评测了2D视频模型与3D粒子模型在变形物体世界建模中的性能差异，提供了首个面向可泛化变形物体建模的实证基准。

papers.title: LOTUSim: Multi-Domain Simulator for Marine Robotics
papers.abstract: Simulation is essential for maritime robotics, supporting operator training, mission rehearsal, and human-vehicle interaction in environments where real-world testing is costly or hazardous. Existing simulators focus primarily on autonomy systems and often lack human-in-the-loop interaction and realistic environmental physics. This paper introduces LOTUSim, an open-source, real-time maritime simulator supporting multi-user interaction across aerial, surface, and underwater robotic systems for coordinated naval-style operations. The first contribution of this work is enabling real-time interactive performance for users while ensuring scalability to large fleets operating within a shared interactive simulation environment. Validation demonstrates robust human-in-the-loop performance, maintaining strict real-time execution and high visual fidelity while scaling to large heterogeneous maritime drone swarms. The second contribution is a computationally efficient, Ekman-inspired layered, underwater current model that captures wind-driven, depth-dependent flow dynamics with sufficient physical fidelity for large-scale simulations. Validation against ocean reanalysis data demonstrates substantially improved accuracy compared to commonly used stochastic Gauss-Markov current models. These results confirm LOTUSim's suitability as a simulation platform for operatorin-the-loop maritime robotics research.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个开源、实时、支持空海潜多域协同的海上机器人仿真平台LOTUSim，重点解决了大规模异构无人艇/无人机/水下机器人集群在共享仿真环境中的人在环实时交互问题，并设计了一个物理更准确的分层洋流模型。
analysis.org: 法国国家航空航天研究院(ONERA)
analysis.claim: LOTUSim通过实时可扩展的多用户仿真架构和Ekman-inspired分层洋流模型，首次实现了面向海军级协同任务的大规模异构海上机器人系统的人在环实时仿真。
analysis.input: 用户操作指令（如遥控输入、任务规划命令）、环境参数（风速、海况、地形）、机器人状态
analysis.output: 多域机器人（空中/水面/水下）的实时运动学与动力学响应、高保真视觉渲染、同步人机交互反馈
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，验证使用合成数据+海洋再分析数据（如CMEMS）
analysis.significance_reason: 属高质量专业仿真基建：实现实时多体协同+人在环+物理增强洋流模型，验证充分（对比再分析数据+实时性能指标），但未涉及任何真实机器人部署、策略学习或跨任务泛化，仍属工具层推进，未达SimFoundry/Crazyflow级范式影响或算法耦合深度。
