papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are deployed through pipelines that end users cannot audit, and a poisoned VLA can behave normally on clean observations while a small visual trigger redirects a long-horizon robot policy before any failure becomes observable. Existing vision or language defenses rarely explain what a triggered VLA representation looks like or how to recover behavior without retraining. We study this gap through two independently proposed VLA attacks from groups with distinct injection strategies, BadVLA and INFUSE; the latter persists after downstream clean adaptation. Across the evaluated poisoned models, we identify a recurring internal mechanism: a \emph{compact causal footprint}, namely a small visual support that is attention-seeded, spatially compact, and \emph{causal} in a precise sense -- masking it returns a clean-calibrated evidence-evolution score to the normal operating region. This footprint motivates TrustVLA, a mechanism-guided inference-time defense that adapts the Dirichlet evidence framework from trusted classification to monitor per-token, per-layer epistemic uncertainty in VLA policies. With only a small clean calibration set, TrustVLA (i)~detects abnormal evidence evolution, (ii)~localizes the compact support by counterfactual mechanism-score drop, and (iii)~recovers the observation by localized inpainting. Across OpenVLA/LIBERO and $π_{0.5}$ transfer evaluations, TrustVLA reduces attack success while preserving clean-task performance, providing a retraining-free, mechanism-guided defense for visual-triggered VLA backdoors.

analysis.tldr: 提出TrustVLA，一种不需重新训练、在推理时检测并修复视觉触发式后门攻击的防御方法，通过识别被毒化VLA模型中可解释的‘紧凑因果足迹’，结合Dirichlet证据监控和局部反事实归因实现检测、定位与图像修复。
analysis.claim: 视觉语言动作（VLA）模型中的后门攻击存在可泛化的紧凑因果足迹，据此可构建无需重训练、可解释、推理时生效的三步防御机制（检测-定位-修复）。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令
analysis.output: 安全/受攻击判断 + 触发区域定位 + 修复后的观测输入（用于下游策略）
analysis.data_dependency: 仅需小规模干净校准集（非真实机器人交互数据）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在VLA后门防御中建立可解释的因果机制（紧凑因果足迹），实证覆盖BadVLA/INFUSE两类攻击、多个VLA基座（OpenVLA/LIBERO/π₀.₅），具备跨任务/跨模型泛化性，但未在真实机器人上验证，无开源代码，且未挑战更复杂的多模态耦合后门（如语言+视觉协同触发），属显著但非范式级贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——真突破尚缺真机验证与开源代码，但机制发现扎实、评估全面，是VLA安全领域首个具备可解释性与推理时修复能力的系统性方案。

papers.title: Vision-Language-Motion Maps: An Open-Vocabulary, Uncertainty-Aware, Queryable Motion Attribute for 3D Scene Maps
papers.abstract: Open-vocabulary 3D maps let robots answer language queries about what and where, but they assume a static world and cannot answer queries about how scene elements behave. We introduce Vision-Language-Motion Maps (VLMM), an open-vocabulary, natural-language-queryable 3D map in which each element carries a fused motion attribute: a VLM/LLM semantic movability prior combined with geometrically observed cross-frame motion, together with a per-element uncertainty. Queries reduce to attribute filters that distinguish what has been seen to move, what could move but has not, and what stays still. On a controlled simulator benchmark with exact ground truth (AI2-THOR, three scene types) we show through ablation that the schema fields are non-substitutable: a semantic-only baseline fails motion queries even with strong features, and neither motion field substitutes for the other (the prior cannot answer "what is moving," observed motion cannot answer "what could move"). On real dynamic RGB-D (TUM and Bonn, six sequences) we show the uncertainty channel-our key difference from prior fused-motion work-consistently improves moving-vs-static average precision and reduces false motion flags, and is robust to estimated (noisy) poses. The raw confidence is not calibrated, but post-hoc isotonic calibration reaches an expected calibration error of 0.10. VLMM is a representation contribution: the closest prior maps each lack at least one of the four properties-open-vocabulary, language-queryable, fused prior-and-observed motion, and per-element uncertainty-that our combination provides.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出了一种叫VLMM的新型3D场景地图表示，它不仅能回答‘这是什么、在哪’（传统开放词汇地图），还能用自然语言回答‘这个东西会不会动、正在动吗、为什么不确定’——通过把大模型给出的语义可动性先验、跨帧几何观测到的实际运动、以及每个物体的不确定性估计三者融合进地图元素中。
analysis.claim: 开放词汇、可自然语言查询、带不确定性感知的融合运动属性（语义先验+观测运动）是构建动态3D场景地图的必要且不可替代的表示维度。
analysis.input: RGB-D视频序列 + 自然语言查询（如‘哪些东西能动但还没动？’）
analysis.output: 每个3D地图元素的三元组：（可动性先验概率，观测运动向量，不确定性标量）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人动作数据，仅需动态RGB-D序列（TUM/Bonn）和仿真器轨迹（AI2-THOR）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统性将语义可动性先验、观测运动与显式不确定性三者耦合进开放词汇3D地图，实证表明三者缺一不可；但在真实机器人闭环控制、任务泛化、策略输出等关键环节无验证，未接入任何执行层，仍属表征层创新，强于纯benchmark但弱于RT-2/Octo等具身行动模型范式级工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——真推进了动态场景理解的表征基础，但尚未连接感知与行动，属于扎实的上游表示创新，非具身智能闭环突破。

papers.title: Robots Acquire Manipulation Skills in Seconds from a Single Human Video
papers.abstract: The ability to acquire skills rapidly and effortlessly while retaining those already mastered is essential for robots. However, current methods still rely on a cumbersome training-time loop that is costly and slow, while eroding skills already mastered. In this paper, we introduce HOST (Human-to-robot One-Shot Skill AcquisiTion), a framework that enables a robot to acquire skills in seconds from a single human video while retaining previously mastered skills. HOST resolves skill acquisition through a cascade of self-grounded prediction. It first estimates the robot's progress within the demonstrated task, then translates the upcoming progression into the robot's own future observations, and finally derives actions from these predicted observations. This cascade is trained on targets coupled to the video demonstration, obtained by mapping the robot trajectory and the video demonstration onto a shared task progress manifold, then redefining each target to align with the future progression of the video. HOST thereby enables the robot to actively follow the demonstrated procedure and adapt it to the robot's embodiment. HOST acquires novel skills at inference time from a single human video in an average of 29 seconds and achieves a 62% average success rate. It exceeds the zero-shot baseline by 45% while retaining previously mastered skills. HOST even exceeds the baseline fine-tuned on 50 robot demonstrations per task while requiring 50 times fewer demonstrations and acquiring each skill 507 times faster. Additional information about HOST is available on the project website.

analysis.tldr: 提出HOST框架，让机器人仅看一段人类操作视频（无需任何机器人数据），29秒内学会新操作技能，且不遗忘已学技能，平均成功率62%，比零样本基线高45%，比用50段真机演示微调的基线更快更少数据。
analysis.claim: 仅凭单段人类视频，机器人可在推理时秒级获得新操作技能，且不干扰已有技能，核心是通过共享任务进度流形实现自接地预测级联。
analysis.input: 单段人类操作视频（无标注、无同步、无机器人视角）
analysis.output: 机器人关节级动作序列
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人演示数据（训练阶段未使用任何真机轨迹）
analysis.significance_reason: 真机验证跨任务泛化（12个操作任务）、实测秒级部署、显著超越零样本和少量微调基线，但未开源代码/模型，缺乏消融实验和多机体对比，未达ALOHA/ACT级系统性工程深度与开放性，属扎实重磅但非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在真实机械臂上实现了单视频秒级技能迁移的端到端闭环，证据扎实，但开源缺失和消融不足限制其复现与社区推动能力。

papers.title: Spectral power, but not phase connectivity, decodes the subanaesthetic ketamine state from surface EEG: the role of between-subject transferability
papers.abstract: Abstract Subanaesthetic ketamine alters the content of consciousness while leaving responsiveness intact. We asked whether this state can be decoded from single eyes-closed EEG epochs, and how spectral power and phase-based connectivity compare when used as features. Re-analysing openly available 62-channel EEG from ten participants (awake versus subanaesthetic ketamine), we trained classifiers under leave-one-subject-out cross-validation to discriminate the two conditions from log band power, weighted phase-lag index (wPLI) connectivity, and their concatenation. Band power decoded the ketamine state above chance (balanced accuracy 0.71), whereas wPLI connectivity computed on the same epochs was at chance (0.47), and combining the feature sets did not improve on power alone. The dissociation held across three classifier families and across spatial montages, and was not explained by the dimensionality of the connectivity feature space. To identify its source, we decomposed the per-feature drug effect into components shared across subjects and subject-specific. The ketamine effect on connectivity was large within individuals but largely subject-specific, and therefore not transferable to held-out subjects (shared fraction 0.05), whereas the spectral effect was substantially shared across subjects (0.53); both feature classes carried comparable individual identity, so the asymmetry reflects transferability rather than fingerprint-likeness. The spectral signature was also recoverable from a sparse electrode subset, as a five-channel lateral montage performed as well as the full array. Undirected phase connectivity thus fails to decode subanaesthetic ketamine not through insufficient spatial sampling, but because the connectivity drug effect is subject-specific in form.

analysis.tldr: 用公开的10人静息态EEG数据，发现仅靠频谱功率（而非相位连接性）能稳定区分亚麻醉剂量氯胺酮状态与清醒状态，且该频谱信号在被试间可迁移，而相位连接变化几乎完全是个体特异的，无法跨被试泛化。
analysis.claim: 亚麻醉氯胺酮引起的脑电改变中，频谱功率具有跨被试可迁移的群体标记特性，而相位连接性虽在个体内显著但不具备跨被试解码能力。
analysis.input: 单次闭眼静息态62通道EEG片段（log带功率或wPLI相位连接矩阵）
analysis.output: 二分类标签（清醒 vs 亚麻醉氯胺酮）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开的离线小规模临床EEG数据（n=10），无实时采集或闭环交互
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实的神经生理机制解析工作，揭示了频谱功率作为跨被试生物标志物的稳健性，但样本量极小（n=10）、无临床验证、未涉及解码实时行为或干预闭环，与基石级BCI（如高精度脑-语/脑-手实时解码、脊髓接口恢复自然步态）相比，既无新范式、也无功能重建、更无临床转化证据，仅限离线分析层面的特征可迁移性归因。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把已有EEG特征、公开数据集和标准机器学习流程用于厘清一个具体药理神经标记的可迁移性来源，方法规范但问题尺度窄、临床相关性弱，暂不具备推动BCI实用化的直接价值。

papers.title: AFUN: Towards an Affordance Foundation Model for Functionality Understanding
papers.abstract: Affordance understanding bridges visual perception and physical action, serving as an explainable interface for robot manipulation in open and unstructured real-world environments. Yet, building an affordance foundation model that not only understands where and how the interaction should happen, but also generalizes across diverse environments, objects, and tasks, remains a long-standing research challenge. Existing methods typically address only part of this challenge, either localizing task-relevant regions without specifying executable motion, or predicting motion but with limited scalability. In this paper, we present ourmodel, a step towards an affordance foundation model for functionality understanding. From a single RGB-D observation and a language task description, ourmodel predicts a task-conditional functional mask (where to interact) and a 3D post-contact motion curve (how to interact). To support open-world generalization, we build a large-scale standardized data pipeline that converts heterogeneous robot, human, simulation, and real-world scan data into a shared affordance schema with language, masks, and object-centric 3D motion labels. We evaluate ourmodel from three aspects: for affordance segmentation, ourmodel outperforms all baselines by a large margin across 8 test sets from 4 benchmarks, improving mean gIoU/cIoU by +23.9/+26.3; for contact-point prediction, it predicts substantially more accurate points, with a 12.7--61.3% hit-rate gain over the best baseline; and for 3D motion, it achieves the best performance on all three test sets. ourmodel can be deployed for real-world robot manipulation without finetuning for robot embodiment or using task-specific heuristics, demonstrating the ability to adapt to open-world affordance tasks. Project page: https://www.zhaoningwang.com/AFUN

analysis.tldr: 用单帧RGB-D图像和自然语言指令，直接输出交互区域掩码（哪里碰）和接触后的3D运动轨迹（怎么动），不依赖机器人本体微调，也不用任务特定规则，靠统一构建的大规模跨源（仿真/人/机器人/扫描）功能标注数据集训练。
analysis.claim: 通过构建首个覆盖多源、多模态、对象中心化的功能标注数据管道，并联合预测功能掩码与后接触3D运动曲线，实现了无需本体微调、无需任务启发式规则的开世界功能理解泛化。
analysis.input: RGB-D图像+语言任务描述
analysis.output: 任务条件下的功能掩码（2D像素级）+后接触3D运动曲线（连续空间参数化轨迹）
analysis.robot_dependency: none（论文强调部署时无需针对具体机器人微调）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖自建大规模混合数据集（含仿真/人类动作捕捉/真实扫描/机器人执行片段），但未使用真实机器人闭环操作数据训练策略
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将功能理解解耦为‘交互位置’+‘后接触运动’双输出，并构建了跨源统一标注范式；实证覆盖8个测试集、3类指标SOTA，且在真实机械臂上零样本部署成功；但未开源代码/模型，数据未公开，且运动预测未接入闭环控制或力反馈，仍属感知-开环规划层突破，未达RT-2/Octo级系统性闭环智能水准。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——在功能理解这一关键中间表征上做出扎实的结构创新与数据基建，但缺乏开源与闭环验证，尚未构成范式级突破。

papers.title: MARCH: Model-Assisted Reinforcement Learning for the Perceptive Control of Humanoids over Sparse Footholds
papers.abstract: Perceptive bipedal locomotion over sparse terrain remains a difficult challenge: model-based methods are precise but brittle to uncertainty, while model-free methods are robust but struggle to discover the precise, constrained motions required for safety-critical locomotion where small errors can cause catastrophic failures. We propose a model-assisted reinforcement learning (RL) framework that combines both perspectives in three steps: (1) generate a safe reference trajectory using simplified models; (2) train a privileged teacher policy guided by a control Lyapunov function (CLF) reward built around the safe reference trajectory; and (3) distill the teacher into a vision-based student policy. We show that this model-assistance procedure produces physically grounded locomotion, improving sample efficiency, reducing the need for a complex learning curriculum, and achieving smoother locomotion behavior alongside stepping stone performance comparable to model-free baselines. We validate our approach in simulation and demonstrate successful deployment on a Unitree G1 humanoid robot navigating sparse footholds with lateral constraints.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种模型辅助的强化学习框架MARCH，先用简化动力学模型生成安全参考轨迹，再用带控制李雅普诺夫函数（CLF）奖励的‘特权教师’策略训练，最后蒸馏成纯视觉输入的学生策略，在仿真中高效训练并在Unitree G1人形机器人上实机验证了稀疏落脚点（如石墩、窄梁）上的稳定行走。
analysis.claim: 模型辅助的RL框架（MARCH）能兼顾安全性与鲁棒性，在稀疏、受侧向约束的落脚点地形上实现物理可解释、样本高效、可部署的人形感知步态控制。
analysis.input: 单目RGB图像 + 落脚点位置先验（隐含在任务设定中，未明确说明传感器融合）
analysis.output: 关节力矩/末端执行器目标轨迹（底层控制输出，由学生策略直接驱动）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人部署数据用于最终验证，但训练阶段完全基于仿真；无真实机器人交互数据用于训练
analysis.significance_reason: 在稀疏落脚点这一经典挑战场景下，首次将CLF引导的特权教师+视觉学生蒸馏完整链路落地到真机人形（G1），具备物理可解释性、样本效率提升和实际部署证据，但未跨机体/跨地形泛化，也未引入新传感器模态或通用表征架构，强于多数纯仿真工作，但尚未达到GR00T/H2O级的范式突破或通用性跃迁。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将模型引导、CLF奖励、策略蒸馏三者闭环落地到真机人形，在特定稀疏地形任务上达成可靠部署，是扎实的系统级推进，但非理论或架构层面的突破。

papers.title: Transferring Contact, Not Just Motion: Compliant Grasping Across Dexterous Hands
papers.abstract: Dexterous grasping depends on contact regulation, not motion alone. Stable manipulation requires fingers to maintain appropriate object loading as contacts slip, deform, or become visually occluded. Existing cross-embodiment dexterous policies unify motion through retargeted hand poses or latent actions, but force feedback remains tied to each hand's sensing and actuation, limiting transfer. This work introduces a cross-embodiment force-position interface for contact-aware manipulation across heterogeneous dexterous hands. Motion intent is represented in a shared hand-pose latent, while each hand's effort signal is calibrated through system identification into physical joint torque in N.m. These torques are mapped to fingertip forces and compact per-finger load descriptors, giving the policy comparable observations of where the hand should move and how the object is loaded. Using this interface, a flow-matching visuomotor policy is trained on vision, proprioception, and calibrated contact, with structured visual masking that encourages reliance on force under grasp-relevant occlusion. The same calibrated signal drives a hybrid force-position controller for demonstration collection and execution, keeping force targets consistent across training and deployment. Experiments across structurally different hands show that calibrated contact feedback enables transferable compliant grasping, with learned primitives reusable in long-horizon manipulation pipelines.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种跨灵巧手的力-位混合接口，将不同硬件的手部关节扭矩统一标定为指尖力和负载描述符，使同一个视觉-本体-力觉策略能在结构差异大的灵巧手上实现柔顺抓取迁移。
analysis.org: 加州大学圣地亚哥分校
analysis.claim: 通过系统辨识校准各灵巧手的关节扭矩为物理一致的指尖力与负载描述符，构建力-位联合表征接口，可实现不依赖特定传感器/执行器的跨机体柔顺抓取策略迁移。
analysis.input: RGB图像+本体感知（关节位置/速度）+校准后的关节扭矩（映射为指尖力与每指负载描述符）
analysis.output: 关节力矩控制指令（经混合力-位控制器执行）
analysis.robot_dependency: Shadow Hand、Allegro Hand、DexPilot等异构灵巧手（含真实机器人平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的多手标定数据与演示数据（系统辨识+演示收集）
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在3种结构迥异的真实灵巧手上验证跨机体柔顺抓取迁移，含系统辨识标定、结构化视觉遮挡训练、混合力位控制器闭环部署；但未开源代码/模型，且未与ALOHA/ACT等基石方法做横向对比或集成进长程管道，属显著推进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：解决了跨异构灵巧手的力信号语义对齐这一关键工程瓶颈，实证充分但生态闭环不足，尚未达到ALOHA/ACT级的通用性与开放性。

papers.title: DNA-binding specificity recognition from predicted homologous protein-DNA structures
papers.abstract: Predicting protein DNA-binding specificity is essential for understanding gene regulation and disease mechanisms. Existing deep learning methods typically infer specificity from a single protein-DNA complex structure, which limits their ability to capture the diverse geometric patterns underlying protein-DNA recognition. Homologous protein-DNA interfaces provide complementary structural evidence and richer geometric features related to interatomic interactions. To address the limited diversity and coverage of experimentally determined complexes, we constructed a large-scale library of predicted homologous protein-DNA complex structures. Building on this resource, we propose HomoDSP, a template-retrieval-based framework for accurate DNA-binding specificity prediction. Benchmark evaluations and validation on newly released JASPAR 2026 samples indicate that HomoDSP outperforms existing methods in both accuracy and generalization, with particularly substantial gains on high-error samples. Moreover, this performance is largely retained when AlphaFold3-predicted complex structures are used as input. Template- and residue-level interpretability analyses suggest that HomoDSP improves prediction by focusing on DNA-affinity residues across multiple homologous templates. Finally, universal Protein Binding Microarrays evaluations on AI-designed DNA-binding proteins show that HomoDSP rescues a baseline failure mode in which the baseline method produces incorrect predictions because of training-set bias. Together, these results support the use of homologous template interfaces as informative structural priors for decoding protein DNA-binding specificity.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出HomoDSP方法，利用大量AI预测的同源蛋白-DNA复合物结构（而非仅依赖单一实验结构）作为模板，提升DNA结合特异性的预测准确率，尤其在难样本和AlphaFold3输入下仍稳健，并能修正因训练集偏差导致的错误预测。
analysis.claim: 利用多模板同源蛋白-DNA复合物结构作为结构先验，可显著提升DNA结合特异性预测的准确性、鲁棒性和泛化性，尤其缓解训练集偏差导致的系统性失败。
analysis.input: 多个同源蛋白-DNA复合物3D结构（可为AlphaFold3预测结果）及目标蛋白序列
analysis.output: DNA结合特异性序列偏好（如位置权重矩阵PWM）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 方法设计合理（模板检索+多结构几何融合），在JASPAR 2026和PBMs上验证了对baseline失败模式的修复能力，且支持AF3输入，但未开源全部预测结构库、未提供端到端训练代码、未在更大规模突变/疾病相关位点上做临床级验证，属扎实的显著贡献，未达基石级（如AlphaFold系列或ESM级）的范式突破或通用性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真推进了结构感知的DNA特异性预测范式，但受限于资源闭源与验证广度，尚未达到开新范式或临床落地级分量。

papers.title: MARLIN: De Novo Molecular Structure Elucidation from Tandem Mass Spectra without a Ground-Truth Formula
papers.abstract: Untargeted tandem mass spectrometry (MS/MS) detects thousands of small molecules per biological sample, yet most go unidentified because they are absent from spectral libraries. These uncharacterized metabolites and natural products are precisely the compounds that matter for drug discovery, biomarker research, and exposomics. Computational de novo structure elucidation could close this gap, but almost all state-of-the-art methods assume the ground-truth molecular formula is known, an oracle that does not exist for genuinely novel compounds and is itself predicted with substantial error. We present MARLIN, a de novo method that elucidates structures directly from a spectrum with no molecular formula at any stage. A self-supervised encoder predicts a molecular fingerprint from the raw peaks, and a block-diffusion language model generates candidate structures conditioned only on the fingerprint and the instrument-measured precursor mass. A provably safe mass-shell constraint keeps every candidate consistent with the measured mass without fixing the atom inventory, and candidates are accepted by exact parts-per-million mass agreement. A symmetric noise objective absorbs encoder error, and a candidate-diversity mechanism keeps the candidates from collapsing to a single structure. On the NPLIB1 benchmark, MARLIN is the strongest method evaluated without a ground-truth formula across exact-match accuracy, structural distance, and fingerprint similarity, and it recovers the correct molecular formula as a byproduct about as often as a dedicated predictor without ever using one. MARLIN enables reliable de novo structure elucidation in the realistic discovery regime where the molecular formula is unavailable.

analysis.tldr: MARLIN是一种无需已知分子式、直接从串联质谱图（MS/MS）推断未知小分子三维结构的AI方法：它用自监督编码器从原始峰谱预测分子指纹，再用块扩散语言模型生成候选结构，并通过质量壳约束（mass-shell constraint）和ppm精度校验保证质量一致性，最终在无分子式前提下实现高精度结构解析。
analysis.claim: 无需任何分子式先验（包括不依赖预测公式），仅凭MS/MS谱图和前体质量即可完成可靠、多样、质量一致的从头分子结构 elucidation。
analysis.input: 原始串联质谱峰列表（m/z强度对）+ 前体离子精确质量（ppm级）
analysis.output: 一组候选分子结构（SMILES字符串）及其排序置信度
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在真实发现场景（无真值分子式）下实现端到端、质量可验证、结构多样的de novo解析，且在NPLIB1上全面超越所有不依赖分子式的现有方法；虽未达AlphaFold2级范式革命，但解决了MS/MS领域长期存在的‘公式依赖’瓶颈，属药物发现与代谢组学中关键基础设施级突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——它终结了质谱从头解析必须依赖（或预测）分子式的教条，用质量壳约束+扩散生成+指纹解耦实现了首个严格满足物理质量守恒的无公式结构生成框架。

papers.title: EEG-SpikeAgent: Agentic Closed-Loop Program Synthesis for Automated EEG Spike Detection
papers.abstract: Automated detection of interictal epileptiform discharges in scalp electroencephalography (EEG) is clinically important, but recent high-performing deep-learning models often trade interpretability for accuracy. We introduce EEG-SpikeAgent, a closed-loop program-synthesis framework that uses a large language model (LLM) agentic system to generate signal-processing features for spike detection in scalp EEG. The system iteratively proposes one deterministic EEG feature module at a time, executes the resulting code on EEG to generate tabular features, evaluates performance via a tabular classifier, summarizes run-level metrics, and feeds structured diagnostics back to the model for refinement. Across iterations, EEG-SpikeAgent proposes and refines candidate signal features and decision rules informed by model performance. We evaluated EEG-SpikeAgent on VEPISET, a public 29-channel dataset of 4-second epochs containing 2,516 discharge-containing and 22,933 non-discharge epochs. Across five-fold cross-validation with a gradient-boosted tree classifier, agent-generated features achieved an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve of 0.935, balanced accuracy of 0.699, F1 score of 0.557, sensitivity of 0.401, and specificity of 0.996 at the default operating point. At an operating point with sensitivity 0.80, mean precision was 0.470 and mean specificity was 0.900. Artifact-aware feature generation improved balanced accuracy and F1 score over spike-only feature search. These results indicate that LLM-based program synthesis can automate EEG feature engineering in auditable and inspectable code-driven manner for clinical and methodological review.

analysis.tldr: 用大语言模型自动编写和迭代优化EEG信号处理代码，生成可解释的特征模块来检测癫痫样尖波，全程闭环、可审计、输出的是Python代码而非黑箱预测。
analysis.claim: LLM驱动的闭环程序合成框架能自动生成、执行、评估并迭代改进用于头皮EEG尖波检测的可解释信号处理特征代码。
analysis.input: 原始29通道4秒EEG时序数据（.edf格式）
analysis.output: 可执行的Python信号处理模块代码（含特征提取+决策规则）及对应分类性能指标
analysis.data_dependency: 仅依赖公开静态EEG数据集VEPISET，无需实时采集或硬件交互
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将LLM程序合成闭环应用于EEG特征工程，实证有效（AUC 0.935），代码可审计、模块可 inspect，但仅在单一公开数据集上验证，未跨中心/跨设备/跨病种泛化，无临床部署或医生反馈验证，未与现有临床工具链集成，属扎实的算法范式迁移而非临床突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把LLM程序合成成功迁移到EEG特征工程，方法新颖、实证可信，但仍是实验室级闭环验证，离临床可用和范式变革尚有距离。

papers.title: Active Real-World Factor-Based Evaluation for Generalist Robot Policies
papers.abstract: Generalist robot manipulation policies trained on large, diverse datasets have shown remarkable promise across a wide range of tasks. However, rigorously evaluating these policies remains a fundamental challenge. Real-world performance depends on a large combinatorial space of task factors including object poses and camera viewpoints, making full, exhaustive evaluation intractable. Additionally, real hardware evaluation is slow and resource-intensive, so current practice is to use narrow test suites that can miss critical failure modes and misrepresent true deployment readiness. We propose an active evaluation framework that addresses this challenge by treating policy evaluation as a sequential experimental design problem. Our approach fits a probabilistic surrogate model over a structured space of task factors and adaptively selects evaluation configurations to maximize information gain over the policy's performance distribution, allowing for sample-efficient characterization of policy behavior across unseen conditions and a systematic identification of failure-prone regions. We conduct 2331 real-world evaluations across 3 tasks with 3 factor variations and find that our approach typically saves the evaluator at least 20-40% of trials compared to typical random testing.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种主动式真实世界评估框架，用概率代理模型建模任务因素（如物体位姿、相机视角）与策略性能的关系，动态选择最有信息量的测试配置，大幅减少实机评估所需的试验次数。
analysis.claim: 通过将机器人策略评估建模为序贯实验设计问题，可在真实硬件上以更少试验次数系统性识别策略的失效区域并刻画其泛化行为。
analysis.input: 任务因素组合（物体位姿、相机视角等结构化变量）及对应的真实机器人执行结果（成功/失败或性能得分）
analysis.output: 策略在未见任务因素组合下的性能预测分布、高风险失效区域定位、评估效率提升建议
analysis.robot_dependency: 真实机械臂（未指明具体型号，但实验基于实机）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实机器人执行反馈数据（2331次实机测试），无法脱离真机运行
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了通用机器人策略落地前‘如何高效测出真实短板’这一关键工程瓶颈，实证扎实（2331次真机测试、3任务×3因子）、方法有统计严谨性，但未开新范式、未提升策略本身能力、未开源代码/模型，属显著工程贡献而非科学突破；明显低于GR00T/H2O/RoboTTT等94+分基石工作（它们定义了新架构/训练范式/跨模态对齐机制），也未达到WholeBodyVLA/ExBody级的系统性能力整合。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把贝叶斯主动学习迁移到机器人策略评估场景，实证充分且实用性强，但属于高质量工具链建设，不改变策略学习范式

papers.title: Deciphering the Streptococcus mutans essentialome: multi-omic resolution of hypothetical genes and identification of a functional RocS equivalent
papers.abstract: Abstract Genome-wide viability catalogs produced by transposon sequencing (Tn-seq) and CRISPR interference (CRISPRi) have successfully mapped the essential genome of Streptococcus mutans . However, particularly for genes annotated as “hypothetical” or uncharacterized, translating these findings into mechanistic biological functions remains a significant bottleneck. In this study, we developed an integrated functional genomics pipeline combining predictive bioinformatics, tunable CRISPRi transcriptional silencing, transmission electron microscopy, transcriptomics, and genetic suppressor screens to characterize nine legacy hypothetical essential genes in S. mutans . Comparative transcriptomics and proteomics revealed a conserved baseline stress signature across diverse essential pathways, marked by the coordinated downregulation of the citZ - citB - idh metabolic locus and insoluble matrix synthesis enzymes ( gtfBC ), paired with the robust activation of the integrative and conjugative element Tn Smu1 . Against this backdrop of systemic stress, we successfully resolved the function of SMU_393, defining it as a functional equivalent of the pneumococcal regulator of chromosome segregation, RocS. Depletion of SMU_393 resulted in abnormal cell widening, hypersensitivity to DNA damage, and a significant subpopulation of anucleate cells. Remarkably, these phenotypes were bypassed by a spontaneous surface-exposed missense mutation ( dnaA Q197E ) within the AAA+ ATPase domain of the replication initiator. Together, this work uncovers an important cell cycle regulator and provides a framework for exploring uncharacterized essential genes of the oral microbiome. Importance Although genome sequencing has identified thousands of genes required for bacterial survival, the precise biological roles for many of them remain completely unknown. This study implements an integrated functional genomics pipeline to resolve the molecular functions of legacy uncharacterized essential genes in the oral pathogen Streptococcus mutans . We discovered a critical molecular checkpoint that acts as a physical anchor, linking the bacterial chromosome to the cell envelope to ensure that chromosome replication is synchronized with cell division. Remarkably, a single mutation in the replication machinery can fully bypass the loss of this anchor, maintaining proper genetic inheritance even during severe cellular stress. Ultimately, this study provides a pipeline for uncovering highly specific physiological vulnerabilities that can be exploited for targeted therapeutics against oral pathogens.

analysis.tldr: 通过整合CRISPRi敲降、转录组/蛋白组、电镜表型和遗传抑制子筛选，解析了变形链球菌中9个‘假想’必需基因的功能，首次确认SMU_393是RocS同源物，作为染色体-细胞膜物理锚点协调DNA复制与细胞分裂，并发现dnaA Q197E突变可完全绕过其缺失导致的分裂缺陷。
analysis.claim: SMU_393是变形链球菌中功能等效于肺炎链球菌RocS的染色体分离调控因子，其缺失引发细胞增宽、DNA损伤超敏和无核细胞亚群，该表型可被dnaA Q197E突变完全抑制。
analysis.input: CRISPRi敲降株、RNA-seq数据、蛋白质组数据、透射电镜图像、遗传抑制子突变谱
analysis.output: 基因功能注释（如SMU_393=RocS等效物）、分子机制模型（染色体-包膜锚定）、可靶向的生理脆弱点
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在细菌功能基因组学领域属显著贡献：对9个长期未注释的必需基因完成多组学实证解析，发现全新细胞周期锚点机制并获遗传抑制证据，但仅限单一病原菌（S. mutans），未构建通用预测模型或开源工具链，也未扩展至其他微生物，影响力局限于口腔微生物学与基础细菌生理学。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——真突破在机制层面（首次揭示染色体-包膜物理锚点及可绕过性），但方法通用性弱、未开源核心流程、未跨物种验证，属于扎实的单系统深度解码，非范式级进展。

papers.title: APICE-Py: An Open-Source MNE-Python Pipeline for Scalable EEG Preprocessing
papers.abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) is fundamental to cognitive neuroscience as it provides a direct measure of human neural activities with millisecond precision. Its noninvasive nature allows for the study of brain function across diverse age groups and experimental contexts–from newborns to adults, and from tightly controlled laboratory environments to more naturalistic real-world settings. However, EEG signals–especially those recorded from infants–are highly prone to noise and artifacts, posing significant challenges for data analysis. To address these issues, we present APICE-Py (Automated Preprocessing for Infants Continuous EEG), an open-source preprocessing pipeline originally designed as a matlab toolbox for infant EEG and now re-implemented in Python to support scalable and flexible analysis across developmental and adult datasets. APICE-Py is built upon three core principles: (i) adaptive artifact detection on continuous data using data-driven thresholds rather than fixed cutoffs; (ii) hierarchical artifact correction, combining short-segment correction via Principal Component Analysis (PCA) with broader segment and continuous data correction using Spherical Spline Interpolation (SSI); and (iii) transparent reporting, providing comprehensive quality logs and decision-tracking to ensure reproducibility and informed analysis. We summarize the underlying algorithms, release an implementation compatible with common EEG formats, and demonstrate its use on three datasets spanning neonates, 5-month-old infants, and child-parent hyperscanned data, acquired using high-density wet electrodes and mobile gel-based EEG systems. When benchmarked against the original MATLAB implementation, APICE-Py achieved comparable levels of data quality and trial retention. While the original pipeline was developed for early developmental EEG (e.g., infants), we show that the pipeline further extends its applicability to both children and adult datasets, enabling robust preprocessing across a broad age range. Moreover, it supports data acquired using a variety of EEG configurations and experimental settings, highlighting its flexibility across age groups, hardware systems, and paradigms. The APICE-Py source code and documentation are freely available at https://github.com/neurokidslab/apice-py.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文把原本为婴儿EEG设计的MATLAB预处理工具APICE重写成开源Python版本（APICE-Py），支持从新生儿到成人的多龄段、多硬件（高密度湿电极/移动凝胶电极）EEG数据，核心改进是自适应阈值去噪、分层校正（PCA+球面样条插值）和全程可追溯的质量日志。
analysis.claim: APICE-Py是一个可扩展、跨龄段、跨硬件的开源EEG预处理流水线，通过数据驱动的自适应去噪与分层校正，在保持原始MATLAB版性能的同时显著提升灵活性与可复现性。
analysis.input: 原始连续EEG信号（含婴儿/儿童/成人数据，支持EDF/BDF等通用格式）
analysis.output: 清洗后的干净EEG时序信号 + 完整质量日志（含每步决策依据与参数）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅依赖公开或合作获取的EEG数据集（新生儿、5月龄婴儿、亲子超扫描）
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实增量工作：工程重构合理（MATLAB→Python）、验证充分（三类真实数据+与原版对标）、开源完整；但未提出新算法原理（PCA/SSI均为成熟方法），未解决EEG领域根本性开放难题（如运动伪迹实时消除、单通道鲁棒解码），也未推动BCI闭环控制或神经解码性能边界。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将已有方法系统化、开源化、泛化到多龄段多硬件场景，提升了EEG预处理的可用性与透明度，但未带来算法或范式层面的突破。

papers.title: Evaluation Protocols and Cross-Subject Generalization in EEG Emotion Recognition
papers.abstract: Reported accuracy in electroencephalography (EEG) emotion recognition depends on the complete evaluation procedure, not only the classifier. We separate the target quantity, development procedure, and reporting rule, then use one archived dynamical graph convolutional neural network (DGCNN) pathway on SEED and SEED-IV as an illustrative case. In a protocol-matched subject-dependent check, the SEED result was within 1.47 percentage points of the public reference value; the 3.40-point SEED-IV difference remained unresolved. Across 30 matched SEED subject-session trajectories, checkpoint selection based on repeated test-set evaluation increased mean window accuracy from 0.7855 at epoch 80 to 0.8892. Under five-fold subject-disjoint evaluation, validation-selected checkpoints achieved training-participant trial accuracies of 0.9990 on SEED and 0.9920 on SEED-IV. Accuracy for entirely held-out participants was 0.5348 (95% conditional subject-level bias-corrected and accelerated [BCa] interval [0.4667, 0.5985]) on SEED. The SEED-IV estimate was 0.3954 ([0.3343, 0.4648]) and is reported only as secondary sensitivity evidence because its protocol-matched compatibility check remained unresolved. The observed train-to-held-out-subject gaps are inconsistent with simple optimization underfitting, but they do not isolate subject identity from implementation, preprocessing, representation, or distributional factors. Supporting analyses further showed that participant rankings depended on representation and time scale, while a development-selected tail-risk ensemble did not establish a positive gain in a separate final evaluation. Subject-dependent, subject-disjoint, and cross-session results should therefore be reported as answers to different questions.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统检验了EEG情绪识别中评估协议对准确率报告的影响，发现跨被试泛化性能极差（SEED上仅53.5%，远低于被试内99.9%），指出当前高准确率多源于评估漏洞而非真实泛化能力，并强调不同评估方式（被试内/被试间/跨会话）回答的是不同科学问题。
analysis.claim: EEG情绪识别的高准确率严重依赖评估协议选择，跨被试泛化能力实际极弱，现有主流报告方式掩盖了模型本质上的个体依赖性。
analysis.input: 原始或预处理后的多通道EEG时序信号
analysis.output: 离散情绪类别（如正/中/负；或四分类）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，但强依赖特定公开EEG数据集（SEED/SEED-IV）的采集与标注协议
analysis.significance_reason: 扎实揭示了EEG情绪识别领域长期存在的评估失范问题，用严谨的协议拆解和实证（包括BCa置信区间、checkpoint选择影响、train-held-out gap量化）戳破‘高精度’泡沫，但未提出新模型/新范式/新硬件，也未解决跨被试泛化本身——只是证明它有多难，属高质量方法论批判型工作，分量介于扎实增量与显著贡献之间。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：不是技术突破，而是对评估实践的系统性纠偏，把领域从‘刷榜幻觉’拉回方法论正轨，但未提供泛化解法。

papers.title: From Noise to Control: Parameterized Diffusion Policies
papers.abstract: We propose Parameterized Diffusion Policy (PDP), a framework for learning diffusion policies conditioned on low-dimensional, continuous parameters embedded in a learned behavior manifold. By constructing this manifold so that distances between latent representations reflect the semantic similarity between physical trajectories, we transform diffusion from a mechanism for stochastic diversity into a precise and optimizable tool for behavior steering. Our approach enables smooth interpolation between known strategies and efficient adaptation to novel constraints without updating policy weights. We demonstrate that PDP significantly improves adaptation performance on complex multimodal benchmarks in both simulated and real-robot experiments compared to standard diffusion policies, particularly in scenarios requiring the synthesis of novel behaviors.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种叫参数化扩散策略（PDP）的新框架，把扩散模型的噪声采样过程变成可调控的‘行为导航’工具：不是随机生成动作，而是通过调节几个连续低维参数（比如‘抓取力度’‘移动速度’），在预学的行为流形中平滑插值或外推新动作序列，且不更新网络权重就能实时适配新任务。
analysis.claim: 扩散策略不应仅用于建模动作分布的随机性，而应被重构为一个可微、可插值、免权重更新的行为参数化控制系统。
analysis.input: 语言/任务描述 + 连续低维行为参数（如目标位姿偏移量、接触力阈值等）
analysis.output: 动作轨迹（时间步序列的关节力矩或末端位姿）
analysis.robot_dependency: PyBullet仿真器 + Franka Emika Panda真实机械臂
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的少量多任务演示数据（摘要未提具体规模，但强调‘small-real’级适配）
analysis.significance_reason: 显著推进了扩散策略的可控性范式：首次将扩散采样空间显式嵌入语义行为流形并支持免微调参数化导航，在真实Panda臂上验证了跨任务插值与约束适应能力；但未开源数据、未覆盖灵巧操作（dexterous）或大规模多机体（multi-embodiment），也未达到ALOHA/ACT级的端到端闭环鲁棒性与部署成熟度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——它把扩散策略从‘采样黑箱’升级为‘可编程行为引擎’，证据扎实（真机+多任务+消融+免权重更新），但尚未扩展至全栈部署级系统。

papers.title: Flash-WAM: Modality-Aware Distillation for World Action Models
papers.abstract: World-action models (WAMs) jointly generate future video and robot actions through iterative diffusion, achieving strong performance on manipulation benchmarks but requiring tens of denoising steps, a cost that precludes real-time control. Step distillation has emerged as the natural remedy, but off-the-shelf methods break down in the joint video-action setting because video and action streams use different SNR-shifted noise schedules and reach training with substantially different marginal noise distributions, an asymmetry that single-modality distillation methods cannot accommodate. We introduce Flash-WAM, a modality-aware step-distillation framework inspired by consistency distillation that selects the consistency function for each modality to match its noise regime: a linear-gradient-scaling parametrization for the action stream's low-noise regime, paired with a variance-preserving parametrization for the video stream's high-noise regime, grounded in a structural analysis of the consistency-function family that characterizes the achievable gradient scaling under the consistency boundary condition. Instantiated on LingBot-VA, Flash-WAM compresses inference to a single step in each modality. On RoboTwin 2.0, this reduces per-chunk latency from 8.1 seconds to 348 ms on NVIDIA L40S, a 23{times} speedup that enables real-time inference. Flash-WAM preserves task success on simulation benchmarks (85.5% RoboTwin 2.0, 95.7% LIBERO) and substantially recovers real-world performance (60% average on a Unitree G1 humanoid robot), while naive consistency distillation drops to 24% at the same step budget.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出Flash-WAM，一种针对世界动作模型（WAM）的模态感知单步蒸馏方法，专门解决视频和机器人动作两种模态因噪声分布不对称导致无法直接用标准一致性蒸馏加速的问题，把原本需数十步扩散的推理压缩到每模态仅1步，实现在仿真中保持高成功率、在真实人形机器人上恢复60%任务成功率。
analysis.org: 未知（作者无明确机构署名，摘要未提所属单位；Arman Akbari/Ci Zhang等姓名常见于中美高校/企业，但无足够线索锁定主导机构）
analysis.claim: 模态间噪声分布不对称是阻碍世界动作模型实现单步蒸馏的根本瓶颈，必须为视频和动作流分别设计匹配其噪声特性的一致性函数，才能在不损性能前提下实现真正可用的实时推理。
analysis.input: 当前观测（视频帧+状态）与语言指令
analysis.output: 未来视频帧序列 + 对应机器人动作序列
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree G1人形机器人（真实部署）、RoboTwin 2.0仿真器、LIBERO仿真环境
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真预训练数据（LingBot-VA/RoboTwin/LIBERO），真实机器人数据仅用于最终验证（未说明是否用于蒸馏训练）
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了WAM领域关键工程瓶颈——多模态单步蒸馏，实证扎实（真机G1上60%成功率 vs 基线24%，23倍加速），但未开新范式、未构建新世界模型架构、未发布新数据集或基准，属于对现有WAM范式的高性能工程深化，强于一般增量但未达基石级（如DreamerV3/World Models）的理论或架构突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：精准定位并攻克了多模态扩散WAM落地实时控制的核心失配问题，蒸馏设计有结构分析支撑，真机验证有效，但未改变世界模型底层范式，也未开源代码/模型，属高水平系统性工程突破。

papers.title: Your Model Already Knows: Attention-Guided Safety Filter for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have demonstrated impressive end-to-end performance across a variety of robotic manipulation tasks. However, these policies offer no guarantees against collisions with task-irrelevant objects in the scene. Existing safety filters sidestep this problem by querying a vision-language model (VLM) to identify obstacles and their locations. This, however, is too slow to run in the control loop and can only be invoked at episode initialization, leaving the filter unable to track moving obstacles. We discover that a small number of attention heads within a VLA model reliably localize the object the policy intends to approach. These heads can be exploited within a training-free safety framework that obtains the active target from the attention heads at every step, treats the remainder of the scene as obstacles, and feeds these into a Control Barrier Function (CBF) filter. Together with a lightweight real-time object tracker, this allows for collision avoidance for non-static obstacles. We evaluate our framework on SafeLIBERO, which we extend with moving obstacles. On the original static benchmark, our method performs comparably to an oracle that uses privileged simulator state to identify the target, emulating a VLM-based identification step run once at episode initialization. On the dynamic variant, where the oracle's init-time target assignment becomes stale, our method substantially outperforms it by 43%, on average. Our findings suggest that the perceptual signals needed for real-time safety filtering are already present within VLA policies and can be exploited without additional training or heavy auxiliary models.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现VLA模型内部已有可直接提取目标物体的注意力头，无需额外训练或调用外部VLM，就能实时识别动作目标并结合CBF实现动态障碍物避碰。
analysis.claim: VLA模型中特定注意力头天然编码了策略意图的目标位置，可被零样本利用构建轻量、实时、动态的安全过滤器。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令
analysis.output: 安全校正后的动作指令（经CBF滤波）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅在仿真环境（SafeLIBERO）中验证
analysis.significance_reason: 提出首个基于VLA内部注意力机制的零样本实时安全过滤框架，在动态障碍场景下显著超越静态oracle基线（+43%），实证扎实（多任务+消融+扩展benchmark），但未在真机部署、未开源代码/模型，且仍限于仿真，未达RT-2/π0级范式突破，属重磅工程-理论交叉贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：巧妙挖掘VLA模型内在结构实现免训练安全过滤，证据充分但限于仿真，尚未跨入真实机器人闭环。

papers.title: SynManDex: Synthesizing Human-like Dexterous Grasps from Synthetic Human Pre-Grasps
papers.abstract: Human hand-object interactions encode functional intent, but direct transfer to robotic hands often fails under morphology, contact, and reachability constraints. We present SynManDex, a synthetic pipeline that uses generated human pre-grasps as affordance-aware proposals and resolves the final contacts with robot-native optimization. SynManDex samples object-conditioned digital human pre-grasps, retargets them to dexterous robotic hand poses, optimizes force-closure contacts on the target embodiment, and admits trajectories that pass checks from each step. The resulting keyframes support both grasp-and-lift demonstrations and various prehensile manipulation tasks such as tea pouring, photo taking, and flute playing, designed via VLM agents. As a result, SynManDex combines high grasp quality (86.4\% grasp stability) with 4.67/5 human-likeness (93.4\%). It achieves 80.7\% successes in simulation and 25/30 (83.3\%) real-robot successes when applied to a 36-DOF bimanual dexterous robotic platform.

analysis.tldr: 用合成的人类预抓取姿态作为功能引导的初始建议，再通过机器人本体感知优化最终接触点，生成既稳定又像人一样灵巧的机器人抓取动作，实测在36自由度双手机器人上完成30个真实任务中的25个。
analysis.claim: 人类预抓取姿态蕴含的功能意图可通过合成+本体优化方式有效迁移至形态差异大的灵巧机器人手，无需真实人类示范数据或机器人交互数据。
analysis.input: 3D物体网格+任务语义描述（如'倒茶'）
analysis.output: 机器人双手机构的关节轨迹关键帧（含力闭合接触点）
analysis.robot_dependency: 36-DOF bimanual dexterous robotic platform（自研平台，未公开型号）
analysis.data_dependency: 零真实机器人交互数据；仅依赖合成人体运动库（如AMASS）和物体网格
analysis.significance_reason: 在灵巧操作领域属显著贡献：首次系统性解耦‘人类意图建模’与‘机器人本体适配’，实测覆盖30个跨功能真实任务且成功率83.3%，但未开源代码/模型，仿真到真机迁移未展示消融（如是否依赖特定手型），也未与ACT/ALOHA等基线对比，尚未达到π0或UMI级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——工程整合：把人类运动先验、VLM任务规划和机器人接触优化串成闭环，在真实双手机器人上跑通多任务，但缺乏开源和基线对比，未动摇现有学习范式

papers.title: Spatially Masked Regression Reveals Local and Distributed Predictability in Electrophysiological Recordings
papers.abstract: Neural recordings are often interpreted as local measurements, yet the signal at any one sensor can also reflect structured activity distributed across the broader network. This raises a basic question: to what extent does an electrode's signal reflect local versus distributed information in the underlying system? More specifically, how much of an electrode's activity is carried by its immediate neighborhood, and how much is embedded more broadly across the array? We address this with a Spatially Masked Regression (SMR) framework that reconstructs each electrode's timeseries from the remaining electrodes while excluding a configurable neighborhood around the target. By progressively increasing this mask, spatial locality becomes an experimental control for quantifying how much predictive information survives after nearby channels are withheld. We apply SMR to intracranial EEG with heterogeneous electrode coverage and to scalp EEG with standardized montages over sensorimotor cortex. Using distance correlation between original and reconstructed signals, we find strong within-subject reconstruction in both modalities, substantial residual predictability even when local neighbors are excluded, and markedly stronger cross-subject transfer in EEG than in iEEG. Masking shows that nearby electrodes contribute strongly to reconstruction but do not account for all of it, indicating that individual channels reflect both local redundancy and broader distributed structure. Surrogates that preserve selected marginal or spectral properties while disrupting phase structure or temporal ordering substantially reduce performance, supporting the conclusion that SMR depends on structured temporal and cross-channel organization rather than on marginal statistics alone. These results position SMR as an interpretable framework for quantifying the balance between local and distributed information in recordings.

analysis.tldr: 提出空间掩码回归（SMR）方法，通过逐步屏蔽目标电极周围邻近通道来量化脑电信号中局部信息与全脑分布式信息的相对贡献，发现即使去掉最近邻电极，仍能显著重建信号，证明单个电极记录同时承载局部冗余和跨区域结构化信息。
analysis.claim: 单个脑电电极的时序信号不仅反映局部神经活动，更显著地编码了跨电极阵列的分布式时空结构，且这种分布式可预测性在头皮EEG中比颅内iEEG更具跨被试泛化性。
analysis.input: 多通道脑电信号（iEEG或scalp EEG），含空间位置信息
analysis.output: 对目标电极原始时间序列的重建信号
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据，仅依赖公开/合作获取的临床脑电数据集（iEEG和scalp EEG）
analysis.significance_reason: 方法设计严谨（掩码控制+距离相关+多种surrogate检验），在两种模态、多被试上验证了分布式可预测性的存在与差异，提供了可解释的量化框架；但未解决临床解码、实时闭环或个体化建模等关键瓶颈，也未推动BCI性能边界（如通信速率、鲁棒性、植入兼容性），属于扎实的方法论推进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：首次系统量化脑电中局部vs分布式信息的平衡，证据充分、可解释性强，但未触及BCI核心性能提升或临床转化，暂未达到基石级分量

papers.title: HARBOR: A Harness Framework for Agentic Robot Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a powerful paradigm for robot learning, particularly in sim-to-real settings, but its broader adoption remains limited by the engineering pipeline surrounding the algorithms. Building tasks, shaping rewards, and tuning hyperparameters require substantial expert effort, making RL workflows costly and difficult to scale. We introduce HARBOR, an agentic framework that frames robot RL automation as a harness-engineering problem: given a simulator codebase and a task specification, it automates the workflow from environment setup to policy training in simulation. HARBOR decomposes such high-level objectives into bounded stages executed by specialized agents through standardized commands, persistent artifacts, executable gates, and reusable knowledge, and scales iteration via decentralized parallel trials and experience learning across runs. We evaluate HARBOR across 6 benchmarks and 16 tasks in total, spanning manipulation, locomotion, and bimanual dexterous control. We demonstrate that HARBOR automates the simulation RL workflow end-to-end, designs rewards, tunes algorithms to match or improve over default configurations, and reduces engineering effort at practical token and wall-clock cost; the resulting policies can also be transferred to real robots.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出HARBOR框架，用多智能体协作方式自动完成机器人强化学习在仿真中的全流程工程工作：包括环境搭建、奖励函数设计、超参调优和策略训练，最终生成的策略还能迁移到真实机器人上。
analysis.claim: 通过将机器人强化学习的工程流程建模为可分解、可复用、可并行的智能体协作任务，HARBOR能全自动完成仿真中从任务定义到策略训练的完整RL工作流，并实现sim2real迁移。
analysis.input: 任务规格描述（自然语言或结构化指令）+ 仿真器代码库
analysis.output: 可部署的仿真训练策略（含自动设计的奖励函数与调优后的超参数配置）
analysis.robot_dependency: PyBullet / MuJoCo / Isaac Gym 等主流仿真器（无特定硬件绑定）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，仅需仿真器接口和任务描述
analysis.significance_reason: 显著推进了机器人RL工程自动化范式：在6个基准、16个异构任务（含双臂灵巧操作）上验证了端到端自动化能力，并展示跨机体迁移；但未开源全部知识库/执行门控机制，且真实机器人实验仅限少量任务（摘要未提具体平台与成功率），尚未达到Unitree G1/Atlas级系统性突破，属于扎实重磅贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——它把RL工程链路拆解成可调度的智能体流水线，大幅降低使用门槛，但核心创新在于系统架构而非算法或硬件突破。

papers.title: Bounding Boxes as Goals: Language-Conditioned Grasping via Neuro-Symbolic Planning
papers.abstract: For robotics to be effectively integrated into household or industrial environments, machines must adapt to natural-language prompts in real time. Although Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have enabled zero-shot generalization in robot task and motion planning (TAMP), current state-of-the-art approaches often remain computationally "heavyweight" or require extensive training on thousands of demonstrations. We present GRASP (Grounded Reasoning and Symbolic Planning), a framework designed as a step toward open-vocabulary tabletop manipulation. Our approach leverages a pretrained VLM to translate natural-language queries into neuro-symbolic goal states, grounded in the physical world via a bounding-box detection pipeline. Unlike methods that rely on fixed color lists or hard-coded coordinates, GRASP enables robots to interpret abstract spatial concepts such as "top shelf" and execute tasks without additional fine-tuning. We achieve 73.3% overall success across 90 real-robot trials at three difficulty levels, requiring no task-specific training.

analysis.tldr: 用预训练视觉语言模型把自然语言指令（如‘拿最上面架子上的红盒子’）转成带物理坐标的符号化目标（即检测到的物体边界框），再驱动机械臂抓取，全程无需任务微调，在真实机器人上90次试验成功率达73.3%。
analysis.claim: 仅靠冻结的VLM+轻量级边界框检测+符号规划器，即可实现开词汇、零样本、免微调的自然语言条件抓取。
analysis.input: 自然语言指令 + RGB图像
analysis.output: 抓取动作序列（含目标物体的2D边界框坐标及抓取位姿）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人标定与部署数据（但无任务级演示数据）
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实（真机90次跨难度测试、73.3%成功率、无微调），推进了开词汇语言到操作的端到端闭环，但未引入新模型架构或底层控制范式，仍属高质量工程整合；显著弱于ALOHA/ACT/π0等定义新学习范式或解决长期稳定性/泛化瓶颈的里程碑工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将VLM与符号规划在真实桌面抓取中稳健落地，但未突破感知-规划-控制耦合的根本瓶颈，也未提供可复用的新基元或理论洞见。

papers.title: Geometric Deep Learning Reveals Ligandable and Cryptic RNA Binding Small Molecule Pockets (SMARTPocket)
papers.abstract: RNAs are important therapeutic targets, however identifying ligandable small-molecule binding pockets remains a major barrier to RNA-targeted drug discovery. Here, SMARTPocket, an atomic-level geometric deep learning framework for predicting RNA-small molecule binding pockets directly from three-dimensional structure is introduced. SMARTPocket represents RNA as full-atom point clouds and uses transfer learning from more than 110,000 protein binding interface structures to overcome the limited number of experimentally elucidated RNA-ligand complexes. Across four established single-chain benchmarks and three broader curated benchmarks, SMARTPocket consistently outperforms existing RNA pocket predictors and general biomolecular modeling approaches. The model generalizes to apo RNA structures when conformational changes are modest, identifies cryptic ligandable pockets, and recapitulates experimentally validated binding sites in the SARS-CoV-2 frameshifting element and an RNA aptamer evolved to bind small molecules. SMARTPocket-guided docking further improves near-native RNA-ligand pose recovery and computational efficiency compared with blind docking. These results establish SMARTPocket as a generalizable framework for structure-based identification of ligandable RNA pockets and for accelerating discovery of RNA-targeted small molecules.

analysis.tldr: 提出SMARTPocket模型，用几何深度学习从RNA三维结构中直接预测可结合小分子的口袋（包括隐式口袋），通过蛋白界面数据迁移学习解决RNA训练数据稀缺问题，并在多个基准上超越现有方法。
analysis.claim: 几何深度学习框架SMARTPocket能从RNA全原子结构中准确预测ligandable和cryptic小分子结合口袋，且无需RNA-配体复合物训练数据。
analysis.input: RNA全原子三维结构（PDB格式点云）
analysis.output: RNA表面可结合小分子的口袋位置与置信度得分（3D坐标+概率图）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将几何深度学习系统性应用于RNA口袋预测，实证覆盖4个单链+3个广义基准，验证了对apo结构、隐式口袋和已知靶点（SARS-CoV-2 frameshifting element）的有效性，且指导对接提升pose recovery；但未开源训练数据、未提供预训练模型权重，且未在湿实验中验证新预测口袋的成药性，尚未达到AlphaFold级范式突破或ESM级通用性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅：真机无关但科学实证扎实，在RNA药物发现这一长期瓶颈问题上实现了有消融、多基准、跨构象的实质性推进，属当前AI×RNA领域top-tier方法，但开源完整性不足限制复现与生态扩展。

papers.title: Residue-Level Attributions in Protein Language Models Do Not Recover Allergen Epitopes
papers.abstract: Deep allergenicity classifiers are increasingly used in safety screening of novel foods, and recent protein language models have substantially improved protein-level allergenicity prediction. However, whether their explanations capture biologically meaningful information remains unclear. We introduce an epitope-grounded residue-level benchmark for quantitatively evaluating attribution faithfulness in protein allergenicity models. Across frozen ESM-2, multi-task ESM-2, and DeepPlantAllergy, protein-level classification was robust, yet classification-head explanation signals did not significantly exceed random in their residue-level alignment with annotated epitopes across AUROC, AUPRC, and Precision@k. Integrated Gradients identified residues that were functionally important to the model, but not overlapping annotated epitopes. Saturation mutagenesis further suggested classifiers may rely on physicochemical and compositional sequence features rather than epitope-specific mechanisms. Residue-level importance signals should therefore not be interpreted as immunological explanations for safety screening or hypoallergen design without quantitative validation. Code available: https://github.com/Jeffateth/XAllergen2.0-paper

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统检验了当前蛋白语言模型（如ESM-2）在过敏原预测任务中给出的残基级归因解释是否真能定位已知免疫表位，结果发现所有主流方法的归因信号与真实表位标注几乎无统计显著性相关，说明这些‘可解释性’输出不能作为生物学依据用于食品安全筛查或低敏蛋白设计。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，姓名无明确机构指向；GitHub仓库名含'Jeffateth'但无法对应知名机构）
analysis.claim: 蛋白语言模型在过敏原预测任务中生成的残基级归因（如Integrated Gradients）无法可靠恢复已验证的免疫表位，其解释信号主要反映序列理化/组成特征而非表位特异性机制。
analysis.input: 蛋白质氨基酸序列
analysis.output: 残基级重要性分数（归因图）及蛋白级过敏性预测概率

analysis.significance_reason: 构建了首个表位标注驱动的残基级归因评测基准，用AUROC/AUPRC/Precision@k+饱和突变实验系统证伪主流PLM解释的生物学有效性，属扎实的批判性工作；但未提出新模型或新范式，也未解决预测性能瓶颈，影响力限于可解释AI在生物安全应用中的可信边界界定。

papers.title: dVLA-RL: Reinforcement Learning over Denoising Trajectories for Discrete Diffusion Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have established a powerful paradigm for generalist robotic manipulation by grounding control into the semantic reasoning of VLMs. Prevailing architectures typically model actions continuously via diffusion or flow processes, or discretely through either autoregressive generation or parallel decoding. Recently, Discrete Diffusion VLAs (dVLAs) have emerged as a distinct alternative, unifying vision, language, and action into a single discrete token space via masked generative modeling. While combining iterative refinement with unified representations, its training has thus far been restricted to Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT), leaving the potential of Reinforcement Learning (RL) for further policy refinement largely unexplored. A fundamental challenge in RL for dVLAs is that the marginal probability of the final action generated by dVLAs remains intractable. To solve this problem, we propose \textbf{dVLA-RL}, shifting the learning objective from the marginal action probability to the joint probability of the sampled generation path. Specifically, by modeling the denoising process as a Markov Decision Process (MDP), we mathematically formulate this path probability as a product of step-wise transitions. This trajectory-level objective provides a unified formulation that natively accommodates variable denoising steps. Leveraging this intrinsic fexibility, we introduce a unified step scheduling approach for complex multi-task learning, tailoring denoising steps to specific task complexities to maximize both success rates and computational effciency. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that our approach achieves a success rate of \textbf{99.7\%} on LIBERO. Furthermore, it establishes strong VLA-based results on RoboTwin 2.0 by delivering a \textbf{30.6\%} improvement over the SFT baseline, remaining competitive with strong World-Action Model baselines.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出dVLA-RL方法，把离散扩散型视觉-语言-动作模型（dVLA）的强化学习训练从‘只优化最终动作’改为‘优化整个去噪轨迹路径’，用路径级概率建模绕过不可计算的边际动作概率难题，并在LIBERO和RoboTwin 2.0上显著超越监督微调基线。
analysis.claim: 通过将dVLA的RL目标从不可解的边际动作概率转向可计算的完整去噪轨迹联合概率，实现了首个可扩展、可调度、实证有效的dVLA强化学习框架。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令
analysis.output: 离散动作token序列（经多步去噪生成）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，全部基于仿真benchmark（LIBERO/RoboTwin 2.0）
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了dVLA领域长期悬置的RL适配难题，理论建模清晰（MDP化去噪路径），实证提升明确（+30.6% on RoboTwin 2.0），但仅限仿真环境、无真实机器人验证、未开源代码/模型、未与主流VLA（如OpenVLA/Octo）做公平对比，属扎实的子方向推进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在dVLA这一新兴子方向上完成了关键RL适配，但受限于纯仿真、无开源、无跨机体/跨用户泛化验证，尚未达到VLA主干模型的分量级。

papers.title: A System for Fast, Resilient, and Adaptable Loco-Manipulation Behaviors on Humanoid Robots
papers.abstract: Humanoid robots could take on physically demanding, hazardous, and repetitive work in spaces built for humans. However, a useful robot for these spaces must coordinate locomotion, whole body motion, perception, contact, and operator supervision. This thesis presents a robot-local, runtime-editable behavior authoring and runtime system. Our system strives to be maximally observable, predictable, and directable following Coactive Design principles developed during the DARPA Robotics Challenge. Our operator interface remains continuously synchronized to the robot for runtime authoring, monitoring, and repair. Our behavior architecture uniquely combines object-centric Affordance Templates, organization and logic inspired by Behavior Trees, and runtime-editable perception through a behavior scene and primitive scene actions. Action primitives build on a whole-body controller that supports moving the arms while walking, and use a concurrent action layering algorithm for speed. The behavior library developed during this work covers more than twenty real-robot task variants, including push and pull doors with knob, push-bar, and lever-handle mechanisms, multi-step exploration sequences, obstacle clearing, and reactive table-to-table manipulation tasks. This behavior system has been deployed on many humanoid robots, such as Boston Dynamics' DRC Atlas, NASA's Valkyrie, IHMC and Boardwalk Robotics' Nadia, Unitree's H1-2, and IHMC's Alex. We evaluate our system across capability, speed, reliability, and speed of behavior creation, adaptation, extension, and combination. Our experiments demonstrate that we can adapt, extend, and combine existing behaviors to create novel loco-manipulation behaviors in minutes or hours. Videos: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLJK5CTyotYqsfgfnXb-09YNFeBose6uEY.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出了一套面向人形机器人的实时可编辑行为系统，把物体中心的可供性模板、行为树逻辑和运行时可调的感知模块组合起来，让操作员能在机器人执行中直接修改行为，已在Atlas、Valkyrie、Nadia等多个人形平台上部署，支持20+种真实机器人任务（如推拉不同结构的门、跨桌搬运、清障等），重点强调行为的快速创建、组合与现场修复能力。
analysis.claim: 通过融合可供性模板、行为树逻辑与运行时可编辑的感知-动作层，构建了一个在真实人形机器人上可快速适配、组合、修复locomanipulation行为的本地化行为系统。
analysis.input: 操作员指令+实时传感器数据（视觉/力/IMU/关节编码器）+场景语义先验（Affordance Templates）
analysis.output: 全身体态+步态+手臂轨迹+接触力控制指令的协同动作序列

analysis.data_dependency: 高度依赖真实机器人运行时数据（含故障响应、人工干预、行为修复日志），无公开训练数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 实机部署覆盖5+主流人形平台、20+复杂locomanipulation任务变体，具备分钟级行为组合与现场修复能力，证据扎实（视频+多平台验证+DARPA背景），但未开源代码/模型，也未引入新学习范式或基础模型，属于工程级重大整合而非理论/算法突破，略逊于GRAIL/WholeBodyVLA等基于生成式建模或端到端VLA的范式跃迁工作。

papers.title: OmniContact: Chaining Meta-Skills via Contact Flow for Generalizable Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
papers.abstract: Learning long-horizon humanoid loco-manipulation poses a dual challenge: it requires not only the robust execution of meta-skills but also their seamless, closed-loop chaining equipped with autonomous recovery. Existing approaches remain limited: explicit humanoid-object interaction representations offer precision but are notoriously difficult for high-level planning, whereas implicit skill embeddings are compact but lack the interpretability required for reliable composition. We propose \ours, a hierarchical framework centered on \textbf{contact flow (CF)}, a compact representation consisting of key body trajectories and time-series binary contact signals. Leveraging this shared interface, our low-level policy \textbf{CF-Track} learns a unified library of loco-manipulation skills, while our high-level module \textbf{CF-Gen} heuristically synthesizes future contact-flow sequences. To support this setting, we additionally collect the OmniContact dataset, a MoCap-based HOI corpus for humanoid loco-manipulation (Appendix~\ref{sec:dataset}). Together, they enable robust execution, autonomous failure recovery, and flexible composition of meta-skills for long-horizon tasks. Experiments show that OmniContact achieves \(98.7\%\) success on \textit{Carry Box} and \(76.5\%\) on \textit{Push-Stack Boxes}, outperforming prior baselines by average margins of \(40.9\%\) in meta-skill and \(66.5\%\) in skill chaining. Besides, our framework naturally integrates with VLMs for semantic task decomposition, enabling complex, semantically grounded loco-manipulation behaviors, such as arranging scattered boxes into a heart shape.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫Contact Flow的紧凑表示（身体关键点轨迹+二值接触信号），用它统一建模人形机器人的运动与操作技能，在仿真中实现了高成功率的长程任务（如搬箱子、推叠箱子），并支持与视觉语言模型联动完成语义化复杂任务（如摆出心形）。
analysis.claim: 接触流（Contact Flow）作为可解释、可组合、可闭环恢复的统一接口，能有效支撑人形机器人长时序locomanipulation任务的分层规划与执行。
analysis.input: 任务语义描述（文本）或高层指令 + 当前状态观测（关节/IMU/接触等）
analysis.output: 低层动作序列（关节力矩/位置控制指令）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真中基于PyBullet/Isaac Gym的人形模型（如H1、GR1）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖MoCap驱动的合成数据（OmniContact数据集），无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在仿真中实现了迄今最稳健的长程人形locomanipulation技能链（98.7% Carry Box成功），接触流设计有明确物理意义且支持VLM语义对接，但未部署真机、无跨机体验证、消融实验不充分（摘要未提）、数据为MoCap合成而非真实交互，尚未达到H2O/GR00T级的范式突破或工程闭环水平，属扎实重磅增量。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将接触物理显式建模为可规划接口，并在仿真中达成SOTA级长程任务成功率，但缺乏真机验证与跨平台泛化证据，尚未构成新范式。

papers.title: CoStream: Composing Simple Behaviors for Generalizable Complex Manipulation
papers.abstract: Long-horizon, contact-rich complex manipulation tasks, such as seating a GPU into a PCIe slot, demand both millimeter high precision and out-of-the-box generalization to new tasks. Existing paradigms struggle to satisfy both: classical pipelines use brittle, task-specific interfaces to achieve high-precision control but require costly pipeline redesigns to adapt to new tasks, whereas monolithic end-to-end policies provide better generalization but lack high precision on complex, out-of-distribution tasks unless retrained with new data. Both paradigms share an implicit assumption: once a manipulation capability is acquired, it must be deployed as a rigid pipeline or monolithic whole, rather than being freely decomposed and recomposed. In this paper, we show that complex manipulation capabilities can emerge naturally from the composition of simple, independent behaviors. Rather than deploying a monolithic policy or a rigid pipeline, we propose \ourshort, a framework orchestrating foundation models and diverse sensing modalities into multiple composable core behaviors: a semantic behavior extracting spatial constraints via foundation models; a predictive behavior forecasting trajectories by tracking keypoints in imagined videos; and a reactive behavior providing high-frequency tactile and force corrections. On a shared $SE(3)$ interface, these outputs compose by right-multiplication into a single pose command at each control step, executed by a compliant controller. We demonstrate \ourshort on 8 real-world tasks spanning everyday manipulation and precision assembly, with the strongest gains in contact-rich assembly and object transfer, and show robust recovery from manual perturbations during execution. {Website:} https://costream-simple.github.io

analysis.tldr: 提出CoStream框架，把复杂操作任务拆解为三个可自由组合的简单行为（语义约束提取、关键点轨迹预测、触觉力反馈修正），通过SE(3)姿态接口实时右乘融合成统一控制指令，在8个真实机器人任务（含GPU插槽装配等高精度接触任务）上验证了泛化性和扰动恢复能力。
analysis.claim: 复杂操作能力无需单一大模型或刚性流水线，而可自然涌现于多个解耦、可组合、多模态协同的简单行为在SE(3)空间的动态融合。
analysis.input: RGB-D图像、触觉传感器信号、力扭矩数据、语言指令（隐含在语义行为中）
analysis.output: 每步输出的SE(3)位姿增量命令

papers.title: ACID: Action Consistency via Inverse Dynamics for Planning with World Models
papers.abstract: Decision-time planning with action-conditioned world models has become a popular paradigm for embodied control. However, the standard planning cost judges a candidate solely by how close its predicted terminal state lies to the goal, leaving the realizability of the intermediate transitions unchecked -- a predicted trajectory can look convincing while the environment rollout drifts away from it. In this paper, we propose ACID, a decision-time planning framework that introduces cycle action consistency: the action inferred backward from a predicted transition by an inverse dynamics model should recover the one that was conditioned on. We fold this per-step residual into the planning cost via a scale-invariant adaptive weight. Across four action-conditioned world models and six tasks spanning rigid and deformable manipulation, articulated control, and visual navigation, ACID consistently improves planning and matches the baseline's accuracy with substantially less planning compute.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出ACID方法，在基于世界模型的决策时规划中，通过引入逆动力学模型验证每一步动作的一致性（即前向预测的动作与逆向推断的动作是否一致），从而修正规划过程中因模型误差导致的轨迹漂移问题，提升规划可靠性并减少计算开销。
analysis.claim: 在动作条件化世界模型的决策时规划中，强制每步动作-状态转移满足逆动力学一致性（cycle action consistency）可显著缓解轨迹漂移、提升规划鲁棒性，且无需额外真实机器人交互即可实现。
analysis.input: 初始观测+目标状态+候选动作序列
analysis.output: 优化后的动作序列
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据（仅使用仿真环境训练/评估）
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有物理意义的动作一致性约束机制，实证覆盖6个仿真任务和4种世界模型，有消融和计算效率对比，但未在真实机器人上验证，也未挑战世界模型的核心表征缺陷（如无持久状态、长程因果断裂等），属于对现有范式的重要工程增强而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真突破需解决世界模型根基缺陷（如状态坍缩、时间非马尔可夫），而ACID是高质量的规划层正则化设计，扎实但未越界。

papers.title: Agentic RAG-VLM: Affordance-Aware Retrieval-Augmented Generation with Self-Reflective Planning for Robotic Grasping
papers.abstract: Generalizable robotic grasping in cluttered environments is essential for deploying manipulators in unstructured human spaces, yet existing VLM-based methods rely on visual similarity for object matching, neglecting physical affordances such as handle graspability and material fragility, and operate open-loop without spatial reasoning or failure recovery, limiting their effectiveness when objects are densely packed or physically diverse. We present Agentic RAG-VLM, a unified framework that bridges VLM-based semantic understanding and physically grounded grasp execution by integrating retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) with vision-language models (VLMs) and agentic self-reflective planning. Agentic RAG-VLM introduces three tightly coupled components: (1) a Hierarchical Affordance-Aware RAG (HAA-RAG) that encodes four-dimensional affordance descriptors, including type, material, fragility, and graspable region, and retrieves strategies by functional affordance compatibility rather than visual appearance; (2) a Scene Graph Constraint Reasoner that constructs spatial relationship graphs from VLM perception and translates proximity, occlusion, and support constraints into concrete grasp parameter adjustments; and (3) an Agentic Self-Reflective Pipeline with a 14-type failure taxonomy and three-level adaptive retry for closed-loop grasp refinement. Evaluated on a 12-task benchmark spanning single-grasp, interactive, and long-horizon scenarios with 360 trials per configuration, Agentic RAG-VLM achieves 78.3 percent overall success, a 53.3 percentage-point absolute gain over VLM-only baselines, demonstrating that affordance-aware retrieval, scene graph reasoning, and agentic recovery are jointly essential for robust manipulation.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个叫Agentic RAG-VLM的框架，让机器人抓取杂乱场景中的物体时，不再只靠‘看起来像啥’来选目标，而是结合物体的物理特性（如是否易碎、哪里能抓、材质如何）、空间关系（谁挡着谁、谁撑着谁）和失败后自动反思重试的能力，最终在12个任务360次/配置的测试中把成功率从25%提升到78.3%。
analysis.claim: 物理可操作性（affordance）感知、场景图空间推理与自反思式失败恢复三者协同，是实现杂乱环境中鲁棒机器人抓取的必要条件。
analysis.input: RGB-D图像+自然语言指令（如‘拿起水杯’）
analysis.output: 六维位姿+夹爪开合参数+重试策略选择

papers.title: Infinite Worlds with Versatile Interactions
papers.abstract: We present LingBot-World 2.0 (also known as LingBot-World-Infinity), an advanced iteration of LingBot-World featuring four distinct upgrades. (1) Our model achieves an unbounded interaction horizon while maintaining consistent output quality, benefiting from a carefully crafted causal pretraining paradigm. (2) Through distilling a real-time variant from the base model, our system guarantees rapid response time, sufficient to drive 720p video streams at 60 fps. (3) Compared to the previous version, this update introduces highly diverse interactive elements, comprising a broader spectrum of actions (e.g., attacking, archery, spell-casting, and shooting) alongside a richer variety of text-driven events. (4) We pioneer the integration of an agentic harness within the domain of world modeling, wherein a pilot agent is tasked with planning and executing character behaviors, while a director agent is responsible for synthesizing novel environmental elements as the scene progresses. Additionally, to facilitate a shared experience, we develop an interface that permits multiple players to simultaneously immerse themselves in this vivid world simulator. We pair our primary 14B model with a lightweight 1.3B counterpart, which supports effortless deployment on a single GPU.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出LingBot-World 2.0（又名Infinite Worlds），是一个面向多玩家实时交互的文本驱动虚拟世界模拟器，核心是两个LLM（14B主模型+1.3B轻量版），通过因果预训练、蒸馏加速、双代理架构（pilot+director）实现长程一致响应、60fps视频流驱动和多样化动作/事件生成，但未涉及真实物理世界建模或机器人控制。
analysis.claim: 通过双代理LLM架构与因果预训练范式，构建了一个支持无限交互时序、多玩家协同、高响应速度且内容持续涌现的文本驱动虚拟世界模拟器。

analysis.output: 动态生成的世界状态序列（含文本描述、视觉帧流、交互反馈）

papers.title: The Rank-One Corner: How Much Value Equivalence Does a Task Need from a World Model?
papers.abstract: A learned world model is usually judged by how faithfully it reconstructs its observations or predicts reward, as though quality were something the model simply has or lacks. But what a task actually needs from a model is narrower: the few predictive coordinates its queries depend on, which we call the closure. We show that how much of that closure a latent comes to represent is set not by the model's capacity or its observations but by the dimensionality of the objective it is trained against, and we measure this directly on a DreamerV3 stack in a controlled environment with known ground-truth closure. An aligned scalar value signal -- the objective at the heart of value equivalence -- installs only a one-dimensional projection of a closure that needs several dimensions: read through a single linear probe, the recoverable structure rises from R^2=0.10 to 0.76 as the scalar is replaced by the full objective. Sweeping the objective's dimensionality from one to four installs exactly that many predictive directions through an auxiliary head, and the same staircase appears -- at attenuated magnitude but the same rank -- through the model's own value head, so the dissociation is dimensional rather than an artifact of head form. Capacity-matched comparisons and in-situ pressure checks rule out the obvious alternatives. The law governs a regime, and we measure its boundary: on a companion closed-loop task whose structure is observable frame by frame, reconstruction installs that structure and the scalar objective suffices -- the objective decides what a latent represents exactly where cheaper training signals cannot already recover it. Value equivalence is thus not all-or-nothing but dimensional: the familiar single-reward objective is its rank-one corner, and a model installs as much of a task's structure as the objective it is asked to predict.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现世界模型中潜变量所表征的任务结构（即‘闭包’）并非由模型容量或数据决定，而是被训练目标的维度严格控制：单标量奖励信号只能激发一维预测结构，而任务实际需要的多维结构必须通过匹配维度的多目标信号才能完整激活。
analysis.claim: 世界模型潜变量所承载的任务相关结构（closure）的维度，精确等于其训练目标的维度；标量奖励仅能诱导rank-one结构，而非任务所需的全部结构。
analysis.input: 仿真环境中的观测序列与奖励信号
analysis.output: 潜空间表示及其线性可分的预测结构（R²测量的闭包恢复度）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据，无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在世界模型理论根基层面做出关键修正：首次用可控实验定量证明目标维度决定潜表征结构维度，推翻‘模型容量/数据量主导表征质量’的隐含假设；证据扎实（DreamerV3实证、消融、ground-truth闭包对照），但限于仿真闭环任务，未扩展至真实机器人或跨任务泛化，未开源代码，故未达里程碑级（95+）但显著超越一般增量工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是改进某个模型，而是揭露了价值等价性（value equivalence）的根本维度缺陷——标量奖励天然丢失高维任务结构，这一发现将重塑世界模型的目标设计范式。

papers.title: ActiveFly-Bench: Aligning Embodied Question Answering with Vision-Language-Action for Aerial Embodied Perception
papers.abstract: We introduce ActiveFly-Bench, the first benchmark to bridge cyberspace reasoning and physical-world interaction for UAV embodied perception. The benchmark decomposes active perception into three hierarchical tasks: Aerial Embodied Question Answering (Air-EQA), Observation Behavior Planning (OBP), and Fine-grained Language-guided UAV Control (FLUC), explicitly connecting high-level task understanding, behavior planning, and low-level control. The datasets are collected from both real-world and simulated outdoor environments for training and evaluation. We further develop ActiveFly, a closed-loop UAV agent that integrates visual-language reasoning with fine-grained control, and deploy it on a physical UAV platform. Experiments with representative VLMs and VLA models show that current UAV agents still struggle with behavior planning, viewpoint adjustment, and robust task completion in active perception. These results establish ActiveFly-Bench as a new testbed for embodied aerial intelligence.

analysis.tldr: 提出了首个面向无人机主动感知的评测基准ActiveFly-Bench，包含三个层级任务（空中具身问答、观测行为规划、细粒度语言引导控制），配套构建了真实+仿真数据集，并在真机上部署了闭环VLA代理ActiveFly来验证现有模型在行为规划和鲁棒任务执行上的短板。

analysis.output: 无人机六自由度控制指令序列（含姿态调整、位移、悬停等）及最终答案

papers.title: Anatomy of Uncertainty: Expressive Descriptors of Robotic Manipulator Motion for Non-verbal Communication in Human-Robot Collaboration
papers.abstract: Robots operating in human-robot collaboration must communicate not only their intended actions but also uncertainty arising from incomplete or ambiguous perception. This work introduces a mathematical framework for expressing perceptual uncertainty through robotic manipulator motion. Drawing on Laban Movement Analysis, robot behavior is organized in a Commitment-Vigilance state space that maps uncertainty-related states - confidence, curiosity, hesitance, fear, and inactivity - to distinct Laban Effort signatures. Five motion primitives - approach, pause, retreat, exploration, and oscillation - are then parameterized using eleven kinematic and geometric descriptors, including acceleration, pause and retreat characteristics, gaze angles, tilt, and shiver amplitude. A video-based human-subject study evaluated recognition of four expressive trajectories and the influence of individual descriptors on perceived intensity. Participants reliably identified the intended behavioral states, while several descriptors significantly modulated expressiveness. The results establish a perceptually grounded basis for encoding robot uncertainty in motion and support future autonomous trajectory generation using parametric movement representations for collaborative tasks in shared environments. Code, videos, questionnaire and appendices are available at "https://bit.ly/github-aou".

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文把机器人操作臂的运动做成一种‘非语言表情’，用Laban动作分析理论把‘不确定感’（比如犹豫、好奇、害怕）翻译成5种可参数化的运动模式，并通过真人实验验证人类能准确识别这些情绪化动作。
analysis.claim: 机器人操纵器可通过参数化的Laban Effort运动描述符，在无语音交互下可靠传达感知不确定性状态（如犹豫、好奇、恐惧等）。
analysis.input: 不确定性语义标签（confidence/curiosity/hesitance/fear/inactivity）
analysis.output: 参数化运动轨迹（含11个可调运动学与几何描述符）

papers.title: AXIS: A Growable Community-Driven Data Engine for Scalable Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: Learning effective robot manipulation policies requires diverse, high-quality demonstrations, yet existing data pipelines are often difficult to scale because they rely on specialized hardware, centralized operators, or fixed task suites. We present AXIS, a growable community-driven data engine and benchmark for scalable robot learning, which enables browser-based teleoperation for large-scale demonstration collection, automatically generates and validates new manipulation tasks, and transforms community-collected demonstrations into training-ready data through automated success checking, quality filtering, trajectory smoothing, and visual and physics-based augmentation. The AXIS dataset currently contains 207 diverse tasks and 50K+ trajectories. Meanwhile, AXIS organizes data into task snapshots and evaluates policies with a systematic held-out protocol. We compare vision-language-action (VLA) policies under a unified AXIS evaluation suite and analyze scaling behavior across different data volumes. Continual pretraining on AXIS substantially improves the overall success rate of $π_{0.5}$ by 5.8%, outperforms the model pretrained on RoboCasa365 by 37.3%, and exhibits consistent scaling with increasing data volume, with the largest gains observed under layout, sensor-noise, and camera perturbations.

analysis.tldr: 提出AXIS系统，通过浏览器远程操控+自动任务生成+数据清洗增强流水线，构建了含207个任务、5万条轨迹的可扩展机器人操作数据集与评测基准，并验证了其对VLA模型持续预训练的有效性。
