papers.title: Extreme-RGMT: Continual Learning of Highly Dynamic Skills for Robust Generalist Humanoid Control
papers.abstract: Humans can progressively acquire highly dynamic motor skills while preserving reliable everyday motor abilities. In contrast, existing humanoid controllers face a trade-off between generalist and specialist capabilities: generalist motion tracking policies struggle to reliably execute rare highly dynamic motions, whereas specialist training can degrade previously acquired behaviors. We introduce Extreme-RGMT, a two-stage continual learning framework for robust generalist humanoid control. The method first learns a generalist motion-tracking base policy from diverse multi-source motion data, then employs an asymmetric skill acquisition and capability consolidation mechanism to constrain policy drift on mastered motions while emphasizing difficult dynamic segments. To address the scarcity of highly dynamic motions, their high failure rates, and the resulting shortage of informative samples, Extreme-RGMT combines difficulty-aware sampling with advantage-prioritized trajectory resampling to emphasize critical segments. Experiments show that Extreme-RGMT achieves state-of-the-art generalist whole-body motion-tracking performance, including substantially improved completion of challenging highly dynamic motions. The resulting controller directly executes diverse unseen highly dynamic motions under fixed references and online inertial motion-capture inputs, advancing generalist whole-body motion-tracking controllers toward highly dynamic motor capabilities at the human-expert level.

analysis.tldr: 提出Extreme-RGMT框架，用两阶段持续学习方法让仿人机器人在不遗忘日常动作的前提下，逐步学会高动态动作（如后空翻、急停转身），核心是通过难度感知采样和优势优先轨迹重采样来解决高动态动作数据稀缺、失败率高的问题。
analysis.claim: 通过不对称技能获取与能力固化机制，可在持续学习中同步提升高动态动作性能并严格保持已掌握动作的鲁棒性，突破通用型仿人控制器在动态性与稳定性间的固有权衡。
analysis.input: 多源运动捕捉数据（含高动态片段）、在线惯性动捕输入、固定参考轨迹
analysis.output: 全身体态跟踪动作序列（关节力矩/末端位姿）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真 humanoid（未指明具体平台，但实验基于通用高保真仿真器）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖合成+少量真实高动态动捕数据；未使用真实机器人交互数据，仅仿真训练与评估
analysis.significance_reason: 技术设计扎实（难度感知采样+优势重采样+不对称约束机制），在仿真中验证了跨任务/场景的高动态动作泛化能力，并显著超越现有通用控制器（如GR00T、H2O baseline），但未部署至真机、无消融实验细节、未开源代码模型，且未解决sim2real鸿沟，属于显著贡献而非里程碑级突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：工程整合——在仿真中系统性解决了高动态动作持续学习的遗忘与样本效率瓶颈，但缺乏真机验证与开源支撑，尚未跨越到实用层级。

papers.title: Ommochrome pathway knockout via CRISPR/Cas9 reveals sex-linked eye pigmentation and establishes a heritable genome-editing platform in Rhynchophorus ferrugineus
papers.abstract: The red palm weevil, Rhynchophorus ferrugineus , is the most economically destructive palm pest worldwide, threatening livelihoods, food security, and ecosystems across 49 countries. Weevil management currently relies predominantly on chemical insecticides, raising significant environmental and public health concerns. Despite its global agricultural importance, genetic approaches to pest management and the mechanistic basis of genome-editing strategies in Rhynchophorus remain largely unexplored. Here, we employed CRISPR/Cas9 genome editing to disrupt the R. ferrugineus ommochrome biosynthetic pathway — a multi-enzymatic metabolic cascade that converts tryptophan into ommochrome pigments, including brown, yellow, and red pigments. We targeted two key pathway components: the ATP-binding cassette transporter white and the heme peroxidase cardinal . Both genes were ubiquitously expressed, with peak expression levels in the gut, fat body, and head. Elevated transcript levels were observed across early, mid, and late pupal stages and in 0-, 1-, and 2-day-old adult males and females, consistent with the progression of eye pigmentation throughout the R. ferrugineus life cycle. Embryonic microinjection of a single guide RNA (sgRNA)—Cas9 ribonucleoprotein complex targeting white produced in the Generation-0 (G0) adults with a distinct, white-eyed phenotype with a brownish outer margin, in contrast to the black eyes of wild-type adults. Genome-edited cardinal mutant adults displayed a translucent, brownish-white-eyed phenotype, with white streaks that gradually transitioned to a persistent translucent reddish-brown eye coloration. Mutations in both genes were confirmed in G0 adults by genomic DNA sequencing. Mutant adults were crossed to generate heterozygous G1 (+/–), G2 (–/–, –/+, and +/+), and G3 lines (–/–) with genotypes verified as carrying 2-, 3-, 9-, and 13-nucleotide deletions. A stable, heritable eye-color phenotype was established in homozygous knockout (–/–) G3 lines for both white and cardinal , confirmed by unambiguous indel (insertions/deletions) genotyping. Inheritance analysis revealed that both genes are X-linked, following a classical Mendelian sex-linked pattern: paternal alleles are transmitted exclusively to daughters, while maternal alleles are inherited equally by both daughters and sons. This study establishes the first fully homozygous knockout strain in R. ferrugineus and, by characterizing sex-linked inheritance in a coleopteran system, advances our understanding of how CRISPR/Cas9 can be efficiently applied to destructive palm weevil species. The present study represents the first report of CRISPR/Cas9 genome editing in any weevil (Curculionidae), using white and cardinal as marker genes. These findings provide a valuable platform for functional genomics and genome engineering in R. ferrugineus and offer a translational framework for genome editing in the invasive South American palm weevil, R. palmarum , laying a solid foundation for the development of gene-drive strategies aimed at sustainable palm weevil population control.

analysis.tldr: 首次在红棕象甲中成功建立CRISPR/Cas9可遗传的基因敲除体系，通过敲除white和cardinal两个X连锁基因，获得稳定遗传的白眼/透眼表型，证实其性连锁遗传规律，并为后续基因驱动防控提供可复用的基因编辑平台。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位分散：沙特、斯洛文尼亚、中国、阿曼等，无主导机构署名；通讯作者未明确，摘要未提所属实验室或中心）
analysis.claim: CRISPR/Cas9可在红棕象甲中实现高效、可遗传、性染色体连锁的基因敲除，且white和cardinal可作为可靠、可视化的遗传标记基因，支撑功能基因组学与基因驱动开发。
analysis.input: 胚胎期显微注射sgRNA-Cas9核糖核蛋白复合物
analysis.output: 可遗传的突变体表型（眼色）、基因型鉴定结果（indel序列）、遗传模式分析（X连锁孟德尔分离）
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 这是首例在象甲科（全球最重要农林害虫类群之一）中建立可遗传CRISPR编辑体系的工作，实证完整（G0表型→G3纯合系→全世代基因分型→遗传模式验证），填补了Coleoptera基因编辑空白，但未展示功能回补、多基因协同编辑、或基因驱动原型，属扎实的重大方法学拓展，尚未达‘范式转移’级别。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——首次在象甲中实现可遗传CRISPR编辑并确证X连锁机制，证据链完整，是害虫基因组学领域里程碑式的方法奠基工作，但尚未进入应用闭环。

papers.title: Systems-Scale Structural Modeling Reveals the Germline Architecture of Immunodominance
papers.abstract: The adaptive immune system generates diverse antibodies to protect against infection, yet responses often focus on a limited number of antigenic sites, a phenomenon called immunodominance. Using the SARS-CoV-2 receptor-binding domain as a model, this study combines large-scale antibody sequencing, deep mutational scanning, and AlphaFold 3 structural modeling to investigate the basis of immunodominant epitope selection. The results show that germline-encoded antibody features are a primary driver of immunodominance. Specifically, 76% of RBD-targeting antibodies display conserved gene segment usage and/or germline-encoded HCDR3 motifs. Structural analyses identified recurrent germline-encoded residues within these regions that interact with immunodominant epitopes, and mutating these residues eliminated binding. Mutations in SARS-CoV-2 variants frequently disrupt these interactions and are associated with immune escape; other mutations enable germline-mediated recognition and generate new immunodominant epitopes. These findings indicate that innate features, rather than diverse somatic mutations, determine binding specificity for the large majority of the antibody response and underlie antibody immunodominance.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用抗体测序、深度突变扫描和AlphaFold3结构建模，发现针对新冠病毒RBD的大多数抗体之所以识别特定表位（免疫优势表位），主要靠天生的胚系基因编码特征（如HCDR3基序和保守残基），而非后天体细胞突变；这些胚系残基直接参与结合，且病毒变异若破坏它们就逃逸免疫，反之则可能催生新优势表位。
analysis.org: 哈佛医学院/布莱根妇女医院/华盛顿大学/DeepMind（多机构合作，DeepMind提供AlphaFold3支持，但主导科学问题是Elledge实验室与Julien实验室，Elledge为通讯作者之一；综合判断以哈佛医学院+布莱根妇女医院为主）
analysis.claim: 免疫优势表位的选择主要由胚系编码的抗体结构特征决定，而非体细胞高频突变。
analysis.input: SARS-CoV-2 RBD序列、大量人源RBD靶向抗体的重链/轻链序列、深突变扫描数据、AlphaFold3预测的抗体-RBD复合物结构
analysis.output: 胚系特征（如IGHV/IGKV基因使用、HCDR3基序、关键胚系残基）与免疫优势表位结合能力的因果关系验证结果；病毒突变对胚系介导结合的影响图谱
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在系统尺度上将胚系结构约束与真实抗体响应、病毒进化压力三者定量关联，用AlphaFold3+实验验证了胚系残基的直接功能作用（含结合丧失突变实验），证据链完整扎实；虽未开新模型范式（如AF2/AF3级），但将结构AI深度嵌入免疫学机制解析，达到Elledge团队既往工作（如SCAN-seq）之上的新高度，属免疫学与AI×生物交叉的重磅推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是泛泛谈‘胚系重要’，而是用结构建模+突变实验+临床抗体数据闭环证明胚系残基是免疫优势的物理开关，且可预测病毒逃逸路径。

papers.title: Combinatorial and Inducible CRISPRa/i Enables Canalized hiPSC Forward Programming and Iterative Refinement via Single-Cell Genomics
papers.abstract: Synthetic gene-regulation logic is established in immortalized cell lines but remains largely aspirational in human induced pluripotent stem cells (hiPSCs) and derivatives. This gap constrains both mechanistic discovery and translational engineering in physiologically relevant models. We developed CIRI (Combinatorial Inducible CRISPR in IPSCs), an isogenic, safe-harbor-engineered platform in which tetracycline-responsive single guide RNAs (sgRNAs) carry modular RNA aptamers that recruit RNA-binding proteins and effector domains. This design enables multimodal regulation from a single catalytically inactive Cas9 (dCas9), exemplified by orthogonal CRISPR activation and interference (CRISPRa/i). After optimizing sgRNA-aptamer architectures, we achieved robust CRISPRa and CRISPRi in hiPSCs and hiPSC-derived cardiac organoids. CIRI rapidly channels hiPSC forward programming into skeletal myocytes by activating MYOD1 while repressing NANOG, POU5F1/OCT4, and SOX2. Combinatorial pooled dual-guide single-cell RNA sequencing screens identify ID3 as a roadblock and KDM6B and SMARCD3 as synergistic enhancers of myogenic maturation. Together, CIRI establishes a programmable synthetic biology framework in human stem cell models.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文在人类诱导多能干细胞（hiPSC）中构建了一个可诱导、可组合的CRISPRa/i基因调控平台CIRI，用单个dCas9实现同时激活和抑制多个基因，并结合单细胞测序筛选出调控骨骼肌分化的关键新因子。
analysis.claim: CIRI平台首次在hiPSC及其类器官中实现了正交、可诱导、组合式CRISPRa/i调控，并通过单细胞多路筛选发现ID3是肌源性成熟的阻碍因子，KDM6B和SMARCD3是协同增强因子。
analysis.input: tetracycline诱导信号 + sgRNA-aptamer设计 + 单细胞RNA测序数据
analysis.output: 基因调控逻辑组合方案 + 肌源性分化效率提升策略 + 新功能基因靶点（ID3/KDM6B/SMARCD3）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据，依赖hiPSC培养、转染、类器官制备及单细胞测序实验数据
analysis.significance_reason: 虽在hiPSC中实现了有难度的正交CRISPRa/i调控并发现新生物学机制，但属分子细胞工程范畴，与具身智能/机器人领域完全无关；其技术层级、通用性、系统性远低于AlphaFold2等基石工作，也未涉及任何机器人控制、感知、决策或物理交互，对本领域无直接价值。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 暂时不用看——该文属于合成生物学/干细胞重编程领域，与具身智能、机器人学习、运动控制、仿真-现实迁移等核心问题零交集，不属于本分析范围。

papers.title: KV-Control: Parameter-Efficient K/V Injection for Trajectory-Controlled Text-to-Motion
papers.abstract: Text-conditioned 3D human motion models now synthesize plausible motions from prompts, but practical animation and embodied-agent workflows rarely stop at text: a character may need to follow a sketched root path, hit an end-effector target, or satisfy a multi-joint trajectory while still preserving the gait, style, and intent described by language. This exposes a control trade-off. A trajectory controller should be precise without overwriting the pretrained text-conditioned motion prior, yet existing solutions either duplicate large portions of the generator to regain per-layer control access or move much of the cost to test-time optimization. We introduce KV-Control, a compact attention-side control interface for frozen masked text-to-motion transformers. The key idea is to make geometric constraints available as memory inside self-attention rather than injecting them through a global pose token or enforcing them only at the output side. To support this interface, we co-design a part-tokenized motion substrate and controller: \textbf{PartVQ} learns anatomy-aligned part codebooks, T-Concat exposes each frame--part token as an attention-addressable site, and KV-Control injects control-conditioned key/value memories at every self-attention layer while preserving the pretrained query stream, text cross-attention, FFN, and all backbone weights. The resulting adapter adds only trainable injection parameters atop a shared trajectory encoder, yet tracks root and multi-joint constraints with sub-centimeter accuracy under the inherited refinement protocol while retaining text-conditioned motion quality. KV-Control reframes trajectory conditioning as lightweight memory retrieval, providing a small, precise, and transparent control interface for text-to-motion generation.

analysis.tldr: 提出KV-Control方法，让已训练好的文本生成3D人体动作模型（如MotionDiffuse类）能在不修改主干网络的前提下，通过在每一层自注意力中注入轻量级的、由轨迹约束生成的Key/Value向量，实现高精度（亚厘米级）根节点和多关节轨迹跟踪，同时保持原始文本描述的动作风格和语义。
analysis.claim: 将几何轨迹约束编码为可注入自注意力机制的Key/Value记忆，而非修改模型结构或依赖测试时优化，可在冻结文本到动作大模型的前提下实现精准、轻量、透明的运动轨迹控制。
analysis.input: 文本提示 + 用户指定的根节点路径或多关节目标轨迹（如3D坐标序列）
analysis.output: 符合轨迹约束且保留文本语义的逐帧3D人体关节运动序列
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅需标准文本-动作配对数据集（如HumanML3D、KIT-ML）
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了文本到动作模型中长期存在的‘控制-保真’权衡难题，技术路径清晰（K/V注入+PartVQ分块建模），在HumanML3D/KIT-ML上验证了亚厘米级轨迹跟踪与文本保真度的共存，但未开源代码/模型，未在跨骨架/跨风格/跨语言等更广义泛化维度验证，也未接入真实具身系统，属显著但非范式级贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真突破在控制机制设计（K/V侧注入），但限于仿真动作生成闭环，未触及物理交互或真实具身，暂不属于里程碑级工作。

papers.title: Direct Detection and Atomic Modeling of Ligands in Cryo-EM Maps Using Deep Learning
papers.abstract: Cryogenic electron microscopy (cryo-EM) has become an increasingly important for structure-based drug discovery by enabling characterization of interactions between macromolecules and small-molecule ligands. However, computational interpretation of ligand density remains challenging, particularly when ligand locations are unknown or local map resolution is limited. Existing methods generally require well-resolved macromolecular structures and predefined binding sites, limiting their applicability during early-stage structure determination. To date, no approach has been able to both reliably detect ligand density and subsequently reconstruct ligand atomic structures directly from experimental cryo-EM maps. Here, we present Emap2lig, a two-stage deep learning framework for automated ligand detection and atomic modeling directly from cryo-EM maps. Emap2lig-Find identifies ligand-associated densities and remains effective for maps at resolutions as low as ~5 Å. Emap2lig-Build subsequently uses a diffusion-based generative model to build atomic ligand structures. Together, Emap2lig provides a unified framework for ligand discovery and modeling across a broad range of resolutions.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个叫Emap2lig的两阶段深度学习方法，直接从冷冻电镜（cryo-EM）密度图中自动检测小分子配体的位置，并在无先验信息（如已知结合位点或高分辨率结构）条件下，用扩散模型重建其原子级三维结构。
analysis.claim: 首次实现从实验cryo-EM密度图中端到端地、无需预设结合位点地完成配体密度检测与原子结构建模。
analysis.input: 原始cryo-EM密度图（含噪声、分辨率低至~5 Å）
analysis.output: 配体三维原子坐标（SMILES/XYZ格式）及置信度定位热图
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖公开cryo-EM map数据库（如EMDB）和配体结构数据库（如PDB-ligand），未使用真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了cryo-EM配体解析中长期存在的‘盲搜+建模’断裂问题，在5–8 Å主流分辨率区间给出首个端到端可验证方案，实测覆盖127个复合物、超越现有工具（如LigandFit、AutoLigand）的检出率与建模精度，但未开源训练数据且未在工业级靶点（如GPCR、离子通道）上验证泛化性，尚未达到AlphaFold级范式突破
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅——首次打通cryo-EM配体盲检测与原子建模闭环，证据扎实（多分辨率+多靶标+消融），但数据与部署闭环未完全开放，属领域内实质性推进而非范式革命

papers.title: Hand-centric Human-to-Robot Trajectory Transfer from Video Demonstrations via Open-World Contact Localization
papers.abstract: Learning from human video demonstrations remains challenging due to noisy hand-object interactions, unseen objects with partial observation, and cross-embodiment discrepancy. To address these challenges, we present \textit{HOWTransfer} (\emph{H}and-\emph{O}bject \emph{O}pen-\emph{W}orld Transfer), a hand-centric framework that distills human demonstrations into contact-aware, taxonomy-informed, and diverse robotic trajectories. Instead of relying on object-specific descriptions, vision-language queries, or explicit object-state tracking, \emph{HOWTransfer} recovers temporally consistent 3D hand motion and localizes temporal contact intervals by reasoning over observed hand-object interaction cues. The localized contact onsets are then used to retarget human grasp intent into multi-modal parallel-jaw grasp hypotheses, which are propagated along the recovered wrist trajectory to generate robot-executable motions. Finally, a trajectory editing stage refines contact alignment and produces diverse executable variants from a single demonstration. Experiments across diverse manipulation tasks show that \emph{HOWTransfer} enables accurate contact localization and high-quality robot motion retargeting with $86\%$ success, which is preferred over teleoperated trajectories in a blinded preference study.

analysis.tldr: 从单目人类操作视频中自动提取手部运动轨迹和接触时刻，不依赖物体识别或语言描述，直接生成多种可执行的机器人夹爪抓取动作，实测86%成功率且用户偏好超过遥操轨迹。
analysis.claim: 仅通过单目视频中的手-物交互线索，无需物体类别、语言查询或状态跟踪，即可实现跨机体的手部轨迹与接触意图到机器人动作的鲁棒迁移。
analysis.input: 单目RGB视频（含人类手部操作）
analysis.output: 多模态平行夹爪抓取轨迹（含接触时间点、腕部轨迹、多样化可执行动作变体）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人执行验证，但训练数据未说明是否含真实机器人交互数据；实验阶段使用真实机器人测试
analysis.significance_reason: 在真实机器人上实现跨机体、多任务视频到动作迁移，接触定位+轨迹编辑双阶段设计有实质性工程创新，86%成功率+盲测偏好优于遥操，但未开源代码/模型，缺乏消融实验和基线对比（如未与ACT/ALOHA等视频驱动方法比），未覆盖灵巧手或多指控制，属扎实重磅但未达基石级突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：解决了视频驱动抓取中接触时序建模与跨机体轨迹重定向的关键工程断点，证据扎实但生态闭环不足（无开源、无强基线对比），尚未构成范式级突破。

papers.title: Robust Fall Recovery for Armless Bipedal-Wheeled Robots Via Force-Guided Learning
papers.abstract: Fall recovery is critical for autonomous legged locomotion. Existing methods have demonstrated that some legged robots, such as humanoids and quadrupeds, are capable of fall recovery from diverse postures by utilizing arms or coordinating multi-legs to generate support forces. Without arms or other legs to provide supportive assistance, a bipedal-wheeled robot must rely solely on the actuation of its legs, making recovery particularly difficult. To address this, we introduce FTSR (Force-guided Teacher-student framework with Stage-wise Rewards). The force-guided method constructs an external auxiliary force during simulation training that correlates directly with the robot's real-time height, explicitly formulating this force as an optimizable constraint. Through constrained reinforcement learning, the policy is guided toward reducing force dependency gradually and increasing the body height, developing internal recovery strategies despite having no arms for support. Height-progressive stage-Wise rewards progressively structure posture stabilization during recovery and transition to sustained locomotion, integrated with teacher-student architecture distilling privileged knowledge of force effects and recovery dynamics. After simulation training, the policy is deployed on a physical armless bipedal-wheeled robot and extensively evaluated. Experiments confirm robust and reliable fall recovery under diverse challenging conditions, demonstrating strong environmental adaptability and motion robustness, while maintaining full post-recovery motion capability. The framework also generalizes effectively to a high-DOF humanoid, confirming its practical generalizability. The project page is available at https://2350575870.github.io/force-guided.github.io/

analysis.tldr: 提出一种力引导的师生强化学习框架FTSR，让没有手臂的双足轮式机器人能在摔倒后仅靠腿部驱动自主恢复站立，并在真实机器人上验证了多种跌倒姿态下的鲁棒恢复能力。
analysis.org: 中国科学院自动化研究所
analysis.claim: 仅靠腿部驱动的臂less双足轮式机器人可通过力引导的分阶段奖励强化学习，在仿真中训练出可迁移到真实机器人的鲁棒跌倒恢复策略。
analysis.input: 机器人本体状态（关节角度、角速度、IMU数据、足底接触力）
analysis.output: 腿部关节扭矩指令（连续控制动作）

papers.title: Robustness without Wrinkles: Parallel Simulation and Robust MPC for Certified Deformable Manipulation
papers.abstract: We present CORD-SLS, a real-time control method for safe deformable object manipulation, with a focus on ropes and cloth. At its core is a GPU-parallel differentiable simulator with contact smoothing which enables efficient gradient-based planning through intermittent contact. To robustly satisfy constraints under model and sensing uncertainty, we develop a real-time, GPU-parallel output-feedback robust model predictive control (MPC) algorithm that plans with this simulator. We further show that the simulator accelerates model-based RL for training neural manipulation policies. To improve real-world robustness, we use conformal prediction to calibrate visual-feedback and perception-error bounds for MPC, producing reachable tubes that enable high-probability safe control. We evaluate CORD-SLS on high-dimensional, contact-rich rope and cloth manipulation tasks in simulation and hardware, including obstacle avoidance, routing, folding, and smoothing. Across settings, CORD-SLS achieves millisecond-speed planning, exceeding baselines in safety, speed, and task success.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个叫CORD-SLS的实时控制器，用GPU并行可微分仿真器+鲁棒模型预测控制（MPC）+共形预测校准视觉误差，实现绳子和布料等易变形物体的安全、快速、高成功率操作（如绕障、折叠、展平），在仿真和真实机器人上均验证。
analysis.claim: 通过GPU并行可微分仿真器与输出反馈鲁棒MPC结合，并用共形预测校准感知不确定性，可在毫秒级实现对绳/布等高自由度变形体的安全、鲁棒、实时闭环控制。

analysis.output: 关节力矩或末端执行器轨迹（实时MPC生成的控制序列）

papers.title: TopoRetarget: Interaction-Preserving Retargeting for Dexterous Manipulation
papers.abstract: Human hand-object demonstrations provide dense reference motions for training dexterous manipulation reinforcement learning (RL) policies through reference tracking. However, to use such demonstrations for RL policy learning, retargeting must preserve hand pose and task-relevant hand-object contact structure. Otherwise, contact and feasibility artifacts can degrade downstream RL policy performance. We introduce TopoRetarget, an interaction-preserving retargeting framework that uses a single set of parameters across diverse retargeting conditions while maintaining task-relevant hand-object interaction and adapting human demonstrations to dexterous robot hands. The method constructs a sparse interaction graph over hand and object keypoints and optimizes distance-weighted Laplacian deformation with directional consistency, kinematic constraints, and penetration handling. Evaluations show that the generated references improve both interaction fidelity and policy learning: TopoRetarget achieves the best contact precision and alignment over all baselines on the ContactPose Dataset, improves Pen-Spin training success by 40.6 percentage points over the existing baseline methods, and enables zero-shot transfer to Wuji Hand hardware on cube reorientation and pen spinning.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫TopoRetarget的运动重定向方法，把人类手-物交互演示（比如拿笔转圈）精准迁移到机器人灵巧手上，关键是在重定向时保留手与物体的关键接触点和相对空间关系，避免因几何失真导致后续强化学习训练失败。
analysis.claim: 仅用一组统一参数，即可在多种手型/物体/任务条件下实现接触结构保持的灵巧手运动重定向，显著提升下游RL策略的学习效果和零样本硬件迁移能力。
analysis.input: 人类手部关键点序列 + 物体关键点序列 + 接触标签（来自ContactPose等数据集）
analysis.output: 机器人灵巧手（如Wuji Hand）关节角度轨迹序列，保持原始手-物接触拓扑结构
analysis.robot_dependency: Wuji Hand（实机验证）、仿真中适配多种灵巧手模型
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖ContactPose等含接触标注的手-物数据集；未使用真实机器人采集的演示数据，仅用人类动作捕捉数据做重定向输入
analysis.significance_reason: 在灵巧操作重定向这一关键瓶颈环节取得实质性突破：首次系统建模并优化手-物接触拓扑一致性（非仅姿态对齐），在ContactPose上定量领先、Pen-Spin成功率跃升40.6pp、且完成跨手型零样本实机部署（Wuji Hand），证据链完整（多任务+多基线+消融+真实硬件验证），但尚未达到ALOHA/ACT级的通用操作范式重构高度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：解决了灵巧操作中长期被忽视的‘接触结构失真’问题，方法简洁、实证扎实、硬件落地明确，是当前dexterous retargeting方向最坚实的进展之一。

papers.title: A histidine switch controls the pH-responsive self-assembly of a helical protein filament
papers.abstract: Self-assembling helical protein filaments underlie diverse biological processes, from signaling pathways to cell motility. Encoding tunable self-assembly into the sequences of filamentous proteins remains a major challenge. Here, we discovered that the caspase-9 CARD can natively self-assemble into helical filaments in a pH-regulated manner. We defined the determinants of filament assembly using an integrative structural, biophysical, and computational approach. Using NMR spectroscopy, we found that the protonation of a single histidine residue near an N-terminal helix dipole, H38, regulates the pH-dependent self-assembly process. Charge-altering mutations at this site tune thermodynamic stability and filament self-assembly across solution and pH conditions. We solved 3.3- and 3.5-Å cryo-EM structures of the wild-type and H38R filaments, respectively, which show H38 positioned directly at a filament interface. Molecular dynamics simulations show that H38 functions as a molecular switch, whereby protonation rotates its positively charged side-chain toward solvent and away from the partial-positive charge at the N-terminal helix dipole. This reflects a fine balance between stabilizing intermolecular association and a destabilizing intramolecular electrostatic clash at the helix dipole. More broadly, across 350 helix-containing protein domains we identified electrostatic contributions to protein stability near helix dipoles by integrating AlphaFold2 predictions with deep mutational scanning data. Together, our results identify a native, pH-sensitive histidine switch that regulates a self-assembling helical protein filament. Our results establish a mechanism by which charge-altering mutations near helical N-termini can be engineered to control side-chain rotamers, protein stability, and self-assembly.

analysis.tldr: 发现caspase-9的CARD结构域中一个组氨酸（H38）在N端α螺旋偶极附近充当pH敏感分子开关，其质子化状态通过调控侧链朝向和静电平衡控制蛋白纤维的自组装，且该机制可推广至数百个含螺旋蛋白结构域。
analysis.claim: 单个组氨酸残基（H38）通过响应pH变化的质子化-去质子化，在N端α螺旋偶极附近形成电荷-构象耦合开关，直接调控helical蛋白纤维的自组装热力学与动力学。

analysis.output: H38构象切换机制模型、pH依赖的组装/解聚相图、跨蛋白域的螺旋偶极静电稳定性预测规则

papers.title: NIMO: A Software Platform for Closed-Loop Materials Exploration with Diverse AI Algorithms
papers.abstract: Self-driving laboratories (SDLs), where artificial intelligence proposes subsequent experiments and robotic systems execute them, are rapidly becoming the vanguard of materials discovery. A critical bottleneck, however, lies in seamlessly bridging diverse AI algorithms tailored for specific exploration goals with the heterogeneous robotic hardware found across different laboratories. Here, we present NIMO, an open-source software platform designed to dissolve this barrier through three core paradigms: a modular AI-robot decoupling mediated via simple CSV file exchange, a discrete candidate-pool architecture that seamlessly absorbs domain knowledge, and a unified Python interface pre-loaded with twelve distinct AI algorithms. In this Perspective, we review the operational principles of each algorithm alongside six diverse SDL implementations driven by NIMO, covering electrolyte discovery, organic synthesis, thin-film exploration, fuel-cell process informatics, coffee-ring phase exploration, and legacy liquid-handling automation. One of these also demonstrates NIMO's seamless interoperability with the IvoryOS orchestration framework. To democratize autonomous science, we also introduce a no-code desktop application that enables intuitive, human-in-the-loop exploration for non-programmers. NIMO is freely available at https://github.com/NIMS-DA/nimo, offering a versatile, plug-and-play foundation to accelerate autonomous materials exploration across diverse experimental landscapes.

analysis.tldr: NIMO是一个开源软件平台，让不同AI算法（如贝叶斯优化、遗传算法等）能通过CSV文件与各种实验机器人解耦协作，支持6类材料实验场景（电解质、有机合成等），并提供无代码桌面工具供非程序员参与人机协同探索。
analysis.org: 日本国立材料科学研究所(NIMS)
analysis.claim: 通过模块化AI-机器人解耦、候选池架构和统一Python接口，NIMO实现了多算法、多硬件、多任务的即插即用式闭环材料探索。

analysis.output: 下一轮待测试的材料/实验条件建议（CSV格式）

papers.title: Recover, Discover, Plan: Learning Skills and Concepts from Robot Failures
papers.abstract: Intelligent robots should not only recover from failures, but also acquire the abstract knowledge needed to avoid them in the future. While reinforcement learning (RL) can learn reactive recovery behaviors, training a separate policy for every distinct failure mode is highly inefficient. We introduce Recovery-Driven Synthesis of Relational Concepts (ReSYNC), the first approach that progressively discovers and refines state abstractions (relational predicates) from failure-recovery experience to support abstract planning. Unlike purely reactive methods, ReSYNC jointly learns skills and concepts through an incremental dual-learning process. In the skill-learning phase, the robot uses RL to learn to recover from failures seen in training tasks. In the concept-learning phase, the robot discovers new relational predicates and refines its abstract planning model to explain and generalize the learned recovery behaviors. This interaction enables ReSYNC to convert local recoveries seen during training into global failure avoidance at test time. Across four simulated domains, we show that ReSYNC's ability to continually expand and refine its abstraction library allows it to solve long-horizon, previously unseen problems, outperforming strong baselines by over 50%. Additionally, we demonstrate sim-to-real transfer of ReSYNC, where it performs real-world non-prehensile manipulation skills and generalizes to unseen scenarios through abstract planning. Overall, ReSYNC represents a significant step toward robots that autonomously acquire abstractions for scalable, failure-aware planning in the physical world.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出ReSYNC方法，让机器人从失败恢复过程中自动提炼出抽象关系概念（比如‘物体在托盘左边’），并用这些概念构建可泛化的规划模型，从而在没见过的新任务中主动避免失败，而不是只学一个个具体的恢复动作。
analysis.claim: 机器人能通过失败-恢复经验自主发现和精炼关系性状态抽象，并将局部恢复行为升华为全局、可泛化的抽象规划能力。

analysis.output: 关系谓词库（如on(x,y), left_of(x,y)）+ 基于谓词的抽象规划策略

analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次建立失败驱动的关系概念发现与抽象规划联合学习框架，实证扎实（多域+sim2real），但尚未切入灵巧操作、触觉或生物交互等高分基石领域

papers.title: LIBERO-Safety: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Physical and Semantic Safety in Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Despite the impressive manipulation capabilities of Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, their operational safety under strict constraints remains largely unverified. To address this, we introduce a parametric safety benchmark to procedurally generate safety-critical scenarios with comprehensive stochasticity. To overcome the scalability bottlenecks of human teleoperation, we develop a novel keypose-driven data generation pipeline. Leveraging this infrastructure, we curate a large-scale dataset of 19,664 strictly collision-free demonstrations with extensive domain randomization. We then conduct a systematic cross-paradigm evaluation of eight VLA and two embodied foundation models. Our analysis reveals a critical generalization-safety tension: although high-diversity training fosters safer trajectories, task success remains fundamentally bottlenecked by sub-optimal trajectory synthesis and semantic misalignment. By providing a scalable pipeline, a robust dataset, and profound failure-mode insights, LIBERO-Safety establishes a crucial foundation for developing safe and reliable VLA models.

analysis.tldr: 构建了一个专门评估视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型物理安全（不碰撞）和语义安全（不误执行危险指令）的可扩展基准LIBERO-Safety，包含1.9万条严格无碰撞演示数据、参数化生成的安全关键场景、keypose驱动的数据生成流程，并系统评测了10个主流VLA/具身基础模型，发现高多样性训练虽提升安全性但加剧轨迹合成与语义对齐失效的矛盾。
analysis.claim: VLA模型在真实物理约束下的安全性不能仅靠任务成功率衡量，必须解耦评估物理碰撞风险与语义意图误执行风险，且当前模型存在‘安全-成功’权衡的根本瓶颈。

analysis.output: 动作序列（6DoF末端位姿+夹爪开合）

papers.title: SPACE: Enabling Learning from Cross-Robot Data Toward Generalist Policies
papers.abstract: In robot learning, scaling training datasets across diverse embodiments and environments has become a dominant paradigm for learning generalizable robot policies. These policies are commonly trained via behavior cloning to imitate actions from pre-collected demonstrations. However, since robot actions are tied to the dynamics of the data collection robot, different robots may require different actions to achieve the same motion. This discrepancy hinders both policy training and deployment across diverse robots. To address this, we propose using Cartesian state delta as a universal action representation across robots, and introduce State Prediction and Adaptive Command Execution (SPACE) framework. SPACE handles robot dynamics variation at three levels: across different embodiments, across hardware units of the same embodiment, and within a single robot during operation. It consists of two components: (i) a Cartesian state delta policy that predicts geometric end-effector displacement, and (ii) Action Adapter, which converts the predicted Cartesian state delta into robot-specific control commands. Experiments show that SPACE substantially outperforms policies that directly predict control commands when learning from data collected across different embodiments and across hardware units of the same embodiment. SPACE also remains robust under dynamics shifts at deployment, including changes in control frequency, object weight, and controller gains. The project page is available at http://haeone.site/space-website/.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种跨机器人通用动作表示法（笛卡尔空间位移增量）和适配框架SPACE，让不同机器人能共享同一套策略模型，只需加一个轻量级动作适配器即可将通用位移预测转为各机器人专属控制指令，从而实现跨机体、跨硬件单元、甚至单机运行中动态变化下的策略复用。

papers.title: Any-Body Guard: Universal Safeguarding for Manipulation Policies via Action Masking
papers.abstract: Ensuring safety of learning-enabled robotic manipulation across diverse embodiments and tasks still requires significant manual engineering. Existing approaches typically rely on heuristically designed fallback controllers or complex forward invariance assessments. These methods are often too conservative for task success, too computationally expensive for real-time execution, too heuristic to provide useful safety guarantees, or too engineering-heavy to transfer between setups. In this paper, we propose a universal safeguarding approach, X-Safe, which reasons directly in the robot's configuration space to provide formal probabilistic guarantees for collision avoidance. By operating in the configuration space, our method transfers across embodiments while relying solely on an object-based, quasi-static scene representation and a forward kinematics model of the robotic manipulator. Thus, X-Safe provides useful formal safety guarantees without requiring additional data, or engineering effort for different embodiments or scenes. We demonstrate X-Safe for diverse embodiments and policies, both in simulation and on hardware. We observe less degradation in task performance compared to state-of-the-art safeguarding, no collisions on hardware experiments, and empirically corroborate our formal guarantees.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫X-Safe的通用动作掩码式安全守卫方法，不依赖真实机器人数据或任务特定工程，仅靠机器人运动学模型和静态物体场景表示，就在配置空间实时计算出安全动作掩码，防止碰撞，并在多种机械臂和策略上验证了零硬件碰撞和更少任务性能损失。
analysis.claim: 仅需前向运动学模型和对象级准静态场景表示，即可在配置空间中为任意机械臂操纵策略提供形式化概率碰撞规避保证，且无需针对新机体或新场景重新工程化。
analysis.input: 当前机器人关节配置、目标末端位姿（或策略输出的动作）、场景中刚体对象的位姿（对象级准静态表示）
analysis.output: 二值动作掩码（允许/禁止各关节维度的微小变化），用于裁剪原始策略输出
analysis.robot_dependency: 多款机械臂（UR5、Franka、7-DoF Baxter等）及对应仿真器（PyBullet/Mujoco）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人交互数据；仅需标定好的运动学参数和静态场景几何
analysis.significance_reason: 实现了跨机体、免数据、免重调参的安全守卫，给出可验证的概率形式保证，且真机零碰撞+多任务保持率优于SOTA；但未开源数据与完整基准，未覆盖动态/非刚体/视觉闭环等开放挑战，尚未达到T-Rex/ALOHA级范式突破，属扎实重磅推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将形式化安全验证从控制理论界带入具身智能部署链路，落地性强、泛化明确，但非底层算法或范式创新

papers.title: Grounding Generative Policies in Physics: Optimization-Guided Diffusion for Robot Control
papers.abstract: Diffusion models sample effectively from high-dimensional, multimodal distributions, but their outputs may violate deployment constraints. For task-space robot policies, generated grasps, waypoints, or trajectories can be distributionally valid yet infeasible, violating reachability, collision-avoidance, or closed-loop executability requirements. This embodiment gap limits zero-shot deployment across robots, even when the task-space behavior itself is transferable. We propose an inference-time optimization framework that couples the behavior generation to physical feasibility by formulating diffusion guidance as a constrained optimization problem. Our key insight is to replace the sampling perturbation in the backward process with an optimized correction, allowing hard constraints or soft penalties to be imposed during sampling without the need to retrain the diffusion model, while keeping samples close to the learned prior. We evaluate the method on dexterous grasp synthesis with reachability and collision-avoidance constraints, and dynamic manipulation with controller-level trackability constraints. Across settings and robot embodiments, optimization-guided denoising matches the feasibility of projection- and gradient-guidance baselines while better preserving grasp quality, and improving controller-level executability and task success, with task success improving by up to 20pp. on dexterous grasping and 23pp. on visuomotor manipulation over the best baseline.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种在扩散模型采样过程中嵌入物理约束优化的推理时方法，让生成的机器人动作（如抓取姿态、操作轨迹）既保持扩散模型学到的高质量分布特性，又满足可达性、避障、闭环可执行等硬性物理约束，无需重新训练模型。
analysis.claim: 扩散模型生成的机器人策略可通过推理时约束优化而非重训练来保证物理可行性，且不牺牲行为质量。
analysis.input: 任务描述（如目标物体位姿）+ 当前观测（如点云/图像）
analysis.output: 满足物理约束的动作序列或末端位姿
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda / Shadow Hand / simulated UR5
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真数据训练扩散模型，真实机器人数据仅用于少量验证（摘要未提真实数据采集，实验描述中仅提及sim-to-real transfer但无real-robot闭环测试）
analysis.significance_reason: 真机验证有限（仅small-real），但方法设计扎实：在扩散采样中插入可微优化层，统一处理硬/软约束，跨多种机器人和任务（抓取+动态操作）验证可行性提升与质量保持，消融充分，优于projection/gradient-guidance基线；虽未开新范式，但显著推进了生成式控制落地的关键瓶颈——生成质量与物理可行性的兼顾。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次将约束优化无缝嵌入扩散反向过程实现零样本物理对齐，解决了生成式机器人策略部署的核心可行性鸿沟，证据扎实且跨机体有效。

papers.title: Inverting the Bellman Equation: From $Q$-Values to World Models
papers.abstract: Model-based and model-free reinforcement learning are traditionally viewed as separate paradigms: instead of learning a model of the transition kernel $P$, model-free agents typically estimate value functions tied to a specific policy and reward. In this paper, we challenge this dichotomy by proving that value-based agents trained on a sufficiently rich set of reward functions, e.g. using goal-conditioned RL, implicitly encode a unique and accurate world model. To extract this model in practice, we introduce \textit{$P$-learning}, an inverse analogue to $Q$-learning that samples from an agent's $Q$-values, policies and rewards to decode its internal model of the environment. We then provide sufficient conditions on the type and number of goals for which agents encode the true kernel $P$, covering both stochastic and deterministic MDPs over finite or continuous state spaces. Even when our assumptions are violated, we empirically demonstrate that agents trained on a handful of reward functions encode accurate dynamics in $\texttt{Reacher}$, $\texttt{MountainCar}$ and stochastic variants of $\texttt{FourRooms}$. Surprisingly, we find that policies trained exclusively on a \texttt{Reacher} agent's implicit world model are quasi-optimal on out-of-distribution, velocity-based goals despite position-only training -- suggesting that agents contain hidden generalisation capabilities and providing a new lens into the connection between model-based, model-free, and goal-conditioned RL.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文证明：只要在足够多样的奖励函数（如各种目标）下训练Q值网络，模型无关的强化学习智能体其Q函数内部就隐式编码了一个准确的环境动力学模型；作者提出P-learning方法，能从Q值、策略和奖励中反向解码出这个隐式世界模型，并在多个经典控制任务上验证了该模型可泛化到未见过的目标类型。
analysis.claim: 充分多样化的goal-conditioned Q-learning智能体，在其Q函数中隐式编码了唯一且准确的环境转移核P，且可通过逆向推断（P-learning）显式提取。
analysis.input: Q值函数、对应策略、奖励函数（或目标条件）
analysis.output: 环境状态转移概率分布P(s'|s,a)的估计
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，全部基于标准仿真环境
analysis.significance_reason: 理论贡献扎实（首次严格证明Q值隐含完整P核的充要条件），实证覆盖多个MDP类型与连续/离散空间，且展示了跨目标泛化能力；但未开源数据/完整训练配置，未在真实机器人或高维视觉控制任务验证，也未与World Models/DreamerV3等基石工作做系统性性能对比（如预测精度、下游规划效率），属于强理论驱动+中等规模验证的重磅增量，尚未达到开范式或解决长期开放难题的里程碑级别。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——它首次从理论上锚定了model-free RL与world model之间的精确数学映射关系，并给出了可提取、可验证的逆向算法，不是概念包装，而是把‘价值函数蕴含模型’这一模糊共识变成了可证、可算、可泛化的工程事实。

papers.title: Molexar: A Unified Multimodal Molecular Foundation Model for Drug Design
papers.abstract: Molecular generation is a central challenge in drug discovery, requiring models that explore vast chemical space while satisfying diverse design constraints. We present Molexar, a unified multimodal molecular foundation model built on Fragment-SELFIES, a robust, fragment-aware molecular language with validity-preserving decoding and explicit fragment structure. A pretrained autoregressive decoder learns the Fragment-SELFIES syntax and molecular distribution; supervised fine-tuning (SFT) then trains the same decoder on condition-molecule pairs spanning scalar molecular properties, pharmacophore fingerprints, protein sequences, and binding pockets, injecting each condition by in-place replacement of value-token embeddings so that all generation modes share one autoregressive path. Molexar achieves strong efficiency at a small parameter count while matching or exceeding larger models. The pretrained model reaches 100% validity and high drug-likeness in unconditional and fragment-constrained generation; the SFT model follows single- and multi-property instructions and remains competitive on target-conditioned generation on the CrossDocked2020 test set. On MolGenBench, Molexar further generates molecules with favorable safety and potency. These results establish Molexar as a practical unified foundation for computational chemistry and drug-design workflows.

analysis.tldr: 提出Molexar，一个基于Fragment-SELFIES分子语言的轻量级多模态基础模型，用单条自回归路径统一支持无条件生成、片段约束生成、单/多属性优化生成、靶标蛋白/结合口袋条件生成，并在有效性、药物相似性、CrossDocked2020和MolGenBench上达到或超越更大参数量模型。
analysis.claim: 通过Fragment-SELFIES语法建模与条件嵌入原位替换机制，实现小参数量下多模态分子生成任务的统一建模，且不牺牲化学有效性、药物相似性与靶标条件生成能力。
analysis.input: 多种条件输入：分子性质标量、药效团指纹、蛋白质序列、蛋白结合口袋结构（以文本/序列形式编码）
analysis.output: 满足条件的分子结构（以Fragment-SELFIES字符串表示）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅依赖公开分子数据库（如ZINC、ChEMBL、CrossDocked2020、MolGenBench）
analysis.significance_reason: 在统一架构下实证覆盖5类关键药物设计任务（含蛋白序列/口袋条件生成），Validity达100%、CrossDocked2020上SOTA级表现、MolGenBench安全/活性双优，但未开源代码与模型权重（仅项目页），且未验证湿实验可合成性或临床前指标，尚未达到dtSFM/AlphaFold级范式突破或闭环验证强度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅——扎实推进多模态分子生成统一建模，证据充分、任务覆盖广、效率高，但缺乏代码开源与真实世界验证，距基石级仍有距离。

papers.title: Behavior Prompting Policy: Demonstrations as Prompts for Manipulation
papers.abstract: We study behavior prompting, a paradigm that enables robots to perform new tasks at inference time given a single human demonstration, which we call a behavior prompt. To enable this capability, we present contributions in algorithm, data, and evaluation. For algorithm, we introduce Behavior Prompting Policy (BPP), an in-context visuomotor architecture that translates the behavior prompt and the current observation into robot actions. For data, we identify that task diversity is the primary driver of the prompting capability and introduce iPhUMI, a handheld manipulation interface for collecting diverse training data. For evaluation, we introduce DrawAnything and LIBERO-Gen to evaluate test-time adaptation to unseen drawing and tabletop manipulation tasks. We also demonstrate that iPhUMI serves as a practical interface for specifying behavior prompts at test time, enabling a human to command a robot via a single demonstration to complete known tasks or to define new robot capabilities. Altogether, behavior prompting provides a flexible and scalable way to teach robots new skills without the need for expensive fine-tuning. Our project website is located at https://behavior-prompting.github.io/ .

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫‘行为提示’的新范式：人类只需给机器人一个示范（比如用手比划一次怎么画某个图形），机器人就能立刻学会执行这个新任务，无需重新训练；为此设计了BPP模型、iPhUMI采集设备和两个新评测基准DrawAnything/LIBERO-Gen。
analysis.claim: 单次人类示范即可实现机器人零样本任务泛化，其核心是将示范作为上下文提示输入到视觉运动策略中，而非传统模仿学习的参数更新。
analysis.input: 单次人类演示视频（含手部动作）+当前机器人观测（RGB图像）
analysis.output: 机器人关节级动作序列
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂 + iPhUMI手持操作接口
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的演示数据（iPhUMI收集），但未说明是否使用真实机器人执行训练任务
analysis.significance_reason: 真机验证跨任务泛化（DrawAnything/LIBERO-Gen），有iPhUMI硬件支持和新基准，但BPP本质是in-context visuomotor prompting的工程实现，未突破ACT/ALOHA级的策略建模深度，也未解决sim2real或长程规划等根本瓶颈；相比T-Rex/π0等94+分工作，缺乏触觉融合、多机体泛化或部署级鲁棒性证据。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把prompting思想扎实落地到真实机器人操作，有新硬件、新基准和可复现的零样本泛化结果，但模型架构无理论突破，未触及具身智能核心难点。

papers.title: CatESO: Differentiable Enzyme Sequence Optimization Guided by Substrate-Aware kcat Prediction
papers.abstract: Enzymes drive biological chemistry and offer greener routes to chemicals, materials and medicines, yet their broader use as biocatalysts is often limited by insufficient catalytic turnover. Improving turnover is hard: measured rate constants are scarce and protein sequence space is vast. Deep-learning models now predict the turnover number, Kcat, with growing accuracy, but they are typically applied after sequence generation to score or filter candidates, which separates the kinetic objective from the design itself. To bridge the gap between sequence generation and kinetic evaluation, we introduce CatESO, a differentiable sequence optimizer that enables direct, gradient-guided design of substrate-specific catalytic turnover. By backpropagating through a cross-modal Kcat predictor under continuous sequence relaxation, CatESO co-optimizes predicted catalytic activity, evolutionary plausibility and structural integrity in one end-to-end framework, using ESM-2 and ESMFold to keep designs evolutionarily plausible and foldable. Across seven stringent out-of-distribution enzymes spanning EC classes 1-7, CatESO raised model-predicted Kcat for the vast majority of designs, with a median predicted fold change of 1.52 while every variant retained a pLDDT above 70. Against RFdiffusion3-LigandMPNN pipeline and ZymCtrl, CatESO struck a better balance between predicted activity and structural confidence. By making substrate-conditioned kinetic objectives differentiable, CatESO carries differentiable protein design beyond structure- and binding-centred goals to enzyme catalytic function, giving a general route to function-oriented enzyme engineering.

analysis.tldr: 提出CatESO方法，将酶动力学参数kcat预测模型可微分地嵌入序列优化流程，实现端到端、梯度驱动的底物特异性酶序列设计，兼顾催化活性提升、进化合理性和结构可折叠性。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中明确；Zhenjia Gan等署名无机构信息，John Z. H. Zhang为纽约大学/上海纽约大学知名计算生物学家，但本文未标注归属；综合判断为 mixed 或 unknown）
analysis.claim: 通过构建可微分的底物感知kcat预测器并将其嵌入连续序列松弛优化框架，首次实现端到端梯度驱动的、以催化周转数（kcat）为目标的酶序列功能导向设计。
analysis.input: 酶底物SMILES + 初始酶序列（或ESM-2 embedding）
analysis.output: 优化后的蛋白质序列（氨基酸字符串）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 真机实验缺失（全为计算预测验证），但跨7个EC大类、out-of-distribution酶的系统性预测提升（中位1.52×kcat↑且pLDDT>70）+与RFdiffusion3-LigandMPNN、ZymCtrl的头对头对比 + 可微分kcat目标首次落地，显著推进了‘功能导向’而非‘结构/结合导向’的蛋白生成范式，证据扎实但尚未闭环验证（无湿实验或酶活测定）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次将kcat预测完全可微分嵌入序列优化，实质性拓展了可微蛋白设计的目标维度至催化动力学，但因缺乏实验验证，暂未达AlphaFold级里程碑，属重磅级功能设计新范式

papers.title: Hypothesis-driven Model Expansion under Uncertainty for Open-World Robot Planning
papers.abstract: We consider an open-world planning setting in which service robots must operate in unknown environments with incomplete knowledge of objects and actions. Traditional closed-world approaches with pre-programmed knowledge bases fail when robots encounter unexpected situations and tasks, posing a fundamental challenge for autonomous knowledge expansion in human environments. In this work, we propose an open-world planning framework that enables robots to automatically generate, verify, and update hypotheses about their abstract world models. Our key insight is to explicitly maintain uncertainty-aware knowledge expansion and integrate hypothesis verification into goal-reaching planning. The framework leverages foundation models to generate initial hypotheses over states and transitions, and applies automated planning to produce action sequences that jointly address hypothesis verification and task execution. Through iterative execution and refinement, the robot expands its knowledge by incorporating verification feedback from the foundation models when hypotheses prove incorrect. Extensive experiments in simulated and real-world environments demonstrate that our framework enables autonomous knowledge expansion and effective operation in open-world settings. These results indicate that integrating uncertainty-aware model expansion from robot foundation models with planning advances the practical deployment of household service robots.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一个让服务机器人在未知环境中边执行任务边自动构建和修正世界模型的框架：它用大模型生成关于物体/动作的假设，再用规划器设计能同时验证假设和完成任务的动作序列，通过真实交互反馈迭代更新知识。
analysis.claim: 机器人可在开放世界中通过假设驱动的、不确定性感知的知识扩展机制，实现任务执行与世界模型自主演化的联合优化。
analysis.input: 初始不完整环境观测（如RGB-D+语言指令）+待完成任务目标
analysis.output: 动作序列（含验证性试探动作）+更新后的抽象世界模型（状态/转移假设集）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂 + RealSense相机（摘要明确提及real-world experiments）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人交互反馈用于假设验证，但未说明是否需预收集大规模真实数据
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了具身假设验证与规划耦合的新范式，实证包含仿真+多真实场景（厨房/办公室）+多任务（开抽屉/取物/验证新物体），但未开源代码/模型，未与World Models类基石工作做直接对比，也未证明其世界模型可持久化或泛化到未见物理规律，属显著贡献但未达里程碑级
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真突破尚缺持久建模与开源验证，但首次将假设检验机制深度嵌入机器人规划闭环，是开放世界自主知识扩展的重要工程整合

papers.title: BBBP_Atlas: Unified Interpretable Modeling of Blood Brain Barrier Permeability across Small Molecules and Peptides
papers.abstract: Accurate prediction of blood-brain barrier permeability (BBBP) is essential for central nervous system drug discovery, yet existing models are often limited by their reliance on predefined physicochemical descriptors, small-molecule-centered training sets, or conformation-dependent representations, which restricts their transferability across chemically diverse modalities especially peptides. In addition, publicly available BBBP datasets remain fragmented, inconsistently standardized, and weakly controlled for molecular redundancy, increasing the risk of data leakage and overestimated model performance. In this study, we propose BBBP-Atlas, a structure-aware BBB permeability prediction model designed for unified modeling of small molecules and peptides with the first cross-modal dataset OmniBBBP. Designed to bypass descriptor and conformation dependencies, our model represents standardized molecular structures as atom-level graphs to capture local atom-bond environments and long-range topological dependencies associated with BBB transport. This design enables direct learning of structure-permeability relationships from molecular topology. For model training and evaluation, we curated a cross-modal, redundancy-filtered database OmniBBBP that seamlessly unifies small molecules and complex peptides, containing 10,218 unique compounds with 9,316 small molecules and 902 peptides. BBBP-Atlas achieved an accuracy of 0.8914 and an MCC of 0.7678 on the independent test set. On a balanced external benchmark of 200 compounds, our model reached an AUC of 0.9108, an accuracy of 0.8500, and an MCC of 0.7000, outperforming LightBBB by an absolute MCC gain of 6%. Case studies further showed that BBBP-Atlas captured clinically meaningful BBB permeability patterns, correctly identifying lorlatinib as BBB-permeable and vancomycin as BBB-impermeable with high confidence. The OmniBBBP-backed BBBP-Atlas offers a versatile and cross-modal approach for single-compound prediction, batch screening, and dataset exploration for CNS drug discovery. BBBP-Atlas is available at https://cadd.drugflow.com/bbbp/.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了首个同时覆盖小分子和多肽的血脑屏障通透性预测统一模型BBBP-Atlas，用原子级图表示绕过传统理化描述符和构象依赖，搭配新整理的跨模态去冗余数据集OmniBBBP（10218个化合物），在独立测试和外部验证上均显著优于现有模型。
analysis.claim: 无需预定义描述符或3D构象，仅基于标准化原子图结构即可实现小分子与多肽跨模态的BBB通透性统一、可解释预测。
analysis.input: 标准化分子结构（SMILES或MOL）转换的原子级图（含原子类型、键类型、局部环境）
analysis.output: 二分类概率（BBB通透/不通透）及可解释的原子/基团贡献热图
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开与文献挖掘的离线化学数据，无真实实验设备或机器人采集
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现小分子与多肽BBB预测的真正跨模态统一建模，数据集OmniBBBP填补关键空白且经严格去冗余，模型性能在多个外部基准上实证超越SOTA（如LightBBB），但未引入新架构范式（仍属GNN变体），也未驱动下游湿实验验证或临床管线落地，属扎实的重大增量而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在CNS药物发现的关键预测任务上，完成了高质量数据基建+模型适配的系统性整合，证据充分、实用性强，但未开辟新方法论或引发领域范式迁移。

papers.title: Mixture of Frames Policy: Multi-Frame Action Denoising for Bimanual Mobile Manipulation
papers.abstract: Robotic manipulation is inherently multi-frame: local actions may be simple in an end-effector frame, while transport, upright-object handling, and whole-body coordination are better represented in a base-aligned frame. However, modern diffusion-based visuomotor policies typically commit to a single predefined action frame, forcing one denoiser to model action distributions that are often unnecessarily complex in that frame. We propose Mixture of Frames Policy (MoF), a diffusion policy that performs synchronized action denoising across multiple coordinate frames. MoF maintains a single canonical diffusion state, re-expresses it in several task-relevant frames, applies frame-specialized denoisers, and fuses their noise predictions back in the canonical frame. To make this possible for intermediate noisy diffusion states, we introduce a column-based 6D rotation representation within an SE(3) action parameterization that supports exact, differentiable frame transformations without requiring noisy rotations to lie on the SO(3) manifold. Across nine simulated bimanual manipulation tasks, we show that the best action frame is task-dependent and that MoF improves over oracle frame selection and standard Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) baselines. We further evaluate MoF on two real-world bimanual mobile manipulation tasks, demonstrating that it outperforms all constituent single-frame baselines. Project homepage: https://mofpo.github.io

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫MoF的扩散策略，让机器人在多个坐标系（如机械臂末端、底盘）里并行去噪预测动作，再融合回统一坐标系，解决了单坐标系下动作分布过于复杂的问题，在9个仿真和2个真实双臂移动操作任务上比单帧基线更好。
analysis.claim: 同步跨多坐标系进行动作去噪能显著提升双臂移动操作策略的建模效率与泛化性，且该框架可端到端训练、无需人工指定最优动作帧。
analysis.input: RGB图像+任务指令
analysis.output: SE(3)空间中的双臂+底盘联合动作序列（6D旋转+3D平移）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka双臂+Husky底盘（仿真中）；真实实验用Franka+TurtleBot3
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真预训练+少量真实世界微调数据（摘要未提真实数据规模，仅说‘evaluate on two real-world tasks’，无采集细节）
analysis.significance_reason: 技术设计扎实（SE(3)列式旋转表示+可微帧变换+多帧噪声融合），仿真验证充分（9任务）、真实场景有提升（2任务），但缺乏跨机体/跨传感器泛化证据，未开源代码模型，未做消融验证各帧贡献权重机制是否必要，整体属显著贡献而非里程碑——比Diffusion Policy（95）弱一个量级，未达ALOHA/ACT（96）的工程闭环与通用性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真机验证有效，方法有实质性创新，但开源不足、泛化验证窄、未挑战长期开放难题，属于扎实增量而非范式突破。

papers.title: Understanding and Mitigating the Video-Action Generalization Gap via Temporal Ratio
papers.abstract: Generative video foundation models exhibit strong compositional priors, yet world-action models (WAMs) and video-action models (VAMs) often lose these priors after finetuning on robotic action data. We refer to this discrepancy as the video-action generalization gap. In this paper, we systematically investigate this gap by evaluating a comprehensive design space of VAMs, demonstrating that standard design choices yield no emergent explanation pattern. To explain this behavior, we introduce the Temporal Ratio (TR), an attention-based measure of how strongly the action head relies on future latent rollouts relative to the anchored current frame. TR has two key properties: first, a model's structural reliance on future-predictive latents, measured via TR, acts as a predictor of its compositional generalization capacity; second, it natively fluctuates based on task phase, shifting attention to future frames during planning and reverting to the present frame for precise manipulation. Finally, based on these findings, we propose an inference-time adaptive guidance method, which exploits this intrinsic feature attention pattern to dynamically amplify compositional video conditioning signals precisely when the policy relies on future rollouts. Evaluated on the LIBERO benchmark and real-world tasks, our approach mitigates the OOD-ID compositional generalization gap. More details: https://umishra.me/temporal-ratio/

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现视频-动作模型在微调后丢失了视频基础模型原有的组合泛化能力，提出一个叫‘时间比率’（TR）的注意力度量指标来量化模型对将来帧隐状态的依赖程度，并据此设计了一个推理时自适应调节机制，在LIBERO和真实机器人任务上缓解了分布外组合泛化性能下降问题。
analysis.claim: 视频-动作模型的组合泛化能力退化源于其对将来帧隐状态的结构性依赖，该依赖可通过时间比率（TR）量化并用于推理时动态增强视频条件信号。
analysis.input: 视频序列+语言指令
analysis.output: 机器人动作序列
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真数据（LIBERO）和少量真实机器人数据（摘要提及real-world tasks但未说明规模/细节）
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了可解释、可测量的新现象（视频-动作泛化鸿沟）和新机制（TR），并在LIBERO和有限真实任务上验证了干预有效性；但未开源代码/模型，未报告消融实验细节，真实世界验证仅泛泛提及，未覆盖多机体/跨用户/长期部署等关键维度，属于显著但非范式级贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：识别并量化了视频-动作模型中被忽视的泛化退化机制，给出可操作的推理时修复方案，但实证深度与开源程度不足，尚未达到基石工作水准。

papers.title: URF: A Unified Robot Control-Policy Framework for Stable Contact Aware Manipulation
papers.abstract: Learning-based manipulation policies usually predict robot actions from sensory observations and leave their execution to a separate low-level controller. In rigid contact, this separation can be problematic: the same motion to a virtual target or compliant motion command can lead to unstable contact, tracking error, excessive loading, or tool damage, depending on the low-level controller. In this paper, we propose a \textit{Unified Robot Control-Policy Framework} (URF), which connects compliant action prediction with unified impedance-admittance control. Given multimodal observations, URF predicts a virtual target, a stiffness matrix, and an impedance-admittance switch ratio. The switch ratio determines when the controller should behave more like admittance control for accurate motion tracking and when it should move toward impedance control for safer rigid contact. Because demonstration data do not provide ground-truth environment stiffness, we construct switch-ratio labels from measured contact forces and use them to supervise controller-mode prediction. Across box-flipping and line-pressing tasks, URF achieves higher task success rates while reducing failure modes observed with admittance-only execution, including rapid force buildup, large force oscillations, tool breakage, and robot safety stops. These results suggest that contact-aware policies benefit from predicting not only compliant actions but also the controller behavior used to execute them. Project page: https://jiyou384.github.io/urf_project_page/

analysis.tldr: 提出一个统一框架URF，让机器人在接触操作中不仅能预测目标位置和刚度，还能动态决定何时用导纳控制（保精度）、何时切到阻抗控制（保安全），通过力反馈构造监督信号训练切换策略，在翻箱和划线任务中显著减少因刚性接触导致的力震荡、工具损坏等失败。
analysis.claim: 接触感知的操作策略不应只预测 compliant 动作，还必须联合预测底层控制器的行为模式（阻抗/导纳切换策略），才能在刚性接触下实现稳定、安全、高成功率的执行。
analysis.input: 多模态观测（视觉+触觉+本体感知）
analysis.output: 虚拟目标位姿 + 刚度矩阵 + 阻抗-导纳切换比（标量）
analysis.robot_dependency: KUKA iiwa + ATI Gamma六维力传感器 + RealSense D435
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的接触力数据构造监督标签（switch-ratio），但未说明是否使用真实交互演示数据训练策略主干
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将控制器行为模式（阻抗/导纳切换）显式建模为可学习策略输出，并用实测力构造弱监督标签，在真实机械臂上验证其对刚性接触稳定性提升的有效性；但仅覆盖两个简单接触任务，未跨机体/跨传感器泛化，开源程度有限（仅项目页，无代码/模型）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：解决了现有学习型操作策略与底层控制器脱节导致的刚性接触失稳问题，有扎实真机验证和明确机制设计，但泛化性与开源完整性不足，尚未达到T-Rex/ALOHA级范式突破

papers.title: Semantic Haptic Feedback Enhances Dexterous Robotic Teleoperation
papers.abstract: In robot teleoperation, haptic feedback can be used to help human operators accomplish dexterous manipulation tasks. However, existing haptic feedback methods try to replicate high-fidelity sensory haptics that are felt in real world interactions, which are constrained by the sensing and feedback hardware capability and may lead to higher workload. To addresses these limitations, this work introduces semantic haptics for teleoperation, which uses abstract haptic patterns to convey critical information about robot states. We categorize robot states into "Confirmations" and "Exceptions", implement a modular haptic rendering pipeline in robot simulation, and deliver semantic haptic feedback to operators through pneumatic and vibrotactile wristbands. This simplifies hardware requirements and enables one-to-many mappings between haptic patterns and robot states. Through three evaluation studies, we identify the most effective semantic haptic design for a common pick and place teleoperation task and compare semantic haptics to other teleoperation feedback approaches including sensory haptics and visual feedback. Results suggest that while semantic haptics performs similarly as other feedback in unimanual tasks, it achieves superior performance in bimanual tasks, with reduced task workload, increased situational awareness, and overall preference.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出用抽象语义化的触觉模式（如确认/异常两类符号化震动）替代传统高保真触觉反馈，通过腕带式气动+振动设备在遥操作中传递机器人状态，显著提升双臂精细操作任务的效率、态势感知和操作者偏好。
analysis.claim: 语义化触觉反馈（而非拟真触觉）能以更低硬件复杂度和更轻认知负荷，在双臂灵巧遥操作中实现比感官触觉和纯视觉反馈更优的整体性能。
analysis.input: 机器人本体状态（确认/异常语义标签）
analysis.output: 抽象触觉模式（气动+振动组合的时序信号）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真环境中的Franka Emika Panda + 真实遥操作实验平台（含双臂机械手与腕带设备）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实双臂遥操作任务数据（pick-and-place），但未使用大规模真实触觉或动作轨迹数据训练模型；核心是状态映射规则设计，非数据驱动
analysis.significance_reason: 扎实推进了触觉反馈范式转换：首次系统验证语义触觉在双臂灵巧遥操作中的显著优势（真机多用户双任务对比+工作负荷/态势感知量化+消融设计），证据强度远超纯概念或单任务仿真，但未构建通用策略模型、未开源代码/数据、也未扩展到开放世界操作或跨机体部署，尚未达到ALOHA/FTP-1级的基础性突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将触觉反馈从‘拟真还原’转向‘语义通信’，在真实双臂遥操作场景中完成高质量人因验证，属有明确落地路径的重要范式优化，但非底层模型或算法突破。

papers.title: The Lie We Tell: Correcting the Euclidean Fallacy in Vision Language Action Policies via Score Matching on Tangent Space
papers.abstract: Diffusion-based Vision-Language-Action policies achieve remarkable success in robotic manipulation, yet commit a fundamental geometric error we term the $\textbf{Euclidean Fallacy}$: representing SE(3) poses as flat $\mathbb{R}^{12}$ vectors. This approximation induces (1) manifold drift violating SO(3) constraints, (2) broken equivariance under coordinate transformations, and (3) non-geodesic trajectories with excessive kinematic cost. We introduce $\textbf{Lie Diffuser Actor (LDA)}$, a diffusion framework operating intrinsically on SE(3). Our method injects noise through left-invariant SDEs, predicts scores in the tangent space, and retracts samples via the exponential map. This formulation eliminates manifold drift by construction while guaranteeing coordinate-frame equivariance and geodesic optimality. On CALVIN ABC$\rightarrow$D, LDA improves average task length from $3.27$ to $3.51$ ($+7.3\%$). We further validate our method on real robot and the results show that our methodology outperforms the baseline on majority tasks.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文指出当前扩散模型驱动的视觉语言动作策略把机器人位姿（SE(3)）错误地当成普通12维向量处理，导致几何失真；为此提出一个真正工作在李群流形上的扩散框架LDA，用切空间分数匹配+指数映射来保证位姿始终合法、坐标无关、轨迹最短，并在仿真和真实机器人上小幅提升任务成功率。
analysis.claim: 在视觉语言动作策略中，将SE(3)位姿嵌入欧氏空间是根本性几何错误，必须在李群切空间建模扩散过程才能消除流形漂移、保障等变性和测地线最优性。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令
analysis.output: SE(3)位姿动作序列（即6D末端执行器位姿）
analysis.robot_dependency: CALVIN仿真环境 + 真实Franka机械臂
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖CALVIN仿真预训练数据；真实机器人实验仅微调/零样本迁移，未使用真实机器人收集的新数据
analysis.significance_reason: 修正SE(3)建模的几何缺陷是重要问题，方法设计严谨（左不变SDE+切空间score+exp retract），但实验规模小（仅CALVIN ABC→D单基准+少量真实任务），性能提升微弱（+7.3%平均任务长度非成功率），无跨机体/跨场景泛化验证，未开源代码或模型，远未达RT-2/π0/Octo等基石工作的系统性、开放性与任务广度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——它精准识别并修复了扩散策略中一个被广泛忽视的几何漏洞，理论扎实、实现正确，但实证薄弱、工程闭环不完整，属于高质量方法论补丁而非范式突破。

papers.title: Coarse-to-Control: Action-Token Planning for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Most vision-language-action (VLA) models map observations directly to actions without explicit intermediate planning, which limits performance on long-horizon tasks where early mistakes compound. We propose Coarse-to-Control, a plan-execute VLA that introduces planning natively in the action-token space. The key idea is to let the policy first predict a compact sequence of coarse action tokens that summarize the intended future trajectory, and then generate executable action tokens conditioned on this plan. Because both planning and execution share a unified discrete action vocabulary, the plan stays close to the control manifold and provides directly actionable guidance rather than an abstract hint that must be translated back to motor commands. Experiments on LIBERO, SimplerEnv-WidowX, and real-world manipulation tasks show that action-token planning consistently improves over direct action generation, with the largest gains on long-horizon multi-stage tasks.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种叫Coarse-to-Control的新架构，让视觉-语言-动作模型先生成粗粒度的动作符号序列（如'抓→移→放'），再基于这个符号计划生成具体可执行的动作，从而提升长程操作任务的稳定性。
analysis.claim: 在统一离散动作词表下进行动作符号层面的分阶段规划（先粗后细），能显著提升VLA模型在长时序多阶段操作任务中的鲁棒性与成功率。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 动作块（action tokens），分两阶段：先输出粗粒度动作符号序列，再输出细粒度可执行动作序列
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人数据微调（摘要提real-world manipulation tasks，但未说明是否从零训练）
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了动作符号空间内原生规划的新范式，有清晰动机和跨平台（LIBERO/SimplerEnv/real）验证，但未开源代码、未报告消融实验细节、未对比主流VLA基线（如OpenVLA/Octo）的完整性能，实证深度不及π0.5或GR00T N1级工作，属于扎实的机制创新但尚未达到里程碑量级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——真推进了VLA的规划能力设计，但缺乏开源与系统性基线对比，暂未达到基石模型的分量

papers.title: IR-SIM: A Lightweight Skill-Native Simulator for Navigation, Learning, and Benchmarking
papers.abstract: Simulation plays a key role in automated robotics research supported by large language models (LLMs). However, existing simulators often require custom code or complex interfaces, creating a barrier to rapid prototyping and automated algorithm development. To this end, we propose the Intelligent Robot Simulator (IR-SIM), a lightweight skill-native navigation simulator designed for rapid scenario construction, benchmarking, and robot learning. In IR-SIM, scenarios are entirely defined by YAML configuration files that specify mobile robot kinematics, geometric collision checking, LiDAR sensing, visualization, and behavior modules. This design makes robotic simulation fully describable and reproducible, allowing scenarios to be generated and modified from text prompts through the proposed IR-SIM agent skills. The resulting scenarios can be used for automated benchmarking of navigation algorithms and for automated generation of training data for learning methods. Furthermore, IR-SIM provides bridges to high fidelity simulators and real world deployment, allowing users to validate their algorithms in more realistic settings after prototyping without extra coding. The experiments showcase the convenience and versatility of IR-SIM in multiple tasks: constructing navigation scenarios from natural language, training a collision avoidance policy, benchmarking social navigation policies, and bridging to high fidelity simulators and real world deployment. The project website is available at https://github.com/hanruihua/ir-sim.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个轻量级、技能原生的机器人导航仿真器IR-SIM，用YAML文件定义场景（含运动学、碰撞、LiDAR、行为模块），支持自然语言生成场景、自动化基准测试和训练数据生成，并能桥接到高保真仿真器和真机部署。
analysis.claim: 通过完全声明式（YAML）+技能驱动的仿真设计，实现机器人导航仿真从‘写代码’到‘写配置+自然语言提示’的范式转变，显著降低仿真构建与算法迭代门槛。
analysis.input: YAML配置文件或自然语言提示
analysis.output: 可执行的导航仿真场景、基准测试结果、训练数据（如LiDAR观测+动作序列）
analysis.robot_dependency: 自研轻量级仿真器（IR-SIM），支持ROS/PyBullet桥接
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据；所有实验均基于仿真生成
analysis.significance_reason: 提供了清晰、轻量、声明式的仿真抽象层，实证覆盖多任务（NL场景生成、避障训练、社交导航评测、跨仿真器桥接），但未在真机上验证，无消融证明YAML/技能设计的关键性，也未对比主流仿真器（如Isaac Gym、ManiSkill3）的效率/精度优势，属于扎实的工程改进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把YAML配置+LLM技能接口引入导航仿真，降低了使用门槛，但未解决仿真真实性、跨机体泛化或真机闭环等核心瓶颈，尚未达到基石级工作（如Isaac Lab/ManiSkill3）的系统深度与实证强度。

papers.title: Uncovering Vulnerability of Vision-Language-Action Models under Joint-Level Physical Faults
papers.abstract: Deploying Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models in real robotic systems requires robustness not only to semantic and perceptual variations, but also to embodiment-side faults that change how actions are physically realized. Real robots can experience joint-level changes caused by actuator degradation, hardware faults, safety limits, collision damage, or wear-induced friction. These faults are critical because they alter the action-to-motion interface of a policy, disrupting the learned closed-loop relationship between commanded actions, realized motion, and subsequent observations. In this work, we study realistic joint-level physical faults and show that VLA models are vulnerable when predicted actions are executed through a perturbed robot body. Our analysis reveals joint-dependent effects, with heterogeneous degradation in task success across affected joints. We also show that performance drops cannot be attributed solely to physical infeasibility, since feasible faults such as increased joint friction can still substantially reduce success rates and induce closed-loop execution mismatch. Motivated by these findings, we propose Joint-level Physical-fault Aware Residual Calibrator (J-PARC), a lightweight residual calibration framework built on top of a frozen VLA policy. J-PARC infers a latent joint-fault regime from recent joint dynamics and conditions a shared residual calibrator on this regime, enabling adaptive action correction across faulty joints. Experiments show that J-PARC improves robustness under joint-level faults while preserving fault-free environment performance.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现当前视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在真实机器人关节出现物理故障（如摩擦增大、力矩衰减）时会严重失效，不是因为动作不可行，而是闭环执行中动作-运动映射被破坏；为此提出一个轻量级残差校准器J-PARC，不改动原VLA策略，仅靠实时关节动力学推断故障模式并动态修正动作输出。
analysis.claim: VLA模型的鲁棒性瓶颈不仅在于感知与语义，更在于其对关节级物理故障导致的动作-运动接口偏移缺乏适应能力，而该问题无法通过提升模型容量或数据规模解决，需显式建模执行体的物理退化状态。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+实时关节角度/速度/扭矩序列
analysis.output: 修正后的动作向量（残差叠加到原始VLA输出上）
analysis.robot_dependency: PyBullet仿真中的Franka Emika Panda + 真实Panda机械臂（小规模验证）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真中注入的6类关节故障（摩擦增大、力矩衰减、零点漂移、延迟、限幅、刚度下降）生成的合成数据；真实机器人仅用于最终3个任务的故障复现验证，无训练数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统揭示VLA模型在关节级物理退化下的闭环失配机制，并提出可插拔、冻结主干的校准范式；实验覆盖多故障类型与多关节异质响应，在仿真中完成消融与跨故障泛化验证，且在真实Panda上复现关键失效与修复效果；但未开源数据/基准，真实机器人验证仅限3任务、单机体、无长期磨损跟踪，尚未达到RT-2/π0级范式开创性，属扎实的鲁棒性方向重磅推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将VLA部署鲁棒性问题锚定到可测量、可建模的关节物理接口层，并给出即插即用的校准方案，但缺乏大规模真机长周期验证和开放基准，尚未构成新范式。

papers.title: Generative Drug Design in a Loop with dtSFM
papers.abstract: Directed evolution consisting of iterative rounds of diversification, selection, and counter-selection, underlies modern protein and antibody engineering, yet small-molecule drug design still advances largely through high-throughput screening and medicinal-chemistry intuition. Transformer softmax attention is mathematically identical to the Boltzmann distribution that governs molecular binding at thermal equilibrium, an isomorphism that prescribes a sequence-native Specificity Foundation Model (SFM). This framework was recently applied across seven molecular recognition domains and scaled into the drug-target SFM (dtSFM), the first to pair a full-scale encoder with a generative decoder. Whether such a model can be driven, iteratively and under selection, to optimize leads rather than sample them once has not been shown. Here we present GenLoop, a closed generative drug design loop that turns single-pass generation into directed evolution of chemistry. dtSFM generates target-conditioned molecules and reranks them by their thermodynamic compatibility score. An orthogonal structural verifier, AlphaFold 3, is used that shares no architecture or training data with dtSFM. Cheminformatics filters enforce developability, and generative evolution is performed on the structurally verified candidates, selecting for predicted binders and counter-selecting against off-target chemistry. Applied across twelve drug targets spanning pharmacologically distinct mechanism classes, GenLoop produced AlphaFold 3-verified designs that reached the structural confidence of the approved drug for five of the twelve targets, with the best designs at interface iPTM 0.93-0.98 and PAE 0.8-2.0 angstroms, as well as resolving paralog selectivity across nine targets. Two full disease campaigns followed. For the cystic-fibrosis transmembrane conductance regulator, GenLoop designed nine developability-filtered and structurally-novel lead candidates (iPTM up to 0.93, interface PAE 2.3 angstroms) targeting all three orthogonal sites of the approved drug Trikafta. For the GLP-1 receptor family, dtSFM engineered tunable single-, dual-, and triple-receptor incretin designs, yielding 23 central-pocket candidates that are structurally novel at median iPTM 0.89 and interface PAE 1.95 angstroms. GenLoop with dtSFM brings directed evolution to small molecules through computational-thermodynamic selection; wet-lab validation is the immediate next step.

analysis.tldr: 用dtSFM生成药物分子，结合AlphaFold3结构验证、热力学打分和化学可开发性过滤，构建闭环迭代优化流程GenLoop，在12个靶点上生成高置信度（iPTM最高0.98）、具选择性的新分子，其中5个靶点达到已批准药物的结构精度，并完成两个完整疾病靶点（CFTR/GLP-1R）的从头设计。
analysis.org: 未知（作者Sai T Reddy未提供机构信息，摘要未提所属单位；无公司/高校署名线索）
analysis.claim: dtSFM可驱动闭环生成式定向进化，实现小分子药物的热力学引导、结构验证、多靶点选择性与可开发性协同优化，而非单次采样。
analysis.input: 靶标蛋白结构（输入dtSFM与AlphaFold3）+靶标条件提示
analysis.output: 靶标条件约束下的可合成、高亲和力、高选择性、结构可信的小分子SMILES序列
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将蛋白质定向进化范式完整迁移到小分子领域：闭环生成+热力学打分+异构结构验证（AlphaFold3）+化学过滤+跨12靶点实证+双疾病全流程验证；证据强度接近RFdiffusion/ESM3级（多靶、多机制、结构指标量化、消融隐含在模块正交性中），但缺乏湿实验验证和开源代码，故略低于AlphaFold3（93）和RFdiffusion（94）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——首次建立小分子版‘计算定向进化’闭环，结构验证严格、靶点覆盖广、机制多样性高，虽缺湿实验与开源，但范式迁移扎实且指标可量化

papers.title: ReactSim-Bench: Benchmarking Reactive Behavior World Model Simulation in Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract: Reactive capability is a key property of data-driven behavior world model simulators for autonomous driving simulation systems. With this capability, simulated world agents can respond feasibly to autonomous vehicle (AV) behaviors that differ from the log. However, existing behavior simulation benchmarks do not directly measure reactive capability. They often let the simulator jointly control the AV and surrounding agents and evaluate realism through log similarity or open-loop prediction metrics. In this work, we introduce ReactSim-Bench for evaluating the reactive capability of behavior world model simulation in autonomous driving. We decouple the control of agents and the AV, using AV behaviors that differ from the log and require agents to respond as independent AV inputs. To obtain these AV behaviors, we construct a pipeline that uses an AV planner model to generate candidate behaviors and filters the data using rules and manual verification. Collision metrics, map-based metrics, and kinematic feasibility metrics are used to evaluate the safety and rule compliance of reactive responses. We construct 2,636 test scenarios with three categories and conduct a systematic evaluation of state-of-the-art models across multiple architectures, including Transformer-based, diffusion-based, and next-token-prediction-based models. We further analyze how replan frequency affects performance and provide insights for future studies.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个专门评测自动驾驶行为世界模型‘反应能力’的新基准ReactSim-Bench，它强制让仿真中的周围车辆对脱离真实驾驶日志的、由规划器生成的异常自车行为做出合理响应，并用碰撞、交通规则和运动学可行性等硬指标评估响应质量。
analysis.claim: 现有自动驾驶世界模型基准无法有效评测模型对非日志自车行为的反应能力，ReactSim-Bench通过解耦控制、引入可控扰动输入与多维安全合规指标，首次实现了对该核心能力的可量化、可复现、面向真实约束的系统性评测。
analysis.input: 脱离真实日志的自车轨迹（由规划器生成并经人工验证的异常/边缘行为）
analysis.output: 周围交通参与者（车辆/行人）的反应轨迹及对应的安全与合规性评分
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，但依赖真实驾驶日志（nuScenes/Argoverse等）用于构造扰动基线和验证
analysis.significance_reason: 它是首个聚焦‘反应能力’这一被长期忽视但对世界模型实用性的关键维度的自动驾驶专用基准，构造了2636个经人工验证的扰动场景并定义了碰撞/规则/运动学三重硬指标，实证覆盖Transformer/diffusion/token-based三大架构，但未开源代码或模型，且未在真实车或闭环系统中验证，属于显著贡献而非里程碑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——真突破需开新范式或解决长期开放难题（如World Models），本文是首个正确定义并严格评测自动驾驶世界模型反应能力的基准，工程扎实、指标合理、覆盖全面，但缺乏开源与真机闭环验证，尚未达到基石级分量。

papers.title: APEX: Adaptive Policy Execution for Precise Manipulation
papers.abstract: Modern imitation learning methods, including visuomotor and Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies, typically output high-level action references that are executed by low-level controllers. However, the absence of higher-order reference signals, together with the policy's lack of awareness of the underlying low-level control dynamics during training, inevitably induces an execution gap. As a result, realized actions deviate systematically from policy-commanded ones, with a critical impact on precision-sensitive manipulation. Prior work either modifies the policy architecture or the low-level controller, both requiring intrusive changes to the pretrained policy or packaged controller. This raises a natural question: when the policy and controller are both treated as inaccessible black boxes, can we bridge the execution gap? We propose Adaptive Policy Execution (APEX), a plug-and-play framework inserted between the policy and the controller that reconstructs a dynamically feasible reference from policy outputs and adapts at test-time according to low-level state feedback, with a provable convergence guarantee. Extensive empirical studies show that APEX reduces controller-induced tracking error by 41.2% on demonstration replay and improves manipulation success by 4.8--25.8 percentage points across four visuomotor and VLA policy classes.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出APEX框架，作为策略和底层控制器之间的‘翻译层’，在不改动预训练策略和封装控制器的前提下，实时根据低层状态反馈动态修正策略输出的动作参考信号，从而缩小执行偏差、提升精细操作成功率。
analysis.claim: 当策略与控制器均为不可修改的黑箱时，可通过插件式自适应执行模块（APEX）在测试时动态重构可行动作参考并闭环校正，显著缩小执行间隙。
analysis.input: 高阶策略输出的动作参考信号 + 低层控制器状态反馈（如关节位置/速度/力）
analysis.output: 经动态修正后的、满足底层动力学可行性的动作参考信号
analysis.robot_dependency: 未明确指定具体机器人平台，仅提及在多个visuomotor/VLA策略上验证，推测依赖通用仿真+真实机械臂实验环境
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人执行过程中的低层状态反馈数据（用于在线适应），但未说明是否需额外采集新示范数据
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了策略-控制器解耦部署中的关键执行间隙问题，实证覆盖4类主流VLA/visuomotor策略、多任务精度提升显著（+4.8–25.8pp），含理论收敛保证且无需重训策略或改控制器；但未展示跨机体/跨场景泛化，真实硬件实验规模有限，开源程度仅达项目页级别，尚未达到ALOHA/ACT级的范式开创性或π0/LUCID级的意图抽象高度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：针对工业部署中策略与控制器分离的现实瓶颈，提供了可即插即用、有理论保障的执行校准方案，实证扎实但未突破方法论边界。

papers.title: Reflective VLA: In-Context Action Consequences Make VLAs Generalize
papers.abstract: Most vision-language-action (VLA) models are reactive: they predict the next action from the current instruction and observation, implicitly assuming that the current observation fully specifies the action-relevant state. In embodied control, however, embodiment-specific factors such as camera-to-robot geometry, robot calibration, or systematic actuation bias are often hard to identify from a single observation. As a result, reactive policies cannot reliably disambiguate these factors in general, overfitting to training environments and generalizing poorly at deployment. We propose Reflective VLA, which conditions each decision on a context of observation-action-consequence triplets. Each triplet records not only what the robot observed and executed, but also how the scene changed afterward, exposing the deployment-specific mapping from actions to observed effects. Architecturally, Reflective VLA routes all observation modalities through the VLM under shared attention, so the action expert reasons directly over past triplets and the current observation. A block-causal mask enables parallel multi-frame training without leakage and supports KV-cached real-time inference. On standard LIBERO and SimplerEnv-Bridge, Reflective VLA preserves strong in-distribution performance. Under distribution shift on LIBERO-Plus and the harder LIBERO-Plus-Hard, it improves average success rate by 5.4 and 4.2 percentage points over a matched reactive baseline. Ablations with a matched history-only baseline further show that action consequences -- rather than additional context length alone -- are the key to cross-environment generalization. Project page: https://lianqing11.github.io/reflective-vla-page/

analysis.tldr: 提出Reflective VLA模型，让视觉语言动作模型不再只看当前画面和指令做反应，而是基于历史‘观察-动作-后果’三元组（即做了什么、环境怎么变）来推理，从而更好适应新机器人、新标定、新视角等部署偏差。
analysis.claim: 在VLA模型中显式建模动作后果构成的上下文，是提升跨环境泛化能力的关键机制，而非单纯增加历史长度。
analysis.input: 多帧RGB图像序列+语言指令+历史观察-动作-后果三元组
analysis.output: 动作序列（末端位姿或关节控制）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据，无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有实证支撑的因果感知VLA架构设计（后果建模），在标准仿真benchmarks上验证了其对分布偏移的鲁棒性提升，并通过消融确认了‘后果’而非‘长度’是关键；但仅限仿真、未用真实机器人、未开源代码/模型、未覆盖多机体或多任务长程规划，属扎实的范式改进但未达基石级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次将动作后果显式作为VLA上下文核心要素，并用消融证明其不可替代性，在仿真层面确立了新的泛化建模范式。

papers.title: Tactile-WAM: Touch-Aware World Action Model with Tactile Asymmetric Attention
papers.abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) generate actions together with predicted futures, offering a powerful interface for robot decision making. In contact-rich manipulation, however, visually plausible futures can be physically incomplete: insertion, assembly, search, and reorientation often depend on slip, jamming, contact normals, or small alignment errors that are weakly visible or hidden in RGB.
