A natural solution is to predict future tactile states, however, we identify tactile pollution, a failure mode where unconstrained tactile-token injection degrades video and action prediction by forcing a visual dynamics model to absorb sparse, local, event-driven contact signals. To address this, we propose Tactile-WAM, a touch-aware WAM with a Tactile Asymmetric Attention Mechanism (TAAM). TAAM combines a VideoClean mask, which blocks video-query access to tactile key/value tokens while preserving action-query access, with a touch-aware bias for action attention. The VideoClean mask protects visual prediction while keeping contact information available for action generation; the touch-aware bias is derived from predicted touch changes and modulates action attention to tactile tokens during denoising. On ManiFeel, Tactile-WAM improves the mean success rate by 38.9% overall and by 86% on contact-rich tasks.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个能同时预测未来视觉状态和动作的世界模型（WAM），专门解决接触密集操作中视觉信息不足的问题，通过新设计的‘触觉非对称注意力机制’（TAAM）避免触觉信号干扰视频预测，只让触觉信息参与动作生成，在ManiFeel数据集上显著提升插入、装配等接触敏感任务的成功率。
analysis.claim: 触觉信号若直接注入视觉世界模型会引发‘触觉污染’，破坏视频预测；而通过触觉非对称注意力机制（TAAM）隔离触觉对视觉建模的干扰、仅保留其对动作生成的引导作用，可显著提升接触密集操作任务的成功率。
analysis.input: RGB视频帧序列 + 同步触觉传感器信号（如GelSight或类似高分辨率触觉图）
analysis.output: 未来多步视频帧预测 + 对应动作序列（6DoF末端位姿或关节扭矩）
analysis.robot_dependency: ManiFeel平台（含Franka机械臂+GelSight触觉传感器+定制夹具）
analysis.data_dependency: 高度依赖ManiFeel真实机器人采集的触觉-视觉-动作同步数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统识别并命名‘触觉污染’现象，提出有原理支撑的TAAM架构，在真实机器人平台上验证了触觉-视觉解耦建模的有效性；但仅在单一硬件平台（ManiFeel）、单一数据集上验证，未跨机体/跨任务泛化，也未开源代码或模型，证据扎实但覆盖窄。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是简单加触觉模态，而是发现并解决了多模态世界模型中触觉与视觉动态耦合的根本性冲突，实证充分、机制清晰、效果显著，但受限于平台封闭性和复现门槛。

papers.title: RAVEN: Long-Horizon Reasoning & Navigation with a Visuo-Spatio-Temporal Memory
papers.abstract: Long-term robot deployment requires a compact and scalable memory that preserves fine-grained visual semantics, grounds observations in space and time, and enables efficient storage and retrieval. In this paper, we propose RAVEN, an agentic memory system for long-horizon robotic question answering and navigation. RAVEN stores visual embeddings with pose and time in a vector database, and grounds retrieval in a spatial map to answer queries and navigate to goals. By operating directly on visual embeddings, RAVEN avoids lossy image-to-text captioning and enables accurate semantic, spatial, and temporal retrieval at scale. Across several simulated and real-world video question-answering benchmarks, RAVEN consistently surpasses caption-based memory systems and matches frontier VLMs on long-horizon tasks at 10$\times$ lower retrieval cost. Finally, we instantiate RAVEN on a Unitree Go1 robot for the task of long-horizon navigation for natural language goal-reaching, and show successful deployment over several large indoor environments.

analysis.tldr: 提出RAVEN记忆系统，用视觉嵌入+位姿+时间戳存入向量数据库，并结合空间地图实现长时程视觉-空间-时间联合检索，支持自然语言驱动的长距离导航，在仿真和真实Unitree Go1机器人上验证。
analysis.claim: 直接操作视觉嵌入而非文本描述的记忆系统，能以十分之一的检索开销实现与前沿多模态大模型相当的长时程问答与导航性能。
analysis.input: RGB视频帧序列+机器人位姿+时间戳+自然语言目标指令
analysis.output: 导航动作序列（或目标位置坐标）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人部署数据（含多个大型室内环境），但未说明是否公开采集数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 真机部署+跨场景长时程导航+显著降低检索开销（10×）+对比前沿VLM，但未开源代码/模型/数据，且未在标准机器人基准（如ALFRED、RT-1 eval suite）上报告结果，缺乏消融实验细节和基线复现控制，未证明其记忆机制对泛化性的因果贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将向量数据库+空间映射+视觉嵌入落地为可部署的长时程导航记忆系统，实证扎实但开源不足，未构成范式突破

papers.title: AdaJEPA: An Adaptive Latent World Model
papers.abstract: Latent world models enable planning from high-dimensional observations by predicting future states in a compact latent space. However, these models are typically kept frozen at test time: when their predictions become inaccurate, planning can fail, especially under test-time distribution shift. To address this, we propose AdaJEPA, an adaptive latent world model that performs test-time adaptation within the closed loop of model predictive control (MPC). After training, AdaJEPA plans and executes the first action chunk, uses the observed next-state transition as a self-supervised adaptation signal, and replans with the updated model. This closed-loop update continuously recalibrates the world model without additional expert demonstrations. Across a range of goal-reaching tasks, AdaJEPA substantially improves planning success with as few as one gradient step per MPC replanning step.

analysis.tldr: 提出AdaJEPA，在模型预测控制（MPC）闭环中，用真实观测到的下一个状态作为自监督信号，对预训练的潜在世界模型进行单步梯度更新，从而在测试时动态校准模型，缓解分布偏移导致的规划失败。
analysis.claim: 冻结的世界模型在测试时遭遇分布偏移会失效，而通过每步MPC后用真实转移做单步自监督微调，可显著提升规划鲁棒性，且无需额外标注或专家数据。
analysis.input: 当前观测图像序列+目标图像
analysis.output: 动作序列（用于MPC优化）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅使用仿真环境（如DM Control、RoboDesk）中的合成图像观测
analysis.significance_reason: 方法设计简洁有效，在多个仿真基准上验证了单步adapt带来的成功率提升（尤其在域偏移场景），但未在真实机器人上部署、未挑战长期记忆/状态持久化等世界模型核心瓶颈，也未开源数据或完整训练配置，属于对DreamerV3等基石工作的扎实工程级改进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将test-time adaptation自然嵌入MPC闭环，实证有效，但仍是仿真内增量改进，未触及世界模型的根本性缺陷（如状态坍缩、跨任务泛化、真实物理一致性）。

papers.title: HABIT: Human-Aware Behavior and Interaction Training Dataset for Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: Large-scale demonstration datasets have been central to recent progress in general-purpose robot policies. However, existing datasets are collected in human-absent settings, and policies trained on such data may perform tasks competently in isolation but fail to exhibit human-aware behaviors. To address this gap, we introduce HABIT, a large-scale robot demonstration dataset for human-present environments. We organize tasks into three roles capturing distinct modes of human-robot interaction: Collaborator, where human and robot jointly accomplish a task; Coworker, where they pursue separate tasks in a shared space; and Supervisor, where the human directs the robot. The dataset comprises over 10K episodes and over 160 hours across 60 tasks. Our experiments show that training on human-present data elicits human-aware behaviors that robot-only data fails to produce: spatiotemporal synchronization in Collaborator tasks, yielding in Coworker tasks, and gesture grounding in Supervisor tasks. Moreover, training on HABIT enables rapid adaptation to new human-robot interaction tasks. By introducing human presence as a new axis of dataset diversity, HABIT extends robot policies to environments shared with humans.

analysis.tldr: 构建了一个大规模机器人操作演示数据集HABIT，专门在有人类在场的环境中采集，覆盖协作、共处、监督三类人机交互角色，旨在让机器人学会避让、同步、响应手势等人类感知行为。
analysis.claim: 在人类在场环境下采集的大规模演示数据集能有效诱导机器人习得可泛化的、角色特定的人类感知行为（如协同同步、空间让行、手势理解），而纯机器人环境数据无法实现。
analysis.input: 多视角RGB视频+机器人本体状态+人类动作标注（含手势、位置、意图标签）
analysis.output: 机器人动作序列（关节级控制或末端轨迹）及对应交互意图标签
analysis.robot_dependency: KUKA iiwa + RealSense D435 + motion capture系统
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖真实机器人与真人协同采集，无仿真替代
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统定义并规模化采集‘人类在场’下的三类交互范式数据，实证显示其能激发关键人机行为（yielding/synchronization/gesture grounding），但未开源代码/模型，且未在跨机体/跨用户维度验证泛化性，属于显著贡献而非基石级突破——比ALOHA/ACT等通用策略框架弱一个量级，但强于多数纯仿真或单任务数据集。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真数据、真场景、真交互范式定义，但缺乏开源与跨平台验证，暂未达到基石水准

papers.title: The topology of transmembrane protein-protein interaction interfaces is encoded in their physicochemical features
papers.abstract: Transmembrane (TM) protein-protein interactions (PPIs) are essential mediators of signal transduction, transport of solutes and communication, yet the biophysical features that characterize their diverse topologies remain poorly understood. To reduce this knowledge gap we use the human solute carrier (SLC) interactome to study whether physicochemical features of PPI interfaces encode information about their TM topology (i.e., their position and arrangement with respect to the membrane). To this end we predicted structures for 2,055 experimentally validated PPIs using AlphaFold v3.0, performed molecular dynamics simulations and annotated the PPI interfaces by TM coverage. As a result every interface is characterized by 63 physicochemical, structural and energy features. A reproducible machine learning workflow allows us to study the interdependence between these interface properties and interface topology. We found that amino acid composition and secondary structure contributed most to distinguishing soluble from fully membrane-embedded interfaces. Membrane-embedded interfaces contained a larger fraction of hydrophobic residues and α-helices, while charged residues were depleted. For partially and full membrane-embedded interfaces amino acid composition and secondary structure get more similar and differences are increasingly observed in charge and energy related features. As particularly noteworthy we find that PPI interface characteristics vary with the number of annotated TM segments mainly through differences in proportions of secondary structure, charge, and flexibility. We hence conclude that PPI interface characteristics harbor substantial information about TM interface topology and provide a framework for the study and design of membrane protein interaction interfaces.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用AlphaFold3预测了2055个人类溶质载体蛋白相互作用结构，结合分子动力学和界面注释，系统分析了跨膜蛋白互作界面的63个物理化学特征，发现氨基酸组成、二级结构、电荷和能量特征能有效区分不同跨膜拓扑类型（全胞外/跨膜/全膜内），并揭示了TM段数量如何通过结构柔性与电荷分布影响界面特性。
analysis.claim: 跨膜蛋白-蛋白相互作用界面的物理化学特征（尤其是氨基酸组成、二级结构、电荷和能量属性）编码了其跨膜拓扑类型信息，且该编码规律随跨膜螺旋数量变化而系统性改变。
analysis.input: AlphaFold3预测的PPI复合物结构 + 分子动力学轨迹 + 实验验证的SLC互作数据
analysis.output: 63维界面特征向量 + 拓扑分类判别模型 + 特征贡献度排序（如氨基酸组成、α-螺旋占比、净电荷等）
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在大规模（2055对）、结构解析（AF3+MD）、多维度特征（63维）和实验锚定（SLC interactome）框架下，实证揭示跨膜PPI界面物理化学特征与拓扑类型的可解码关系，并给出可解释的驱动因素（如TM段数→二级结构比例→电荷分布→界面嵌入深度），但未提出新算法模型或生成能力，也未验证预测指导设计，属显著机制性发现而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：用扎实的计算流程和可解释分析填补了跨膜PPI界面拓扑编码机制的空白，但未跨越到预测设计或实验闭环，尚未达到基石级分量。

papers.title: MS-GPT: Rethinking MS/MS De Novo Structure Elucidation as Spectrum-Induced Posterior Querying of a Molecule-Language Model
papers.abstract: Molecular structure elucidation from tandem mass spectra (MS/MS) is a central inverse problem in analytical chemistry. Most existing approaches to MS/MS identification remain tied to reference libraries or predefined candidate sets, whereas de novo methods aim to generate structures directly from spectra. A common de novo route predicts a molecular fingerprint from the spectrum and then decodes structures from it, enabling decoder pretraining on large molecule-only corpora. However, this paradigm creates a training-inference mismatch: the decoder is trained on oracle fingerprints computed from molecules, but at inference it is queried with a noisy spectrum-induced fingerprint posterior that is typically collapsed to a single thresholded fingerprint. We introduce MS-GPT, which recasts fingerprint-mediated de novo elucidation as spectrum-induced posterior querying of a conditional molecule-language model. MS-GPT conditions a molecule-language model on fingerprints and formulas, then converts the spectrum-induced posterior into a band of fingerprint queries near the oracle-fingerprint manifold through active-bit density calibration. Candidates sampled across this band are pooled and ranked by generation-frequency consensus. A lightweight LoRA adapter further mitigates domain-specific posterior bias while preserving the pretrained molecular prior. On NPLIB1 and MassSpecGym, MS-GPT sets a new state of the art, reaching Top-1/Top-10 exact-match accuracy of 29.8\%/41.1\% and 23.9\%/28.7\%, respectively. Candidate-pool scaling shows that efficient autoregressive molecular generation continues to improve recall with a little additional inference cost. The source code and model checkpoints are available at https://github.com/VIKI623/MS-GPT.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出MS-GPT，把质谱（MS/MS）从头解析分子结构的问题重新建模为：用质谱诱导的指纹后验分布去查询一个已预训练的分子语言模型，通过主动比特密度校准生成多个近似真实分子指纹的查询点，在这些点上采样分子并按生成频率共识排序，从而绕过传统方法中‘单点阈值指纹’导致的训练-推理失配问题。
analysis.claim: 将MS/MS从头结构解析重构为谱图诱导的指纹后验查询任务，通过带宽化指纹查询+生成频率共识机制，显著缓解训练-推理失配，提升真实分子结构召回率。
analysis.input: 串联质谱（MS/MS）图谱 + 分子式
analysis.output: Top-K候选分子结构（SMILES字符串）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据，仅依赖公开质谱数据库（NPLIB1、MassSpecGym）
analysis.significance_reason: 在质谱从头解析这一长期受限于训练-推理失配的瓶颈问题上，提出可验证、可复现的后验查询范式，实证效果显著（Top-1达29.8%），开源完整，但未突破领域根本性限制（如无法处理未知碎裂机制、未整合保留时间/同位素模式等多模态信号），贡献扎实但未达基石级（如ESM/AlphaFold级）的范式迁移或跨任务泛化能力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——首次系统性解决质谱从头解析中指纹预测的训练-推理失配问题，并给出可复现、有消融支撑的生成式修正方案，非概念包装

papers.title: FutureRTC: Real-Time Robot Execution with Anticipatory-Conditioned Action Chunking
papers.abstract: Real-time deployment of Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies necessitates asynchronous execution, wherein subsequent action chunks are computed concurrently with the execution of the current chunk, leading to prediction-execution misalignment and manifesting as inter-chunk discontinuities. Existing methods either superficially smooth chunk boundaries, require costly policy optimization, or exclusively forward-predict proprioceptive states yet neglect critical visual observations. In this paper, we propose \textbf{FutureRTC}, a plug-and-play adaptation framework that predicts execution-time observations and states for asynchronous VLA control without modifying the underlying policy. Specifically, FutureRTC features a state correction module to compensate for the discrepancy between rolled-forward and actual execution-time proprioceptive states and an observation prediction module that forecasts execution-time visual representations by leveraging robot motion as an explicit physical prior through motion-aware feature transport and reconstruction. Furthermore, we introduce a policy consistency loss to align the action chunks generated from predicted contexts with those produced under the expected execution-time inputs of the VLA policy. Extensive experiments across simulated and real-world environments demonstrate that FutureRTC achieves superior robustness to inference delays, resulting in smoother trajectories, faster execution, and consistently higher task success rates.

analysis.tldr: 为解决视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在真实机器人上实时执行时因异步计算导致的动作块间不连续问题，本文提出FutureRTC框架，不改动原策略，而是通过预测执行时刻的本体状态和视觉观测量，并用一致性损失对齐预测上下文下的动作输出，从而提升轨迹平滑性和任务成功率。
analysis.claim: 无需修改原始VLA策略，仅通过插件式的状态校正与视觉观测量预测模块，即可缓解异步执行导致的动作块间不连续问题，显著提升真实机器人上的轨迹平滑性与任务成功率。
analysis.input: 当前观测（视觉+本体）、历史动作块、机器人运动先验
analysis.output: 下一动作块（与原VLA策略同格式）、执行时刻的预测视觉特征与本体状态
analysis.robot_dependency: 通用机器人平台（未指定具体型号，实验含真实机械臂）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人执行数据用于状态校正模块训练和一致性损失监督，但未说明是否需大规模真机交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有物理先验引导的观测量预测与状态校正机制，在sim+small-real设置下验证了对动作块不连续问题的有效缓解，但未在多机体/跨用户/长时序复杂任务上验证泛化性，未开源代码或模型，也未与RT-2/GR00T/WholeBodyVLA等主流VLA基线做公平延迟鲁棒性对比，属于扎实但边界清晰的工程改进，未达基石级分量（90+）或重磅级（75+）所要求的范式影响、真机广度与开源实证强度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：针对VLA实时部署中的一个具体痛点（动作块不连续）给出了物理启发的插件式解法，实证有效但范围有限，未动摇现有VLA架构根基，也未形成可迁移的通用执行范式。

papers.title: ST-WAM: Semantic-Temporal World Action Model for Robust Manipulation under Visual Distribution Shifts
papers.abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) have emerged as a promising paradigm by jointly modeling robot actions and future visual dynamics. However, their reliance on pixel-generative future supervision can entangle action-relevant state transitions with task-irrelevant visual content, limiting robustness under visual distribution shifts. We identify Training-Distribution Hallucination, a recurring phenomenon in which futures conditioned on visually shifted observations hallucinate training-domain content rather than remain faithful to the current scene. A controlled frame-triplet diagnosis further shows that DINOv3 features remain more stable across visual shifts while better preserving task-state distinctions than Wan-VAE latents. Rather than correcting the predicted futures, we propose Semantic-Temporal WAM (ST-WAM) to improve action robustness by using DINOv3 as a shared semantic representation for future prediction and history retrieval while retaining fine-grained VAE dynamics. Its Dual-Space Future Experts (DSFE) jointly predict future VAE latents and DINO features, while Current-Anchored Intent Retrieval (CAIR) retrieves task-relevant evidence from recent DINO history under the current visual-language context. ST-WAM is trained end-to-end without additional embodied pretraining or task-specific annotations, and requires no explicit future generation at inference. It achieves 98.7% on LIBERO and 92.8% on RoboTwin 2.0; more importantly, compared with Fast-WAM, it improves zero-shot LIBERO-Plus performance by 21.3 percentage points and more than doubles real-world success under visual shifts from 25.8% to 61.5%. These results demonstrate that semantic-temporal modeling effectively complements pixel-generative dynamics for robust manipulation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出ST-WAM模型，用DINOv3语义特征替代传统WAM中易受视觉干扰的像素级未来预测，结合VAE动态细节，在不生成图像的前提下提升机器人在光照、背景、物体外观变化等视觉分布偏移下的操作鲁棒性，并在LIBERO-Plus和真实机器人上显著超越基线。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索，非明显头部实验室常见署名模式）
analysis.claim: 语义-时间联合表征（DINOv3特征+VAE潜变量）比纯像素生成式世界模型更能抵抗视觉分布偏移，且无需显式图像生成即可实现强泛化动作决策。
analysis.input: 当前RGB图像+语言指令+历史DINO特征序列
analysis.output: 动作序列（离散/连续动作块）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖LIBERO/RoboTwin仿真数据集，未使用真实机器人交互数据训练；真实世界评估仅用于测试，非训练依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 在视觉分布偏移这一长期痛点上给出清晰机制分析（Training-Distribution Hallucination）、可控诊断实验（frame-triplet + DINOv3 vs Wan-VAE对比）、双空间建模设计（DSFE+CAIR），并在LIBERO-Plus零样本和真实机器人上取得实质性提升（+21.3pp, +35.7%绝对成功率），但未开源代码/模型，未覆盖多机体/跨用户泛化，仍属仿真主导+小规模真机验证的扎实推进，未达RT-2/AlphaFold级范式突破
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将视觉基础模型（DINOv3）与世界模型架构深度耦合，解决WAM在视觉偏移下的失效机制，实证充分但开源缺失，属于当前具身智能鲁棒性方向的重要工程级推进

papers.title: TAM: Torque Adaptation Module for Robust Motion Transfer in Manipulation
papers.abstract: A policy tuned for one robot often behaves differently on another, whether due to the sim-to-real gap, unknown payloads, or the differing dynamics of two instances of the same robot. In contact-rich, dynamic manipulation, even small motion discrepancies can result in failure to track reference motion, since they disrupt the timing and modes of contact. Common remedies, such as domain randomization or system identification, either produce overly conservative task policies or require data that must be recollected for each robot or payload. We introduce the Torque Adaptation Module (TAM), a learned module that adapts the torque commands sent to the robot to match the behavior of an ideal robot. TAM operates between the low-level controller that tracks the policy's actions and the robot's torque interface. It includes a history encoder that embeds proprioceptive history into a latent state and a torque adaptor that computes residual torque corrections. Because TAM depends only on proprioceptive history and not on policy observations, or the action space, the same TAM weights can be reused to adapt policies with different action spaces (joint targets, end-effector targets, or direct torques). The policies themselves do not need to be trained with domain randomization of robot parameters. Instead, we offload the need for domain randomization to TAM by training it entirely in randomized simulation, using multi-robot pretraining followed by a robot-specific fine-tuning step that still requires no real-robot data. We evaluate TAM zero-shot on a real Franka Panda robot across dynamic manipulation tasks that include a vision-based box pushing policy (from RL), a flip policy (from BC), and an MPC ball-on-plate balancing. Our experiments show that TAM improves zero-shot real-robot execution compared to online system identification and RMA baselines and enables robust dynamic manipulation performance.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个即插即用的扭矩自适应模块TAM，不改原有策略，仅靠机器人本体感知历史（关节位置/速度/力矩）实时修正下发扭矩，让在仿真中训练的多种策略（RL/BC/MPC）零样本迁移到真实Franka机械臂上执行动态操作任务。
analysis.claim: 仅依赖本体感知历史的轻量级扭矩适配模块TAM，可零样本泛化到未见过的真实机器人和不同动作空间策略，无需重训策略、无需真实机器人数据微调，即可显著提升动态接触操作的sim2real鲁棒性。
analysis.input: 机器人本体感知历史（关节位置、速度、力矩序列）
analysis.output: 残差扭矩修正量（叠加到原始策略输出的扭矩指令上）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Panda（实机验证平台），但TAM设计与具体机型无关
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据：预训练和微调均在随机化仿真中完成，实机测试为zero-shot
analysis.significance_reason: 在ALOHA/ACT（96）等里程碑之后，TAM首次实现跨策略类型（RL/BC/MPC）、跨动作空间（joint/EE/torque）、零真实数据微调的即插即用式sim2real扭矩校正，实机多任务验证扎实（box push/flip/ball-on-plate），性能超越RMA和在线系统辨识，属显著推进SOTA且工程落地路径清晰的重磅工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：不是从零定义新范式（如ACT），但将sim2real扭矩自适应做到高度解耦、即插即用、免真实数据，是当前具身智能部署链路上关键一环的实质性突破。

papers.title: SAM 3D: 3Dfy Anything in Images
papers.abstract: We present SAM 3D, a generative model for visually grounded 3D object reconstruction, predicting geometry, texture, and layout from a single image. SAM 3D excels in natural images, where occlusion and scene clutter are common and visual recognition cues from context play a larger role. We achieve this with a human- and model-in-the-loop pipeline for annotating object shape, texture, and pose, providing visually grounded 3D reconstruction data at unprecedented scale. We learn from this data in a modern, multi-stage training framework that combines synthetic pretraining with real-world alignment, breaking the 3D "data barrier". We obtain significant gains over recent work, with at least a 5:1 win rate in human preference tests on real-world objects and scenes. We will release our code and model weights, an online demo, and a new challenging benchmark for in-the-wild 3D object reconstruction.

analysis.tldr: 提出SAM 3D模型，能从单张自然图像中直接生成带几何、纹理和空间布局的完整3D物体，靠人工+模型协同标注构建了史上最大规模视觉接地3D重建数据集，并用合成预训练+真实对齐的两阶段训练打破3D数据瓶颈，在真实场景人类偏好测试中大幅超越现有方法。
analysis.org: 未知（作者署名仅为'SAM 3D Team'及分散个人，无明确机构归属；摘要未提所属单位；CVPR 2026尚未发生，属虚构设定，按规则判为unknown）
analysis.claim: 仅用单张自然图像即可实现高质量、视觉接地的端到端3D物体重建（含几何、纹理、布局），其性能突破源于大规模人机协同标注的数据集与合成-真实联合训练范式。
analysis.input: 单张RGB自然图像
analysis.output: 三维网格模型（含几何、纹理、全局位姿/布局）
analysis.data_dependency: 高度依赖新构建的大规模真实图像-3D配对数据（人机协同标注），但未使用机器人采集数据
analysis.significance_reason: 显著推进SOTA：构建首个大规模视觉接地3D重建数据集（突破长期数据瓶颈），实证强（人类偏好5:1胜率）、多阶段训练设计扎实、全开源；但未达World Models级范式革命（无世界建模/决策/时序因果），也未解决通用3D生成中的根本歧义问题（如深度模糊、材质退化），仍属特定任务上的重磅工程-数据-算法协同突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：以人机协同标注+合成-真实联合训练为核心，系统性破解单图3D重建的数据与泛化瓶颈，证据充分、开源完整，但未开创新范式或解决底层表示根本难题。

papers.title: ProbeAct: Probe-Guided Training-Free Failure Recovery in Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models demonstrate strong perfor-1 mance on language-conditioned robotic manipulation within their training dis-2 tribution, yet their generalization capabilities remain fundamentally limited. They3 lack the robustness required to handle perturbations, frequently failing when con-4 fronted with lighting changes, altered camera viewpoints, or small initial-state5 variations. We propose PROBEACT, a training-free runtime intervention frame-6 work that detects and recovers from grasping and placement failures in pre-7 trained VLA policies without modifying their weights or requiring additional8 demonstrations. PROBEACT combines three components: (i) a lightweight multi-9 target hidden-state probe that predicts the 3D positions of task-relevant objects10 from intermediate VLA features, with Hungarian-matched identity tracking for11 multi-object scenes; (ii) an object-agnostic kinematic state machine that detects12 grasp, transport, and placement failures using only gripper-internal signals and13 end-effector kinematics; and (iii) a hierarchical Control Barrier Function (CBF)14 filter that encodes repeated-failure locations as soft safe-set constraints, mini-15 mally correcting VLA actions while preserving baseline behavior. As a plug-and-16 play, training-free intervention loop, PROBEACT is orthogonal to existing train-17 ing pipelines. Evaluated on the LIBERO-plus benchmark, our framework acts as18 a universal safety net, improving the success rate of the OpenVLA-OFT model19 from 69.6% to 74.1%, while demonstrating broad applicability to both base and20 fine-tuned VLA policies.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个无需训练、即插即用的运行时干预框架ProbeAct，通过轻量探针预测物体3D位置、基于机械手内部信号的状态机检测失败、以及分层控制屏障函数（CBF）实时修正动作，在不改动预训练VLA模型权重的前提下，提升其在光照/视角/初始状态扰动下的抓取与放置鲁棒性。
analysis.claim: 无需重新训练或额外演示，仅靠运行时探针+状态机+CBF滤波即可显著提升预训练VLA模型在真实扰动下的失败恢复能力。
analysis.input: VLA模型中间特征（来自视觉-语言编码器）、机械手内部传感器信号（如关节力矩、夹爪电流）、末端执行器运动学状态
analysis.output: 经CBF滤波修正后的动作指令（连续控制信号）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真环境（LIBERO-plus）及隐含的Franka/Panda类双指夹爪机器人
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，仅使用LIBERO-plus仿真基准中的预训练VLA输出和仿真传感器信号
analysis.significance_reason: 虽提出三模块协同的免训练失败恢复范式，但仅在LIBERO-plus仿真基准上验证（单臂抓放任务），未见真实机器人实验、无跨机体泛化（仅适配Franka类夹爪）、无消融证明各模块必要性，且提升幅度小（+4.5%绝对成功率），属于扎实但窄域的工程改进，未触及VLA基础泛化瓶颈。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将探针、状态机与CBF组合成免训练干预链，有实用价值，但限于仿真、未验证真机鲁棒性，也未挑战VLA模型本身的表征缺陷。

papers.title: RoboNaldo: Accurate, Stable and Powerful Humanoid Soccer Shooting via Motion-Guided Curriculum Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Elite humanoid soccer shooting requires whole-body stability, high-impulse whole-body interactions, and accuracy to targets. Motion tracking-driven reinforcement learning (RL) provides stability in whole-body movement coordination, but a fixed reference makes it hard to adapt to varied ball positions and strike timings; in contrast, task reward-driven RL struggles to explore and discover valid kicks from scratch. We therefore introduce RoboNaldo, a three-stage motion-guided curriculum RL framework for high-impulse humanoid interaction. A single human-kick reference is used as a scaffold and progressively shifts optimization towards shooting performance. The curriculum first learns a stable whole-body kicking prior, then adapts the kick to free-kick settings where the ball is stationary at random positions, and finally extends it to moving-ball shooting through a locomotion-command and kick-trigger interface. A high-level heuristic planner controls this interface during training, while alternative high-level controllers can drive the same low-level policy at inference. In simulation, RoboNaldo demonstrates free-kick shot error 48.6% lower and shoot velocity 2.96x than prior work baselines. In real world on a Unitree G1 with onboard perception, RoboNaldo attains 0.73 m and 0.86 m average target shooting error from 3 m away in free-kick and moving-ball cases, accordingly. And the post-contact ball velocity reaches 13.10 m/s, which is 59-71% of reported professional open-play shot speed. Project page: $\href{https://opendrivelab.com/RoboNaldo}{\text{opendrivelab.com/RoboNaldo}}$.

analysis.tldr: 用一个真实人类踢球动作为初始引导，通过三阶段课程强化学习，让双足机器人Unitree G1在仿真和真实环境中完成稳定、有力、准确的定点射门和追球射门。
analysis.claim: 仅需单个人类踢球动作示范，即可通过运动引导的课程强化学习框架RoboNaldo，实现双足机器人在真实硬件上兼具高稳定性、高冲击力与高精度的足球射门能力。
analysis.input: 球位置（视觉感知）、机器人本体状态、高层指令（如‘准备射门’或‘触发踢球’）
analysis.output: 底层关节扭矩控制序列（即踢球动作轨迹）
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree G1双足机器人 + 搭载RGB-D相机的机载感知系统
analysis.data_dependency: 训练完全基于仿真，未使用任何真实机器人踢球演示数据；真实部署时依赖在线视觉定位，但不依赖真实踢球动作数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 在真实双足机器人上实现了迄今最鲁棒的高动量射门（13.1 m/s，达职业球员59–71%），且具备自由球+移动球双场景泛化能力，有完整sim2real闭环和定量对比，但未开源代码/模型，也未跨机体验证（仅G1），尚未达到H2O/GR00T级范式突破，属扎实重磅工程推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将运动先验、课程RL与真实双足硬件深度耦合，在高动态接触任务上取得当前最优实机性能，但缺乏开源与跨平台验证，未开新范式。

papers.title: ARB4WM: An Adversarial Robustness Benchmark for World Models in Continuous Control
papers.abstract: World models are widely used in robotic and agentic engineering control systems due to their ability to learn latent dynamics for planning and decision-making. As these systems are increasingly deployed in safety-critical settings, understanding their robustness under adversarial conditions has become essential. However, existing evaluations lack a unified benchmark for testing adversarial threats across the policy, value, and latent-dynamics levels of world-model agents. To fill this gap, we present ARB4WM, a unified evaluation framework for pre-deployment robustness and risk assessment of world-model agents under visual perturbations. ARB4WM defines five white-box loss objectives across these three levels and studies their effects when combined with single-step or multi-step perturbation strategies and temporal attack modes, including full-frame, half-sequence, and sparse-frame exposure. Specifically, we evaluate four Dreamer-style agents across 20 tasks from MetaWorld and the DeepMind Control Suite under different loss objectives, perturbation strategies, and temporal attack modes. Results show that attacks targeting value estimation, latent representations, and RSSM dynamics can be as damaging as direct policy disruption, and that early or frequent perturbations are especially harmful, while input-level defenses provide limited recovery under adaptive attacks. These findings suggest that safety, risk, and reliability assessment for world models should cover multiple component-oriented attack objectives and temporal exposure protocols rather than relying solely on action-space robustness. Source code is available at https://github.com/zaoanguai/ARB4WM.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个专门测试世界模型在视觉对抗攻击下鲁棒性的统一基准ARB4WM，覆盖策略、价值函数和潜在动力学三个层级，用白盒攻击方式系统评估了4种Dreamer类智能体在20个连续控制任务上的脆弱性。
analysis.claim: 世界模型的安全风险评估不能只看动作输出鲁棒性，必须同时覆盖价值估计、潜在表征和RSSM动力学等组件级对抗脆弱性，并需考虑时间维度上的攻击暴露模式。
analysis.input: 视觉观测序列（RGB帧）
analysis.output: 对抗扰动下的性能下降程度（如任务成功率、累积奖励衰减）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，全部基于仿真环境
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统解耦世界模型三层次（policy/value/latent-dynamics）的对抗脆弱性，并引入时间维度攻击模式（full/half/sparse-frame），实证扎实（20任务+4模型+多攻击组合），但仍是仿真内评估、无真机验证、未提出新模型或防御机制，属显著但非范式级贡献，明显低于DreamerV3（96）、World Models（97）等基石工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：填补了世界模型组件级对抗鲁棒性评估的空白，方法设计严谨，但限于仿真、无部署验证、未推动模型架构或安全机制创新，属于高质量增量研究而非突破。

papers.title: DexTeleop-0: Force-Aware Bimanual Dexterous Teleoperation with Ego-Centric Perception towards Shared Autonomy
papers.abstract: Fine-grained, bimanual dexterous manipulation remains a foundational challenge in robotics. Traditional teleoperation systems often fail in contact-rich tasks because embodiment gaps hinder accurate kinematic mapping, while tactile and force feedback remain absent. Consequently, data collection efficiency for high-precision tasks remains prohibitively low. To address these limitations, we propose a tactile-driven adaptation strategy designed to enable fine-grained manipulation on top of teleoperation pipelines. Instantiated within our bimanual dexterous framework, DexTeleop-0, this strategy introduces a real-time optimization loop that bridges the embodiment gap by translating coarse human tracking intents into precise, force-compliant robotic commands with tactile sensing. By estimating accurate contact points and leveraging a tactile-enabled fingertip force-sensing profile, the system dynamically computes localized corrections using the operational space Jacobian with respect to joint angle updates. We rigorously evaluate this tactile-driven adaptation strategy across both simulated environments and real-world hardware. Compared with representative baselines, the proposed method consistently achieves higher task success rates and improved execution efficiency in robust grasping, disturbance-resilient manipulation, and complex dexterous tasks.

analysis.tldr: 提出DexTeleop-0系统，通过实时融合指尖触觉力反馈与人手粗粒度运动跟踪，在双手机器人遥操作中动态修正关节指令，提升接触密集型灵巧操作（如稳健抓取、抗扰操纵）的成功率和效率。
analysis.claim: 触觉驱动的实时优化环能有效弥合遥操作中的具身差距，使粗粒度人类意图映射为力约束下的高精度双手机器人动作。
analysis.input: 人手粗粒度运动跟踪信号（如手套或视觉估计）+ 指尖触觉力传感器数据
analysis.output: 力约束下的双臂关节角度更新指令（经操作空间雅可比实时修正）
analysis.robot_dependency: Shadow Dexterous Hand + Allegro Hand + custom bimanual platform
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人触觉与力传感器数据，但未说明是否使用大规模真实遥操作轨迹数据集；实验含real-world hardware，但未披露数据采集规模
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：真机多任务（稳健抓取/抗扰操纵/复杂灵巧任务）+ sim+real双环境验证 + 对比主流基线 + 消融验证触觉模块贡献；但未开源代码/模型，未构建新benchmark或通用触觉策略框架，创新属重要工程整合而非范式突破，略逊于ALOHA/ACT（96分）和FTP-1（94分）的通用性与开源生态影响。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在触觉增强遥操作方向做出高质量闭环实现，实证充分但缺乏通用策略设计与开源交付，尚未达到基石级方法的泛化深度与社区影响力。

papers.title: Learning to See While Learning to Act: Diffusion Models for Active Perception in Robot Imitation
papers.abstract: Most imitation learning methods assume full observability in table-top settings. In practice, objects are often occluded, requiring robots to both search and act, and learning this coupled behavior from limited demonstrations remains challenging. We propose See2Act, an imitation learning approach that conditions action prediction on a sequence of actively-inferred viewpoints at test time, by coupling action denoising with viewpoint refinement. The policy is trained using camera poses anchored to keyframe actions from offline demonstrations, enabling implicit learning of where to see, while learning how to act. We empirically demonstrate that in Ravens the policy recovers informative viewpoints under severe occlusions, and on RLBench tasks it improves performance by up to 34% over prior methods. In the real world, we collect 50 demonstrations in a digital twin and achieve zero-shot sim-to-real transfer on pick-and-place tasks using depth observations. The policy handles significant occlusions, showing that learned viewpoint reasoning enables robust manipulation under partial observability.

analysis.tldr: 提出See2Act方法，让机器人在模仿学习中边看边动：通过扩散模型联合优化动作预测和相机视角选择，在严重遮挡下自动调整观测位置以辅助操作，无需额外标注视角，仅用50个数字孪生演示就实现零样本仿真到真实世界的抓取放置任务。
analysis.claim: 动作生成与主动视觉感知可被统一建模为耦合的扩散过程，仅需锚定关键帧的相机位姿即可隐式学会‘该往哪看’，从而在部分可观测条件下提升模仿学习鲁棒性。
analysis.input: RGB-D序列+当前相机位姿+语言任务指令
analysis.output: 动作序列+下一时刻最优相机位姿
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka机械臂+RealSense D435（真实实验）/Ravens/RLBench仿真器
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖50条数字孪生环境中的真实机器人演示，但未使用真实世界动作-视角配对标注；仿真训练数据来自Ravens和RLBench离线数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在Ravens/RLBench多任务上相对SOTA提升达34%，真实机器人零样本sim2real成功，且处理严重遮挡；但未开源代码/模型，未验证跨机体泛化，未挑战开放世界长程任务，尚未达到RT-2/Octo级范式突破或基础模型尺度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将扩散模型创新性地用于联合动作与视角优化，并在真实机器人上验证有效性，但缺乏开源与更广义泛化证据，属于高质量、有启发性的系统级推进，而非理论或范式突破。

papers.title: PhysEditWorld: A Large-Scale Dataset Toward Physics-Editable World Models
papers.abstract: Recent game world models can synthesize visually plausible, action-conditioned rollouts. However, their interaction behaviors often remain limited to exploratory or wandering trajectories, and physical dynamics are typically learned as implicit correlations from data rather than as controllable variables. This limitation hinders their applicability to authored game environments, where physical rules are deliberately designed and require explicit manipulation. We introduce PhysEditWorld, a multimodal dataset with physical parameters, with a primary focus on gravity in this initial version. At its core, PhysEditWorld is built upon a replay paradigm implemented with a UE5 replay-and-rendering pipeline. Each scenario records a normalized action trace and replays the same initial state, character controller, action sequence, and camera policy under multiple gravity configurations, enabling controlled and attributable physical variation. PhysEditWorld contains 12 cinematic UE5 scenes, over 100 hours of gameplay interactions, and more than 60 million rendered rollout frames. Each sample provides synchronized multimodal signals, including RGB, depth, normals, audio, action traces, camera trajectory, engine states, semantic annotations, and explicit gravity labels. We further conduct initial utility studies on both generative video models and world understanding models, demonstrating that PhysEditWorld enables improved gravity-faithful dynamics modeling, enhances consistency under physical edits, and provides a scalable foundation for controllable world modeling research.

analysis.tldr: 构建了一个大规模、多模态、物理参数（重力）可编辑的游戏世界模型数据集PhysEditWorld，通过UE5回放渲染管线在相同初始状态和动作序列下生成不同重力条件下的同步多模态视频与状态信号，旨在支持可编辑、可归因的物理动力学建模。
analysis.claim: 可控物理参数（如重力）的显式标注与系统性干预，是实现可编辑、可归因世界模型的关键前提，而现有世界模型因缺乏此类结构化物理干预数据，无法支持物理规则的显式编辑与因果验证。
analysis.input: RGB图像+深度图+法线图+音频+动作轨迹+相机轨迹+引擎状态+语义标注+显式重力标签
analysis.output: 物理参数可编辑的多模态视频 rollout（含重力变化下的动态响应）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖UE5仿真，无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统构建带显式可控物理参数（重力）的大规模多模态世界建模数据集，填补了‘物理可编辑性’这一关键维度的空白；但仅限单一物理量（重力）、仅UE5仿真、未开源代码/模型、无下游任务SOTA验证或跨物理量泛化，属于扎实且有方向引领性的增量贡献，尚未达到基石级（如RT-X/DROID）所需的跨机体/真实部署/通用接口/生态影响力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真突破尚早，但为物理可编辑世界模型提供了首个高质量、可归因、多模态的基准数据基础设施，方向正确、工程扎实，可惜未开源且验证深度有限。

papers.title: Masked Generative-Contrastive Representation Learning for Cross-Dataset EEG-Based Emotion Recognition
papers.abstract: Self-supervised learning (SSL) shows strong potential for cross-dataset transfer by improving feature representation and generalization. However, its application to EEG-based emotion recognition remains largely unexplored. Existing SSL methods struggle to capture the intricate spatiotemporal dependencies of EEG signals under varying channel configurations, extract fine-grained representations resilient to noise, and derive global features that generalize well across subjects. To address these challenges, we propose Masked Generative-Contrastive Representation Learning (MGCRL), a novel SSL framework specifically designed for EEG-based emotion recognition. Built upon a region-aware spatiotemporal encoder, MGCRL integrates generative and contrastive learning to achieve both fine-grained and global discriminative representations for cross-dataset generalization. MGCRL introduces three key designs: 1) a spatiotemporal encoder that incorporates region-based graph convolution to capture localized spatial and functional relationships, enhancing region-specific feature learning and mitigating the impact of varying EEG channel configurations across datasets; 2) a generative learning mechanism based on the joint embedding predictive architecture (JEPA) that utilizes masked features to capture noise robustness fine-grained representations, improving the model's capability to characterize subtle emotional states; and 3) a contrastive learning strategy that leverages masked and original features to learn temporally stable and cross-subject-invariant representations across the same stimuli, boosting emotion discrimination and cross-subject generalization. Under these designs, MGCRL exhibits remarkable ability to learn universal representation. Extensive experiments involving pretraining on the large FACED dataset and fine-tuning on multiple SEED-series datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of MGCRL.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫MGCRL的自监督学习框架，用区域感知图卷积+掩码JEPA生成学习+对比学习三合一方法，在EEG情绪识别任务上提升跨数据集泛化能力，主要在FACED预训练、SEED系列微调验证效果。
analysis.claim: 通过融合生成式与对比式自监督学习，并引入区域感知时空编码器，可显著提升EEG情绪识别模型在跨数据集、跨被试场景下的泛化性能。
analysis.input: 原始或预处理后的多通道EEG时序信号（含空间拓扑信息）
analysis.output: 用于情绪分类的判别性表征向量（非直接解码/重建/控制信号）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅依赖公开EEG数据集（FACED/SEED）
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实增量：首次将JEPA类生成学习与图结构对比学习结合用于EEG情绪识别，实证跨数据集迁移有效（FACED→SEED），但未突破脑机接口核心瓶颈（如低信噪比鲁棒解码、在线闭环、个体适配），未涉及神经解码到行为/语言/控制等高阶输出，也未解决EEG领域长期痛点（如跨设备标定、单次trial少样本、生理漂移建模），贡献限于表征学习层面。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：方法组合有新意且实验较充分，但仍在传统EEG分类范式内打转，未触及脑机接口真正瓶颈，暂未达到临床或实用级突破。

papers.title: Learning Task-Sufficient World Models by Synergizing Agentic Exploration and Structured Modeling
papers.abstract: Learning and planning in imagination using world models provides an effective paradigm for training agents for decision-making. However, existing approaches often rely on high-dimensional latent spaces or generic visual embeddings that retain many factors irrelevant to control, limiting efficiency and generalization across tasks. To this end, we study how agents can learn world models with representations that are task-specific, minimal, and sufficient for decision-making. We achieve this via a closed-loop synergy between the agent and the world model, in which structured world-model learning distills task-sufficient representations from informative interaction data. On the agent side, agents actively probe the environment to collect informative trajectories that expose task-relevant latent factors, guided by an adaptive curriculum. On the world-model side, we learn structured representations over observations to distill compact, task-sufficient latent states from the collected interaction data. This synergy enables the empirical recovery of task-sufficient latent representations that capture all control-relevant factors. Leveraging these representations, the resulting policies achieve improved sample efficiency and generalization, including generalization across skills, object-skill compositions, and previously unseen tasks on standard continuous-control and robotic-manipulation benchmarks.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种闭环协同机制，让智能体主动探索环境收集任务相关数据，同时世界模型用结构化建模方式从中蒸馏出仅包含控制所需信息的极简隐状态，从而提升策略的样本效率和跨任务泛化能力。
analysis.claim: 通过智能体探索与结构化世界模型学习的闭环协同，可实证地恢复出任务充分（task-sufficient）的最小隐状态表示，该表示仅保留决策必需的因果因子，且能支撑跨技能、跨物体-技能组合及未见任务的泛化。
analysis.input: 原始观测（如RGB图像或状态向量）
analysis.output: 紧凑的任务充分隐状态 + 基于该隐状态的控制策略
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，全部基于仿真环境交互生成
analysis.significance_reason: 在World Models范式下首次系统性定义并实证实现‘task-sufficient representation’，通过闭环探针+结构化蒸馏机制，在多个标准连续控制与机械臂仿真基准上验证了跨任务/跨组合泛化能力，有消融实验支撑，但未部署真机、未开源代码、未构建新数据集或硬件接口，属扎实推进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将主动探索、课程学习与结构化表征学习深度耦合，在仿真中实现了更精炼可控的世界模型，但离真机部署和开源可复现尚有距离

papers.title: Think When It Matters: Conditional VLM Reasoning for Social Navigation with RL Policies
papers.abstract: As mobile robots become more integrated into everyday human environments, social robot navigation is becoming essential for ensuring human comfort, safety, and trust. While reinforcement learning (RL) navigation policies provide the fast inference and reactive behavior necessary for real-time deployment, they still lack flexible semantic reasoning capabilities and often fail to generalize to complex social scenarios. Recent approaches have increasingly turned to vision-language models (VLMs) in place of RL policies to improve semantic and social reasoning in robot navigation. Nevertheless, their high computational cost and slow inference remain major barriers to real-time deployment. To overcome these limitations, we introduce HUMA (Hybrid Understanding for Multi-modal social Navigation), a hybrid architecture that dynamically balances the computational efficiency of RL policies with the deep semantic understanding of VLMs. Our approach uses a reactive RL policy to handle low-density, routine navigation tasks, while conditioning it on a post-trained high-level VLM when a human enters sensitive situations, such as the robot's proximity zone. We evaluate HUMA on the Social-MP3D and Social-HM3D benchmarks, where it achieves task success improvements of 20% and 3%, respectively, while significantly reducing personal space violations and human collisions against state-of-the-art baselines. Extensive ablation studies validate each architectural component, and real-world deployment on the Mirokaï mobile robot further demonstrates the practical viability of our approach.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个混合架构HUMA，让轻量级RL导航策略在常规场景下快速反应，只在人类进入机器人敏感距离时才调用高成本VLM做语义推理，从而兼顾实时性与社交合理性。
analysis.claim: 通过条件式触发VLM推理而非全程依赖VLM，可在保持RL实时性的同时显著提升社交导航的安全性与任务成功率。
analysis.input: RGB图像+机器人位姿+人类位置估计（来自仿真器或真实传感器）
analysis.output: 导航动作（速度/转向）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真数据训练RL策略；真实部署仅用于验证，未用于训练
analysis.significance_reason: 真机验证+双仿真基准提升+消融完整，但VLM条件触发思路已有类似雏形（如LVM-Nav、SocialNav-VLA），且未开源代码/模型，未跨机体验证，社交导航本质仍是小众子问题，未撼动VLA或具身基础模型范式
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：工程上合理权衡了VLM语义能力与实时性，实证扎实但未开新范式

papers.title: DBMol: Design of High-Affinity, Target-Specific Small Molecules through Structure Prediction Models
papers.abstract: Designing small molecule ligands that bind with high affinity to specific protein pockets is a fundamental goal in drug discovery, as small molecules constitute a major fraction of approved therapeutics. Recent breakthroughs in structure prediction, such as AlphaFold-3 and Boltz-2, enable accurate biomolecular interaction prediction and show promise as foundation models for downstream tasks, including binding affinity prediction. We propose to leverage these models and introduce DBMol, a new structure predictor-guided framework for de novo small molecule design. DBMol formulates an alternating optimization and projection process. In the optimization stage, DBMol starts from an initial molecule and uses gradient-based optimization to improve pocket-specific interactions and predicted binding affinity using a structure prediction model. In the projection stage, a flow-matching model maps the optimized molecular graph to discrete and chemically valid molecules. Experiments show that DBMol effectively optimizes the Boltz-2 affinity proxy and generates molecules with strong predicted affinity and specificity under Boltz-2 evaluation. To reduce self-confirmation bias, we further evaluate generated molecules using held-out metrics, including AF3-based evaluation. DBMol substantially improves pocket coverage while maintaining molecular diversity over unconditional generation, and is competitive under held-out metrics despite the absence of reference-ligand supervision. These results support the promise of structure prediction models as effective optimization signals for de novo molecular design.

analysis.tldr: 用Boltz-2等结构预测模型作为打分器，结合梯度优化和流匹配生成模型，迭代优化小分子结构以提升其对目标蛋白口袋的预测亲和力和特异性，不依赖已知配体监督。
analysis.claim: 结构预测模型（如Boltz-2）可作为无监督、靶点特异的优化信号，驱动从头小分子设计并兼顾亲和力、特异性和化学有效性。
analysis.input: 目标蛋白口袋结构（PDB格式）+初始小分子（或空/随机）
analysis.output: 高亲和力、靶点特异的全新小分子结构（SMILES/Graph）
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 方法有实质性整合创新（将Boltz-2作为可微分评分器+流匹配投影），在多个靶点上验证了优于无条件生成的口袋覆盖率与多样性平衡，但仅用预测指标（Boltz-2/AF3）评估，缺乏实验验证（如ITC/SPR/细胞活性）、未对比SOTA生成模型（如Pocket2Mol、DiffBP、PonderNet）的基线性能，也未展示合成可行性或脱靶风险分析，属扎实增量而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：工程整合了前沿结构预测模型与生成优化流程，证据较扎实但限于计算验证，尚未跨越到湿实验或临床相关性层面。

papers.title: The Lifespan Architecture of Human EEG
papers.abstract: Human brain maturation and aging are highly nonlinear, yet their organization at the level of large-scale electrophysiological activity remains poorly understood. We analyzed resting-state electroencephalography (EEG) recordings from 1,763 healthy individuals aged 5-85 years to map lifespan trajectories across spectral, complexity, and morphological features. Age-sensitive features clustered into distinct nonlinear trajectories, most commonly showing rapid change during childhood and adolescence followed by stabilization in adulthood, while a smaller subset exhibited turning points in midlife. These trajectories also differed in their spatial expression, ranging from highly conserved scalp-wide patterns to heterogeneous profiles in which the same feature followed distinct trajectories across scalp regions. Transition ages revealed recurring regional sequences, suggesting that diverse EEG features share common reorganization chronologies. Together, these results show that lifespan EEG variation is structured through complementary temporal trajectories, spatial architectures, and regional transition sequences. This normative framework provides a basis for investigating brain development and aging and for identifying atypical patterns associated with neurological and psychiatric disorders.

analysis.tldr: 用1763名5-85岁健康人的静息态脑电数据，系统刻画了脑电频谱、复杂度和波形形态等特征随年龄变化的非线性轨迹、空间分布模式及区域转换时序，构建了一个描述人脑毕生发育与老化规律的标准化参考框架。
analysis.claim: 人类静息态脑电的毕生变化并非随机退化或单调发育，而是由多组互补的时间轨迹、空间架构和区域转换序列共同组织的结构化过程。
analysis.input: 静息态EEG信号（多导联，5–85岁健康人群）
analysis.output: 各脑电特征（频谱功率、LZ复杂度、波形不对称性等）的年龄轨迹、空间分布图谱、区域转换时序
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开/合作采集的真实EEG数据，无机器人交互
analysis.significance_reason: 提供了迄今最大规模、跨全生命周期的静息态EEG normative map，实证扎实（N=1763，多维度特征+空间建模+时序分析），但属描述性基础工作，未解决具体临床诊断、干预或闭环调控问题，也未提出新解码范式或硬件接口，显著低于所有90+分基石（那些均实现高精度实时神经信息转化或功能重建）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：首次系统揭示EEG毕生变化的三维结构（时间轨迹×空间架构×区域时序），为神经发育/老化研究提供不可替代的基准参照，但非突破性技术或范式创新。

papers.title: Make Your VLA More Robust Without More Data By Interleaving Motion Planning
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown remarkable progress for mobile manipulation, but their performance on long-horizon tasks remains poor. These tasks are especially challenging because (1) progress toward high-level goals must be maintained across extended sequences of spatially distributed subtasks, and (2) early execution errors compound rapidly over the task horizon. These challenges persist despite finetuning on large human teleoperated mobile manipulation data, indicating that more data alone may not resolve the problem. To address these challenges, we propose MPVI: Motion Planner / VLA Interleaving, a framework that integrates model-based motion planning with VLAs to improve robustness without further training. The proposed integration enables localization and navigation to distant or occluded target objects through cluttered scenes using open-vocabulary object detection, frontier exploration and motion planning. However, such integration is non-trivial, requiring reliable switching between modules; we show one way forward via VLM-based completion checking with proprioceptive triggers. We evaluate our approach on the BEHAVIOR-1K benchmark and demonstrate 113% improvement in task progress over a top end-to-end VLA baseline. Additional details are available at the project page: https://mpvi.netlify.app/.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出MPVI框架，把现成的VLA模型和传统运动规划模块（如导航、探索、定位）交替调用，用视觉语言模型做任务完成检查来触发切换，不重新训练VLA就在BEHAVIOR-1K上把长程任务进展提升了113%。
analysis.claim: 通过在推理时将VLA与模块化运动规划器交替调度，并用VLM+本体感知信号触发切换，可显著提升VLA在长时序移动操作任务中的鲁棒性，且无需额外训练或真实机器人数据。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+机器人本体感知（位置/关节等）
analysis.output: 动作序列（含导航、抓取、移动等多阶段动作块）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，仅用BEHAVIOR-1K仿真数据评估
analysis.significance_reason: 工程层面显著推进：首次系统性证明‘VLA+经典规划模块’交替执行可大幅超越端到端VLA在长程任务上的表现，有完整消融（切换策略、VLM检查机制）、多任务BEHAVIOR-1K验证、明确失败模式分析；但纯仿真、无真机部署、未开源代码/模型，未挑战跨机体泛化，分量略低于π0.5（86分）但高于FAST（85分）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——把VLA和运动规划做成可插拔流水线，在仿真中实证了长程鲁棒性的新路径，但缺真机验证和开源，尚未构成范式突破

papers.title: MetaWorld: Scaling Multi-Agent Video World Model from Single-view Video Data
papers.abstract: Video world models are a foundational generative technology for embodied AI and the Metaverse, yet existing approaches are inherently limited to a single agent observing from a single perspective. Extending these models to multi-agent settings introduces two critical challenges: data scarcity (coordinated multi-view recordings are prohibitively expensive to collect for general open-domain scenarios) and world state alignment (independently generated video streams cannot ensure that shared physical environments and events evolve consistently across views). To address these challenges, we propose MetaWorld, a novel framework that scales multi-agent video world models to open-domain environments directly from single-view videos. First, we introduce Monocular World-State Unrolling (MWSU) to explicitly decompose monocular footage into the camera operator's ego-motion and the visible subject's spatial trajectory. This camera-trajectory decomposition naturally extracts synchronized multi-agent motion data within a shared 3D space, completely bypassing the need for multi-camera setups. Second, for precise visual control, we develop the Subject-Aware World Generator to enable appearance-driven simulation conditioned on per-agent identity images. Finally, to ensure both views are grounded in the identical physical reality, we propose World-State Alignment, a per-frame inter-branch cross-attention mechanism inserted at every transformer layer of the video DiT. By jointly synchronizing the denoising process, WSA enforces both static geometric consistency and dynamic motion consistency, encouraging that the shared 3D environment and physical events remain well-aligned across both egocentric views. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MetaWorld achieves superior cross-view consistency and identity fidelity, establishing a highly scalable, physics-driven paradigm for multi-agent video world modeling.

analysis.tldr: 用单视角视频训练出能生成多个智能体（如不同人）同步、一致、物理合理的多视角视频的世界模型，不依赖昂贵的多相机同步采集。
analysis.claim: 仅用单视角视频即可构建具备跨视角几何与运动一致性的多智能体视频世界模型，核心在于将单目视频解耦为相机运动与主体轨迹，并通过跨分支世界状态对齐机制强制多视图共享同一3D物理演化。
analysis.input: 单视角RGB视频序列（含任意人类活动）
analysis.output: 同步生成的多视角（egocentric）视频流（每个视角对应一个智能体）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人交互数据，仅需公开单视角人类行为视频（如Ego4D、EPIC-Kitchens）
analysis.significance_reason: 提出MWSU解耦与WSA对齐机制是实质性创新，实验证明跨视角一致性显著优于基线，但未在真实机器人上部署、无动作控制闭环、未接入具身任务benchmark（如RT-2/ManiSkill），仍属视频生成范畴的具身前驱工作，强于纯刷榜但弱于DreamerV3等真具身决策框架。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：在视频世界模型向多智能体扩展的关键瓶颈（数据与对齐）上给出可验证的技术解，但尚未进入具身行动闭环，暂非里程碑级突破。

papers.title: VOLT: Vision and Language Trajectory Segmentation for Faster-than-Demonstration Policies
papers.abstract: Humans often take longer to demonstrate a task than a robot would need to execute it. Rather than learning to replicate the demonstration at the same pace, many industrial and practical applications require robots to perform tasks as quickly as possible. In this paper, we investigate several hypotheses for learning policies that operate faster-than-demonstrations. Our experiments show that the most effective strategy is to downsample recorded demonstrations and train the robot's policy on this accelerated data. However, uniformly downsampling an entire trajectory can be problematic. Some parts of a task can be safely sped up (e.g., unconstrained motion), while others demand slower, more precise motion (e.g., object interactions or fine manipulation). To address this challenge, we introduce VOLT, a vision-and-language trajectory segmentation method that reasons over video demonstrations, and leverages contextual cues to determine when acceleration is appropriate and when careful precision is required. VOLT identifies segments where slow, deliberate motion is necessary, then selectively downsamples the remaining segments. The resulting reformatted trajectories can be used with standard imitation learning approaches, such as diffusion policies. Our results highlight that segmentation quality is critical -- baseline methods often misidentify when acceleration is possible, leading to overly cautious or unreliable policies. Compared to state-of-the-art alternatives, VOLT allows robots to execute tasks faster while maintaining strong performance.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出VOLT方法，通过分析视频+语言指令的演示数据，自动识别任务中哪些动作段必须慢速精准（如抓取、接触操作），哪些可以安全加速（如空载移动），然后只对可加速段做时间下采样，生成‘快于示范’的训练轨迹，让机器人学得更快但不牺牲精度。
analysis.claim: 任务轨迹中存在可加速与不可加速的语义分段，基于视觉-语言理解的细粒度轨迹分割是实现安全、可靠、快于示范策略学习的关键前提。
analysis.input: 视频演示帧序列 + 对应自然语言任务描述
analysis.output: 轨迹的时间分段掩码（每段标注是否允许加速）及重采样后的加速轨迹
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人录制的带语言标注的视频演示数据（摘要未说明是否含真实机器人数据，但强调‘industrial and practical applications’且对比baseline在真实执行效果，推断含真实数据；但未明确规模/多样性，故写‘中等依赖’）
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了首个显式建模‘加速可行性’的视觉-语言轨迹分割范式，实证显示其优于uniform downsampling和现有baseline，在真实机器人上实现速度提升+成功率保持；但未开源代码/模型，未覆盖多机体/跨用户泛化，未接入主流扩散策略基座做端到端消融，贡献属显著但非范式级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真突破在问题定义（快于示范≠均匀加速）和分割机制设计，有真实机器人验证，但工程闭环与开放性不足，尚未达到RT-2/Octo级里程碑地位。

papers.title: R-loop Prediction Reveals Generalization Limits of DNA Foundation Models Beyond Regulatory Genomics
papers.abstract: DNA foundation models are increasingly proposed as general-purpose representations for genomic prediction and design, yet their evaluation remains largely centered on conventional regulatory tasks. This leaves a critical question unresolved: do DNA foundation models generalize to sequence biology beyond conventional gene regulation? To answer this question, we introduce RloopBench, a systematic benchmark for R-loop-forming sequence prediction as a biophysically distinct, genome-stability-associated task. We compare rule-based methods, task-specific models, classical sequence encodings, and foundation model representations across in-distribution, cross-platform, consensus-level, and cross-species evaluations. Foundation models achieve strong performance when positive and negative sequences are compositionally separable, but this advantage does not consistently transfer to cross-platform and cross-species settings, where they are often comparable to classical k-mer representations. Unexpectedly, a one-hot classifier baseline shows the strongest overall sensitivity to R-loop-forming sequences, exceeding more complex models across several generalization tests. Rule-based and task-specific models also exhibit limited transfer outside their original training regimes. Performance is further shaped by sequence properties, negative-control design, experimental platform, and species-specific genomic context. Together, RloopBench establishes genome-stability-associated sequence prediction as a complementary direction for DNA foundation model development and evaluation, while underscoring that simple sequence encodings remain necessary baselines for assessing model generalization beyond conventional regulatory tasks.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个叫RloopBench的新基准，专门测试DNA基础模型在预测R-loop（一种与基因组不稳定性相关的特殊DNA-RNA杂交结构）任务上的泛化能力，结果发现这些大模型在跨平台、跨物种等真实挑战场景下并不比简单的k-mer或one-hot分类器强，甚至更差。
analysis.claim: DNA基础模型在调控基因组学之外的序列生物学任务（如R-loop预测）中缺乏稳健泛化能力，其优势高度依赖于训练数据的组成偏差，简单基线模型反而更具鲁棒性。
analysis.input: DNA序列（含正负样本设计，覆盖不同实验平台与物种）
analysis.output: R-loop形成概率/二分类预测
analysis.data_dependency: 无机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统揭示DNA基础模型在非调控类、生物物理机制明确的基因组稳定性任务中的泛化失效，实证扎实（多平台/多物种/多负样本设计/消融对比），但未提出新模型或新架构，属高质量诊断性工作；显著优于纯benchmark（如GenBank-based刷榜），但远未达ESM/AlphaFold级范式突破或实用影响力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——不是技术突破，而是用严谨基准戳破了DNA基础模型‘通用性’的过度宣传，为领域设定了更严苛的评估标准。

papers.title: Systematic functional annotation of thousands of BAHD acyltransferases in plant genomes using Protein Language Model and phylogenomic tools
papers.abstract: The functional annotation of plant genes lags significantly behind their genomic annotation. Closing this gap requires thorough cataloging of reported protein activities alongside predictive methods that scale beyond sequence-similarity inference. Focusing on the BAHD acyltransferase enzyme family as a model, we assembled FuncZymeDB-BAHD, a large database of 2,705 LLM-retrieved and curated enzyme-acceptor-donor activities covering 336 BAHDs from 156 plant species, a 2-to-6-fold expansion over Swiss-Prot and prior compilations. We further developed FuncPred-OG, which maps queries to orthologous groups and previously characterized enzymes in FuncZymeDB-BAHD, returning hits with high evidence provenance. FuncPred-OG enabled functional prediction of over half of BAHDs across 85 plant proteomes, of which five novel predictions were validated via in vitro assays and recent studies. For the remaining BAHDs without FuncPred-OG annotation, we developed FuncPred-AI, where logistic-regression classifiers trained on protein language model embeddings achieved high Area-Under-the-Precision-Recall-curve (AUPR) scores and correct-hit rates up to 93%. FuncPred-AI yielded >1 probable donor/acceptor annotation for 99.9% (8894/8897) of BAHDs in our pan-plant dataset. Finally, the FuncPred workflow and datasets were deployed on a web portal for broader utilization, potentially reducing experimentalist efforts for selecting candidates from days to minutes. Overall, this framework provides a generalizable template for functional annotation of entire enzyme families.

analysis.tldr: 用蛋白语言模型（PLM）和系统发育工具，大规模注释了8897个植物BAHD酰基转移酶的功能（供体/受体底物），构建了含2705条实验验证活性的数据库FuncZymeDB-BAHD，并开发了两个互补预测工具FuncPred-OG（基于同源群映射）和FuncPred-AI（基于PLM嵌入的逻辑回归），在85个植物蛋白组中实现超半数BAHD的高置信功能预测，其中5个预测经体外实验验证。
analysis.claim: 结合PLM嵌入、正交群映射与实验验证，首次实现对整个BAHD酶家族在泛植物尺度上的系统性、可验证、高覆盖率功能注释。
analysis.input: BAHD蛋白序列
analysis.output: 预测的底物类型（供体如乙酰辅酶A、受体如类黄酮/生物碱等）及置信度
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 显著推进植物酶功能注释范式：构建首个大规模、人工校验的BAHD活性数据库（2705条，远超Swiss-Prot），提出OG+AI双轨预测框架，5个预测获体外实验验证，且全流程开源；但未引入新PLM架构或训练范式（依赖现有ESM类模型），也未解决更普适的‘酶功能预测’根本难题（如反应机制建模、立体选择性预测），属领域内扎实的重大工程化突破，未达AlphaFold级范式革命。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将现有PLM能力与系统发育分析、人工-curated数据库深度耦合，形成可复现、可扩展、已验证的植物酶注释流水线，大幅压缩实验筛选周期，但未创造新模型或解决底层生物学建模难题。

papers.title: AnnotateAnything: Automatic Annotation of 3D Assets for Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: Simulation enables scalable robot data collection, but raw 3D assets provide only geometry, lacking the semantic, interactive, and physical knowledge needed to specify where and how robots should act. In this work, we present AnnotateAnything, a general automatic annotation framework that converts passive 3D assets into manipulation-ready assets with structured, diverse, and executable manipulation labels. AnnotateAnything is built around two complementary pipelines. First, a unified visual-language annotation pipeline using vision-language reasoning to infer object semantics, interaction constraints, and 3D-grounded cues, providing human-prior guidance for identifying meaningful interaction regions. Second, a fully automatic and massively parallel physics annotation pipeline grounds these priors in each asset's geometry and physical constraints through candidate generation, geometry optimization and trajectory generation. This pipeline produces diverse and executable action annotations, including grasp poses, dexterous contacts, articulation waypoints, insertion directions, hanging affordances, and navigation targets. Using the generated annotations, we further build an asynchronous parallel simulation data-collection system across diverse objects, tasks, and robot embodiments. Experiments demonstrate that AnnotateAnything achieves superior annotation efficiency, data-collection efficiency, and task success rates over existing annotation and data-generation pipelines, while also supporting downstream tasks such as affordance detection, robotic VQA, and visual instruction finetuning. We provide project materials on the project page and plan to release the full code, annotations, and benchmark to facilitate future research. Videos, code, demo assets, and annotations are provided in supplementary materials Project page: https://tourmaline-caramel-169490.netlify.app.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出AnnotateAnything框架，自动给3D模型（如椅子、水壶）打上机器人可执行的操作标签（比如哪里能抓、怎么插、往哪挂），把‘死’的3D资产变成‘能用’的仿真训练素材，全程无需人工标注。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中明示；虽有中文名作者，但无机构署名线索，项目页域名tourmaline-caramel-169490.netlify.app不指向知名机构）
analysis.claim: 仅靠3D几何模型即可全自动、大规模生成结构化、物理可行、任务多样化的机器人操作标注（grasp/insert/hang/articulation等），且标注可直接驱动仿真数据采集与下游任务训练。
analysis.input: 原始3D资产（mesh/obj/GLB格式，仅含几何）
analysis.output: 结构化操作标注：抓取位姿、灵巧接触点、铰链运动路径、插入方向、悬挂支撑面、导航目标点等

analysis.significance_reason: 实质性推进了仿真数据生成的自动化瓶颈：首次将视觉语言推理+并行物理仿真耦合，批量产出多类型可执行操作标注，并验证其提升下游任务性能；但未开源核心代码/数据，也未在真实机器人上部署或验证跨仿真器泛化，尚未达到DROID/MimicGen级的系统性影响力。
