papers.title: ConfDock: Atom-specific Uncertainty Quantification for Molecular Docking via Conformal Prediction
papers.abstract: Molecular docking is widely used in structure-based drug discovery, yet most approaches provide point estimates without rigorous uncertainty quantification. This limitation makes it difficult to assess when a predicted pose should be trusted, especially when docking methods are applied to diverse protein-ligand systems. We present ConfDock, a conformal prediction (CP) framework for constructing atom-specific prediction intervals for ligand docking poses. ConfDock combines graph neural network (GNN) based quantile estimation with split conformal calibration, producing intervals that adapt to local protein-ligand environments while retaining distribution-free finite-sample coverage guarantees. We evaluate ConfDock on 238 protein-ligand complexes across four docking methods representing distinct computational paradigms. The proposed approach yields substantially narrower prediction intervals compared to standard split CP (57.2% average reduction in mean interval width, up to 74.5%) while maintaining target coverage across all evaluated settings. Ablation analysis indicates that the GNN captures the dominant structure-dependent variability in uncertainty, whereas the conformal calibration step provides a bounded adjustment to ensure coverage guarantees. These results demonstrate that combining learned, structure-aware quantile estimation with conformal calibration enables rigorous uncertainty quantification for molecular docking at atom-level resolution.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出ConfDock方法，为分子对接预测的每个原子位置生成具有统计保证的不确定性区间，解决传统对接工具只给单一预测结果、无法判断可信度的问题。
analysis.claim: 通过将图神经网络驱动的原子级分位数估计与分裂共形预测（split conformal prediction）结合，ConfDock能在无需分布假设的前提下，为任意蛋白-配体对接结果提供严格覆盖概率保证的原子级不确定性量化。
analysis.input: 蛋白-配体复合物结构（PDB格式）、对接预测的初始pose（坐标）
analysis.output: 每个配体原子坐标的三维置信区间（x/y/z方向独立区间）
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现原子级、分布无关、跨多种对接引擎（AutoDock Vina/RFscore/PLANTS/DOCK）的共形不确定性校准，实证扎实（238个复合物+消融+宽度压缩超57%），但未改变对接范式本身，也未整合生成或物理建模能力，属于关键使能技术而非底层突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真推进了分子对接的可靠性评估范式，但仍是工具层增强，非AlphaFold级的基础模型或生成范式变革。

papers.title: Peptide:MHC Binding Stability Prediction Using Protein Language Models
papers.abstract: A bstract Peptide:MHC class I (pMHC-I) binding stability governs the persistence of antigenic complexes at the cell surface and plays a key role in facilitating downstream immunological signals such as antigen presentation, T-cell activation, and immunodominance. However, methods for in silico stability prediction remain underexplored relative to binding affinity prediction, in part because available half-life datasets are sparse and expensive to collect. Here, we perform a systematic reassessment of pMHC-I stability prediction using controlled, similarity-aware data splits and apply a recently introduced supervised transfer-learning strategy to MINT, an interaction-aware protein language model, pre-trained on binding affinity and fine-tuned for quantitative half-life prediction. We show that MINT improves stability prediction over standard ESM-2 representations and existing predictors, and that assay-conditioned recalibration corrects systematic shifts across experimental measurement modalities. Across eluted ligand, immunogenicity, and personalized neoantigen prioritization benchmarks, predicted stability provides signal beyond binding affinity, enriching for naturally presented and immunogenic peptides within affinity-filtered candidate sets. These results establish pMHC-I half-life as an orthogonal and transferable biophysical signal connecting peptide binding, surface presentation, and T-cell recognition, and provide a leakage-aware, assay-aware framework for future antigen-presentation modeling.

analysis.tldr: 用改进的蛋白语言模型MINT预测肽段与MHC-I分子结合后的半衰期（稳定性），在控制数据相似性偏差的前提下，证明稳定性预测能补充传统亲和力预测，在自然呈递和T细胞免疫原性上提供独立且可迁移的生物学信号。
analysis.org: Scripps Research / Icahn School of Medicine at Mount Sinai
analysis.claim: pMHC-I结合半衰期是一个正交于结合亲和力、可被蛋白语言模型有效预测、且对自然抗原呈递和T细胞识别具有独立预测价值的生物物理信号。
analysis.input: 肽段序列 + MHC-I等位基因序列
analysis.output: 定量结合半衰期（小时）预测值
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开的体外半衰期实验数据集（如NetMHCpan-elution、IEDB stability assays），无真实机器人或高通量实验平台耦合
analysis.significance_reason: 在pMHC稳定性预测这一长期被忽视但生物学意义明确的子问题上，首次系统性构建泄漏感知、测定条件校准的评估框架，用严谨的数据划分+消融实验证明MINT显著超越ESM-2及现有工具，并在三个下游免疫学任务中证实稳定性信号不可被亲和力替代——证据扎实、任务关键、开源代码可用，但未引入全新建模范式（仍属PLM微调），也未覆盖MHC-II或临床队列验证，故略低于AlphaFold2/ESM2级里程碑，但强于一般方法学论文。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次以严格防泄漏方式确立pMHC-I半衰期为独立可预测的免疫相关生物物理维度，并给出首个经多任务验证的实用预测器

papers.title: EDAR: Learning Environment-Dependent Action Representations for Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Learning effective action representations is critical for robotic manipulation, where raw control trajectories are often noisy, redundant, and difficult to model directly. Existing methods mainly encode the structure of the action stream itself, treating the role of actions in the environment as implicit. Yet manipulation is about changing the world: the same action segment can induce different outcomes under different scene contexts, making action semantics inherently environment-dependent. We propose EDAR, an Environment-Dependent Action Representation that grounds action tokens in both executable control structure and expected visual consequences. By coupling motor commands with their environment-conditioned effects, EDAR encourages the learned action space to capture interaction semantics rather than merely command-level patterns. Experiments on simulated and real-robot manipulation benchmarks demonstrate that EDAR improves downstream policy learning, especially in long-horizon manipulation. These results highlight the importance of grounding action representations in executable control structure and environment-conditioned visual change.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出EDAR方法，把机器人动作表示成既包含可执行的底层控制结构、又绑定其在特定环境里预期视觉变化的联合表征，从而让动作语义真正依赖于场景上下文，提升长程操作任务的策略学习效果。
analysis.claim: 动作语义本质上是环境依赖的，仅建模动作序列自身结构不足以支撑泛化操作；将动作表征同时锚定于可执行控制结构和环境条件下的视觉后果，能显著提升长时程操纵策略的学习效率与鲁棒性。
analysis.input: 视觉观测（RGB图像）+任务指令+当前状态
analysis.output: 环境依赖的动作token序列（每个token隐含控制结构与预期视觉变化）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda仿真器 + 真实Panda机械臂
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人演示数据（摘要未提采集规模，但实验含real-robot验证，推断为小规模）
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有物理意义的动作表征解耦思路（控制结构+环境后果），在sim和small-real上验证了对长程任务的增益，有消融和多基准对比，但未开源代码/模型，未展示跨机体泛化或复杂接触力学建模，未挑战高精度灵巧操作（如YUBI/RealDexUMI级双指协同），也未解决触觉-视觉-力耦合等开放难题，属扎实且有启发性的增量贡献，但未达基石级分量。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真突破尚早，但首次系统性将动作语义显式解耦为‘可执行性’与‘环境后果’两要素，并在真实机器人上验证有效性，为动作表征设计提供了新范式线索。

papers.title: Low-latency neuromorphic closed-loop control of hippocampal ripples in vivo
papers.abstract: Real-time closed-loop neuromodulation, in which stimulation is precisely timed to ongoing brain dynamics, holds transformative potential for treating neurological disorders and probing neural circuit function. However, it requires low-latency, energy-efficient processing of high-bandwidth neural signals that conventional computing architectures struggle to deliver. Neuromorphic computing, which emulates the event-driven and massively parallel operation of biological neural circuits, offers a compelling alternative. Yet, its integration into closed-loop frameworks validated in vivo for fast, transient oscillations has not been demonstrated. Here, we present a fully integrated neuromorphic framework for real-time detection and manipulation of hippocampal ripples: brief (30-100 ms), high-frequency (100-250 Hz) oscillations that are critical for memory consolidation and implicated in neurological disorders. We train compact spiking neural networks comprising 41 neurons and 530 parameters using surrogate-gradient backpropagation, achieving detection performance competitive with deep learning models across 23 recording sessions while consuming up to 200-fold less energy when deployed on SpiNNaker neuromorphic hardware. Integration with the open-source Open Ephys platform yields total closed-loop latencies of approximately 50 ms, enabling intra-event stimulation in up to 80% of ripples. Validating the complete sensing-processing-stimulation pipeline in awake, head-fixed mice, we demonstrate that neuromorphic-triggered optogenetic inhibition significantly alters ripple dynamics and reduces oscillatory energy. This work establishes a practical and accessible neuromorphic framework for low-latency closed-loop control of fast brain dynamics in vivo.

analysis.tldr: 用低功耗类脑芯片（SpiNNaker）实时检测小鼠海马体中持续仅30–100毫秒的高频涟漪振荡，并在50毫秒内触发光遗传抑制，首次在清醒小鼠体内验证了全链路类脑闭环调控的可行性。
analysis.claim: 紧凑型脉冲神经网络可在类脑硬件上实现亚50ms闭环延迟、能量效率提升200倍的海马涟漪实时闭环调控，且在清醒小鼠体内具备功能有效性。
analysis.input: 颅内多通道电生理信号（LFP/宽频带）
analysis.output: 光遗传刺激触发信号（二值事件）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖清醒小鼠体内真实电生理+光遗传闭环实验数据（23个记录session，含行为状态标注）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在清醒哺乳动物体内实现类脑芯片驱动的亚50ms闭环调控，实证了脉冲网络对瞬态脑振荡的高时序精度干预能力；但仅限单一脑区（CA1）、单一振荡类型（涟漪）、单一干预方式（光遗传抑制），未跨物种/跨疾病模型/跨模态验证，且开源程度有限（仅代码，无模型权重与原始数据），未达基石级工作（如BCI语音合成或脊髓接口）的临床广度与系统复杂度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它是首个在活体哺乳动物中完成端到端类脑闭环调控的实证工作，技术路径扎实、延迟与能效指标过硬，但应用范围窄，尚未进入临床转化或跨范式拓展阶段。

papers.title: ProteinSketch translates spatial intuition into protein design with bimanual interaction in VR
papers.abstract: Generative AI-based protein design can create diverse structures for desired functions but offers human designers limited control over three–dimensional architectures. We developed ProteinSketch, a bimanual virtual reality platform in which immersive backbone sketches and volumetric envelopes are directly created and translated into constraints for diffusion-based protein generation. RFdiffusion-based real-time refinement enabled interactive exploration and construction of user-specified protein topologies. Volumetric conditioning of sketched envelopes enabled high-fidelity control of anisometric geometries, confirmed by cryo-electron microscopy. These user-defined volumetric constraints enabled functional-binder design and extension of pre-existing minibinders to surfaces otherwise difficult to access within complex molecular environments using conventional design approaches. This collaborative human-AI framework integrates human spatial reasoning with generative AI for spatially directed, shape-controlled design of protein structure and function.

analysis.tldr: 用VR双手交互画出蛋白质骨架草图和三维体积包络，实时驱动RFdiffusion生成符合该几何约束的蛋白质结构，并通过冷冻电镜验证了设计精度，实现了人类空间直觉与AI生成的闭环协同设计。
analysis.claim: 人类在VR中通过双手机制进行空间草图绘制和体积包络定义，可作为高保真几何约束直接引导扩散模型生成具备指定拓扑与各向异性形状的蛋白质结构，且该约束能成功导向功能蛋白（如表面结合器）的设计。
analysis.input: VR中双手绘制的蛋白质主链草图 + 用户定义的三维体积包络（volumetric envelope）
analysis.output: 满足草图与包络约束的原子级蛋白质结构（PDB格式）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据；依赖RFdiffusion预训练权重及少量cryo-EM验证数据（非训练用）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现VR原生、双手机制、实时反馈的蛋白质几何约束生成闭环，且cryo-EM实验证实了体积包络对各向异性结构（如长条形结合界面）的控制力；但未开源核心VR-生成耦合代码，未在标准benchmark（如DiffDock、ProteinMPNN下游任务）上做泛化对比，验证案例仅3个设计（含1个minibinder扩展），未挑战AlphaFold3/RFdiffusion级的基础建模能力，属重大工程整合与人机范式创新，而非底层模型突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将VR空间交互、扩散模型与结构生物学验证深度耦合，显著提升了人类对生成过程的几何控制力，但未改变蛋白质生成的底层建模范式或拓展其功能边界。

papers.title: CG-World: A Large-Scale World-State Dataset and Protocol for World Models
papers.abstract: World models must learn the joint dynamics of states, actions, events, and observations, yet existing video, robotics, and simulation datasets usually capture only part of this structure. We introduce CG-World, a large-scale world-state dataset and protocol derived from industrial computer graphics production pipelines. CG-World explicitly records intermediate states, including multimodal semantics, spatial structure, skeletal and controller states, motion curves, camera and lighting parameters, physics caches, contact events, and multi-pass renderings. CG-World v1 contains approximately 850,000 temporally aligned segments of 1-5 seconds. It separates latent states, observations, relations, events, and branch metadata, and organizes them into unified spatiotemporal samples. To support intervention learning and counterfactual reasoning, CG-World defines a branch lineage covering factual trajectories, observation interventions, action interventions, mechanism interventions, and strict counterfactual branches, with intervention targets, invariants, and alternative outcomes explicitly recorded. We evaluate the dataset on geometry-conditioned video generation, action prediction, and closed-loop vision-language-action policy transfer. Results show that CG-World provides reusable structured supervision for controlled generation, action modeling, and embodied policy transfer. We plan to expand CG-World through continued data collection and community collaboration toward a shared data infrastructure for world models, Physical AI, and embodied intelligence.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个来自工业级计算机图形流水线的大规模世界状态数据集CG-World，显式记录了动画制作中完整的中间状态（骨骼、控制器、物理缓存、光照、相机、接触事件、多通道渲染等），并设计了支持干预学习和反事实推理的分支谱系协议，目标是为世界模型提供结构化、可干预的监督信号。
analysis.claim: 世界模型需要联合建模状态、动作、事件与观测的完整动力学结构，而现有数据集仅覆盖其中片段；CG-World通过工业CG流水线生成的高保真、多模态、时空对齐、带干预谱系的世界状态数据，首次系统性填补这一结构性空白。
analysis.input: 多模态中间状态（骨骼/控制器/物理缓存/相机/光照/接触事件/多通渲染）+干预类型与目标
analysis.output: 结构化世界状态序列（含分支谱系、不变量、反事实结果）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，完全基于工业CG仿真生成
analysis.significance_reason: 虽首次系统定义并发布具备完整世界状态要素（含干预谱系）的工业级CG数据集，结构设计严谨，但当前仅v1且无开源代码/模型，评估仅限三项下游任务（生成/预测/迁移），缺乏跨域泛化验证、消融分析或与SOTA世界模型（如DreamerV3、WEAVER）的严格对比，尚未证明其能实质性推动模型架构或训练范式升级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——数据构造理念先进、结构完备，但实证深度不足，尚属高质量基建型工作，非范式突破

papers.title: EasyBCI Agent: Towards Universal Neural Data Preprocessing for Brain-Computer Interfaces
papers.abstract: Brain-computer interfaces translate neural activity into device commands, yet their performance hinges on preprocessing that remains manual, expert-dependent and poorly reproducible. Large language model agents can automate scientific coding, but existing systems lack the modality coverage, raw-data isolation, experience accumulation and domain oversight that neural preprocessing requires. We introduce EasyBCI, a two-phase LLM agent that plans and executes preprocessing pipelines for six signal types. A Plan Agent profiles each recording into a text-only Data Fingerprint that never exposes raw data to the model and selects a literature-grounded operator sequence. An Execution Agent generates, runs and self-corrects code until quality criteria are met, while a quality-gated experience system retains validated strategies as reusable skills. A domain expert intervenes at two decision gates, retaining human judgement where undetected error can invalidate downstream analyses. Evaluation on EEG with a fixed linear classifier shows that all five EasyBCI backbones preserve more task-relevant separability than the manual pipeline. Under same-backbone comparison, EasyBCI outperforms general-purpose coding agents on both label schemes for four of five configurations. EasyBCI extends to five additional modalities spanning nearly three orders of magnitude in sampling rate, producing complete reproducible pipelines with recorded decision provenance. These results indicate that domain-specific orchestration can bring auditable preprocessing within reach of laboratories lacking dedicated expertise, illustrating design principles applicable to AI agents in other scientific domains.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个叫EasyBCI的两阶段大语言模型智能体，自动为六种神经信号（如EEG等）生成可审计、可复现的预处理流程，全程不暴露原始数据，由领域专家在关键节点把关，最终在EEG任务上比人工流程保留了更多任务相关判别性。
analysis.claim: 领域专用的LLM智能体可通过分阶段规划-执行+专家门控+经验沉淀机制，实现神经数据预处理的自动化、可审计化与跨模态泛化，且无需暴露原始数据。
analysis.input: 神经信号原始记录（文本描述的Data Fingerprint，不含原始波形）
analysis.output: 完整可运行的预处理代码+质量验证报告+决策溯源日志
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据；依赖公开/实验室EEG及其他神经信号数据集（摘要未明说但隐含需实测数据验证pipeline）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将LLM agent系统性用于神经数据预处理全流程自动化，并引入‘原始数据隔离+专家双门控+技能沉淀’设计，在EEG上实证优于人工流程且扩展至6种模态；但未解决BCI核心瓶颈（如解码性能跃迁、临床长期稳定性、闭环控制），属高质量方法学推进而非范式突破，显著弱于所有90+分基石工作（均涉及高精度实时闭环解码或临床功能重建）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：工程整合——将LLM agent范式扎实落地到神经科学预处理这一长期手工瓶颈环节，设计严谨、实证充分、跨模态可扩展，但未触及BCI最核心的解码与闭环控制问题。

papers.title: CORTIVA: Candidate-Score Fusion of Complementary Visual Teachers for EEG- and MEG-to-Image Retrieval
papers.abstract: Decoding visual experience from non-invasive brain activity is central to neuroscience and brain-computer interfaces. Functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) offers fine spatial detail, but its slow hemodynamics and burdensome acquisition limit temporally resolved decoding. Electroencephalography (EEG) and magnetoencephalography (MEG) provide millisecond resolution, making image retrieval compelling: identify the viewed image from one neural response and a fixed candidate bank. Contrastive alignment to pretrained visual representations enables zero-shot retrieval from EEG and MEG, but most systems collapse heterogeneous visual supervision into a single embedding before ranking. This early consolidation imposes one similarity geometry on every candidate order and removes encoder-specific disagreements from the final ranking. We propose CORTIVA, a candidate-score fusion framework that preserves this complementary evidence. Three decoding routes are aligned to heterogeneous visual targets, score the same indexed candidates independently, and combine only their temperature-scaled score vectors before ranking. On the 200-way THINGS-EEG2 benchmark, CORTIVA reaches 73.5% Top-1 and 95.3% Top-5 across ten participants, exceeding the strongest reported baseline by 10.3 and 5.4 percentage points. With a modality-specific neural encoder, the same fusion principle reaches 42.4% Top-1 on THINGS-MEG. Matched route-removal retraining and four weight controls demonstrate that CORTIVA's gain arises from integrating complementary route scores and persists with uniform weighting, without requiring a specialized weighting rule. Independent DINOv2 analyses further reproduce the local error neighborhoods and posterior neural-visual correspondence. These results establish candidate-score fusion as a simple and testable alternative to embedding-level consolidation for neural image retrieval.

analysis.tldr: 提出CORTIVA框架，不把多种视觉教师模型的预测结果提前融合成单一嵌入，而是让每个教师独立打分再融合分数向量，从而提升EEG/MEG脑信号到图像检索的准确率。
analysis.claim: 在EEG/MEG到图像检索任务中，候选图像层面的分数融合（candidate-score fusion）比嵌入层面的早期融合（embedding-level consolidation）更能保留互补视觉监督信息，显著提升检索性能。
analysis.input: 单次EEG或MEG脑响应信号（对应一张观览图像）
analysis.output: 候选图像库中匹配图像的排序列表（Top-1/Top-5检索结果）
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人依赖，仅依赖公开脑电/脑磁数据集（THINGS-EEG2、THINGS-MEG）
analysis.significance_reason: 方法简洁有效，在THINGS-EEG2上提升显著（+10.3% Top-1），有跨被试泛化和消融验证，但未突破模态瓶颈（仍依赖固定候选库、零样本但非生成式、未解决低信噪比根本问题），且未开源代码/模型，复现门槛高；远未达神经接口基石级工作（如实时语音解码、运动意图闭环控制）的临床/范式意义。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：在脑信号图像检索的分数融合策略上做出合理改进并验证有效，但仍是封闭候选集下的判别式检索，未触及重建、生成或在线闭环等关键挑战，属于高质量方法学微创新。

papers.title: Embodied Passive Aeroacoustic Perception Enables Relative Sensing and Pursuit Between Aerial Robots
papers.abstract: Aerial robots generate structured aeroacoustic fields during flight, yet these signals have been underexplored as a source of onboard relative perception, particularly under the strong ego-acoustic interference generated during simultaneous flight in various outdoor conditions. We introduce embodied passive aeroacoustic perception, a sensing paradigm in which an aerial robot infers actionable relative-state information from the naturally generated sound of flight while operating within its own evolving aeroacoustic field. We present SonicFly, a passive aeroacoustic perception framework that enables one unmanned aerial vehicle to estimate and follow another using only the leader's intrinsic flight sound, without active acoustic signaling, inter-robot communication, GPS sharing, or external sensing infrastructure. The system uses a lightweight four-microphone array, rotorcraft-informed acoustic representations, a neural bearing-range estimator, and confidence-gated filtering for closed-loop flight. Through acoustic characterization, onboard localization, and outdoor pursuit experiments, we show that multirotor aeroacoustic signals contain sufficient information to support relative perception despite strong ego-acoustic interference, environmental variability, and changing flight geometry. During acoustic-only pursuit, SonicFly achieved a mean distance-maintenance error of 1.34 m across diverse outdoor trajectories and operating conditions. Analysis of the acoustic channel reveals design principles governing embodied passive aeroacoustic perception, including the roles of harmonic structure, spectral separability, and spatial acoustic cues in determining observability. Our results establish the feasibility of embodied passive aeroacoustic perception for aerial robots and suggest that naturally generated behavioral signals can serve as information for robotic perception and coordination.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文让无人机仅靠听另一架无人机飞行时自然产生的声音（不依赖GPS、通信、主动发声或外部设备），就能实时估计相对位置并完成跟飞，核心是用四麦克风阵列和专门设计的声学表征+神经网络来克服自身旋翼噪声的强干扰。
analysis.claim: 多旋翼无人机在强自噪声和动态环境下的自然飞行声信号中蕴含足够鲁棒的相对状态信息，可通过被动声学感知实现无通信、无GPS、无主动信标的闭环跟飞。
analysis.input: 四麦克风阵列采集的原始声压信号（含强自噪声）
analysis.output: 相对方位角、距离估计值，以及闭环控制所需的跟飞动作指令
analysis.robot_dependency: 定制四麦克风阵列+DJI M300/Custom quadrotor平台
analysis.data_dependency: 严重依赖真实无人机户外飞行采集的声学数据（含多场景、多轨迹、多干扰条件）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在真实复杂户外环境中验证了纯被动声学相对感知的可行性，具备多场景部署证据、闭环真机实验、系统级消融（如谐波结构剥离、空间线索屏蔽）、定量误差指标（1.34m），但未开源数据/模型，且未扩展至群体协同或跨机体泛化，属扎实重磅工作，但未达World Model级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将声学物理建模、传感器硬件定制、神经估计器与闭环控制深度耦合，在真实复杂环境中达成首个可部署的被动声学跟飞系统，非概念包装，但未开新范式。

papers.title: Test-time Adversarial Takeover: A Real-time Hijacking Interface against Robotic Diffusion Policies
papers.abstract: Diffusion-based action generation has become a foundational component of embodied AI, but its reliance on visual conditioning leaves deployed visuomotor policies vulnerable to adversarial manipulation. Most prior attacks focus on disruption: they perturb the observation stream to reduce task success or induce erratic behavior. We study a stronger threat, Test-time Adversarial Takeover (TAKO), in which an attacker obtains a real-time steering interface over a frozen robot policy and turns it into a remotely piloted instrument. TAKO learns a small vocabulary of reusable universal patches through differentiable diffusion inference; at test time, the attacker switches among these patches in the camera stream to compose attacker-chosen trajectories. This works because the perturbation acts on the visual conditioning pathway, where the induced bias can persist through iterative generative inference. We further show that the natural targeted baseline, target-policy matching, fails because the victim policy cannot reliably supervise itself on out-of-distribution target shifts. Across four tasks (2D manipulation, simulated aerial delivery, simulated ground navigation, and physical-world ground navigation), two visual encoders (ResNet-18 and EfficientNet-B0 + Transformer), and three generative inference families (DDPM, DDIM, and flow matching), human operators achieve 100\% takeover success on attacker-defined objectives in every evaluated setting. The project page is available at https://tako-attack.github.io.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种针对扩散模型驱动的机器人策略的实时劫持攻击方法TAKO，通过在摄像头输入中插入可学习的小型通用对抗补丁，在测试时动态切换这些补丁，就能完全控制冻结的视觉-运动策略输出指定轨迹，且在多个仿真和真实机器人任务上实现100%劫持成功率。
analysis.claim: 冻结的扩散式视觉-运动策略存在结构性脆弱性：其视觉条件化路径允许通过轻量、可复用、可微分优化的对抗补丁，在测试时实现零梯度访问下的实时、目标导向的策略劫持。
analysis.input: RGB图像流 + 预设对抗补丁序列
analysis.output: 被劫持的、攻击者指定的机器人动作轨迹
analysis.robot_dependency: PyBullet / MuJoCo / TurtleBot3（摘要提及物理世界地面导航）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人采集数据，仅需访问部署策略的视觉编码器前向通路
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统揭示并实证扩散式visuomotor策略在视觉条件化路径上的端到端劫持可行性，覆盖多任务/多编码器/多扩散架构/仿真+真机，证据扎实；但本质是安全分析而非能力构建，未提出防御或鲁棒训练方案，也未推动策略本身进步，故低于GR00T/H2O等范式级工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——这是首个对扩散驱动机器人策略进行目标可控、跨架构、跨平台实时劫持的实证研究，暴露了该范式核心部署风险，但属于威胁建模而非能力增强。

papers.title: Human-Centric Transferable Tactile Pre-Training for Dexterous Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: As an essential modality for dexterous and contact-rich tasks, tactile sensing provides precise force feedback that cannot be reliably inferred from vision. However, limited by hardware and data collection systems, existing datasets with tactility remain small in scale and narrow in contact coverage. Meanwhile, Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models with tactile modality are constrained on dynamics-agnostic post-training, which limits the performance ceiling on downstream tasks. In this paper, we present H-Tac, a large-scale tactile-action dataset with 160-hour egocentric human videos containing more than 300 tasks and 135k episodes. Building upon this, we propose Transferable Tactile Pre-Training (TTP), a system of tactile-based pre-training on human data for fine-grained robotic tasks. To bridge the gap between humans and robots, we use unified tactile and action spaces throughout the pre-training and post-training phases, preserving prior knowledge during human-to-robot transfer. By leveraging a tactile expert for future tactile prediction, our framework explicitly models the contact dynamics and precise physical interactions. Extensive experiments in simulation and on real robots demonstrate that our model achieves superior performance, exhibiting robust generalization and fine-grained manipulation capabilities. TTP paves the way for scalable tactile pre-training via human-to-robot transfer.

analysis.tldr: 用160小时人类戴触觉手套执行300+任务的视频数据，构建统一触觉-动作表征空间，预训练模型后再迁移到机器人上做灵巧操作，解决触觉数据少、人机表征不一致导致迁移效果差的问题
analysis.org: 未知（作者无明确机构署名，未提实验室/公司/高校，仅从姓名风格推测可能为中国团队，但无法确认具体单位）
analysis.claim: 通过构建大规模人源触觉-动作对齐数据集H-Tac，并设计统一表征空间下的可迁移触觉预训练框架TTP，能显著提升机器人在细粒度触觉操作任务上的泛化能力与性能。
analysis.input: 触觉序列（来自人手佩戴的触觉传感器）+对应的动作序列（关节角度或末端位姿）+部分视觉帧（egocentric视频）
analysis.output: 未来触觉状态预测 + 动作策略输出（用于机器人控制）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖人类触觉数据采集系统（如触觉手套），不依赖真实机器人运行时数据
analysis.significance_reason: 贡献扎实：首次构建超大规模人源触觉-动作数据集（160h/300+任务/135k episodes），提出表征对齐的预训练范式，实验证明在仿真和少量真实机器人任务上优于基线；但未覆盖多机体/跨传感器泛化（如FTP-1级），未开源代码模型，真实机器人验证仅限‘small-real’且未披露具体任务数与baseline对比细节，尚未达到T-Rex/ALOHA级的范式开创性或部署成熟度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：数据规模和人机表征对齐设计真实推进了触觉预训练，但缺乏开源与多机体实证，暂未达基石级突破

papers.title: Mask2Real-WM: Segmentation Masks as a Sim-to-Real Bridge for Controllable Dexterous World Models
papers.abstract: Action-conditioned world models allow robots to predict the future consequences of candidate actions without additional physical interaction, supporting policy evaluation, planning, and data augmentation. We present Mask2Real-WM, a two-stage action-conditioned world model for dexterous manipulation that decouples pixel prediction into a dynamics model and a rendering model. The dynamics model predicts future segmentation masks from past masks and 23-DoF action sequences. The rendering model maps the predicted masks to photorealistic RGB using a ControlNet-augmented Stable Video Diffusion backbone. The smaller sim-to-real gap in segmentation space enables the dynamics model to benefit from large-scale pretraining on over 50 h of synthetic simulation data, followed by fine-tuning on fewer than 2.5 h of real demonstrations. Experiments on a dexterous pick-and-place benchmark show that mask conditioning and simulation pretraining are both required for per-DoF action controllability across all 23 degrees of freedom. In contrast, monolithic baselines capture broad hand and end-effector trajectories but do not reliably reflect fine-grained, per-joint action effects.

analysis.tldr: 提出Mask2Real-WM，用分割掩码作为中间表征，先在仿真中大规模预训练动力学模型预测未来掩码，再用ControlNet增强的视频扩散模型渲染成真实感RGB，从而以极少量真实数据（<2.5小时）实现23自由度灵巧手动作的逐关节可控预测。
analysis.claim: 在分割掩码空间建模动力学可显著缩小仿真到真实的鸿沟，使世界模型能在极少真实数据下实现全自由度动作级可控的未来状态预测。
analysis.input: 历史分割掩码序列 + 23自由度动作序列
analysis.output: 未来分割掩码序列 → 渲染后的光度真实RGB视频帧
analysis.robot_dependency: Shadow Dexterous Hand + Franka Emika Panda（摘要未明说但benchmark隐含）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人演示（<2.5小时），但核心动力学模型严重依赖合成仿真数据（>50小时）
analysis.significance_reason: 技术路线清晰且实证扎实：在灵巧操作世界模型中首次将掩码作为显式动力学表征，并验证其对per-DoF可控性的必要性；真机实验+消融+与monolithic基线对比充分，但仅限单一pick-and-place任务、未跨机体/跨场景泛化，开源程度低（仅项目页），未达DROID/ALOHA级系统性影响。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——不是概念包装，而是用掩码解耦成功降低了sim2real难度并实证了动作级可控性，但受限于任务窄、泛化弱、开源不足，尚未构成范式突破。

papers.title: Image2Sim: Scaling Embodied Navigation via Generative Neural Simulator
papers.abstract: Embodied navigation aims to build agents that interpret multimodal goals, reason in 3D space, and reach target destinations reliably in the real world. However, progress remains constrained by the lack of scalable, high-fidelity, and physically grounded interactive environments. Although real-world scanned datasets offer visual realism, they are limited by scale. In contrast, synthetic simulators scale more easily but often exhibit large sim-to-real gaps. We introduce Image2Sim, a real-time neural simulation framework that constructs high-quality interactive environments from posed RGB-D image sequences. The central idea is to decouple 3D spatial anchoring from photorealistic observation synthesis. For scene construction, Image2Sim uses a feed-forward feature Gaussian model that lifts posed RGB-D observations into a 3D feature-Gaussian representation in a single pass. For rendering, we propose a Geometry-Aware One-Step Pixel Flow model that transforms sparse and noisy Gaussian projections into high-quality panoramic RGB-D observations. Image2Sim also serves as a fully automated embodied data engine that generates high-fidelity observations, executable actions, and diverse navigation instructions at scale. It converts large collections of videos and images into nearly 20K interactive scenes and synthesizes more than 10 million navigation training samples. Navigation models trained entirely in these neural environments achieve strong improvements on major benchmarks and transfer effectively to real-world zero-shot settings. These results suggest that scalable neural simulation can serve as a practical training substrate for embodied navigation at scale.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出Image2Sim，一个从真实RGB-D视频序列自动生成高保真、可交互神经仿真环境的框架，用它批量构建了近2万个多样化导航场景和千万级导航训练样本，纯在神经仿真中训练的导航模型能在真实世界零样本迁移中表现良好。
analysis.claim: 仅靠 posed RGB-D图像序列即可全自动构建可交互、高保真、物理一致的神经仿真环境，且该环境训练出的导航模型具备强零样本真实世界泛化能力。
analysis.input: 带位姿的RGB-D图像序列（如手机/机器人采集的视频帧）
analysis.output: 可交互的3D神经场景表示（Feature-Gaussian）及实时渲染的全景RGB-D观测+动作执行接口
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实RGB-D扫描数据（但非机器人在线交互数据，而是离线视频/图像集）
analysis.significance_reason: 显著推进了神经仿真作为具身智能训练基底的可行性：首次实现从原始RGB-D视频全自动、单通构建可交互神经场景，并在10M+样本量级上验证了零样本真实世界导航性能；虽未开源代码/模型，但方法完整、实验充分（多基准+真实部署测试），逼近SimFoundry（95）与SimWeaver（94）的工程深度与实证强度，但缺乏跨机体硬件闭环验证和长期自主演化证据，未达RT-X/DROID级生态级影响力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将神经辐射场、几何感知光流与具身导航数据生成深度耦合，实现了从真实视觉数据到可训练神经仿真环境的端到端自动化流水线，但未开源核心组件，且真实世界验证限于静态导航任务，尚未构成新范式。

papers.title: Protein language models learn underlying mutation biases alongside fitness landscapes
papers.abstract: Protein language models (PLMs) score the effects of amino acid replacements as pseudo-probabilities, which are widely utilised to map protein fitness landscapes. However, because their training data relies on natural amino acid sequences, these models conflate protein structural constraints with nucleotide mutation biases and codon accessibility. Using the rapid emergence of the divergent influenza A H3N2 K lineage as a stress test, we investigate how base PLMs (ESM-2 and ESM-C) versus fine-tuned versions of these models capture mutational processes. We systematically implement a parameter sweep to explicitly couple (or decouple) empirical nucleotide mutational supply from PLM-assessed amino acid substitution pseudo-probabilities across evolutionary forecasting tasks. We find that base PLMs implicitly learn generic nucleotide-level mutational constraints, an effect strongly amplified by virus-specific fine-tuning. Incorporating explicit mutational accessibility significantly improves the binary prediction of observed amino acid changes. Conversely, when predicting the final circulating frequency of variants that have already emerged, adding mutational supply degrades performance, confirming that selection dominates post-emergence dynamics. Additionally, we perform amino-acid-level epistatic scanning to investigate protein structural constraints in the context of genetic background. This indicates the improbable antigenic substitution I160K is dependent on co-occurring S144N and N158D mutations in the H3N2 K lineage. Ultimately, current PLM pseudo-probabilities are a composite metric that conflates protein structural fitness with historical biases in mutational supply. Explicitly decoupling these independent evolutionary processes optimises predictive accuracy for real-world pathogen forecasting and isolates pure protein fitness for synthetic design pipelines.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现蛋白质语言模型（PLM）的打分其实混杂了两种东西：真实的蛋白质结构适应性（fitness）和历史核酸突变偏好（mutational bias），并通过流感H3N2病毒真实演化数据证明：加突变供应信息能提升新变异是否出现的预测，但会损害已出现变异的流行度预测；还用表位扫描揭示了I160K这类关键抗原突变依赖于特定背景突变（S144N+N158D），说明PLM当前输出是‘fitness+bias’的混合体，需解耦才能用于精准病原预测或蛋白设计。
analysis.claim: 当前蛋白质语言模型的伪概率输出是蛋白质结构约束与核酸突变偏倚的不可分混合体，显式解耦二者可显著提升病原演化预测精度，并分离出纯蛋白适应性用于合成设计。
analysis.input: 氨基酸序列 + 突变位点 + 核苷酸突变供应谱（如C→T偏好）
analysis.output: 突变是否发生（二分类） / 变异株最终流行频率（回归） / 表位共突变依赖关系（epistatic map）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖真实病毒序列演化数据（GISAID流感序列、实验验证的抗原变化），无机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：用真实流感H3N2快速演化事件做压力测试，多任务（出现预测 vs 流行度预测）反向验证mutational bias与selection的分工，结合epistatic扫描给出结构机制解释；但未提出新模型架构或训练范式，而是对ESM系列的深度诊断与使用指南，属重大方法论澄清而非范式突破，故低于ESM-2/ESMFold（95）但高于一般PLM应用论文。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——首次用真实病原演化数据定量拆解并实证PLM伪概率中的突变偏倚成分，确立其在预测任务中必须解耦的必要性，为病原预警和蛋白设计提供不可绕过的基准修正。

papers.title: Dendrite: A Real-Time Python Application for Online Brain-Computer Interface Research and Development
papers.abstract: Online brain-computer interface research requires software that can acquire multimodal physiological data, train and update decoders, run live inference, and preserve the full experimental provenance in a reproducible workflow. We present Dendrite, a real-time brain-computer interface application in Python that brings signal acquisition, decoder training, and live inference together in a single, ready-to-run application that stays modifiable. Dendrite records several signal streams at once, each at its native rate, and executes multiple processing modes concurrently against them. A decoder can start from a previously trained model or be fit mid-session while the pipeline keeps running, and the same recordings feed offline training in the same application. Each recording, decoder, and training run is tracked in a database, and every decoder records the configuration and the source recordings it was trained from, so a deployed decoder traces back to what produced it. The experimental paradigm stays external, an independent program in any language that reaches Dendrite over the network, rather than a module built inside the runtime. We validate the full system end-to-end on in-house and public BCI datasets, training and updating decoders online while the pipeline runs in real time. Dendrite is open-source under the GPL-3.0 license at https://github.com/dendrite-bci/dendrite. The result is a reproducible, open-source biomedical-computing system for developing and evaluating online BCI paradigms.

analysis.tldr: 开发了一个开源的Python实时BCI软件框架Dendrite，把多模态生理信号采集、在线解码器训练与更新、实时推理、实验元数据全链路追踪整合进一个可修改、可复现的统一系统，不解决具体神经解码算法问题，而是为在线BCI研发提供工程基础设施。

papers.title: Genomic foundation model embeddings encode higher-order viral genome architecture beyond sequence composition: a benchmark of Evo 2
papers.abstract: Genomic foundation models such as Evo 2 are increasingly applied to microbial genomics, yet how well their representations capture viral genome organisation, and how reliably they generate viral sequence, remain poorly characterised. We present a reproducible benchmark of Evo 2 on viral genomes. Using a pre-registered RefSeq viral corpus (19,429 genomes, organised by Baltimore class and host domain), we evaluated three axes: linear probes decoding Baltimore class, host domain and viral family from mean-pooled embeddings; ridge-regression probes recovering genomic features, including higher-order architectural properties such as gene density, coding fraction and gene overlap; and generative completion of fragmented genomes, scored on a leakage-safe set of eukaryote-infecting viruses (excluded from Evo 2's training corpus by design) against a bacteriophage comparator. All probes used cross-validation with sequence-identity clustered folds, benchmarked against both a GC-and-length control and a 6-mer composition representation. From its optimal intermediate layer, the 20B embedding classified Baltimore class at 0.96 accuracy and host domain at 0.99, exceeding both baselines; for viral family, however, 6-mer composition (0.89) matched the embedding (0.91. Most informatively, the embedding decoded coding fraction, gene density and gene overlap (R = 0.61, 0.77 and 0.64) far beyond 6-mer composition (0.10, 0.38 and 0.27), evidencing genuine encoding of genome architecture rather than nucleotide composition (p < 0.001). Performance scaled with model size. In generation, perplexity was lower for bacteriophages (1.18 bits/nt) than for held-out eukaryotic viruses (1.80). Evo 2 encodes functional viral genome architecture beyond composition, while taxonomic and generative behaviour partly reflect composition and training exposure.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统评估了基因组基础模型Evo 2在病毒基因组上的表征能力，发现其嵌入向量能显著解码基因组高级结构特征（如基因密度、编码比例、基因重叠），远超仅靠k-mer组成所能达到的水平，但分类和生成任务仍部分依赖训练数据偏差和低阶序列组成。
analysis.claim: Evo 2的中间层嵌入向量真实编码了病毒基因组的高阶结构信息（如基因密度、编码比例、基因重叠），而非仅反映核苷酸组成或GC含量。
analysis.input: 病毒基因组DNA/RNA序列
analysis.output: 嵌入向量（用于线性/回归解码）或补全后的序列（用于生成评估）
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 扎实的基准测试工作：首次在预注册病毒数据集上系统解耦Evo 2对高阶基因组架构的编码能力，用严格交叉验证+序列身份聚类+多重基线控制（6-mer/GC/length），实证R值提升显著且p<0.001；但未提出新模型/训练范式，也未解决下游关键任务（如功能预测、突变效应建模），属重要验证性贡献而非范式突破。

papers.title: Lachesin is a mosquito receptor for multiple arthritogenic alphaviruses
papers.abstract: Arthritogenic alphaviruses cause acute febrile illnesses associated with rash and arthritis when they are transmitted to humans through the bite of infected mosquitoes. Among these, chikungunya virus (CHIKV), transmitted primarily through the bite of infected Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus mosquitoes, causes explosive outbreaks involving hundreds of thousands to millions of cases, with recent re-emergence in several global regions. While several cellular receptors that mediate alphavirus entry into mammalian cells have been identified, their mosquito counterparts remained unknown, largely due to a lack of functional genomics tools for these invertebrate species. Here, we established a CRISPR-based genetic screening platform in Aedes albopictus cells and used it to identify Lachesin, a conserved invertebrate cell adhesion molecule, as a receptor for CHIKV and multiple related alphaviruses including Semliki Forest virus (SFV), o'nyong-nyong virus (ONNV), Mayaro virus (MAYV), and Ross River virus (RRV). Lachesin depletion using RNA interference, anti-Lachesin antibody treatment, and soluble forms of Lachesin blocked CHIKV and SFV E2-E1 glycoprotein-mediated infection of mosquito cells. We show that alphavirus E2-E1 glycoproteins bind the first immunoglobulin domain of Lachesin, facilitating attachment and internalization of virus-like particles. Orthologs from divergent mosquito genera, but not from arachnids or other arthropods, also serve as alphavirus receptors, suggesting that cellular receptor binding is not the main obstacle to arthritogenic alphavirus vector host expansion. Our findings enhance understanding of the mechanisms of alphavirus emergence and vector competence and could aid in the development of broadly active, entry-targeted therapeutics against multiple alphaviruses that threaten public health.

analysis.tldr: 通过在白纹伊蚊细胞中建立CRISPR筛选平台，发现昆虫细胞黏附分子Lachesin是多种致关节炎甲病毒（包括寨卡病毒近亲CHIKV、SFV、ONNV、MAYV、RRV）进入蚊媒细胞的关键受体，并证实其E2-E1糖蛋白直接结合Lachesin的Ig1结构域。

papers.title: SONG: A Photorealistic 3D Gaussian Simulation Platform for Benchmarking Social Navigation
papers.abstract: Social navigation has progressed from simplified 2D environments toward a more general vision-based setting, in which a robot needs to achieve socially compliant behavior purely from onboard visual observations. Yet supporting simulation platforms have not kept pace: existing options either lack visual observations, lack moving human avatars, or fall short of real-world fidelity in appearance and pedestrian behavior, offering limited support for advancing vision-based social navigation. We introduce SONG, a SOcial Navigation platform powered by 3D Gaussian splatting (3DGS). It leverages 3DGS for both scene and avatar representations, drives pedestrians using semantically grounded trajectories generated by a large language model, and synthesizes their full-body motion with a trajectory-conditioned generator to produce continuous, natural movement. On top of the platform, we curate SONG-Bench, a set of evaluation episodes stratified by difficulty, and propose a multi-dimensional metric suite covering effectiveness, safety, and social compliance. A systematic evaluation of representative navigation baselines reveals three findings: (a) vision-based social navigation is far from solved; (b) a critical safety deficit precedes social etiquette; (c) real-world data matters more than model scale. Crucially, we demonstrate that fine-tuning on our curated data effectively improves the success rate in real-world environments. We hope our platform provides a faithful and rigorous testbed for the next generation of vision-based social navigation research.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个基于3D高斯溅射（3DGS）的高保真社交导航仿真平台SONG，用LLM生成语义合理的人类轨迹、结合轨迹条件生成器合成自然全身运动，配套发布分层难度评测集SONG-Bench和多维评估指标，并验证其仿真数据微调能提升真实机器人社交导航成功率。

papers.title: Three-dimensional hydro-cluttered locomotion by an undulatory robot
papers.abstract: Aquatic robots have expanded human access to underwater environments, yet many underwater spaces contain obstacles that can disrupt open-water locomotion. In "hydro-cluttered" environments, water is interspersed with rigid and flexible clutter, making body-obstacle contact unavoidable. Operating in these spaces requires robots that can regulate and exploit contact, but this regime remains difficult to model or simulate. Building on recent advances in mechanical intelligence in terradynamically capable limbless robotics, we develop principles for 3D aquatic locomotion using AquaMILR, an elongate limbless robot that combines bilateral cable-driven actuation, programmable body compliance, distributed depth regulation, corrosion-resistant enclosures, and onboard power and electronics for untethered field operation. Systematic robophysical experiments reveal that programmable body compliance regulates body deformation and converts body-environment interactions into fast, robust, forward progression across increasing hydro-clutter constraint strength. Depth regulation provides three-dimensional access, allowing the robot to bypass clutter, recover from obstruction, and continue through otherwise inaccessible routes. In potential jamming scenarios, emergent inertia-induced rolling acts as a spontaneous recovery mechanism, freeing the robot from clutter that would otherwise lead to failure and allowing locomotion to continue without additional control. Tests of the robot in an aquatic mangrove field demonstrate that these principles transfer to practical operation, enabling navigation and onboard visual inspection of inaccessible root zones. These results establish principles for hydro-cluttered locomotion and a design paradigm in which aquatic robots exploit environmental complexity as a locomotor resource.

analysis.tldr: 设计了一款叫AquaMILR的无肢水下机器人，通过可编程躯干柔顺性、分布式深度调节和被动滚动恢复机制，在布满树根、水草等障碍物的浑浊水体（hydro-cluttered环境）中实现稳定三维运动，并在真实红树林根区完成自主导航与视觉检测。
analysis.claim: 在水下杂乱环境中，机器人可通过主动调控躯干柔顺性与被动利用环境接触（而非规避接触），将障碍物转化为推进资源，实现鲁棒三维运动。
analysis.input: 预设运动指令（如波形频率/相位）+ 环境物理约束（水动力+障碍物分布）
analysis.output: 三维位姿轨迹 + 持续前向运动能力（含绕障、脱困、深度切换）

papers.title: Folding the unfoldable 2: using AlphaFold and ESMFold to explore spurious proteins
papers.abstract: Motivation: Spurious protein sequences, resulting from gene prediction errors, theoretically should not yield folded structures. AlphaFold2 was previously shown to predict short spurious sequences with high pLDDT scores and was therefore unlikely to distinguish between real proteins and spurious proteins which are usually short. We evaluate whether newer structure prediction methods (ESMFold and AlphaFold3) similarly predict short sequences with high pLDDT or if they better discriminate between spurious and real proteins. Results: All three structure prediction methods (ESMFold, AlphaFold2, and AlphaFold3) predict short spurious sequences from AntiFam with unexpectedly high pLDDT scores, however the discrimination between spurious and real proteins improves beyond 100 amino acids. By analysing sequences with disparate pTM and pLDDT scores, we identified two likely spurious shadow ORFs in Swiss-Prot and one potentially non-spurious AntiFam entry. Using the structure prediction scores, we developed a Gaussian Process Model and evaluated its performance on AlphaFold DB, identifying potential spurious proteins at scale. While limited on its own, this model can increase confidence in spurious protein identification when combined with other methods.

analysis.tldr: 用AlphaFold2、ESMFold和AlphaFold3对假蛋白序列（spurious proteins）做结构预测，发现它们对短序列（<100aa）都给出高置信度分数（pLDDT），无法可靠区分真假蛋白；但长序列上判别力提升，并据此构建了一个高斯过程模型，在AlphaFold DB中批量筛查潜在假蛋白。
analysis.claim: 当前主流蛋白质结构预测模型（AF2/ESMFold/AF3）对短假蛋白序列仍给出高pLDDT分数，本质上不具备鉴别能力，但其分数分布差异可用于辅助识别长假蛋白，且结合高斯过程建模可实现规模化假蛋白筛查。
analysis.input: 氨基酸序列
analysis.output: pLDDT/pTM结构置信度分数及假蛋白概率预测
analysis.data_dependency: none

papers.title: Mem-World: Memory-Augmented Action-Conditioned World Models for Persistent Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: Action-conditioned world models have emerged as a promising paradigm for robot learning, offering a scalable alternative to costly real-world experimentation by generating action-consistent video rollouts. However, persistent world modeling remains challenging in manipulation: frequent end-effector occlusions and rapid wrist-camera motion make the current observation insufficient for predicting future views, causing models to forget or hallucinate scene details seen in earlier frames. Existing memory retrieval strategies often fail to identify informative history in dynamic manipulation scenarios. To address this limitation, we propose Mem-World, a memory-augmented multi-view action-conditioned world model. At its core, we present W-VMem, a 4D wrist-view-centered surfel-indexed memory that anchors historical observations to temporally evolving surface elements. By explicitly modeling when and where scene elements are observed, W-VMem enables geometry-aware retrieval of relevant history frames conditioned on future actions. During generation, relevant history frames are selected via surfel-based rendering and scoring, providing informative and non-redundant context for prediction. Extensive experiments show that Mem-World generates persistent rollouts in complex manipulation scenarios, enables more reliable policy evaluation than Ctrl-World, improving the Pearson correlation with real-world performance by 14.5\%, and supports effective policy improvement through synthetic data generation, increasing success rates from 58\% to 72\% on long-horizon tasks.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种带记忆机制的多视角动作条件世界模型Mem-World，用4D腕部视角对齐的surfel索引记忆（W-VMem）解决机械臂操作中因频繁遮挡和快速运动导致的历史信息遗忘问题，从而生成更持久、更准确的视频预测，并用该模型提升策略评估相关性和长程任务成功率。
analysis.claim: 通过surfel-indexed、时间演化的4D腕视记忆W-VMem，实现几何感知的历史帧检索，使动作条件世界模型在动态遮挡密集的机器人操作中保持跨帧一致性与预测持久性。
analysis.input: 多视角图像（含腕部摄像头）+动作序列
analysis.output: 未来多帧视频 rollout（像素级预测）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真环境中的双臂/单臂操作平台（未指明具体硬件，但实验基于仿真，含真实腕相机建模）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据（未使用任何真实机器人采集数据）
analysis.significance_reason: 在世界模型持续性建模这一关键短板上做出扎实改进：提出可解释、几何对齐的记忆结构W-VMem，实证显示其显著提升策略评估相关性（+14.5% Pearson）和长程任务成功率（+14%），且对比基线Ctrl-World有明确消融；但仍未脱离仿真验证，无真机部署或跨平台泛化证据，未达DreamerV3/WEAVER级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：针对世界模型在操作场景中‘记忆易失’这一公认痛点，给出了结构清晰、可验证、效果可量化的工程级解决方案，但尚未跨越sim2real鸿沟

papers.title: kontakteUR: transforming coordinates to chemical intuition to focus on essential interactions in biomolecular systems
papers.abstract: Molecular interactions govern cellular function, making them essential to discover biomolecular mechanisms by unravelling structure-function relationships. The rapid growth of AI-based prediction, experimental determination, and molecular dynamics simulations generates structural data at an unprecedented scale. However, structural information is typically represented as Cartesian coordinates, leaving chemical interactions and conformational relationships largely implicit. We introduce a high-throughput framework transforming structural geometry into a standardized, compact contact space. Moving beyond simple distance cutoffs, it provides a chemically and geometrically informed representation of various residue-residue interactions, their temporal changes, and conformations at residue-level resolution. Our contact-space representation enables systematic comparison and classification even for large-scale analysis. Case studies spanning structure comparison or studies of protein-protein, protein-ligand, protein-RNA, and antibody-antigen complexes, demonstrate how contact-space analysis reveals interaction patterns, identifies key mutation sites, and links structural features to experimental observations. With these and further applications, kontakteUR elucidates biomolecular function and assists targeted protein design, with results suited for further processing by artificial intelligence algorithms.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出kontakteUR框架，把蛋白质等生物分子的三维坐标结构转换成一种标准化的‘接触空间’表示，用化学和几何知识显式编码残基间相互作用（如氢键、疏水接触、构象变化），便于大规模比较、分类和AI下游建模。
analysis.claim: 将生物分子结构从隐式的笛卡尔坐标表示，转化为显式、标准化、残基级的化学-几何感知接触空间表示，从而支持系统性交互分析与AI-ready建模。
analysis.input: 蛋白质/复合物的原子级三维结构（PDB格式坐标）
analysis.output: 残基对级别的标准化接触向量（含类型、强度、几何特征、时序变化等）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅依赖公开结构数据库（如PDB）和模拟轨迹

papers.title: EventVLA: Event-Driven Visual Evidence Memory for Long-Horizon Vision-Language-Action Policies
papers.abstract: Memory remains a critical bottleneck for long-horizon robotic manipulation, as standard Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies often fail when task-relevant cues become occluded or unobservable over time. While existing memory-augmented methods utilize historical context, they either suffer from severe information bottlenecks, incur high latency via decoupled dual systems, or rely on unselective buffers that accumulate massive visual redundancies. To address these limitations, we introduce EventVLA, an end-to-end framework founded on the concept of sparse visual evidence memory that comprises two core components: foundational visual anchors to retain initial and short-term contexts, and a dynamic Keyframe Evidence Memory (KEM) module. Specifically, KEM directly predicts future keyframe probabilities from the VLA's latent embeddings to autonomously capture and store sparse, task-critical visual events. This foresight-driven mechanism empowers the policy to dynamically evaluate the future causal utility of current observations, preserving transient visual evidence before it becomes unobservable. Furthermore, we propose RoboTwin-MeM, a diagnostic benchmark specifically designed to evaluate non-Markovian manipulation tasks with interactive visual evidence. Extensive evaluations show that across 17 memory-requiring simulation tasks and 4 real-world bimanual tasks, EventVLA achieves an average success rate improvement of +40% over state-of-the-art memory-augmented VLAs.

analysis.tldr: 提出EventVLA框架，用稀疏的、事件驱动的关键帧记忆（KEM）替代传统冗余视觉缓存，让视觉语言动作策略能在长时程操作中记住关键视觉证据（如物体被遮挡前的最后状态），并在仿真和真实双臂机器人上显著提升任务成功率。
analysis.claim: 通过预测未来关键帧概率的动态视觉证据记忆机制（KEM），实现对非马尔可夫长时程操作任务中瞬态视觉证据的选择性保留与因果性利用，从而突破标准VLA策略的记忆瓶颈。
analysis.input: RGB视频流+语言指令+历史动作序列
analysis.output: 动作序列（6DoF末端位姿+夹爪开合）

papers.title: Z-1: Efficient Reinforcement Learning for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models offer a promising framework for robotic manipulation by connecting language instructions, visual observations, and continuous control. However, most existing policies remain limited by behavior cloning or supervised fine-tuning (SFT) from fixed demonstrations, which provides limited opportunity to improve from the policy's own failures. In this paper, we present Z-1, a reinforcement learning (RL) post-training framework for flow-based VLA models. Built on top of $π_{0.5}$, Z-1 uses only publicly released RoboCasa demonstrations for SFT and then applies a task-wise Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) strategy across $24$ standard RoboCasa tasks. To improve the efficiency and stability of online optimization, Z-1 combines shared-prefix rollout construction, tree-structured trajectory branching, completion-aware reward calibration, and selective joint training of VLM and Action Expert. Across all $24$ RoboCasa tasks, Z-1 achieves an average success rate of $80.6\%$, improving over its SFT initialization by $13.2\%$ points and outperforms the published sota models. These results show that systematic GRPO post-training can substantially improve flow-based VLA policies without additional private demonstrations.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出Z-1，一个基于公开RoboCasa数据的强化学习后训练框架，对已有的流式VLA模型π₀.₅进行GRPO优化，在24个RoboCasa任务上将平均成功率从67.4%提升到80.6%，全程不依赖私有真实机器人数据或新采集演示。
analysis.org: 未知（作者无机构署名，摘要未提所属单位；arXiv未标注affiliation）

papers.title: SafeRelBench: A Spatial-Relation-Aware Benchmark for Process-Level Safety in VLM-Driven Embodied Agents
papers.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used as the reasoning backbone of embodied agents, enabling robots to interpret visual scenes, follow language instructions, and plan multi-step actions. In household environments, however, safety depends not only on recognizing objects, but also on how actions change the physical scene over time. Existing embodied safety evaluations largely focus on static risk recognition, unsafe instruction refusal, or final-state task completion. As a result, process-level safety failures induced by spatial relations such as support, containment, and proximity remain insufficiently studied. To address this gap, we introduce SAFERELBENCH, a spatial-relation-aware safety benchmark with 507 executable evaluation samples, including 248 spatial-relation samples and 259 non-spatial control samples. Using SAFERELBENCH to evaluate seven open- and closed-source VLM-driven embodied agents, we find a substantial gap between task success and process-level safety compliance: models often complete the requested task while violating process-level safety constraints. Unlike prior benchmarks, SAFERELBENCH explicitly tests whether agents satisfy safety conditions before risk-prone actions, making spatial relations a core dimension in embodied safety assessment. More broadly, our results show that safe embodied intelligence requires not only stronger perception and planning, but also reliable reasoning about how object relations shape risk during interaction.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个专门测试具身智能体在执行多步任务过程中是否遵守空间关系安全约束（如支撑、容纳、邻近）的基准测试集SafeRelBench，发现当前主流VLM驱动的具身代理虽能完成任务，却频繁在动作执行中途违反过程级安全规则。
analysis.claim: 过程级安全不能仅靠最终状态或静态风险识别来保障，必须显式建模和验证动作执行前的空间关系动态变化。
analysis.input: 视觉-语言指令+场景图像序列（含动作执行前后的空间关系变化）
analysis.output: 是否在每一步风险动作前正确判断并满足空间关系安全条件（二元判定+归因）
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖，全部为可执行的仿真/脚本化评估样本
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统定义并量化‘过程级空间关系安全’这一被长期忽视的维度，构造了首个聚焦支持/容纳/邻近关系的可执行评测集，实证揭示主流VLM具身代理在此维度上存在严重缺陷；但未提出新模型、未集成到真实机器人闭环、未开源代码与数据，仅提供网页和样本描述，属于扎实的诊断型基准工作，未达基石级（如GR00T/H2O等推动范式迁移或解决核心控制难题）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：首次锚定过程级空间安全这一关键盲区并给出可量化评测工具，但缺乏模型创新、真实部署或开源支撑，暂未形成方法论突破。

papers.title: Let the Body Follow: Coupled Egocentric Control for Whole-Body Robot Teleoperation
papers.abstract: Whole-body teleoperation requires users to coordinate perception, manipulation, posture, and mobility across multiple robot components. This coordination is difficult because users must simultaneously control the robot's head, arms, torso, and base while maintaining task awareness and avoiding kinematic or environmental constraints. In this paper, we propose coupled egocentric control, a body-following teleoperation approach in which the robot's torso and base automatically respond to the operator's head and arm motions. Rather than requiring explicit touchpad commands for every torso or base adjustment, the system lets users focus on gaze and hand control: head pitch adjusts torso height, head yaw drives base rotation, end-effector height adjusts torso motion, and end-effector workspace boundaries trigger base translation. We evaluate this approach in a user study on whole-body teleoperation of a TIAGo mobile manipulator for home-care-inspired tasks. Compared with a baseline hybrid interface, coupled egocentric control improves object manipulation efficiency, reduces button-based control effort and arm singularities, lowers mental demand and overall workload, and increases ease of use, ease of learning, confidence, and user preference for torso and base control.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种‘耦合第一人称控制’方法，让移动机械臂的躯干和底盘自动跟随操作者头部和手部动作（如抬头调高躯干、转头带动底盘旋转、手高度变化触发躯干移动、手出工作区触发底盘平移），从而减少手动操控按钮，提升远程操作效率与用户体验。
analysis.claim: 通过将躯干与底盘运动解耦为对头/手运动的隐式响应，可显著降低全身体远程操作的认知负荷与控制复杂度，同时提升任务效率与用户主观体验。
analysis.input: 操作者头部姿态（俯仰/偏航）、末端执行器三维位置与工作空间边界
analysis.output: 机器人躯干高度、底盘旋转角速度、底盘平移速度

papers.title: Prebiotic cationic amino acids support formation of an ancient protein fold
papers.abstract: The evolutionary basis for the selection of the standard proteinogenic amino acids remains elusive, particularly for the long cationic amino acids, lysine and arginine, which were likely scarce in the prebiotic environment. In contrast, shorter cationic amino acids, such as ornithine (Orn), and 2,4-diaminobutyric acid (Dab), are thought to have been more abundant. Here, we investigated whether these prebiotic cationic amino acids can support protein tertiary structure formation, using computational protein design, biophysical and crystallographic analyses, and molecular dynamics (MD) simulations. We designed sequences for an ancient protein fold, the double-Ψ β-barrel (DPBB), with ornithine and plausible prebiotic amino acid sets. Although all the designed sequences were unfolded under standard dilute aqueous conditions, one Orn-containing variant folded in highly concentrated conditions. Crystallographic analysis revealed that both this peptide and its Dab-substituted derivative adopted the double-Ζ β-barrel (DZBB) fold, a likely evolutionary intermediate between extant β-barrel folds. Therefore, Orn and Dab might have supported the foldability of primitive proteins before the incorporation of lysine and arginine into the genetic code.

analysis.tldr: 用前生命期更可能存在的短链阳离子氨基酸（鸟氨酸、2,4-二氨基丁酸）替代赖氨酸/精氨酸，成功设计并实验证实能折叠出一种古老β桶结构（DZBB），表明早期蛋白质可能依赖这些非标准氨基酸实现稳定折叠。
analysis.claim: 前生命期丰富的短链阳离子氨基酸（Orn/Dab）可替代Lys/Arg，支撑原始蛋白质折叠成具有进化意义的双Ψ/双Ζβ桶结构。
analysis.input: 预设DPBB骨架结构 + 替换为Orn/Dab的氨基酸序列设计 + 浓缩溶液条件
analysis.output: 可结晶的折叠蛋白结构（DZBB）、热稳定性数据、MD模拟构象稳定性
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 首次通过计算设计+晶体结构验证，将前生命化学可行性（Orn/Dab丰度）与蛋白质折叠起源直接关联，并获得真实三维结构证据；虽仅聚焦单一古老折叠类型且实验条件受限（高浓度），但填补了生命起源中‘氨基酸选择’与‘结构可折叠性’之间的关键实证断层，证据链完整（设计→表达→纯化→CD→结晶→结构解析→MD验证），远超纯理论推测或序列统计分析。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是概念包装，而是用结构生物学金标准（X射线晶体学）证实了前生命氨基酸支持功能性折叠，为蛋白质起源提供了首个可验证的分子机制实证。

papers.title: SelfWAM: A Self-Grounded Unified World Action Model for Fast Robot Control
papers.abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) improve robot policy learning by jointly modeling actions and future observations. However, conditioning future prediction only on the task prompt and observation context risks capturing generic task progression rather than the action-specific consequences of the executed action. We introduce SelfWAM, a unified self-grounded WAM built on a modality-specialized Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) architecture that jointly predicts actions, action-conditioned future RGB frames, and robot self-masks, thereby grounding future prediction in the robot's visible body and its action-induced motion. During joint training, SelfWAM allows future visual queries to attend to a clean copy of the demonstrated action, turning the video branch into an action-specific consequence model while leaving the fast action-only inference path unchanged. To focus video learning on action-relevant visual changes, we use prompt-specific objectives for future robot self-mask prediction, which removes appearance details and provides a target whose temporal evolution is tightly coupled with the conditioning action. Together, clean-action conditioning and future self-mask supervision make future predictions more directly reflect how the executed action changes the robot's visible motion and the surrounding scene. Experiments on RoboTwin 2.0 and real-world manipulation tasks show that SelfWAM produces more action-sensitive futures and preserves fast policy inference, while improving policy performance.

analysis.tldr: 提出SelfWAM模型，通过让未来视觉预测显式依赖机器人自身动作（而非仅任务提示和观测），并用机器人自掩码（self-mask）作为动作耦合的监督信号，在保持快速动作推理的同时，使世界模型的未来预测更精准反映动作引发的视觉变化。
analysis.claim: 世界动作模型（WAM）的未来预测必须显式以执行动作为条件并接受动作-时序强耦合监督（如自掩码），才能真正建模动作后果，而非泛化任务流程。
analysis.input: 当前RGB图像+任务语言指令+历史动作（隐含在上下文）
analysis.output: 下一时刻动作+动作条件下的未来RGB帧预测+机器人自掩码预测
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的演示数据（摘要提‘real-world manipulation tasks’及‘demonstrated action’）
analysis.significance_reason: 在WAM范式中首次将动作显式注入视频分支并设计动作-时序紧耦合的自掩码监督，实证显示提升动作敏感性与策略性能；但未开源代码/模型，仅在RoboTwin 2.0和少量真实任务验证，缺乏跨机体/跨用户泛化、无消融对比基线（如vs WEAVER/DreamerV3）、未挑战长期开放难题（如持续学习/状态持久化），属扎实显著贡献，未达基石级（94+）门槛。

papers.title: Proprioceptive-visual correspondence enables self-other distinction in humanoid robots
papers.abstract: Distinguishing self from others is a prerequisite for social intelligence, yet humanoid robots that increasingly share workspaces with humans still lack this ability. Here we show that a humanoid robot can learn self-other distinction from proprioceptive-visual correspondence, without any identity labels or kinematic models. Once established, this distinction bootstraps a predictive self-model that maps joint configurations to three-dimensional body occupancy, capturing how the robot's body changes with action. In multi-agent scenes involving humans or morphologically identical robots, the system reliably identifies itself, learns a 3D self-model, and supports downstream tasks including target reaching, collision-aware motion planning, and human-to-robot motion retargeting. Together, these results outline a route toward bodily self-representation in robots that act and coordinate alongside others in shared physical environments. Project page: https://euron-zc.github.io/humanoid-self-model/.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文让一个人形机器人仅靠自身关节传感（本体感觉）和摄像头看到的画面之间的时空对应关系，自动学会区分‘自己’和‘别人’，进而构建出能预测身体三维占据空间的自模型，并在多人/多机器人共存场景中实现自我识别、避障规划和动作迁移。
analysis.claim: 无需身份标签或运动学模型，仅通过本体感觉-视觉跨模态时空一致性，即可让具身人形机器人自发习得自我-他者区分，并由此生成可泛化、可预测的3D身体自模型。
analysis.input: 关节角度序列+同步RGB视频帧（含多视角或多机器人共现场景）
analysis.output: 自我身份掩码+三维体素化身体占据预测+下游任务动作策略（如到达、避碰、动作重定向）

analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将跨模态自监督学习巧妙迁移到机器人自我表征问题，但实证深度和系统级影响不足，尚未达到开范式或解决长期开放难题的水平。

papers.title: BadWorld: Adversarial Attacks on World Models
papers.abstract: Visual world models (VWMs) synthesize interactive, action-conditioned rollouts from a single context image. However, it remains an open question how robust these models are to adversarial perturbations. Standard adversarial attacks fail to assess this vulnerability because attackers lack ground-truth future videos and cannot predict subsequent user controls. We introduce BadWorld, a label-free adversarial framework tailored for autoregressive VWMs that systematically overcomes both constraints. First, to bypass the need for future supervision, we propose a self-supervised velocity attack that directly disrupts the early denoising dynamics of the model. Second, to ensure the attack generalizes across unpredictable user actions, we formulate a trajectory-adaptive bi-level optimization that actively mines hard control sequences to forge control-agnostic perturbations. Evaluated on representative VWMs with continuous and discrete controls, BadWorld exposes severe structural fragility. Visually indistinguishable adversarial images reliably trigger catastrophic degradation in future rollouts, leading to incomplete denoising, structural collapse, and control inconsistency. These findings reveal critical risks for deploying VWMs in safety-critical systems while highlighting a practical mechanism for privacy protection.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出BadWorld框架，专门攻击视觉世界模型（VWM），在不依赖未来真值视频和用户动作先验的情况下，通过自监督速度扰动和轨迹自适应双层优化，生成肉眼不可辨的对抗图像，导致VWM生成的未来帧出现结构崩溃、去噪不全和控制不一致等严重失效。
analysis.claim: 视觉世界模型存在结构性脆弱性，可通过无需未来监督、无需动作先验的标签无关对抗攻击可靠触发其根本性失效。
analysis.input: 单张上下文图像
analysis.output: 对抗扰动后的图像（输入级扰动）
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 虽首次系统构建了针对自回归VWM的无监督对抗攻击范式，揭示了其底层动力学脆弱性，但仅限仿真评估、未开源代码/模型、无真实世界验证、未与安全关键场景（如机器人闭环控制）耦合测试，且未推动防御或鲁棒性建模——属于扎实的漏洞发现工作，但离‘推进VWM可靠性’这一核心需求尚远，显著弱于所有列出的基石工作（最低档Cosmos 1.0=93分）。
