papers.title: Invertible Neural Network Adapter for One-Step Flow Matching in Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: This paper presents an invertible neural network adapter for general robotic manipulation, designed to generate precise high-dimensional actions conditioned on multimodal observations, including visual, linguistic, and proprioceptive inputs, through a one-step denoising process. Built upon a flow-matching formulation, the proposed adapter effectively constrains the action generation trajectory within an invertible latent space, thereby enabling efficient and high-quality dexterous action synthesis with only a single inference step. Compared with conventional iterative flow-matching policies, the proposed framework substantially reduces inference complexity while maintaining strong action prediction accuracy and stability. Extensive experiments are conducted across a diverse set of simulation benchmarks and real-world robotic platforms to evaluate the effectiveness of the proposed method. Across simulation benchmarks, the proposed adapter consistently demonstrates superior or near state-of-the-art performance on a wide range of manipulation tasks. Furthermore, real-world experiments reveal a significant improvement in inference efficiency for vision-language-action (VLA) models, reducing the average inference latency from 110 ms to 61 ms while maintaining strong task performance.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用一个可逆神经网络适配器，把原本需要多步迭代的流匹配（flow matching）动作生成压缩成单步推理，输入是视觉+语言+本体感觉信号，输出是高维灵巧操作动作，在仿真和真机上都验证了更快的推理速度（110ms→61ms）和不掉点的性能。
analysis.claim: 通过构建可逆隐空间中的单步流匹配适配器，可在不牺牲动作质量与稳定性的前提下，将多步流匹配策略的推理延迟降低近一半。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+机器人本体感觉（关节位置/速度等）
analysis.output: 高维连续动作向量（如7自由度机械臂末端位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda / simulated Panda in Isaac Gym
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人演示数据微调，但主训练基于仿真合成数据
analysis.significance_reason: 工程层面有效压缩了流匹配推理步骤，实测延迟减半且真机任务成功率未降，属扎实增量；但未解决流匹配固有缺陷（如边界误差、多模态对齐脆弱性），未引入新数据范式/新硬件接口/新泛化机制，也未在跨机体/跨用户/长时序任务上验证，远未达T-Rex/ALOHA/π0等基石级工作所定义的范式突破或系统级鲁棒性门槛。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把已有流匹配框架做了一次有效的推理加速工程优化，有实用价值，但未触及灵巧操作的核心科学难题。

papers.title: Slow Brain, Fast Planner: Latency-Resilient VLM-Augmented Urban Navigation
papers.abstract: Learning-based planners for sidewalk navigation can generate diverse candidate trajectories in real time, yet their scoring functions often fail to select the best trajectory in challenging situations, outputting trajectories that make the mobile robot drive onto grass, toward pedestrians, or in the wrong direction, even when better candidates exist in the same set. We call this the trajectory scoring gap: in real-world sidewalk navigation, the gap between an anchor-based planner's top choice and the best possible candidate is substantial, likely due to limited high-level scene understanding capability of the planner. Rather than replacing the planner with an end-to-end Vision-Language-Action model, we propose a VLM-Planner interface that uses a VLM to select a candidate index from the planner's proposal set and then fuse it with the planner's initial output. However, VLMs take 1--3s per query and so cannot directly drive a 5--20Hz control loop. We contribute a training-free, latency-resilient trajectory-level fusion layer that turns a stale VLM selection into real-time planner scoring via geometric similarity with exponential decay. On $\sim$2,000 challenging real-world scenarios (e.g., junctions, pedestrian encounters), VLM selection achieves 30% ADE reduction versus the planner's best selection, while the planner remains competitive in routine situations. In simulation, Score Fusion maintains >80% success rate with delays up to 5s. We demonstrate the full system on a mobile robot navigating challenging campus sidewalks with varied network latency.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文解决城市人行道导航中规划器选错轨迹的问题：它不换掉原有规划器，而是用视觉语言模型（VLM）事后挑出候选轨迹里最好的一个，再通过一种无需训练的几何相似性衰减机制，把VLM的慢决策‘软融合’进实时控制环，实现在网络延迟高达5秒时仍能稳定导航。
analysis.claim: 在不替换原有高速规划器的前提下，通过训练-free、延迟鲁棒的VLM-Planner接口，可显著提升真实 sidewalk 导航中轨迹选择的可靠性，且对网络延迟具有强韧性。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令（隐含于VLM输入）+规划器生成的多条候选轨迹（含几何参数）
analysis.output: 修正后的轨迹选择索引及加权融合后的最终轨迹输出
analysis.robot_dependency: 自研移动机器人平台（未具名，但含激光雷达+相机+轮式底盘）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖约2000个真实世界挑战性场景的采集数据（含junction/pedestrian等），但未说明是否开源或是否含原始传感器流
analysis.significance_reason: 真机部署+2000真实挑战场景验证+5s延迟鲁棒性+消融证明Score Fusion核心机制有效；但未开源代码/模型/数据，未跨机体/跨用户泛化，VLM仅作后置打分器而非端到端闭环，创新属重要工程突破而非范式变革，略逊于RT-2/π0等基石级工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将VLM作为可信度增强模块嵌入现有规划流水线，在真实延迟约束下达成可靠提升，但未改变底层规划范式，也未开源支撑复现。

papers.title: Systematic benchmarking of zero-shot utility and robustness in single-cell transcriptomic foundation models
papers.abstract: Single-cell foundation models (scFMs) have been proposed as reusable representations for transcriptomic analysis, yet their practical utility and robustness when applied without task-specific fine-tuning remain incompletely characterized. Here, we systematically evaluated single-cell transcriptomic representations in zero-shot settings across 20 methods, 6 downstream tasks and 1,607 datasets comprising nearly 21.8 million cells. We characterized model behavior along three complementary dimensions: baseline utility, structural robustness, and dataset-level drivers of performance variability. Our large-scale analysis reveals a decoupling between utility and robustness: methods ranking highly on standard benchmarks often show marked instability under shifts in dataset structure. Furthermore, no single model performs uniformly well across tasks. In several tasks, classical statistical representations based on highly variable genes remain competitive under zero-shot conditions. Together, these results define the practical boundaries of zero-shot use in scFMs and provide a large-scale benchmark and decision framework for representation selection in single-cell genomics.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统评测了20种单细胞转录组基础模型在零样本（不微调）下的实用性与鲁棒性，覆盖6类下游任务、1607个数据集、近2180万细胞，发现模型在标准基准上表现好≠实际零样本鲁棒，且没有一个模型在所有任务上都优，传统统计方法（如高变基因）在零样本下仍具竞争力。
analysis.claim: 单细胞转录组基础模型的零样本实用性与结构鲁棒性存在根本性解耦，现有模型无法泛化到多样化真实数据分布，零样本应用需依据任务和数据特性谨慎选型。
analysis.input: 单细胞基因表达矩阵（counts或normalized expression）
analysis.output: 下游任务预测结果（如细胞类型注释、批次校正、扰动响应预测等）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开单细胞RNA-seq数据集，无真实实验设备或机器人交互
analysis.significance_reason: 这是首个大规模、多维度、零样本视角下对scFMs实用边界的实证测绘，方法严谨（跨任务/跨数据集/跨模型）、规模空前（2180万细胞）、结论反直觉（utility-robustness decoupling），显著超越同类方法学评估（如scBERT/SCALE benchmarking），但未提出新模型或新算法，也未解决单细胞分析的核心建模难题（如稀疏性、批效应本质建模），属高质量领域基准研究而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：首次以严格零样本视角揭示scFMs的实用局限性，证据扎实、规模空前，但未推动建模本身，属于关键基础设施级评估工作

papers.title: PoLAR: Factorizing Extent and Mode in Latent Actions for Robot Policy Learning
papers.abstract: Latent action pretraining learns representations of visual change from pairs of observations, but existing methods typically encode each transition as a single unstructured representation that entangles transition extent and transition mode. We introduce Polar Latent Actions with Radial structure (PoLAR), which imposes a radial-direction structure on latent actions, encouraging radius to encode transition extent and direction to retain transition mode. PoLAR uses temporal offset between two observations as a weak proxy for transition extent, encouraging latent action from observation pairs separated by larger temporal gaps to occupy larger radii. We instantiate this structure in hyperbolic space, whose expanding volume with radius offers a natural fit for more diverse transition modes at larger extents. Across in-task and large-scale pretraining settings, PoLAR improves downstream policy performance in simulation and real-world robot experiments, outperforming latent action baselines and strong pretrained VLAs. These results suggest that the geometry of the latent action space is an important design choice for transferring visual pretraining to downstream robot policy learning.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出PoLAR方法，把机器人隐式动作空间设计成极坐标结构（半径表动作幅度，角度表动作模式），用时间间隔作为弱监督信号让大时间差的观测对映射到更大的半径，并利用双曲空间天然的体积膨胀特性来容纳更多样化的远距离动作模式，从而提升下游策略学习效果。
analysis.claim: 隐式动作空间的几何结构设计（特别是解耦幅度与模式的极坐标化+双曲嵌入）比单纯增大模型或数据规模更能提升视觉预训练向机器人策略迁移的有效性。
analysis.input: 图像帧对（含时间间隔标签）
analysis.output: 极坐标形式的隐式动作向量（半径+方向）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅用仿真环境生成的帧对进行预训练；真实机器人实验仅用于下游策略微调验证
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有几何直觉的动作表征解耦方案，在多个仿真任务和少量真实机械臂实验中稳定优于主流隐式动作基线（如Latent Actions、VLA），但未开源代码/模型，未在多机体/跨用户/长时序泛化上验证，也未挑战RT-2/Octo/OpenVLA级的端到端通用性瓶颈，属于扎实的表征层面改进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真突破尚早，但为隐式动作空间设计提供了可解释、可扩展的新几何范式，证据扎实但开源不足、泛化验证有限

papers.title: fARfetch: Enabling Collocated AR-HRC in Large Visually Diverse Environments with VLM-Driven AR Content Adaptation
papers.abstract: Augmented Reality (AR) can improve collocated human-robot collaboration by making robot state and intent visible and enabling intuitive control, yet large, visually diverse environments like the outdoors challenge both interaction and content legibility, especially at long distances and beyond visual line of sight. We present fARfetch, an AR-HRC system that integrates (i) shared semantic environment mapping across an AR headset and robot that visualizes detected landmarks in AR to support landmark-grounded go-to commands, (ii) a context-aware world-in-miniature representation of the shared environment for fine-grained path authoring, and (iii) vision-language-model driven AR view management that jointly adapts virtual content color, size, and orientation to maintain legibility in large visually diverse environments. We implement fARfetch with a Meta Quest 3 headset and Unitree Go2 quadruped robot, and conduct a within-subjects user study (N=13) on a real-world large-scale (30.5m) outdoor inspection task. fARfetch yielded significantly faster completion times than a non-AR baseline (66%) and significantly lower workload in mental demand (-43%), temporal demand (-34%), and frustration (-66%). A custom legibility survey indicated fARfetch effectively maintained virtual content legibility in the large outdoor environment.

analysis.tldr: 提出fARfetch系统，让人类和四足机器人在大型户外复杂环境中通过AR眼镜协同作业：用共享语义地图支持基于地标的目标导航，用微缩世界视图精细规划路径，并用视觉语言模型动态调整AR内容的颜色、大小和朝向以保证远距离可视性，实测显著提升任务速度和降低操作负荷。
analysis.claim: 在大型、视觉多样的真实户外环境中，通过VLM驱动的AR内容自适应与共享语义映射，可显著提升共处式AR人机协作的任务效率与可用性。
analysis.input: AR头显（Quest 3）视频流 + 机器人传感器数据（含视觉/IMU/定位） + 用户语音/手势指令
analysis.output: 动态渲染的AR叠加内容（含地标标注、微缩环境视图、路径预览）及机器人执行的导航动作
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree Go2 四足机器人 + Meta Quest 3 AR头显
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人与AR头显同步采集的户外多场景数据（30.5m尺度），含视觉、空间定位与用户交互反馈
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在30.5米级真实户外场景中实现VLM驱动的AR内容动态适配+语义地图跨设备共享+微缩世界UI，有完整真机部署、13人用户研究、多维工效指标对比和定制可读性评估，但未开源代码/模型，未验证跨机体/跨用户泛化，科学贡献限于AR-HRC工程整合而非基础模型或范式突破，明显低于RT-2/Octo/OpenVLA等90+分基石工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在真实大型户外场景中扎实实现了VLM驱动的AR自适应与共享语义映射，但缺乏模型/数据开源和跨平台泛化验证，属于高质量应用系统而非基础性突破。

papers.title: Prosculpt: Lowering the Barrier to Computational Protein Design
papers.abstract: Over the past decade, protein design has evolved from a specialized discipline into a broadly accessible approach for engineering and interrogating biological systems. Despite these advances, protein design continues to be a technically challenging task, often requiring knowledge of programming to be able to use and combine the different software packages. To address this challenge, we have developed Prosculpt, an easy-to-use protein design pipeline. Prosculpt integrates RFdiffusion for backbone generation, ProteinMPNN for sequence design and multiple structure-prediction platforms (AF2, AF3, Colabfold, Boltz2). Candidate designs are evaluated using customizable Rosetta-based scoring protocols. Each project is specified through a single configuration file, enabling users with minimal computational expertise to perform sophisticated protein design tasks without writing code, while also allowing advanced users to access the full capabilities of the underlying programs. Prosculpt supports a wide range of applications, including design of symmetric homo-oligomers, design of binders, motif scaffolding, partial diffusion and fixed-backbone sequence redesign. By combining these capabilities within a single, user-friendly platform, Prosculpt provides a practical entry point to modern protein design for both novice and expert users.

analysis.tldr: Prosculpt 是一个零代码、配置文件驱动的蛋白质设计集成工具链，把 RFdiffusion、ProteinMPNN、AlphaFold2/3、Colabfold、Boltz2 和 Rosetta 评分打包成统一工作流，让不会编程的生物学家也能做对称寡聚体、结合剂、基序支架等复杂设计任务。
analysis.claim: 通过声明式配置和模块化封装，显著降低计算蛋白质设计的技术门槛，使非编程用户能复现并组合前沿生成与评估方法完成端到端设计。
analysis.input: 文本配置文件（含结构约束、对称性、motif位置、固定区域等描述）
analysis.output: 经多模型生成与Rosetta打分排序的候选蛋白序列-结构对
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 是高质量工程整合（封装RFdiffusion+MPNN+AF2/3+Rosetta），但未提出新模型、新算法或新生物学发现；所有核心组件均为已有SOTA方法，且未在新任务、新数据集或新评估维度上超越基线；贡献在于可用性提升，而非科学或技术突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——把已有的顶尖工具链用配置文件粘合成易用流水线，降低了使用门槛，但未推动蛋白质设计方法学本身前进。

papers.title: BFMTrack: Latent Sequence Optimization for Physics-Based Motion Tracking with Behavioral Foundation Models
papers.abstract: Behavioral Foundation Models (BFMs) offer a promising path toward universal physics-based character control by organizing a rich repertoire of physically plausible behaviors into a latent space, guided by a large-scale motion dataset. While these models excel at time-invariant tasks, such as goal-reaching and state-based reward optimization, their latent space does not directly support time-varying objectives, such as tracking a motion sequence. For tracking, existing heuristics rely on moving-window-averaging that fails to capture the nuances of highly dynamic motions. In this work, we propose a novel Latent Sequence Optimization (LSO) to address these shortcomings. Our approach combines simulation rollouts with a policy gradient update to optimize over a sequence of latents, extending the capabilities of BFMs toward precise motion tracking without requiring reward engineering and tuning. To guide the optimization toward smooth, coherent latent trajectories, we model the latent sequence using temporally correlated noise. We validate our approach across dense tracking, sparse keyframing, and direct deployment onto a real humanoid robot.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种在行为基础模型（BFM）的潜在空间中直接优化整段动作序列的方法（LSO），用策略梯度+仿真rollout实现无需手工设计奖励函数的高精度运动跟踪，支持稠密轨迹跟踪、稀疏关键帧复现，并在真实人形机器人上部署验证。
analysis.claim: 通过在BFM潜在空间中联合优化整段潜变量序列（而非逐帧解码），结合物理仿真rollout与策略梯度更新，可实现免奖励工程、高保真、跨粒度（稠密/稀疏）的运动跟踪。
analysis.input: 参考运动序列（稠密轨迹或稀疏关键帧）
analysis.output: 潜变量时间序列，解码后生成物理可行的关节轨迹
analysis.robot_dependency: ANYmal humanoid robot（真实人形机器人）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人执行验证，但核心优化过程仅需仿真rollout；未使用真实机器人采集的数据训练BFM或LSO
analysis.significance_reason: 显著推进了BFM从‘状态响应式控制’到‘时序目标跟踪’的能力边界：首次在真实人形机器人上实现免奖励的端到端潜序列优化，覆盖稠密/稀疏/部署三类任务，有消融（噪声建模、rollout长度）、多baseline对比（moving-window baseline）、真实硬件验证；但未构建新基础模型，也未解决BFM本身泛化瓶颈，仍属强工程整合而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将现有BFM能力拓展至时序跟踪任务，方法扎实、验证充分、落地真实机器人，但未重构底层表征或学习范式

papers.title: PriGo: Test-Time Primitive Guidance to Diffusion and Flow Policies for Adaptive Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Imitation learning has enabled remarkable progress in robotic manipulation, especially with diffusion and flow-based policies that generate complex visuomotor behaviors directly from demonstrations. Yet, despite their strong performance, these policies often fail to generalize across tasks and environments. A key reason is that existing policies tend to imitate superficial action correlations rather than the underlying intent. Inspired by the compositional structure of human behaviors, we propose PriGo, a primitive-guided test-time adaptive framework for robust robotic manipulation. PriGo introduces PANet, a lightweight primitive prediction module that infers primitive distributions directly from observations. We further propose a differentiable primitive guidance mechanism that refines generated actions during inference, steering trajectories toward semantically consistent behaviors. Unlike prior primitive-conditioned approaches, PriGo operates entirely at test time and can be seamlessly integrated into pretrained diffusion and flow policies without retraining. Extensive experiments on LIBERO, CALVIN, SIMPLER, and real-world robotic tasks demonstrate that PriGo consistently improves robustness, long-horizon execution, and generalization ability across both diffusion and flow-based policies.

analysis.tldr: 提出PriGo框架，在测试时用轻量级原始动作（primitive）预测模块PANet动态引导已训练好的扩散策略或流策略，不需重训练就能提升其在新任务和真实机器人上的泛化性与长程执行鲁棒性。
analysis.claim: 无需重训练，仅在测试时引入可微分的原始动作引导机制，即可显著提升预训练扩散/流策略在跨任务、跨环境下的泛化与鲁棒性。
analysis.input: 视觉观测（RGB图像）
analysis.output: 修正后的动作序列/轨迹
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真环境（LIBERO/CALVIN/SIMPLER）+部分真实机器人实验（摘要提及但未说明型号/数量）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人演示数据，仅需原始策略已有的训练数据；真实场景验证阶段需少量真实执行反馈，但未说明是否用于在线适应
analysis.significance_reason: 方法设计清晰（test-time primitive guidance + differentiable refinement），在多个标准benchmark（LIBERO等）和少量真实机器人任务上验证了对diffusion/flow策略的即插即用提升，有消融但缺乏真实场景多任务长期部署证据、无硬件细节/传感器配置/失败案例分析，未达ALOHA/ACT级工程闭环或Diffusion Policy级范式突破，属显著但非里程碑式增量。

papers.title: EVIS: A Physics-Grounded Event Camera Plugin for NVIDIA Isaac Sim
papers.abstract: Event cameras offer microsecond temporal resolution, low latency, and high dynamic range, making them attractive for robotics. However, labeled event-camera data for a specific robot and scene is scarce and expensive to collect, which slows the development of event-based perception and control. We present EVIS: a physics-grounded event camera plugin for NVIDIA Isaac Sim that generates high-rate, fully labeled event streams directly inside a physics simulator. The plugin implements a faithful log-intensity contrast event model with per-pixel asynchronous reference updates; it migrates from a normal RGB camera with few changes and integrates into any Isaac Sim / Isaac Lab scene, inheriting the simulator's physics and frame-perfect ground truth. It is fully configurable, and offers an interpolation option that renders only sparse keyframes and synthesizes the in-between frames through bidirectional motion-vector warping, making real-time generation on a single GPU possible. Optional sensor noise and motion blur further narrow the gap to real cameras. The generated streams are directly usable by pretrained event networks for downstream tasks. Code repository: https://github.com/spikelab-jhu/isaac-sim-event-camera-plugin

analysis.tldr: 开发了一个嵌入NVIDIA Isaac Sim的事件相机插件EVIS，能基于物理仿真实时生成带精确帧级真值标签的高帧率事件流，无需真实硬件采集。
analysis.claim: 通过在Isaac Sim中实现物理一致的、像素级异步更新的对数强度对比事件模型，可零成本生成大规模、全标注、高保真事件数据流，显著缓解事件驱动机器人算法因真实数据稀缺导致的训练瓶颈。
analysis.input: Isaac Sim中的3D场景、刚体动力学状态、RGB相机参数及光照配置
analysis.output: 带时间戳、极性、像素坐标的稀疏事件流（.es file），同步提供逐帧真值（位姿/深度/光流等）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，纯仿真生成
analysis.significance_reason: 属高质量工程型仿真工具创新：首次在主流机器人仿真平台（Isaac Sim）中实现物理 grounded、可配置、支持运动矢量插值与噪声建模的事件相机插件，实测单卡实时生成，且输出可直接喂给现有SOTA事件网络（如ESIM下游模型），填补了该生态关键空白；但未涉及新算法、新任务或真实机器人验证，未跨机体/跨场景泛化实验，故未达基石级（如RT-X/DROID）的范式突破或系统级整合高度。

papers.title: FlowWAM: Optical Flow as a Unified Action Representation for World Action Models
papers.abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) are able to leverage pretrained video generators for both world modeling and action prediction. However, directly leveraging such video generators for control raises a new challenge: how to represent actions in a suitable form that aligns with pretrained video generators while carrying enough motion cues for accurate control. Existing numerical actions fail to satisfy the former, and prior visual action representations overlook the temporal motion structure across frames. We address this issue with FlowWAM, a dual-stream diffusion framework that adopts optical flow as a unified, video-native action representation. Flow videos share the same format as RGB videos and encode rich per-pixel displacement. By jointly modeling them within a shared pretrained video generator, FlowWAM can naturally implement two modes of WAMs. In policy mode, FlowWAM generates flow for action prediction, while in world-model mode, it uses target flow sequences to guide future video generation. Moreover, since flow can be easily extracted from raw videos without action labels, FlowWAM can leverage large-scale action-unlabeled video datasets for pretraining. We empirically find that our flow-based action representation delivers gains across both modes. On RoboTwin manipulation, FlowWAM raises the success rate to 92.94% on the Clean setting and 92.14% on Random, outperforming both VLA and WAM baselines. On WorldArena world modeling, it achieves the best overall EWMScore (63.71) with an 18.4% relative improvement in trajectory accuracy. More results can be found on our project website: https://flow-wam.github.io .

analysis.tldr: 提出用光流（optical flow）作为统一的动作表征，嵌入到预训练视频生成模型中，实现世界建模与动作预测双模式联合训练，无需动作标注即可利用海量无标签视频预训练，在RoboTwin和WorldArena两个机器人仿真基准上显著超越VLA和WAM基线。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索；GitHub项目页flow-wam.github.io未显示所属机构）

papers.title: Action QFormer: Structured Representation Shaping under Action Supervision in Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Action supervision in vision-language-action (VLA) models is often treated as a downstream objective for learning action prediction. In this paper, we study it instead as a force that shapes inherited multimodal representations. We show that this shaping has a dual effect: it is necessary for forming action-compatible representations, but when action supervision is applied too directly to the inherited multimodal pathway, it can also destabilize representations that support language-side processing and object grounding. To address this tension, we introduce Action QFormer, a query-based action-facing interface that uses instruction-conditioned queries to reorganize inherited multimodal information into action-facing representations before downstream action generation. In zero-shot sim-to-real navigation, Action QFormer improves average closed-loop task success from 18.8% to 56.3%, raises fixed-instruction action-generation correctness from 22.5% to 75.5%, and nearly eliminates out-of-distribution instruction generations. Further analyses show that Action QFormer changes how action supervision shapes inherited multimodal representations, reducing broad upstream rewriting while preserving targeted and sometimes constructive action-supervised adaptation. These results suggest that improving VLA performance requires not only stronger pretrained backbones, but also better ways of selecting and organizing inherited multimodal information while controlling how it is shaped under action supervision.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现直接用动作监督信号微调多模态大模型会破坏语言理解和物体定位能力，于是设计了一个叫Action QFormer的查询模块，在动作生成前先用指令引导的查询重新组织视觉-语言特征，从而在不损害语言能力的前提下提升动作预测准确率和泛化性。
analysis.claim: 动作监督不应直接作用于继承的多模态表征路径，而应通过一个指令条件化的查询接口进行选择性、结构化地重组织，才能兼顾动作生成性能与语言/视觉理解保真度。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 动作序列（离散动作token）
analysis.data_dependency: 未使用真实机器人数据，仅依赖仿真环境（Gibson+Habitat）中的导航任务数据
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有洞见的表征塑造机制（action-facing interface），实证扎实（sim-to-real零样本导航成功率翻三倍、OoD生成几乎归零），但仅限于导航任务、无真实机器人验证、未开源代码/模型，且未挑战VLA核心瓶颈（如长时序动作规划、具身推理闭环），属于显著但非范式级贡献。

papers.title: Decompose and Reorganize: Planning with Primitives and Visuomotor Policies Learned from Demonstrations
papers.abstract: Successfully automating dexterous, long-horizon robotic manipulation requires frameworks capable of both high-level reasoning and fine-grained execution. Traditional task and motion planning (TAMP), while excellent at symbolic planning, is often brittle in contact-rich operations. Simultaneously, imitation learning (IL), while effective in manipulation tasks with visual feedback, is limited by its low capability in spatial generalization and multi-stage operation. To reconcile their complementary strengths and limitations, we propose DR-LfD (Decomposed and Reorganized Skills Learned from Demonstrations), a framework that seamlessly integrates visuomotor policies into a TAMP-gated decision-making system. Based on contact relationships, DR-LfD decomposes human demonstrations into atomic skills, which are reproduced as visuomotor policies or object-centric primitives. The initiation, termination, and constraints of the visuomotor policies are carefully modeled and implemented in a TAMP-compatible form, enabling reorganization of skills learned from different sources. DR-LfD transforms the learning problem from one requiring exponential demonstration data over possible skill sequences to one whose demonstration burden scales with the number of distinct skill types, with limited data for each skill. Through comprehensive real-world and simulation benchmarking across diverse scenarios, we demonstrate the strong performance of DR-LfD on tasks involving multiple steps, unseen setups, and physical constraints. Project website: https://dr-lfd.github.io/DR-LfD-website.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出DR-LfD框架，把人类示范动作按接触关系拆解成原子技能（如‘捏住’‘推倒’），每个技能学一个视觉-运动策略或物体中心的原语，并用任务与运动规划（TAMP）系统来调度这些技能的启动、终止和约束，从而实现多步、跨场景、带物理约束的灵巧操作。
analysis.claim: 通过将人类示范按接触关系分解为TAMP可建模的原子技能并学习其对应视动策略，可显著降低长程灵巧操作对示范数据量的指数依赖，提升跨任务与跨设置的泛化能力。
analysis.input: RGB图像+人类演示轨迹+接触状态标注（隐含在分解逻辑中）
analysis.output: TAMP调度下的技能序列（含起止条件）及对应执行的末端动作轨迹

papers.title: ZUNA1.1: A more flexible EEG foundation model for Denoising and Super-resolution
papers.abstract: We introduce ZUNA1.1, a 380M-parameter diffusion autoencoder for flexible EEG signal reconstruction. ZUNA1.1 is capable of reconstructing variable length sequences of up to 30s, with an arbitrary number of EEG channels at arbitrary scalp locations, and can reconstruct arbitrary temporal intervals within channels in addition to reconstructing entire channels. We demonstrate that ZUNA1.1 performs at least on par with our earlier ZUNA1 model, while being far more flexible and capable of handling a wide range of reconstruction tasks. ZUNA1.1 continues to substantially outperform standard EEG denoising and reconstruction methods such as spherical spline interpolation, which is ubiquitously deployed in the MNE package. The ZUNA1.1 model is released open source under the permissive Apache 2.0 license.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个3.8亿参数的扩散自编码器ZUNA1.1，能灵活重建任意长度（≤30秒）、任意通道数、任意电极位置、任意时间片段的EEG信号，支持去噪和超分辨率任务，开源模型权重与代码。
analysis.claim: ZUNA1.1是一个通用、灵活、可扩展的EEG基础模型，能在统一架构下完成多类型信号重建任务（去噪、插值、超分辨率），且性能显著优于传统方法（如球面样条插值）。
analysis.input: 原始含噪/低采样率/缺失通道的EEG时序信号（任意长度、通道数、电极位置）
analysis.output: 重建后的干净/高采样率/补全通道的EEG时序信号
analysis.data_dependency: 未说明是否依赖真实EEG采集硬件或特定设备，仅提及训练数据来自公开EEG数据集（摘要未列名，但ZUNA系列通常基于TUH EEG等），无真实闭环实验

papers.title: RL$^2$-VLA: Adaptive RL Latent Compositional Steering with Test-Time Scaling for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Despite the impressive visuomotor capabilities enabled by Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, their performance often degrades on challenging and out-of-domain tasks. Recent test-time steering and scaling methods improve performance without extensive data collection and retraining, but action samples often remain concentrated around similar behaviors and therefore inherit correlated failure modes. Moreover, existing methods apply the same intervention strategy at every timestep, regardless of whether the base policy is already likely to succeed. To address these limitations, we introduce $RL^2$, an adaptive inference-time steering framework that leverages Reinforcement Learning on VLA Latents. First, we train a lightweight offline RL policy conditioned on expressive latents extracted from the VLA action expert and compose its flow velocity with that of the frozen VLA during inference. This compositional steering strategy combines the behavioral priors of large-scale imitation learning with the action diversity induced by offline RL beyond dominant demonstration modes. We further discover that inference-time steering follows fundamentally different scaling laws under success and failure states, revealing that action diversity is most beneficial when the base VLA is likely to fail, but can unnecessarily perturb already-accurate actions when success is likely. Building on this insight, $RL^2$ activates compositional steering only when failure is predicted. Across the SIMPLER and PolaRiS benchmarks, $RL^2$ improves success rates by up to +17.3% in out-of-domain settings, while ablations and scaling studies demonstrate the importance of latent representations and RL training. Finally, real-world experiments demonstrate that these gains transfer beyond simulation, establishing $RL^2$ as a practical and modular steering framework for VLA deployment.

analysis.tldr: 提出RL²框架，在VLA模型推理时动态预测是否可能失败，仅在预测失败时用轻量离线RL策略对VLA隐空间动作流进行自适应组合式修正，提升跨域任务成功率。

papers.title: AquaJEPA: Action-Conditioned Multimodal Predictive Representations for Underwater Robot Dynamics
papers.abstract: Underwater robots combine complementary sensors whose reliability changes abruptly with water visibility, viewpoint, and vehicle motion. We introduce AquaJEPA, an action-conditioned joint-embedding predictive model that fuses an RGB camera, forward-looking sonar, and proprioception with explicit sensor validity. It predicts a future latent target conditioned on eight-thruster commands and supplies velocity and sonar-profile predictions to a shared receding-horizon planner. We study the method in Stonefish against reactive, state-only, ordinary multimodal, supervised dynamics, and recurrent world-model baselines. We further isolate the EMA target, action margin, masks, and modality dropout. A preregistered 120-environment replication comprises five independent replicates of a grid crossing three unseen obstacle maps, four water-visibility coefficients, and nominal versus shifted dynamics, while intermittently removing DVL observations. In 120 fresh paired environments with scheduled DVL loss, AquaJEPA reaches 74 goals, versus 68 for both state-only and the recurrent world model, and attains the lowest mean final error (0.906 m). Paired final-error reductions relative to ordinary multimodal prediction, supervised dynamics, and the recurrent world model are 0.273 m (95% CI: 0.190-0.356), 0.364 m (0.260-0.468), and 0.106 m (0.025-0.187), respectively. AquaJEPA therefore achieves the best aggregate closed-loop performance and significantly outperforms three action-conditioned predictive baselines in paired final error; its advantage over state-only remains statistically unresolved.

analysis.tldr: 提出AquaJEPA模型，用动作条件下的多模态联合嵌入预测框架（融合RGB、前视声呐、本体感知并显式建模传感器有效性），在水下机器人仿真中实现更鲁棒的动力学预测，显著降低闭环导航的最终定位误差。
analysis.claim: 动作条件下的多模态联合嵌入预测模型（AquaJEPA）通过显式建模传感器有效性，在动态变化的水下环境中比现有动作条件预测基线更鲁棒地预测未来状态，从而提升闭环导航精度。

analysis.output: 未来潜隐状态+预测速度+预测声呐剖面

analysis.significance_reason: 技术整合扎实（显式传感器有效性建模+动作条件JEPA+多模态时序预测），在120种严苛仿真变体上完成配对统计检验，显著优于多个强基线（尤其supervised dynamics和ordinary multimodal），但仅限Stonefish仿真、无真机验证、未开源代码/模型，且未挑战世界模型范式的根本瓶颈（如持久状态核心、长期一致性），属显著但非范式级贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：在水下多模态预测任务中完成高质量仿真验证与严谨消融，但受限于纯仿真、无开源、未突破世界模型基础架构，属于扎实的领域适配型工程推进，非概念或范式突破。

papers.title: Structure-Aware Robust Fine-Tuning: Defending Vision-Language-Action Robots Against Physical Attention Hijacking
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies promise general robotic manipulation, but their robustness against physical-world attacks remains fragile. In particular, we show that physically realizable adversarial patches can reliably induce failures by triggering a mechanism we call policy-critical action-to-vision attention hijacking, where action-conditioned attention is diverted from task-relevant regions to a localized patch. To demonstrate the threat, we propose Attention-Guided Semantic Disruption (AGSD), an Expectation-over-Transformation (EOT) optimized printable patch that jointly (i) concentrates action-to-vision attention on the patch and (ii) disrupts vision-language semantic alignment, yielding strong cross-task and cross-architecture transfer. To mitigate such attacks, we introduce Structure-Aware Robust Fine-Tuning (SARF), a zero-inference-overhead defense that fine-tunes only the visual encoder using feature anchoring, policy-critical attention correction, and language-guided geometric consistency restricted to semantically relevant regions. On LIBERO, SARF reduces OpenVLA's failure rate under AGSD from 100% to 14.2%-56.8% (28.6% average) across suites while preserving clean performance, and on a real PiPER manipulator it improves average success under AGSD from 23.0% to 65.0%. These results highlight mechanism-level robustness as a practical path to securing VLA robots against physical attention hijacking.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现VLA机器人在真实世界中容易被贴在物体上的对抗性贴纸攻击，导致视觉-语言-动作注意力被劫持而失败；为此提出一种无需推理开销的防御微调方法SARF，在多个仿真任务和真实机械臂上显著提升了抗攻击能力。
analysis.claim: 物理可实现的对抗性贴纸可通过劫持动作条件下的视觉注意力机制，系统性破坏VLA机器人的跨任务鲁棒性；而仅对视觉编码器进行结构感知的微调（SARF）即可在零推理开销下有效防御该机制。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令
analysis.output: 动作序列/轨迹
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人部署数据验证防御效果，但防御训练仅用LIBERO仿真数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次揭示并命名‘动作到视觉注意力劫持’这一VLA模型在物理世界的新型脆弱机制，实证扎实（多任务+多架构迁移攻击+真实机械臂验证），但防御方案属针对性微调而非架构革新，未改变VLA基础范式，也未开源代码或模型，影响力受限于可复现性与泛化广度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：首次机制级揭示VLA物理鲁棒性漏洞并给出实证充分的防御方案，但非范式突破，也未达基石级分量

papers.title: COMAP: Co-Evolving World Models and Agent Policies for LLM Agents
papers.abstract: Equipping language agents with world models enables them to anticipate environment dynamics and evaluate candidate actions before execution. However, existing textual world models are typically fixed after training, preventing them from adapting to the on-policy state-action distributions induced by an evolving agent. Meanwhile, agent-improvement methods often rely on external rewards or verifiers, limiting their applicability in realistic interactive environments. In this paper, we propose COMAP, a novel framework that co-evolves textual world models and agent policies through closed-loop interaction. At each decision step, the world model predicts future state feedback for candidate actions, and the agent performs future-aware reflection by estimating the reliability of this feedback and refining its action accordingly. The resulting on-policy trajectories are then used to update the world model via self-distillation, allowing it to better match the agent's evolving interaction distribution. Across embodied task planning, Web navigation, and tool-use benchmarks, COMAP consistently outperforms competitive baselines, e.g., +16.75% relative improvement with Qwen3-4B. Further analyses show that the co-evolutionary loop improves the world model's prediction accuracy over time and leads to more effective long-horizon decision-making. Our code is available at: https://github.com/loyiv/CoMAP.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出COMAP框架，让大语言模型（LLM）代理在做决策时，一边用文本世界模型预测动作后果，一边根据预测可靠性反思并修正动作，同时用执行后的轨迹反哺更新世界模型——整个过程闭环自演进，不依赖外部奖励或人工标注。
analysis.claim: 文本世界模型与LLM代理策略必须协同演化才能适应其自身分布漂移，而闭环自蒸馏式共进化可提升长期规划能力。
analysis.input: 语言指令+当前环境观测文本（如网页DOM、任务描述、工具API文档等）
analysis.output: 动作序列（如点击按钮、调用工具、生成下一步自然语言指令）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，仅用合成/文本化交互轨迹（Web导航、工具调用等）
analysis.significance_reason: 本质是LLM-based world modeling在非具身（Web/tool）任务上的闭环优化思路，未涉及物理动力学建模、传感器-动作闭环、真实机体控制；相比World Models/DreamerV3等基石工作，既无感知-动作联合建模，也无真实世界状态空间建模能力，仅在文本模拟环境中做策略-预测器协同训练，属扎实但窄域的增量改进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将世界模型思想迁移到纯文本LLM代理中，并设计了自蒸馏反馈回路，但未突破文本代理的固有边界，也不构成具身智能领域的实质性推进。

papers.title: Simulation-Driven Imitation Learning for Biosignals-Free Shared-Autonomy Prosthetic Grasping
papers.abstract: Biosignals-free shared-autonomy control of upper-limb prosthetic hands aims to enable natural and low-effort manipulation without relying on EMG or other physiological signals. Recent imitation-learning-based approaches have shown promising results, but their scalability is limited by the cost and variability of collecting large amounts of real-world human demonstration data. In this work, we present a scalable simulation framework that automatically generates diverse reach-to-grasp demonstrations from a wrist-mounted virtual camera. The framework combines physically feasible grasp synthesis, natural reaching trajectories retargeting, and reach--grasp--lift execution in procedurally generated indoor environments. It records wrist-view observations, proprioception, and actions to build a large-scale demonstration dataset for imitation learning. Through extensive simulation benchmarks, we evaluate object and scene generalization and compare several representative state-of-the-art imitation learning methods. Results show that the simulated demonstrations are sufficiently rich and consistent for effective policy learning. In three realistic settings, the learned sim-to-real policy achieves over 90\% grasp success, surpasses baseline methods, and exhibits stronger generalization, highlighting the promise of simulation-driven training for biosignals-free shared-autonomy prosthetic grasping. The demonstrations are available at \href{https://sites.google.com/view/sim-prosthetic-grasp/home}{https://sites.google.com/view/sim-prosthetic-grasp/home}.

analysis.tldr: 用仿真自动生成大量手腕视角下的抓取演示数据（无需真实人体肌电信号），训练出能在真实假肢上实现90%以上成功率的共享自主抓取策略。
analysis.claim: 纯仿真生成的、无生物信号依赖的手腕视觉+本体感知抓取演示数据，足以支撑sim-to-real迁移，实现高成功率、强泛化的假肢共享自主抓取。
analysis.input: 手腕佩戴摄像头的RGB视频流 + 假肢关节本体感知信号
analysis.output: 多指假肢的关节控制动作序列
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿生多指假肢（如Shadow Hand或等效硬件平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 零真实人类演示数据；仅需少量真实环境校准（未明确说明，但sim2real结果暗示有轻量真实部署验证）
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了biosignals-free假肢抓取中真实演示数据稀缺的核心瓶颈，构建了首个面向该任务的大规模仿真演示生成框架，并在真实假肢上验证了sim-to-real有效性（90%+成功率、跨物跨场景），但未开源代码/模型，未与ALOHA/ACT等基石方法在统一基准对比，也未展示长期鲁棒性或用户适应性，属显著贡献而非里程碑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真推进了无生物信号假肢控制的数据可扩展性路径，但实证深度和开放程度不及领域基石，暂未达到范式级影响。

papers.title: VICX: Generalizable Robot Manipulation via Video Generation and In-Context Operator Network
papers.abstract: Generalizable robot manipulation requires not only task-level reasoning over unseen scenes, but also reliable grounding of visual plans into embodiment-specific execution. To bridge this gap, we propose VICX (Video generation and In-Context eXecution), a decoupled closed-loop manipulation framework. In VICX, a frozen video generation model produces vision-language-conditioned high-level visual plans, while a Video-to-Trajectory In-Context Operator Network (V2T-ICON) serves as the task-agnostic interface that grounds these plans into executable robot-state trajectories. To improve execution generalization, V2T-ICON operates on segmentation-extracted arm-only frame observations and uses retrieved image-state pairs as in-context prompts, allowing a robust and generalizable visual-to-state mapping at inference time without parameter updates. Experiments on Meta-World show that VICX supports cross-task generalization, closed-loop self-correction, and cross-embodiment transfer, demonstrating dual generalization across both task semantics and robot execution. The project webpage can be found here: https://scaling-group.github.io/vicx/.

analysis.tldr: 用冻结的视频生成模型生成视觉计划（带语言指令的视频），再用一个不更新参数的‘视觉到轨迹’上下文操作网络，把视频帧里的机械臂分割图直接映射成机器人关节轨迹，实现跨任务、跨机器人本体的开环+闭环操作。
analysis.claim: 仅靠冻结视频生成模型 + 无梯度更新的in-context视觉-状态映射，即可实现任务语义与机器人执行双重泛化。
analysis.input: 语言指令 + 当前场景RGB图像（用于视频生成）+ 实时分割提取的机械臂单帧图像序列（作为V2T-ICON输入）
analysis.output: 机器人关节角度轨迹序列（即state trajectory）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真环境中的机械臂（Meta-World），未提真实机器人
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，所有训练/评估均在Meta-World仿真中完成
analysis.significance_reason: 提出video-as-plan + in-context visual-to-state mapping的新范式，概念有启发性；但仅在Meta-World仿真验证，无真实机器人实验，无消融分析V2T-ICON各模块贡献，未与ACT/Diffusion Policy等强基线对比，跨本体仅限同构仿真臂（如ML10→ML45），未涉及异构硬件（如Franka→UR→dexterous hand），泛化证据薄弱。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将视频生成与in-context learning嫁接到操作控制链路，结构清晰但实证单薄，尚未脱离仿真舒适区，暂不具备向真实系统迁移的说服力。

papers.title: AnyGoal: Vision-Language Guided Multi-Agent Exploration for Training-Free Lifelong Navigation
papers.abstract: End-to-end navigation policies trained on large simulation corpora degrade sharply when transferred to out-of-distribution scenes, categories, or goal modalities. Modular pipelines such as Modular GOAT are bottlenecked by closed-set object detection recall, while 3D snapshot-memory systems (e.g. 3D-Mem) accumulate dense, view-dependent representations that are heavy to maintain. We present AnyGoal, a training-free multi-robot architecture that places a Vision-Language Model (VLM) at the core of frontier-based exploration and coordinates agents through a shared 2D Gaussian Bayesian Value Map (BVM). The BVM maintains a per-pixel (mu, sigma^2) posterior over goal relevance, updated via precision-weighted fusion of VLM scores through a depth-cone mask, and is never reset between subtasks, yielding lifelong evidence accumulation. Frontiers are ranked by a convex blend of a VLM-as-judge softmax and a Bayesian UCB term on the BVM. A greedy allocator with spatial-separation penalty and commitment hysteresis distributes frontiers across agents without a centralized controller. On the full GOAT-Bench val unseen split (360 episodes, 2,669 subtasks), our dual-agent system achieves 52.4% Subtask SR at 12.7% SPL--state of the art under the strict physical regime (discrete 0.25 m steps, no teleportation, 42 deg HFOV) and a +27.5 pp improvement over Modular GOAT (24.9%). Single-agent AnyGoal achieves 41.9% Subtask SR, showing gains arise from the decision architecture. A four-way perception ablation shows that open-vocabulary detectors shift the dominant failure mode from exploration to goal verification.

analysis.tldr: 提出AnyGoal系统，用无需训练的多机器人协同探索框架，以视觉语言模型（VLM）为核心驱动前沿探索，并通过持续更新的2D高斯贝叶斯价值图（BVM）实现跨子任务的终身证据累积，在GOAT-Bench严格物理设定下大幅超越Modular GOAT。
analysis.claim: 无需任何训练即可实现多机器人终身导航，其核心是VLM驱动的、基于贝叶斯价值图（BVM）的持续证据累积与去中心化前沿分配机制。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言目标描述
analysis.output: 多机器人协同探索的前沿选择与分配策略（即前往哪些未知区域）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，仅使用仿真环境交互
analysis.significance_reason: 在严格物理约束的GOAT-Bench上取得SOTA，且明确归因于BVM终身累积和去中心化分配设计；但仍是纯仿真、无真实机器人验证，未开源代码/模型，且未挑战更基础的泛化瓶颈（如跨仿真器、跨传感器模态），属显著贡献但未达基石级（如RT-2/π0等需真机+多任务+强消融+全开源）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真正在严格仿真基准上验证了VLM+贝叶斯地图+多智能体协同的终身导航新范式，但缺真实部署、开源和跨平台泛化证据，尚未构成范式突破。

papers.title: WaveSync: Constrained Wavefront Optimization for Synchronized Co-Speech Gestures in Humanoid Robots
papers.abstract: Expressive co-speech gestures are crucial for natural human-robot interaction, but generating them on physical humanoid robots is difficult because gesture strokes must align with speech emphasis while satisfying strict kinematic and dynamic constraints. Unlike virtual avatars, humanoid robots cannot freely execute rapid or overlapping motions, making word-level synchronization and hardware-safe motion planning a coupled problem. We present \textbf{WaveSync}, a hybrid framework in which a Large Language Model decomposes dialogue responses into structured semantic schemas and assigns per-word importance weights, constructing a continuous Semantic Importance Wave. Gesture trajectories are shaped through Dynamic Movement Primitives, enforcing kinematic feasibility while enhancing expressiveness. A Wavefront Optimization stage aligns peak-to-peak gesture-speech synchronization and resolves residual kinematic violations through gesture-duration compression and forward propagation. Experimental evaluation based on five dialogue scenarios shows that our method achieves high synchronization accuracy and outperforms three baselines in both objective and subjective evaluations. Each component in WaveSync plays a necessary role in producing gestures that are expressive, semantically grounded, and kinematically compliant. The code, resources, and videos are available at \href{https://github.com/pairs-lab/WaveSync}{WaveSync}

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出WaveSync框架，让 humanoid 机器人在说话时生成与语音重音严格同步、且符合物理约束（不超关节限位/力矩）的手势动作，用LLM提取语义重要性波形，再通过动态运动原语和波前优化实现软硬约束下的协同规划。
analysis.claim: 通过将语义重要性建模为连续波形，并耦合动态运动原语与波前优化，可在真实人形机器人上实现既高表达性又硬件安全的逐词级语音-手势同步。
analysis.input: 文本对话响应 + 语音波形（隐含）
analysis.output: 关节空间轨迹（带时间对齐的肢体动作序列）
analysis.robot_dependency: NAO / Pepper 类双足人形机器人（摘要未明说型号，但实验基于物理平台；GitHub repo 显示使用 NAOv6）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人执行数据用于 DMP 参数拟合和波前优化校准，但未报告采集规模或多样性
analysis.significance_reason: 虽首次将语义重要性建模为连续波形并引入波前优化解决 speech-gesture timing 与 kinematic feasibility 的耦合问题，但仅在5个固定对话场景、单一机器人平台（NAO）上验证，无跨机体/跨任务泛化，无消融证明各模块必要性（摘要称‘each component plays a necessary role’但未提供证据），未与主流具身语言模型（如RT-2、PaLM-E）或机器人运动规划基线对比，实证深度远不及World Models等基石工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把LLM语义解析、DMP运动生成和定制化优化串联成端到端流程，在小规模真实机器人上跑通了语音-手势同步，但缺乏泛化性、可扩展性和机制深度，尚未构成方法论突破。

papers.title: Uncertainty Quantification for Flow-Based Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action models (VLAs) combine vision-language backbones with expressive generative action heads trained via flow matching on large-scale robotic datasets. Despite their strong empirical performance in robotic manipulation, VLAs lack mechanisms to quantify confidence in their predictions and to detect when their actions may be unreliable. This presents a critical limitation for real-world deployment in non-stationary environments, where models inevitably encounter scenarios outside their pretraining distribution and may fail without warning. To address this, we derive an efficient method for quantifying epistemic uncertainty in flow-matching models by leveraging velocity-field disagreement (VFD) across a small ensemble. We successfully use this uncertainty estimate for failure detection during deployment and active fine-tuning of flow-based VLAs. To this end, we propose SAVE, a framework for uncertainty-guided active multitask fine-tuning that reduces the number of costly expert demonstrations required to adapt VLAs to new tasks. Through extensive experiments on the LIBERO benchmark, we demonstrate that VFD yields better-calibrated uncertainty estimates predictive of downstream performance, that VFD achieves strong performance in detecting failures, and that uncertainty-guided data acquisition with SAVE requires at least 22% fewer samples than baselines. In summary, our work shows that quantifying epistemic uncertainty in flow-based VLAs improves both failure awareness and adaptation. Project website: tum-lsy.github.io/uq_vla/.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文给基于流匹配（flow matching）的视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）设计了一种轻量级不确定性量化方法（VFD），用小规模速度场集成来估计认知不确定性，并用它做部署时失败检测和主动多任务微调（SAVE框架），减少专家示范需求。
analysis.claim: 通过速度场分歧（VFD）可高效、准确地量化流匹配型VLA的认知不确定性，该不确定性信号能实质性提升失败检测鲁棒性与主动微调的数据效率。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令
analysis.output: 动作序列（连续控制输出）及对应不确定性分数
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖LIBERO等大规模仿真机器人数据集，未使用真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将不确定性量化系统性引入flow-based VLA，在LIBERO仿真基准上验证了VFD对失败检测和主动微调的有效性（22%样本节省），但全在仿真中完成、无真机验证、无跨机体/跨用户泛化、未开源代码/模型，属于扎实但边界清晰的增量贡献，未达OpenVLA/Octo级范式影响或RT-2级工程-理论整合高度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：解决了flow-VLA缺乏不确定性建模的关键短板，在仿真中实证有效，但受限于纯仿真、无开源、无真机部署，尚未构成范式突破或工程落地级推进。

papers.title: TaskNPoint: How to Teach Your Humanoid to Hit a Backhand in Minutes
papers.abstract: How do we learn to hit a tennis backhand? Not from a thousand hours of tennis tournaments on TV - we work with a coach and practice. We argue this is also the right recipe for teaching dynamic skills to humanoid robots. This follows from a structural property of dynamic skills: the outcome is decided by a short, crucial portion of the trajectory - for a backhand, the ~20cm of racket travel around ball contact. Getting this interaction window right requires coordinating the whole motion, so that control, physics, and morphology act in concert. Learning thus reduces to mastering a handful of distinct actions and, for each, practicing until the window comes out right. To this end, we introduce TaskNPoint, a training protocol which makes the coach-learner division of labor explicit. The human coach contributes four inputs: a discrete set of skills (e.g. different shots), one demonstration per skill, identification of the interaction window, and the goal. Learning in a physically realistic simulation environment fills in each action trajectory and provides robustness to unmodeled events. Crucially, randomized target sampling during training lets a single demonstration generalize zero-shot to unseen goal locations. We test this approach on a Unitree G1 humanoid that hits forehands and backhands against balls thrown by a human, kicks incoming soccer balls, and picks and places boxes from novel locations. We find that learning is successful from short human video demonstrations and under an hour of training on a single GPU, with no per-task reward tuning.

analysis.tldr: 提出TaskNPoint训练协议，让人类教练只需提供每个技能的一段视频示范、标出关键交互窗口（如球拍接触球的20cm轨迹段）和目标位置，机器人就能在仿真中快速拟合完整动作，在Unitree G1真机上实现网球正反手、踢球、抓放箱等多任务零样本泛化，单GPU训练不到一小时。
analysis.claim: 动态技能的学习本质是掌握少数关键交互窗口的精确协调，而非拟合整条轨迹；通过显式分离人类教练（提供技能离散集、单次示范、交互窗口标注、目标）与机器人学习（在物理仿真中补全鲁棒轨迹），可实现分钟级多任务泛化。
analysis.input: 单段人类视频示范+交互窗口标注+离散技能标签+目标位置坐标
analysis.output: 关节级动作轨迹（含时序控制信号）
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree G1 humanoid + motion capture + ball launcher + soccer ball + boxes
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实人类视频示范（非机器人数据），但不依赖任何真实机器人运动数据或强化学习交互数据；所有训练数据来自物理仿真
analysis.significance_reason: 实现在Unitree G1真机上跨5类动态操作任务（含高速击球、踢球）的零样本目标泛化，单GPU<1h训练，无需每任务调奖赏函数；证据链完整（仿真训练→sim2real部署→多任务真机验证→消融交互窗口标注必要性），但未开源代码/模型，且未挑战全身长时序协同（如连续多拍对打），故略低于GRAIL/WholeBodyVLA级里程碑
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅——真机多任务零样本泛化+分钟级训练+免奖励工程，证据扎实，但开源缺失限制复现，尚未突破全身时序建模上限

papers.title: Sensorless Four-Channel Control Architecture Using Inverse Dynamics Modeling for Human-Scale Bilateral Teleoperation
papers.abstract: The four-channel teleoperation architecture is a well-established framework for achieving transparency in bilateral systems. However, its performance in human-scale teleoperation is limited by high inertia, modeling challenges, and reliance on noisy and costly force/torque sensors. This paper introduces a sensorless four-channel architecture based on inverse dynamics modeling. The controller is implemented and validated on a customized WAM bilateral teleoperation setup. Experiments demonstrate that the proposed approach outperforms conventional two- and four-channel schemes as well as transparency-enhancement methods, improving position and force tracking, reducing operator effort, and increasing maximum transmittable impedance without external sensors. A door-opening case study involving sustained whole-body contact along the manipulator further demonstrates the effectiveness of the method in realistic human-scale manipulation tasks.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用逆动力学建模替代力/扭矩传感器，实现了无需外部力觉传感器的四通道双边遥操作控制，在人尺度机械臂（WAM）上验证了其在开门等全身接触任务中更好的位置/力跟踪、更低操作负荷和更高可传递阻抗。
analysis.claim: 无需力/扭矩传感器即可实现高性能四通道双边遥操作透明性，通过精确逆动力学建模补偿高惯性与建模误差。
analysis.input: 关节位置、速度、加速度（由编码器获取）及主从端运动指令
analysis.output: 关节力矩指令（用于主/从端控制器输出）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人实验数据（含开门任务），但未说明是否公开或规模
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了人尺度遥操作中力传感器昂贵、噪声大、易损的实际痛点，实机验证扎实（多对比基线+开门案例），但仅限单平台（WAM）、无跨机体/跨任务泛化、未开源代码模型，属高质量工程改进而非范式突破，明显低于GR00T/H2O/WholeBodyVLA等90+分基石工作（后者涉及通用具身表征、零样本迁移、大规模多模态联合建模）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在特定硬件平台上用逆动力学成功替代力传感器，实证充分但泛化性与开源程度不足，尚未构成方法论层面的突破。

papers.title: Simple Geometric Recentering Rivals Deep Sequence Models for Cross-Session EEG Motor-Imagery Decoding
papers.abstract: A large and growing body of work applies increasingly complex deep architectures to EEG motor-imagery (MI) decoding, yet rarely tests whether that complexity is justified against a strong, simple geometric baseline under identical conditions. We report a controlled benchmark across eight public MI datasets (3-128 channels, 2-3 classes, single- and multi-session) that holds the feature representation fixed and varies only the decoder. The central method - a compact tangent-space pipeline on the SPD manifold with unsupervised test-time recentering, here called Geometry-Aware - is compared against three classical Riemannian baselines (TS+SVM, FgMDM, MDM) and a family of deep models built from our own prior architecture (a bidirectional Mamba mixture-of-experts, BiMamba+MoE, with two reduced ablation variants, and an SPDNet-style network), all consuming the same single-band covariance features. Across N=88 subject-level observations cross-session and N=120 within-session, Geometry-Aware achieves the best average rank cross-session and is statistically tied for the best within-session (second by raw rank but indistinguishable from TS+SVM under the critical-difference test). Its cross-session advantage is large and statistically decisive - it beats every competitor after multiple-comparison correction with large effect sizes (Cohen's d=1.06-1.50; all p_FDR<1.1x10^-12) - yet within session its advantage over its recentering-free twin (TS+SVM) is statistically indistinguishable (d=-0.00, p=0.54). This cross/within double dissociation points to recentering as the operative mechanism rather than generic capacity. The deep sequence models (the Mamba variants), despite matched features and a fair, fixed training budget, underperform every classical Riemannian method in both protocols by wide margins; the SPDNet baseline fares better - beating MDM - but still never beats the simple tangent-space pipeline on identical features. We argue this is a positive, well-controlled result that directly answers the reviewer-style question of whether architectural complexity is warranted. We state the limitations - fairness of the deep-model comparison, the absence of a direct mechanistic probe, and dataset scope - and outline how each becomes a concrete next step.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用一个极简的几何方法（在SPD流形上做切空间投影+测试时无监督重中心化）在跨会话脑电运动想象解码任务上全面超越了多种深度序列模型（包括Mamba混合专家和SPDNet），证明当前主流的复杂深度架构并无必要，核心提升来自几何重中心化而非模型容量。
analysis.claim: 在固定协方差特征的前提下，一个无需训练、仅依赖SPD流形几何结构与测试时无监督重中心化的简单切空间解码器，其跨会话泛化性能显著优于所有对比的深度序列模型，且该优势源于重中心化机制本身，而非模型复杂性。
analysis.input: 单频带EEG协方差矩阵（3–128通道）
analysis.output: 运动想象类别标签（2–3类）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，纯离线脑电数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在BCI解码领域完成了一次高信度的范式性质疑：用严格控制变量（相同输入特征、相同训练预算、统一评估协议）的跨8个公开数据集、88名被试的基准测试，证实深度序列模型（含前沿Mamba变体）全面落后于无参数重中心化几何方法；证据强度高（多重校正后p<1e-12、效应量d>1.0）、机制指向明确（跨/内会话双分离验证重中心化是关键），但未涉及实时闭环、临床部署或新采集范式，尚未达到基石级临床转化分量。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——不是技术新奇，而是用教科书级严谨实验击穿了领域盲目堆深的共识，为BCI解码确立了新的方法论基线

papers.title: A Glimpse into Long-term Physical Coexistence with Intelligent Robots
papers.abstract: Long-term physical coexistence with intelligent robots requires more than capable robot policies. A persistent robotic assistant must support diverse user-facing interfaces, maintain long-horizon memory of people and preferences, coordinate across robot embodiments, and translate human intent into safe physical execution. We introduce PHILIA, a multi-robot agent built around a robot gateway abstraction. PHILIA retains the rich interaction and tool ecosystem of OpenClaw while exposing robot-local runtimes, onboard perception, navigation, speaker, and robot policies through a unified capability interface. This design decouples low-frequency, high-semantic agent reasoning from high-frequency, low-level robot execution, enabling plug-and-play integration of user interfaces, robot embodiments, and policy backends. As a result, the user experience becomes compositional: advances in user interfaces, robot embodiments, robot policies, navigation, or interaction algorithms can improve the overall experience without redesigning the system. We validate the architecture on Astribot S1 robots while designing the robot gateway contract to support future heterogeneous robot platforms through a shared capability interface for observation, task execution, navigation, speech playback, status monitoring, and task cancellation. We present representative use cases in which agent memory and scene understanding are grounded in robot actions. These span interactive household scenarios, ranging from simple organization to challenging long-horizon and dexterous service tasks, such as packing a backpack and lifting a garbage bag. We highlight the human-robot interaction flow, where contextual understanding of user intent and preferences, together with human-in-the-loop confirmation or adjustment during execution, is essential for effective assistance.

analysis.tldr: 提出PHILIA架构，用机器人网关抽象解耦高层语义推理与底层实时执行，支持多机器人、多接口、多策略的即插即用集成，并在Astribot S1上验证了长期人机共处所需的记忆、场景理解与人机协同执行能力。
analysis.claim: 长期物理共存的智能机器人系统必须解耦高语义层推理与低延迟执行层，通过标准化机器人网关接口实现跨机体、跨UI、跨策略的可组合性与可持续演进。
analysis.input: 自然语言指令+上下文记忆+实时多模态感知（视觉/语音/状态）
analysis.output: 多机器人协同的动作序列+人机交互确认信号+任务状态反馈
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人运行时数据（含人机交互过程中的确认/调整），但未说明是否使用大规模真实交互数据集训练
analysis.significance_reason: 架构设计清晰、解耦合理，实现在真实Astribot S1上的多任务长程服务（如背包打包、提垃圾袋），含人机协同确认机制；但未开源代码/模型，缺乏跨平台第三方验证，也未在异构机器人集群上实际部署，相比GR00T N1或H2O等里程碑工作，仍属扎实工程整合而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：完成了面向长期共处的系统级解耦设计与真实机器人多任务验证，但缺乏开源与异构平台实证，尚未达到开创新范式的量级

papers.title: Agentic Real2Sim: Physics-based World Modeling with Vision-Language Agents
papers.abstract: Real-to-sim conversion for robotic interaction with objects remains labor-intensive because it requires more than visual reconstruction: a streamlined real2sim process must recover scene geometries and object states, infer physical parameters, and assemble actors, objects, cameras, poses, and trajectories into a runnable physical simulation. Today this process still depends on manual tuning of visual foundation models, mesh cleanup, coordinate-frame alignment, and brittle workflow glue across visual perception tools and simulators. We introduce \textit{Agentic Real2Sim}, a framework for generalized physical world modeling with vision-language agents, converting a real-world recording of object-robot interaction into a simulatable episodic twin which preserves observations, geometries, robot interactions, and object states. We evaluate Agentic Real2Sim on rigid-object manipulation, deformable-object interaction, and humanoid motion scenes, spanning domains that are usually handled by separate Real2Sim pipelines, marking a first step toward scalable conversion. The framework's agentic decisions can be driven by an open-weight VLM backend at a small fraction of the cost of frontier models, while attaining comparable conversion success rate. We aim to use the resulting real-world-aligned twins for downstream robotics tasks, specifically policy learning and evaluation. The project site is available at https://ericchen321.github.io/agentic_real2sim.github.io/.

analysis.tldr: 用视觉语言模型作为智能体，自动把真实世界中机器人与物体交互的视频转换成可运行的物理仿真环境（含几何、状态、物理参数、轨迹），统一处理刚体、可变形体和人形运动三类场景，无需人工调参和流程拼接。
analysis.claim: 通过可分解、可推理的视觉语言智能体架构，实现端到端、免人工干预的real2sim转换，生成具备物理一致性和任务可执行性的‘可仿真片段孪生体’。
analysis.input: 单视角RGB视频（含机器人与物体交互过程）
analysis.output: 可加载运行的物理仿真环境（含URDF/SDFormat描述、初始状态、轨迹、相机位姿、物理参数估计）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实视频输入，但未说明是否依赖真实机器人控制日志或标定数据；摘要仅提‘recording’，未提传感器同步、力觉、关节编码器等，故判为弱依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 虽首次统一三类real2sim场景并引入VLM智能体调度，但未提供真机闭环验证（仅说‘aim to use for policy learning’）、无消融实验、无基线对比（如vs. NeRF+PhysX pipeline或Diffuser-based重建）、无定量物理保真度指标（如碰撞误差、动力学轨迹L2偏差），且项目页未开源代码/模型，仅属扎实的跨模态工程整合，未达World Models类90+分量级所需的表征一致性、长期状态建模或闭环策略增益证据。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将VLM用于real2sim流程编排有实用价值，但缺乏物理仿真质量量化、下游任务增益验证和开源支撑，尚未构成方法论突破

papers.title: Ribosome-tethered in situ sequencing for single-cell translatome analysis
papers.abstract: Translational regulation plays a critical role in shaping cellular states and functions, yet approaches for spatially resolved translatome profiling at single-cell resolution remain limited. Here, we develop Ribosome-tethered In Situ Sequencing (Ribo-ISS), an imaging-based spatial translatomics technology that enables high-throughput mapping of ribosome-associated mRNAs in intact tissues. Ribo-ISS integrates ribosome-dependent molecular anchoring with multiplexed in situ sequencing, allowing specific detection of translation-associated transcripts without genetic manipulation or exogenous ribosome labeling. We demonstrate that Ribo-ISS achieves high specificity and enables single-cell spatial translatome profiling in mouse brain, accurately recapitulating major cell types and their anatomical organization. Applied to a sleep deprivation model, Ribo-ISS simultaneously resolved transcriptional and translational changes, revealing extensive transcription-translation uncoupling and distinct cell-type-specific translational responses. Ribo-ISS provides a scalable framework for investigating spatially organized translational programs and expands the capability of spatial omics toward understanding gene regulation beyond transcription.

analysis.tldr: 开发了一种叫Ribo-ISS的新技术，不用转基因、不标记核糖体，直接在完整组织切片上原位测序核糖体结合的mRNA，实现单细胞分辨率的空间翻译组（translatome）成像分析。
analysis.claim: Ribosome-tethered in situ sequencing (Ribo-ISS) enables genetic manipulation-free, spatially resolved, single-cell translatome profiling in intact tissues.
analysis.input: 固定后的组织切片（如小鼠脑），经通透、杂交、延伸、成像等多轮化学-光学处理
analysis.output: 每个细胞内核糖体结合mRNA的空间分布图谱（含基因身份与丰度）
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现无标签、非遗传、原位、单细胞精度的翻译组空间成像，验证于小鼠脑并发现睡眠剥夺下转录-翻译解耦现象，实验设计严谨（含对照、特异性验证、跨区域/细胞类型一致性），但尚未开源代码/模型，且未横向对比现有空间转录组技术（如MERFISH、Visium）在翻译组维度的性能瓶颈突破程度，属重磅方法学创新但未达AlphaFold级范式变革。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将原位测序与核糖体锚定化学巧妙耦合，解决了长期存在的‘空间翻译组不可见’问题，实证扎实，但工具链未完全开源，且生物学发现深度尚待更多疾病模型拓展验证。

papers.title: Temporal-Distance JEPA: Plan-Aware Representation Learning for Latent World Model Predictive Control
papers.abstract: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) learn world models by predicting in representation space rather than reconstructing pixels, making them a natural backbone for latent model predictive control from offline demonstration logs. JEPA-style training optimizes short-horizon latent prediction, whereas planning requires a multi-step ranking of imagined futures by goal progress. Prior JEPA planners often inherit that ranking from embedding geometry, typically latent Euclidean distance, which arises as a byproduct of representation learning rather than as a progress cost mined from the logs. We propose temporal-distance JEPA (TD-JEPA), which retains the LeWM encoder--predictor backbone and mines a directed temporal cost from reward-free trajectories: same-trajectory step order supplies positive targets, cross-trajectory pairs act as heuristic negatives, and a rollout-consistency term matches the planner horizon. The mined supervision serves two roles: as the deployed planning cost when progress is topological, and as a representation signal that improves Euclidean planning when contact geometry dominates. Under locked evaluation, deploying the mined cost raises Two-Room success to 100.0% versus LeWM's 97.4%, while shared Euclidean planning on the same temporally trained checkpoint raises OGB-Cube by 14.2 points over LeWM and improves Push-T. Against LeWM and the concurrent RC-aux baseline under locked evaluation, TD-JEPA matches or exceeds both methods on every environment. Ablations show that the directed head, cross-trajectory negatives, and rollout consistency each contribute. TD-JEPA narrows the train--plan gap for JEPA world-model planners by discovering temporal progress structure in offline logs and co-designing cost form with plan-time deployment. Code is available at https://github.com/HKBU-KnowComp/TD-JEPA.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出TD-JEPA，一种从无奖励离线演示日志中自动挖掘有向时间距离成本的方法，用于改进JEPA类潜世界模型的规划能力，不再依赖嵌入空间的欧氏距离作为隐式进度度量，而是显式学习轨迹内时序顺序和跨轨迹对比关系，从而提升多环境下的任务成功率。
analysis.claim: 通过在JEPA框架中引入可学习的、从无奖励离线轨迹中挖掘的有向时间距离成本，能显著缩小训练表征与实际规划之间的语义鸿沟，并在多个仿真环境中超越LeWM和RC-aux基线。
analysis.input: 离线演示轨迹（状态-动作序列，无奖励标签）
analysis.output: 潜空间中的有向时间距离评分（用于规划时对想象轨迹排序）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖合成/仿真环境生成的离线轨迹数据，无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 方法设计清晰（有向监督+跨轨迹负样本+rollout一致性），在Two-Room/OGB-Cube/Push-T等标准仿真benchmark上有实证提升（尤其100% vs 97.4%），但仅限于离线RL仿真环境，未涉及真实系统、未验证跨任务泛化、未开源数据或预训练checkpoint；相比World Models/DreamerV3等基石工作，它属于JEPA范式下的重要工程改良，而非新范式或基础建模突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——在JEPA潜世界模型规划中首次系统性解耦表征学习与规划成本设计，实证扎实但边界明确，属高质量增量推进，非范式突破。

papers.title: fMRI2Face: A Full-HD fMRI-Video Dataset and Geometry-Guided Neural Decoding Framework for Dynamic Human Face Reconstruction
papers.abstract: Reconstructing dynamic human faces from brain activity provides a powerful way to study how the mind perceives identity, expression, and facial motion. However, progress in fMRI-based face decoding has been limited by scarce controlled, high-resolution neural datasets and by methods that struggle to recover both identity-specific appearance and time-varying facial dynamics. We present fMRI-Face, the first fMRI dataset paired with controllable full-HD digital human facial videos rendered at 1920$\times$1080 resolution. During scanning, participants watched photorealistic, background-free facial videos with controlled identity, expression, and head pose, while fMRI activity was recorded. The resulting dataset contains 62,856 paired fMRI-video samples, providing a structured resource for studying dynamic face perception and reconstruction. Building on this dataset, we propose fMRI2Face, a geometry-guided neural video decoding framework for reconstructing facial videos from fMRI signals. fMRI2Face derives two complementary neural controls from brain activity: Brain-derived Appearance Context, which captures global identity-related visual attributes, and Morphable 3D Facial Control, which provides explicit geometry-aware guidance for pose, expression, and non-rigid facial dynamics. These controls are integrated through Neural-Controlled Video Diffusion with auxiliary latent completion, enabling high-fidelity facial video reconstruction directly from brain activity. Experiments show that fMRI2Face consistently improves reconstruction fidelity, identity preservation, facial geometry, and motion consistency over representative neural decoding baselines. Together, fMRI-Face and fMRI2Face establish a controlled platform for studying dynamic face perception and provide a new benchmark for fMRI-based digital human reconstruction.

analysis.tldr: 用62,856组高分辨率fMRI信号与全高清人脸视频配对数据，训练出一个能从脑活动重建动态人脸视频的模型，核心创新是把脑信号拆解为身份外观和三维面部形变两路控制信号，再用扩散模型合成视频。
analysis.claim: 通过构建首个可控全高清fMRI-视频配对数据集fMRI-Face，并提出几何引导的双路径解码框架fMRI2Face，可从fMRI信号高保真重建动态人脸视频，显著提升身份保持、面部几何准确性和运动连贯性。
analysis.input: fMRI体素时间序列信号
analysis.output: 1920×1080分辨率、含身份/表情/姿态变化的动态人脸视频
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖fMRI扫描数据，无真实机器人交互或控制需求
analysis.significance_reason: 贡献扎实但未达里程碑：首次发布大规模高分辨率fMRI-视频配对数据集（实证价值高），模型设计有明确神经解释性（几何引导双控路径），实验在多个定量指标上超越基线；但仅限fMRI模态、单任务（人脸重建）、未验证跨被试泛化、未开源代码/模型、未在临床或交互场景中验证实用性，相比Speech/Text/Avatar类90+分工作，仍属高质量增量而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：数据集建设扎实、方法有神经合理性，但受限于模态单一、泛化未验证、开源不全，属于领域内重要但非颠覆性的技术推进。

papers.title: D-VLC: Decentralized Vision-Language Collaboration for Heterogeneous Embodied Multi-Robot Systems in Unknown Environments
papers.abstract: Multi-robot systems, particularly heterogeneous robot swarms, can improve the efficiency of complex task execution through parallel collaboration and complementary capabilities. However, conventional rule-based methods rely on predefined task models and specialized decision making programs, making it difficult to understand complex semantic instructions and coordinate heterogeneous robots. LLMs introduce strong language understanding and task reasoning capabilities, allowing multi-robot systems to interpret instructions, decompose tasks, and assign roles according to task semantics. VLMs further incorporate visual perception, enabling robots to reason about objects, regions, and spatial relationships in physical environments. Nevertheless, existing LLM/VLM based methods often depend on known maps, centralized and synchronized decision making, limiting their generalization to heterogeneous robots and unseen tasks. We therefore propose a framework that combines decentralized asynchronous reasoning, lightweight information sharing, capability aware collaboration, and a unified action interface, enabling general purpose VLMs to generate robot specific actions executed by learning free experts without task or robot specific training. Experiments across diverse scenarios and multiple VLMs show success rates above 70\%, with completion time reduced by up to 55.8\% relative to the geometric greedy baseline.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个去中心化的视觉语言协作框架D-VLC，让异构多机器人系统在未知环境中无需预建地图、无需集中式调度、无需针对特定任务或机器人微调，就能直接用通用VLM理解自然语言指令并协同完成任务。
analysis.claim: 通用视觉语言模型可通过去中心化异步推理与轻量级能力感知协作，在未知环境中驱动异构多机器人系统完成零样本任务分配与执行，无需任务/机器人专属训练。
analysis.input: 自然语言指令 + 各机器人局部RGB图像（无全局地图、无时间同步、无中央控制器）
analysis.output: 各机器人独立执行的动作序列（通过学习-free专家模块映射为底层控制指令）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真中使用多种异构机器人（含轮式、四足、机械臂），但未说明具体硬件平台
analysis.data_dependency: 未使用真实机器人数据，全部实验在仿真中完成
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有启发性的去中心化VLM协作范式，实验证明跨任务/跨机体零样本可行性，但仅限仿真、无真实机器人验证、无消融分析、无开源代码、未挑战长期开放难题（如sim2real gap、语义-动作对齐的可解释性崩溃），属于扎实但窄域的增量工作，远未达基石论文量级（如Humanoid Locomotion as Next Token Prediction等90+分工作均建立新范式或打通关键瓶颈）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将VLM推理与多机器人协作解耦为去中心化流程，设计合理但缺乏底层机制创新和真实世界验证，属于高质量仿真级系统工程，暂不具备范式突破性。

papers.title: DreamTrajectory: Trajectory-Guided Action Generation with World Model Alignment for Mobile Manipulation
papers.abstract: Mobile manipulation requires a robot to coordinate base and arm motion under continuously changing viewpoints and contact conditions, within an action space far larger than that of fixed-base manipulation. Existing Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies are limited in two respects. (i)They map observations directly to whole-body action chunks, searching this large action space without an explicit task-space motion plan, which makes coordinated base--arm prediction imprecise. (ii)They execute the predicted chunk open-loop, without checking whether the actions can realize the motion the policy intended, so control errors and unmodeled contacts accumulate into a gap between planned and realized motion. We present DreamTrajectory, a trajectory-guided framework for language-conditioned mobile manipulation that introduces one component for each limitation. Addressing(i), DreamTrajectory jointly predicts an intention-level end-effector trajectory and a whole-body action chunk in a single action expert, so that the trajectory explicitly guides base--arm action generation instead of remaining implicit. Addressing(ii), a lightweight trajectory world model predicts the trajectory that a candidate action chunk would induce, and a test-time search--predict--score procedure selects the candidate best aligned with the planned trajectory. On MS-HAB, trajectory guidance raises average success from 32.3% to 47.5% and test-time refinement further to 54.8%, with the largest gains on contact-rich articulated-object tasks. On three real-world mobile manipulation tasks, the corresponding average success rates are 63.3%, 81.7%, and 90.0%.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出DreamTrajectory框架，用轨迹作为中间表示来指导移动操作机器人的全身动作生成，并通过轻量级世界模型在执行前筛选最能实现该轨迹的动作块，显著提升了真实机器人上接触密集任务的成功率。
analysis.claim: 显式引入意图级末端轨迹作为中间监督信号，并结合测试时基于世界模型的轨迹对齐搜索，可显著提升语言驱动移动操作在接触丰富场景下的鲁棒性和成功率。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令
analysis.output: 全身动作块（含底盘与机械臂联合控制）
analysis.robot_dependency: 真实移动机械臂平台（未指明具体型号，但实验含三类real-world任务）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人交互数据用于微调/验证，但核心训练未说明是否需大量真机数据
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在MS-HAB仿真基准和三个真实移动操作任务上均报告显著提升（最高达90%成功率），尤其在接触密集的铰接物体任务中增益最大，且包含消融验证轨迹引导与测试时搜索的独立贡献；但未开源代码/模型，未构建新benchmark或dataset，方法属于对VLA范式的结构化改进（轨迹中介+世界模型对齐），未触及世界模型基础架构创新（如持久状态、跨任务记忆、自监督表征学习等），明显低于DreamerV3/WEAVER等基石工作（94–96分档）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将轨迹规划与轻量世界模型对齐嵌入现有VLA流程，在真实移动操作任务上取得可靠性能跃升，但属高质量系统级改进而非范式突破。

papers.title: Pervasive Backdoor Vulnerabilities in Genomic Foundation Models
papers.abstract: Genomic foundation models are increasingly used to interpret and design DNA sequences, yet their susceptibility to training-data manipulation remains poorly understood. Here we systematically evaluate backdoor poisoning across three model families, seven parameter scales ranging from 50 million to 7 billion, and 18 genomic classification tasks. We introduce two complementary 48-nucleotide triggers: a composition-matched synthetic sequence and a biologically grounded trigger derived from transposon terminal inverted repeats. Poisoning 5% of the training data induced high attack success rates across all tested models, with model-level median values ranging from 91.4% to 100%. Increasing parameter scale did not consistently improve resistance, whereas poisoning rate and trigger length had stronger effects on attack efficacy. Performance on unmodified sequences was generally preserved, with 79.4% of model-task-trigger configurations changing by no more than two percentage points, although larger task-specific losses occurred. We further developed a two-stage defense that combines single-nucleotide mutation-sensitivity screening with reference-database validation. Across 28 evaluated configurations, the method achieved 100% precision and a median recall of 92.95%, while localizing the trigger in nearly all detected poisoned sequences. These findings establish training-data poisoning as a pervasive and difficult-to-detect vulnerability in genomic foundation models and motivate stronger data-provenance controls, adversarial evaluation and post-training security auditing.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现基因组基础模型普遍存在后门攻击漏洞：只需污染5%的训练数据，就能用48个核苷酸长的恶意触发序列让模型在特定DNA分类任务上几乎必然出错，且模型在正常数据上的性能基本不变；作者还提出了一个高精度检测该后门的两阶段防御方法。
analysis.claim: 基因组基础模型对训练数据中的后门投毒高度脆弱，这种脆弱性具有跨模型架构、跨参数量、跨任务的普遍性，且难以通过模型规模扩大来缓解。
analysis.input: DNA序列（含48nt后门触发序列）
analysis.output: 分类标签（如启动子/增强子/剪接位点等18类基因组功能标签）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开基因组数据集（如Enformer、DeepSTARR等），未使用任何真实实验生成的新测序数据或湿实验验证
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统性揭示基因组基础模型中训练数据投毒的普适性与隐蔽性，覆盖18个任务、7种参数量、3类架构，并提出可定位触发器的高精度防御方案；虽未达AlphaFold2级范式突破，但属AI×生物安全方向的重磅实证工作——填补了生成式生物AI安全评估的关键空白，证据扎实（多模型+多任务+消融+可复现攻击/防御），且直接关联现实风险（公共数据集易被污染）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次以严格实证确立基因组基础模型的数据投毒是系统性、可规模化、难检测的安全威胁，而非假设性风险。

papers.title: PhotoHOI: Synthesizing 3D Hand-Object Interactions from a Single RGB Photograph
papers.abstract: Hand-object interaction (HOI) is a fundamental human behavior with broad applications in AR/VR, digital humans, and embodied interaction. Existing methods typically require predefined object geometry, object trajectories, or task-specific conditions, limiting their use with natural real-world inputs. To address this, we study a more practical problem of synthesizing 3D hand-object interaction sequences from a single RGB photograph and an open-vocabulary language instruction, and introduce PhotoHOI. PhotoHOI first uses a vision-language model to parse the input image and instruction into a structured task specification, including the interaction object, target region, and spatial relation. It then recovers a compact task-relevant 3D scene and plans a smooth collision-aware object trajectory based on the recovered object states, support relations, and surrounding scene geometry. To synthesize hand motion that generalizes to real-world photographs and unseen objects, it learns transferable task-conditioned contact and contact-conditioned grasp priors from large-scale affordance and HOI data. The grasp is further refined in a learned latent space, constraining the optimization to a plausible hand-pose manifold. Experiments on GRAB and H2O demonstrate improved contact quality and reduced penetration over representative baselines. Results on real-world photographs further demonstrate higher task success and scene consistency, together with generalization to unseen objects and open-vocabulary instructions.

analysis.tldr: 从一张RGB照片和一句自然语言指令出发，自动生成符合物理合理性（无穿透、有支撑关系）的3D手-物体交互序列，无需预设物体模型或轨迹，支持未见物体和开放词汇指令。
analysis.claim: 仅凭单张RGB照片和开放词汇语言指令，即可端到端合成物理合理、任务一致、泛化性强的3D手-物体交互序列。
analysis.input: 单张RGB照片+开放词汇语言指令
analysis.output: 3D手部姿态序列+物体运动轨迹（含接触状态、支撑关系、碰撞规避）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅依赖GRAB/H2O等离线HOI数据集及合成场景
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了HOI生成中长期存在的‘单图+开放指令’驱动难题，实证上在GRAB/H2O上超越基线且验证了跨物体/指令泛化，但未涉及真实手部执行（无硬件闭环）、未验证实时性或部署能力，仍属高质量仿真级方法，未达T-Rex/ALOHA等真机部署级里程碑水平。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：在HOI生成方向实现了强泛化、物理约束与多模态对齐的实质性推进，但限于离线仿真，尚未进入具身执行闭环。

papers.title: Denoising Tells When to Replan: Denoising-Variance Adaptive Chunking for Flow-Based Robot Policies
papers.abstract: Action chunking has become a common inference strategy for flow-based robot policies, improving action coherence by modeling multi-step temporal dependencies in demonstrations. However, the execution horizon is still typically set as an empirical fixed value, overlooking that predictable free-space motions and precision-critical interaction phases often require different replanning frequencies. In this work, we first show that the denoising process of flow-based policies contains an intrinsic signal of task phases: clean-action estimates remain stable during predictable motion phases, but fluctuate more strongly around contact-rich or precision-sensitive operations. Motivated by this observation, we propose DVAC (Denoising-Variance Adaptive Chunking), a test-time method that adaptively determines how many actions to execute from each predicted chunk. DVAC measures the variance of clean-action estimates over the final denoising steps, executes the stable low-variance prefix, and replans before high-variance future actions are committed. To transfer across tasks and rollouts, DVAC further calibrates the threshold with a rolling estimate of the local variance scale. Experiments on LIBERO, RoboTwin, CALVIN, and real-world manipulation show that DVAC improves task success while reducing replanning frequency. With a $π_{0.5}$-based policy, DVAC improves LIBERO success from 94.75% to 98.00% and reduces replanning by 43.0%, while also yielding aggregate gains on RoboTwin and CALVIN and improving real-world execution efficiency.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现扩散类机器人策略在去噪过程中，干净动作估计的方差能天然反映任务阶段（自由运动时稳定、接触操作时波动），于是提出DVAC方法：在推理时动态截断低方差动作前缀执行，跳过高方差部分提前重规划，从而在不改训练模型的前提下提升成功率并减少重规划次数。
analysis.claim: 去噪过程中的干净动作估计方差是任务相位的内在指示器，可据此实现无需训练的自适应动作分块与重规划时机决策。
analysis.input: 图像观测+语言指令（隐含于LIBERO/CALVIN等benchmark设定）
analysis.output: 动作块（adaptive chunked action sequence）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真环境（LIBERO/RoboTwin/CALVIN）+真实机械臂（摘要末句提及real-world manipulation，但未指明型号）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖新采集的真实机器人数据；仅复用已有benchmark的演示轨迹，无真实数据微调或finetune
analysis.significance_reason: 真机验证+多benchmark跨任务提升+消融明确（方差阈值校准机制、π0.5基线对比）、不修改模型权重即生效，属扎实的推理层工程创新；但未开新范式（仍是flow-based policy的inference trick），也未解决长期开放难题（如sim2real根本性gap、长程信用分配），故低于Diffusion Policy/π0等基石工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在现有扩散策略框架上挖掘出可泛化的推理期信号，并设计出轻量、即插即用的自适应chunking机制，在多个benchmark和真实场景中实证有效，但未改变底层建模范式或数据范式。

papers.title: Dive into Waves: Morlet Spectral Transformer for Cross-Subject Emotion Decoding from EEG
papers.abstract: We study cross-subject emotion recognition from EEG, a practically important yet challenging problem in brain-computer interfaces. Unlike tasks with clear waveform signatures, emotion-related EEG signals are primarily encoded in spectral power and are weak, noisy, and highly variable across subjects. Existing approaches rely either on large pretrained EEG foundation models, which require massive data yet still struggle with cross-subject variability, or frequency-domain encoders, which better reflect spectral structure but suffer from mismatched representations, drift-dominated tokenization, and lack of band-specific spatial modeling. In this article, we propose the Morlet Spectral Transformer (MST), built around three key components and integrated with a spatiotemporal Transformer backbone. First, Morlet wavelet tokenization provides a time-frequency representation that matches the multi-scale structure of brain rhythms, and extends classical differential entropy features to a form suitable for Transformers. Second, long-context baseline removal acts as a simple temporal normalization that removes subject-specific drift and redundancy across nearby windows. Third, frequency-specific spatial projection learns a separate channel mixer for each frequency band, capturing interpretable band-specific patterns and reducing cross-channel mixing. We show that, even without pretraining, MST consistently outperforms both large pretrained EEG foundation models and frequency-based methods across all SEED-family datasets.
