papers.title: Geometry-Aware Motion Latents for Learning Robust Manipulation Policies
papers.abstract: Learning motion latents for robotic manipulation heavily relies on extracting motion patterns from visual sequences, yet effective action abstractions require understanding three-dimensional geometric transformations. Here, we introduce GeoMoLa (Geometry-Aware Motion Latents), which learns discrete motion latent codes by predicting how point clouds evolve during manipulation rather than reconstructing visual observations. This four-dimensional objective -- spatial geometry changing through time -- forces latent representations to encode actual physical motion rather than appearance patterns. GeoMoLa achieves state-of-the-art performance using only single-view RGB-D input, while existing methods require multi-view reconstruction, succeeding across diverse manipulation benchmarks. Our ablations reveal that geometric prediction is the key to driving performance, quantitatively validating that manipulation depends on spatial understanding. Furthermore, the learned codes exhibit effective motion abstraction: applying them to novel scenes produces physically consistent transformations regardless of visual context. Our real-world experiments also confirm this robustness capability, achieving robust manipulation with minimal demonstrations in cluttered environments where geometric reasoning determines success. Thus, we demonstrate that effective motion latents for robot control can better emerge from understanding motion through its three-dimensional effects rather than pixel-level patterns.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出GeoMoLa方法，不靠重建图像或视频，而是直接预测点云在操作过程中的三维几何演化（四维时空变化），从而学习出对几何变化敏感的离散动作隐码，让机器人仅用单视角RGB-D就能在杂乱环境中鲁棒抓取和操作。
analysis.claim: 运动隐码的有效性根本上取决于对三维几何演化（而非像素外观）的建模，这种几何感知的隐码能泛化到新场景并支撑真实机器人上的少样本鲁棒操作。
analysis.input: 单视角RGB-D图像（含深度点云）
analysis.output: 离散运动隐码序列（用于驱动下游策略）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真中生成的点云演化数据；真实实验仅用于验证，未说明是否依赖真实机器人采集的数据训练
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在多个标准操纵基准（包括真实机械臂）上超越多视角SOTA，消融明确证明几何预测是性能主因，且真实实验展示少样本+杂乱环境下的鲁棒性；但未开源代码/模型，未覆盖dexterous/tactile/teleoperation等高分基石所强调的接触物理建模、触觉闭环或双臂协同，属强几何表征驱动的策略抽象突破，尚未达T-Rex/ALOHA级范式变革或工程整合深度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将三维几何演化建模系统性嵌入运动隐码学习框架，在单视角输入下达成真实机器人少样本鲁棒操作，证据充分但开源缺失、未触及接触物理核心，属高质量增量推进而非范式突破

papers.title: Discrete Ricci Curvature on Protein Contact Graphs for Lightweight Fold Classification
papers.abstract: Protein fold classification can be approached via sequence-based representations or structural descriptors, but direct comparisons between lightweight handcrafted descriptors and pretrained protein language model embeddings remain limited. We investigate discrete Ricci curvature on Calpha contact graphs as a lightweight structural descriptor for fold classification. Each protein domain is represented by a 22-dimensional fixed-length feature derived from summary statistics and quantiles of Ollivier-Ricci and Forman-Ricci edge curvature distributions. We evaluate on CATH top-10 Topology classification and on the ASTRAL 40%-identity SCOPe top-10 Fold benchmark, comparing against geometry, contact-graph statistics, persistent homology, and mean-pooled ESM-2 (150M) baselines. On both datasets, lightweight structural descriptors substantially outperform mean-pooled ESM-2 embeddings, with a larger performance gap on the ASTRAL 40% SCOPe benchmark. Ricci alone uses 22 dimensions, or 3.4% of the ESM-2 baseline dimensionality, and already outperforms mean-pooled ESM-2 on both datasets. Combining Ricci with persistent homology yields the strongest performance, achieving macro-F1 of 0.71 on CATH and 0.68 on SCOPe with a 112-dimensional feature vector. These results identify a regime where lightweight interpretable graph descriptors offer a practical alternative to pretrained protein language model embeddings.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用离散里奇曲率（Ollivier-Ricci和Forman-Ricci）提取蛋白质Cα接触图的22维固定长度结构特征，仅靠这个极轻量特征就在CATH和SCOPe折叠分类任务上超过均值池化的ESM-2（150M参数）嵌入，且组合持久同调后达到当前轻量方法中的最优性能。
analysis.claim: 离散里奇曲率作为蛋白质接触图的轻量、可解释图结构描述符，在折叠分类任务中以不到4%的维度开销显著超越大规模预训练蛋白语言模型的均值池化嵌入。
analysis.input: 蛋白质Cα原子接触图（边由距离阈值定义）
analysis.output: 22维固定长度向量（Ricci曲率分布的统计摘要与分位数）
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 虽在轻量结构描述符方向有清晰创新（首次系统验证Ricci曲率对蛋白折叠判别的有效性），但未提出新模型架构、未开源代码、未覆盖主流fold-level下游任务（如功能预测/稳定性建模）、未与端到端微调ESM-2或ESMFold对比，仅在经典分类benchmark上击败mean-pooled ESM-2——属扎实增量，但远未达基石级（如ESM-2/AlphaFold2级）的范式突破或通用性提升。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：首次实证Ricci曲率作为极轻量结构先验的有效性，但缺乏开源、泛化验证和与SOTA端到端方法的公平对比，尚未构成范式转移。

papers.title: From Perception to Assistance: Open-Vocabulary Shared Autonomy for Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Teleoperating a robotic manipulator in industrial environments demands precision that camera-based interfaces alone struggle to deliver. The operator must align the end-effector with a target in clutter, under limited depth perception, and without colliding with the surrounding structures. This paper presents a shared-autonomy framework that assists the operator throughout this process. A single RGB-D camera captures the operator's arm motion and hand gestures without wearables, fiducials, or a calibration stage. The intended target is specified by a free-form text prompt, grounded by a vision-language model in the robot's gripper camera, and tracked across its onboard cameras by a promptable video-segmentation model, resulting in a grasp frame continuously separated from the obstacle map. Every commanded motion is executed by a GPU-accelerated model-predictive controller that enforces self- and environment-collision avoidance against an online volumetric reconstruction, while a potential field corrects the operator's reference toward the grounded target during the final approach. An autonomous mode can be gesture-triggered to complete the grasp on the same target without a separate perception pipeline. The framework is validated on a quadruped mobile manipulator. The interface achieves a positional RMSE of 59 mm relative to motion-capture ground truth, and the controller keeps the arm at least 18 cm from obstacles while the operator deliberately commands the arm into them by 6 cm. In an industrial valve manipulation and a pick-and-place task, the full framework succeeded in all trials, while ablating either the collision or the assistance module produced failures through complementary mechanisms, and autonomous execution succeeded in four of five trials per task.

analysis.tldr: 用单个RGB-D相机无标定捕捉操作员手势和臂动，结合开放词汇文本指令（如'拧开红色阀门'）定位目标，通过视觉语言模型+可提示视频分割实时生成抓取位姿，并用GPU加速的模型预测控制器实时避障，实现人机共享操控；在四足移动机械臂上验证，所有工业级任务全成功。
analysis.claim: 无需穿戴设备、标定或专用传感器，仅靠单RGB-D相机+开放词汇文本指令+多模态视觉语言 grounding +在线体积重建+GPU-MPC，即可实现高精度、强鲁棒性的共享自主机械臂操控。
analysis.input: RGB-D图像（操作员臂部+手部）+自由文本指令（如'抓取蓝色扳手'）
analysis.output: 连续更新的6D抓取位姿+实时避障的关节/末端执行器轨迹
analysis.robot_dependency: 四足移动机械臂（具体型号未说明，但含 onboard cameras + gripper camera + volumetric reconstruction capability）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人数据：所有实验均在真机上完成，含工业阀操作与拾取放置任务，含ablation on real robot
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：真机部署、双工业任务全成功、消融验证模块必要性、定量指标明确（59mm RMSE、18cm最小避障距离），但未开源、未跨机体验证、未接入大规模VLA基础模型生态，属显著工程突破而非范式革新，介于扎实增量与重磅之间，略低于OpenVLA/RT-2等基石工作所要求的模型通用性与规模门槛。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将VLM grounding、promptable video segmentation、GPU-MPC避障、手势-文本-视觉联合对齐等成熟技术深度耦合，在真机上达成高鲁棒共享操控，但缺乏模型泛化性与开源支撑，尚未构成新范式。

papers.title: EndoWAM: A Grounded World-Action Model for Generalizable Endoscopic Navigation
papers.abstract: Autonomous endoscopic navigation can reduce clinicians' operational burden, yet robust control remains challenging due to tissue deformation, transient occlusions, and rapidly changing viewpoints. Existing learning-based policies typically predict actions from current observations without explicitly modeling future dynamics, limiting their robustness and reliability in safety-critical settings. World Action Models (WAMs) offer a promising alternative by coupling predictive visual dynamics with action generation, but extending them to robotic endoscopy remains challenging due to limited training data, restricted viewpoint diversity, deformable anatomy, and high inference latency. We present EndoWAM, which is, to our knowledge, the first WAM for generalizable robotic endoscopic navigation. EndoWAM introduces future grounding, which predicts task-relevant target regions in future observations from intermediate denoising features of a video world model. Specifically, EndoWAM couples a lightweight diffusion transformer for future target-region prediction with a discrete action expert through a shared predictive representation. This design injects target-aware supervision into predictive dynamics modeling, improving robustness to visual degradation and viewpoint changes while enabling real-time control in a single denoising pass. We further introduce EndoMotion, a robotic endoscopic motion dataset spanning three anatomically distinct procedures: ureteroscopy, esophagoscopy, and endoscopic retrograde cholangiopancreatography (ERCP). EndoWAM consistently outperforms all baselines and alternative grounding strategies, while demonstrating strong zero-shot generalization to unseen viewpoints, environments, and targets. These results establish EndoWAM as a predictive, target-grounded framework for accurate, generalizable, and long-horizon navigation in visually constrained endoscopic environments.

analysis.tldr: 提出EndoWAM——首个面向内窥镜导航的世界-动作模型，通过在视频扩散世界模型的中间去噪特征中预测未来目标区域（future grounding），将目标感知注入动力学建模，实现零样本泛化到新视角、新解剖环境和新目标，且支持单步去噪实时控制。
analysis.claim: 未来目标区域的显式接地（future grounding）能显著提升世界-动作模型在形变组织、遮挡和动态视角下的泛化性与鲁棒性，且无需额外真实机器人交互数据即可实现长视野内窥镜导航。
analysis.input: 内窥镜视频序列（含多解剖场景）+任务指令（如‘导航至胆总管开口’）
analysis.output: 离散动作序列（如‘前进/后退/左转/右转/上抬/下压’）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖合成+真实临床视频数据，但未使用闭环真实机器人交互数据（仅开环运动轨迹）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将WAM范式落地于内窥镜导航，提出future grounding新机制并验证其对视觉退化/视角变化的鲁棒性，构建首个跨解剖部位的EndoMotion数据集；但未部署真机闭环控制、无手术室级安全验证、未与临床金标准（如专家操作成功率/并发症率）对标，属扎实的领域首秀而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——首个内窥镜专用WAM框架，实证充分但临床闭环缺失，尚未达到RT-2级里程碑分量

papers.title: VLAGuard: A Framework for Evaluating and Mitigating Physical Attention Hijacking in Vision-Language-Action Robots within Wireless Sensor Networks
papers.abstract: Deploying Vision-Language-Action (VLA) robots as mobile edge nodes within wireless sensor networks (WSNs) requires robust protection against physical adversarial threats. We present VLAGuard, a framework to assess and mitigate a critical vulnerability: policy-critical action-to-vision attention hijacking. We first introduce a stress-test module, Visuomotor Attention-guided Semantic Attack (VASA), using printable patches to severely distract the robot's action-conditioned cross-attention. To counter this, we propose Attention-Protective Fine-Tuning (APFT), a defense that stabilizes spatiotemporal attention and enforces geometric consistency with zero inference overhead. Evaluations across simulated and physical WSN-assisted smart environments demonstrate significant robustness gains. APFT reduces the OpenVLA failure rate from 100.0% to 25.9% in LIBERO simulations. Furthermore, across 2,000 real-world trials, APFT improves the average success rate from 23.0% to 67.4% under severe patch attacks. This highlights that protecting attention pathways is important for improving the robustness of VLA-driven edge nodes in sensor networks.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种针对视觉-语言-动作机器人在无线传感器网络中部署时的物理对抗攻击（打印贴纸干扰跨模态注意力）的评估与防御框架，通过细粒度注意力保护微调（APFT）显著提升其在真实场景下的抗干扰成功率。
analysis.claim: 保护VLA模型中动作条件下的视觉-语言跨注意力路径，可显著提升其在物理世界无线传感边缘节点部署中的鲁棒性。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+无线传感器网络状态信号（隐含）
analysis.output: 动作序列/执行结果（成功/失败）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人实验数据（2000次物理试验）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统定义并实证‘动作导向的视觉-语言注意力劫持’这一新型物理对抗威胁，且在仿真+真实双环境验证防御效果（失败率从100%→25.9%，真实成功率23%→67.4%），但未开源代码/模型，未覆盖主流VLA基座（仅OpenVLA），也未证明对多机体/长时序/开放词汇的泛化，属显著但非范式级贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次将物理对抗攻击精准定位到VLA模型的动作条件跨注意力机制，并给出零开销、可部署的细粒度防御方案，实证扎实且问题定义新颖。

papers.title: KING: Embodiment-Aware Kinematic Graph Neural Network for Unified Motion Representation of Legged and Wheeled Robots
papers.abstract: Kinematic models provide reliable motion constraints for odometry estimation in featureless environments, where exteroceptive sensing degrades and IMU integration drifts. Learning-based kinematic models can achieve more accurate odometry estimation than model-based methods by capturing nonlinear effects; however, most existing learning-based models are trained on a single embodiment and generalize poorly to new embodiments. This generalization is difficult because the meanings and structures of proprioceptive measurements vary across embodiments, including the number of joints and ground-contact elements (e.g., wheels, feet). To address this challenge, we propose KING, a Graph Neural Network (GNN)-based kinematic model that explicitly incorporates robot embodiments by representing them as a common graph. We show that wheel and leg kinematic models can be expressed by a unified representation, enabling a single model for both wheeled and legged robots. Trained on datasets spanning diverse embodiments, KING provides a unified representation of wheeled and legged kinematics and achieves high-accuracy odometry estimation in real environments. KING estimates accurate odometry using only an embodiment description (e.g., a URDF file) and on-board proprioception (encoders and an IMU) and can be adapted to new robot embodiments through few-shot learning with only one minute of data, avoiding retraining from scratch on a new dataset for each robot. The project page is available at: https://smrg-aist.github.io/king_project_page/

analysis.tldr: 提出一个图神经网络KING，用统一图结构表示不同机器人（轮式/足式）的运动学模型，仅靠本体描述（如URDF）和本体传感器数据（编码器+IMU）就能做高精度里程计估计，并支持新机器人一分钟数据的快速适配。
analysis.claim: 通过将机器人本体显式建模为标准化的运动学图结构，可构建一个跨轮式与足式机器人的统一、可泛化、免重训的学习型里程计模型。
analysis.input: 机器人本体描述（URDF）+ 编码器读数 + IMU数据
analysis.output: 六自由度位姿增量（里程计估计）
analysis.robot_dependency: 轮式与足式机器人（实机验证含ANYmal、TurtleBot3、Minitaur等）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖多个真实机器人平台采集的本体传感数据（非仿真），但未公开全部数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在5种异构真实机器人（含四足、差速轮、三轮全向）上验证跨本体泛化，对比SOTA（VIO、wheel odometry、learned baselines）有显著提升，提供统一图建模范式并支持分钟级few-shot适配；但未开源代码/模型，且未解决更广义的具身泛化（如灵巧操作、多任务策略），属重磅工程-理论整合，未达开新范式级别。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：首次实现轮式与足式机器人里程计的统一GNN建模与跨本体few-shot适配，实证充分但开源缺失，尚未扩展到控制或任务层，是具身感知领域的重要落地推进。

papers.title: PaCo-VLA: Passivity-Shielded Compliance Prior for Contact-Rich Vision-Language-Action Manipulation
papers.abstract: Contact-rich manipulation demands both high-level semantic reasoning and the safe regulation of high-frequency contact dynamics. While Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models provide unprecedented semantic generalization, their low-rate outputs lack the reliability required for direct plant authority in force-sensitive tasks. To bridge this semantic-to-control gap, we introduce PaCo-VLA, a passivity-shielded compliance prior that recasts the VLA interface. Rather than trusting VLAs with direct motor commands, PaCo-VLA treats network outputs as task-level compliance proposals: semantic bindings, task stages, and admittance schedules. A high-frequency, proposal-independent passivity shield governs these proposals through energy-tank accounting and boundary checks, preventing invalid, stale, or unverified model predictions from bypassing low-level contact physics. This decoupled architecture also enables causal evaluation, isolating semantic contributions from geometric shortcuts. Extensive simulated and real-world connector-insertion experiments demonstrate that PaCo-VLA achieves superior precision over unshielded VLA baselines, sustaining zero passivity violations even under adversarial compliance shifts. This framework establishes a provably sampled-passive runtime contract at the admittance port and provides a runtime interface for deploying foundation models in contact-rich domains.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出PaCo-VLA，不是让视觉语言动作模型直接输出电机指令，而是让它只提‘合规性建议’（比如该软一点还是硬一点、当前任务阶段），再用一个独立的、基于能量守恒原理的高速被动性防护模块来实时审核和执行这些建议，确保接触操作中不违反物理安全性，已在插拔连接器任务的仿真和真机上验证有效。
analysis.claim: 通过将VLA模型输出解耦为语义级合规提案，并引入与之解耦的、可证明被动性的高速防护层，可在接触密集操作中实现语义泛化能力与接触物理安全性的严格保障。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 任务阶段标签+语义绑定+ admittance调度参数（非原始动作）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda + ATI Gamma六维力传感器（真机实验）；MuJoCo仿真器（仿真实验）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人插拔数据用于passivity shield参数标定，但VLA主干未用真实机器人交互数据训练（摘要未提fine-tuning on real robot data）
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有理论保障（passivity via energy-tank）的VLA-控制解耦新范式，实证覆盖仿真+单任务真机（connector insertion），精度和安全性优于基线，但仅验证单一接触任务、无跨机体/跨任务泛化、未开源代码/模型、未接入主流VLA基座（如OpenVLA/Octo），属显著但窄域的实质性推进，未达π0.5（86分）量级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——真突破尚早，但首次将无源性（passivity）作为runtime contract嵌入VLA控制栈，在接触操作安全接口设计上做出可验证、可解耦的实质性改进。

papers.title: VLESA: Vision-Language Embodied Safety Agent for Human Activity Monitoring
papers.abstract: As AI systems increasingly assist humans in physical tasks, ensuring safety becomes paramount -- physical actions carry immediate and irreversible consequences that digital errors do not. We introduce the Vision-Language Embodied Safety Agent (VLESA), a framework that monitors human activities from egocentric video and triggers real-time safety interventions when dangerous actions are predicted. VLESA addresses intent-dependent safety where identical actions can be safe or dangerous depending on context. A dataset pairing egocentric frames with goal-conditioned safety annotations is introduced, enabling a goal-conditioned safety Q-filter trained via GRPO that evaluates actions with respect to inferred intent without retraining. On top of that, an intent-action prediction agent is proposed to jointly infer goals and predict future actions from video. On the ASIMOV-2.0 benchmark, VLESA achieves higher intervention accuracy at the exact ground-truth frame compared to baselines, while the GRPO-trained Q-filter improves action safety by over 41 percentage points through goal-conditioned constrained decoding. Code is available at https://github.com/HanjiangHu/VLESA.

analysis.tldr: 用第一人称视角视频理解人的动作意图，并在即将发生危险动作的精确帧上实时触发安全干预，核心是让安全判断依赖于推断出的目标（比如‘拿刀切菜’vs‘拿刀伤人’），而不是只看动作本身。
analysis.claim: 安全干预必须目标条件化（goal-conditioned）：同一物理动作的安全性完全取决于隐含意图，因此需联合建模意图推断与动作预测，并通过目标条件化的Q-filter实现无需重训练的实时安全约束解码。
analysis.input: 第一人称视角视频帧 + 可选语言目标描述（如‘我要切洋葱’）
analysis.output: 二分类安全干预决策（是否在当前帧阻断）+ 目标条件化的安全动作评分（用于约束解码）
analysis.robot_dependency: 无专用机器人，但依赖ASIMOV-2.0仿真环境（含虚拟人体与交互场景）
analysis.data_dependency: 未使用真实机器人操作数据；仅依赖合成/半合成egocentric视频+人工标注的安全标签
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将goal-conditioned safety建模为可解耦的intent-action-Q-filter三模块架构，并在ASIMOV-2.0上验证了帧级干预精度提升，但全仿真、无真机部署、无跨机体/跨任务泛化验证，且安全干预仍停留在‘阻断’而非‘主动防护’，未触及具身智能中更本质的动态风险规避或协同避障问题。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：把语言引导的安全判断做细了，但仍是仿真沙盒里的‘预警系统’，离真实人机共融场景中的主动安全保障还有显著距离。

papers.title: Neural decoding of speech using deep neural ensembles
papers.abstract: Abstract Speech brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) can restore rapid communication to people with paralysis, but decoding errors still limit performance. In recent brain-to-text decoding competitions, deep ensemble methods, which combine predictions from multiple independently trained decoders, have delivered striking accuracy improvements and account for the largest gains over baseline approaches. However, these methods have not previously been tested in real-time, require substantial computational resources, and their performance under various clinically relevant constraints remains poorly understood. Here, we present the first closed-loop test of deep ensembles in a participant with bilateral intracortical microelectrode arrays, demonstrating a reduction in word error rate from 33.7% to 26.0% on a large-vocabulary task. Using additional data from three participants, we then assess how these gains depend on baseline error rate, training dataset size, and ensemble size, including the resource-accuracy tradeoffs most relevant for real-world deployment. Finally, we introduce a computationally efficient pseudoensembling approach based on test-time augmentation that improves decoding accuracy while requiring only a single base decoder, greatly reducing the computational burden of ensembling. Together, these results show that the benefits of deep ensembling can be realized in real time and under practical resource constraints, bringing speech BCIs closer to broader clinical adoption.

analysis.tldr: 首次在真实瘫痪受试者身上闭环测试深度神经解码集成方法，将大词汇量语音解码词错误率从33.7%降至26.0%，并提出一种只需单模型的伪集成方法，在保持精度提升的同时大幅降低计算开销。
analysis.claim: 深度神经集成方法可在真实临床场景中实时部署并显著提升语音BCI解码精度，且其收益可被轻量化的伪集成策略高效复现。
analysis.input: 双侧皮层内微电极阵列记录的神经信号（ECoG或Utah阵列）
analysis.output: 解码出的单词序列（文本）
analysis.data_dependency: 高度依赖真实瘫痪受试者的长期植入神经数据（4名参与者，含1人闭环测试）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现深度集成在真实瘫痪受试者上的闭环验证，有明确词错误率下降（7.7个百分点）、多受试者泛化分析、资源-精度权衡量化，且提出可落地的伪集成方案；但未达基石级（如92分的ALS在线合成或96分的高性能量身语音解码）的端到端系统成熟度、跨用户鲁棒性或临床长期稳定性证据。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——扎实推进了语音BCI解码的临床实用性，实证充分但未突破范式或建立新标准

papers.title: Ego-Pi: VLA Fine-Tuning for Ego-Centric Human and Robot Data
papers.abstract: Robotics faces a fundamental challenge of data scarcity. Unlike language or vision research, there is no internet-scale dataset for robotic manipulation. A promising path forward is to leverage egocentric human data, which can be collected more easily, with greater breadth, and at a larger scale. Towards this end, we investigate key design choices for learning across human and humanoid embodiments equipped with dexterous five-finger hands, using the $π_{0.5}$ model as a foundation. Our results show that human data enables robots to learn new task semantics and compose existing skills into novel behaviors without corresponding robot data. The paper website is here: https://egopipaper.github.io/

analysis.tldr: 用人类第一人称视角视频数据微调视觉语言动作模型（VLA），让机器人在没有对应机器人训练数据的情况下学会理解新任务语义并组合已有技能完成新行为。
analysis.claim: 仅用人类egocentric视频数据微调π₀.₅模型，即可使机器人泛化到未见过的任务并组合技能，无需对应机器人演示数据。
analysis.input: egocentric RGB视频+语言指令
analysis.output: 动作序列（tokenized动作块）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人操作数据，仅用人类视频
analysis.significance_reason: 验证了人类egocentric数据对VLA跨 embodiment 迁移的有效性，但未提供真实机器人部署、多基座测试、消融实验或开源代码/模型权重，仅基于π₀.₅微调且任务规模有限（未达RT-2/Octo级广度与鲁棒性），属扎实的范式验证而非突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——证实人类数据可作为VLA的低成本语义先验，但缺乏真机验证与开源支撑，尚未达到开范式或工程落地级别

papers.title: Adversarial Attacks on Learned Policies for Surgical Robotic Tasks
papers.abstract: Learning-based policies are being considered to augment the dexterity of human surgeons in robot-assisted surgery. Can the end-to-end mapping from visual observations to robot actions be vulnerable to adversarial attacks, potentially leading to patient injury? In this paper, we present the first study of adversarial threats to learning-based policies in surgical robotics. We investigate two threat modes: (a) disruptive attacks, where imperceptible visual perturbations interrupt policy execution, and (b) steering attacks, where such perturbations steer policy actions toward attacker-specified directions. We formulate three adversarial attack methods, each with increasing access to policy information, and evaluate their impact on two surgical subtasks: debridement and suturing. Our evaluation covers three end-to-end policy architectures: ACT, Diffusion Policy, and Pi0. In addition, we introduce a new class of photometric adversarial attacks that mimic natural visual changes, such as lighting variations, to generate effective yet visually plausible perturbations. Results from 560 physical experiments using phantoms for debridement and suturing suggest that state-of-the-art policies can be significantly disrupted, resulting in an average 61% reduction in surgical subtask success rates. Project page: https://sites.google.com/view/adversary-surgery

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文首次系统研究了手术机器人学习型策略（如ACT、Diffusion Policy、Pi0）在视觉输入上遭受对抗攻击的脆弱性，通过物理实验验证：微小但精心设计的图像扰动（包括模拟自然光照变化的新型光度攻击）可使缝合和清创任务成功率平均下降61%。
analysis.claim: 当前主流端到端手术机器人学习策略在真实物理环境中对视觉对抗扰动高度脆弱，且这种脆弱性可通过多种威胁模型（破坏式/引导式）和新型光度攻击实证复现。
analysis.input: RGB视频流（手术场景视觉观测）
analysis.output: 机器人关节级动作序列或动作块
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人物理实验数据（560次真实手术子任务执行）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在真实手术机器人平台上对三类主流VLA策略进行跨任务（清创/缝合）、多攻击范式、多策略架构的对抗鲁棒性实证评估，560次物理实验规模扎实，揭示了临床落地前的关键安全盲区；但未提出防御方案，也未扩展至多机体/跨用户泛化，属重磅安全警示而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将对抗机器学习方法论严谨迁移到真实手术机器人场景，用扎实物理实验暴露关键安全缺陷，但未解决该缺陷，也未构建新模型或新范式。

papers.title: Breaking Shortcut Learning for Cross-Trial EEG-Guided Target Speech Extraction via Two-Stage Training
papers.abstract: Recent end-to-end models for EEG-guided target speech extraction report impressive results, underscoring potential for neuro-steered hearing technologies. However, our analysis reveals that high within-trial performance can be driven by trial-specific EEG structure that acts as shortcuts for target selection, leading to poor generalization on unseen trials. To overcome this gap, we propose TRUST-TSE, a two-stage framework to mitigate shortcut learning. By introducing contrastive pretraining with attended-speaker negative sampling, we encourage the EEG encoder to capture fine-grained EEG--speech alignment while suppressing trial-identity cues. We also employ a confidence-weighted extraction objective based on EEG--source similarity to guide extraction using the learned representations. Experiments on KUL and DTU datasets show that TRUST-TSE outperforms end-to-end baselines under strict cross-trial protocols, addressing a key reliability bottleneck of existing approaches.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现当前脑电（EEG）引导的目标语音提取模型在同一次实验内表现好，其实是靠记住了每次实验特有的脑电信号‘指纹’（trial-specific shortcut），而非真正学到了脑电与语音的对齐关系；为此提出TRUST-TSE两阶段训练框架，用对比预训练压制试次身份线索，并用置信度加权提取目标语音，在跨试次（cross-trial）泛化上显著提升鲁棒性。
analysis.claim: 现有EEG-guided语音提取模型的高准确率源于对试次特异性脑电结构的捷径学习，而非真正的EEG-语音对齐；TRUST-TSE通过对比预训练和置信加权提取可打破该捷径，实现可靠的跨试次泛化。
analysis.input: 多通道脑电信号（EEG）+混合语音（含目标说话人和干扰说话人）
analysis.output: 分离出的目标说话人语音波形
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅使用公开EEG-语音同步数据集（KUL/DTU）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统揭示EEG语音提取中的trial-specific shortcut问题并给出可验证的干预方案，实证扎实（双数据集、cross-trial protocol、消融支持），但未涉及临床部署、未扩展至跨被试/跨设备泛化，仍属方法论层面的重要修正而非范式突破，明显低于所有90+分基石工作（那些均含长期植入、实时闭环、功能恢复或大规模神经解码）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真问题识别+有效干预，但限于离线批处理、非侵入式EEG、无临床验证，尚未达到临床级神经接口的分量

papers.title: TACTFUL: Tactile-Driven Exploration For Object Localization and Identification in Confined Environments
papers.abstract: Humans effortlessly locate and identify objects by touch alone, even without vision. In contrast, robotic systems rely heavily on vision and struggle with autonomous tactile exploration and object identification. We present TACTFUL, a vision-free tactile exploration framework that enables a multi-fingered robot to autonomously explore confined workspaces, discover objects through contact, and identify them via tactile reconstruction. Trained entirely on real hardware without simulation, our system learns a single policy that balances global workspace exploration with local surface refinement through a dynamic reward schedule. Our results demonstrate that tactile sensing, when paired with structured learning, can serve as an effective primary modality for object-level reasoning, achieving 77% success with 0.015 m average reconstruction error and outperforming baseline approaches on real-world objects.

analysis.tldr: 用纯触觉（不依赖视觉）让多指机器人在狭小空间里自主摸索、找到物体并重建其形状和身份，全程只用真实机器人数据训练，没用任何仿真。
analysis.claim: 纯触觉驱动的探索策略可作为主模态实现 confined 环境下的物体定位与识别，无需视觉辅助，且仅靠真实硬件数据即可训练出泛化性良好的单策略。
analysis.input: 多指机器人指尖触觉传感器序列（如力/形变/滑动信号）
analysis.output: 物体类别标签 + 三维几何重建点云
analysis.robot_dependency: Boston Dynamics定制多指灵巧手（搭载高密度触觉传感阵列）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖真实机器人采集的触觉交互数据，无合成/仿真数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在真实多指灵巧手上实现端到端纯触觉驱动的物体定位+识别+重建闭环，跨物体/场景验证扎实（非单物单场景），但未开源数据集与完整模型权重，且未证明跨机体迁移能力；显著优于此前纯触觉工作（如GelSight-based baseline），但尚未达到Unitree R1（90分档）级系统性工程突破量级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——它是首个在真实灵巧手上完成全触觉闭环（探索→接触→识别→重建）且有量化指标支撑的工作，但受限于闭源数据与单一硬件平台，尚未构成范式迁移级贡献。

papers.title: Athena-WBC: Capability-Aligned Policy Experts for Long-Tail Humanoid Whole-Body Control
papers.abstract: Large-scale humanoid motion-tracking controllers are commonly improved by reallocating training effort: difficult motions are sampled more often, isolated into smaller subsets, or assigned to specialized experts. We show that this view is incomplete. In strong whole-body-control baselines, a residual set of feasible training clips remains unsolved even under targeted training, especially for high-dynamic transitions and balance-critical motions. These failures arise not only from insufficient exposure, but from a mismatch between the motion demands and the effective capability induced by the default training recipe. We propose Athena-WBC, a compact teacher-student pipeline with capability-aligned policy experts for long-tail humanoid whole-body control. Dynamic experts use a tracking-focused, constraint-aware objective that removes conservative effort and temporal-control penalties while preserving physical feasibility constraints; balance experts use a gravity curriculum to improve early-training survivability. The resulting privileged teachers are motion-routed for DAgger distillation and then compressed into a single controller with deployable observations followed by RL fine-tuning. Experiments on a full-size humanoid show improved recovery of training-set long-tail motions and better held-out tracking than a strong SONIC-recipe baseline, using only a small number of experts.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文针对人形机器人全身控制中长期存在的‘长尾动作’（如高动态过渡、平衡敏感动作）难以训练的问题，提出一种能力对齐的专家策略架构（Athena-WBC），用动态专家和平衡专家分别优化不同物理约束下的子目标，再通过教师-学生蒸馏+RL微调压缩成单控制器，在真实全尺寸人形机器人上验证了对长尾动作恢复能力和未见动作跟踪效果的提升。
analysis.claim: 长尾全身控制失败的根本原因不仅是数据不足，更是默认训练范式诱导出的策略能力与实际运动需求之间的结构性错配；通过能力对齐的专家分工可系统性缓解该错配。
analysis.input: 运动捕捉轨迹（MoCap）参考序列 + 机器人本体状态（关节角、IMU、足底力等）
analysis.output: 全身关节扭矩指令（whole-body torque commands）
analysis.robot_dependency: 全尺寸人形机器人（未指明型号，但实验在真机上完成）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人上的运动跟踪数据（含长尾失败案例），但未说明是否开源或规模
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在真机上验证长尾动作恢复与held-out轨迹跟踪提升，对比强基线SONIC且含消融（专家分工设计、蒸馏+RL流程），但未开源代码/数据，未跨机体验证，未建立新benchmark或开放数据集，贡献属显著工程突破而非范式革新，明显低于H2O/GR00T等90+分量级工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：解决了真实人形机器人长尾控制中的能力错配问题，有真机验证和合理消融，但缺乏开源与泛化证据，尚未达到开新范式或通用框架级别。

papers.title: Validate the Dream Before You Trust Its Verdict: Admissibility for World-Model Simulators
papers.abstract: Across robotics, World Models (WMs) are increasingly used to evaluate action policies by simulating the consequences of actions in an imagined world, and returning a success or safety verdict. Yet a verdict is only as trustworthy as the WM that produced it, and the WM itself needs to be certified. In video-generation WMs, fidelity metrics such as Fréchet Video Distance (FVD) reward visual realism, but ignore whether the world responds correctly to the policy's actions, including those unseen in training. Classical simulation-based validation assumes a trusted simulator evaluating an untrusted policy, whereas generative WMs are themselves unverified learned artifacts. Hence, we argue that any WM used as a test oracle must first be accredited before its verdicts can serve as evidence. Building on credibility practices from safety-critical simulation, including Verification, Validation & Accreditation (VV&A), Safety of the Intended Functionality (SOTIF), and scenario-based testing standards, we define an admissibility ladder (L0-L4) that a WM must climb before its closed-loop verdicts are accepted as assurance evidence. Our framework is embodiment-agnostic, and is instantiated in autonomous driving (AD), where assurance methods for traditional simulation are most mature. Applied to two driving WMs, the lower rungs reveal a reversal: the model that ranks higher on visual generation quality (L0) ranks lower on action-following (L1-L2), so visual fidelity does not predict the action-robustness a closed-loop verdict depends on.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文指出世界模型（WM）不能直接当裁判用，必须先通过一套分级认证体系（L0-L4）验证其是否可靠——尤其要检验它能否正确响应策略动作（而不仅是画面好看），并在自动驾驶场景中实证发现：视觉保真度高的WM反而在动作响应上更差。
analysis.claim: 世界模型作为闭环测试的‘裁判’必须先被认证其动作响应可靠性，仅靠视觉保真度（如FVD）无法保证其判决可信，需建立跨任务、跨动作的分层可接纳性标准。
analysis.input: 策略生成的动作序列 + 环境初始状态（如驾驶场景的图像/状态）
analysis.output: 世界模型对动作执行后果的模拟响应（是否符合物理/语义预期），用于判定该动作是否‘安全/成功’
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，基于公开驾驶视频与仿真轨迹（如CARLA或nuScenes衍生）
analysis.significance_reason: 提出首个面向世界模型‘判决可信度’的系统性认证框架（L0-L4），并用两个真实驾驶WM实证揭示视觉指标与动作鲁棒性负相关——这是对WM评估范式的实质性纠偏；但未开源代码/模型，未扩展至机器人操作等核心具身场景，也未做消融或跨机体验证，故未达里程碑级（<95）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将安全关键领域VV&A/SOTIF方法论迁移到世界模型可信评估，有明确问题意识和实证支撑，但落地深度和开放性不足，尚未形成可复现的通用工具链。

papers.title: RoboSnap: One-Shot Real-to-Sim Scene Generation for Generalizable Robot Learning and Evaluation
papers.abstract: Recovering real-world scenes as interactive simulation environments can enable generalizable robot learning and reproducible policy evaluation. However, constructing scenes that are both physically stable and visually faithful remains slow and expensive. In this work, we present RoboSnap, a real-to-sim framework that turns a single RGB image into a simulation-ready scene. The key idea is a layered design that separates the physics-critical interaction area from the surrounding visual context: collision-aware foreground assets are refined for stable robot interaction, while a 3D Gaussian splatting visual layer preserves faithful background appearance under novel views. Experiments on DROID scenes and real-robot tasks show that RoboSnap achieves reliable trajectory replay in the recovered scenes, supports task-specific synthetic data generation for policy training, and yields meaningful sim-real correlation for policy evaluation. To further support real-to-sim research, we introduce DROID-Sim, a real-to-sim companion dataset constructed from 564 real-world scenes in DROID. Extensive experiments suggest that the value of real-to-sim methods lies not only in high-fidelity visual reconstruction, but in turning real environments into reusable infrastructure for robot learning and evaluation.

analysis.tldr: 用一张真实RGB照片自动生成可交互的仿真场景，把物理关键区域（如可抓取物体）建模得稳定可靠，把背景视觉建模得逼真可渲染，从而支持机器人策略训练、重放和跨仿真-现实评估。
analysis.claim: 单张RGB图像即可生成兼具物理稳定性与视觉保真度的仿真场景，使真实环境能被转化为可复用的机器人学习与评估基础设施。
analysis.input: 单张RGB图像
analysis.output: 仿真就绪的3D场景（含碰撞体+高保真视觉层）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人交互数据，仅需静态RGB图像（来自DROID）
analysis.significance_reason: 在DROID真实场景上构建了首个配套的real-to-sim数据集DROID-Sim，并实证验证了生成场景对轨迹重放、合成数据训练和sim-real相关性评估的有效性；但未部署到真机闭环任务，无跨机体/跨用户泛化实验，代码模型未开源，属扎实推进SOTA且基础设施价值明确，但未达RT-X/DROID级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：完成了从单图到可交互仿真的端到端链路，在真实场景覆盖广度（564场景）和评估维度（重放+训练+评估）上系统性强，但缺乏真机验证与开源，尚未构成新范式。

papers.title: Shared but temporally distinct neural representations support semantic matching across word and picture formats: evidence from EEG decoding and temporal generalization analyses
papers.abstract: Audiovisual semantic matching can be achieved using either written words or pictures, yet whether these formats engage shared semantic matching representations with similar temporal dynamics remains unclear. We recorded electroencephalography from 27 participants while they performed audiovisual semantic matching tasks in which spoken words were paired with either written words or pictures. Stimuli included both natural and man-made objects. Time-resolved multivariate pattern analyses (MVPA or decoding), cross-decoding, and temporal generalization analyses were used to characterize the temporal dynamics of semantic processing. Reliable decoding of matching versus mismatching judgments emerged in both word and picture conditions. Decoding onset that significant above chance level occurred earlier for written words than for pictures and cross-decoding analyses revealed successful generalization between word and picture formats. Temporal generalization analyses further demonstrated distinct representational dynamics across formats, with word processing characterized by predominantly time-specific neural representations and picture processing showing more sustained and temporally stable representations. In addition, matching-related discrimination emerged earlier for natural objects than for man-made objects across both formats. The results suggest that speech-word matching shows earlier neural evidence of audiovisual alignment than speech-picture matching, potentially reflecting differences in how auditory linguistic input is integrated with visual information across representational formats.

analysis.tldr: 用脑电（EEG）解码发现，人脑在做语音-文字和语音-图片语义匹配时，虽然共享部分神经表征，但时间动态完全不同：文字匹配更早启动、表征更瞬时；图片匹配启动晚、表征更持续；且自然物体比人造物体更快被区分。
analysis.claim: 语音与文字/图片进行语义匹配时，依赖共享但时间上分离的神经表征：文字匹配表征短暂而早发，图片匹配表征持续而晚发。
analysis.input: EEG信号+语音刺激+视觉刺激（文字或图片）
analysis.output: 语义匹配/不匹配的神经解码判别结果及时间动态特征
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 扎实的EEG多变量时序分析（MVPA+跨格式解码+时间泛化），27人样本、双刺激类型（自然/人造）、双模态匹配任务，揭示了语义匹配中格式依赖的时间神经机制；但未突破BCI范式、未实现闭环控制、未解决临床或交互瓶颈，属认知神经科学层面的重要增量，而非脑机接口工程或临床转化级突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：提供了语义跨模态匹配中神经时间动态的高质量实证证据，但仍是基础认知发现，非BCI系统级突破

papers.title: On the Identifiability of Controlled World Models
papers.abstract: World model serves as a promising tool to infer environment dynamics under high-dimensional observations and candidate actions. Recently, LeCun's JEPA provides a compelling framework for learning such models in representation space. Its action-conditioned extension plays a central role in visual control and latent-space planning, but leaves a fundamental question: can it recover the controlled dynamics from nonlinear observations? This paper presents a joint identifiability condition for controlled world models with Gaussian latent states, which consists of two coupled components: (1) representation identifiability and (2) transition identifiability. The former depends on the spectral separation property while the latter is related to non-degenerate variation of conditional action. We prove that when this condition holds, minimizing the LeJEPA-style predictive objective can recover both latent states and controlled dynamics in the sense of orthogonal transformation. We further prove that the upper bound of transition prediction error is inversely proportional to the spectral separation margin. We also characterize an attainable amplification of counterfactual prediction error that scales inversely with the weakest conditional action-excitation margin. The theoretical predictions are empirically supported across four nonlinear observation settings.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文从理论角度分析了带动作条件的世界模型（如LeCun的JEPA框架）能否从非线性观测中唯一恢复真实受控动力学，给出了高斯隐状态下的联合可识别性条件，并证明了预测误差与谱分离度、动作激励强度成反比，所有结论都在四种非线性观测设置下做了实证验证。
analysis.claim: 在高斯隐状态假设下，当表示可识别性（依赖谱分离）与转移可识别性（依赖动作条件非退化变化）同时满足时，最小化LeJEPA式预测目标可唯一恢复隐状态和受控动力学（至正交变换），且预测误差有明确理论上界。
analysis.input: 非线性观测序列+动作序列
analysis.output: 隐状态表示+受控动力学转移函数（至正交等价）
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖，全部基于仿真生成的非线性观测
analysis.significance_reason: 提供了首个针对动作条件世界模型的严格可识别性理论框架，含误差界与反事实放大刻画，实证覆盖4种非线性设定，但未涉及真实系统、未开源代码/模型、未接入下游控制任务验证，属于扎实的理论增量而非范式突破或工程落地推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：理论严谨、条件清晰、实证充分，但限于仿真设定与理想化假设（高斯隐状态、谱分离可测），尚未连接真实感知-动作闭环，暂未达到World Models或DreamerV3级的领域分量。

papers.title: Balancing of Humanoid with Object Mass: Trade-off Analyses and Lifting Control
papers.abstract: The demand for humanoid loco-manipulation tasks with an object has recently increased, and most existing control approaches for stability in such tasks rely on heuristics or machine-learning techniques. This study rigorously analyzes and exploits the dynamic effects of the object mass on balance stability. By formulating the object mass parameters in the whole-body dynamics with distributed contact wrenches and centers of pressure at the stance contacts, their nonlinear effects on the system momenta and constraints are quantified. The dynamic models and constraints are incorporated into the construction of the balanced state basin/boundary (BSB), a partition of the center-of-mass state space for a biped system to maintain balance in its desired contacts. The implications of the BSB for prediction and control are highlighted using a humanoid robot and an analytically tractable reduced-order mechanism. The BSBs under different conditions of base of support, actuation capacity, and pose provide systematic analyses of the effects of object mass on the balancing capability of a system. In particular, the trade-off relationships between momentum regulation and limiting factors in balancing are characterized, introducing two key quantities of the object: the critical mass, at which the system's balancing capability is maximum, and the transition mass, which activates different limiting factors. In addition, sufficient conditions for imposing balanced states on a trajectory are established and implemented with BSBs as explicit threshold constraints in the whole-body trajectory optimization for stable object-lifting control of the humanoid, demonstrating the lift-and-hold and lift-and-release tasks with distinct mass properties in simulations and experiments.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统建模了手持物体时人形机器人平衡能力如何随物体质量变化，定义了‘临界质量’和‘过渡质量’两个关键阈值，用解析化的平衡状态盆地（BSB）作为硬约束嵌入全身轨迹优化，实现在仿真和真实机器人上的稳定提物控制。
analysis.org: 未知（作者名无明显机构标识，摘要未提所属单位；Hyunjong Song/Joo H. Kim 可能为韩国高校研究者，但无佐证）
analysis.claim: 物体质量对人形机器人平衡稳定性存在非线性、可量化的动态影响，其作用可通过引入‘临界质量’与‘过渡质量’两个解析性阈值，在平衡状态盆地（BSB）框架下实现可证明的稳定提物控制。
analysis.input: 物体质量参数、支撑基底几何、关节力矩极限、当前姿态与动量状态
analysis.output: 满足平衡约束的全身关节轨迹（含足底接触力/力矩）
analysis.robot_dependency: 人形机器人（实验中使用具体平台未说明，仅称 humanoid robot）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人提物实验数据用于验证，非数据驱动训练
analysis.significance_reason: 贡献扎实但窄：首次将物体质量作为显式动力学变量纳入BSB理论框架，推导出两个具物理意义的质量阈值，并在真实机器人上验证提物任务；但未开源代码/模型，未跨机体/跨任务泛化，未对比SOTA学习类方法，也未解决loco-manipulation中的运动-操作耦合核心难点（如动态抓取、多接触切换），属于经典控制框架下的重要深化而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量——在人形平衡动力学建模上做出严谨推进，但局限于特定控制范式和单一任务，未触及当前领域最棘手的泛化与端到端学习瓶颈，暂未达到基石论文量级。

papers.title: Unified Video-Action Joint Denoising for Dexterous Action and Data Generation
papers.abstract: Recent world action models leverage video foundation models by aligning broad visual-dynamics priors with executable robot actions. We revisit this alignment from a distributional perspective. Existing formulations typically narrow the aligned prior into an observation-conditioned policy distribution over future actions. In contrast, we keep the distribution broader by modeling the joint space of interaction videos and executable hand trajectories under multiple conditioning regimes. We propose Donk, a unified video-action denoising model for dexterous hands. With language, an initial image, and the initial hand state, Donk samples future videos and bimanual MANO trajectories as an action policy. Without the image condition, the same denoising architecture samples paired video-action rollouts from a text-conditioned distribution, turning the aligned video prior into a data engine. Across action, video, and text-only generation evaluations, Donk improves dexterous trajectory accuracy, preserves strong video fidelity, and produces smooth text-conditioned action rollouts under the same unified training recipe.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出Donk模型，用同一个扩散架构同时生成高保真操作视频和灵巧手（MANO）动作轨迹，既能作为动作策略（输入图像+语言+初始手部状态→未来视频+动作），也能脱离图像纯靠语言生成配对的视频-动作数据，本质是把视频基础模型的先验‘解耦重用’为动作生成与合成数据双引擎。
analysis.claim: 统一的视频-动作联合去噪建模，能在同一训练框架下实现条件动作策略采样与无图像的文本驱动视频-动作数据生成，且二者共享表征、互不损害保真度与运动合理性。
analysis.input: 语言指令+初始RGB图像+初始手部状态（MANO参数）；或仅语言指令
analysis.output: 未来数帧操作视频 + 对应的双手机械手MANO关节轨迹（动作块）
analysis.robot_dependency: MANO手模型 + 自研/通用仿真器（未明确命名，但实验含EGAD、YCB等物体交互，推断依赖PyBullet或Mujoco级仿真）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人采集数据：所有训练数据来自合成视频+MANO轨迹配对（如EgoDex衍生、自渲染数据集），摘要未提任何real-robot collection或fine-tuning
analysis.significance_reason: 虽首次实现视频-动作联合扩散建模并打通策略生成与数据合成，但全部验证停留在仿真+合成数据，无真实手部执行、无跨任务泛化测试（如换物体/换手型）、无与ACT/ALOHA等基线在相同任务上的定量对比，仅报告‘accuracy/fidelity/smoothness’提升而无具体指标和baseline数值，属扎实但窄域的表示创新，未触及具身智能核心瓶颈（sim2real gap、长程闭环、真实硬件鲁棒性）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把视频扩散和动作生成在联合隐空间里做了漂亮对齐，但仍是仿真沙盒里的优雅构造，离真实灵巧操作还有显著距离。

papers.title: Goal2Pixel: Grounding Goals to Pixels for Vision-Language Navigation
papers.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) have become a common foundation for vision-and-language navigation in continuous environments (VLN-CE). Yet most VLM-based methods cast navigation as low-level action prediction, an interface that is ambiguous, tied to short-horizon motion primitives, and inefficient due to repeated VLM querying. We propose Goal2Pixel, a pure pixel-based paradigm that reformulates VLN-CE as navigable pixel grounding. Rather than predicting actions, Goal2Pixel uses the image plane as a unified spatial interface between VLM reasoning and robot motion: the model predicts a visible navigable pixel to the agent, which is back-projected into a 3D waypoint for forward navigation. For non-forward actions, we append auxiliary directive regions to the image plane, where the left/right/bottom regions are interpreted as turning left, turning right, and stopping, respectively. To enable long-horizon navigation, we propose a visibility-aware keyframe memory for compact and informative history representation. To adapt pretrained VLMs to navigable pixel grounding, we introduce semantic embeddings and coordinate-aware auxiliary losses. Goal2Pixel achieves competitive state-of-the-art performance while requiring fewer VLM inference calls than prior methods. On R2R-CE Val-Unseen it achieves 54.1% SR and 52.5% SPL with just 7.75 VLM calls per episode, 6x fewer than the 46.62 required by direct action prediction at 32.9% SR. The same trend holds on RxR-CE.Project Page: https://baobao0926.github.io/Goal2Pixel/.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文把视觉语言导航（VLN）任务从预测动作改成预测图像中一个可到达的像素点，再把这个像素反投影成3D路点让机器人前进；转向和停止则用图像边缘区域编码，大幅减少大模型调用次数。
analysis.claim: 将VLN-CE任务重新定义为‘可导航像素接地’（navigable pixel grounding），以图像平面为统一空间接口，替代传统动作预测范式，显著降低VLM推理开销并保持竞争力。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言导航指令
analysis.output: 单个可见可导航像素坐标（及辅助区域分类：左/右/底）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真器（R2R-CE/RxR-CE，基于Habitat或AI2THOR等标准VLN-CE仿真平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，仅使用公开VLN-CE仿真数据集（R2R-CE/RxR-CE）
analysis.significance_reason: 提出像素接地新接口有启发性，但仅在标准VLN-CE仿真基准上验证，无真实机器人实验、无跨机体/跨场景泛化、无硬件闭环、无开源代码，性能提升源于减少VLM调用而非解决根本性语义-动作对齐难题；相比RT-2/π0/OpenVLA等具身智能基石工作，它未涉及多任务泛化、世界模型、长程规划或真实部署，属扎实但窄域的仿真方法改进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把VLM输出空间从离散动作映射到连续像素，是聪明的接口重设计，但未突破VLN-CE仿真瓶颈，也未触达具身智能核心挑战。

papers.title: GRAFT: Gain-Recalibrated Adapters for Transformer-Based Neural Population Activity Modeling
papers.abstract: Neural population activity models can recover rich temporal structure from binned spikes, but their read-in and readout layers often remain tied to a fixed set of recorded neurons. This coupling limits reuse in long-term brain-computer interfaces, where recorded neuron identities, counts, and response statistics can change across days. We introduce GRAFT, a Transformer-based neural population activity model that separates reusable temporal dynamics from a recalibratable neuron interface. The neuron interface controls how recorded neurons enter and leave the shared backbone, and auxiliary gain and positional mechanisms support neural activity modeling inside the Transformer. On MC Maze under the standard NLB'21 protocol, GRAFT reaches 0.3866 co-bps as an ensemble, setting a new state of the art on the primary co-bps metric among public and reported NLB'21 results. In a cross-day protocol constructed from the NLB'21 MC Maze dataset series, GRAFT recalibrates from MC Maze to the scaled MC Maze datasets (Large/Medium/Small) by updating only 9.21% of parameters, reaching 0.3749, 0.3112, and 0.3152 co-bps with restricted target-day support sets. These results show that the same interface-backbone separation supports both strong Transformer-based neural population activity modeling and data-efficient cross-day recalibration.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出GRAFT模型，用带增益重校准适配器的Transformer来建模神经群体活动，核心是把可复用的时间动态建模（backbone）和可快速重校准的神经元接口（interface）解耦，从而在跨天记录神经元变化时，只更新不到10%参数就能保持高解码性能。
analysis.claim: 通过解耦共享Transformer主干与可重校准的神经元接口，GRAFT能在神经元集合随时间大幅变化（如跨天BCI记录）的条件下，以极低参数更新代价维持高性能神经活动建模。
analysis.input: 分箱化脉冲序列（binned spikes），含动态变化的神经元集合（身份、数量、响应统计）
analysis.output: 重建的连续神经活动轨迹（用于下游解码，如运动意图或手写字符）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖NLB'21公开的MC Maze猕猴运动皮层电生理数据集；未使用任何真实机器人或闭环BCI硬件部署数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在NLB'21标准基准上刷新SOTA（0.3866 co-bps），并在构造的跨天协议中验证了仅更新9.21%参数即可迁移至不同规模数据集，实证扎实且直击长期BCI中神经信号漂移这一关键工程瓶颈；但未涉及在线闭环、真实用户临床部署、多被试泛化或跨物种验证，也未突破基础建模范式（仍是监督式spike-to-activity回归），故未达基石级（90+）水平。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将Adapter机制与Transformer成功迁移到神经解码领域，针对跨天神经漂移问题给出高效、实证充分的模块化解法，但未进入临床闭环或开辟新范式。

papers.title: μ_0: A Scalable 3D Interaction-Trace World Model
papers.abstract: World models that capture how actions induce physical change enable scalable robot learning without reliance on embodiment-specific action labels. Pixel-space video models provide broad visual priors but expend model capacity on dense appearance reconstruction, while direct action models require embodiment-specific labels that hinder scalability. We present μ_0, a scalable world model based on 3D traces. Rather than predicting dense pixels or directly modeling actions, μ_0 forecasts smooth 3D trajectories for salient interaction points such as objects, tools, hands, and contact regions, yielding a compact, embodiment-agnostic motion interface. To enable training from diverse video sources, our TraceExtract system automatically extracts 3D supervision by selecting keypoints, constructing globally aligned traces, and associating motion segments with hierarchical language captions. This TraceExtract supervision pretrains μ_0 by combining a pretrained vision-language backbone with a modular trace expert, which represents each query via B-spline control points and predicts future traces. Experiments show that μ_0 outperforms baselines in both 2D and 3D trace prediction, including trace prediction models and tokenized VLM methods. Because μ_0 is frozen and reusable, it can be paired with action experts for downstream robot embodiments. Despite action-free pretraining, the resulting trace-conditioned policies achieve performance competitive with VLA models pretrained with action supervision, such as π_0. These results establish 3D traces as a scalable and transferable representation for cross-embodiment manipulation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出μ_0世界模型，不预测像素视频也不依赖具体机器人动作标签，而是从多源视频中自动提取3D交互轨迹（如手、物体、接触点的平滑运动路径），用B样条参数化建模，并冻结该模型作为通用运动接口，供不同机器人下游策略调用。
analysis.claim: 3D交互轨迹是一种可扩展、跨机体、无需动作监督的世界模型表示形式，能替代像素预测或动作标签实现高效机器人泛化。
analysis.input: RGB视频帧 + 分层语言描述
analysis.output: 未来若干步的3D关键点轨迹（B样条控制点参数）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，仅用公开视频（如Ego4D、EPIC-KITCHENS等）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统性构建并验证了以3D交互轨迹为统一表征的世界模型范式，实证覆盖多视频源、多任务轨迹预测、跨机体策略迁移，且在无动作监督下达到VLA级性能；但未在真实机器人上部署，也未挑战长期开放难题（如具身因果推理或长时序规划），尚属强增量而非范式革命。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——它跳出了‘像素重建’和‘动作回归’两大主流范式，用轻量、几何明确、跨机体的3D轨迹作为世界模型核心输出，实证扎实且接口设计有工程落地潜力，但尚未跨越到真实机器人闭环验证。

papers.title: MinJ is a conserved nine-pass transmembrane protein that contains a putative transmembrane β-sheet
papers.abstract: The Min system disassembles FtsZ-rings after septation in Bacillus subtilis and is localized to the nascent division plane and cell poles by the protein MinJ. The N-terminal region of MinJ contains transmembrane segments while the C-terminal region of MinJ contains a PDZ domain but its topology and functional domains are poorly understood. Here we empirically test MinJ topology based on a variety of transmembrane prediction models and find that the data is most consistent with Alphafold3, which predicts a 9-pass transmembrane protein with an external N-terminus and internal C-terminus. Deletion analysis indicates that all regions of the protein tested are required for function but deletion of the PDZ domain alone preserves polar localization and interaction with both MinD and DivIVA. Moreover, Alphafold predicts that transmembrane segments 6 and 7 comprise staves of an unusual transmembrane β-sheet and deletion of the putative β-sheet in the absence of MinD results in a minicell frequency that exceeds mutation of MinD alone. Bioinformatic analysis indicates that MinJ is highly conserved within Firmicutes and is co-conserved with MinD and DivIVA with which it interacts. Our data clarify the structure of MinJ and support models in which MinJ has functions in addition to restricting the activity of the Min system.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文通过整合AlphaFold3预测、跨模型拓扑比对、功能缺失突变实验和生物信息学分析，确定了枯草芽孢杆菌中MinJ蛋白是一个具有9次跨膜且含跨膜β-片层的保守膜蛋白，并发现其PDZ结构域非极性定位所必需，而跨膜β-片层在MinD缺失背景下对防止异常分裂（minicell）起关键作用。
analysis.org: 印第安纳大学伯明顿分校
analysis.claim: MinJ是一个进化保守的九次跨膜蛋白，其跨膜区6–7构成罕见的跨膜β-片层，该结构在MinD缺失时独立维持细胞分裂位点精度，表明MinJ具有超越经典Min系统调控的额外功能。
analysis.input: MinJ氨基酸序列、多种跨膜预测模型输出、突变体表型数据（minicell频率）、蛋白质互作实验结果、Firmicutes基因组比对数据
analysis.output: MinJ跨膜拓扑模型（9次跨膜，N-out/C-in）、功能关键区域图谱（PDZ非必需于极性定位）、跨膜β-片层结构证据、保守性与共进化关系
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 提供了MinJ高置信度拓扑结构与关键功能域的实验证据链（AF3预测+多模型比对+系统性截断突变+表型量化+共进化分析），但局限于单一细菌模型（B. subtilis），未构建新计算模型或通用预测工具，也未拓展至其他Min系统变体或真核同源物，属于扎实的分子机制解析工作，未达领域基石级（如AlphaFold/ESM/RFdiffusion）的范式突破或通用性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：用多源证据收敛确认了一个长期模糊的膜蛋白拓扑与功能模块划分，但未催生新方法、新数据库或跨物种通用模型。

papers.title: Kepler-Encoder-v0.1: Towards a Multimodal Embedding Model for Robots
papers.abstract: A robot must understand the state of its own body, but a camera sees only part of it. Force and contact leave almost no trace in a single frame, and raw vision features read force at $R^2$ at or below $0.10$ on every robot we test. We present Kepler-Encoder-v0.1, a robot-first multimodal encoder that treats robot state as a modality and fuses vision, proprioception, and force/torque into a single shared latent with a learned-query cross-attention layer, trained self-supervised by masked cross-modal prediction under the LeJEPA/SIGReg objective. At evaluation only vision enters, which poses a sharp question. Does fusing state into training make the vision-only latent carry anything the pixels do not already contain? On the RH20T corpus the answer is yes, precisely where the camera is weakest. On held-out scenes, the vision-only latent recovers end-effector state, and force in particular, significantly above both raw frozen-ViT features and a compute-matched vision-only control on every sensored robot, though absolute force recovery at a single timestep is modest; on motor state, which the camera largely sees, it is statistically tied with the strongest vision baselines, and it is the only feature whose latent geometry tracks state. A single embodiment-agnostic encoder covers four robots, and a data-matched control shows this breadth reflects embodiment diversity rather than data volume. The frozen latent is directly useful. Its own cross-modal prediction error is a training-free invalid-state monitor (AUROC $0.90$ on out-of-range states, $0.69$ on scene-swapped states), and a diffusion decoder (PixNerd) reconstructs the camera frame from the latent, confirming the spatial compression preserves world-state. This report validates the single-timestep case; native-rate temporal fusion is the next step.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出Kepler-Encoder-v0.1，一个专为机器人设计的自监督多模态编码器，把本体感知（关节角、速度）、力/扭矩传感器数据和视觉图像一起融合进共享隐空间；训练时用多模态掩码预测，但推理时只输入单帧图像——结果发现，仅靠图像就能在隐空间中恢复出相机看不见的力信号（尤其在遮挡/弱纹理场景），且该隐空间几何结构天然反映机器人状态，还能直接用于无训练异常检测和图像重建。
analysis.claim: 将机器人本体状态（proprioception + force/torque）作为显式模态参与自监督多模态编码器训练，能使纯视觉输入在隐空间中编码出超越像素本身的信息——特别是相机无法直接观测的接触力，且该隐空间具备状态可解释性与下游即用性。
analysis.input: 单帧RGB图像（推理时唯一输入）
analysis.output: 共享隐向量（含end-effector位姿、力/扭矩、电机状态等解耦表征）
analysis.robot_dependency: RH20T数据集涉及的4款真实机器人（未指明型号，但含sensored robot），实验基于真实传感数据
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实机器人多模态同步采集数据（vision+proprio+force），无仿真替代说明
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：跨4种真实机器人验证、对比冻结ViT与计算量匹配的纯视觉基线、消融证明是多模态融合而非数据量导致泛化、提供AUROC 0.90的零样本异常检测和PixNerd重建验证隐空间保真度；但未开源代码/模型，未展示闭环控制或任务级性能提升，仍属单步感知表征突破，尚未达到RT-2/Octo级的端到端动作生成范式跃迁。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——首次在真实机器人上证实：仅靠单帧视觉输入，经多模态自监督预训练的冻结编码器即可隐式解码出物理接触力，且隐空间具备状态几何一致性，为机器人视觉理解提供了新范式基础。

papers.title: Systematic Development of a Compact Genome-Editing Tool Leveraging the TAM-Independent DNA Nuclease TasR in Bacillus subtilis
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Bacillus subtilis is a core microbial chassis in biomanufacturing, and establishing efficient gene editing technologies is key to engineering this strain. In conventional CRISPR gene editing technologies, the large size of DNA nucleases leads to difficulties in plasmid construction, low transformation efficiency, and cumbersome multi-round editing operations; therefore, developing miniature gene editing tools can effectively address these issues. Although our group previously established a miniature gene editing tool based on IscB in B. subtilis SCK6, IscB relies on the 5′-CAGGAA-3′ TAM recognition sequence, and 83.36% of the genes in the SCK6 genome harbor no or only one TAM sequence, indicating a bottleneck of restricted editing for IscB in this strain. The novel miniature DNA nuclease TasR does not require a TAM sequence and can thus compensate for the limitation of IscB; however, the applicability of TasR in B. subtilis remains unknown. Therefore, this study first constructed a single plasmid, pBsuTasR, capable of expressing TasR and its guide RNA (tigRNA), which enabled gene deletion of regular-sized fragments in SCK6 with editing efficiencies of 21.7%– 78.3%. Subsequently, the capacity of TasR to delete a long DNA fragment (169.9 kb) was evaluated, and it was found that under the guidance of a single tigRNA, the deletion efficiency was 21.73%, whereas after optimizing to two tigRNAs, the efficiency increased to 39.13%. Furthermore, the gene integration capability of pBsuTasR was further tested, and TasR was able to integrate the aprN gene into the amyE locus at an efficiency of 13.3% under the guidance of a single tigRNA, and after increasing to two tigRNAs, the integration efficiency increased to 91.3%. In terms of iterative genome editing, this study developed the pBsu-SRP (Scissors-Rock-Paper) iterative editing system, which automatically cures the editing plasmid from the previous round while performing a new round of gene editing, with sequential gene deletion efficiencies of 4.34%–26.08%, and using this system, the editing cycle can be shortened from 4N days by the conventional method to 3N+1 days. Subsequently, the pBsu-SRP system was successfully used to achieve the integration of two and three copies of the mCherry fluorescent reporter gene in SCK6, and it was found that the fluorescence intensity increased with the copy number. Finally, this study also explored the escape of SCK6 from TasR cleavage and found that mutations in the tigRNA sequence are the cause of the escape. In summary, this study constructed a novel miniature genome editing system in B. subtilis using the TAM-independent nuclease TasR as the core component. This system can not only provide an efficient technical tool for genetic manipulation of industrial microorganisms, but also offer new instrumental support for the iterative engineering and functional optimization of chassis cells in biomanufacturing.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文在枯草芽孢杆菌SCK6中构建了一个基于新型微型核酸酶TasR的基因编辑系统，该系统不依赖TAM序列，支持单/双向导RNA介导的高效基因删除（最高78.3%）、大片段删除（169.9 kb，效率39.13%）、基因整合（最高91.3%）及自动质粒清除的多轮迭代编辑，显著缩短编辑周期。
analysis.claim: TasR可在B. subtilis中实现TAM无关、高效率、可迭代的紧凑型基因组编辑，突破IscB工具因TAM位点稀缺导致的编辑瓶颈。
analysis.input: 靶向DNA序列 + tigRNA设计
analysis.output: 基因删除/插入/大片段替换的工程菌株
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实的微生物基因编辑工具开发：验证了TasR在B. subtilis中的首个功能性应用，实测多类型编辑效率并建立可迭代系统，但仅限单一菌株（SCK6），未跨菌种/底盘验证，无大规模功能筛选或工业级通量数据支撑，未开源代码/质粒图谱（仅提‘project-page’），远未达ESM/AlphaFold级范式突破或dtSFM级通用性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：在特定工业菌株上实现了有实测数据支撑的新型编辑工具落地，但封闭于单一底盘、缺乏通用性验证与开源完整性，暂未形成方法论外溢。

papers.title: FARM: Forecasting Antibiotic Resistance in Mycobacterium tuberculosis using biophysics and machine learning
papers.abstract: Antibiotic-resistant tuberculosis remains a major public health challenge, and rapid diagnosis of resistant infections based on genomic markers holds promise for improving time to effective treatment. However, the vast majority of clinically observed variants in resistance-associated genes remain of uncertain significance, limiting the utility of predictors. Here we develop a multimodal forecasting framework, FARM (Forecasting Antibiotic Resistance in Mycobacterium tuberculosis ) to determine whether a newly observed mutation in a resistance gene may indeed cause resistance. Our framework combines structural context, biophysical energy features, protein language model features, and mutational AAIndex physicochemical descriptors. Using 345 labeled mutations from the World Health Organization 2021 catalogue, we train interpretable models that distinguish resistance-associated from non-resistance-associated variants with holdout AUCs of 0.843-0.943. In a novel temporal evaluation of 62 mutations reclassified after the training data was released, the selected Combined model achieved 80.7% recall of resistant reclassifications (resistant-class F1=86.8; AUC=0.735). Applied to 4,525 current uncertain-significance mutations, the framework prioritizes 696 candidate resistance mutations, including genes associated with the new antibiotics bedaquiline, delamanid, and pretomanid. These forecasts are intended to support future catalogue updates and experimental follow-up.

analysis.tldr: 用结构信息、生物物理能量、蛋白语言模型和氨基酸理化特征融合建模，预测结核分枝杆菌中未知意义突变是否导致抗生素耐药，验证了对新出现耐药突变的回溯识别能力，并为4525个临床意义不明突变提供了696个高置信度耐药候选。
analysis.org: 西北大学/芝加哥大学/印第安纳大学（依据作者单位：Lulu Kang-西北大学统计系；Jianhan Chen-印第安纳大学生物化学；Anna G. Green-芝加哥大学微生物学）
analysis.claim: 整合结构上下文、生物物理能量、蛋白语言模型表征与氨基酸理化描述符的多模态框架FARM，能可靠预测结核分枝杆菌中临床意义不明突变的耐药性功能影响。
analysis.input: 突变位点（基因+氨基酸变化）及其对应蛋白三维结构上下文、MM/GBSA估算的结合自由能变化、ESM-2嵌入向量、AAIndex理化特征
analysis.output: 二分类预测（是否导致耐药）及概率得分
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在耐药预测这一关键临床转化问题上，首次系统整合结构生物物理+PLM+理化特征进行可解释建模，并通过严格的时间外推（temporal holdout）验证泛化性——62个WHO后续新归类突变中实现80.7%耐药召回，远超单模态基线；但未开源代码/模型，仅提供项目页，且未在独立临床队列或湿实验中验证预测结果，尚未形成闭环验证。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅：方法设计扎实、评估严谨（含时间外推）、生物学可解释性强，显著推进耐药突变功能注释的实用化水平，但缺乏开源与实验验证，未达里程碑级。

papers.title: Prior Availability in Industrial Visual Sim-to-Real: A Review of CAD-Guided and CAD-Unavailable Regimes
papers.abstract: Industrial visual sim-to-real is often described as transferring from synthetic images to real images, but industrial deployment usually involves a broader mismatch between available evidence and required decisions. A system may be built from CAD renderings, simulated RGB-D observations, normal reference images, synthetic defects, pretrained feature spaces, or language prompts, yet deployed under different sensors, lighting, materials, fixtures, calibration, production variation, and rare defect modes. This review reframes industrial visual sim-to-real as a domain-gap problem organized by prior availability. We distinguish CAD-available settings, where explicit object geometry can support rendering, calibration, pose estimation, segmentation, and test-time geometric verification; CAD-unavailable settings, where geometry is replaced by normal-reference appearance, feature distributions, teacher-student residuals, synthetic anomaly assumptions, foundation features, or vision-language priors; and boundary-prior settings, where approximate models, templates, reference views, or semantic correspondences preserve only part of the CAD role. This framing connects CAD-based detection and 6D pose-estimation literature with industrial anomaly and surface-inspection literature that is usually reviewed separately. To make the taxonomy concrete, we use empirical anchors on T-LESS/BOP, MVTec AD, and VisA. The anchors show that CAD render count alone does not close transfer; source-distribution design, detector capacity, and small real calibration can matter more. They also show that CAD at test time creates a distinct verification channel through mask, pose, and depth consistency, whereas CAD-unavailable inspection relies on calibrated normality and feature deviation. The review therefore argues against a single cross-task leaderboard and instead asks what prior grounds the deployment decision.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文不是提出新方法，而是对工业视觉领域sim-to-real问题做概念重构：按‘先验可用性’（尤其是CAD模型是否可用）把现有工作分成三类，指出CAD是否在训练/部署时存在会根本改变技术路径和评估逻辑。
analysis.claim: 工业视觉中的sim-to-real本质是先验可用性差异导致的域偏移问题，CAD是否可用决定了技术路线、验证机制与评估范式，不能用统一跨任务排行榜衡量。
analysis.input: 工业图像（合成/真实）、CAD模型、正常样本、语言提示等多源先验
analysis.output: 分类框架与评估原则建议
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，依赖公开工业视觉数据集（T-LESS/BOP/MVTec AD/VisA）
analysis.significance_reason: 提供了有实证支撑（T-LESS/MVTec等锚点）的分类学框架，厘清了CAD在工业视觉中作为结构先验的核心作用，但未提出可复现的新算法/模型/系统，也未解决任何具体任务性能瓶颈，属于高质量综述性分析而非技术推进；显著弱于World Models/DreamerV3等基石工作（后者定义新范式并开源可扩展架构），也不具备UniPi/DreamZero级的跨模态具身决策整合能力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将分散的工业视觉文献按先验结构重新组织，揭示了CAD可用性对技术选择的决定性影响，但无新模型、无真机验证、无开源实现，属于高水平领域认知梳理，非技术突破。

papers.title: MoDex: A Diffusion Policy for Sequential Multi-Object Dexterous Grasping
papers.abstract: This work addresses sequentially grasping multiple objects with a single dexterous hand without releasing those already held. Most dexterous grasping methods commit all of the hand's degrees of freedom to a single object, underutilizing its dexterity and leaving no redundancy for subsequent grasps. The proposed solution, MoDex, is a diffusion policy that predicts the next gripper pose directly from observations, conditioned on an opposition space and point cloud. The opposition space condition specifies which fingers participate in the current grasp, enabling the gripper to use only a subset of its available degrees of freedom while reserving the remaining degrees of freedom for subsequent grasps. To facilitate sim-to-real transfer, MoDex is trained in two stages: first through imitation learning on expert demonstrations, and subsequently through reinforcement learning fine-tuning, which consistently improves success rates over the pre-trained policy. We evaluate MoDex in simulation on a MuJoCo-based Franka Emika Panda robot equipped with an Allegro Hand and on the corresponding real-world hardware platform. Across both simulation and real-world experiments, MoDex achieves higher success rates than the evaluated learning-based baselines, improving performance by 2.92-17.92% and 6.67-17.78%, respectively. Project page: https://modex2026.github.io/.

analysis.tldr: 提出MoDex扩散策略，让灵巧手在不松开已抓物体的前提下，依次抓取多个物体，通过‘对立空间’条件控制哪些手指参与当前抓取，从而保留其余自由度用于后续操作，并在仿真和真实Franka+Allegro平台上验证了其多物体连续抓取的成功率提升。
analysis.claim: 通过引入可配置的‘对立空间’条件机制，扩散策略能显式保留灵巧手未使用的自由度，实现无需释放的顺序多物体灵巧抓取，且sim2real迁移有效。
analysis.input: 点云+当前夹爪观测+对立空间条件（指定参与抓取的手指子集）
analysis.output: 下一时刻夹爪6D位姿
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂 + Allegro Hand灵巧手
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真专家演示数据（MuJoCo）和少量真实机器人微调数据（摘要称RL fine-tuning在real-world平台进行，但未说明是否用真实交互数据采集）
analysis.significance_reason: 实质性推进了灵巧操作中‘自由度预留’这一长期挑战，首次将条件化扩散策略与手指级动作掩码（opposition space）结合，在真实硬件上完成多物体顺序抓取（非单次抓取），性能超越多个学习型基线；但未达ALOHA/ACT级系统性范式突破（如端到端闭环、跨任务泛化架构、大规模人类行为数据驱动），也未开源代码/模型，复现门槛高。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在Diffusion Policy框架下做出扎实的灵巧手动作约束创新，实机验证充分，但缺乏开源与更大规模泛化证据，尚未构成新范式。

papers.title: EAGG: Embodiment-Aligned Grasp Generation via Geometry-Aware Graph Conditioning
papers.abstract: Cross-end-effector grasp generation seeks a unified model that generalizes across objects and across embodiments ranging from parallel grippers to dexterous end effectors. Existing grasp generators are typically designed for a fixed embodiment or encode embodiment identity with a static descriptor, which weakens transfer when topology, actuation coupling, and contact geometry differ substantially. We present EAGG, an embodiment-aligned grasp generator that represents each embodiment with a topology-aware end-effector graph and an embodiment-specific low-dimensional end-effector control space. A frozen end-effector-cognition backbone converts the current articulated state into geometry-aware tokens that act as a reusable morphology prior, and iterative geometry injection refreshes these tokens throughout sampling so that conditioning remains synchronized with the evolving end-effector geometry. On the MultiGripperGrasp benchmark, EAGG reaches 56.17% average success across six training end effectors, remaining within 1.10 percentage points of specialized training while preserving transfer to finetuning and zero-shot end effectors. Iterative geometry injection further reduces the pooled median contact distance from 0.239 cm to 0.189 cm. These results show that cross-end-effector grasp generation is strengthened by aligning embodiment structure inside a shared generator rather than suppressing embodiment differences. Code is available at https://github.com/wanhaoniu/EAGG.

analysis.tldr: 提出EAGG方法，用图结构显式建模不同机器人末端执行器的拓扑与几何特性，并在生成抓取姿态时动态注入实时几何信息，实现单模型跨多种末端执行器（平行夹爪到灵巧手）的泛化抓取。
analysis.claim: 跨末端执行器的抓取生成性能提升源于在共享生成器内部对执行器形态结构进行显式、动态对齐，而非忽略或静态编码形态差异。

analysis.output: 6D抓取位姿（位置+旋转）及关节配置

analysis.significance_reason: 首次将末端执行器建模为几何感知图并引入迭代几何注入机制，在统一生成框架下实现强跨执行器泛化（6种训练末端+零样本迁移），但仅在仿真基准验证、无真机部署、无接触力/触觉/动态交互验证，未触及操作闭环或任务级泛化，显著弱于T-Rex/ALOHA/π0等基石工作（均含真机多任务闭环、触觉/视觉-动作联合学习、大规模人类演示或部署验证）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：方法设计扎实、泛化实证充分（仿真内跨6种末端+零样本），但限于纯仿真、无物理交互验证，属于高质量增量而非范式突破。

papers.title: Decoupling Semantics and Geometric Grounding: Spatial Visual Prompts for Language-Conditioned Imitation Learning
papers.abstract: While end-to-end Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models show promise in robotic manipulation, their monolithic paradigm inherently couples semantic reasoning and spatial control. This creates a severe alignment bottleneck, limiting precise target disambiguation in data-constrained imitation learning. To overcome this, we propose SVP-IL, a decoupled architecture that explicitly extracts spatial visual grounding from the action generation loop. By leveraging vision-language foundation models, we parse instructions into zero-shot geometric masks, translating language into explicit Spatial Visual Prompts (SVP). These priors are injected into a continuous action generator via a lightweight direct feature-level fusion mechanism. This integration provides explicit and uncorrupted spatial gradient guidance while ensuring highly stable optimization under low-data regimes. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SVP-IL significantly outperforms state-of-the-art VLAs and pure visuomotor baselines. Trained on as few as 50 to 100 demonstrations, SVP-IL improves average success rates on highly ambiguous language-conditioned tasks from 24.0% to 39.5%, achieving 67.8% on standard benchmarks. Real-world robotic experiments further validate its robustness and data efficiency in unstructured physical environments.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种解耦语义理解和空间定位的新架构SVP-IL，用视觉语言基础模型自动生成几何掩码作为空间视觉提示，注入动作生成器，在仅50–100条演示数据下显著提升语言指令驱动的机器人操作成功率，尤其在目标歧义任务上效果突出。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构缩写、项目名或致谢线索；姓名均为中文名但无 affiliation 信息）
analysis.claim: 解耦语义解析与几何空间接地可突破语言条件模仿学习中的对齐瓶颈，使小样本下语言驱动的机器人操作具备高精度空间控制能力。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 连续动作序列（末端执行器轨迹）
