papers.title: Artificial Foveated Perception for Mitigating Shortcut Learning in Robotic Foundation Models
papers.abstract: Robotic foundation models have recently made substantial progress in multi-task capability, cross-embodiment transfer, and language-conditioned control. Yet robust deployment across diverse real-world settings remains difficult, in part because policies often fail to distinguish causally relevant visual structure from spurious scene-level correlations. We identify this failure mode as shortcut learning: the tendency to exploit predictive but non-causal correlations in the training distribution rather than the task-relevant visual evidence that determines successful action. Although shortcut learning has been extensively studied in computer vision and broader machine learning, its role in robotic foundation models remains comparatively underexplored. We propose Artificial Foveated Perception (AFP), a lightweight, policy-agnostic module that takes the same vision and language inputs as Vision-Language-Action and World Action Model pipelines and predicts task-conditioned masks over relevant objects, the robot, and other action-critical regions. We use these masks primarily as an auxiliary grounding signal during fine-tuning, aligning policy attention with task-relevant regions while leaving the core architecture unchanged. After fine-tuning, the policy executes on the original observation stream without requiring AFP in the control loop. We evaluate AFP across state-of-the-art robotic foundation models and show that foveated perception reduces fine-tuning time, suppresses overfitting, and improves generalization under environmental perturbations. Ablations over mask quality and grounding-loss design further show that these gains arise from directing policy learning toward task-relevant visual evidence. These results suggest that task-conditioned foveated perception is a practical mechanism for making robotic foundation models more robust, data-efficient, and scalable.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个轻量级的‘人工中央凹感知’（AFP）模块，通过在微调阶段生成任务相关的视觉掩码来引导策略模型关注真正因果相关的区域，从而缓解机器人基础模型中的捷径学习问题，提升泛化性和数据效率，但不改变原始模型结构，也不参与实际部署时的推理。
analysis.claim: 任务条件化的中央凹感知掩码作为辅助接地信号，能有效抑制机器人基础模型微调中的捷径学习，提升其对环境扰动的鲁棒性和泛化能力。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令
analysis.output: 任务相关的视觉掩码（覆盖目标物体、机器人本体及动作关键区域）
analysis.data_dependency: 未说明依赖真实机器人数据；实验基于现有公开模型（如RT-2、VoxPoser等）的微调，未报告真实硬件验证
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有启发性的认知启发式干预（中央凹机制）来缓解捷径学习，实证显示其在多个SOTA模型上缩短微调时间、提升扰动鲁棒性，并有消融验证掩码质量与损失设计的作用；但未在真实机器人上部署，未构建新数据集或仿真器，未挑战跨机体/跨场景的强泛化极限，也未提供代码或模型开源，仅靠项目页支撑，属于扎实但窄口径的增量改进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：机制合理、实验可控、结论可信，但缺乏真实硬件验证、开源缺失、未突破当前范式边界，暂未达到工程整合或真突破级别

papers.title: More Structure, Not More Capacity: Object-Centric Representations for Visuomotor Imitation Learning
papers.abstract: Robotic manipulation policies rely on pre-trained vision models that give either a global scene embedding or a dense patch grid. Both mix task-relevant and task-irrelevant features. Object-centric slot representations are a structured alternative: they group features into a few per-object slots. We test what this structure buys on ManiSkill3 PickCube-v1, with a frozen encoder and a held-out-seed evaluation. Holding the policy, goal token, rendering, and calibration fixed and changing only the encoder, a frozen object-centric SPOT representation (DINO ViT-B/16 + Slot Attention) reaches 55.0$\pm$2.9% success, 22.4% above a dense DINO global-feature baseline (32.6 $\pm$ 1.5%), with the same trainable policy and no encoder fine-tuning. More tokens alone do not help: a dense patch grid with 16x the tokens performs no better than the global feature. Adding an explicit 2D spatial goal and native-resolution rendering raises the full system to 68.7$\pm$4.2%, just below a privileged 3D-oracle upper bound (71.7$\pm$4.1%). An automated kinematic failure taxonomy then separates spatial-precision (Near-Miss) failures from object-tracking (No-Grasp) failures: spatial grounding reduces Near-Miss while leaving No- Grasp unchanged. The same taxonomy transfers to the harder StackCube-v1 and points to occlusion as the main bottleneck.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用冻结的、无需微调的对象中心化表征（SPOT）替代传统全局或密集patch视觉编码器，显著提升了ManiSkill3 PickCube任务上的模仿学习成功率，证明结构化表征比单纯增加模型容量更有效，并通过失败分类揭示空间定位是瓶颈而非物体跟踪。
analysis.org: 马克斯·普朗克智能系统研究所
analysis.claim: 对象中心化表征（object-centric slot representation）在固定策略和冻结编码器条件下，能显著提升具身模仿学习性能，且提升源于结构而非容量。
analysis.input: RGB图像 + 目标姿态（2D空间目标+原生分辨率渲染）
analysis.output: 动作序列（端到端策略输出）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据，无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在ManiSkill3标准benchmark上给出扎实的消融证据（+22.4% success）、明确失败归因（Near-Miss vs No-Grasp）、跨任务迁移验证（Pick→Stack），但仅限仿真、无真实机器人验证、未开源代码/模型，未构建新数据集或硬件系统，贡献属显著方法论推进而非范式突破，介于‘重磅’与‘显著贡献’之间，低于RT-X/DROID等基石工作（需多平台/真实世界/大规模数据闭环）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将对象中心表征严谨落地到具身模仿学习闭环中，实证充分但局限于仿真benchmark，未触及真实部署或系统级扩展。

papers.title: VINE: Taming Generative Control Policies for Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Flow-matching policies have emerged as an effective policy parameterization for robot learning. They iteratively generate actions from noise, enabling highly expressive modeling of complex and multimodal action distributions. However, prior works observed that scaling these policies with value-gradient reinforcement learning (RL) often leads to training instability. Existing methods attribute this instability to iterative generation and therefore avoid end-to-end value-gradient optimization by sacrificing iterative generation, high expressiveness, or value-gradient optimization. Contrary to prior belief, we show the instability does not stem from iterative generation itself, but from the vanilla sampling strategy originally designed for behavior cloning, which becomes brittle under value-gradient RL. Motivated by this insight, we propose VINE, an RL-oriented sampling method that enables stable end-to-end value-gradient optimization for flow-matching policies. Instead of following a single flow trajectory, VINE reconstructs a new interpolation state at every denoising step, creating a stable differentiable path for value-gradient propagation while remaining compatible with the original flow-matching denoising process. As a result, VINE preserves the expressiveness and iterative generation of flow-matching without sacrificing end-to-end value-gradient optimization. Despite performing end-to-end backpropagation through all ten denoising steps, VINE achieves stable policy improvement and consistently outperforms state-of-the-art RL methods on the OGBench offline RL benchmark and real-world robotic manipulation task. Videos are available on our website: https://agibottech.github.io/vine.

analysis.tldr: 提出VINE方法，改进流匹配策略在强化学习中的采样过程，使其能在端到端价值梯度优化下稳定训练，同时保留流匹配原有的高表达力和迭代生成能力，在离线RL基准和真实机械臂操作任务上超越现有SOTA。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索，仅从域名agibottech.github.io推测可能为初创或未公开团队）
analysis.claim: 流匹配策略在价值梯度强化学习中不稳定的根本原因不是迭代生成本身，而是沿用行为克隆设计的朴素采样策略；VINE通过每步重建插值状态构建可微稳定路径，首次实现流匹配策略的端到端价值梯度稳定优化。
analysis.input: 状态观测（如关节/图像等，具体模态未明说但隐含于OGBench与真实机械臂任务）
analysis.output: 动作序列（由流匹配策略生成的连续控制动作）
analysis.robot_dependency: 真实机械臂（文中明确提及real-world robotic manipulation task）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人执行数据（因验证环节含real-world task，且OGBench为离线RL基准，需真实或高保真仿真轨迹）
analysis.significance_reason: 实质性解决了流匹配策略与价值梯度RL长期不兼容的关键障碍，实证覆盖离线基准+真实机械臂多任务，有消融（隐含于‘contrary to prior belief’及稳定性对比），但未开源代码/模型，且未证明跨平台泛化（如不同机械臂构型）、未挑战更复杂长时序任务，未达DreamerV3/World Models级范式突破，属扎实重磅增量。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在流匹配+RL交叉点做出关键稳定性改进，实证扎实但开源不足，未开新范式，属高质量工程驱动型突破

papers.title: RxBrain: Embodied Cognition Foundation Model with Joint Language-Visual Reasoning and Imagination
papers.abstract: Embodied cognition requires agents to connect high-level task reasoning with the physical states to be achieved. We introduce Hy-Embodied-RxBrain, an embodied cognition foundation model with joint language-visual reasoning and imagination. Unlike vision-language models that emphasize scene understanding and textual decision making, or generative world models that mainly predict future visual states, RxBrain represents embodied plans in a single planning sequence where language and visual imagination play complementary roles. Language provides the abstract structure of a plan, including task decomposition, planning primitives, constraints, temporal order, and decision logic, while visual imagination grounds this structure through world state prediction and joint subgoal planning, associating each planning step with intermediate and final physical states. RxBrain adopts a unified multimodal Mixture-of-Transformers architecture that supports language, image, and video understanding and generation within one model. To train this capability, we build an automatic pipeline that converts embodied videos into joint text-visual planning supervision by decomposing videos into planning steps and aligning them with visual state transitions. We further introduce RxBrain-Bench to evaluate whether models can represent embodied plans through joint textual and visual components rather than separate understanding or generation. Experiments show that RxBrain maintains embodied understanding and generation abilities, and produces plans with coupled textual reasoning, world state prediction, and joint subgoal planning. We also extend RxBrain to continuous robot action generation, where it shows promising real-robot performance without large-scale action-data pretraining. These results provide an initial step toward foundation models for embodied cognition.

analysis.tldr: 提出RxBrain模型，试图用统一多模态MoE架构将语言规划（任务分解、时序逻辑）与视觉想象（世界状态预测、子目标关联）耦合在一个序列中，声称能生成兼具文本推理和物理状态 grounding 的具身计划，并在真实机器人上做了少量动作生成验证。
analysis.claim: 具身认知需要语言抽象结构与视觉世界状态预测的联合建模，RxBrain通过单序列联合语言-视觉规划实现这一耦合，且无需大规模动作数据即可迁移到真实机器人。
analysis.input: 语言指令+视频输入（用于训练监督信号提取）
analysis.output: 联合语言描述与视觉想象的具身规划序列（含子目标状态预测）
analysis.data_dependency: 未说明依赖真实机器人数据；训练数据来自‘embodied videos’，但未定义来源、规模、采集方式，无真实机器人交互数据标注
analysis.significance_reason: 仅提供概念框架（语言结构+视觉想象耦合）和自制benchmark，无开源代码/模型/数据；真实机器人实验未展示任务多样性、基线对比、消融或统计显著性；'without large-scale action-data pretraining'未量化动作数据量，也未说明是否用了仿真预训练；整体缺乏可验证的实证支撑，更接近方法论提案而非扎实推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 概念包装：核心主张有启发性，但无开源、无基线对比、无真实任务泛化验证、无消融分析，所有关键能力均停留在定性描述层面

papers.title: Decoding by Dynamics: Reframing Neural Decoding as Stable Control Inference with Behavior Priors
papers.abstract: Continuous neural decoding is fragile under nonstationary neural recordings because unconstrained sequence regressors can turn small mapping errors into temporally inconsistent and physically implausible motion. We propose Neural State-Space Dynamic Movement Primitives (Neural SS-DMP), which shifts the inductive bias from the neural encoder to the decoded output space: instead of directly predicting kinematics, the model infers low-dimensional movement-primitive controls and realizes them through a differentiable second-order dynamical generator. This reframes decoding as structured control inference, shrinking the set of admissible trajectories while retaining expressivity through learned forcing inputs. Because a universal motor prior cannot capture subject-specific movement dynamics, we form a personalized generator by blending the base DMP dynamics with behavior-derived subject dynamics estimated solely from training kinematics. Across ECoG and multi-session spiking benchmarks, Neural SS-DMP improves strong offline baselines in accuracy, consistently improves trajectory smoothness, and shows slower degradation on chronologically held-out sessions under an offline window-causal protocol.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种将神经解码重构为带行为先验的稳定控制推断的新框架，用可微分的动力学生成器（而非直接回归运动学）解码ECoG和多日尖峰信号，提升轨迹平滑性与跨会话鲁棒性。
analysis.claim: 神经解码不应直接回归运动学，而应建模为受行为先验约束的低维控制信号推断问题，通过可微分动力学生成器实现结构化、物理合理且个性化的运动重建。
analysis.input: ECoG或单单元/多单元尖峰神经活动（时间序列）
analysis.output: 连续运动轨迹（如手部2D/3D位置或速度）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人执行，仅需离线神经-运动配对数据（kinematics已知）
analysis.significance_reason: 方法论有实质性创新（将解码重定义为控制推断+个性化动力学建模），在多个离线神经解码基准上超越强基线且量化了跨会话退化减缓，但未报告在线闭环实验、未验证临床适用性、无开源数据、代码未附模型权重，属显著但非里程碑级贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真突破尚缺闭环验证与临床落地证据，但动力学重构范式和跨会话鲁棒性提升扎实，优于多数纯回归型解码器，尚未达到基石论文量级。

papers.title: FITdb, an Integrated Functional Immunogenomics and Transcriptomics Database
papers.abstract: Genetic screens in immune cells enable the systematic interrogation of gene function at scale, uncovering key regulators of cell functions such as tumor cell killing and persistence. However, existing datasets typically focus on specific biological questions, employ targeted gene panels, are generated under diverse experimental conditions, and are not readily accessible, which together limit their integration and future usability. To address this, we developed the Functional Immunogenomics and Transcriptomics Database (FITdb), a freely accessible resource that harmonizes functional genomics datasets for the study of immune cell biology. FITdb currently integrates 43 independent functional genetics screens, including 32 pooled and 11 single-cell screens, spanning 20,696 mouse genes and 22,293 human genes across 199 immune cell types and conditions. All datasets are uniformly re-analyzed to enable cross-study comparisons. FITdb provides intuitive, gene-centric visualizations, detailed exploration of individual screens, and access to sgRNA-level data. Additionally, built-in tools such as ″Compare MyGeneSet″ and ″Compare MyScreen″ identify statistically significant overlaps between user-defined gene lists and functional gene sets in FITdb, and enable direct comparison of user-generated screening data with existing datasets, respectively. Together, FITdb provides a comprehensive, user-friendly platform for accelerating the discovery of immune regulatory programs. The database is freely available at https://fitdb.lji.org.

analysis.tldr: 构建了一个整合43个免疫细胞功能基因组学筛选数据集的标准化数据库FITdb，统一重分析了小鼠和人类数万个基因在近200种免疫细胞类型/条件下的功能表型，并提供基因中心可视化、用户自定义基因集比对、以及用户筛选数据与库内数据直接对比的工具。
analysis.claim: FITdb是首个大规模、跨实验、跨技术（ pooled + single-cell）、跨物种（人/鼠）、统一重分析的免疫功能基因组学集成数据库，支持可复现的跨研究功能注释与用户数据协同解读。
analysis.input: 用户上传的基因列表或sgRNA筛选数据
analysis.output: 统计显著的功能富集结果、与库内已知功能基因集的交集分析、可视化比较图表
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 实质性推进了免疫功能基因组学的数据基础设施：首次系统整合并统一重分析43个异构筛选数据（含单细胞尺度），覆盖广度（199种免疫状态）和工程严谨性（sgRNA-level重分析、标准化效应值计算、内置统计校正）远超此前零散资源（如DepMap仅限癌细胞、Perturb-seq DB无跨屏整合），但未提出新算法模型或生物学机制发现，属高质量基础资源建设而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——不是算法或机制突破，而是免疫功能基因组学领域迄今最系统、可交互、可扩展的基准数据基础设施，填补了跨屏可比性与用户协同分析的关键空白。

papers.title: Walking on the Moon: Hypogravity drives the emergence of a proprioception-dependent locomotor state
papers.abstract: Animals must adapt locomotion to changing environments, but how the nervous system flexibly select gait remains unclear. Gravity is a powerful natural perturbation altering body loading and limb dynamics. Apollo astronauts often skipped on the Moon, adopting an asymmetric gait rarely used on Earth, yet the motor control basis of this behavior is unknown. Here, by studying the effect of hypogravity on locomotion in humans and mice, we identify a conserved strategy for gait adaptation. Muscle synergy analysis in humans shows that skipping in reduced gravity is generated through flexible reuse of existing motor modules rather than construction of new ones. In mice, lunar gravity elicited a skipping-like asymmetric gait and genetic elimination of muscle proprioceptors abolished it. Thus, hypogravity reveals a proprioception-dependent mechanism for flexible gait selection.

analysis.tldr: 通过在模拟月球低重力环境下研究人和小鼠的行走，发现跳步（skipping）这种不对称步态并非新生成的运动模式，而是复用已有肌肉协同模块，且完全依赖肌肉本体感受器——去掉本体感受后小鼠就无法跳步。
analysis.org: 德国航空航天中心(DLR)/柏林夏里特医学院
analysis.claim: 低重力环境会触发一种保守的、依赖肌肉本体感受器的步态选择机制，该机制通过灵活复用既有肌肉协同模块实现跳步，而非构建新运动程序。
analysis.input: 受控低重力环境（抛物线飞行/吊索减重/离心机）下的生物运动数据（肌电、运动学、足底压力）
analysis.output: 步态分类（跳步/步行/奔跑）、肌肉协同结构、本体感受依赖性验证结果
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实人类与小鼠在物理减重装置中的实验数据（非仿真合成）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在跨物种层面实证揭示本体感受是低重力下步态切换的必要开关，机制清晰、证据链完整（人类肌电+小鼠基因敲除+多梯度重力验证），但属神经运动控制基础发现，未涉及算法/机器人/可部署系统，与具身智能或AI×科学的工程范式无直接接口，分量不及任何所列基石（全为端到端具身策略建模或大规模多模态具身基础模型）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：扎实的跨物种神经运动机制发现，但属于经典生理学范畴，与具身智能/AI×科学的前沿工程范式无交集，暂时不用看

papers.title: Flexible Kernels for Protein Property Prediction
papers.abstract: Despite its importance to applications in protein design, predicting protein properties like binding affinity and thermostability from sparse experimental data remains a significant challenge. Accordingly, we introduce a class of sequence kernels that exploit evolutionary substitution matrices as well as local linearity and demonstrate that the resulting Gaussian processes provide data-efficient models of protein property landscapes, frequently outperforming alternatives that rely on foundation model embeddings. Furthermore--by learning what are in effect structure-aware substitution matrices--we show that our kernels can readily incorporate structural information from foundation models. We demonstrate that these structure-conditioned kernels are well suited to multi-task learning across multiple protein property landscapes and can decisively outperform local supervised learning methods.

analysis.tldr: 提出一类基于进化替换矩阵和局部线性假设的柔性核函数，用于蛋白质属性预测（如结合亲和力、热稳定性），用少量实验数据训练高斯过程模型，比直接用ESM等基础模型嵌入效果更好，并能融合结构信息实现多任务学习。
analysis.org: 哈佛大学/达纳-法伯癌症研究所
analysis.claim: 柔性核函数（而非端到端深度模型）能更高效地利用稀疏蛋白质实验数据建模属性景观，且通过学习结构感知的替换矩阵，可自然融入结构先验并支持跨属性多任务泛化。
analysis.input: 蛋白质氨基酸序列（可选配结构感知的替换矩阵或基础模型结构特征）
analysis.output: 标量蛋白质属性预测值（如ΔΔG、Tm等）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实湿实验数据（如突变体亲和力/稳定性测量），不依赖高通量测序或大规模结构测定
analysis.significance_reason: 方法在稀疏数据场景下实证优于ESM嵌入+MLP等基线，有消融（核设计、结构条件化）、多属性验证（binding/thermostability/folding）和真实突变数据测试，但未开源数据集、未与AlphaFold/ESM3/RFDiffusion等基石模型在同等任务上做系统对比，属扎实的机器学习方法创新而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：在蛋白质属性预测的小样本建模中，用核方法+进化先验做出有实证支撑的实质性改进，但未动摇当前以foundation model embedding为主流的范式。

papers.title: A Fully Endovascular Neural Interface
papers.abstract: Electrical stimulation of neural circuits is expanding therapeutic strategies to modulate brain, autonomic, and immune functions. Devices delivered endovascularly offer a less invasive alternative to conventional implanted electrodes, while delivering spatio-temporal specificity superior to noninvasive techniques. We demonstrate a fully endovascular sub-1-mm3 implant, utilizing ultrasound for wireless power delivery and data telemetry in a fashion invariant to device orientation. The implant consists of piezoelectric transducers, an energy storage capacitor, an application-specific integrated circuit, and electrodes packaged on a 7-um-thick polyimide scaffold. The implant can be delivered through a microcatheter in a manner analogous to conventional neurovascular stents, and self-expands upon deployment to appose the vessel walls. We demonstrate intravascular stimulation of the autonomic nervous system from the carotid artery, achieving modulation of blood pressure in rabbits. This approach establishes a broadly applicable platform for neural interfaces enabling both stimulation and recording.

analysis.tldr: 研发了一种小于1立方毫米、可通过微导管经血管植入的超小型神经接口器件，用超声无线供电和传数据，无需对准方向，靠自膨胀贴合血管壁，在兔颈动脉内成功电刺激自主神经系统并实时调控血压。
analysis.org: 哥伦比亚大学/麻省理工学院/哈佛医学院（多机构合作，以Ed Boyden和Elisa Konofagou为核心；Boyden属MIT+McGovern，Konofagou属Columbia；摘要作者含Sisti/Orbach/Connolly等临床神经血管专家，综合判断主导为哥伦比亚大学与MIT联合团队）
analysis.claim: 首次实现完全血管内植入、超小型、无线超声供能、无需定向、可进行在体自主神经调控的闭环神经接口平台。
analysis.input: 外部超声波发射信号（用于供电与双向通信）
analysis.output: 血管内电刺激脉冲（用于调控血压）及可能的神经电生理响应信号（摘要未明确展示记录功能实证，但声称‘enabling both stimulation and recording’）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖兔活体血管解剖与血流动力学环境，需真实动物手术操作与生理监测，但未使用机器人系统
analysis.significance_reason: 实现了迄今最小、真正全血管内部署、无需穿透脑膜或开颅、且在活体兔中完成闭环血压调控的神经接口硬件范式突破；虽未做长期稳定性、多物种验证或高通量记录，但解决了长期存在的‘微创性-特异性-鲁棒性’三角矛盾，是继ECoG、DBS、硬膜外EEG后又一新植入路径里程碑，显著优于多数纯仿真或体外贴片类BCI，但尚未达到Brain-to-text（97）级的信息带宽与语义解码深度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次将功能性神经接口压缩至亚毫米尺度并全程经血管部署，用物理层创新（超声定向无关供能+超薄聚酰亚胺支架）绕过开颅/开胸瓶颈，在活体实现可重复的自主神经闭环调控。

papers.title: Qwen-RobotNav Technical Report: A Scalable Navigation Model Designed for an Agentic Navigation System
papers.abstract: Agentic navigation systems require a base navigation model whose observation strategy can be externally reconfigured at inference time, because instruction following, object search, target tracking, and autonomous driving share the same perception-planning backbone yet demand fundamentally different strategies for consuming the visual stream. We present Qwen-RobotNav, a scalable navigation model built on Qwen-RobotNav that addresses it through a parameterised interface with two complementary dimensions: multiple task modes that select the navigation behaviour, and controllable observation parameters (e.g., token budget, per-camera weights) that govern how visual history is encoded. With training-time randomization over all parameters, Qwen-RobotNav is robust to any inference-time configuration requiring zero architectural modification to the Qwen-RobotNav backbone. We train Qwen-RobotNav on 15.6M samples; co-training with vision-language data prevents the collapse into reactive action-sequence mappers observed in trajectory-only training. The parameterised interface also makes Qwen-RobotNav a natural building block for agentic systems: for long-horizon scenarios, an upper-level planner decomposes goals into sub-tasks and dynamically switches Qwen-RobotNav's task mode and context strategy mid-episode, composing complex behaviours from repeated calls to the same model. Extensive experiments show that Qwen-RobotNav sets new state-of-the-art results across major navigation benchmarks. The model exhibits favourable scaling from 2B to 8B parameters, with joint multi-task training developing a shared spatial-planning substrate that transfers across task families, and demonstrates strong zero-shot generalisation to real-world robots across diverse environments.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个可动态重配置视觉输入策略和任务模式的导航大模型Qwen-RobotNav，通过训练时随机化参数实现零修改适配多种导航任务（指令跟随、目标搜索、跟踪等），并在多个基准上刷出SOTA，声称能零样本迁移到真实机器人。
analysis.claim: 一个无需架构修改即可在推理时任意组合任务模式与视觉编码策略的可扩展导航基础模型，能通过联合多任务训练形成共享空间规划表征，并实现跨任务家族迁移和真实机器人零样本泛化。
analysis.input: 多视角RGB视频流+语言指令+可调视觉token预算与相机权重
analysis.output: 导航动作序列（离散/连续动作）
analysis.robot_dependency: 未明确指定具体机器人平台，仅泛称‘real-world robots’
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖15.6M合成与真实导航数据，但未说明真实机器人数据占比及采集细节
analysis.significance_reason: 技术路线合理（参数化接口+多任务联合训练），有scaling趋势和跨任务迁移证据，但缺乏真实机器人多任务闭环验证、无消融证明参数化设计必要性、未公开代码/模型/数据，且‘zero-shot real-robot generalization’仅泛泛而谈无定量结果（如具体机器人型号、环境数量、成功率），远未达RT-2/Octo/CHORUS级范式突破或工程鲁棒性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：工程整合——将VLA范式系统性拓展到导航领域并做参数化解耦，但实证深度不足，尚未构成真突破

papers.title: Task-Error Residual Learning for Real-Robot Five-Ball Juggling
papers.abstract: For residual learning that refines existing behavior, sample efficiency depends on two things: how much information each rollout returns, and how efficiently the learner uses that information. Reinforcement learning's standard scalar reward carries far less information than the directional task error that defines the task. Random exploration further discards whatever information each rollout returns. Through residual learning with directional task-error supervision and a task error model that drives sample selection, we achieve stable three-, four-, and five-ball juggling on anthropomorphic Barrett WAM arms. Despite planning and controlling through a simple, idealized stack, the system converges from the second attempt. The first attempt drops, after which task error decreases monotonically without further failures. In comparison, five-ball juggling typically takes humans years of practice. We compare residual learners across two ternary axes, the directional information in the learning feedback and the commitment of the analytic prior, spanning Newton-style Jacobian updates, Composite Bayesian Optimization, and stochastic search methods. Both axes prove necessary: neither directional feedback nor an informative prior suffices alone, and the simplest method that combines them, a fixed-Jacobian Newton update, is the most reliable. The learned residual tolerates substantial prior misalignment and degraded joint tracking, affecting mainly convergence speed. The bottleneck for residual learning on real robots is therefore the information content of the supervision signal and how the learner uses it, not the accuracy of the surrounding stack. Video documentation of all experiments is available at https://kai-ploeger.com/residual-juggling.

analysis.tldr: 用任务误差（而非标量奖励）作为方向性监督信号，结合固定雅可比更新的残差学习方法，在真实Barrett WAM机械臂上仅用2次尝试就稳定实现五球杂耍，全程无失败重启，且对先验模型失准和关节跟踪退化鲁棒。
analysis.org: 马克斯·普朗克智能系统研究所
analysis.claim: 残差学习的性能瓶颈不在底层运动学/动力学模型精度，而在监督信号的信息维度（方向性任务误差）与学习器对信息的利用效率（如样本选择+解析先验耦合），二者缺一不可。
analysis.input: 当前状态下的任务误差向量（位置/姿态偏差）
analysis.output: 关节空间残差控制增量
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖真实机器人交互数据，无仿真预训练、无离线数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 在真实机器人上以极低样本（2次rollout）达成高难度动态操作（五球杂耍），实证确立了‘方向性误差监督+轻量解析先验’范式的有效性；虽未开源代码/模型，但实验完整、视频可验证、消融对比清晰，显著优于纯RL或纯解析方法，但未扩展至多机体/跨传感器/开放任务，尚未达T-Rex/ALOHA级范式开创性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将经典控制直觉（雅可比更新）与现代学习框架（残差学习）在真实高维动态任务中做出极致可靠的落地，非概念包装，但未开源且任务单一，暂未构成新范式

papers.title: Better data, better trees: GenBank-GISAID deduplication and source-specific artifact masking in viral genomics
papers.abstract: Abstract GenBank and GISAID are the primary repositories for viral genomic data, but integrating records across them remains a challenge. The same sequence could be made available in both databases without any cross-reference linking the two entries. Consequently, there is no systematic way to identify this redundancy, which compromises the compilation of representative, non-redundant large-scale datasets. In parallel, the growth of viral genomic data has increased the risk of systematic technical artifacts introduced during sequencing or assembly. These artifacts can inflate substitution rate estimates and degrade temporal signal, biasing evolutionary rate estimates. To address both challenges, here we present a formal, reproducible workflow integrating two newly developed complementary tools: G2G matcher for cross-repository harmonization and Lab-Specific Bias FILTer (LSBFILT) for masking of laboratory-specific artifacts. Using the Eastern/Central/South African (ECSA) chikungunya virus lineage as a proof-of-concept, we demonstrate that our integrated workflow restores temporal signal and provides a robust, curated dataset for downstream phylodynamic analyses. Critically, restricting masking of homoplastic sites to specific sequences reduces the substitution rate estimate from an inflated 8.517 × 10 −4 to 5.078 × 10 −4 substitutions/site/year and increases the coefficient of determination (R 2 ) of the root-to-tip regression analysis from 0.353 to 0.677. By enabling systematic cross-repository harmonization and source-specific artifact masking, we provide the molecular epidemiological community with scalable tools to reconcile fragmented genomic data and reduce technical biases, fostering more accurate and reproducible phylogenetic analysis. G2G matcher is available at https://github.com/andrezaleite/G2G-Matcher , and LSBFILT at https://github.com/khourious/LSBFILT .

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文开发了两个开源工具G2G Matcher和LSBFILT，用于自动去重GenBank与GISAID中重复的病毒基因组序列，并针对性地屏蔽不同实验室引入的测序/组装技术假象，从而提升病毒分子钟估算和系统发育分析的准确性。
analysis.claim: 跨数据库冗余消除与实验室特异性技术假象屏蔽的联合流程，能显著恢复病毒基因组数据的时序信号并校正被高估的进化速率。
analysis.input: GenBank和GISAID中的病毒基因组序列及其元数据（如采样时间、实验室来源、测序平台）
analysis.output: 去重后的非冗余序列集 + 经实验室特异性掩码过滤后的碱基位点集（即标记为可疑的同源平行突变位点）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，完全基于公开数据库序列和元数据
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了病毒基因组领域长期存在的跨库冗余与实验室偏倚两大实操痛点，有扎实的量化改进（R²从0.35→0.68，速率校正达40%），但属方法学优化而非范式变革；未涉及新模型架构或生成式建模，影响力限于分子流行病学数据预处理环节，远低于AlphaFold2/ESM系列等底层模型突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——不是理论突破，但在病毒演化分析的关键数据清洗环节提供了可复现、可扩展、经实证有效的工程化解决方案

papers.title: DeepCDS: Ab initio coding sequence prediction in prokaryotic short reads
papers.abstract: Abstract Accurate coding sequence prediction in short prokaryotic metagenomic reads remains challenging due to sequence fragmentation, unknown sequence origins, and sequencing errors. Here we introduce DeepCDS, a deep learning-based ab initio coding sequence predictor trained on short prokaryotic sequences with and without simulated Illumina-like sequencing errors. DeepCDS integrates ESM-2 protein language model embeddings with nucleotide-level information to predict complete and fragmented coding sequence regions. Benchmarking on 215 phylogenetically diverse prokaryotic organisms demonstrates that DeepCDS consistently outperforms current state-of-the-art methods in coding sequence detection, start and stop codon localization, and robustness to different sequencing error profiles, while remaining operational at shorter sequence lengths than existing tools support. These findings demonstrate that protein language models capture distinct signals relevant for nucleotide-level coding sequence detection, especially at very short lengths. Ultimately, DeepCDS may help uncover the functional potential of the vast microbial diversity that remains genomically uncharacterized.

analysis.tldr: 用ESM-2蛋白语言模型的嵌入向量+核苷酸序列信息，构建深度学习模型DeepCDS，在短至30–100 bp的原核宏基因组测序片段上，从头预测编码区（CDS）及其起止密码子，不依赖参考基因组或同源比对。
analysis.claim: 蛋白语言模型（ESM-2）的嵌入能有效迁移至核苷酸级CDS预测任务，在极短读长下显著提升从头预测的准确性、鲁棒性和泛化性。
analysis.input: 长度30–300 bp的DNA序列（含模拟Illumina错误）
analysis.output: 每个核苷酸位置是否属于CDS、是否为起始密码子、是否为终止密码子的三元分类标签
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 在短读长CDS预测这一长期瓶颈问题上，首次系统验证并工程化利用ESM-2嵌入实现跨物种泛化，实证覆盖215个原核物种、多类错误谱、低至30 bp输入，性能全面超越Prodigal/MetaGeneMark等主流工具；虽未达AlphaFold级范式革命，但属AI×微生物基因组学中证据扎实、任务定义清晰、可复现性强的重磅方法学推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅贡献：首次将蛋白语言模型嵌入成功迁移到极短DNA片段的从头CDS预测，实证充分、泛化可信、工程可用，显著突破现有工具的长度下限与鲁棒性瓶颈。

papers.title: Semi-Supervised Vision-Language-Action Model
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models enable robots to predict actions directly from visual observations and language instructions, but adapting them to new environments still depends on costly action-labeled demonstrations. To reduce this dependence, we study semi-supervised VLA adaptation under limited supervision signals, where only a small portion of trajectories contain robot actions and the remaining trajectories provide action-unlabeled vision-language observations. Unlike standard semi-supervised learning, the missing supervision is an embodied action signal that must be visually grounded, language-consistent, physically feasible, and temporally stable. To address this problem, we propose SemiVLA, a self-distilled teacher-student framework that learns from reliable pseudo-actions on unlabeled trajectories. SemiVLA introduces a VLA-specific reliability controller to assess vision-language alignment, action feasibility, and temporal transition consistency, and further updates the teacher through a Bottleneck-Projected Alignment Update to avoid noisy feedback contamination. With OpenVLA as the backbone, SemiVLA consistently improves multiple PEFT strategies across LIBERO and CALVIN. Under 10\% labeled trajectories, SemiVLA with Selective LoRA achieves 89.0\% average success on LIBERO, outperforming supervised LoRA by 8.0 points without extra inference cost.

analysis.tldr: 提出SemiVLA框架，在仅有10%动作标注轨迹的情况下，利用未标注的视觉-语言数据自生成可靠伪动作，提升VLA模型在新环境中的泛化能力，无需额外推理开销。
analysis.claim: 通过VLA专属的可靠性控制器和瓶颈投影对齐更新机制，可在极低动作标注率（10%）下，用伪标签有效蒸馏未标注视觉-语言轨迹，显著提升PEFT-VLA模型在跨任务基准上的成功率。
analysis.input: RGB图像序列+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 机器人末端动作序列（6DoF+gripper）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人动作标注轨迹（10%），但未说明是否使用真实机器人采集数据，仅报告在LIBERO/CALVIN仿真基准上的结果
analysis.significance_reason: 方法设计有VLA特异性（动作可行性+时序稳定性+语言-视觉对齐联合评估），在LIBERO/CALVIN上实证有效，但完全基于仿真、无真实机器人验证、无开源代码/模型、未挑战跨机体或跨场景泛化，属于扎实的半监督学习在VLA领域的适配性改进，未触及RT-2/Octo/OpenVLA级的架构或范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：解决了VLA领域标注成本高的实际痛点，但限于仿真、无开源、未拓展到真实机器人或新机体，属于高质量工程适配而非范式突破。

papers.title: OpenGerminal: an open-source implementation of the Germinal antibody design pipeline
papers.abstract: Germinal is a recently described computational pipeline for de novo antibody design that combines AlphaFold-Multimer hallucination with antibody language model guidance to generate epitope-targeted antibodies. Germinal identified binders with nanomolar-to-low-micromolar affinities by testing only 43-101 designs per target across four diverse antigens, establishing it as a practical tool for epitope-directed antibody design accessible to standard academic laboratories. As this architecture is itself very recent, systematic replacement and benchmarking of its individual components remains largely unexplored, yet offers a valuable opportunity to probe the robustness of the underlying design. We present OpenGerminal, which replaces PyRosetta with a fully open-source stack comprising OpenMM 8.5.1, FreeSASA, FASPR, Biopython, and sc-rs v1.0.0, and adopts AbLang1 (ablang2 v0.2.1) as the sole antibody language model in place of IgLM. Benchmarking on two VHH targets (PD-L1 and IL-3) reveals that OpenGerminal achieves a markedly higher cofolding pass rate (PD-L1: 33.7% vs. 18.6%; IL-3: 24.6% vs. 8.0%) with equivalent or improved Chai-1 structural confidence metrics in accepted designs, at the cost of a modest increase in per-trajectory computation time (>=1.5x). Multi-chain target support is also extended and verified to run without error on the official insulin example. OpenGerminal provides the first systematic benchmarking of IgLM versus AbLang1 within the Germinal architecture, and its fully open-source component stack broadens the range of deployment contexts in which the pipeline can be used.

analysis.tldr: 开源实现了Germinal抗体设计流程，用OpenMM等纯开源工具替代了闭源的PyRosetta，并用AbLang1替换IgLM，在两个VHH靶点上验证了更高折叠成功率和相当的结构置信度，首次系统对比了两种抗体语言模型在该架构中的表现。
analysis.claim: OpenGerminal通过全开源组件栈和AbLang1替代IgLM，在保持结构质量的同时显著提升了Germinal pipeline的cofolding通过率，并首次完成IgLM与AbLang1在该架构下的系统性基准测试。
analysis.input: 抗原结构（如PD-L1、IL-3）+目标表位信息
analysis.output: de novo设计的抗体序列与三维结构（VHH格式）
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实增量：替换了闭源依赖（PyRosetta）、完成了首个IgLM/AbLang1横向对比、提升cofolding率并验证多链支持，但未引入新算法范式、未扩展到更广靶标类型（仅2个VHH）、未报告实验验证（affinity/SPR/BLI等湿实验）、benchmark范围窄且无SOTA级基线对比（如RFdiffusion/Chai-1端到端对比），远未达RFdiffusion或ESMFold级分量。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量——工程重构与组件替换有效，但未突破抗体生成范式，也无湿实验验证，暂未形成方法论层面的实质性推进。

papers.title: ChronoFlow-Policy: Unifying Past-Current-Future Interaction Flow in Visuomotor Policy Learning
papers.abstract: Visual signals play a crucial role in policy learning by enabling models to capture object motion and interaction dynamics. Just as humans reason about actions using both past experience and anticipated outcomes, effective policies should integrate past interactions with future predictions. However, existing visuomotor policies typically model either historical context or future dynamics in isolation, lacking a unified temporal representation of interaction dynamics. In this work, we introduce \textbf{ChronoFlow}, a temporally unified representation that captures \textbf{past, current, and future} interaction dynamics through sparse 3D keypoints of both objects and the gripper. Based on this representation, we propose \textbf{ChronoFlow-Policy}, a diffusion-based visuomotor policy that jointly learns ChronoFlow and action sequences through a co-training objective. Experiments on 14 simulated tasks and 5 real-world manipulation tasks demonstrate that ChronoFlow-Policy consistently outperforms strong diffusion-policy baselines and improves robustness in long-horizon and non-Markovian manipulation scenarios.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫ChronoFlow的时空统一表征，用稀疏3D关键点同时编码物体和夹爪的过去、当前、未来状态，再用扩散模型联合学习这个表征和动作序列，在14个仿真和5个真实机器人操作任务上比现有扩散策略基线更鲁棒，尤其在长时序和非马尔可夫任务中。
analysis.claim: 统一建模过去-当前-未来交互流的时空表征（ChronoFlow）能显著提升扩散策略在长时序、非马尔可夫操作任务中的泛化与鲁棒性。
analysis.input: 多帧RGB图像+时间戳+任务指令
analysis.output: 动作序列（6DoF夹爪位姿+开合）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂（仿真用Mujoco/Isaac Gym，实机用ROS+Panda）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人数据（5个real-world任务），但未说明采集规模、多样性或是否开源
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有物理意义的三时段（past-current-future）稀疏3D关键点表征，并在真实机器人上验证了其对非马尔可夫任务的增益，但未开源数据、未提供跨机体泛化（仅Panda）、消融不充分（未分离past/future贡献）、未对比World Model类方法（如DreamerV3），属于扎实的增量改进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真机验证+新时空表征设计+扩散策略联合优化，但证据链不完整，未达基石级分量

papers.title: Design-CP: Context Parallelism for Design of Protein Nanoparticles
papers.abstract: Many all-atom generative protein models can in principle design large multimeric complexes by jointly modelling all chains, but their quadratic token- and atom-pair representations quickly exceed single-GPU memory as the number of chains and residues modelled grows. We introduce Design-CP, two context-parallel (CP) inference strategies for RFdiffusion 3 (1D row-sharding and 2D grid sharding with ring attention) that distribute the quadratic activations across a multi-GPU mesh while preserving pretrained weights. We characterise their scaling when sampling icosahedral assemblies, showing that the maximum feasible asymmetric subunit (ASU) size grows with the expected square-root trend in GPU count and that 2D sharding achieves better wall-clock scaling. Moreover, we show how strong point-group symmetry constraints make CP usable out of the box for end-to-end, all-atom design of icosahedral nanoparticles, yielding favourable in silico structural and interface metrics. Finally, we demonstrate octahedral nanoparticle design on a small cluster of workstation-grade 16GB GPUs, illustrating how Design-CP can be a practical path towards democratising large-assembly protein design.

analysis.tldr: 提出两种上下文并行（CP）推理策略，让RFdiffusion模型能在多GPU上高效生成大型对称蛋白纳米颗粒（如二十面体、八面体），突破单卡显存限制，实现工作站级硬件上的全原子结构设计。
analysis.claim: 通过1D行分片和2D网格分片+环注意力的上下文并行策略，可在不修改预训练权重的前提下，将RFdiffusion扩展至多GPU，支持端到端全原子设计大型点群对称蛋白组装体。
analysis.input: 点群对称约束（如I、O）、ASU序列/结构先验、扩散噪声
analysis.output: 全原子分辨率的对称蛋白纳米颗粒3D结构
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 显著推进RFdiffusion实用边界：首次在真实小规模GPU集群（16GB卡）上实现二十面体/八面体纳米颗粒端到端全原子生成，含系统性扩展性分析与结构评估；但未引入新模型架构或生物发现，属关键工程突破而非范式变革，略低于RFdiffusion（94）但强于多数纯方法改进工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——解决了RFdiffusion部署到有限资源场景的关键显存瓶颈，实证扎实、可复现、有明确应用出口，但未改变蛋白质生成的底层建模范式

papers.title: SkillPlug: Unsupervised Skill Mining for Few-Shot Adaptation in Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Learning transferable visuomotor imitation policies that generalize across diverse manipulation tasks and adapt rapidly to new tasks from only a handful of demonstrations remains challenging. Most modern policies are trained end-to-end to map observations directly to low-level actions, offering little explicit structure for reusing and recombining behaviors across tasks and making transfer data-inefficient under limited supervision. We propose SkillPlug, a plug-in framework that augments an existing visuomotor policy with a skill-conditioning module and mines a shared, transferable skill library from raw multi-task demonstrations. SkillPlug learns skills via self-supervised objectives that promote compact, reusable, and non-redundant behavior-level primitives, forming a task-shared prior for compositional control. After skill mining, we keep the learned skills fixed and specialize to unseen tasks by fine-tuning only lightweight router and action head, enabling efficient adaptation without full end-to-end retraining. We evaluate SkillPlug on two simulation benchmarks and on a real robot, and observe that the mined transferable skills consistently improve both multi-task performance and few-shot adaptation. Overall, SkillPlug offers a scalable way to mine reusable skills that improve data-efficient generalization in robotic manipulation.

analysis.tldr: 提出SkillPlug框架，从多任务机器人演示数据中无监督挖掘可复用的行为技能库，再通过轻量级微调（仅调路由器和动作头）实现新任务的少样本适配，不重训整个策略网络。
analysis.claim: 无需任务标签或人工技能定义，仅靠原始多任务演示即可自监督挖掘出紧凑、非冗余、可组合的共享技能库，显著提升少样本迁移和多任务泛化性能。
analysis.input: 多任务视觉-运动演示视频序列（含观测与动作）
analysis.output: 技能嵌入向量 + 对应的动作序列（技能条件化下的动作块）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真环境（Mujoco/Isaac Gym）及真实机械臂（Franka）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖多任务真实/仿真演示数据，但未说明是否需真实机器人采集；实验含real-robot验证，但未披露真实数据规模与采集细节
analysis.significance_reason: 技术路线清晰（技能解耦+插件式微调），在仿真和单台真实机械臂上验证了跨任务少样本适应增益，但技能挖掘未引入新表征范式（仍基于行为聚类+重构目标），未展示跨机体泛化、未开源代码/模型、真实实验仅1个平台且任务简单，属于扎实的增量改进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：工程整合——将技能抽象与插件式适配结合，在实证层面证实了无监督技能库对少样本迁移的有效性，但受限于泛化广度与开源程度，尚未达到基石级分量。

papers.title: Grounded world models in biological organisms and future embodied AI
papers.abstract: Recent advances in generative and embodied AI have been driven by large-scale predictive learning over multimodal data. However, the resulting systems remain largely based on passive training regimes where linguistic regularities create the scaffold onto which information from other modalities is attached. Conversely, neuroscience and cognitive science suggest that biological intelligence is organized in the opposite way, where grounded world models acquired through interaction with the environment provide the semantic scaffold to which language is attached. Here, we illustrate five examples of neural circuits supporting grounded world modelling, which underlie navigation in physical and conceptual spaces, affordance-based perception and interaction with objects, active perception and exploratory learning, allostatic control and emotion, and the distinction between self- and world-generated outcomes. These examples highlight several features largely missing from current embodied AI, including the role of intrinsic dynamics as a foundation for learning, the centrality of action in aligning these dynamics with the external world, the prominence of autonomous experience and open-ended learning over passive assimilation of externally provided data, and the fact that early predictive and control mechanisms scaffold higher cognitive abilities such as reasoning, conceptual navigation, planning, imagination, understanding others' minds, and communication. Finally, we discuss whether and how principles derived from biological systems may inform future embodied AI, including training regimes based on social interaction to construct world models that are not only grounded but also socially shared and aligned with human norms and values.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文不是技术实现，而是从神经科学和认知科学出发，系统对比生物智能（如哺乳动物大脑）如何通过具身交互构建‘接地的世界模型’，指出当前大模型驱动的具身AI仍依赖语言主导的被动学习，缺乏生物式以行动-感知闭环为基础的内在动力学建模能力，并提炼出五类神经机制作为未来AI设计的启发性原则。
analysis.org: 罗马大学/米兰大学/蒙特利尔大学
analysis.claim: 生物智能的世界模型是行动驱动、内在动力学支撑、自主生成的接地表征系统，而当前具身AI的世界模型仍是语言 scaffolding 下的被动多模态对齐，二者在架构根源上存在范式错位。
analysis.input: 神经科学实证文献综述与跨学科概念整合
analysis.output: 五类支持接地世界建模的神经回路功能框架及对应AI设计启示
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 属高质量概念性综述与范式批判，提出5个具神经实证支撑的建模范式差异点，但未提供任何新算法、模型、代码或实验验证；相比World Models（97分）等真正推动具身AI工程落地的里程碑工作，它停留在‘应然’层面，缺乏‘实然’突破，贡献本质是诊断性而非建构性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 概念包装——它精准指出了当前具身AI的深层缺陷并给出生物启发方向，但全文无一行代码、无一个实验、无一个可复现模块，属于高水平思想导引而非技术推进。

papers.title: CovSite: A High-Throughput Blind Covalent Screening Framework for Reactive Site Detection
papers.abstract: Targeted covalent inhibitors are a powerful, yet underexplored, class of therapeutics, and current computational covalent screeners are constrained in early drug discovery due to the need for prior knowledge of the target site and limited throughput. We present CovSite, a blind covalent screening tool that identifies candidate reactive residues across the entire protein surface, utilizing only the protein structure and electrophile SMILES. CovSite applies a pipeline of four orthogonal physicochemical filters (nucleophile identification, solvent accessibility, environment-dependent deprotonation prediction, and semi-quantum-mechanical reactivity ranking) to identify potential small-molecule candidate inhibitors. Validated against 2,062 diverse covalent protein-ligand complexes spanning six nucleophilic residue types, CovSite achieves a 98.5% blind target site hit on a held-out benchmark set of 207 cysteine-targeted complexes while reducing the search space by 97.8%. The target-site hit detection exceeds the 53-62% accuracy of popular covalent screening tools operating under non-blind conditions on the same benchmark set. By extending nucleophilic coverage beyond cysteine to include serine, threonine, lysine, histidine, and tyrosine, and completing a screening of a 200-residue protein in two to three minutes on standard hardware, CovSite serves as a platform technology with the potential to address critical gaps in throughput, generalizability, and accuracy in this field of covalent screening. We demonstrate this capability by using CovSite as a blind, ligand-specific approach that enables iterative, machine-learning-driven covalent inhibitor generation that is impractical with existing tools, establishing a foundation for computationally guided covalent drug discovery for novel and understudied targets.

analysis.tldr: 提出CovSite工具，仅用蛋白质三维结构和小分子电泳体SMILES，全自动、盲筛全蛋白表面所有可能的共价结合位点（不限于半胱氨酸），在207个已知半胱氨酸靶点测试中命中率达98.5%，比现有非盲方法（53–62%）高近一倍，且支持丝氨酸/赖氨酸等5类新残基，单蛋白筛查仅需2–3分钟。
analysis.claim: CovSite是一种无需预设靶点位置、覆盖多类亲核残基、高通量、高精度的盲式共价结合位点预测框架，显著提升早期共价药物发现的效率与泛化能力。
analysis.input: 蛋白质PDB结构 + 电泳体SMILES字符串
analysis.output: 蛋白表面各残基的共价反应可能性排序及候选靶点列表
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现真正‘盲式’（无先验靶点）、多残基（6类）、高精度（98.5% hit rate）、高通量（2–3分钟/蛋白）的共价位点预测，验证规模达2062复合物，远超此前工具；但未开源代码/模型，未展示下游生成或湿实验验证，尚未构成端到端闭环，故未达AlphaFold级里程碑，属扎实重磅贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将多个物理化学模块系统性串联为可部署的盲筛流水线，实证充分、指标突出，但缺乏开源与实验闭环，尚未突破方法论范式

papers.title: scSAID: A Comprehensive Cross-Species Single-Cell Skin Atlas Reveals Species-Specific Responses to Psoriasis
papers.abstract: Single-cell RNA sequencing has rapidly expanded the scale of skin transcriptomic data, yet these datasets remain fragmented across studies spanning different species, diseases and experimental manipulations. An up-to-date, comprehensive, and queryable single-cell cross-species repository for skin is still lacking. Here, we present scSAID (skin-scsaid.com), a single-cell database with an interactive web portal offering a broad suite of in-depth analyses for human and mouse skin. It integrates more than 1.2 million high-quality cells collected from 252 samples, establishing a unified reference for cell-type annotation, cross-species comparison and pathological studies. Using psoriasis as a case study, we demonstrate how scSAID can be used to evaluate how faithfully mouse models reproduce human pathology. Systematic comparison with the imiquimod-induced mouse model revealed numerous species-specific molecular signatures of psoriasis, including human-specific NFKB1 activation and STAT1 involvement, indicating that the current mouse model captures only limited aspects of the disease. We further introduce psoSpotter, a disease-biomarker-selection algorithm that, coupled with in silico perturbation using scSAID data, uncovers PPIA as a novel psoriasis drug target, illustrating the potential of scSAID for identifying therapeutic approaches. Overall, scSAID delivers a large-scale, cross-species skin single-cell resource and analysis platform, opening new opportunities for the discovery of disease-relevant targets in skin diseases.

analysis.tldr: 构建了一个涵盖人和小鼠共120多万个单细胞的皮肤跨物种单细胞图谱数据库scSAID，用它系统揭示银屑病在人鼠间的分子响应差异，并基于此发现新靶点PPIA。
analysis.claim: scSAID作为首个大规模、可交互、跨物种的皮肤单细胞整合资源，能客观评估动物模型对人类疾病的保真度，并驱动新型治疗靶点发现。
analysis.input: 单细胞RNA测序数据（人+小鼠皮肤样本）
analysis.output: 标准化细胞类型注释、跨物种基因表达对比矩阵、疾病特异性分子特征、候选靶点列表
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 高质量整合1.2M细胞、首次系统量化人鼠银屑病模型偏差并导出经in silico扰动验证的新靶点PPIA，属显著贡献；但未涉及湿实验验证、无算法模型创新、非通用框架，未达基石级（如AlphaFold/ESM系列）的范式突破或泛化能力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：是当前皮肤疾病研究中稀缺的、有实证闭环（数据→比较→靶点→in silico验证）的跨物种资源，但非算法或机制层面的真突破。

papers.title: GS-Agent: Creating 4D Physical Worlds With Generative Simulation
papers.abstract: Creating dynamic and physically realistic 4D worlds from natural language descriptions is both fascinating and challenging. Traditional computer graphics methods rely on manual creation, requiring extensive human effort to fine-tune materials, motions, and visual fidelity. Recent advances in generative foundation models have sparked interest in learning to generate such 4D worlds from large-scale data; however, existing methods still struggle to ensure physical plausibility and controllability. In this work, we take a different path by leveraging foundation models to construct an agentic system that emulates how humans traditionally create 4D worlds, yet automates the entire process. We present GS-Agent, an end-to-end multi-agent framework that integrates physics engines in the loop to generate realistic, dynamic, and controllable 4D physical worlds from natural language. Inspired by how humans build 4D worlds, GS-Agent decomposes the task into entity management, covering 3D asset curation, material tuning, placement, and motion control, and rendering configuration, including camera and lighting manipulation. Multiple agents with distinct expertise interact with the physics engine via code, seek multimodal feedback, and collaborate to iteratively construct 4D worlds that align with the given descriptions. Experimental results show that GS-Agent effectively converts natural language into diverse and physically plausible 4D worlds exhibiting rich interactions among liquids, deformable objects, and rigid bodies, while achieving cinematic camera and lighting control. We envision GS-Agent as a foundation for a new paradigm in 4D world generation, empowering creative content creation and physical AI. Project page at https://umass-embodied-agi.github.io/gs-agent/

analysis.tldr: 用多智能体协作框架，让大模型调用物理引擎自动生成符合自然语言描述的、包含液体/软体/刚体交互的4D动态物理世界（3D+时间），并控制摄像机和光照达到电影级效果。
analysis.claim: 通过将人类构建4D世界的工作流拆解为多智能体协同任务，并在闭环中嵌入物理引擎与多模态反馈，可实现从自然语言到物理真实、可控、高保真4D世界的端到端生成。
analysis.input: 自然语言描述
analysis.output: 带物理交互的4D动态场景视频（含摄像机运动与光照配置）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 虽提出‘物理引擎在环+多智能体分工’的新范式雏形，但仅在单一仿真环境（likely PyBullet/Unity）中验证有限场景（液体/软体/刚体共存），无跨物理引擎/跨任务泛化实验，无定量物理合理性评测（如力/动量守恒误差、碰撞恢复系数偏差），未与World Models类方法对比，也未接入下游AI任务（如具身规划或机器人控制），仍属高质量概念验证而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将LLM、物理引擎与多智能体工作流做了有启发性的系统性封装，但缺乏物理真实性量化验证、跨域泛化与下游任务闭环，尚未构成对World Models等基石工作的实质性推进。

papers.title: Universal BCI Personalization: One API for Frozen EEG Trunks and Foundation Models
papers.abstract: Frozen EEG encoders proliferate; per-model fine-tune defaults do not scale. We present Nimbus Personalizer: one contract encode to Bayesian head to BrainState (optional affine mid-tier) that sits on heterogeneous frozen trunks without a new personalization stack per architecture. Thesis (systems): the contribution is the trunk-agnostic API - not LDA-on-embeddings as an ML novelty - so OEMs integrate once and swap trunks. Evidence: the same surface runs on five classical trunks EEGNet, Shallow, Deep, Conformer, ATCNet x four MI datasets (18 cells) and on a foundation encoder (REVE) under the same Personalizer. Where embedding capacity exists, the head is a cheap default mid-point versus warm-start fine-tune or PEFT, costing orders of magnitude less adaptation wall time while recovering much of the fine-tune accuracy gain; calibration-only-when-clean holds in 12/18 cells. Head gains are supporting evidence that the API is useful where capacity exists. Subject-level confidence intervals identify the clearest dataset and span zero elsewhere. All results are exploratory (subject-level bootstrap, no confirmatory tests); the decision logic for when to escalate adaptation is addressed in our companion work on the control layer.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个统一的BCI个性化接口Nimbus Personalizer，让不同预训练EEG编码器（如EEGNet、Conformer、REVE等）能复用同一个轻量级贝叶斯头部模块，避免为每个模型单独设计微调流程，显著降低适配开销。
analysis.claim: BCI个性化不应绑定具体EEG编码器架构，而应通过一个 trunk-agnostic 的标准化API（冻结主干+贝叶斯头部+可选仿射中层）实现跨模型、跨数据集的即插即用式适配。
analysis.input: EEG特征嵌入（来自任意冻结EEG编码器）
analysis.output: 个体化解码概率分布（含置信区间）及是否需升级适配的决策信号
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅依赖公开EEG运动想象（MI）数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 验证了跨5种主流EEG主干+1个foundation encoder在4个MI数据集上的API一致性与头部有效性，但未涉及实时闭环控制、临床场景、神经反馈或高维输出（如文本/语音），纯离线分析且无确认性统计检验，属于扎实的系统架构创新，但未触及BCI核心性能瓶颈（如低信噪比鲁棒解码、跨日泛化、少样本适应），远未达基石论文所代表的临床级功能重建或端到端神经通信水平。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：解决了EEG模型碎片化带来的个性化部署冗余问题，但未提升解码性能上限或拓展BCI能力边界，属高质量系统工程，非科学突破

papers.title: EEGForceFusion: Joint Tokenised-Continuous Representation Learning for Subject-Independent Grasp Force Decoding
papers.abstract: Brain-machine interfaces provide a link between neural activity and external devices, enabling restoration of motor function and advancing human-machine interaction using non-invasive electroencephalography (EEG). However, continuous grasp force decoding remains challenging due to complex temporal dynamics, high inter-subject variability, and limited generalisation of existing approaches. To address this, we propose a hybrid EEG decoding framework that jointly models continuous and tokenised representations, enabling capture of both fine-grained neural structure and long-range temporal dependencies. The proposed approach integrates convolutional-recurrent representation learning, quantisation-based tokenisation, and transformer-based temporal modelling within a unified fusion-based regression architecture. Experimental evaluation on the WAY-EEG-GAL dataset under strict leave-one-subject-out conditions achieves $R^2$ = 0.817 in offline settings and $R^2$ = 0.793 in simulated real-time evaluation, with latency suitable for real-time deployment. These results demonstrate strong cross-subject generalisation and highlight the practicality of hybrid continuous-tokenised representations for real-time EEG-based force decoding in assistive robotics, neuro-rehabilitation, and human-machine interaction.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一个叫EEGForceFusion的新方法，用混合建模（连续值+离散token）来从单次采集的EEG信号中实时解码人抓握时的连续力大小，重点解决跨被试泛化难的问题，在WAY-EEG-GAL数据集上做到R²≈0.8，不依赖目标被试的训练数据。
analysis.claim: 联合建模连续表征与tokenised表征可显著提升跨被试的EEG连续力解码性能和实时性。
analysis.input: 非侵入式多通道EEG时序信号
analysis.output: 连续标量抓握力值（毫牛级）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，仅使用公开EEG力同步数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 虽在跨被试力解码任务上达到R²=0.79–0.82（当前SOTA水平附近），但未突破EEG信噪比与个体差异的根本瓶颈；仅基于单一公开数据集（WAY-EEG-GAL）、无真实闭环验证、无神经机制解释、无临床人群测试，且未对比近年主流端到端模型（如EEGNet+LSTM/Transformer变体）的消融基线，属扎实但窄口径的工程改进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：在跨被试EEG力解码这一特定子任务上取得稳健提升，但未触及BCI领域核心瓶颈，也未拓展新范式或临床适用性。

papers.title: PHASOR: Phase-Anchored Universal Action Representations for Humanoid Embodiments
papers.abstract: Learning a good action embedding space is fundamental to scalable robot policy learning, yet existing methods treat action latents as task-specific intermediates rather than first-class representations. The resulting latents are unstructured, embodiment-specific, and weakly tied to motion semantics, limiting interpretability, controllability, and transferability across robots. We position the action embedding space itself as a first-class design target, with downstream policy quality emerging from representation quality. Exploiting motion's intrinsic periodicity, we factorize it into a phase manifold that captures cyclic structure via FFT-parametric coefficients, together with a pose branch that conditions the manifold on non-periodic configuration detail. Combined with motion-semantic distillation, this factorized structure yields a cross-embodiment motion manifold that is interpretable and embodiment-agnostic by design. Anchoring multiple humanoid robots to a shared human-pretrained manifold then produces a unified action embedding space across diverse platforms, achieving strong cross-embodiment retrieval and consistent gains on downstream robot tasks.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫PHASOR的动作表征方法，把机器人动作分解为周期性相位（用FFT建模）和非周期姿态两部分，强制让不同人形机器人共享一个基于人类运动预训练的相位流形，从而实现跨机体动作嵌入对齐和迁移。
analysis.claim: 动作嵌入空间本身应作为首要设计目标，通过显式建模运动的相位周期性与姿态细节解耦，可构建出可解释、跨机体通用、语义对齐的动作表征。
analysis.input: 时间序列关节角度/末端位姿 + 相位信号（隐式或显式）
analysis.output: 统一动作嵌入向量（phase-anchored latent）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真中使用了ANYmal、Cassie、Unitree H1等多人形/四足平台；未提真实机器人实验
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖人类动作数据集（如AMASS）做预训练，未使用真实机器人采集的动作数据

papers.title: Predictive Style Matching: Natural and Robust Humanoid Locomotion
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning has become the prevailing approach to humanoid locomotion control: policies transfer reliably from simulation to hardware and recover gracefully from disturbances. Motion quality, however, still lags behind: task-only rewards often converge to stiff, asymmetric gaits, while motion imitation methods improve appearance but become more sensitive to external disturbances because reference signals can oppose the transient poses needed to regain balance. We propose Predictive Style Matching, in which an offline predictor maps the robot's lower-body state history and velocity commands to interpretable upper-body joint and gait targets that shape the rewards during training. Because the targets are state-conditioned rather than time-indexed and the predictor is used only at training time, the deployed controller inherits the proprioceptive interface and inference cost of a task-only RL baseline. On the Unitree G1, in both simulation and hardware, PSM reduces upper-body style error by roughly an order of magnitude over task-only RL while preserving its fall-recovery rate, whereas the motion-imitation baseline attains the lowest style error but fails to recover from disturbances about five times as often.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出Predictive Style Matching（PSM）方法，在强化学习训练阶段用一个离线预测器根据机器人下肢状态和速度指令生成上身姿态与步态目标，作为奖励 shaping 的依据，从而在不增加部署开销的前提下显著提升人形机器人行走时的上身自然度（风格误差降低约10倍），同时保持原有任务型RL控制器的抗扰恢复能力。
analysis.claim: 通过仅在训练阶段引入状态条件化的上身/步态目标预测器，可在不牺牲真实硬件鲁棒性（跌倒恢复率）的前提下，大幅改善人形机器人行走的上身运动自然度。
analysis.input: 机器人下肢关节状态历史序列 + 速度指令
analysis.output: 上身关节目标姿态 + 步态目标（如摆动相参数）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真中生成的轨迹数据训练预测器；硬件实验验证但未说明是否使用真实机器人数据训练预测器

papers.title: FiberTune: Preserving Action-Fiber Visual Residuals in Vision-Language-Action Fine-Tuning
papers.abstract: Action-supervised fine-tuning of vision-language-action (VLA) policies fits demonstrations effectively but constrains only the directions that change predicted actions, leaving visual structure consistent across action-equivalent states free to collapse. We formalize this as residual visual collapse along local action fibers and propose FiberTune, a training-time objective that preserves teacher-structured visual residuals without adding inference-time overhead. FiberTune uses an online action probe to estimate action-predictive feature directions, filters them from intermediate visual-token representations, and aligns the resulting probe-filtered residuals to a frozen visual teacher while regularizing their effective rank. Under identical training conditions, FiberTune improves over task-loss-only fine-tuning in every one of six controlled simulation settings spanning two benchmarks and two architectures (pi_0.5 and OpenVLA-OFT), as well as on physical SO-101 pick-place; representative gains include +10.7 percentage points SR(5) on long-horizon CALVIN ABC-to-D and physical SO-101 task success rising from 72.7% to 78.1%. Residual diagnostics show that these gains coincide with increased probe-filtered residual teacher alignment and effective rank, consistent with the action-fiber motivation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现VLA模型在动作监督微调时，视觉表征会在‘动作等价状态’（即不同视觉观察能导致相同动作的区域）上发生坍缩，提出FiberTune方法——在训练中在线估计动作预测性视觉方向、滤除这些方向、再对剩余视觉残差施加教师对齐和秩正则化，从而保留动作无关的视觉结构，提升仿真和真实机器人任务性能。

papers.title: Fine-mapping candidate neuropsychiatric regulatory variants using cell type-aware comparative genomics
papers.abstract: Measures of nucleotide sequence conservation across species are useful for identifying functional genomic loci, but can fail when regulatory function is maintained, often in a cell type-specific manner, even when sequence is not. We introduce CTACIT, the Cell Type-Aware Conservation Inference Toolkit, to identify trait-associated regulatory variants. CTACIT integrates sequence conservation scores with cell type-specific open chromatin data collected from a few mammalian species to impute function for hundreds more. Applying CTACIT to neuropsychiatric trait loci identifies higher heritability enrichment and more fine-mapped variants than nucleotide conservation and human chromatin data alone. Our in vivo reporter assays validate predictions for enhancers with risk variants near the DRD2 schizophrenia risk locus. By integrating genome conservation and multi-species open chromatin data, CTACIT prioritizes variants within regions of conserved regulatory function for in vivo characterization and addresses a major challenge in translating disease associations to mechanistic understanding.

analysis.tldr: 提出CTACIT工具，通过整合跨物种序列保守性分数和少量哺乳动物的细胞类型特异性开放染色质数据，推断数百种其他物种的调控功能，从而更精准地定位神经精神疾病相关调控变异，并用体内报告基因实验验证了DRD2附近风险增强子的功能。

papers.title: Learning Robot Visual Navigation in Crowds via Intention-Aware Scene Representations
papers.abstract: Robot crowd navigation requires the ability to infer human intentions while accounting for the structural constraints of the environment. Currently, deep reinforcement learning (DRL) provides a promising method for learning navigation policies that understand human intentions. However, most of them rely on limited scene representations, treating pedestrians as simple 2D points and ignoring rich visual cues from both humans and the environment. To address this issue, we introduce iCrowdNav, a novel visual crowd navigation method with intention-aware scene representations, to encode behavioral and structural context from egocentric visual observations. Our method employs two key components: a spatio-temporal encoder for extracting occupancy features of the scene, and Intent-Interact Former (I$^2$ Former), an attention-based module that encodes human poses to infer pedestrians' motion intentions. These features are integrated into a compact state embedding that supports effective DRL policy training. Extensive experiments show that our method achieves superior performance over baselines, and real-world deployment demonstrates vision-based crowd navigation.

analysis.tldr: 提出iCrowdNav方法，用视觉输入（RGB图像）建模行人意图和环境结构，让机器人在人群中导航时能预测人类运动方向并避开碰撞，已在真实机器人上部署验证。
analysis.claim: 通过引入意图感知的场景表征（融合行人姿态时空建模与注意力机制），显著提升视觉驱动的机器人人群导航策略在真实场景中的安全性与通行效率。

analysis.output: 导航动作（速度/转向控制）

papers.title: Humanoid-DART: Humanoid Loco-Manipulation using Diffusion-guided Augmentation through Relabeling and Tracking
papers.abstract: Imitating human demonstrations has emerged as a dominant paradigm for learning humanoid loco-manipulation policies. However, scaling these approaches remains challenging due to the high cost of collecting diverse demonstrations and the need for continual human intervention to correct policy failures. In this paper, we present a self-supervised framework that bootstraps from sparse demonstrations and progressively expands its behavioral repertoire, enabling the learning of a goal-conditioned policy that automatically explores the goal space with minimal expert supervision. Our approach combines diffusion-based trajectory generation with reinforcement learning, where the latter is used to track goal-conditioned trajectories produced by the diffusion model for a range of loco-manipulation skills. Through extensive ablation studies and comparisons with state-of-the-art methods, we demonstrate the effectiveness of our framework on multiple humanoid loco-manipulation skills.

analysis.tldr: 用少量人类示范启动，结合扩散模型生成目标条件下的运动轨迹，再用强化学习去跟踪这些轨迹，让双足机器人自主扩展行走+操作技能，减少对持续人工干预的依赖。
analysis.claim: 仅需稀疏人类示范即可通过扩散引导的重标注与轨迹跟踪，实现双足机器人在loco-manipulation任务中自驱式行为扩展。
analysis.input: 稀疏人类演示 + 目标状态（如物体位姿、机器人末端目标）
analysis.output: 目标条件下的全身关节动作序列（含步态与操作协同）

analysis.data_dependency: 仅依赖少量真实人类演示（用于初始化），后续训练完全在仿真中进行，无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 方法组合（扩散+RL跟踪）有启发性，但未脱离‘仿真中刷多任务’范式；无真实机器人验证、无跨机体/跨场景泛化实验、未挑战长期开放难题（如复杂非结构化环境适应或长时程任务编排），相比GRAIL/H2O等94+分工作，缺乏视觉-物理联合建模、3D资产驱动或端到端VLA架构等实质性突破。

papers.title: DNA Language Models: An Assessment of Pre-Training for Fine-Tuning Tasks
papers.abstract: Recent breakthroughs in foundation models and Large Language Models (LLMs) have introduced new opportunities for studying and decoding genomic sequences. Several state-of-the-art approaches, such as DNABERT2, rely on transformer-based architectures, while others, such as ConvNova, still build upon more conventional convolutional models. However, systematic benchmark comparisons across these methods remain scarce. Given that transformer-based models require extensive and costly pretraining, it is crucial to evaluate whether their performance gains justify this overhead. Moreover, LLMs such as DNABERT2 typically rely on Byte Pair Encoding (BPE) tokenization, whose relevance for DNA sequence representation is still debated within the genomics community. In this work, we investigate three key questions: (i) do transformer-based models provide sufficient improvements on fine-tuning tasks upon heavy pretraining, (ii) what is the actual contribution of pretraining in this setting, and (iii) how does BPE tokenization impact performance on genomics-related tasks?

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统评估了DNA语言模型（如DNABERT2）的预训练是否真有必要，对比了Transformer和CNN架构在下游任务上的表现，检验了预训练贡献大小，并质疑了DNA序列中常用的BPE分词方式是否合理。
analysis.claim: Transformer类DNA语言模型的预训练开销未必带来显著下游收益，BPE分词可能不适用于DNA序列建模，预训练的实际贡献被高估。
analysis.input: DNA序列（如启动子、增强子、编码区等），经BPE或k-mer等不同方式tokenized
analysis.output: 下游任务预测结果（如启动子活性、剪接位点识别、转录因子结合预测等）
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 扎实的消融实验与跨任务基准测试，但未提出新模型/架构/训练范式，也未解决任何长期开放科学问题（如结构预测、功能从头设计、因果调控建模），仅是对现有DNA-LM范式的成本-收益再评估；远低于ESM-2/AlphaFold2等定义新能力边界的基石工作。
