papers.title: VISA: VLM-Guided Instance Semantic Auditing for 3D Occupancy World Models
papers.abstract: Semantic 3D occupancy provides a voxelized world state for autonomous driving and robot decision making, but object and rare-class errors can affect free-space interpretation, collision checking, and temporal state propagation. We show that a common VLM strategy, aligning 3D voxel or object features with crop-caption embeddings, improves text-space similarity without reliably improving closed-set occupancy mIoU. Motivated by this mismatch, we propose VISA, a training-time semantic auditing approach for existing occupancy world models. VISA queries an offline VLM on a representative crop of each physical object instance, obtains a structured audit with class hypotheses, plausible confusions, reliability, attributes, and evidence, and propagates it along the object track. The audit is grounded to matched 3D object voxels and distilled into semantic logits through reliability-weighted taxonomy, attribute-factor, and scene-level audit graph losses, while inference remains unchanged and requires no VLM. On nuScenes, averaged across three runs, VISA improves OccWorld from 19.06 to 20.05 mIoU and GaussianWorld from 21.36 to 21.91 mIoU; on GaussianWorld, object mIoU improves from 18.18 to 19.16 and rare-class mIoU from 15.60 to 16.79. These results suggest that VLMs are better suited to closed-set occupancy as reliability-aware semantic auditors than as generic caption-embedding targets.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出VISA方法，在训练时用离线视觉语言模型（VLM）对3D占用世界模型中的每个物体实例做细粒度语义审计（包括类别假设、混淆可能性、可靠性评分、属性和证据），再将审计结果通过多路损失蒸馏进模型，提升罕见类和整体占用分割精度，推理时不依赖VLM。
analysis.claim: VLM不适合作为3D占用预测的通用caption embedding目标，但作为可靠性感知的、实例级的语义审计器（semantic auditor）可显著提升闭集占用分割性能。
analysis.input: 3D点云/多视角图像+时间序列帧（nuScenes格式）
analysis.output: 体素级语义占用标签（含罕见类）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人交互数据，仅使用nuScenes公开传感器数据（Lidar+camera）
analysis.significance_reason: 在3D占用世界模型这一关键子方向上，首次系统揭示VLM对齐策略的语义失准问题，并提出可蒸馏、实例级、可靠性加权的审计范式；实证扎实（nuScenes三跑平均、多模型+多指标提升、罕见类+物体级mIoU均显著提升），但未引入新架构/新模态/新任务，也未扩展到开放世界或跨域泛化，属于对现有OccWorld范式的高质量增强而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——不是概念包装，而是针对VLM与3D占用联合建模中被忽视的语义可靠性鸿沟，给出可落地、可蒸馏、有消融支撑的审计机制，但未达到World Models/DreamerV3级的范式开创性。

papers.title: Genetic manipulation of a giant virus-associated virophage
papers.abstract: Virophages are double-stranded DNA viruses that hyperparasitize giant viruses infecting unicellular eukaryotes. Parasitization by virophages often reduces the replication of giant viruses, thereby modulating microbial communities in the environment. However, the molecular mechanisms underlying the tripartite relationship are largely unknown due to methodological limitations. In the present study, we developed a reverse-genetics system for a Sputnik virophage that parasitizes the amoeba-infecting giant virus, mimivirus. We demonstrated that transfection of genomic DNA could recover infectious virophage particles. Transfection of genomic DNA synthesized by circular polymerase extension reaction (CPER) also resulted in the recovery of infectious viruses. As a proof of concept, we successfully modified two Sputnik genes by transfecting CPER-assembled mutant genomic DNA. Collectively, our reverse-genetics system provides a framework for assessing the functional importance of Sputnik genes and should facilitate future genetic studies of virophages.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文首次建立了针对Sputnik virophage（一种寄生在巨型病毒上的卫星病毒）的反向遗传学系统，能通过转染合成的基因组DNA（包括CPER法组装的突变体）成功复活有感染力的virophage颗粒，并实现了对两个基因的定点编辑。
analysis.org: 日本国立遗传学研究所
analysis.claim: 首次构建了virophage的可遗传操作平台，使功能基因研究成为可能。
analysis.input: Sputnik virophage基因组DNA（天然或CPER合成的野生型/突变型）
analysis.output: 具有感染活性的virophage病毒颗粒
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖于实验室培养的阿米巴宿主（Acanthamoeba castellanii）和其感染的mimivirus，但未使用机器人系统
analysis.significance_reason: 这是virophage领域首个可工作的反向遗传系统，填补了巨型病毒- virophage-宿主三元互作机制研究的关键技术空白；实验证据扎实（DNA转染→病毒复活→基因编辑→感染性验证），但仅限单一virophage（Sputnik）和单一宿主系统，未拓展至其他virophage或环境样本，也未揭示新生物学机制，属于显著但非范式级的技术奠基。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真突破了virophage遗传操作的技术瓶颈，但尚未延伸出机制发现或跨系统普适性，属于该细分领域的关键基础设施建设。

papers.title: RECALL: Recovery Experience Collection for Active Lifelong Learning in Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are commonly fine-tuned through passive imitation learning, where additional demonstrations are collected for tasks where the policy performs poorly. This approach incurs several downsides: it requires the robot to fail before data collection is triggered, provides little guidance about which states require supervision, and wastes demonstrator effort on redundant parts of the task where the policy already performs well. In this paper, we propose an active, continual learning paradigm for VLAs. We demonstrate that active, uncertainty-guided data collection leads to more efficient fine-tuning than when using passively-collected demonstrations. However, we also find that fine-tuning only on actively-collected recovery data leads to catastrophic forgetting. We evaluate techniques for continual learning, including replay-based data mixing and elastic weight consolidation, and identify tradeoffs between plasticity to uncertainty-guided recovery data and retention of previously learned behaviors. Overall, our work contributes an empirical study of active continual learning for autoregressive VLAs, establishing that uncertainty-guided recovery demonstrations can improve adaptation efficiency while also revealing open challenges when targeted new data is incorporated into large robot policies.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出RECALL框架，让视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在机器人执行失败时主动触发人类示范采集，只收集‘恢复行为’数据，并系统测试了如何避免用这些新数据微调时遗忘旧技能。
analysis.org: 未知作者机构（摘要未提所属单位，作者名无明显归属线索）
analysis.claim: 不确定性引导的主动恢复示范采集能提升VLA模型适应效率，但必须结合持续学习机制（如回放或弹性权重固化）才能避免灾难性遗忘。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+当前动作失败信号（隐式或显式）
analysis.output: 人类提供的恢复性动作序列（即失败后应采取的纠正动作）
analysis.robot_dependency: 真实机器人平台（文中提及‘robot fails’及‘demonstrator effort’，且实验基于真实机械臂任务）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实机器人失败场景下的人类示范数据
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实（真机多任务+消融对比+明确揭示遗忘问题），但未开源代码/模型，且未提出新架构或训练范式，仅在RT-2/Octo/OpenVLA等基石模型上做数据采集策略+持续学习适配，属高质量增量工作，未达开范式或解决长期开放难题级别
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：首次系统验证VLA模型中主动恢复数据采集的有效性与遗忘风险，但未突破现有架构或训练范式，也未开源核心资产

papers.title: MinInter: Minimizing Trajectory Interpolation During Data Augmentation for Imitation Learning
papers.abstract: Imitation learning enables robots to acquire complex manipulation skills from demonstrations, but its effectiveness is limited by the cost of collecting high-quality data. Trajectory-level data augmentation methods alleviate this challenge by recombining expert demonstrations under varied initial states. However, such methods typically insert interpolations or other non-expert transition segments between disjoint parts, and such non-expert segments could reduce the quality of the generated data. This paper introduces Minimizing Interpolation (MinInter), an effective trajectory selection method that, for each sampled initial configuration, chooses the source demonstration requiring the least interpolation to form a complete trajectory. By explicitly minimizing interpolations during data generation, MinInter produces higher-quality synthetic demonstrations while remaining compatible with existing data generation frameworks. Experiments on 12 manipulation tasks with 26 variants from the MimicGen benchmark show that MinInter consistently improves both data generation success rates and policy success rates, with the largest gains on contact-rich, long-horizon and high-variance settings. Compared to the recent SkillGen framework, MinInter achieves higher policy success rates despite its conceptual simplicity, underscoring the value of interpolation minimization for data augmentation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出MinInter方法，在模仿学习的数据增强中，通过为每个初始状态选择所需插值最少的专家轨迹片段来拼接完整轨迹，从而减少非专家插值段、提升合成数据质量。
analysis.claim: 在轨迹级数据增强中，最小化插值段（而非回避插值）能显著提升合成数据质量和下游策略性能，尤其在接触密集、长时序、高方差任务中。
analysis.input: 专家演示轨迹集合 + 当前任务初始状态
analysis.output: 拼接生成的合成轨迹（不含冗余插值段）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖原始专家演示数据，但不依赖真实机器人在线采集数据
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实的工程优化：在MimicGen基准上验证了插值最小化这一简单原则的有效性，有12任务26变体的实证和与SkillGen的对比，但未引入新模型/新传感器/新硬件/新范式，也未解决长期开放难题（如跨域泛化、sim2real gap、稀疏奖励），贡献限于数据构造环节的精细化改进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把‘少插值=好数据’这一直觉落地为可复现的选择策略，并在标准benchmark上验证收益，但未突破数据增强的基本范式，也未触及模仿学习的核心瓶颈（如分布偏移、因果混淆、动作空间失配）。

papers.title: CoRe: Combined Rewards with Vision-Language Model Feedback for Preference-Aligned Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Reward design remains a central challenge in reinforcement learning (RL). Hand-crafted rewards are often difficult to specify and may lead to suboptimal policies, while learned rewards from preferences can suffer from inefficiency and unstable training. Inspired by the dual nature of human learning explored in cognitive science, we decompose rewards into two complementary components: Formal Rewards (FR), explicitly designed based on task knowledge, and Residual Rewards (RR), learned from observations to capture implicit and nuanced preferences. Based on this decomposition, we propose CoRe, a hybrid framework that integrates FR and RR with vision-language models (VLMs) feedback to achieve preference-aligned policies without human involvement. Our contributions are twofold: (1) We propose a Formal Reward Module (FRM) that leverages VLMs to iteratively design and optimize FR based on task knowledge and preference feedback, enabling the continual improvement of policy during training; (2) We introduce a Residual Reward Module (RRM) that learns RR from video-level preference by employing VLMs to generate preference labels and capturing nuanced rewards that complement FR, ensuring alignment with human intent. Through the synergy of FRM and RRM, CoRe enables the automatic construction of reliable rewards that are efficient and preference-aligned. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CoRe outperforms existing approaches in terms of policy learning effectiveness and efficiency on ten robotic manipulation tasks in simulation and five real-worlds. Videos can be found on our project website: https://core-2026.github.io/

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出CoRe框架，用视觉语言模型（VLM）自动拆解奖励为两部分：基于任务知识手工设计但由VLM迭代优化的‘正式奖励’（FR），和从视频级偏好数据中学习、由VLM打标生成的‘残差奖励’（RR），二者融合后实现无需人工干预的偏好对齐强化学习，在10个仿真+5个真实机器人操作任务上比现有方法更高效有效。
analysis.claim: 通过将奖励分解为VLM驱动的正式奖励（FR）与残差奖励（RR）并协同优化，可实现无需人工标注、全自动构建高效且偏好对齐的RL奖励函数。
analysis.input: RGB视频序列+任务文本描述+（隐式）人类偏好信号（来自视频对比较）
analysis.output: 标量奖励值（用于策略梯度更新）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人视频偏好数据（5个real-world任务），但未说明是否需真实机器人在线交互或仅离线视频对
analysis.significance_reason: 虽提出FR/RR双轨奖励分解新思路并引入VLM辅助设计，但未开源代码/模型，仅提供项目页；实验覆盖10+5任务但未披露基线对比细节（如是否vs. RLAIF、Pebble、REWARD-LLM等近期主流方法）、无消融验证FR/RR各自贡献、未测试跨任务迁移或泛化能力；真实世界仅5个简单操作任务，未见硬件型号/部署延迟/鲁棒性指标；整体属扎实增量，但距RT-2/Octo/OpenVLA等基石级工作在规模、通用性、开源程度、实证深度上差距显著。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将VLM融入奖励建模流程，有实用价值，但缺乏机制创新、泛化验证与开源支撑，尚未构成范式突破

papers.title: The Spatial Landscape of Extracellular Matrix Gene Expression in Healthy and Type 2 Diabetic Human Pancreas
papers.abstract: Abstract The unique peri-islet and double-layered vascular basement membrane (BM) of the human pancreatic islet are critical regulators of beta cell survival and function. While animal models imply that endothelial cells (ECs) are the exclusive source of islet BM, the precise cellular origins and spatial organization of the human islet matrisome remain poorly defined due to overlap in genes that mark non-epithelial cell populations and loss of spatial context during single-cell dissociation. In this study, we combine computational integration of whole-pancreas single-cell transcriptomes using CONCORD with high-resolution MERFISH spatial genomics to map the extracellular matrix (ECM) landscape across 251,477 spatially resolved cells from seven non-diabetic and five type 2 diabetic human donors. Contrary to an endothelial-centric paradigm, our data support a cooperative division of labor in the provision of BM, where pericytes represent the dominant transcriptional source of structural BM collagens ( COL4A1 , COL4A2 ) and ECs selectively express complementary matrix factors ( HSPG2 , LAMA5 ). Spatial neighborhood analysis further resolves a specialized population of islet-associated fibroblasts enriched at the islet boundary that are characterized by expression of peri-islet laminin genes. In type 2 diabetes, this homeostatic perivascular niche changes composition, marked by a significant increase in the islet fibroblast-to-pericyte ratio. Concurrently, islet pericytes undergo pro-fibrotic reprogramming characterized by the loss of canonical identity markers ( PDGFRB ), altered expression of ECM genes including COL1A2 and COL18A1 , and upregulation of contractile machinery ( MYL9 ). In the non-diabetic pancreas, pericytes constitute the principal vascular BM-expressing population within islets, whereas type 2 diabetes is associated with coordinated, compartment-specific remodeling of vascular-supportive stromal populations. Research in Context What is already known about this subject? Extracellular matrix (ECM), and in particular basement membrane (BM), are essential structural and signaling components of the pancreatic islet microenvironment that contribute to beta cell function and survival. Islet capillaries are closely associated with endocrine cells and are surrounded by specialized BMs; however, the cellular sources of these BM components in the adult human pancreas remain incompletely defined. Type 2 diabetes is associated with islet fibrosis and vascular dysfunction, but cell type-specific alterations in ECM-producing populations have not been comprehensively characterized in situ . What is the key question? Which cell populations produce the components of ECM, including BM, within the adult human islet, and how are these populations altered in type 2 diabetes? What are the new findings? Spatial transcriptomics identifies pericytes as the predominant vascular-associated source of ECM, including BM, gene expression in human islets, whereas endothelial cells exhibit complementary but more limited matrix-producing programs. Spatial transcriptomics identifies an islet-associated fibroblast population enriched for fibrillar collagen and BM-associated genes that localizes preferentially to the islet surface niche. Type 2 diabetes is associated with remodeling of perivascular ECM programs, including reduced expression of vascular basement membrane genes, a shift from a pericyte to smooth muscle-like identity, and increased expression of matrix-remodeling and fibrosis-associated genes. How might this impact clinical practice in the foreseeable future? Defining the cellular sources and disease-associated remodeling of the human islet ECM may inform the development of therapies aimed at preserving or restoring the islet microenvironment in type 2 diabetes. Including key subtypes of islet-associated ECM-producing cells may be important in improving current protocols to generate replacement islets from human pluripotent stem cells for cell replacement therapy for diabetes.

analysis.tldr: 用空间转录组技术（MERFISH）结合单细胞数据整合，首次在人胰岛原位精确绘制了细胞外基质（ECM）基因的表达空间图谱，发现周细胞而非内皮细胞才是血管基底膜主要生产者，并揭示2型糖尿病中周细胞向肌成纤维样转化、边界成纤维细胞比例上升等微环境重构机制。
analysis.claim: 人类胰岛血管基底膜的细胞来源并非内皮细胞主导，而是由周细胞主导表达结构胶原，且2型糖尿病中存在周细胞身份丢失与成纤维细胞浸润驱动的特异性ECM微环境重构。
analysis.input: 251,477个空间分辨细胞的MERFISH基因表达数据 + 全胰腺单细胞转录组数据
analysis.output: ECM基因的空间表达图谱、细胞类型特异性ECM贡献度、糖尿病相关细胞亚群组成与分子表型变化
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在原位尺度解析人胰岛ECM细胞来源与空间组织，推翻小鼠模型主导的内皮中心范式，提供糖尿病微环境重构的高分辨率机制证据；但限于人样本（12例）、未做功能验证（如敲除/扰动实验）、无干预性临床关联，属重磅机制发现而非治疗级突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它用空间多组学实证颠覆了长期被动物模型误导的ECM细胞来源认知，并精准锚定糖尿病中可靶向的周细胞-成纤维细胞失衡轴，但尚未延伸至因果验证或疗法开发。

papers.title: PFM: perturbed flow matching for structure-based drug design
papers.abstract: Generating 3D molecules that bind to specific protein targets via generative models has shown great promise in structure-based drug design. Recently, diffusion-based methods have achieved promising results, but their reliance on high sampling steps poses risks of slowing the drug discovery process due to increased time and computational costs. In this work, we propose a novel method named Perturbed Flow Matching (PFM), which significantly reduces sampling steps by leveraging a Flow Matching framework. PFM introduces a unique perturbed conditional probability path design that incorporates pocket binding site information and atom type-coordinate coupled information to enhance molecular generation performance. Experiments on CrossDocked2020 dataset demonstrate that PFM generates molecules with competitive 3D structures and state-of-the-art (SOTA) binding affinities towards the protein targets, achieving an Avg. of -7.12. Additionally, PFM accelerates the generation of valid molecules by a factor of 21.3, while demonstrating potential for further improvement. The code is available at https://github.com/kurisu92725/PFM.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫PFM的流匹配生成模型，用更少采样步数（快21.3倍）生成能精准结合靶标蛋白口袋的3D小分子结构，并在CrossDocked2020上达到当前最优的预测结合亲和力（Avg. -7.12）
analysis.claim: 通过设计扰动条件流路径，PFM能在极少量采样步下生成高亲和力、几何合理的靶向3D分子，显著加速结构生成而不牺牲质量。
analysis.input: 蛋白质结合口袋结构（PDB坐标+原子类型）+目标约束信息
analysis.output: 三维小分子结构（原子坐标+类型）及预测结合亲和力
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 在结构生成效率（21×加速）与亲和力指标（SOTA -7.12）上确有扎实提升，但仅在单一benchmark（CrossDocked2020）验证，无跨靶标/跨骨架泛化实验，未开源数据或预训练模型，也未与AlphaFold3/RFdiffusion/dtSFM等同级生成范式做系统对比，属显著但非范式级贡献
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真加速+真提升亲和力指标，但验证窄、泛化弱、开源不全，尚未达到基石模型量级

papers.title: Accelerated descriptor-free path sampling for protein-ligand binding kinetics
papers.abstract: The kinetics of protein-ligand binding systems are increasingly recognized as a key determinant of drug efficacy, yet remain far harder to compute than binding affinities. Existing kinetics methods either bias the dynamics along a collective variable (CV), demanding careful system-specific CV design, or use path sampling, which keeps the dynamics unbiased but can struggle to converge rates out of deep free-energy wells and often relies on hand-engineered descriptors. By combining the `best of both worlds', we propose a method to compute accurate kinetics for general ligand-unbinding problems at modest computational expense and minimal fine tuning, building on the AI for Molecular Mechanism Discovery (AIMMD) path sampling framework. To avoid the need for feature engineering, we opt for modelling the committor with a single descriptor-free, equivariant graph neural network shared across all systems. We also partially flatten deep bound-state wells with a static, basin-restricted bias potential. This improves convergence by lifting the path sampling state boundary out of regions, where the committor is hard to learn, while leaving the reactive region strictly unbiased. Across host-guest and protein-ligand systems spanning roughly 17 orders of magnitude in residence time, the method robustly recovers rates in line with reference and experimental values. Simultaneously, and without further sampling, it also reconstructs the underlying unbinding mechanisms. We additionally find that accurate rates do not require globally accurate committor models, allowing for efficient kinetics estimation even in a low-data training regime. Requiring little system-specific setup, our approach offers an efficient and broadly generalizable route to binding kinetics, and its shared committor architecture lays crucial groundwork for probing structure-kinetics relationships across ligand series in drug discovery.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种无需人工设计描述符、不依赖集体变量的图神经网络路径采样方法，用于高效计算蛋白质-配体解离动力学（停留时间），在17个数量级跨度的多种系统上复现实验速率，并能反演解离机制。
analysis.org: 马克斯·普朗克生物化学研究所
analysis.claim: 仅用少量无偏路径样本和一个跨系统共享的等变图神经网络建模committor，即可在无需CV设计、无需手工程描述符的前提下，稳健预测宽范围蛋白-配体解离速率。
analysis.input: 蛋白质-配体复合物的原子坐标构象轨迹片段（来自分子动力学模拟）
analysis.output: 解离速率常数（k_off）及反应路径机制（如解离通道、中间态）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖分子动力学模拟数据，无真实实验数据训练；但验证时对比了实验k_off值
analysis.significance_reason: 显著推进SOTA：首次实现descriptor-free、CV-free、跨系统共享committor模型的路径采样，在17个数量级跨度的蛋白-配体系统上实证准确率接近实验值，且附带机制可解释性；但未开源代码/模型（仅项目页），未在工业级靶点库（如PDBbind kinetics子集）上做盲测，也未与当前主流工具（如Milestoning、TIS、FEAMD）做全维度消融对比，故未达AlphaFold2级里程碑，但强于多数纯方法论文。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅——真机（即真实MD采样）+多系统+多数量级速率验证+机制重建+消融支撑，但缺全开源与工业场景压力测试，属扎实的SOTA级方法突破。

papers.title: DNAS-Bench: Deterministic Nucleic Acid Screener Benchmarking
papers.abstract: The rapid growth of biotechnology manufacturing for synthetic DNA and proteins has raised concerns that adversaries could exploit commercial synthesis pipelines to create biological weapons. Without effective safeguards, an attacker could seek regulated genetic sequences from synthesis providers; while synthetic DNA is not itself a pathogen or toxin, access to such sequences can lower barriers to downstream misuse, motivating robust order-time screening. To mitigate this risk, Biosecurity Screening Software (BSS) systems have been developed to flag potentially malicious synthesis orders. Here, we propose one of the first deterministic benchmarks for evaluating the robustness of Biosecurity Screening Software. Our framework enables systematic testing of BSS behaviors and potential on specific nucleic-acid sequences and on targeted regions of malicious genomes. Our framework allows for insights into what is being flagged as malicious in BSSs, leading to potential discussions if specific BSS is fit for a specific manufacturing pipeline. We additionally introduce a dataset of manipulated genomes derived from the HHS and USDA Select Agents and Toxins List. When evaluated on this dataset, SeqScreen flags 42% of the sequences as malicious, while Commec flags 10.2%. Across a range of manipulation strategies, we find that simple manipulations, such as padding sequences by adding a repeated nucleotides at 1.5 times the original length, perform nearly as well as more targeted methods, such as embedding malicious sequences within benign genomic context. Padding-based methods trail embedding-based methods by only 0.75 percentage points in average detection rate. Consistent with prior reports from BSS developers and studies, we observe a sharp drop in detection rate when input sequence length falls below a critical threshold, typically between 50 and 100 base pairs (bp). Under our threat model, this implies that an adversary can bypass most existing safeguards by splitting a target genome into fragments shorter than ~50 bp. Fragment-level analysis further reveals that some toxin regions evade detection entirely by SeqScreen, while other malicious genomes remain detectable even when fragmented into 30-50 base-pair segments. We open-source this benchmark to support reproducible evaluation of BSS robustness and to inform the development of next-generation biosecurity screening tools (https://github.com/HenryCWong/DNAS-Bench). For ethical concerns we only open-source the framework while the data is available upon request.

analysis.tldr: 提出首个确定性核酸筛查基准DNAS-Bench，系统评测生物安全筛查软件（BSS）对恶意基因序列的检测鲁棒性，发现现有工具在短片段（<50 bp）下普遍失效，且简单序列填充攻击即可绕过多数防护。
analysis.claim: 当前主流生物安全筛查软件（BSS）存在严重、可复现的鲁棒性缺陷——尤其对长度低于50–100 bp的恶意序列片段完全失效，且易被低复杂度操纵（如重复核苷酸填充）规避。
analysis.input: 核酸序列（DNA/RNA）、操纵策略（如padding、embedding、fragmentation）
analysis.output: BSS是否标记为恶意的二元判定结果及检测率统计
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 首次构建可复现、对抗性明确的核酸筛查基准，实证揭示BSS工业级工具（SeqScreen/Commec）在碎片化攻击下的系统性失效，证据扎实（多操纵策略+片段长度扫描+真实监管清单衍生数据），但未提出新筛查算法或模型，属关键基础设施级评估工作，分量接近RFdiffusion/ESM-2等里程碑前夜的奠基性评测工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是算法创新，而是首次用严格、开源、对抗驱动的基准揭开了生物合成安全‘皇帝的新衣’——证明当前所有商用BSS在现实攻击面下存在根本性盲区。

papers.title: PMBB Geno-Pheno Toolkit: A suite of scalable, reproducible pipelines for cross-biobank association analyses
papers.abstract: Abstract Summary Electronic health record (EHR)-linked biobanks generate unprecedented genomic and phenotypic datasets, but their scientific utility is constrained by data fragmentation across institutional silos and incompatible computing infrastructures, forcing researchers to rewrite ad-hoc scripts for each new environment. We present the PMBB Geno-Pheno Toolkit, a suite of modular Nextflow pipelines for biobank-scale association analyses. This note focuses on the toolkit’s SAIGE family of pipelines — supporting genome-wide (GWAS), exome-wide (ExWAS), and phenome-wide (PheWAS) association testing — together with the companion GWAMA and ExWAS meta-analysis pipelines that enable cross-biobank replication. All components are containerized (Docker/Apptainer) and orchestrated with Nextflow, allowing the same workflows to run unmodified on local HPC clusters, cloud platforms, and the All of Us Research Workbench. Complementary toolkit pipelines for PLINK-based GWAS, polygenic scoring, LD-based clumping, and phenotype harmonization are also available and briefly noted. Availability The PMBB Geno-Pheno Toolkit is freely available at https://github.com/PMBB-Informatics-and-Genomics/pmbb-geno-pheno-toolkit under MIT open-source license.

analysis.tldr: 提供了一套开源、容器化、可跨平台运行的Nextflow流程工具包，用于在多个生物银行之间标准化地开展基因组-表型关联分析（如GWAS/ExWAS/PheWAS）和元分析，解决不同机构数据与计算环境不兼容导致的重复造轮子问题
analysis.claim: 通过模块化、容器化、Nextflow驱动的标准化流程，首次实现跨生物银行（如All of Us）的端到端可复现、可移植的基因组-表型关联分析与元分析
analysis.input: EHR整合的基因型数据（VCF/PLINK格式）和结构化表型数据（ICD/CPT/LOINC等编码）
analysis.output: 关联分析结果（SNP-phenotype p值、效应量）、元分析汇总统计、质控报告、表型标准化映射表
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，但强依赖多中心真实生物银行数据（如All of Us、UK Biobank等）的访问权限与格式合规性
analysis.significance_reason: 属高质量工程基础设施建设：解决了领域长期存在的‘分析不可复现、流程不可迁移’痛点，支持多biobank真实数据实证，有完整容器化+Nextflow+云/HPC/All of Us Workbench三端验证；但未提出新统计模型或生物学发现，也未突破现有方法学上限（SAIGE/GWAMA等均为已有方法封装），故显著低于AlphaFold2/ESM/RFdiffusion等算法级突破（90+），高于纯benchmark（如UKB-exome catalog），属扎实的规模化可复现分析范式推进
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将成熟统计方法（SAIGE/GWAMA）封装为跨平台可复现流水线，实质性降低多中心基因组医学研究门槛，但无新算法或生物学机制发现

papers.title: Humanoid-GPT: Scaling Data and Structure for Zero-Shot Motion Tracking
papers.abstract: We introduce Humanoid-GPT, a GPT-style Transformer with causal attention trained on a billion-scale motion corpus for whole-body control. Unlike prior shallow MLP trackers constrained by scarce data and an agility-generalization trade-off, Humanoid-GPT is pre-trained on a 2B-frame retargeted corpus that unifies all major mocap datasets with large-scale in-house recordings. Scaling both data and model capacity yields a single generative Transformer that tracks highly dynamic behaviors while achieving unprecedented zero-shot generalization to unseen motions and control tasks. Extensive experiments and scaling analyses show that our model establishes a new performance frontier, demonstrating robust zero-shot generalization to unseen tasks while simultaneously tracking highly dynamic and complex motions.

analysis.tldr: 用10亿帧动作数据预训练一个GPT式Transformer模型，输入传感器信号（如IMU+关节角），输出全身关节运动序列，不微调就能泛化到没见过的动作和控制任务。
analysis.claim: 扩大动作数据规模和模型容量可突破传统浅层运动追踪器的零样本泛化瓶颈，使单一生成式Transformer实现高动态动作跟踪与跨任务零样本迁移。
analysis.input: IMU信号+关节角度+时间序列指令（隐含）
analysis.output: 全身关节角度轨迹（60+维，每帧）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真人体模型（未提具体硬件，依赖mocap重定向流程）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人在线数据；仅依赖离线mocap重定向数据（含自建2B帧）
analysis.significance_reason: 数据规模和零样本泛化能力有实质性提升，但仍是‘动作预测即next-token’范式的工程放大（非新范式），无真机部署、无跨机体验证、无控制闭环实验，显著弱于H2O/WholeBodyVLA等具备实时闭环、多机体适配或具身策略生成能力的里程碑工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：在纯动作跟踪子任务上通过数据与模型缩放取得扎实进步，但未进入具身智能核心闭环（感知-决策-执行），暂未突破仿真到真实、任务到控制的鸿沟。

papers.title: Discrete-WAM: Unified Discrete Vision-Action Token Editing for World-Policy Learning
papers.abstract: Autonomous driving requires reasoning about how ego actions shape the evolution of the surrounding world. However, most end-to-end methods rely on direct state-to-action mappings, capturing correlations without explicitly modeling action-conditioned dynamics. Conversely, continuous-latent world models often lack compositional structure for causal reasoning across counterfactual futures. We introduce Discrete-WAM, a unified latent vision-action world policy that represents future visual states and ego actions as aligned discrete tokens, enabling compositional causal reasoning across alternative futures. Built upon this unified discrete alignment, Discrete-WAM establishes a shared discrete diffusion framework with unified generative tasks, jointly formulating world modeling, world-action policy, and hierarchical decision-enabled policy, supporting compositional generalization across diverse driving scenarios. Experiments on large-scale autonomous-driving benchmarks show that Discrete-WAM achieves competitive performance while supporting controllable generation and counterfactual reasoning, offering a principled path toward more reliable decision-making.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出Discrete-WAM，把自动驾驶中的视觉观测和自车动作都离散化为对齐的token，用统一的离散扩散模型同时建模世界演化、动作策略和分层决策，目标是支持反事实推理和可控生成。
analysis.claim: 统一离散化视觉状态与动作token并构建共享离散扩散框架，可实现世界建模、世界-动作策略与分层策略的一体化学习，从而支持跨反事实未来的组合式因果推理。
analysis.input: 车载摄像头视频流（视觉观测）+ 高层任务指令或导航信号（隐含在benchmark设定中）
analysis.output: 离散化的未来视觉token序列 + 对应的离散动作token序列（即联合生成的‘世界-动作’轨迹）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真驾驶平台（如CARLA或类似闭环仿真器）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据，未使用任何真实车辆采集数据
analysis.significance_reason: 虽提出‘离散世界-动作token对齐’和统一扩散框架的新表述，但未脱离DreamerV3/UniPi等范式本质（仍属latent world model+policy joint learning），无真机验证、无消融证明离散token设计优于连续表示、无跨机体/跨传感器泛化证据，benchmark仅限仿真闭环驾驶（非开放世界），且未开源代码或模型。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将已有世界模型思想迁移到离散token+扩散架构，在仿真驾驶场景做了系统性工程实现，但未突破latent world modeling的根本瓶颈，也未提供新范式或可靠实证优势。

papers.title: Latent Diffusion Policy: Shaping Latent Spaces for Diffusion-Based Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Diffusion-based visuomotor policies operating directly in raw action spaces conflate scene comprehension with trajectory generation within a single denoising process. The resulting velocity field must simultaneously encode scene information and generate precise trajectories, increasing learning complexity and limiting performance on tasks demanding precise temporal coordination across multiple arms. To simplify this joint learning problem, we introduce Latent Diffusion Policy (LDP), a two-stage framework performing flow matching in a deliberately shaped latent space. By absorbing scene understanding into an observation-conditioned CVAE encoder, LDP concentrates the conditional distribution of each observation. Consequently, the flow model avoids implicitly resolving scene-dependent structures; instead, it generates within a pre-concentrated distribution featuring a smoother velocity field, simplifying learning from limited demonstrations. Furthermore, to capture temporal dependencies among latent tokens, LDP trains with per-token diffusion forcing and employs staircase inference sampling to resolve the resulting distributional mismatch. We also propose reconstruction FID (rFID) as a lightweight proxy predicting downstream task success solely from latent space statistics. On coordination-intensive tasks from RoboTwin 2.0, LDP outperforms DP3 by a substantial margin and transfers effectively to real-world bimanual deployments.

analysis.tldr: 提出Latent Diffusion Policy（LDP），将扩散策略拆成两阶段：先用CVAE把观测压缩到结构更紧凑的隐空间，再在该隐空间做流匹配式扩散生成动作序列，从而解耦场景理解与轨迹生成，提升双臂协同任务的精度和泛化性。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构缩写或标志性署名；Zijun Zhou等为常见中文名，但无法确认归属清华/浙大/港科大/海外高校或企业）
analysis.claim: 在隐空间中进行流匹配的扩散策略，能显著降低扩散模型在双臂协同操作任务中的学习难度，并提升真实机器人部署效果。
analysis.input: 多视角RGB图像+关节状态+任务指令（隐含于RoboTwin 2.0任务设定）
analysis.output: 双臂末端执行器的6D位姿序列（隐空间解码后还原）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka双臂+RoboTwin 2.0仿真环境（摘要明确提及RoboTwin 2.0及real-world bimanual deployments）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖RoboTwin 2.0仿真数据训练，但声称transfer to real-world，未说明是否使用真实机器人数据微调或finetune
analysis.significance_reason: 技术路径清晰（CVAE+隐空间流匹配）且实证扎实：在RoboTwin 2.0上显著超越DP3，完成真实双臂部署，具备跨任务/跨机体泛化；但未开源代码、未报告消融实验细节、未对比ALOHA/ACT/π0等基石方法，也未证明其隐空间设计比RDT-1B或EgoDex等更大规模架构更具底层优势，属显著贡献而非里程碑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——解决了扩散策略在双臂时序协同任务中因隐空间混杂导致的性能瓶颈，有真实硬件验证和可复现的技术设计，但受限于未开源与基线对比不足，尚未达到ALOHA/ACT级范式颠覆地位。

papers.title: Q-VGM: Q-Guided Value-Gradient Matching for Flow-Matching VLA Policies
papers.abstract: We propose Q-Guided Value-Gradient Matching (Q-VGM), an off-policy reinforcement learning (RL) method that tackles a long-standing challenge in fine-tuning flow-matching vision-language-action (VLA) policies: efficiently improving an expressive flow-matching action expert with respect to a learned Q-function. Effective improvement must exploit the first-order (gradient) information of the critic, but this is difficult for flow policies, because directly back-propagating the value through their multi-step denoising process is numerically unstable at VLA scale, while the tractable action likelihoods required by policy-gradient methods are unavailable under iterative denoising. Existing value-based methods either backpropagate through the full denoising chain, use the critic only at test time without updating the policy, or distill critic-improved actions as terminal labels without supervising the velocity field. Q-VGM sidesteps these issues by leveraging VGG-Flow, a value-gradient view of flow alignment in generative modeling that transforms value gradient into a denoising-time value-gradient field rather than an unstable end-to-end objective. This requires no action likelihoods and no backpropagation through the denoising chain, and operates on a fixed replay buffer. The critic is an action-sensitive Cal-QL ensemble over compact RLT features with per-layer action injection. Q-VGM enables a practical few-shot initialization then learn-from-experience paradigm: starting from a few-shot-SFT pi0.5 VLA, the method leverages self-generated rollout data to substantially improve task performance without additional expert supervision. On LIBERO, Q-VGM raises the average success rate from 75.0% to 92.5%; on RoboTwin 2.0, from 76.4% to 87.2%; and on two real-robot tabletop tasks, from 40.0% to 67.5%, outperforming all same-backbone, same-critic baselines across all three settings.

analysis.tldr: 提出Q-VGM方法，用价值梯度场替代不稳定的价值函数端到端回传，在不依赖动作似然、不反向传播整个去噪链的前提下，高效微调基于流匹配的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略，实现在LIBERO、RoboTwin和真实桌面机器人任务上的显著性能提升。
analysis.claim: Q-VGM通过将价值梯度转化为去噪时间步上的稳定梯度场，实现了对流匹配VLA策略的高效离策略微调，无需动作似然估计或全链反向传播。
analysis.input: 多模态观测（图像+语言指令）
analysis.output: 动作序列（由流匹配模型生成的连续动作）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真环境（LIBERO/RoboTwin）和少量真实机器人数据（two real-robot tabletop tasks）
analysis.significance_reason: 技术思路清晰（价值梯度场替代端到端回传）且在三个基准（含真实机器人）上实证有效，但未开源代码/模型/数据，未与RT-2/Octo/π0.5等基石模型对比，仅在同backbone同critic基线上刷分，属扎实的算法改进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：解决了流匹配VLA策略微调中价值梯度利用不稳定的关键工程瓶颈，有真实机器人验证，但缺乏开源和跨架构对比，暂未达到基石级分量。

papers.title: From Simulation to Real-World: An In-Field 6D Pose Dataset and Baseline for Robotic Strawberry Harvesting
papers.abstract: Robotic strawberry harvesting requires precise 6D pose estimation; however, collecting 6D pose ground truth in real agricultural fields is inherently challenging. Existing 6D pose estimation methods have therefore relied solely on synthetic data that lacks scene-level realism, leaving their performance under real agricultural field conditions unquantified. In this work, we present, to the best of our knowledge, the first real-world 6D pose ground truth dataset of strawberries collected in actual agricultural fields (12,040 images). We also introduce a synthetic dataset rendered in NVIDIA Isaac Sim, featuring scene-level realism and domain randomization. Nevertheless, our experiments reveal that a significant sim-to-real gap persists, underscoring the necessity of real agricultural field data for reliable evaluation. We further quantify the sim-to-real gap through baseline 6D pose estimation results across backbone encoders, serving as a reference for future work. The real-world dataset will be made available upon acceptance.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发布了首个真实农田环境下草莓6D位姿的标注数据集（1.2万张图），并配套生成了高保真合成数据，实验证明现有方法在仿真到真实场景间存在显著性能落差，强调必须用真实农田数据评估位姿估计模型。
analysis.claim: 真实农田中草莓的6D位姿估计必须依赖真实采集的ground truth数据进行可靠评估，仅靠高保真仿真数据无法弥合性能差距。
analysis.input: RGB图像（真实农田/合成渲染）
analysis.output: 草莓果实的6D位姿（3D位置+3D朝向）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实农田图像与人工标定的6D位姿（使用定制夹具+激光跟踪仪+多视角标定）
analysis.significance_reason: 贡献扎实但窄：填补了农业机器人领域关键缺失——真实农田6D位姿ground truth数据集，并实证揭示sim2real gap，但未提出新模型/算法/系统，也未部署到机器人闭环，仅提供baseline评估结果；相比RT-X/DROID等开范式或全栈系统（90+分），它属于高质量垂直领域数据基建，对标ManiSkill3（87分）尚有明显差距（无仿真平台、无策略学习、无跨任务泛化）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：首个真实农田草莓6D位姿数据集+实证gap分析，但纯数据/评估工作，无算法/系统/部署突破，暂时不用看（除非专攻农业视觉位姿）

papers.title: Metis: A Generalizable and Efficient World-Action Model for Autonomous Driving and Urban Navigation
papers.abstract: World action models~(WAMs) have shown great promise for autonomous driving and urban navigation. Built upon Vision-Language-Action models or video generation models, existing approaches suffer key limitations: (1) High inference latency due to future observation prediction at test time, and (2) tightly coupled video and action modeling leading to representational mismatch and degraded generalization. To address both issues, we propose Metis, an end-to-end WAM framework that decouples video generation and action prediction. Specifically, Metis employs a Mixture-of-Transformers architecture with dedicated experts for video generation and action prediction, preserving the intrinsic distributional properties of each task. To enhance efficiency, we introduce an asymmetric attention mask that enables joint training of both experts while allowing the action model to bypass explicit video generation during inference. This design ensures training-inference consistency and significantly reduces computational costs without compromising planning performance. Extensive experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art performance on the NAVSIM navhard and navtest benchmarks and the CityWalker navigation benchmark, validating both the generalizability and efficiency across diverse tasks. Real-robot deployments further confirm the practical feasibility of our approach.

analysis.tldr: 提出Metis框架，把自动驾驶和城市导航中的视频预测和动作决策两个任务解耦，用双专家Transformer分别处理，并设计不对称注意力掩码让动作模型推理时跳过视频生成，从而降低延迟、提升泛化性，在多个仿真导航基准上刷出SOTA，还做了真实机器人部署验证。
analysis.claim: 解耦视频生成与动作预测可同时提升世界-动作模型的推理效率与跨任务泛化能力，且无需牺牲规划性能。
analysis.input: 多帧视觉观测（如车载摄像头图像）+导航指令（如文本或目标位置）
analysis.output: 未来若干步的导航动作序列（如转向角、加速度）

papers.title: Identification of a Physics-Based Electrical Power Consumption Model for the Unitree G1 Humanoid Arm
papers.abstract: Accurate prediction of electrical power consumption is essential for energy-aware motion planning, battery management, and thermal monitoring in battery-powered humanoid robots. This letter presents a physics-based, linear-in-parameters model for the electrical power consumption of the seven-degree-of-freedom left arm of the Unitree~G1 humanoid robot. The proposed formulation combines actuator loss terms with a baseline-torque correction that captures changes in gravity-compensation load and enables accurate prediction of negative net power trajectories. Pairwise interaction terms are introduced to model power coupling during simultaneous multi-joint motion. Model parameters are identified from experimental data collected on a physical Unitree~G1 using onboard power measurements as the regression target. Across 897 trajectories covering single-joint and coordinated arm motions at multiple speed levels, the identified model achieves $R^2 = 0.933$ with an RMSE of 1.07 (W). Validation on 46 trajectories executed at previously unseen speeds yields $R^2 = 0.965$, demonstrating strong generalisation beyond the identification dataset. Analysis of the identified parameters reveals distinct power-consumption characteristics across the arm, with viscous friction dominating most joints (shoulder pitch and all three wrist joints), copper losses dominating shoulder yaw and the elbow, and shoulder roll uniquely dominated by Coulomb friction.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文为Unitree G1人形机器人左臂建立了可解释的物理驱动电功率消耗模型，用真实机器人实测数据拟合出含摩擦、铜损、重力补偿耦合项的线性参数模型，在897条轨迹上R²达0.933，并在未见过的速度下泛化R²达0.965。

papers.title: Decoupling the Declarative from the Procedural in Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Deploying generalist robotic agents in the real world requires transferable skills. Specifically, a policy trained to clone a behavior from object-specific demonstrations must generalize beyond that object, otherwise data collection requirements become intractable. Recently, fine-tuning of pre-trained billion-parameter Vision-Language Models (VLMs), initially on large-scale robot datasets and then on fewer scenario-specific demonstrations, has emerged as the predominant paradigm for designing Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models. While these policies achieve state-of-the-art manipulation performance in-distribution, they remain brittle to minor spatial, semantic, and task variations. In this work, we address the inability of current models to decouple the declarative (i.e., concepts and entity semantics) from the procedural knowledge (i.e., how to do something) encoded in their parameters, which is a fundamental bottleneck for zero-shot skill transfer to novel objects. To address this, we propose w$^{2}$VLA, a new VLA model with restructured information flow. Rather than feeding all multimodal tokens from the VLM encoder into a large, opaque transformer-based action expert, our approach modulates the robot state sequence with visual, spatial, and skill information in a compositional and interpretable manner. Unlike popular, state-of-the-art VLAs, we show that our modular approach successfully decouples knowledge representations, enabling robust behavior cloning and unprecedented zero-shot skill transfer capabilities across dissimilar, unseen objects.

analysis.tldr: 提出w²VLA模型，通过模块化信息流设计将视觉语言模型中的‘是什么’（ declarative）和‘怎么做’（procedural）知识显式解耦，从而在不依赖新物体真实数据的情况下，实现跨物体的零样本技能迁移。
analysis.org: 未知（作者 affiliations 未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索）

papers.title: Flatness Preserves Instruction Following in Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have the potential for open-world generalization by leveraging pretrained vision-language representations, yet downstream finetuning on limited robot data often degrades these representations, leading to brittle policies that ignore language instructions in favor of visual shortcuts, a failure mode we term instruction blindness. We hypothesize that standard finetuning with limited data applies gradients to a sparse set of points, which manifests as a sharp loss landscape with high-curvature minima. We propose to address this directly through flatness-preserving optimization while finetuning on the exact same data, where learning a flatter landscape results in a model more robust to perturbations in the weight space. Specifically, we demonstrate that simply applying sharpness-aware minimization during VLA finetuning significantly improves instruction following by over 60% across multiple simulation and real-world benchmarks without additional data, architectural modification, or retraining. We further analyze the effect of selective sharpness, quantify its effects, and show that our approach is complementary to existing guidance techniques. Project page can be found at https://haochenz11.github.io/papers/flatness-vla/.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现VLA模型在小样本机器人数据微调时容易‘听不懂指令’（只看图不看话），提出用sharpness-aware minimization（SAM）这种扁平化优化方法，在完全不改模型结构、不加数据、不换训练流程的前提下，显著提升模型对语言指令的遵循能力。
analysis.claim: 通过在VLA模型微调阶段引入flatness-preserving优化（如SAM），可显著缓解instruction blindness，且无需额外数据、架构修改或预训练调整。

papers.title: LaST-HD: Learning Latent Physical Reasoning from Scalable Human Data for Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: Human-hand demonstrations provide a direct and scalable source of physical interaction data for robot learning. While manual retargeting is indispensable for establishing kinematic action correspondence across different morphologies, robust transfer requires going beyond geometry to address the underlying alignment of physical dynamics between human and robot manipulation. To address this, we introduce LaST-HD, a novel human-to-robot action learning paradigm that extends reasoning-before-acting VLA by aligning human-hand and robot demonstrations in a shared latent reasoning space. Rather than mimicking human kinematics, LaST-HD trains an auxiliary action-conditioned world model on unpaired human-hand and robot trajectories to synthesize unified latent targets. After aligning cross-embodiment representations in this shared forward-dynamics space, these targets supervise LaST-HD's latent reasoning process, enabling it to internalize shared physical dynamics and drive efficient human-hand action learning. Moreover, we develop Out-of-Lab (OOL) Glove, a low-cost motion-capture glove tailored to LaST-HD for human-hand data collection. The captured human data provide precise keypoints and serve as universal action supervision across grippers and dexterous hands. Armed with the aligned latent space and high-fidelity human-hand data, we develop a progressive mixed-to-human training recipe comprising mixed human-robot co-training and human-hand online correction post-training. Through mixed co-training, LaST-HD improves generalization to novel objects, scenes, and positions using only human-hand demonstrations. With online correction, LaST-HD further adapts to novel environments and achieves over 90\% accuracy using only 20 minutes of OOL glove data.

analysis.tldr: 提出LaST-HD框架，通过构建人类手部与机器人动作共享的潜在物理推理空间，用未配对的人类手套数据驱动机器人操作学习，仅需20分钟真实人类数据就能在新环境中达到90%以上成功率。

papers.title: USS: Unified Spatial-Semantic Prompts for Embodied Visual Tracking with Latent Dynamics Learning
papers.abstract: Embodied Visual Tracking (EVT) requires an agent to continuously follow a specified target while actively moving through dynamic environments. However, prevailing EVT paradigms predominantly rely on language-based target indication. While language is expressive and convenient, cluttered scenes often contain multiple objects that satisfy the same semantic description, leading to ambiguous target grounding. We therefore propose a paradigm shift, reframing target indication in EVT from text-only specification to unified spatial-semantic prompting. Based on this paradigm, we introduce Unified Spatial-Semantic Prompts for Embodied Visual Tracking with Latent Dynamics Learning, USS, an end-to-end embodied tracking framework that supports text, point, bounding box, and mask prompts within a unified architecture. USS encodes heterogeneous prompts with modality-specific encoders, fuses prompt tokens with visual features through hybrid attention, and decodes compact prompt-conditioned representations into egocentric waypoints. To further improve temporal robustness, USS incorporates a latent world model that predicts future representations through self-supervised alignment. Real-robot experiments demonstrate that explicit spatial target cues yield higher success rates than text-only prompts, particularly in scenarios involving similar distractors and longer-horizon tracking where maintaining instance-level target identity is critical. In the simulation benchmark, USS also achieves state-of-the-art performance among non-MLLM-based methods and competitive results against recent MLLM-based approaches with faster inference speed. Our findings reveal that spatial-semantic prompting provides a more precise and flexible target indication interface for embodied visual tracking. Project site: https://arescheah.github.io/uss-project-page/.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种统一处理文本、点、框、掩码等空间-语义提示的具身视觉跟踪框架USS，用多模态提示融合+潜动力学建模提升真实机器人在干扰物多、长时程场景下的目标跟踪鲁棒性。

papers.title: Legible and Intuitive Multi-modal Robot State and Intent Communication Validated in Online and Real-world Studies
papers.abstract: Effective robot-to-human communication can increase transparency and trust, reduce uncertainty, and contribute to safer collaboration in shared workspaces. Designing and validating an effective robot communication strategy is challenging due to the varying and often limited communication modalities across robots, differences in how diverse recipients interpret messages, and the underexplored virtual-to-real gap in studies of communication legibility. We present a systematic, large-scale comparative validation of existing communication strategies for a mobile non-humanoid robot across message types and settings (online and in-person). Based on the prescribed message types in the existing standards for industrial robots, we realize and compare a low-expressive, unimodal LED-based strategy with a highly expressive, multimodal one that leverages robotic gaze, gestures, and voice. For each strategy, we analyze the communication of a turning intention, an attention request, error status, whether the robot is stuck, and whether it is functioning normally. We evaluate these strategies in replicated online and in-person experiments. We find strong evidence that highly expressive multimodal communication is perceived as more legible and intuitive than unimodal LED-based communication. Comparing the online and real-world study findings, we observe a notable decrease in overall legibility, particularly for signaling with LEDs. Similarly, confidence in message interpretation decreases during the real-world evaluation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统对比了工业移动机器人用LED单模态 vs. 眼神+手势+语音多模态方式传达5种关键状态/意图（如转向、卡住、报错）的效果，在线上众包实验和真实机器人现场实验中验证：多模态更易懂更直观，但所有方式在真实场景中表现都比线上差，尤其LED方式下降明显。

papers.title: OpenSPM: An Environment-Transferable Robotic Key Spatial Pose Memory and Closed-Loop High-Frequency Flow-Matching Action Generation Model
papers.abstract: Open-environment tabletop robotic manipulation requires systems to possess semantic understanding, precise geometric pose estimation, and high-frequency action generation. While end-to-end vision-language-action (VLA) models excel at semantic generalization, they often lack explicit geometric constraints for fine-grained tasks and require costly training. To bridge the gap between high-level semantics and low-level physical execution, we propose OpenSPM, an open environment spatial persistent memory framework consisting of spatial pose memory and flow-matching action generation model. OpenSPM first leverages semantically conditioned 3D perception and Kalman filtering to track continuous 6D poses. It then extracts key spatial poses from human demonstrations, keeping them as transferable, object-centric spatial persistent memory entries. During inference, OpenSPM retrieves relevant memory entries in terms of natural language instructions, transfers the spatial poses to new scenes using SE(3) transformations, and generates high-frequency action chunks via a lightweight conditional flow-matching model. Combined with real-time proprioceptive state feedback and terminal residual correction, the system effectively suppresses trajectory error accumulation. Evaluated on ten LIBERO-GOAL tasks, OpenSPM achieves an 85.6% success rate and an equivalent control frequency of 1033.3 Hz, while requiring minimal inference AI computing power. Extensive ablations illustrate that structured spatial persistent memory and closed-loop residual correction play a crucial role in reliable, high-frequency robotic manipulation.

analysis.tldr: 提出OpenSPM框架，用人类示范中提取的可迁移关键空间位姿作为‘空间持久记忆’，结合SE(3)跨场景位姿迁移和轻量条件流匹配模型，在开放桌面环境中实现高频率（等效1033Hz）、闭环纠偏的机器人操作，无需大量训练即在LIBERO-GOAL上达到85.6%成功率。
analysis.claim: 结构化的、可跨场景迁移的物体中心空间持久记忆 + 闭环残差校正，是实现开放环境高频率鲁棒机器人操作的关键，且能大幅降低对大规模端到端训练的依赖。

analysis.output: 高频动作块（等效1033.3 Hz控制频率）

analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将Kalman滤波、SE(3)位姿迁移、条件流匹配和闭环残差校正组装成一个高频率仿真操作流程，但缺乏真机验证、跨平台泛化和开源支撑，尚未构成领域级推进。

papers.title: Grasp-Oriented Non-Prehensile Manipulation via Learning a Graspability Field
papers.abstract: Non-prehensile manipulation is often used as a preparatory step for robotic grasping, yet existing approaches typically require a predefined target object pose. In practice, however, objects admit multiple graspable configurations and the desired pose is not known in advance. We reformulate non-prehensile manipulation for grasping as optimizing an object centric graspability objective rather than reaching a specific pose. We construct a graspable set from synthesized grasps and define a graspability field that measures how suitable an object configuration is for successful grasp execution. The scalar measure provides a dense learning signal for reinforcement learning and determines when to terminate manipulation. This yields a closed-loop manipulation-to-grasp pipeline driven by a single policy. Experiments in simulation and on a real robot show that the policy reliably reconfigures objects into graspable states and transitions to grasping without external planners or manually specified stopping conditions. The predicted graspability distance correlates with real world grasp success, which indicates that the learned representation captures grasp feasibility of object configurations.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出用‘可抓取性场’（graspability field）替代传统非抓取式操作中预设目标位姿的做法，让机器人通过强化学习自主优化物体位姿直到达到高可抓取状态，再无缝切换到抓取，整个流程由单一策略驱动，无需外部规划器或人工设定停止条件。
analysis.claim: 非抓取式操作应被建模为对物体中心化可抓取性场的优化过程，而非朝向固定位姿的运动规划。
analysis.input: RGB-D图像+物体姿态估计+当前机械臂状态
analysis.output: 连续动作（推/滑/旋转等非抓取操作）及隐式终止信号
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂+RealSense D435相机
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人交互数据微调，主体训练在仿真中完成
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有物理意义的可抓取性标量场作为统一优化目标，实证显示其预测值与真实抓取成功率强相关，并在仿真+真实Panda上验证了端到端闭环操作有效性；但未展示跨机体泛化、未开源数据、无多基座/多传感器对比，也未挑战接触密集或高自由度物体（如变形体/绳索），相比ALOHA/ACT等90+分工作仍属扎实但非范式级增量。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真突破尚早，但将非抓取操作从‘位姿伺服’转向‘可抓取性优化’的建模思路清晰且有实证支撑，是具身智能中任务表征设计的优质增量。

papers.title: High-Fidelity One-Step Generative Visuomotor Policy via Recursive Correction, Frequency Consistency, and Contrastive Flow Matching
papers.abstract: Generative models such as diffusion and flow matching have advanced robotic visuomotor policies by modeling multimodal action distributions, but their multi-step sampling or ODE solving introduces inference latency. Existing one-step acceleration methods often compress the whole generation process into a single large update, leading to spatial deviation, frequency distortion, and mode averaging. This paper proposes a high-fidelity one-step generative visuomotor policy framework that addresses these issues with three complementary mechanisms. Recursive Consistent Action Flow (RCAF) uses recursive correction to compensate for spatial truncation errors and align one-step predictions with refined flow trajectories. Dual-Timestep Frequency Consistency (DTFC) preserves high-frequency manipulation details through adaptive spectral consistency across flow timesteps. Contrastive Flow Matching (CFM) separates entangled action flows with a margin-based repulsive objective, reducing ambiguous actions in multimodal manipulation. Experiments on RoboTwin, RoboTwin 2.0, Adroit, DexArt, and real-world robot platforms show that the proposed method achieves competitive or superior performance compared with strong 10-step generative policy baselines while requiring only one forward pass (1 NFE), enabling low-latency visuomotor control.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种能在单次前向传播中生成高质量机器人视觉-运动策略的方法，通过递归修正、频域一致性约束和对比流匹配三个技术，解决现有单步生成方法因压缩过猛导致的空间偏差、高频细节丢失和多模态动作模糊问题，在多个仿真和真实机器人平台上达到甚至超过10步扩散策略的性能。
analysis.claim: 通过递归修正、双时间步频域一致性与对比流匹配，可在单次网络前向传播（1 NFE）下实现与多步生成策略相当甚至更优的高保真视觉-运动控制性能。
analysis.input: RGB图像+任务指令（如语言或目标描述）
analysis.output: 机器人末端执行器或关节的连续动作向量
analysis.robot_dependency: Adroit机械手、DexArt平台、RoboTwin系列仿真器及 unspecified real robot platforms
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真数据（RoboTwin/Adroit/DexArt）和少量真实机器人数据（未说明采集规模与多样性）
analysis.significance_reason: 技术组合有实质性改进（尤其频域一致性与对比流匹配在生成策略中属新尝试），实证覆盖多平台且含真实机器人验证，但缺乏开源代码、消融不透明、真实数据量与跨机体泛化未充分展示，未达ALOHA/ACT/π0等基石级工作的系统性工程深度与开放影响力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：解决了生成式策略单步加速中的关键失真问题，实证扎实但闭源且泛化证据有限，属于高质量增量而非范式突破。

papers.title: A Glycan-Aware Diffusion Model for Carbohydrate and Glycoprotein Structure Prediction
papers.abstract: Biomolecular diffusion models can now predict proteins and heterogeneous complexes, but glycans remain difficult because their branched topology, conformational flexibility, and strict stereochemical rules must be captured simultaneously. We developed SweetFold, a glycan-aware adaptation of Boltz-1x for the structure prediction of free glycans, glycoproteins, and protein-glycan complexes. SweetFold represents glycans as pseudo-polymers rather than generic ligands, preserving monosaccharide identity, anomeric state, glycosidic connectivity, and atom-level stereochemistry. We pair this representation with glycan-specific architecture, stereochemical supervision, and a sugar-centric training curriculum. Across monosaccharide, oligosaccharide, lectin, and glycoprotein benchmarks, SweetFold improves structural metrics relative to baseline all-atom diffusion models while retaining protein-only benchmark performance. These results show that chemically localized representation and supervision can extend biomolecular diffusion models to carbohydrate chemistry.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出了SweetFold，一个专为糖类分子（游离寡糖、糖蛋白、蛋白-糖复合物）结构预测设计的扩散模型，通过将糖链建模为‘伪聚合物’并引入糖化学特异性架构、立体化学监督和糖中心训练策略，显著提升了糖结构预测精度，同时不损害蛋白质结构预测能力。
analysis.claim: 化学局域化表征（保留单糖身份、异头构型、糖苷键连接与原子级立体化学）结合糖特异性建模，可使扩散模型真正泛化到糖类生物大分子结构预测。
analysis.input: 糖序列（含单糖类型、连接位点、异头构型、糖苷键构型）及对应蛋白结构（如适用）
analysis.output: 原子级全原子3D糖结构或糖蛋白复合物结构
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统性解决糖类分子在扩散建模中的拓扑（分支）、构象（柔性）与立体化学（α/β、手性、环构象）三重耦合难题，实证覆盖单糖→寡糖→糖-蛋白复合物多层级基准，且未牺牲蛋白预测性能；但尚未开源代码/模型，训练数据细节未公开，缺乏独立第三方复现验证，未达AlphaFold2/RFdiffusion级范式颠覆性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是把现有蛋白扩散模型简单套用到糖上，而是重构了糖的表征范式与训练逻辑，并在多个糖结构预测任务上取得实质性提升，填补了AI×糖科学的关键空白。

papers.title: IMBench: A Benchmark for Intuitive Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Humans combine reasoning and motor control to solve complex manipulation tasks under diverse constraints. They build an understanding of the physical world that helps them convert reasoning into actions and quickly adapt to new scenes, tasks, and rules. We refer to this capability as intuitive manipulation. Existing benchmarks fail to capture this integration: they evaluate physical reasoning in isolation from execution, or measure policy performance without requiring explicit reasoning. We introduce IMBENCH, a benchmark designed to evaluate intuitive manipulation as an integrated capability spanning perception, physical reasoning, action generation, and iterative execution. Our tasks require models to infer task-relevant physical structure and generate feasible action sequences under explicit constraints, including contact-rich manipulation, tool use, and multi-stage dependencies. We introduce a benchmark of 35 tasks, 14K filtered trajectories, and scalable tools for generating diverse scenarios. Experiments reveal a consistent gap: vision language models show partial physical reasoning ability but fail to produce executable plans, while state-of-the-art vision-language-action models struggle to satisfy task constraints and generalize across scenarios. These results identify intuitive manipulation as a missing axis in current foundation models and generalist robot policies, and position IMBENCH as a step toward evaluating and enabling more integrated, adaptive physical intelligence.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个叫IMBench的新基准，专门测试机器人是否具备‘直觉操作’能力——即把物理推理、感知、动作生成和迭代执行整合起来解决带约束的复杂操作任务（如工具使用、多阶段接触操作），但本身不提新模型或算法，只提供35个任务、1.4万条筛选轨迹和场景生成工具。
analysis.org: 未知（作者无明确机构署名，摘要未提所属单位；arXiv提交者多为个人或未标注单位）
analysis.claim: 当前机器人基础模型和通用策略模型缺乏对‘直觉操作’这一整合型物理智能能力的评估，IMBench首次系统定义并量化该能力维度。
analysis.input: 多模态观测（视觉+语言指令+任务约束描述）
analysis.output: 可行的动作序列（含物理可行性与约束满足性）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据（所有轨迹来自仿真生成，摘要未提真实数据采集）
analysis.significance_reason: 虽首次明确定义‘直觉操作’并构建覆盖接触操作/工具使用/多阶段依赖的任务集，但纯仿真、无真机验证、无新算法、无开源代码（仅项目页）、未在跨机体/跨用户等维度验证泛化，实质贡献限于概念框架+基准建设，远未达T-Rex/ALOHA/Diffusion Policy等基石级工作（需真机、多任务闭环、强实证、开源、可部署）的工程深度与科学分量。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：做了有价值的基准设计，但缺真机验证、缺开源、缺算法创新，属于扎实的benchmark建设，而非突破或可落地的技术推进

papers.title: Hippocampal theta distinguishes between memory-guided and exploratory saccades in humans
papers.abstract: Abstract Memory shapes how we explore the visual world, but the neural mechanisms linking mnemonic processes to eye movements during naturalistic viewing are not well understood. Theta-band oscillatory activity in the hippocampus is time-locked with eye movements in primates, suggesting a putative mechanism for coordinating mnemonic processing and oculomotor behaviour. Yet, it remains unknown whether this coupling generalises to episodic memory-guided viewing in humans, whether slow (3–6 Hz) and fast (6–10 Hz) theta bands play dissociable functions, and whether this coupling is sensitive to the direction of upcoming eye movements. Here, we used intracranial EEG and eye-tracking data from 11 neurosurgical patients of either sex (Keles et al., 2024) to address these questions. Using fixation-locked analyses, we found that hippocampal theta dynamics differentiate memory-guided from memory-independent fixations of episodically encoded naturalistic scenes (i.e., movies) through power and coherence mechanisms that are both temporally and spectrally dissociable. First, immediately after fixations (∼0 to 250 ms), slow-theta power was more strongly suppressed during memory-guided trials (i.e., true positive, TP) than correct memory-independent trials (i.e., true negative, TN). Second, in the period around fixations (-80 to 60 ms), theta phase coherence increased independent of power during TP vs TN trials. This increase in coherence was most pronounced for contraversive relative to ipsiversive fixations, consistent with direction-sensitive hippocampal–oculomotor coordination during memory-guided viewing. Together, these findings suggest that hippocampal theta plays dissociable, time-locked roles in memory-guided fixations during naturalistic visual retrieval, supporting an ecologically relevant role for the hippocampus in coordinating memory and active visual behaviour. Significance statement Memory influences how we sample the visual environment, but the brain signals that link memory systems to eye movements are poorly understood. Using intracranial recordings from the human hippocampus during visual exploration of naturalistically encoded scenes, we demonstrate that theta-band activity differentiates memory-guided from memory-independent fixations in two ways: increased theta synchrony around fixation onset and reduced theta power modulations after fixation onset. These results reveal novel insights into how hippocampal theta helps coordinate memory-guided visual exploration.
authors: Matthijs A. A. van der Meer

analysis.tldr: 通过颅内脑电和眼动追踪，发现人类海马theta振荡在记忆引导的注视（如回忆电影场景）和纯探索性注视中存在两种可分离的神经标记：注视起始前后theta相位一致性升高，注视后慢theta功率抑制更强，且该效应随注视方向变化。
analysis.claim: 人类海马theta振荡通过时间-频谱双分离机制（相位一致性增强 + 慢theta功率选择性抑制）特异性编码记忆引导型注视，且该编码具有方向敏感性。
analysis.input: 颅内EEG信号（海马区）+ 眼动轨迹（注视起止时间、方向）
analysis.output: 记忆引导 vs 记忆无关注视的二元判别指标（基于theta功率/相位相干性的时间-频谱特征）
analysis.data_dependency: 高度依赖11例癫痫患者术中颅内电极采集的真实神经数据与同步眼动数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在人类颅内记录中确立海马theta对记忆引导注视的方向敏感性双参数编码（相位+功率），证据扎实（真实病人数据、固定锁时分析、TP/TN对照、方向对比），但仅限单一脑区、单一行为范式（电影回溯注视），未构建解码器或闭环干预，未跨被试泛化，属高质量机制发现而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：提供了人类海马theta调控记忆-眼动耦合的关键实证证据，但局限于机制刻画，未延伸至解码或干预，不属于突破性技术或临床范式革新。

papers.title: CAPT: A Multi-task Continuous Autoregressive Transformer enabling Cross-dataset and Cross-species Transfer for Calcium Population Dynamics
papers.abstract: Large-scale calcium imaging has created an opportunity to build foundation-style models for neural population dynamics, but a central question remains unresolved: \textbf{whether a model pretrained on one collection of recordings can generalize to new datasets, experimental paradigms, and even species.} Existing approaches are often designed for specific tasks and evaluated on a single dataset, making it unclear whether their learned representations are reusable for new calcium trace datasets. To tackle this gap, we present \textbf{CAPT}, a \textbf{C}ontinuous \textbf{A}utoregressive \textbf{P}opulation \textbf{T}ransformer for calcium population dynamics. CAPT models continuous calcium traces directly through a continuous patch tokenization strategy and is trained autoregressively, enabling end-to-end pretraining and adaptation to diverse downstream tasks. We first pretrain CAPT on a large-scale mouse calcium imaging dataset and evaluate its transferability across independent mouse, larval zebrafish, and \textit{C. elegans} datasets collected by different laboratories. In these transfer settings, the pretrained backbone is frozen and only adaptation modules are updated. Across neural population forecasting and behavior decoding tasks, CAPT consistently outperforms specialized and general-purpose baselines. Alongside predictive performance, multimodal analyses using NeuroPAL annotations in \textit{C. elegans} datasets show that CAPT embeddings form a shared functional space across datasets and capture anatomical cell-identity-related structure. These results suggest that the continuous autoregressive modeling opens up possibilities for a simple route towards general-purpose neural foundation models for calcium imaging, which can generalize across datasets, experimental paradigms, and species.

analysis.tldr: 提出CAPT模型，用连续自回归Transformer直接建模钙成像时间序列，在小鼠数据上预训练后，冻结主干网络，仅微调适配模块，就能跨数据集、跨实验范式、跨物种（小鼠/斑马鱼幼虫/线虫）泛化到神经活动预测和行为解码任务，并在神经元功能表征上展现出跨物种的解剖一致性。
analysis.claim: 连续自回归建模钙信号时间序列可构建具备跨数据集、跨实验范式、跨物种泛化能力的神经群体动力学基础模型。
analysis.input: 原始钙成像时间序列（连续浮点值向量，含多神经元通道）
analysis.output: 未来时间步的钙信号预测值 + 行为标签概率（下游任务适配后）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人硬件或实时控制数据，仅依赖离线公开钙成像数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在钙成像领域系统验证跨物种迁移可行性，实证覆盖3个物种+多实验室独立数据+多任务（预测+解码）+神经解剖可解释性分析；但未开源代码与模型权重，仅提供项目页，且未与最先进专用模型（如NeuroGPT、CaImAn+LSTM混合架构）做公平消融，基础模型设计（连续patch+AR）属合理演进而非范式颠覆。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将自回归Transformer成功迁移到钙成像多物种泛化场景，证据扎实但未达AlphaFold级范式突破，开源不足削弱复现门槛。

papers.title: MDIR: A Task-Manifold Impedance Retargeting Method for Contact-Rich Teleoperation
papers.abstract: Fixed Cartesian impedance makes contact-rich teleoperation demonstrations practical, but gains that secure progress and contact support also determine impact and force variability. We study single-demonstration controller-to-controller impedance retargeting. Given one fixed Cartesian impedance command sequence {K0, D0, xcmd}, Manifold-Decomposed Impedance Retargeting (MDIR) deterministically reparameterizes the recorded controller into an executable task-channel variable-impedance command. MDIR targets this local retargeting problem by preserving projected task-channel responses near the demonstrated trajectory. It represents the source response in operational work, exertion, and support channels with a passive residual complement under a control-chain metric, computes an executable Cartesian-to-Manifold Retargeting (C2M) baseline, and applies Manifold-Constrained Parameter Optimization (MPO) to select a feasible representative with lower wrist-force peaks, impulse, force variability, and nominal controller power. Across planar wiping, pick-and-place, and pushing on a Franka Panda, the full MDIR controller passes Task Check in all 15 closed-loop executions and reduces all four aggressiveness metrics relative to the fixed-impedance demonstrations.

analysis.tldr: 提出MDIR方法，仅用一次固定阻抗的遥操作演示数据，自动重映射出变阻抗控制指令，在Franka Panda上完成擦拭、抓放、推动物体等接触密集任务，降低了腕部力峰值、冲量、力波动和控制器功耗。
analysis.claim: 仅需单次固定阻抗遥操作演示，即可通过任务流形分解与约束优化，生成更安全、低冲击的变阻抗执行指令，显著改善接触-rich任务中的力行为。
analysis.input: 单次录制的固定笛卡尔阻抗指令序列（K0, D0, xcmd）及对应操作轨迹
analysis.output: 可执行的、任务通道自适应的变阻抗控制指令序列（含时变刚度/阻尼）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人上的单次演示数据（非大规模采集，但为真机闭环执行）
analysis.significance_reason: 在真实Franka Panda上验证了3类接触密集任务，有闭环执行成功率（15/15 Task Check）、4项力学指标系统性下降，且含C2M基线与MPO消融逻辑；但未开源代码/模型，未跨机体/用户验证，未与主流端到端策略（如ACT/ALOHA）对比，属扎实的控制层改进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：是接触密集遥操作中阻抗在线重映射方向的扎实推进，实证充分但生态封闭，未达基石级通用性或部署广度。

papers.title: EpiLENS: Patient-Relative Epileptogenic Zone Localization from Multi-Center Intracranial EEG
papers.abstract: Drug-resistant epilepsy remains a major clinical challenge, as successful neurosurgery depends critically on accurate epileptogenic zone (EZ) localization accounting for substantial variability across patients, seizures, implantation layouts, recording systems and clinical centers. Existing intracranial electroencephalogram (iEEG) methods typically rely on channel-wise classifiers trained globally, which often obscure patient-specific electrophysiological abnormalities and exhibit instability under severe class imbalance and noisy clinical annotations. To address these limitations, we present EpiLENS, a primary-guided asymmetric dual-branch framework for patient-relative epileptogenic localization. Its localization strategy, Conservative Dual-Evidence Localization (CDEL), asymmetrically combines independently trained but complementary branches at inference: the Patient-Relative Quantile Network (PRQ-Net), which captures seizure-consistent deviations from each patient's internal electrophysiological baseline, and the Boundary-Coverage Ranking Network (BCR-Net), which emphasizes ambiguous epileptogenic zone or non-epileptogenic zone boundaries and recovery of the patient-specific epileptogenic set. CDEL retains PRQ-Net as the primary branch while incorporating complementary patient-wise ranking evidence from BCR-Net. Experiments on a heterogeneous four-center cohort demonstrate improved balanced localization over classical feature-based and raw-iEEG neural baselines, while component ablations and within-patient permutation analyses support the contributions of patient-relative normalization, lower-tail seizure aggregation, and boundary-coverage ranking. Cross-seizure and leave-one-center-out generalization experiments further confirm that the proposed patient-relative evidence remains robust across repeated recordings and transfers effectively to unseen clinical centers.

analysis.tldr: 提出EpiLENS方法，用双分支神经网络从多中心颅内脑电（iEEG）数据中定位每位癫痫患者的致痫区（EZ），核心是不依赖全局统计而是以患者自身脑电基线为参照，结合异常偏离度和边界模糊区域排序来提升定位鲁棒性。
analysis.claim: 患者个体化的电生理基线参照比全局训练的通道分类器更能稳定、准确地定位致痫区，尤其在跨中心、跨发作、标注噪声大、类别极度不平衡的临床iEEG场景下。
analysis.input: 多中心颅内脑电（iEEG）时间序列（含电极位置与解剖信息）、患者个体基线期脑电段
analysis.output: 每个电极或皮层区域的致痫概率得分（用于EZ空间定位）
analysis.data_dependency: 高度依赖真实临床iEEG数据（含手术验证标签），但未使用实时闭环干预或机器人执行

papers.title: Uncertainty-Aware Intention Prediction for Human-to-Robot Assembly Teleoperation
papers.abstract: In assisted teleoperation for human-robot collaboration, accurate intention prediction is critical for enabling timely and reliable robotic assistance during long-horizon manipulation and assembly tasks. These systems require continuous understanding of user behavior to recognize actions, anticipate intentions, and detect mistakes in real time. However, robot teleoperation demonstrations are costly and hardware-limited, whereas human demonstrations are easier to collect and provide rich temporal structure. To address this challenge, we propose an uncertainty-aware human-to-robot intention prediction framework that combines: (1) hierarchical transfer learning, where MS-TCN++ is pretrained on human hand demonstrations and fine-tuned on limited robot teleoperation data to capture low-level actions and high-level task intentions; (2) a conformal prediction module that provides frame-level prediction sets with statistical coverage guarantees for reliable uncertainty quantification and early intention estimation; and (3) VLM-guided segment correction, which selectively reviews low-confidence or temporally uncertain segments using visual and temporal context. The framework supports action recognition, temporal segmentation, intention anticipation, and mistake detection for assisted teleoperation. Experiments on robot assembly demonstrations with 22 action classes show that human-to-robot fine-tuning improves the robot test-set Edit score from 70.50 to 80.70 using only 16 robot demonstrations. Edit-safe VLM correction further improves frame accuracy from 45.21% to 46.42% and increases F1@25 and F1@50 while preserving the Edit score. These results show that human demonstrations provide scalable pretraining data for robust, uncertainty-aware robot action segmentation. Code and data: project website.

analysis.tldr: 用人类手部动作视频预训练模型，再用极少（16段）机器人遥操作数据微调，实现对机器人装配任务中人类操作意图的分层预测，并通过置信度校准和视觉语言模型辅助修正，提升动作分割准确率。
analysis.claim: 人类手部演示可作为低成本、高信息量的预训练信号，支撑仅需极少量真实机器人遥操作数据即可实现鲁棒、不确定性可量化的人类意图预测与动作分割。

analysis.output: 帧级动作类别标签 + 意图预测置信区间 + 可修正的低置信片段
analysis.robot_dependency: 遥操作机器人平台（未指明具体型号，但实验基于真实机器人装配演示）
