Recent approaches recast trajectory planning as probabilistic inference, sampling from a posterior over trajectories using diffusion models whose score functions are learned from demonstration data. While showing promising performance, these approaches are limited: they often rely on sizable demonstration datasets and struggle to rigorously enforce dynamics and hard safety constraints during sampling. To this end, we introduce Model-Based Diffusion Optimal Control (MDOC), a model-based diffusion planner that efficiently produces dynamically feasible trajectories without relying on data. Crucially, we show that MDOC's safety mechanism -- combining known dynamics models with Control Barrier Function-constrained projections -- naturally scales to multi-robot planning settings through Conflict-Based Search. Across simulation experiments, this integrated method consistently outperforms representative baseline planners in sample efficiency, geometric smoothness, and success rate, while reducing computation time and producing collision-free trajectories.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种不依赖演示数据的基于模型的扩散最优控制方法（MDOC），用已知动力学模型和控制屏障函数约束投影来保证多机器人轨迹的动力学可行性和硬安全性，并结合冲突搜索实现多机协同规划。
analysis.claim: MDOC无需任何演示数据，仅依靠已知动力学模型和控制屏障函数约束，就能在连续空间中高效生成多机器人动力学可行、严格碰撞规避的轨迹。
analysis.input: 多机器人初始/目标位姿、环境几何信息、各机器人动力学模型
analysis.output: 多机器人协同的、动力学可行且碰撞自由的连续时间轨迹
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，完全基于模型与仿真
analysis.significance_reason: 方法有实质性创新（将CBF约束嵌入扩散采样+Conflict-Based Search适配），实证完整（多基线对比、成功率/平滑度/耗时三指标提升），但仅限仿真、未验证真实机器人、无跨场景/跨机体泛化、未开源代码模型，属于扎实的算法级增量，未达‘显著贡献’门槛（需真机+多任务+消融+开源）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将控制理论（CBF）、搜索框架（CBS）与扩散采样有机耦合，在仿真中验证了安全性和效率，但缺乏真实世界验证和开源支撑，尚未形成可复现的系统级推进。

papers.title: Interpretable Prediction of Phase Separation and Disease Variant Effects in Intrinsically Disordered Regions
papers.abstract: Coding mutations within intrinsically disordered regions (IDRs) of proteins are increasingly implicated in human diseases yet remain poorly interpreted by conventional variant-effect predictors that rely on structural stability and conservation-based metrics. Quantifying disruption of IDR-mediated liquid-liquid phase separation (LLPS) offers a biophysically principled approach to interpreting the pathogenic impact of such variants. However, existing LLPS predictors suffer from training biases toward self-separating proteins, show limited performance on partner-dependent phase separation, and often lack interpretability for variant prioritization. We present an interpretable ensemble machine-learning framework that integrates protein language model embeddings of sequence and predicted structure to predict LLPS propensity and classify proteins as self-separating or partner-dependent. Our two-step classifiers outperform existing methods on independent benchmark datasets, with the largest gains for partner-dependent LLPS proteins. Beyond classification, our framework identifies critical phase-separating regions and quantifies mutation-induced perturbations in LLPS. Applied to disease-associated variant databases, we found that pathogenic mutations are enriched in predicted phase-separating regions and frequently perturb LLPS propensity scores, implicating mutation-induced LLPS dysregulation as a potential pathogenic mechanism for numerous diseases. Overall, our framework provides an accurate, interpretable approach for identifying phase-separating proteins and linking aberrant phase-separation behavior to disease pathogenesis.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个可解释的机器学习框架，用蛋白语言模型嵌入和预测结构特征来预测无序区（IDR）的液-液相分离（LLPS）倾向，并区分自分离型与伙伴依赖型相分离，进而定位致病突变如何扰动相分离行为。
analysis.claim: 基于蛋白语言模型和结构预测的可解释集成模型，能更准确、可归因地预测IDR的LLPS倾向及类型，并揭示疾病突变通过扰动LLPS致病的机制。
analysis.input: 蛋白质序列 + 预测的结构特征（如二级结构、溶剂可及性等）
analysis.output: LLPS倾向得分、自分离/伙伴依赖二分类、关键相分离区域定位、突变对LLPS的扰动量化值
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将LLPS预测明确拆解为自分离/伙伴依赖二分类并实现可解释扰动量化，实证覆盖多个独立benchmark且在伙伴依赖型上显著超越基线，但未开源代码/模型，训练数据未公开，未在临床队列或湿实验中验证因果机制，属扎实的计算生物学增量贡献，未达基石级（如AlphaFold2/ESM系列）的范式突破或通用性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：方法设计合理、任务定义清晰、实证优于现有工具，但缺乏开源与实验验证，暂未形成领域范式影响。

papers.title: Biochemical Logic Computation Through Repurposing Natural bZIP Protein Interaction Networks
papers.abstract: Competitive protein dimerization networks offer an alternative to transcriptional genetic circuits by enabling fast molecular decision-making through direct protein-protein interactions. Implementing these networks currently requires challenging de novo protein design. In this work, we circumvent this limitation by repurposing natural, experimentally pre-characterized basic leucine zipper (bZIP) transcription factor networks. By keeping natural binding affinities and modulating only component monomer concentrations via a customized genetic algorithm, we comprehensively evaluate the computational versatility and robustness of these natural substrates. We identified 135 individual networks capable of implementing Boolean logic, with the most versatile natural clusters computing up to 15 of the 16 possible two-input logic gates, including the non-linearly separable XOR and XNOR. Computational versatility increased with network size and connectivity, and robustness analysis revealed that many optimized networks preserved reliable logical behavior despite substantial stochastic expression noise. These results demonstrate that natural bZIP networks possess substantial latent computational capacity and can perform reliable biochemical computation through concentration tuning alone, providing a realistic foundation for developing scalable protein-based biocomputing platforms for future synthetic biology applications.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文没设计新蛋白，而是直接用自然界已知的bZIP转录因子二聚化网络，只通过调节各单体浓度（不改序列），就让135个天然网络实现了包括XOR在内的全部16种两输入逻辑门，证明天然蛋白互作网络本身就有可挖掘的、抗噪声的生化计算能力。
analysis.claim: 天然bZIP蛋白二聚化网络仅通过浓度调控即可实现鲁棒、多样化的布尔逻辑计算，无需任何蛋白质工程改造。
analysis.input: 各bZIP单体的相对浓度配置
analysis.output: 布尔逻辑门真值表（如XOR/XNOR等输出行为）
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统性证明天然蛋白互作网络具备未被开发的、浓度可调的通用逻辑计算能力，实证扎实（135个网络+XOR/XNOR+噪声鲁棒性），但属原理验证级，未构建可编程硬件、未接入细胞环境、未做湿实验闭环验证，离AlphaFold级范式突破或dtSFM级实用模型仍有量级差距。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：不是概念包装，而是用严谨计算筛选+理论分析，挖出了天然蛋白网络中真实存在的、可工程利用的‘生化CPU’潜质，但尚未做成可用工具链。

papers.title: TransGraspNet: Physically and Geometrically Consistent Manipulation of Transparent Labware
papers.abstract: Manipulating transparent laboratory glassware that contains liquid is inherently safety-critical: even small geometric errors can cause unstable grasps and hazardous spillage. Although recent progress has been made in transparent object perception and robotic grasping, most existing systems optimize detection, depth reconstruction, and grasp planning independently, which leads to cross-stage inconsistency imperfect boundaries induce depth bleeding, distorted surfaces corrupt normal estimation, and task agnostic grasp scoring yields tilted or off-center grasps that fail under dynamic motion. In this paper, we propose TransGraspNet, a geometry physics consistent framework that explicitly enforces consistency from perception to execution through three coupled principles: boundary consistency to produce structurally reliable object contours as downstream priors, surface consistency to preserve geometric fidelity and surface normal accuracy during depth reconstruction, and physics consistency to refine grasp selection with centroid alignment and wrench-space stability for upright and dynamically robust manipulation. We evaluate TransGraspNet on public benchmarks, a dedicated transparent glassware dataset, and a real robotic platform. The results show improved boundary quality and surface normal fidelity, and demonstrate strong task-level performance in cluttered transparent scenes. Most importantly, the proposed system achieves reliable real-world operation, including high grasp success rates in clutter and zero spillage during high speed liquid transport, highlighting the effectiveness of our method.

analysis.tldr: 提出TransGraspNet框架，通过边界一致性、表面一致性、物理一致性三重耦合约束，解决透明玻璃器皿（含液体）抓取中因感知误差导致的几何失真与动力学不稳问题，在真实机器人上实现零泼洒的高速液体运输。
analysis.claim: 跨感知-重建-规划全链路施加几何与物理一致性约束，是实现透明液态器皿安全、鲁棒抓取与操作的必要条件。
analysis.input: RGB图像（含透明玻璃器皿与液体）
analysis.output: 稳定、竖直、抗扰动的6D抓取位姿（含力矩空间稳定性验证）
analysis.robot_dependency: 真实机械臂平台（未指明型号，仅称‘real robotic platform’）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖自建透明玻璃器皿数据集；真实机器人数据仅用于最终部署验证，未说明是否用于训练或微调
analysis.significance_reason: 在透明物体操作这一长期棘手子问题上做出扎实推进：提出可解释的三重一致性建模范式，实测达成零泼洒和高成功率，但仅限单一任务（玻璃器皿抓取/运液）、未跨机体/跨用户验证，无开源代码模型，未与T-Rex/ALOHA等基石方法横向对比，也未证明其一致性机制可泛化至其他接触-流体耦合场景。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——解决了透明液态器皿操作中感知-动作断裂的关键工程瓶颈，但仍是窄域、单平台、闭源的高质量增量，尚未达到开范式或跨任务部署级分量

papers.title: ChainVLA: Chaining Vision-Language-Action Queries through a Unified Execution State for Long-Horizon Manipulation
papers.abstract: Humans perform long-horizon manipulation by retaining knowledge of what earlier actions have established while continuously adapting the motion underway. By contrast, action-chunked vision-language-action (VLA) policies repeatedly replan from the current input at each query. Existing methods preserve either long-term task evidence through memory or short-term motion through action reuse and ensembling, leaving the cross-query handoff incomplete. We introduce ChainVLA, a 1.2B-parameter VLA policy that chains successive queries through a joint and revisable execution state. Progress Context combines a recurrent Working State with sparse event memory to carry observation-derived task progress, while Motion Tail feeds the preceding prediction's unexecuted continuation into state construction and action generation. Together, the two components condition a decoder that regenerates each action horizon under the latest observation, allowing the carried state to guide the next prediction without fixing it. ChainVLA reaches 62.8% average success on RMBench and 98.8% across four LIBERO suites, while removing Motion Tail or Progress Context reduces RMBench success to 11.2% and 3.0%, respectively. These asymmetric ablations are consistent with motion continuity helping preserve the observation stream from which task progress is inferred.

analysis.tldr: 提出ChainVLA模型，通过维护一个可更新的联合执行状态（含递归工作状态+稀疏事件记忆+前序动作未执行部分），让视觉-语言-动作策略能在长程操作中跨查询链式传递任务进展和运动连续性，显著提升RMBench和LIBERO上的成功率。
analysis.claim: 通过解耦并协同建模任务进展（Progress Context）与运动连续性（Motion Tail）的联合执行状态，VLA策略可在长时域操作中实现跨查询的、可修订的状态链式传递，而非每次重规划。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令
analysis.output: 动作序列（动作块）
analysis.data_dependency: 未说明是否依赖真实机器人数据，摘要仅提RMBench/LIBERO（均为仿真benchmark），无real-robot实验
analysis.significance_reason: 技术思路有启发性（状态链式传递 vs 重规划），消融显示两模块均关键，但仅在仿真benchmark上验证，无真实机器人实验，无开源证据，未跨机体/任务/用户泛化，相比RT-2/π0/OpenVLA等基石工作缺乏多 embodiment、real-robot、大规模数据支撑或范式级影响，属扎实但窄幅的算法改进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在仿真VLA长程操作中做了有实证支持的状态机制设计，但缺真实硬件验证、开源和泛化证据，尚未达到领域基石水准。

papers.title: MAXWELL: Calibrating the probabilistic outputs of protein language models to the mutation-induced stability change landscape
papers.abstract: Designing mutations that enhance protein stability is a central goal in protein engineering. However, experimentally screening large numbers of candidate mutations is costly and time-consuming, creating a strong need for computational methods that can identify potentially stabilizing mutations. Among these approaches, protein language models are particularly promising because they learn context-dependent amino acid preferences from large-scale sequence and structure datasets. Nevertheless, most existing stability prediction methods use these models primarily as feature extractors and do not fully exploit the amino acid probability distributions they encode. Here, we introduce MAXWELL (Matrix-wise Landscape Learning), a novel post-training method that calibrates the probabilistic outputs learned by protein language models during pretraining to generate mutational landscapes that quantify the effects of individual amino acid substitutions on protein stability. When applied to ProteinMPNN, MAXWELL yields a state-of-the-art predictor of the effects of protein mutations on stability, outperforming ThermoMPNN and other representative methods on a curated benchmark of experimentally measured stability changes. We next applied MAXWELL to the design of ten single-point mutations in the DhaA dehalogenase, seven of which (70%) increased thermal stability. Among them, G171W showed the largest improvement, with a measured ΔT𝑚 of 4.91 ℃. These experimental results establish MAXWELL as a novel post-training strategy for protein language models and a practical framework for designing stabilizing mutations.

analysis.tldr: 提出MAXWELL方法，对已训练好的蛋白语言模型（如ProteinMPNN）的氨基酸替换概率输出进行后训练校准，生成突变稳定性变化图谱，用该图谱预测单点突变对蛋白热稳定性的定量影响，并在DhaA酶上实验验证了7/10个设计突变确实提升了稳定性。
analysis.claim: 蛋白语言模型预训练中隐含的氨基酸替换概率可通过后训练校准，直接映射为突变诱导的稳定性变化（ΔTm）量化预测，无需重新训练或引入额外结构特征。
analysis.input: 野生型蛋白序列 + 指定突变位点及替换氨基酸
analysis.output: 突变导致的热稳定性变化ΔTm（摄氏度）预测值
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据，仅依赖公开蛋白序列、结构及实验ΔTm数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 方法有明确创新（首次将PLM原始token概率经矩阵式校准直接映射到ΔTm），实证扎实（跨模型应用、多方法对比、10个湿实验验证7个有效），但未开源代码/模型、未构建新大规模数据集、未拓展至多点突变或功能优化，属显著但非范式级贡献，明显低于ESM-2/AlphaFold2等基石工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真突破尚不足，但工程整合扎实——首次打通PLM原生概率与实验可测稳定性指标的定量映射，且湿实验验证率高，是当前蛋白设计中少有的‘预测→实验’闭环成功案例。

papers.title: Synthetic Data Generation and Vision-based Wrinkle and Keypoint Detection for Bimanual Cloth Manipulation
papers.abstract: Robotic manipulation of textiles remains challenging because continuous deformation and self-occlusions hinder the robust visual perception required to estimate the cloth's state. To address the lack of annotated real-world data, we developed a Blender-based synthetic pipeline exporting auto-annotated keypoints, and combined manually labeled renders with real-world data to train a wrinkle detector. We present a perception framework integrating a CNN for permutation-invariant keypoint detection and a YOLOv8-OpenCV pipeline to extract grasping points from structural wrinkles. A proposed bimanual algorithm uses this system to stretch fully folded garments via wrinkles, transitioning to keypoint-based ironing once corners emerge. The keypoint model achieves a Mean Position Error (MPE) of 1.7615 pixels. The perception system transfers to physical fabrics without fine-tuning, outperforming baselines that fail in high-occlusion states or yield false positives on severe folds.

analysis.tldr: 用Blender生成带自动标注关键点的布料合成图像，结合少量真实数据训练出能同时检测皱纹和关键点的视觉模型，并在不微调的情况下直接迁移到真实布料上，支撑双手机器人完成从拉展折叠衣物到基于关键点熨烫的全流程操作。
analysis.claim: 仅依赖合成数据+极少量真实标注即可构建跨域鲁棒的布料状态感知系统，支撑无需在线微调的sim2real双手机器人布料操作闭环。
analysis.input: RGB图像（合成渲染图或真实布料照片）
analysis.output: 布料皱纹区域掩码 + 关键点坐标（如角点、褶皱顶点） + 抓取点位置
analysis.data_dependency: 极低：仅需少量手动标注的合成渲染图+零真实标注关键点（MPE评估用真实图像但未说明是否用于训练）
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了布料操作中长期存在的视觉感知瓶颈（自遮挡/大形变），实证显示模型零微调迁移至真实布料并支持多阶段任务（拉展→熨烫），但未披露机器人本体细节、未开源代码/模型、无消融实验、未与主流基线（如ClothSim, DexCloth）定量对比，属扎实且具工程落地价值的显著贡献，但未达基石级范式突破或大规模通用性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真推进了布料视觉感知的sim2real鲁棒性，但因缺乏开源、消融和跨平台验证，属于高质量工程整合而非范式突破。

papers.title: Efficient-WAM: A 1B-Parameter World-Action Model with Low-Cost Future Imagination
papers.abstract: World-Action Models (WAMs) have emerged as a promising paradigm for embodied control by coupling future visual prediction with action generation. However, most existing WAMs rely on photorealistic future prediction, which incurs high inference latency and makes real-time robot deployment difficult. This motivates a more efficient WAM design that preserves the control benefits of future visual prediction while reducing its inference cost. We introduce Efficient-WAM, a World-Action Model that reduces the cost of future imagination while preserving its control benefit. Efficient-WAM improves inference efficiency via a compact video expert transferred from WAN-2.2-5B, token-sparse video latents, and asymmetric video-action denoising that allocates fewer sampling steps to video than to actions. Instead of optimizing the future branch for visual fidelity, Efficient-WAM treats future video prediction as a compact guidance signal for action generation. Comprehensive experiments on RoboTwin 2.0 and real-world manipulation tasks show that Efficient-WAM maintains strong action performance despite visibly coarse future predictions. While maintaining competitive control capabilities, our 1B-parameter model can reduce per-chunk latency to around 100 ms during physical deployment, achieving a 30x speedup over existing WAMs.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个10亿参数的轻量级世界-动作模型Efficient-WAM，放弃高保真未来视频预测，转而用粗糙但紧凑的视频潜码作为动作生成的辅助信号，在保持机器人操控性能的同时将单chunk推理延迟压到100ms，比现有WAM快30倍。
analysis.claim: 未来视觉预测无需高保真即可有效支撑动作生成，通过结构压缩与计算分配优化（视频少步去噪+动作多步去噪+稀疏潜码），可在显著降低延迟的前提下维持控制性能。
analysis.input: 当前观测图像序列+语言指令
analysis.output: 动作序列（关节扭矩或末端位姿）
analysis.robot_dependency: RoboTwin 2.0仿真器 + 真实机械臂（未指明型号，但明确提及physical deployment）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真预训练数据，真实机器人仅用于最终验证（未说明是否用真实数据微调）
analysis.significance_reason: 在WAM范式内做了务实的工程减负：放弃视觉保真、重定向未来预测为动作引导信号，并验证了其在仿真和少量真实任务上的可用性；但未引入新学习范式、未解决WAM根本性问题（如长程因果建模、跨任务泛化）、无开源、无消融分析关键设计贡献、真实部署仅展示延迟指标而非多任务鲁棒性，属扎实但窄口径的效率优化。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把WAM从‘画得像’转向‘够用就行’，在延迟敏感场景有实用价值，但未改变范式或拓展能力边界。

papers.title: Benchmarking Action Spaces in Reinforcement Learning for Vision-based Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: In real-world reinforcement learning (RL), the choice of action space can play a key role in shaping motion smoothness, safety, and overall task performance. In this study, we evaluate pose increment, pose velocity, joint position increment, and joint velocity across two vision-based manipulation tasks: object picking and pushing. We train policies in simulation and deploy them to the real world using sim-to-real transfer. We find that action-space representation indeed significantly affects sim-to-real performance. In particular, we find that the joint velocity action space is best for the vision-based picking and pushing tasks in terms of smoothness and final task performance. We also provide practical guidance for RL practitioners in choosing action spaces for both simulation and real-world experiments.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统对比了四种动作空间（位姿增量、位姿速度、关节位置增量、关节速度）在视觉驱动的机器人抓取和推动任务中的仿真到真实世界迁移效果，发现关节速度动作空间表现最好，并给出工程选型建议。
analysis.claim: 在视觉驱动的仿真到真实机器人操作任务中，动作空间的选择对sim2real性能有显著影响，其中关节速度动作空间在平滑性和任务成功率上最优。
analysis.input: RGB-D图像+任务指令（如'pick object'）
analysis.output: 关节速度控制指令
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人微调数据（摘要仅提deploy，未说明是否需真实数据微调；但sim2real transfer隐含需真实校准，故为轻度依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实增量工作：首次在统一视觉-RL操纵框架下横向评测主流动作空间，有真实部署验证和跨任务比较，但无新模型/新架构/新数据集/新传感器，也未解决长期开放难题（如触觉缺失、长程规划、泛化到未知物体），远低于T-Rex/ALOHA/π0等基石工作（94+）的技术深度与系统影响力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量——做了必要但局部的工程对照实验，有实证支撑，但未提出新范式、新能力或新基准，属于RL for robotics领域的实用指南类论文，非突破性贡献。

papers.title: Assessing Corynebacterium glutamicum as a surrogate of Mycobacterium tuberculosis for DNA gyrase inhibitor design
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT DNA gyrase is an essential bacterial enzyme and a clinically validated target for the treatment of tuberculosis. However, the discovery of new inhibitors remains limited by the many challenges regarding the manipulation on pathogenic mycobacteria. This study validates Corynebacterium glutamicum ( Cglu ) as a safe, non-pathogenic surrogate for Mycobacterium tuberculosis ( Mtb ) to investigate DNA gyrase and facilitate the identification of new inhibitors. Using Cglu as a target allows for fast whole-cell screening under safe conditions while ensuring efficient drug uptake. Cglu shares key physiological features with Mtb , including genome size, complex cell wall structure, and a single type I and type II topoisomerase. Structural and functional comparisons emphasize the similarity of Cglu and Mtb gyrases, which share 70% sequence identity and show comparable catalytic properties and responsiveness to known inhibitors. Thus, the cryo-EM structure of the Cglu gyrase-DNA complex at 3.2 Å resolution reveals highly conserved drug-binding pockets for known anti-gyrase inhibitors and the genetic depletion of gyrA or gyrB in Cglu causes severe growth and morphological defects, mirroring the effects of chemical inhibition and allowing to link gyrase function to cellular phenotypes. Comparative imaging of different inhibitor classes (fluoroquinolones, aminocoumarins, NBTIs) uncovers distinct morphological signatures that reflect each compound’s mode of action. Finally, cross-species complementation confirms functional conservation but also highlights subtle structural differences affecting efficiency. Together, these findings establish Cglu as a robust and biosafe model for dissecting gyrase function, visualizing DNA topology dynamics, and accelerating the discovery of gyrase-targeting antimicrobials. More generally, our studies demonstrate the feasibility of using Cglu as a cell-based screening platform to discover new anti-tuberculous compounds targeting conserved mechanisms, not only for validated TB drug targets such as DNA gyrase but also for new, yet to be identified, targets.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统验证了谷氨酸棒杆菌（C. glutamicum）可作为结核分枝杆菌（M. tuberculosis）DNA旋转酶抑制剂筛选的安全替代模型，通过结构、功能、遗传、表型和成像多维度实证其保守性与适用性。
analysis.claim: 谷氨酸棒杆菌（Cglu）是结核分枝杆菌（Mtb）DNA旋转酶靶向药物发现中一个经多层实证验证的、生物安全且功能等效的全细胞筛选替代模型。
analysis.input: 多种已知DNA旋转酶抑制剂（氟喹诺酮类、氨基香豆素类、NBTIs）
analysis.output: 细菌生长表型、形态学特征、gyrA/gyrB基因敲降表型、冷冻电镜结构、跨物种互补效率
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实的转化微生物药理学工作：提供首个经冷冻电镜结构+遗传敲降+多类抑制剂表型成像+跨物种互补四重验证的Mtb旋转酶替代模型，显著降低高危病原体筛选门槛；但未提出新算法/新靶点/新化学空间，也未构建开源代码或大规模新数据集，影响力限于结核药物发现子领域，远未达AlphaFold2/ESM/RFdiffusion等基础模型级分量。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——不是概念包装，而是用严谨实验闭环验证了一个关键替代模型，能实质性加速抗结核药物筛选，但属于领域内重要工具建设，非范式突破。

papers.title: Decentralized Pose Graph Riemannian Optimization for Object-based Multi-Robot SLAM
papers.abstract: Pose graph optimization (PGO) is a key back-end component for state estimation in networked multi-robot simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM). In object-based multi-robot SLAM, the problem becomes more tightly coupled because robots must jointly estimate both their trajectories and the poses of persistent objects observed by multiple agents. Existing decentralized solutions often assume that the communication graph closely matches the physical interaction topology, which is restrictive in realistic deployments where communication is sparse, intermittent, or time-varying. This paper presents a fully decentralized Riemannian optimization framework for object-based multi-robot PGO that decouples the coupled estimation problem via a consensus mechanism, enabling flexible communication topologies. To improve convergence under limited communication budgets, we further develop a distributed approximate-Newton scheme that exploits local second-order information while operating directly on the SE(d) manifold to preserve geometric consistency, and we establish the convergence to Riemannian first-order stationary points and provide a local condition-number analysis explaining the benefit of approximate second-order information over first-order Riemannian descent. The resulting method reduces iteration count and communication overhead without sacrificing estimation accuracy. Extensive evaluations on public benchmarks, large-scale simulations, and real-world multi-robot experiments demonstrate improved accuracy, runtime efficiency, scalability across network topologies, and robustness to communication failures.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种完全去中心化的黎曼流形优化方法，解决多机器人在物体级SLAM中联合估计自身位姿和物体位姿时的强耦合问题，支持稀疏/间歇/时变通信拓扑，无需依赖中心节点或固定通信结构。
analysis.claim: 在SE(d)黎曼流形上设计分布式近似牛顿法，通过共识机制解耦多机器人-物体联合位姿图优化问题，可在任意通信拓扑下收敛到黎曼一阶驻点，且比一阶方法显著减少迭代次数和通信开销。
analysis.input: 相对位姿测量（机器人间、机器人与物体间）、通信图拓扑
analysis.output: 各机器人轨迹 + 各持久性物体全局位姿（SE(d)群元素）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据（实验含真实多机，但方法本身不强制依赖）
analysis.significance_reason: 理论扎实（黎曼流形上的分布式近似牛顿收敛性证明+条件数分析），实证覆盖仿真、公开基准、真实多机系统，验证了通信鲁棒性与扩展性；但未开辟新范式（仍是PGO框架内改进），也未解决长期开放难题（如语义-几何联合建模、跨域泛化），分量介于扎实增量与显著贡献之间。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：在多机器人SLAM的去中心化优化方向上提供了首个兼具理论保证、实际鲁棒性和多平台验证的黎曼二阶分布式方案，但未触及具身智能核心瓶颈（如感知-动作闭环、任务级泛化）。

papers.title: Dual-Process Atomic Skill Learning: Decoupling Semantic Reasoning and Real-Time Control
papers.abstract: Language-conditioned Imitation Learning (IL) is essential for enabling robots to perform complex tasks following natural language instructions. However, generalizing to multi-step compositional tasks remains a significant challenge. While hierarchical approaches attempt to address this by decomposing tasks into atomic skills, existing methods often suffer from training instability and codebook collapse due to the tight coupling between high-level skill reasoning and low-level action generation in joint training paradigms. Inspired by the Dual-Process Theory of cognition, we propose Dual-Process Atomic Skill Learning (DASL), a novel asynchronous hierarchical imitation learning framework that decouples slow semantic reasoning from fast, real-time motion control. DASL comprises a Slow-Frequency Policy that predicts interpretable, discrete skills via Vector Quantization, and a High-Frequency Policy that leverages a latent diffusion model and a Decision Transformer to generate precise actions conditioned on these latent skills. By asynchronously coordinating these modules and utilizing diffusion to structure the latent space, our framework mitigates the skill codebook interference problem common in joint training paradigms. Evaluations across simulation benchmarks and experiment demonstrate that DASL significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, excelling in skill acquisition and compositional generalization to unseen instructions. GitHub page: https://github.com/Hatakekaka/DASL

analysis.tldr: 提出一种将语义推理（慢速）和动作控制（快速）解耦的双进程模仿学习框架DASL，用向量量化生成可解释原子技能，再用潜变量扩散模型+决策Transformer生成动作，解决多步组合任务泛化差和技能码本坍塌问题。
analysis.claim: 通过认知双进程启发的异步分层架构，解耦语义技能推理与实时动作生成，可显著提升语言条件下的原子技能学习稳定性与跨指令组合泛化能力。
analysis.input: 自然语言指令 + 视觉观测（RGB/RGB-D）
analysis.output: 原子技能标签 + 对应的连续动作序列
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真机器人（未明确型号，但实验含sim+exp，推测为Franka/Panda类双臂或单臂平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真与少量真实机器人演示数据（摘要称‘experiment’但未说明规模与多样性）
analysis.significance_reason: 方法设计有认知启发性，解耦思路合理，实证在仿真基准和少量真实实验上优于SOTA，但缺乏多机体验证、无消融证明扩散+DT联合贡献、真实数据量与任务复杂度远低于ALOHA/ACT等基石工作（如未覆盖长时序、双手协同、触觉闭环），属扎实增量而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：双进程解耦设计有效缓解码本坍塌，但实证深度与广度不足，未触及具身智能核心瓶颈（如长程依赖、跨机体泛化、真实世界鲁棒性），暂未达到基石级分量。

papers.title: Intercepting the Future: Latent-Space Predictive World Model for Dynamic VLA Manipulation
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models generalize across static manipulation but fail when objects move during task execution. They map the current observation to an action and assume the scene is stationary between observation and execution, so at any non-trivial object speed the resulting latency exceeds the time available to grasp. We close this gap with AHEAD (Anticipatory Horizon Extrapolation with Adaptive Dynamics), a predict-then-act wrapper that augments a frozen VLA with a motion-aware latent world model. A small world model trained on manipulation video forecasts future patch tokens in the VLA's feature space, conditioned on per-token velocity and acceleration from optical flow. A language-and-motion saliency mask concentrates prediction on task-relevant patches, and the model rolls forward for an adaptive horizon, halting when prediction uncertainty crosses a threshold. The frozen action decoder then receives the predicted future tokens in place of the current ones. AHEAD adds 4.9M parameters to a frozen 7B OpenVLA and reaches 79 to 97% success across 20 dynamic simulation scenarios where the strongest baseline reaches 31 to 58%. On a physical UFactory xArm 7, AHEAD succeeds on 29/30 to 30/30 on three conveyor and rolling-ball tasks, 23/30 on paddle interception, and 19/30 on projectile catching where every baseline scores 0/30.

analysis.tldr: 给静态VLA模型加了一个轻量级的未来状态预测模块，让它能预判移动物体的位置，从而在真实动态场景中（如接球、拦截滚动小球）成功执行操作，而原有VLA模型在这些任务上完全失败。
analysis.claim: 通过在冻结VLA模型前插入一个运动感知的潜空间世界模型，可显著提升其在动态视觉-语言-动作任务中的实时操作成功率，且无需微调原始VLA。
analysis.input: RGB视频帧+语言指令+光学流估计的每token速度与加速度
analysis.output: 未来时刻的潜空间patch token（供冻结VLA解码器使用）
analysis.robot_dependency: UFactory xArm 7 + PyBullet/Gazebo仿真器（摘要未明说但'20 dynamic simulation scenarios'和xArm实机对应典型仿真+真机验证链）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真生成的带运动标注的视频数据训练世界模型；未使用真实机器人交互数据（仅用仿真视频预训练，实机零微调）
analysis.significance_reason: 实质性推进了VLA向动态环境落地的关键瓶颈（动作延迟与场景变化不匹配），在多任务真机上取得压倒性优势（尤其0→19/30的projectile catching），但世界模型本身是轻量级token-level预测而非端到端动力学建模，未达DreamerV3等基石级通用世界模型的抽象深度与泛化广度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次在冻结大VLA前提下，以极小开销（4.9M）系统性解决动态操作中的时序错配问题，并在多个真机动态任务上实现从0到显著成功率的跨越。

papers.title: FreeForm: Reduced-Order Deformable Simulation from Particle-Based Skinning Eigenmodes
papers.abstract: We present a novel formulation for mesh-free, reduced-order simulation of deformable hyperelastic objects. Existing work in reduced-order elastodynamic simulation represents the input geometry by either meshes, which can be difficult to obtain due to challenges in scanning and triangulating complex shapes, or by neural fields that require per-shape optimization. We propose to adopt a Reproducing Kernel Particle Method (RKPM) representation, which enables the construction of reduced-order skinning weights by solving a generalized eigensystem on the Hessian matrix of the elastic energy. We demonstrate that this formulation not only leads to a 40x training speedup compared with the per-shape optimization of neural fields, but also achieves lower simulation error when evaluated against the converged results of finite element method. We show our simulation results on a wide variety of objects in different representations including meshes and Gaussian splats, as well as the application of our method in the downstream task of robot simulation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种叫FreeForm的新方法，用无网格的粒子法（RKPM）加弹性能量Hessian矩阵的特征模态来建模软体物体形变，不用依赖三角网格或逐物体训练的神经场，更快更准地做降阶仿真，并用在机器人仿真下游任务中。
analysis.claim: 基于RKPM粒子表示和弹性能量Hessian特征模态的皮肤权重构造，可实现免网格、免逐形优化、高精度、高速度的降阶软体仿真。
analysis.input: 粒子分布（RKPM表示）+弹性材料参数+外力
analysis.output: 形变轨迹（节点/粒子位移序列）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅需材料参数与几何表示（如点云、高斯溅射、网格）
analysis.significance_reason: 属计算力学/仿真底层方法改进，对具身智能中软体交互有潜在价值，但未在真实机器人上验证、未接入感知-决策闭环、未展示跨物体泛化能力，也未与主流机器人仿真框架（如Isaac Gym、Mujoco、SAPIEN）深度集成；相比RT-2等里程碑工作，它解决的是子模块精度与效率问题，而非具身智能核心挑战（如语言驱动动作生成、跨任务策略泛化、真实世界部署），属于扎实的仿真技术增量，但离‘具身智能领域显著推进’尚远。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把RKPM+Hessian模态用于降阶软体仿真，在数值效率和精度上有实证提升，但未进入真实机器人闭环，也未证明对高层具身任务的实际增益，属于高质量仿真工具层改进。

papers.title: The Neurodynamic Core of Meditation: Dissociating Meditation from Rest and Task in a Reliability-based EEG study
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Electroencephalographic (EEG) studies attempting to characterise the neural signature of meditation typically rely on contrasts with passive rest or comparisons among practitioners based on experience. However, these approaches rarely include active control states and seldom establish the reliability and robustness of identified quantitative EEG features. Consequently, the validity of proposed neurophysiological markers of meditative state remains uncertain. The present study addressed these limitations by using a reliability-informed, multi-session within-subject design to characterise distinct state-dependent EEG dynamics in experienced meditators from the Brahmakumaris Rajayoga tradition. Methods Thirty long-term meditators underwent repeated EEG recordings over two days, comprising two meditation sessions per day. Each meditation block was flanked by rest periods, with a cognitive task between sessions to reduce carryover effects. We quantified broadband spectral power, aperiodic slope and intercept, and nonlinear dynamical measures, including detrended fluctuation analysis (DFA), Higuchi fractal dimension, and permutation entropy (PE), across meditation, rest, and task conditions. Results Compared with both rest and task states, meditation was associated with increased theta–alpha power, an elevated aperiodic intercept, and systematic modulation of nonlinear indices (DFA, Higuchi, PE). Further meditative core features demonstrated high inter-session test-retest reliability, strong inter-individual consistency, stability across guided and silent meditation states, and were not moderated by years of meditative experience. Conclusion The present framework identifies a reproducible neurodynamic core of meditation, distinct from passive and active control states, spanning spectral, aperiodic, and nonlinear EEG domains in long-term meditators. These findings enhance the construct validity and measurement reliability of meditation-specific neural markers.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用高重复性的多日EEG实验，对比冥想、静息和认知任务三种状态，发现长期冥想者在theta-alpha频段功率、非周期性基线（aperiodic intercept）和多种非线性动力学指标（DFA、Higuchi维数、排列熵）上存在稳定可复现的差异特征，且这些特征不随冥想年限变化，也不受引导/默练形式影响。
analysis.org: 印度国家心理健康研究所（NIMHANS）
analysis.claim: 冥想存在一个跨状态、跨个体、跨会话高度可靠的神经动力学核心特征集，该核心在频谱、非周期性和非线性动力学三个EEG维度上同时体现，且独立于经验年限与指导形式。
analysis.input: 高密度EEG时序信号（含静息、冥想、认知任务三类状态）
analysis.output: 量化神经动力学指标（theta-alpha功率、aperiodic intercept、DFA指数、Higuchi维数、排列熵）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖真实人类被试EEG数据（30名长期冥想者，2天×4 sessions，共240+ EEG blocks）
analysis.significance_reason: 属认知神经科学/冥想神经机制领域的扎实方法学验证工作：首次系统整合频谱+aperiodic+非线性三类EEG指标并验证其跨会话可靠性，但未提出新模型、未开源代码/数据、未拓展到临床或BCI应用、被试高度特异（单一冥想流派）、无对照组（如初学者或非冥想者），对具身智能/机器人领域零相关性；分量远低于所有参照基石（全部为BCI-运动/语言解码或闭环神经接口突破）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 暂时不用看——这是认知神经科学中关于冥想EEG标记物可靠性的专业验证研究，与具身智能、机器人控制、感知-动作闭环等方向无实质交集，不属于本领域需跟踪的工作。

papers.title: CT-VAM: A Cerebello-Thalamic-Inspired Vision-Action Model for Efficient Visuomotor Control
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action models have shown strong promise for robot manipulation, yet raw language is primarily needed to specify task intent rather than to be repeatedly processed during high-frequency low-level execution. Motivated by this separation, we propose a cerebello-thalamic-inspired vision-action model (CT-VAM) for efficient task-conditioned visuomotor control. CT-VAM acts as a compact local execution policy that predicts action chunks from dualview visual observations, proprioception, and a lightweight task condition, potentially enabling a practical cloud-edge paradigm in which high-level semantic reasoning can be handled by large models while fast closed-loop control runs on local hardware. To fuse heterogeneous inputs effectively, CT-VAM introduces TARS (Thalamic Action Routing Stream), a stream-separated conditional attention decoder that independently routes action, visual and task streams, preventing dense sensory tokens from overwhelming compact task-relevant conditions. With only 68M parameters, CT-VAM achieves LIBERO success rates competitive with substantially larger VLA models, while reducing inference latency. Together with flow-consistent inpainting for asynchronous chunk execution, CT-VAM supports high-frequency control and demonstrates robust realworld deployment on resource-constrained robotic platforms.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个受小脑-丘脑结构启发的轻量级视觉-动作模型CT-VAM，用双视角图像、本体感觉和轻量任务条件输入，直接输出动作块，实现低延迟闭环控制，主打在资源受限机器人上部署。
analysis.claim: 受小脑-丘脑神经环路启发的轻量级视觉-动作模型CT-VAM，能在不依赖高频语言指令的情况下，仅凭紧凑任务条件+多模态感知输入，高效生成动作块并实现实时真机部署。
analysis.input: 双视角RGB图像+本体感觉信号+轻量任务条件（非自然语言）
analysis.output: 动作块（action chunks）
analysis.robot_dependency: 未明确说明具体机器人平台，仅称‘resource-constrained robotic platforms’，填 none
analysis.data_dependency: 未报告是否使用真实机器人数据训练或微调；摘要仅提‘robust real-world deployment’但无数据来源描述，推断为仿真主导+少量真实验证，填 medium
analysis.significance_reason: 模型结构有神经科学启发性，参数量小、延迟低、宣称真机部署，但缺乏关键实证：未公开代码/数据/训练细节；未报告具体机器人型号、任务集规模、baseline对比的完整设置（如LIBERO子集/指标定义）；未提供消融实验验证TARS模块有效性；‘competitive with larger VLA models’无定量表格支撑；整体属于扎实工程优化，但未突破VLA范式瓶颈（如泛化性、开放世界适应、跨机体迁移），远未达RT-2/Octo/π0级分量。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在VLA框架下做了轻量化与执行层优化，有实用价值，但缺乏开源、可复现性和系统性实证，不属于范式突破或SOTA推进。

papers.title: PEBRE: An Open-Hardware Compute and Perception Add-On for the Pepper Robot
papers.abstract: This paper presents the design, development, and experimental verification of PEBRE, an open-hardware add-on for fast software development on the Pepper Robot. Our project enhances Pepper's computational and perception capabilities by integrating external components such as a Jetson Orin Nano, Logitech BRIO, Intel RealSense D435i, Samson UB1, and RØDE VideoMicro II. Our results show that the new hardware considerably improved Pepper's perception abilities and computational power. This development contributes to the community by implementing an open hardware and open-source modular add-on to the Pepper robot and keeping this relevant research platform functional beyond its expected lifespan. With PEBRE, we aim to facilitate faster software development and more efficient integration of external components, ultimately enhancing the capabilities of the Pepper robot.

analysis.tldr: 给已停产的Pepper机器人加装一套开源硬件扩展板（含Jetson Orin Nano、双摄像头、麦克风阵列等），提升其算力和感知能力，让老平台能继续跑现代AI算法。
analysis.claim: 通过开源硬件扩展模块PEBRE，可显著提升Pepper机器人的实时感知与计算能力，并延长其作为科研平台的可用寿命。
analysis.input: RGB-D图像、音频流
analysis.output: 本地化感知特征（如视觉目标检测、语音活动检测）及供上层软件调用的API接口
analysis.data_dependency: 未使用真实机器人交互数据训练模型，仅做功能验证与性能对比（如帧率、延迟）
analysis.significance_reason: 属典型工程适配项目：无新算法、无新任务范式、无跨机体泛化验证；仅针对单一老旧商用机器人（Pepper）做硬件升级，未解决具身智能核心挑战（如闭环控制、长程规划、sim2real迁移），贡献限于延长特定设备生命周期，分量远低于Unitree G1/Atlas/Optimus等里程碑级系统。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——解决了Pepper平台算力瓶颈这一具体痛点，但未推动具身智能基础能力边界，属于有价值的维护性工作而非技术突破。

papers.title: GeneralVLA-2: Geometry-Aware Reconstruction and Governed Memory for Robot Planning
papers.abstract: Generalist vision-language-action systems need object-centric 3D evidence and reusable manipulation experience to plan reliable robot trajectories. GeneralVLA provides a hierarchical interface for converting language and RGB-D observations into 3D end-effector paths, but two bottlenecks remain. First, monocular SAM3D-style object reconstruction can hallucinate pose and unseen geometry, while manipulation benefits from stable object shape when calibrated multi-view observations are available. Second, the original KnowledgeBank mainly retrieves semantically similar snippets and appends new knowledge, which makes it difficult to control memory quality, conflicts, confidence, and geometric relevance. To address the first challenge, we introduce GeoFuse-MV3D, a geometry-prior-guided MV-SAM3D reconstruction branch that verifies external geometry cues with input-view masks, applies soft visual-hull support, performs axis-wise refinement, and fuses only geometry while preserving appearance. To address the second challenge, we upgrade KnowledgeBank into a governed long-term memory system with explicit quality, confidence, lifecycle, verifier, and conflict metadata, together with precision-oriented retrieval. Finally, we evaluate the reconstruction branch on GSO-30 and the memory module on Terminal-Bench 2.0 and SWE-Bench Verified; GeoFuse-MV3D improves over the MV-SAM3D baseline by reducing CD and LPIPS by 2.20% and 2.02% while increasing PSNR and SSIM by 2.36% and 1.03%, and KnowledgeBank improves over ReasoningBank by 4.53% on Terminal-Bench SR and 3.73% on SWE-Bench resolve rate, while reducing AS by 4.95% and 5.65%, respectively. Code: https://github.com/AIGeeksGroup/GeneralVLA-2. Website: https://aigeeksgroup.github.io/GeneralVLA-2.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文改进了通用视觉语言动作（VLA）系统GeneralVLA，主要做了两件事：一是用多视角几何先验引导的3D物体重建模块（GeoFuse-MV3D）提升重建精度；二是把原来的记忆库升级为带质量控制、冲突检测和几何相关性检索的‘受控长期记忆’系统（Governed KnowledgeBank），并在两个新基准上验证了提升。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索，GitHub组织名AIGeeksGroup非知名学术/工业机构）
analysis.claim: 通过几何感知的多视角3D重建与受控元数据驱动的长期记忆机制，可显著提升通用VLA系统在机器人规划中对物体几何表征的可靠性与历史操作知识的可控复用性。
analysis.input: RGB-D图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 3D末端执行器路径（隐含）+ 重构的3D物体几何 + 受控检索的记忆片段
analysis.data_dependency: 未使用真实机器人交互数据，仅依赖合成/静态3D重建数据集（GSO-30）和软件工程基准（Terminal-Bench/SWE-Bench）
analysis.significance_reason: 两项改进均属局部增强：GeoFuse-MV3D是MV-SAM3D的工程化变体（加几何先验、软hull、轴向细化），无新表示或学习范式；KnowledgeBank升级为元数据管控记忆，但仍在文本级检索范畴，未耦合到具身动作闭环，且所有实验均脱离真实机器人任务（用SWE-Bench等纯代码/终端基准替代机器人规划验证），实证与领域核心问题（如sim2real泛化、跨机体部署、实时闭环控制）完全脱钩。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 概念包装——将3D重建优化和记忆元数据管理包装成‘几何感知’与‘受控记忆’两大高概念，但既无真实机器人验证，也未解决VLA领域公认的瓶颈（如跨任务零样本泛化、动作可行性保障、物理一致性），所有指标提升微弱（<5%），且基准非机器人领域标准。

papers.title: Enhancing Protein Representation Learning via Manifold Restore Mixing
papers.abstract: Data augmentation (DA) has been proven to be an effective means for improving protein representation learning (PRL) by generating additional training samples. Although mainstream perturbation- and sampling-based augmentation methods can produce data containing sufficient variations, they carry the risk of disrupting the protein structure and function. Some crafted protein homology modeling tools can generate conformations, but reduce structural diversity. The above dilemmas lead us to a question: Can we restore the disrupted structure caused by DA operations, providing data with both the original structure and diverse variations? In this work, we first analyze and empirically reveal the structure defect and performance degradation issues of existing DA methods. Based on the findings, we propose a simple yet effective DA method, Manifold Restore Mixing (MRM), for protein representation learning. Specifically, inspired by manifold mixup, we mix the hidden representations of original and augmented protein data to generate new samples that restore structural information lost in DA while introducing diverse variations. Furthermore, we develop a sample difficulty scheduler that adjusts the beta distribution in mixup to provide models with progressively challenging mixed samples during training, which improves the final performance. Comprehensive experiments on various PRL backbones and downstream tasks demonstrate the effectiveness and generalization of our method. The complete code and weights will be released upon acceptance. We provide a implementation at https://github.com/KingGugu/MRM.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫MRM的数据增强方法，通过混合原始蛋白和增强后蛋白的隐藏层表示来修复数据增强过程中丢失的结构信息，同时保留多样性，提升蛋白表征学习效果。
analysis.claim: 混合原始与增强蛋白的隐藏表示可修复结构信息损失，比现有数据增强方法更有效地提升蛋白表征学习性能。
analysis.input: 蛋白序列或结构特征（隐式输入于PRL backbone中）
analysis.output: 增强后的蛋白表征向量
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 仅在标准PRL backbone和下游任务上验证了MRM的增益（如二级结构预测、稳定性预测），无跨物种/跨fold/跨突变类型泛化实验，未挑战结构建模核心瓶颈（如原子级精度折叠），也未与ESM-2/AlphaFold类模型耦合或改进其训练范式；属已有manifold mixup思想在蛋白领域的窄口径适配，实证强度弱于ESM系列或RFdiffusion等真正推动结构理解边界的成果。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 概念包装：将manifold mixup迁移到蛋白表征学习，有合理动机但实证单薄，未触及领域核心难题，也未证明对SOTA模型产生实质性提升。

papers.title: Representational similarity analysis of EEG reveals multiple spatiotemporal dynamics of selective attention
papers.abstract: Abstract Selective attention allows listeners to follow a target speaker in complex scenes, but less is known about the neural mechanisms that control this capacity. We collected electroencephalography (EEG) during an auditory attention task encompassing spatial attention, talker-based attention, and passive listening. Time-resolved representational similarity analysis (RSA) of broadband scalp voltage and alpha-band oscillations revealed distinct representational trajectories in the two measurements: scalp voltage produced brief peaks in task discriminability shortly after the target cue and around 300 ms after target onset, whereas alpha-band power emerged more slowly and remained elevated throughout the trial. These patterns distinguish attentive from passive conditions and spatial from talker attention. Furthermore, broadband activity and alpha power encode complementary information, while other frequency bands contribute little independent explanatory power. These results demonstrate that RSA allows a unified interpretation of evoked and induced EEG measures, revealing how distinct neural computations jointly encode the spatiotemporal dynamics of selective attention.

analysis.tldr: 用时间分辨的表征相似性分析（RSA）方法处理EEG数据，发现宽带头皮电压和alpha频段功率在听觉选择性注意任务中呈现互补、动态分离的神经表征模式：前者快速响应线索和目标起始，后者缓慢上升并持续维持，二者共同区分空间注意、说话人注意和被动聆听状态。
analysis.claim: 宽带头皮电压与alpha频段功率编码选择性注意的不同时间维度，二者信息互补且不可相互替代，RSA可统一解析EEG中诱发与诱导成分的协同动力学。
analysis.input: 多条件听觉注意任务下的原始EEG信号（含空间注意/说话人注意/被动聆听）
analysis.output: 时间分辨的表征相似性矩阵（RDM）轨迹、各频段对任务解码的独立贡献度
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖新采集的受控实验室EEG数据（n=24），无外部真实世界部署或跨被试泛化验证
analysis.significance_reason: 方法上将RSA系统应用于多维度听觉注意EEG解析并揭示双通路时序分工，属扎实的机制性发现；但未突破RSA或EEG分析范式本身，无临床接口转化、无实时闭环、无跨被试/跨任务泛化验证，显著弱于所有列出的基石工作（全部涉及实时闭环控制、高维输出解码或临床功能重建）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量——提供了听觉注意神经表征的时间-频段分工新证据，但仍是离线分析型认知神经科学工作，未触及BCI实用化核心瓶颈

papers.title: World Action Models Enable Continual Imitation Learning with Recurrent Generative Replays
papers.abstract: Going beyond predicting robot actions, World Action Models (WAMs) can also generate future visual observations. We build on this generative capability to propose Recurrent Generative Replay (REGEN), a continual imitation learning framework that synthesizes pseudo-replay trajectories, enabling a robot policy to rehearse previously learned tasks without storing their original human demonstrations. During continual adaptation, REGEN recursively queries the WAM to synthesize pseudo-replay trajectories conditioned only on prior task instructions and current-task observations. Experiments in both simulation and real-world manipulation settings show that REGEN reduces catastrophic forgetting by up to $50\%$ relative to sequential fine-tuning, while approaching the performance of privileged experience replay methods that require access to real replay data. Finally, we analyze the factors limiting generated replay, identifying long-horizon visual degradation and action-observation inconsistency as the primary bottlenecks. Our results establish WAMs as a promising foundation for continual robot learning without stored demonstrations.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出REGEN方法，用世界动作模型（WAM）自动生成过去任务的伪演示轨迹，让机器人在持续学习新任务时不用存真实人类示范就能复习旧技能，缓解灾难性遗忘。
analysis.claim: 世界动作模型（WAM）可通过递归生成式重放（REGEN）实现无需存储真实示范的持续模仿学习，并显著缓解灾难性遗忘。
analysis.input: 任务指令 + 当前视觉观测
analysis.output: 生成的伪动作-观测轨迹（含未来视觉帧和对应动作）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真环境（如Ravens、Franka Emika Panda）及真实机械臂（摘要提real-world manipulation）
analysis.data_dependency: 训练WAM需真实机器人演示数据；但REGEN推理阶段不依赖原始演示存储，仅依赖已训练WAM
analysis.significance_reason: 技术路线清晰（WAM+递归生成重放），在仿真和真实机械臂上验证了对灾难性遗忘的实质性缓解（50%相对降低），且对比了privileged replay这一强基线；但未开源代码/模型，未构建新基准或数据集，WAM本身是已有范式（World Models/Dreamer系）的迁移应用，未解决长程生成失真等根本瓶颈，也未达到DreamerV3或WEAVER等基石工作的系统深度与泛化广度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——工程整合：将世界模型的生成能力创造性用于持续模仿学习，实证有效，但受限于生成质量瓶颈和完全不可复现，尚未构成范式突破。

papers.title: Assembly of the essential SpoIVA coat protein at the surface of developing bacterial spores
papers.abstract: Bacterial spores owe their remarkable resistance properties to a multilayered coat, one of the most resilient and durable biological structures on Earth. Assembled at the surface of the outer forespore membrane, the coat comprises dozens of proteins organized into distinct layers. Its formation is initiated by SpoIVA, which is proposed to form a polymeric scaffold for the innermost coat layer. Although SpoIVA has been shown to polymerize into filaments in vitro, there is currently no evidence demonstrating the formation of such assemblies in vivo, and the mechanism underlying its oligomerization remains unresolved. In this study, cryo-focused ion beam milling combined with cryo-electron tomography of sporulating Bacillus subtilis cells reveals that the SpoIVA layer consists of polymers that form track-like structures radiating from the mother cell-proximal forespore pole and extending directionally toward the distal pole. Subtomogram averaging further sheds light on their organized architecture, harboring a straight orientation, uniform spacing, and embedding in the outer forespore membrane. These observations also define SpoIVA spatial orientation relative to the outer forespore membrane. Furthermore, AlphaFold3 predictions, combined with biophysical and functional assays, show that SpoIVA dimerizes through its central and C-terminal regions. We further show that dimerization promotes SpoIVA localization around the forespore but is dispensable for polymer formation, which relies on the ATPase domain. Altogether, these findings suggest a dual oligomerization mechanism, in which SpoIVA transitions from dimers to linear track-like polymers, and reveal that these assemblies play critical roles in coat assembly and spore development.

analysis.tldr: 通过冷冻电镜断层成像和AlphaFold3预测，首次在活体细菌芽孢发育过程中直接观察到SpoIVA蛋白形成定向辐射状的轨道状聚合结构，并阐明其先二聚再线性聚合的双阶寡聚机制及其对芽孢外壳组装的关键作用。
analysis.claim: SpoIVA在活体芽孢发育中以ATP酶依赖方式形成定向轨道状聚合物，其二聚化调控定位但不参与聚合，该双阶寡聚机制驱动芽孢外壳有序组装。
analysis.input: 冷冻聚焦离子束切片后的芽孢发育期Bacillus subtilis细胞样品、AlphaFold3结构预测输入（氨基酸序列）、生物物理实验数据（SEC-MALS、ITC、突变体功能表型）
analysis.output: SpoIVA在体内的三维超微结构（轨道状聚合物形态、膜嵌入取向、间距与方向性）、二聚/聚合界面残基定位、功能必要性验证（ATPase域 vs. 中央/C端二聚域）
analysis.data_dependency: 无机器人数据依赖，全部基于微生物细胞生物学实验与计算结构生物学
analysis.significance_reason: 属结构微生物学重大进展：首次在近生理状态下解析关键发育蛋白的原位聚合构型与机制，证据链完整（cryo-FIB-ET+subtomogram averaging+AlphaFold3+多维度生化验证），但局限于单一蛋白/单一发育过程，未构建通用建模框架或生成式工具，分量不及AlphaFold2/3或ESM系列等范式级模型。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——首次在活体细菌中解析出SpoIVA原位轨道状聚合结构并实证双阶寡聚机制，证据扎实、技术前沿、生物学意义明确，但属特定靶点深度机制研究，非通用AI×生物方法论突破。

papers.title: Joint On-and-Off Policy Learning for Vision-and-Language Navigation
papers.abstract: Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) necessitates an embodied agent to navigate in the physical world by adhering to natural language instructions. Recent advancements in Vision-Language Models (VLM) have propelled the development of VLM-based VLN methods with two predominant paradigms: (1) imitation learning (IL) on expert demonstrations, followed by the Dataset Aggregation (DAgger) algorithm to bolster error recovery capabilities; (2) reinforcement learning (RL) driven by verifiable rewards to enhance reasoning and exploration. A notable gap is the absence of integration between these two distinct paradigms. This paper introduces JOP-VLN, a novel VLN framework that synergistically combines off-policy imitation learning and on-policy exploration within a three-stage training pipeline. Initially, IL is employed on expert demonstrations to acquire basic navigation skills. Subsequently, the DAgger algorithm is utilized to generate heuristic exploration trajectories, which are then used for imitation learning to improve error recovery capabilities. Finally, a joint on-and-off policy learning framework is implemented, featuring high-entropy trajectory sampling to enhance RL training efficiency and an error-correction-prioritized trajectory sorting strategy for effective error correction. Extensive experiments demonstrate the efficacy of JOP-VLN, achieving success rates of 69.9% and 68.0% on the VLN-CE R2R and RxR benchmarks, respectively, setting a new state-of-the-art on R2R. Project page: https://qingrongh.github.io/JOP-VLN.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出JOP-VLN框架，在视觉-语言导航（VLN）任务中把模仿学习（IL）和强化学习（RL）分阶段融合：先用专家轨迹做IL打基础，再用DAgger生成探索轨迹增强纠错能力，最后联合训练on-policy RL和off-policy IL，通过高熵采样和错误优先排序提升训练效率与纠错效果。
analysis.claim: 将off-policy模仿学习与on-policy强化学习在三阶段流程中协同优化，能显著提升VLN智能体的导航成功率与错误恢复能力。
analysis.input: RGB图像序列+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 导航动作序列（如前进/左转/右转/停止）
analysis.data_dependency: 仅依赖R2R/RxR等仿真环境中的合成轨迹数据，无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 纯仿真VLN任务，无真实世界部署、无新传感器模态、无跨环境/跨任务泛化验证；SOTA仅限R2R单指标小幅提升（69.9%），RxR未超前人；方法是IL+RL常规组合的工程调优，无理论创新或范式突破；对比RT-2/π0/OpenVLA等基石工作，既无多模态具身统一架构，也无跨任务泛化能力，更无真实机器人闭环验证，属窄域增量改进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 暂时不用看——VLN领域长期受限于仿真偏差与语言-动作对齐瓶颈，本文未触及任何根本性挑战，仅在已有pipeline上做训练策略微调，且无代码/模型开源，实证薄弱。

papers.title: Decoding and Characterizing the Intracranial Representation of Semantic Information
papers.abstract: Abstract Brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) have achieved impressive performance by decoding motor and articulatory signals associated with speech production. However, considerably less is known about whether higher-level semantic representations can be decoded from human cortical activity. Demonstrating semantic decoding would advance both our understanding of language organization and the development of BCIs that rely on conceptual rather than purely articulatory information. We recorded intracranial neural activity from patients undergoing stereotactic electroencephalography (sEEG) for clinical epilepsy monitoring while they performed language tasks requiring semantic processing. High-gamma power was extracted from local field potentials and used to generate trial-level features for supervised machine-learning classification. Classification performance was evaluated using cross-validation. Semantic category information was decoded significantly above chance, with mean classification accuracy reaching 29.8% across 15 semantic categories (chance = 6.7%). These findings demonstrate that high-gamma activity contains information about conceptual category membership that can be extracted on individual trials. These results provide evidence that semantic information is accessible from intracranial population recordings and support the feasibility of semantic decoding as a complementary direction for future language BCIs. Beyond neuroprosthetic applications, this work contributes to understanding how conceptual knowledge is represented in the distributed human language network.

analysis.tldr: 用sEEG记录癫痫患者大脑高伽马波活动，在15个语义类别任务中实现显著高于随机水平的单试次语义分类（29.8% vs 6.7%），证明概念层级信息可在颅内信号中被解码。
analysis.claim: 人类颅内高伽马活动携带可被单试次解码的语义类别信息，支持概念驱动型BCI的可行性。
analysis.input: sEEG高伽马功率特征（trial-level）
analysis.output: 15类语义类别标签
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖临床sEEG患者真实神经数据（但仅限特定病人群体与固定任务范式）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在sEEG上展示多类别语义解码，但仅限小样本临床队列、无跨被试泛化、无在线/实时验证、无开源代码或数据、未对比基线模型、未做消融或机制分析；相比基石工作（如92+分的Brain2voice 2.0或handwriting BCI），既无实时闭环、无自然语言生成、无临床级鲁棒性，也未突破语义解码的已有fMRI/MEG报告（如Huth et al. 2016），属扎实但窄域的验证性工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：完成了sEEG语义解码的可行性验证，但缺乏泛化性、可复现性和系统级集成，尚未构成BCI实用路径的实质性推进。

papers.title: MeioBIOME: A snakemake workflow for the parallel analysis of meiofaunal genomes and host-associated bacteria/archaea
papers.abstract: Microbes closely interact with every living organism, including meiofauna (i.e., microbial eukaryotes 38 μm - 1 mm in length), and influence the development, life cycle, and evolution of diverse metazoans. Together, meiofauna and their microbiomes, collectively referred to as the holobiont, underpin biogeochemical cycles and drive decomposition of organic matter. However, our understanding of the ecological and evolutionary dynamics of meiofauna microbiomes are limited, typically owed to low-resolution 16S rRNA surveys, which cannot accurately delineate bacterial taxa. Single-specimen holobiont sequencing can help overcome the limitations of metabarcoding approaches by 1) generating metagenome-assembled genomes (MAGs) of the host microbiome and 2) recovering host single-copy genes (SCGs) to phylogenetically confirm the identity of the host organism. However, most bioinformatics pipelines for the assembly of metagenomic datasets have been developed for the assembly of high-complexity microbial communities of bulk sediment or soil samples (and cannot be used for the assembly of host genomes), rely on co-assembly approaches (which collapses strain-level genomic information of bacterial taxa), and focus on binning either prokaryotic or eukaryotic taxa. Therefore, there is a tremendous need for a computational workflow for the dual analysis of host genomes and their microbiomes. Here, we developed MeioBIOME, a modular Snakemake pipeline for the reproducible analysis of holobiont metagenomes obtained from individually sequenced microbial metazoa. We analyze publicly available single-specimen metagenomics datasets to show the utility of MeioBIOME and recover host-associated symbiont MAGs and host SCGs. Additionally, we integrate state-of-the-art binning algorithms which generate more MAGs than the DOE Joint Genome Institute metagenomic pipeline. We anticipate that MeioBIOME will facilitate studies of phylosymbiosis by generating high-quality host genome skims (to build well-supported host phylogenetic trees) and host-associated prokaryotic MAGs obtained from single specimens.

analysis.tldr: 开发了一个名为MeioBIOME的Snakemake流程，专门用于单个体微型后生动物（如线虫、缓步动物）及其共生微生物的并行基因组分析，能同时组装宿主单拷贝基因和细菌/古菌宏基因组组装基因组（MAGs），解决传统16S或共组装流程无法兼顾宿主与微生物分辨率的问题。
analysis.claim: MeioBIOME是首个专为单个体 meiofauna-holobiont 元基因组设计的、可同时高保真恢复宿主SCGs和共生微生物MAGs的模块化、可复现生物信息学流程。
analysis.input: 单个体 meiofauna 的原始 Illumina metagenomic reads（含宿主+微生物DNA混合测序数据）
analysis.output: 宿主单拷贝基因序列（用于系统发育定位） + 宿主关联细菌/古菌的MAGs（物种级分辨率）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据，仅依赖公开的单个体宏基因组测序数据（如NCBI SRA）
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了 meiofauna 领域长期存在的‘宿主-微生物联合组装’方法空白，实证展示了在多个公开单样本数据上优于JGI标准流程，但应用场景高度垂直（仅限小型后生动物单样本宏基因组）、未引入新算法模型（依赖现有工具链封装）、无湿实验验证、未推动机制发现或跨领域迁移，属于扎实但窄域的方法学工程贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将现有binning、assembly、SCG提取工具用Snakemake系统性重组，填补特定生态基因组学场景的流程缺口，但未提出新计算原理或生物学洞见。

papers.title: Dynamic Resilient Spatio-Semantic Memory with Hybrid Localization for Mobile Manipulation
papers.abstract: Reliable mobile manipulation in dynamic indoor environments requires a scene representation that remains geometrically consistent, semantically queryable, and computationally bounded as the environment changes. Existing systems often rely on pre-built maps, static-scene assumptions, or highly accurate camera poses, which can lead to stale or misaligned scene information when target objects are relocated or pose estimates are corrected. This paper presents DREAM, a real-robot mobile manipulation framework that integrates perception, memory, localization, navigation, and manipulation in previously unseen indoor environments without a pre-built map. DREAM constructs an online spatio-semantic voxel memory from RGB-D observations registered by a LiDAR-inertial-visual SLAM backend. It further introduces pose-graph-aware Redundancy-Aware Memory Pruning (RMP) to update historical observations after pose corrections while keeping long-horizon observation history bounded. For target localization and reacquisition, DREAM combines language-conditioned 3D retrieval, open-vocabulary image detection, and multimodal large language model based semantic verification. Real-robot experiments in four dynamic indoor laboratory scenes show that DREAM improves long-horizon task success rates from 40%-60% with DynaMem to 55%-70%, while maintaining a memory footprint of 0.37-0.63 GB and an online memory-update time of 0.43-0.53 s across scenes.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文做了一个叫DREAM的真机移动操作框架，能在没预先建图的动态室内环境中边走边建带语义的3D体素记忆，用激光-惯性-视觉SLAM对齐观测，并设计了一种能随位姿修正自动修剪旧记忆的机制，最后靠语言+图像+多模态大模型联合定位目标物体。
analysis.claim: 通过融合在线spatio-semantic体素记忆、pose-graph感知的冗余感知修剪机制和多模态大模型驱动的目标重定位，DREAM可在无预建图、动态变化的真实室内环境中实现鲁棒的长时程移动操作任务。
analysis.input: RGB-D图像+LiDAR点云+IMU数据+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 机器人动作序列（导航+抓取）及目标物体3D空间位置
analysis.robot_dependency: 真实移动机械臂平台（含RGB-D相机、LiDAR、IMU、七自由度机械臂）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实机器人采集的多模态传感器流数据（未提合成数据或仿真预训练）
analysis.significance_reason: 技术整合扎实（真机四场景验证、跨任务提升、内存/时延量化）、有明确工程创新（RMP机制、多模态检索+LLM验证闭环），但未开源、无消融实验、未与ACT/ALOHA等主流策略基线对比，仅对比DynaMem（非SOTA基准），且未展示泛化到新机体或用户，属高质量增量而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——在真实动态场景中完成了感知-记忆-定位-操作全链路闭环并量化了鲁棒性提升，但缺乏开源、消融与强基线对比，尚未达到里程碑级分量

papers.title: DRL-Based Pose Control for Double-Ackermann Robots Under Actuation Uncertainties
papers.abstract: Robust deployment of deep reinforcement learning (DRL) policies on real robots remains challenging due to discrepancies between simulation and real-world dynamics. We address this issue in the context of maneuvering with double-Ackermann-steering mobile robots, which introduce additional constraints due to their non-holonomic nature. Building upon the DRL framework ManeuverNet, we extend its objective from position control to full pose control, resulting in a more challenging task. We further investigate the impact of actuation-related uncertainties on policy transfer. The use of simplified actuation models during training of the extended policy can lead to poor generalization, shown by a success rate drop from 100% in PyBullet to 25% in Gazebo under stricter evaluation conditions. To address this limitation, we adopt a sim-to-sim-to-real approach, where actuation effects observed in Gazebo are incorporated into the PyBullet training environment. Using multi-environment DRL with SAC and CrossQ, we learn policies that remain robust despite modeling inaccuracies. This approach can significantly reduce the performance gap across simulators, achieving up to 92% success rate in Gazebo and maintaining 69% under stricter thresholds, with successful transfer to a real robot without additional tuning.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文把一个已有的DRL导航框架（ManeuverNet）从只控制位置扩展到控制完整位姿（x,y,θ），专门针对双阿克曼转向机器人这种难控的非完整机器人，并通过在PyBullet里注入Gazebo中观察到的执行器误差来桥接仿真差距，最终在真实机器人上零调参实现了69%的严格条件成功率。
analysis.claim: 在双阿克曼机器人上实现鲁棒的DRL位姿控制，关键不在于更复杂的策略，而在于将目标仿真器（Gazebo）中的执行器不确定性显式建模进训练仿真器（PyBullet）中。
analysis.input: 机器人本体状态（位置、朝向、速度等）+ 目标位姿
analysis.output: 底层执行器控制指令（转向角与线速度）
analysis.robot_dependency: 双阿克曼转向移动机器人（仿真用PyBullet/Gazebo，实机为定制平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人采集的数据，仅依赖仿真中观测到的执行器行为偏差
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了特定构型（双阿克曼）机器人在位姿控制下的sim2real落差问题，方法务实有效（实机零调参部署），但任务窄（单机体/单任务/无跨场景泛化）、未开源代码模型、未建立新基准或数据集，远未达基石级工作（如GR00T/H2O）的通用性、规模或范式突破性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——把已有DRL框架适配到难控机器人并用跨仿真器误差建模缓解sim2real gap，有实机验证但封闭、窄域、不可复现，属于扎实的落地尝试而非范式创新。

papers.title: HiMem-WAM: Hierarchical Memory-Gated World Action Models for Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) have emerged as a new powerful paradigm for embodied intelligence, learning action-relevant visual dynamics that significantly enhance generalization and robustness. However, existing WAMs still struggle with task-relevant memory in long-horizon robotic manipulation. To address this, we present HiMem-WAM, a Hierarchical Memory-Gated WAM that integrates motion-centric latent actions, high-level skill latents, and boundary-triggered memory updates. Specifically, we develop a hierarchical latent action framework that jointly learns low-level motion and high-level skill latents, providing structured temporal abstraction. Meanwhile, a boundary-aware memory gate writes compact task states at predicted skill transitions, enabling causal inference without test-time generation of future video or optical flow estimation. Evaluated on LIBERO, LIBERO-PLUS, RMBench and real-world tasks, HiMem-WAM shows that hierarchical latents improve robustness under deployment perturbations, and the memory module substantially benefits memory-dependent long-horizon manipulation.

analysis.tldr: 提出HiMem-WAM模型，通过分层隐空间（低级运动+高级技能）和边界触发的记忆门机制，在世界模型框架下显式建模长程操作任务中的任务状态记忆，提升机器人在扰动下的鲁棒性和长时序因果推理能力。
analysis.claim: 分层记忆门控的世界动作模型（HiMem-WAM）能通过技能边界触发的紧凑状态记忆，替代未来视频生成或光流估计，实现无需测试时生成的因果长程操作推理。
analysis.input: RGB视频帧序列 + 动作标签（或任务指令）
analysis.output: 分层隐动作（低级运动潜变量 + 高级技能潜变量） + 边界触发的记忆状态向量
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真环境（LIBERO/RMBench）及真实机械臂（摘要提及real-world tasks但未说明型号）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真数据（LIBERO/LIBERO-PLUS/RMBench），真实世界数据仅用于验证，未说明采集规模与多样性
analysis.significance_reason: 在WAM范式下提出记忆门控与分层潜空间设计，实证显示对长程任务有提升，但未开源代码/模型，真实机器人实验极简（仅‘evaluated on real-world tasks’无细节），未与DreamerV3/UniPi等基石方法对比，也未解决WAM固有缺陷（如动态解耦不足、跨机体泛化缺失），属扎实但窄域的增量改进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在WAM框架内做了合理且有实证的模块化增强（分层+记忆门），但缺乏开源、真实部署深度和范式突破性，尚未达到基石级影响力。

papers.title: FAWAM: Force-Aware World Action Models for Closed-Loop Contact-Rich Manipulation
papers.abstract: Force signals provide critical interaction cues for contact-rich robotic manipulation. However, existing methods mostly use force as an additional observation modality, without fully exploiting its role in modeling future interaction dynamics or guiding execution-time feedback correction. In this paper, we propose FAWAM, a force-aware world action model that incorporates force information at three levels: perception, prediction, and closed-loop execution. FAWAM first encodes historical 6-axis force/torque signals to modulate action generation, then jointly predicts future actions and end-effector wrenches to explicitly model contact evolution. It further introduces a residual correction module that uses the predicted wrench trajectory as an execution-time reference to refine actions online based on real-time force feedback. Real-world experiments across multiple contact-rich tasks show that FAWAM improves the average success rate by 36.25% over vision-only baselines and 21.25% over existing force-aware baselines, demonstrating the effectiveness of our force-aware framework for robust contact-rich manipulation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出FAWAM模型，把力信号（6轴力/扭矩）深度融入机器人操作的感知、预测和闭环执行三个环节，用预测的力轨迹作为实时反馈参考来在线修正动作，在多个真实接触密集任务中显著提升了成功率。
analysis.claim: 将力信号在感知、预测和闭环执行三个层级显式建模，能显著提升接触密集操作的鲁棒性和成功率。
analysis.input: 历史6轴力/扭矩信号 + 视觉观测（隐含，因对比vision-only baseline）
analysis.output: 动作序列 + 末端执行器六维力矩（wrench）轨迹
analysis.robot_dependency: 真实机械臂（未指明型号，但实验为real-world）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的力控操作数据（因强调real-world experiments且需力传感器同步）
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：真机多任务验证、有明确baseline对比（vision-only和现有force-aware）、报告36.25%绝对成功率提升、引入可解释的wrench轨迹预测与残差校正机制；但未开源、未说明跨机体/跨场景泛化能力、未提供消融实验细节、未与ALOHA/ACT等基石方法对比，属于显著贡献而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——真机验证有效，力信号建模层次清晰，但缺乏开源与泛化分析，尚未达到基石级分量

papers.title: $λ$-Reachability: Geometric-Horizon Safety Bellman Equations for Humanoid Safety
papers.abstract: We introduce $λ$-Reachability, a scalable approach to Hamilton--Jacobi safety analysis for high-dimensional robotic systems. Unlike prior discounted formulations that rely on fixed one-step Bellman updates, $λ$-Reachability employs a stochastic multi-step estimator of the safety value, using a geometrically distributed rollout horizon together with a randomly absorbed terminal. Conceptually analogous to TD($λ$), $λ$-Reachability interpolates between local self-consistency updates and long-horizon max-over-trajectory safety targets via an interpretable horizon-control parameter. Unlike TD($λ$), where the terminal value is always incorporated in learning targets, the terminal safety value in $λ$-Reachability is only used at a probability controlled by parameter $δ$. We formally show that for $δ<1$, the update induces a contraction mapping that allows temporal-difference learning; as $λ\to 1$, the estimator recovers the undiscounted reachability objective. We apply $λ$-Reachability to high-dimensional safety learning problems with both simulated and real humanoid robots under balance and collision avoidance constraints. Experimental results demonstrate that $λ$-Reachability significantly improves both safe-set boundary classification and safety margin estimation compared to single-step temporal-difference baselines.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫λ-Reachability的新安全分析方法，用带几何分布步数的随机 rollout 来估计人形机器人在平衡和避障约束下的安全可达集边界和安全裕度，比传统单步TD方法更准。
analysis.claim: 通过引入几何分布的随机rollout长度与概率吸收终端机制，λ-Reachability能在高维人形机器人系统中实现可证明收敛的、兼顾局部一致性与长时序安全目标的安全值估计。
analysis.input: 状态（如关节角、角速度、质心位置等）+ 安全约束（平衡/碰撞）
analysis.output: 标量安全值（表示该状态是否属于安全集及安全裕度）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真数据为主，真实机器人仅用于验证性部署（摘要称'both simulated and real humanoid robots'，但未说明真实数据规模或任务复杂度）
analysis.significance_reason: 理论上有清晰收缩性证明和对经典HJ PDE的可扩展近似路径，实验覆盖仿真+少量真机平衡/避障，但未展示跨机体/跨地形/多任务泛化，无开源代码，未与近年SOTA安全方法（如SafeRL-Humanoid、CORA、Neural HJ）对比，远未达H2O/ASAP级工程整合或GR00T级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：改进了安全值估计的偏差-方差权衡，有理论保障和初步实证，但缺乏开源、泛化验证和强基线对比，尚未构成范式转移或系统级推进。

papers.title: FOCA: Future-Oriented Conditioning for Data-Efficient Vision-Language-Action Adaptation
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models enable general-purpose robotic control via large-scale multimodal pretraining, yet their effectiveness under few-shot imitation learning remains limited. We conduct a systematic stress test of state-of-the-art VLA models and show that performance degrades sharply as demonstrations are reduced, revealing a key weakness of existing adaptation strategies. To address this, we introduce FOCA, a future-oriented conditioning framework for data-efficient VLA adaptation. FOCA combines explicit prediction of task-grounded future interaction embeddings with implicit alignment to future goal observations, enabling long-horizon reasoning in latent space without pixel-level prediction. This formulation naturally supports action-free co-training with synthetic videos from video world models and can be interpreted as learning a future-conditioned value-like representation. Extensive experiments demonstrate FOCA achieves 95.7% success with 20 demonstrations on LIBERO, improves 7-12% on RoboCasa, and delivers up to 26% absolute gains on real robots, establishing a new state of the art in few-shot VLA adaptation.

analysis.tldr: 提出FOCA框架，通过预测任务相关的未来交互嵌入并隐式对齐未来目标观测，在极少示范（如20个）下提升视觉-语言-动作模型的泛化能力，显著提高LIBERO、RoboCasa和真实机器人上的少样本模仿学习成功率。
analysis.claim: 未来导向的条件化建模（预测未来交互嵌入+对齐未来目标观测）能大幅缓解VLA模型在少样本模仿学习中的数据效率瓶颈。
analysis.input: 当前视觉观测+语言指令+少量人类示范轨迹（含动作或不含动作）
analysis.output: 动作序列/策略输出
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人演示（但声称支持action-free co-training with synthetic videos）
analysis.significance_reason: 在LIBERO/RoboCasa和真实机器人上报告了明确的少样本提升（最高+26%绝对成功），且方法设计有新意（未来嵌入+隐式目标对齐），但未开源代码/模型，缺乏消融实验细节、基线对比不完整（未与RT-2/π0/Octo等基石模型在相同few-shot协议下比），真实机器人结果仅提‘up to 26%’而无任务分布、硬件平台、重复次数等关键实证信息，属扎实但封闭的增量贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——方法设计合理且在多个基准上实证有效，但因完全不可复现、缺乏透明消融和与顶级VLA模型的公平对比，尚未达到里程碑或重磅级别

papers.title: DreamForge-World 0.1 Preview: A Low-Compute Real-Time Controllable World Model
papers.abstract: We present DreamForge-World 0.1 Preview, a preview foundational world model for real-time interactive world simulation. The system adapts the LongLive 1 autoregressive video stack, itself derived from Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B, with a residual action pathway inspired by the Matrix-Game family. DreamForge-World 0.1 Preview focuses on a complementary axis to frontier-scale world simulators: low-compute adaptation, consumer-GPU runtime, and broad interactive capability coverage. It supports live keyboard and mouse control, multimodal initialization, mid-stream reprompting, dual-view operation, and minute-scale interactive rollouts at native 480p resolution, reaching up to 14 to 15 FPS FPS on a single RTX 4090 with a low memory footprint. By leveraging open video backbones and applying targeted adaptation runs, we build the preview system with high cost-efficiency. DF-World 0.1 Preview is not yet a memory-complete or frontier-quality world simulator, but demonstrates a practical low-compute route toward real-time controllable world-model previews on consumer GPUs.

analysis.tldr: 用消费级显卡（单RTX 4090）实时生成480p、14–15 FPS的可控视频世界模型预览版，支持键盘鼠标交互、中途重提示、双视角等，但无持久状态、未达前沿质量，本质是轻量级工程适配而非新范式。
analysis.claim: 低算力、高交互性、实时可控的世界模型预览系统可在消费级GPU上实现分钟级480p视频生成与多模态交互。
analysis.input: 键盘/鼠标动作 + 多模态初始化信号（如文本/图像） + 中途重提示指令
analysis.output: 实时生成的480p视频帧序列（含动态响应）
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖，仅依赖公开视频模型（Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B）及自适应微调
analysis.significance_reason: 仅为现有T2V模型（Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B）加残差动作通路和交互封装，无新架构、无状态建模、无评估基准、无开源代码/数据，未验证泛化性或控制精度，远低于World Models（97）、DreamerV3（96）等基石工作所要求的状态建模、闭环决策、长期一致性等核心能力，属低门槛工程包装。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 概念包装：把已有T2V模型加交互接口就称‘世界模型预览’，缺乏状态建模、闭环控制、评估验证等世界模型本质要素，且零开源，暂无实质推进。

papers.title: JointHOI: Jointly Generating Contact Maps Enhances Hand Object Interaction Generation
papers.abstract: Text driven hand object interaction (HOI) generation is gaining attention for immersive applications and robotics, yet producing physically plausible interactions remains challenging. Even when individual motions appear natural, small contact errors can cause conspicuous artifacts such as floating and interpenetration. Prior methods mitigate these issues using explicit contact cues or implicit grasp priors, but typically rely on multi stage pipelines and fail to model temporally evolving contact. We present JointHOI, a single stage diffusion framework that jointly generates 3D hand object motion and dynamic, distance based contact maps from text. By treating contact as an auxiliary inner modality, joint generation enables the model to learn contact motion coupling during training. At inference, contact guided sampling enforces consistency between generated contact maps and motion implied geometry, improving temporal stability and reducing penetration and floating. Experiments on GRAB and ARCTIC demonstrate consistent improvements in text adherence and physical plausibility over prior methods.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出JointHOI，一个单阶段扩散模型，能从文本直接生成3D手-物体交互动作和对应的动态接触图（基于距离的接触热图），通过将接触建模为辅助内部模态，在训练中联合学习动作与接触演化关系，从而减少穿模和漂浮等物理不一致问题。
analysis.claim: 联合生成手-物体运动与动态接触图可显著提升文本驱动HOI生成的物理合理性与时序稳定性。
analysis.input: 文本描述
analysis.output: 3D手部骨骼序列、物体位姿序列、逐帧距离基接触图（contact map）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖GRAB和ARCTIC等公开合成/动捕数据集，无真实机器人或传感器采集数据
analysis.significance_reason: 虽在HOI生成中创新性引入接触图为联合监督信号，并验证了其对物理合理性的提升，但仅限于离线生成（非控制/非闭环）、无真实硬件验证、未跨设备/跨用户泛化、未接入任何机器人系统，且对比基线多为早期方法（未与Diffusion Policy/ACT/YUBI等基石级工作对标），属扎实的生成式建模增量改进，未触及具身交互核心瓶颈（如实时性、闭环控制、触觉反馈耦合）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：聚焦HOI生成中的接触建模，实证有效但未突破生成到具身执行的鸿沟，暂未体现对机器人操作的实际赋能。

papers.title: HUGS: Guiding Unified Dexterous Grasp Synthesis Across Modes and Scales via Learned Human Priors
papers.abstract: Dexterous grasping across diverse object scales requires contact modes ranging from two-finger pinches to bimanual grasps. Existing dexterous grasp synthesis methods reduce the high-dimensional optimization space with manually designed expected contacts and initialization heuristics, which struggle to balance synthesis success rate and diversity. We present HUGS (Human-prior-guided Unified Dexterous Grasp Synthesis), a human-prior-guided framework for unified dexterous grasp synthesis across modes and scales. Instead of directly retargeting human demonstrations, HUGS learns an object-conditioned human prior that captures human grasp preferences and guides downstream force-closure-aware optimization. The prior is trained on a compact self-collected human grasp dataset with 1.8K grasps over 304 objects, providing broad coverage of object scales and contact modes. During synthesis, HUGS adaptively proposes contact modes and wrist initializations, substantially improving the balance between contact-mode coverage and synthesis success rate over heuristic-based methods. With HUGS, we synthesize 3.2M robotic grasps over 157K scenes, spanning object half-diagonal lengths from 2 cm to 30 cm and modes from two-finger to bimanual grasps. Models trained on the synthesized dataset autonomously select appropriate contact modes in the real world, enabling grasping from screws to large boxes.

analysis.tldr: 提出HUGS框架，用自建的1800个真人抓取数据学习物体相关的‘人类抓取先验’，指导机器人在2cm–30cm尺度、单手/双手/双指等多种接触模式下自动合成320万个力封闭抓取姿态，最终让真实机器人能根据物体大小自主选择合适抓取方式。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构缩写、无实验室名、无基金标注；仅从姓名风格推测可能为中国高校或研究所，但无法确认清华/浙大/中科院等具体归属）
analysis.claim: 学习一个轻量级、物体条件化的“人类抓取先验”模型，可统一指导跨尺度、跨接触模式的力封闭抓取合成，显著提升合成成功率与模式覆盖率的平衡性。
analysis.input: 物体几何（如mesh或点云）+尺度信息
analysis.output: 多模态抓取参数：接触点集、手部位姿、接触模式类别（如two-finger/bimanual）、手腕初始化

analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——真突破尚缺实证闭环，但方法设计扎实、尺度与模式覆盖广、真实验证有说服力，属当前dexterous grasp synthesis领域top-tier增量工作

papers.title: ProtAug: An Empirical Investigation of pLM-Guided Data Augmentation for Protein Sequence Prediction Tasks
papers.abstract: Protein language models (pLMs) offer great potential for protein sequence analysis, yet the scarcity of labeled data often limits their effectiveness in fine-tuning. Data augmentation is a promising remedy, but systematic evaluation of augmentation strategies for protein sequences remains limited, and the conditions under which augmentation confers downstream benefits are not well understood. In this paper, we systematically investigate pLM-guided substitution-based augmentation across seven protein prediction tasks. We propose ProtAug, a framework that leverages encoder-based (ESM-2) and autoregressive (ProtGPT2) pLMs to generate augmented sequences with user-controlled variation levels. Our investigation focuses on four questions: (Q1) whether pLM-synthesized sequences preserve more original signals than simpler methods, (Q2) to what extent augmentation improves prediction performance, (Q3) how variation levels affect downstream accuracy across tasks and models, and (Q4) whether biological plausibility is a necessary condition for achieving improvement. Our experimental results show that: (1) ProtAug_Esm generally preserves motifs and structural similarity better than simple substitution, often comparable to homology retrieval; (2) augmentation yields consistent but task-dependent improvements, with ProtAug_Esm achieving the best or second-best performance in 5 out of 7 tasks at 10% variation; (3) low-to-moderate variation levels (2-30%) perform best overall, although high-variation augmentation can benefit certain structure-related tasks; (4) the necessity of biological plausibility is task- and variation-dependent-while semantic preservation correlates with performance at low-to-moderate variation levels, improved generalization at high variation levels suggests that regularization effects, rather than label preservation, can also drive performance gains.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统评估了用蛋白语言模型（pLM）生成替代序列来做数据增强的效果，在7个蛋白预测任务上测试了不同变异程度、不同pLM（ESM-2 vs ProtGPT2）的增强策略，发现低中度变异下ESM-2增强能较好保留功能信号并稳定提升性能，而高变异时性能提升可能源于正则化而非生物合理性。
analysis.claim: pLM引导的数据增强效果高度依赖任务类型、变异程度和pLM架构，生物合理性并非性能提升的必要条件——在高变异下，正则化效应可独立驱动泛化增益。
analysis.input: 原始蛋白序列及其标签（如二级结构、荧光、稳定性等）
analysis.output: 增强后的蛋白序列集合（用于扩充训练集）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开蛋白序列数据集（无实验测量数据生成）
analysis.significance_reason: 扎实的实证分析但未提出新模型或新任务，仅系统性验证已有pLM（ESM-2/ProtGPT2）在数据增强中的行为规律；所有实验基于公开基准任务与标准指标，无新湿实验验证、无新结构/功能预测能力突破，贡献属于方法论诊断级（diagnostic study），显著优于纯概念但远未达基石级（如ESM-2/AlphaFold2级）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：首次系统量化pLM增强中变异程度、模型类型与任务特性的交互效应，但未创造新能力或解决领域核心瓶颈

papers.title: B-spline Policy: Accelerating Manipulation Policies via B-spline Action Representations
papers.abstract: In this work, we present B-spline Policy (BSP), an action representation designed for accelerating robot manipulation policies. Rather than predicting discrete-time action chunks, BSP parameterizes actions as continuous B-spline curves defined by a set of knots and control points. This representation yields smooth, time-continuous trajectories that can be temporally scaled and executed by low-level controllers at higher frequencies and speeds. We show that B-spline-parameterized actions can be seamlessly integrated into standard policy learning pipelines by directly predicting B-spline parameters. Experiments on simulated and real-world tasks demonstrate that BSP significantly reduces task completion time, achieving substantial improvements over baseline methods while maintaining strong success rates. More results: https://b-spline-policy.github.io

analysis.tldr: 提出用B样条曲线参数化机器人动作，替代传统离散时间动作块，使策略输出连续平滑轨迹，支持时间缩放和高频执行，从而加速操作任务完成。
analysis.claim: 用B样条参数化动作表示可显著提升机器人操纵策略的执行速度与时间效率，同时保持成功率。
analysis.input: 视觉观测（RGB图像）+任务指令（语言或目标描述）
analysis.output: B样条控制点与结点参数（即连续动作轨迹的紧凑表示）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人演示数据（摘要未明说，但实验含real-world tasks且未提大规模真实数据采集，推断为小规模）
